title: Sr. Technical Program Manager, Content Localization, Understanding and Enrichment
descriptionHtml:
Come build the future of entertainment with us. Prime Video is a premium streaming service that offers customers a vast collection of TV shows and movies, all with the ease of finding what they love to watch in one place. We offer customers thousands of popular movies and TV shows including Amazon Originals and exclusive licensed content to exciting live sports events.

Prime Video's CLUE ( Content Localization, Understanding and Enrichment) organization is seeking a Senior Technical Program Manager to lead complex, cross-organizational programs that drive Prime Video's technology and product evolution. This role operates across multiple organizations, delivering initiatives where the problem and strategy may not yet be fully defined. You will use your expertise and judgment to determine the right goals, design long-term solutions, and align stakeholders to deliver outcomes with meaningful customer and business impact.

As a Senior TPM, you will lead programs that sit across domains including Content Understanding, Content Derivatives, Artwork, Metadata, Trust and Safety. You will partner with engineering, product, science, and business leaders across Prime Video to drive technical decisions, simplify complex problem spaces, and deliver solutions that leverage ML/AI capabilities to advance our mission of being the first-stop entertainment destination for hundreds of millions of customers worldwide.

Key job responsibilities
- Lead and deliver complex programs with cross-organizational impact, operating across multiple organizations within Prime Video
- Drive clarity in ambiguous spaces where the problem, strategy, and solution path may not yet be fully defined
- Define program scope, requirements, and long-term plans for initiatives with high leadership visibility
- Identify gaps and risks across systems and teams; design simplified solutions that address constraints and deliver the best outcome
- Drive technical decisions and architectural trade-offs across engineering teams, representing benefits and challenges of each approach
- Partner with science and engineering teams to integrate ML/AI capabilities into cross-domain programs
- Influence stakeholders and partner teams through data-driven judgment to align on the right goals and priorities
- Build consensus across organizations, presenting complex decisions and trade-offs clearly to senior leadership
- Establish and drive program mechanisms that ensure consistent delivery and long-term operational excellence
- Clear roadblocks with the right resources, escalating when appropriate to maintain program momentum
- Simplify and drive the use of best practices across the TPM and engineering communities
- Mentor and develop other TPMs on the team


A day in the life
Your primary focus is driving complex, cross-team programs from ambiguity to delivery. On any given day, you might be defining requirements with engineering leads, clearing roadblocks across partner teams, or presenting program trade-offs to senior leadership. You will work closely with science and product teams to integrate ML/AI capabilities into customer-facing experiences. You will balance tactical execution with strategic thinking, making trade-offs between short and long-term needs. Beyond program delivery, you will contribute to team mechanisms, mentor other TPMs, and help shape how we operate .

About the team
The Content Understanding and Derivatives team delivers AI-powered content analysis that drives customer engagement and monetization across Prime Video's global catalog. Our systems generate derivative assets and metadata at scale, enabling personalization, advertising, and playback experiences that increase viewing time and revenue. We operate within PV CPL (L10) and CLUE (L8), delivering impact through three strategic capabilities:

Content Understanding & Search creates the foundational data layer (MediaCoRE) and search infrastructure (MCX) that powers critical downstream applications including Metronome, Ad placements, and Trust and Safety operations.
Content Derivatives generates customer-facing assets—clips and artwork—that increase content discovery and engagement across all territories.
Content Metadata produces enriched metadata (Genre, Mood, Ad cue points, Binge watch timecodes) that enables PV Personalization, Ads, and Playback teams to optimize display and viewing experiences.

Our AI systems operate at catalog scale across all territories, providing the intelligence layer that connects content to customers and drives key business metrics.

- 5+ years of technical product or program management experience
- 3+ years of software development experience
- 5+ years of technical program management working directly with software engineering teams experience
- Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
- Experience building and evaluating system-level technical design
- Experience developing and executing/delivering product and technical roadmaps

Preferred qualifications

- 5+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
- Experience defining KPI's/SLA's used to drive multi-million dollar businesses and reporting to senior leadership

title: Principal Applied Scientist, Prime AI/ML Science
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Prime is building the future of AI-based personalization in driving long-term value out of the Prime subscription. Join our team of Scientists and Engineers developing AI/ML models to predict the Prime customer long-term behavior and optimize the customer experience with the Prime program. This includes identifying who our customers are, modeling customer behavior, and creating personalization systems to optimize the experience. As an AI/ML expert, you will partner directly with product owners to define the vision for this space and drive the roadmap for team execution.

This is a complex personalization and optimization challenge. We sit at the intersection of massive-scale subscription and behavioral data, real-time decision systems, hundreds of millions of customers, and intersection with other shopping and benefit data across Amazon. Our vision is to enable a data-driven intelligent foundation that powers the future of Prime through scalable personalization, generation, and decisioning capabilities that serve optimal, cohesive customer experiences across all touchpoints. We build the science and infrastructure that allows Prime to know each member deeply, decide what to show them and when, generate the right content in the right format, and measure whether it worked — all optimized toward long-term member value.

As a Principal Applied Scientist, you will be the intellectual engine behind this transformation. You will define the frontier, architect the science strategy for a large, cross-cutting organization, and drive breakthroughs that reshape how Prime thinks about customers and the membership program at the deepest level.

You will pioneer next-generation Gen AI / LLM-based foundation models that build rich, evolving models of customer intent. This will include building Gen AI/transformer architectures that abstract noisy behavioral signals into high-quality latent representations of human preference. It will require thinking about real-time, multi-objective, globally scalable ranking systems that address cold start problems at billions of decisions per day. You will do all of this as a force multiplier, building foundational technology that empowers scientists and engineers, and driving teams across Prime and Amazon to deliver the best science outcomes for customers.

Come define what the Prime membership program and experience looks like in the age of AI!

Strategic operations management: The RPM develops and executes regional procurement strategies to drive network growth and operational excellence. This includes managing complex supply chain needs through supplier performance frameworks and demand planning coordination across facilities. This role requires a deep understanding of operational requirements that drive measurable business impact, while supporting SME coordination and enabling SPMs achieve stablished KPIs.

People leadership: Leading a multi-site procurement team demands strong people management capabilities. The RPM builds and develops talent across geographically dispersed locations, ensuring team members have the tools and support needed to serve their respective sites effectively. This includes coaching SPMs and SC to maintain high performance standards and deliver consistent results across the network, while excelling in connection results.

Stakeholder management: Success in this role depends on strong partnerships with senior site leadership and regional support functions. The RPM collaborates with key operational stakeholders through quarterly one-on-one meetings and maintains open communication channels throughout the year. They drive efficiency improvements and align procurement strategies with site objectives, deeply understanding operations processes and brilliant basics. Additional responsibilities include representing SPO in regional leadership forums and GPO workstreams, supporting SPMs in achieving site QBR targets, and managing strategic relationships with internal partners and external suppliers. The RPM also oversees high-complexity service disruptions, high-risk contracts, and senior stakeholder expectations.

Cost optimization: The RPM develops direct reports capabilities to identify and capture sustainable savings aligned with company policies and reporting standards. RPMs ensure SPMs achieve regional targets through strategic procurement leadership, utilizing expertise in procurement strategy and category knowledge, while deploying company savings methodologies and value creation frameworks.

Network optimization: RPMs standardize procurement processes and FC service activities while managing supply chain initiatives. They apply analytical tools for supply base optimization, supplier segmentation, and lead cross-functional cost projects. RPMs align global category strategies with local execution and contribute to SPO Global Initiatives through standardized practices across the FC network.

Compliance and risk management: RPMs drive compliance and risk mitigation strategies. They ensure SPMs implement supplier governance frameworks, maintain procurement policy adherence, and manage supply chain risks. This includes oversight of due diligence processes (onboarding through Supplier Connect, TPS & others), contract compliance, and supplier adoption of required tools (including Avetta, Accurate or SR audit requirements).

The role requires strong Deliver Results, Earn Trust, Hire and Develop the Best, Insist on Highest Standards and Ownership.

- Experience in people management
- Experience in project management including resource planning, managing schedules, reporting project status and prioritizing tasks

title: Area Manager, Early Career (2027) - SoCal, HI
descriptionHtml:
Power that runs the world | Discover careers in Operations

Operations roles at Amazon put you at the center of how things move from a click to a doorstep. You'll help design, improve, and run systems that connect people, products, and places, at scale. You'll take ownership early, work closely with teams to solve real-world challenges, and see the direct results of your decisions as they reach customers every day. Here, the impact of what you build isn't abstract, it's visible, immediate, and meaningful - keeping one of the world's most complex operations moving forward. This is where your journey takes shape through action, responsibility, and the opportunity to grow in many directions.

This is not a corporate, remote or office-based position. This is a full-time, early career position located within one of Amazon’s fulfillment centers, sort centers, delivery stations or other operations buildings. Amazon is seeking customer focused individuals to lead a team of hourly employees across our Operations network! Our warehouses are fast-paced environments where standing, walking, and having on-the-production floor conversations are common as a supply chain leader.

As an Area Manager, you will be responsible for engaging, leading and developing your team in a warehouse environment. Your main focus will be motivating, mentoring, and managing your team to meet goals. Amazon provides extensive training and development to become an exceptional people leader. As a people manager, you will ensure that your team has all the tools needed to succeed and maintain the highest levels of safety, quality, attendance and performance at work.

Visit this page to find more information on each of our building types:

https://www.aboutamazon.com/workplace/facilities

Please note we are not able to provide sponsorship now or in the future for these positions. Eligible candidates must have work authorization without employer intervention to be considered.

This posting encompasses all openings in the country. Site placement is matched by aligning your location preferences with location availability after your interview. Relocation benefits are offered at time of offer to eligible candidates.

Benefits: Medical, financial, and/or other benefits. Visit this page to learn more about the benefits Amazon offers:

https://www.amazon.jobs/content/en/benefits


Key job responsibilities
• Support, mentor and motivate 50-100 direct report Amazon Associates.
• Work independently and operate in an autonomous environment.
• Stand/walk during shifts lasting up to 12 hours.
• Willing and able to regularly work shift patterns that include nights, weekends, and/or holidays based on business needs. While shifts vary site to site, most follow a fixed 4-day work week with 3 days off.
• Oversee truck deliveries, handle and sort packages using pallet jacks, operate PIT. equipment (at applicable facilities) and step in as needed.
• Work in an environment where the noise level varies.
• Lift up to 49 pounds and frequently push, pull, squat, bend and reach.
• Climb and descend stairs (when applicable).

A day in the life
As an Area Manager, no two days look exactly the same, but every shift gives you the chance to lead a team, solve real problems, and directly impact how millions of customers receive their orders.

Start of Shift: Set the Tone
• Get a handoff from the outgoing manager and review what's carrying over so nothing falls through the cracks.
• Lead a team huddle to kick off the shift. Huddles are used to align on goals, safety priorities, and key focus areas.
• Confirm your team is in place, positioned for success, and ready to go before operations begin.

Middle of Shift: Lead from the Floor
• Walk the floor regularly to stay connected to your team, spot issues early, and keep things running smoothly.
• Drive results across safety, quality, and productivity — balancing all three in real time.
• Adjust staffing and resources as volume and priorities shift throughout the day.
• Coach and develop your team members, respond to challenges as they come up, and partner with support teams to remove roadblocks.
• Keep peers and leadership informed on how the shift is tracking and flag risks before they become problems.

End of Shift: Close Strong
• Do a final walkthrough to make sure your area is clean, organized, and set up for the next team's success.
• Review your shift's performance data and capture what went well and what to improve
• Hand off to the incoming manager with a clear picture of priorities, open items, and next steps.
• Wrap up any remaining administrative tasks so you leave the shift with a clean slate.
• Every shift, you'll see the direct results of your leadership: from the energy of your team to the packages that reach customers' doorsteps. This is where your decisions have real, visible impact.

Basic qualifications

- Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree. (You must have all degree requirements met before your first day).

Preferred qualifications

- Strong communication skills, both verbal and written.
- Excellent customer service and interpersonal skills.
- Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's program for Supply Chain, Business/Management, Engineering or another related field.

title: CPU Verification Engineer, Verification Team
descriptionHtml:
Annapurna Labs, as part of Amazon Web Services (AWS), develops innovative hardware and software for AWS cloud customers.
Annapurna Labs is like a big start-up in AWS. We develop cutting-edge technologies, work with amazingly talented engineers, and truly shape the future.
Working for Annapurna Labs is thrilling, fast-paced, and a constant learning experience.

Annapurna Labs is looking for engineers to join our Pre-Silicon Verification team — the team that sits at the very center of the chip development lifecycle.

A day in the life
As a CPU Verification Engineer on the Graviton team, you will be responsible for verifying the correctness, performance, and robustness of our next-generation ARM CPU cores and their surrounding subsystems. You'll work at the intersection of micro-architecture, system architecture, and software — ensuring our CPUs meet the highest quality bar before they reach silicon.

About the team
Diverse Experiences
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Inclusive Team Culture
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship and Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic qualifications

- B.Sc. or M.Sc. in Electrical Engineering or Computer Engineering degree.
- 5 years minimum experience in pre-silicon verification of complex digital designs.
- Working knowledge of ARM CPU architecture (ARMv8/ARMv9) privilege levels, exception model, memory model, and instruction set.
- Hands-on experience with SystemVerilog and UVM methodology.
- Experience with constrained-random verification, functional coverage, and assertions (SVA).

Preferred qualifications

- Knowledge of the following programming languages (Python, Perl, shell).
- Knowledge of PCIe, Processors, Ethernet, DDR.
- Experience with formal verification tools and methodologies.
- Experience with performance modeling, profiling, or performance-driven verification.
- Experience verifying cache coherency mechanisms MOESI/MESI state machines, directory-based coherency, snoop filter operation, and multi-level cache hierarchies.
- Experience verifying ARM virtualization extensions.

descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is Amazon's low Earth orbit satellite network. Our mission is to deliver fast, reliable broadband connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. From households to small businesses, schools, hospitals, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will serve communities and organizations operating in places without dependable internet access.

Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

We are looking for a Senior Technical Program Manager (TPM) to lead the core network integration for the Leo direct-to-device (DTD) system. This is a high-impact role where your work will directly influence how quickly and reliably we deploy the DTD network and enable service to our customers.

As a Senior Technical Program Manager for NTN Core Network Integration, you will own the end-to-end technical program strategy for DTD core networking for Leo DTD systems, from architecture and design through verification and deployment.

Join us in shaping the future of satellite communications at Leo.

Key job responsibilities
As a Senior Technical Program Manager on our Leo DTD team, you'll lead technical program management of DTD core network integration across the Leo DTD constellation, ensuring our Leo NTN solutions perform flawlessly in real-world environments.

Drive programs from early architecture and design through integration and qualification testing, ensuring these critical systems meet performance, reliability, and schedule requirements. You'll develop mechanisms and processes connecting Leo engineering and business teams, core network vendors and partners, network operators, and software vendors to build the Leo NTN solution.

Serve as the central program leader across a diverse set of cross-functional teams—from business development, communication systems, networking software, to systems integration and test—to ensure network connectivity and performance are delivered for Leo NTN. Success requires deep technical judgment, strong program leadership, and the ability to align complex engineering organizations.

Develop and maintain program plans that track major milestones across feature development, design reviews, integration activities, qualification testing, and end-to-end network readiness. You will proactively identify technical and programmatic risks, build mitigation strategies, and communicate clear status updates to engineering leaders and stakeholders to ensure alignment across the organization.

Help transition from early development of DTD core network into a large-scale DTD solution supported by the Leo DTD constellation, device ecosystem, and core networks. You will collaborate with engineering teams as well as hardware and software vendors for networking, and test equipment vendors to scale the DTD network.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of technical product or program management experience
- Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules

- Experience with wireless and mobile networks

Preferred qualifications

- Experience dealing well with ambiguity, prioritizing needs, and delivering measurable results in an agile environment

Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

title: Facilities Operations Centre (FOC) Engineer, AWS
descriptionHtml:
G'day! You've found an opportunity that could define your next chapter.

Applicants must be Australian citizens and hold or be eligible to obtain an Australian Government Security Clearance with the ability to successfully complete an Organisational Suitability Assessment. More information regarding security clearances can be found at https://www.agsva.gov.au/.

The Mission - Why This Program, Why Now?

You're joining at the defining moment of one of the most significant technology programmes Australia has ever undertaken. This programme will build and operate the dedicated cloud giving Australia's national security community and its allies the capability to see more, share more, innovate and act faster than ever before.

The architectural decisions being made now - how we structure networking, implement security controls, and automate at scale - will shape how Australia's national security community operates for the next decade. You won't be inheriting someone else's design choices. You'll be making them.

Your Opportunity

Imagine being the calm, decisive voice at the centre of one of the world's most advanced data centre operations. As a Facilities Operations Centre (FOC) leader, you'll stand at the nexus of physical infrastructure and digital innovation - the person who ensures Australia's most critical cloud infrastructure never misses a beat.

This isn't just a monitoring role. You're building something from the ground up - a newly developed 24x7 Facilities Operations Centre that will become the nerve centre for data centre operations across the region. Every Large Scale Event, every Critical Site Event, every electrical and mechanical system pulse flows through your team. You'll shape the protocols, grow the people, and set the standard for operational excellence that others will follow for years to come.

You'll work alongside a remarkable team of software engineers, hardware specialists, network architects, supply chain experts, and security professionals - all united by a shared obsession with reliability, safety, and customer experience. Here, bold ideas aren't just welcomed; they're expected. And you'll have the autonomy to own them from concept to completion.

If you've ever wanted to be at the heart of something that truly matters - where your decisions directly protect the infrastructure that powers innovation for millions - this is your moment.

Benefits

· Learning & development - AWS training and certification support, access to internal learning platforms.

· Health, income protection and life cover - Amazon subsidises private health insurance premiums, and group salary continuance and life insurance are included at no cost to you

· Military differential pay launching in Australia - Australian employees taking defence reserve leave may receive up to 52 weeks of military differential pay to help cover the difference in pay while serving

· Employee Assistance Program - Free, confidential support 24 hours a day, 7 days a week for you and your family - mental health, financial coaching, legal questions, and everyday life events.

· Family-building benefit - Access to Maven for fertility treatment, adoption support, surrogacy, and parenting coaching

· Amazon Extras & employee discount - cashback and discounts across hundreds of retail, fitness, travel, and lifestyle partners.

Key job responsibilities
You'll be the operational heartbeat of our data centre infrastructure - the person who transforms real-time data into decisive action and ensures our customers experience nothing but seamless, uninterrupted service.

Your days will be defined by impact. You'll monitor the full spectrum of our facilities infrastructure platform, reading the signals that others miss and acting before issues become incidents. When the unexpected strikes - and in a 24x7 environment, it will - you'll be the point of contact that internal and external teams turn to for clarity, coordination, and calm leadership.

But you're not just responding to events; you're preventing them. You'll contribute to outage post-mortem analysis, turning every incident into an opportunity to strengthen our systems. You'll develop communication and escalation protocols that sharpen your team's response times and elevate performance across the board. You'll build and refine the tools that give your team a technological edge.

When emergency recovery efforts demand coordination across multiple teams and time zones, you'll be the person who brings order to complexity - ensuring the right people have the right information at the right time. Your meticulous attention to record-keeping will create the institutional knowledge that makes your team stronger with every passing day.

Perhaps most importantly, you'll grow this team to a standard of operational excellence that sets the benchmark for the industry. You'll mentor, develop, and inspire the next generation of operations professionals who will carry this mission forward.

This is shift work in a 24x7 environment, including weekends and holidays - because the infrastructure never sleeps, and neither does your commitment to protecting it.

Basic qualifications

- 1+ years of construction or project management, or 1+ years of electrical or mechanical engineering experience
- 2+ years of data center engineering or operations experience

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with computer skills, including proficiency in MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
- 3+ years of data center or mission critical facilities (example: hospital, military facility, public safety facility, etc.) experience
- Experience with Microsoft Office including Outlook, Word, and Excel

title: Regional ACES Manager, West, INFC ACES
descriptionHtml:
At Amazon, we're working to be the most customer-centric company on earth. To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright, and driven people. Amazon is one of the most recognizable brand names in the world and we distribute millions of products each year to our loyal customers. We recently launched our operations in India through Amazon.in, working tirelessly to bring the world’s most customer centric online shopping experience to the Indian consumer.

title: Advanced Compute Specialist (Chips), UKGI Public Sector
descriptionHtml:
AWS Public Sector is hiring a specialist to build the go-to-market plan for custom silicon across UKGI (UK, Germany and International Organisations). You will define the market, shape the proposition, and drive adoption into government workloads at a time when sovereign AI infrastructure and national-scale compute programmes are creating unprecedented demand for custom silicon (Trainium, Inferentia, Graviton, Nitro) and GPU.

Near-term, you will support our account teams to win GPU and Graviton deals. Longer-term, you will develop the strategy for positioning AWS-designed chips into infrastructure programmes where public sector organisations want to own on-premises compute as a national asset. This is a new role with no established playbook - you will build it from scratch.

You will work directly with Annapurna Labs (the team behind AWS custom silicon), UK government programme leads, and account teams across Defence, Intelligence, Central Government, and Research to connect real customer demand to the next generation of AWS chips.

The ideal candidate is excited about the incredible opportunity silicon innovation presents in the industry today and is deeply passionate about working with great teams that deliver the highest quality services. You are naturally customer obsessed and thrive in a fast-paced environment that requires strong technical and business judgment and solid communication skills.

Key job responsibilities
- Build and own the Advanced Compute pipeline for UKGI: identify, qualify, and progress opportunities for Graviton, Trainium, Inferentia, and GPU across UK public sector accounts.

- Develop the go-to-market strategy for AWS silicon in sovereign and on-premises contexts.

- Support account teams on active GPU deals - providing technical positioning, commercial structuring, and deep market expertise.

- Build the demand signal from UK government: aggregate requirements and translate customer intent into product roadmap input.

- Develop customer-facing propositions around confidential computing on Graviton, on-premises silicon deployment, and sovereign AI compute.

- Work with Public Policy to position AWS silicon within broader government policy and frameworks such as the UK AI Hardware Plan.

- Bridge hardware and software, translate silicon performance capabilities into customer-facing value propositions and product requirements that span the full solution stack

- Build relationships with senior technical and commercial decision-makers at C-suite level.

A day in the life
You split your time between progressing active GPU opportunities with account teams and building the longer-term Chips go-to-market plan. A typical week might include briefing an account team on Graviton positioning for a department migration, joining an internal call with silicon teams to relay UK government compute requirements, drafting a customer proposal for confidential compute on Trainium, and meeting a programme director at a government department to discuss AI research infrastructure options. You report directly to the Head of Customer Acceleration and work closely with Solutions Architects, Specialist Sellers, and the Public Policy team.

About the team
The AI, Emerging Tech & Customer Acceleration team is the specialist engine supporting UKGI account teams. Our job is to find new markets, bring deep technical and commercial skills into the biggest deals, and accelerate the time between opportunity and outcome for UK public sector customers.

Basic qualifications

- Experience working with Advanced Compute technologies including, but not limited to: Accelerated Compute, High Performance Compute, Visual/Spatial Compute, and/or IoT.
- Experience working with Data & AI related technologies, including, but not limited to, AI/ML, GenAI, Analytics, Database, and/or Storage
- Experience developing and executing on GTM strategies that are large in scope
- Experience engaging and influencing senior executives
- Experience working within UK Defence, Intelligence, Research or Critical National Infrastructure organisations

Preferred qualifications

- Experience leading engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
- Knowledge of AWS silicon (Graviton, Trainium, Inferentia) or competing custom compute platforms
- Experience working with semiconductor or hardware product teams to translate field demand into product requirements
- A UK national and able to obtain and maintain a UK Government Security Clearance

title: Area Manager , Operations Lead
descriptionHtml:
Operations is the beating heart of Amazon. This key part of our business makes sure we fulfil and dispatch orders efficiently so that our customers get their items on time. As an Area Manager, you’ll make sure your site is running as smoothly as it should so that we can meet customer demand. You will be leading a team that helps keep our operations safe, efficient, and of a high quality and taking on a number of projects across our network to drive productivity.

Key job responsibilities
- Create, oversee, and drive a culture of safety and wellbeing
- Analyse and implement changes to keep quality and productivity at a consistently high level
- Oversee projects to streamline processes, optimise productivity and increase quality of service for customers within your area of responsibility
- Analyse shift performance against relevant business objectives, and put in place actions to improve our operational excellence
- Work collaboratively with management-level colleagues to standardise shift practices

A day in the life
You’ll work on a shift pattern at one of our sites, making sure it is as productive as it can be. Your main focus will be to own and drive a culture of safety and uphold quality and shift performance standards. You’ll also oversee process improvements within your area and drive implementation. A typical day is varied, including everything from routine team management and daily operational responsibilities to process improvement and wide-scale operational contingency tasks. You’ll also be a role model and mentor to new managers.

Please note this role may require night shift working. Candidates are expected to be flexible in working hours across days and nights.

About the team
Customer Fulfilment, or CF, is where it all started for Amazon. CF has scaled up from a humble team of booksellers to a sophisticated global team which handles millions of orders every day. The team is the foundation of our business and its efforts have helped us diversify across new regions and services. With the help of emerging technology, we’re always looking for ways to offer a bigger, better product range – delivered quickly and affordably.

The CF team are the first people in the chain that helps customers get products at the speed we’re known for. We’re based in Fulfilment Centres, which are at the heart of Amazon’s fast-paced Operations network. Our centres are sometimes referred to as the ‘First Mile’ because it’s where most Amazon packages start their journey. We help to manage dynamic inventory and facilitate speedy deliveries round the clock.

Lots of different people work in our Fulfilment Centres, so there are plenty of opportunities for every skillset. Some of us work with physical products, while others analyse data to help everyone across the business make smart decisions

Basic qualifications

- Advanced degree, or Bachelor's degree
- Experience in people management and team development
- Experience engaging, verbally and in writing, with internal and external stakeholders to convey complex ideas in a clear, concise manner
- Experience using data analysis to drive business decisions
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English, and have the ability to take direction in English

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with Six Sigma tools and Lean techniques, or experience in similar environments
- Experience designing AI, Computer Vision, or Mapping products
- Experience within a distribution center, logistics, or manufacturing environment
- Experience working with the MS Office suite (Word, Excel, Outlook) in a professional environment

title: Operations Supervisor
descriptionHtml:
Der operative Geschäftsbereich ist das Herz von Amazon. Ein effektiv ablaufender Betrieb trägt dazu bei, dass Artikel bearbeitet und rechtzeitig an unsere Kund:innen versendet werden. Als Operations Supervisor erlebst Du, wie alle unterschiedlichen Teile des Betriebs funktionieren und trägst zu einem reibungslosen Ablauf bei.
Du fungierst als erste:r Ansprechpartner:in für Teammitglieder während ihrer Schicht und hilfst ihnen beim Befolgen der Prozesse, die Deine Manager:innen eingeführt haben. Du sammelst praktische Erfahrung und benutzt analytische Systeme, die zum Erfolg unseres Unternehmens beitragen.

Für diese Position bieten wir ein monatliches Bruttogehalt von € 2.885,80 (zuzüglich 13. und 14. Monatsgehalt).
Das angegebene Grundgehalt bezieht sich auf eine Vollzeitbeschäftigung. Bei Teilzeit wird das Gehalt anteilig berechnet.
Gemäß den geltenden gesetzlichen Bestimmungen weisen wir darauf hin, dass das Mindestgehalt für diese Position durch den jeweiligen Kollektivvertrag festgelegt wird. Sie dürfen sich außerdem auf viele weitere Vorteile wie einen Mitarbeiterrabatt freuen! Darüber hinaus bieten wir Ihnen auch viele immaterielle Vorteile, wie unser Engagement, Sie aktiv zu fordern und in Ihrer Entwicklung zu fördern, sowie eine erfrischende Abwesenheit starrer Hierarchien. Sie haben zudem die Möglichkeit, mit den klügsten Köpfen aus verschiedenen Branchen zusammenzuarbeiten, Ihre Ideen aktiv einzubringen und so unseren Erfolg maßgeblich voranzutreiben.


Key job responsibilities
- Messung und Überwachung von Arbeitsflüssen, Verfolgen der Leistung am Standort und Bereitstellung wichtiger Schichtinformationen an die Schicht-/Bereichsleiter:innen im Betrieb, um für schichtübergreifende Operational Excellence zu sorgen
- Unterstützung und Schulung von Mitarbeitenden, damit diese großartige Leistungen erbringen können, und Beaufsichtigung ihrer täglichen Aufgaben
- Unterstützung des/der Schicht-/Bereichsleiter:in bei Projekten zur Prozessverbesserung, Förderung eines sicheren Arbeitsumfelds und Erhöhung des Mitarbeiterengagements
- Zusammenarbeit mit anderen Abteilungen, um Lösungen für häufige Probleme zu finden oder Bedürfnisse in wichtigen Leistungsbereichen zu erfüllen
- Nutzung von Datenanalysen, um Möglichkeiten zur Optimierung von Sicherheit, Qualität und Produktivität zu finden

A day in the life
Als Operations Supervisor arbeitest Du an einem unserer Betriebsstandorte. Du unterstützt Deine:n Schicht-/Bereichsleiter:in bei der Durchführung des Schichtplans. Du hilft bei der Vorbereitung von Schichtbesprechungen mit Deinem Team und überwachst Verfahren und Abläufe. Damit stellst du sicher, dass Sicherheitsregeln, Qualitätssicherungsprozesse und die Prioritäten für den Tag befolgt werden.
Probleme, die Du bemerkst, eskalierst Du an Deine:n Manager:in. Gelegentlich agierst Du auch selbst als Schichtleiter:in und bietest Deinen Mitarbeitenden die notwendige Anleitung, um ihre Aufgaben zu erledigen. Bei Bedarf unterstützt Du Deine:n Schicht-/Bereichsleiter:in bei der Schichtplanung und sorgst dafür, dass zu Stoßzeiten genügend Teammitglieder eingeteilt sind.

About the team
Amazon Logistik (AMZL) ist für die Auslieferung von Millionen von Produkten unserer Kunden und Kundinnen direkt an die Haustür verantwortlich. Die „Last-Mile-Logistik“ liefert unsere Pakete in Partnerschaft mit Drittanbietern und realisiert zahlreiche Initiativen zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung, um Millionen von Kunden zufrieden zu stellen.
Unser Ziel ist es, das Liefererlebnis für unsere Kund:innen so reibungslos wie möglich zu machen und globale Lieferlösungen für unsere neuesten Angebote einzuführen, darunter Amazon Fresh, Prime Now und Amazon Restaurants.
Unsere Arbeit lässt sich in zwei Sparten unterteilen. „Under the Roof“ betrifft alles was innerhalb unserer Logistikstandorte passiert und „On the Road“ alles was in den Liefergebieten auf der Straße stattfindet. Unsere Mitarbeitenden bereiten die Pakete in entsprechenden Schichten (Nacht, Früh, Spät) auf den täglichen Versand an unsere Lieferteams vor und kümmern sich um Retouren, die nicht ausgeliefert werden konnten.
Jedes Jahr setzen wir neue Maßstäbe in puncto Kundenerlebnis und bieten neue, innovative Lieferdienste an. Wir suchen nach neuen Möglichkeiten, um branchenweite Logistikherausforderungen zu überwinden, sowie nach neuen Ideen, um unseren CO2-Fußabdruck zu reduzieren. Ein Fuhrpark innovativer Fahrzeuge (einschließlich E-Fahrzeugen) und modernste Technologie unterstützen uns dabei.

Basic qualifications

- Fortgeschrittene Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.
- Erfahrung in der Arbeit mit Datenanalytik und deren Anwendung zur Problemerkennung
- Erfahrung mit MS Office (Word, Excel, Outlook) im beruflichen Umfeld

Preferred qualifications

- Erfahrung im Stakeholdermanagement, einschließlich Aufbau und Pflege professioneller Beziehungen
- Erfahrung in der Arbeit in einem Betriebsumfeld, beispielsweise in Logistik, Einzelhandel, Gastgewerbe oder im Kundenservice
- Fortgeschrittene Englischkenntnisse

title: Senior Station Manager
descriptionHtml:
AMZL Sr. Station Leaders are responsible for all budgetary, people development and operations objectives for an Amazon Logistics Delivery Station (DS). Additional responsibilities include managing and leading a team of Operations, Area and Shift Managers, coaching and mentoring the team to ensure performance objectives are met, building positive employee relations and building leadership bench strength within the DS.

- Drives vision for station team and creation of quality initiatives, process change initiatives and other lean initiatives to enable their functional area and ultimately the DS to meet and exceed business plan
- Problem-solves for closing gaps between performance and goals
- Will set and clarify requirements and expectations for Operations, Area and Shift Managers. Measures performance, provides feedback, and holds Ops Managers accountable for their performance and the performance of their departments

title: Operations Supervisor
descriptionHtml:
Operations is the heart and soul of everything Amazon does. It is thanks to effective operations that items are processed and dispatched to our customers on time. Being an Operations Lead/Supervisor gives you the chance to see how all the different parts of operations work and play a role in making sure everything runs smoothly.

You’ll be the first point of contact for team members during their shift and help them follow the processes that your managers have put in place. This is a hands-on role, which will give you experience in using the tools and systems that make our operations successful.

Key job responsibilities
Measure and monitor workflows, track onsite performance, and provide important shift information to frontline management to ensure operational excellence across shifts.

Support and train employees to deliver great service and supervise them in their daily tasks
Support the Shift/Area Manager with projects to improve processes, cultivate a safe working environment, and increase workforce engagement
Work with other departments to find solutions to address common issues or support needs in areas of key performance.

Use data analysis to identify ways to optimise safety, quality and productivity

A day in the life
As an Operations Lead/Supervisor, you’ll be based in one of our operational sites. You’ll support your Shift/Area Manager to carry out the plan for the shift. That will involve helping with pre-shift meetings with your team and monitoring procedures to make sure everyone is following safety rules, quality processes, and the priority plan for the day.

You’ll escalate any issues you spot to your manager, but sometimes you’ll be the most senior person on shift and will give people the direction they need to complete their tasks. At other times, you’ll support your Shift/Area Manager in planning shifts to make sure you have enough team members working during peak times.

title: Amazon Ads — Strategic Partner / Account Executive (ブランドの事業成長を推進する統合マーケティングリード) , Grocery
descriptionHtml:
Amazonは、オンラインショッピングとしての成長にとどまらず、生活者の日常に深く浸透した総合コンテンツメディアへと進化しています。Amazon Adsは、Amazon内外における生活者の購買・視聴・検索行動から得られるインサイトをもとに、
Prime Video、Fire TV、Twitch、、提携している外部メディア、Alexa、Amazonデバイス、リアルイベントなど多様なソリューションを統合し、国内外の大手ブランド企業の成長戦略を支援する統合マーケティング組織です。

本ポジションは、広告枠の販売を超えて、ブランドの事業成長を共創するビジネスパートナーとして、生活者起点の課題定義から、認知・検討・購買までの一貫した統合コミュニケーション設計をリードします。特にPrime Video広告本格展開期という変革フェーズにおいて、日本市場における新しい広告モデルの創出を担う中心的役割です。

Amazon Adsならではの成長と経験

- 「コンテンツ × メディア × コマース × シグナル」を統合できる唯一の広告プラットフォーム

- 認知形成 → 行動喚起 → 購買検証まで、統合的に可視化可能

- Prime Video広告の本格展開という市場変革期の中心に立てるポジション

- 大手ブランドの意思決定に影響を与え、数十億円規模のマーケティング投資に関わる裁量

- 世界最先端のプロダクトや事例へのアクセスと、グローバルチームと協働できる環境

事例紹介

＜事例1: 国内大手飲料ブランド（新商品ローンチにおけるコンテンツ連動型統合キャンペーン ）＞

Prime Video上のオリジナルコンテンツとデジタル広告、購買シグナル分析を統合した統合キャンペーン。ブランドストーリー → 意識変容 → 購買行動の一貫設計により、ブランド好意向上と購買成果の両立を実現。AEは、生活者インサイトの解釈から統合戦略設計、社内外の関係者統合、成果検証の推進までをリードし、クライアントの成長課題に対する最適解を共創しました。

＜事例2：グローバルデリバリーサービス（エンターテインメントコンテンツと連動したブランド体験型キャンペーン ）＞

Prime Videoの人気コンテンツと連動した広告クリエイティブと、ディスプレイリターゲティング × 購買シグナル検証を組み合わせ、認知と行動成果の同時達成を実現。AEは、広告主の意思決定者との関係構築からキャンペーン全体設計、実行・検証までを主導し、従来型広告の限界を超えるブランド体験の創出を牽引しました。

求める人物像

複雑なマーケティング課題を生活者視点で整理し、生活者シグナルとクリエイティブを横断する統合的解決策を設計できる方。 答えのないテーマに自ら仮説を立て、ステークホルダーを巻き込みながら実行と成果創出まで責任を持って推進できる方を歓迎します。

Key job responsibilities
戦略設計・実行

- ブランドの事業目標に基づく統合マーケティング戦略の設計

- Amazon内外における購買・視聴・検索行動から得られる消費者インサイト分析・効果検証・改善サイクルの推進

- Prime Video Ads、Fire TV、ディスプレイ、スポンサー広告などフルファネルで複数メディアを統合した施策立案・実行

関係構築・プロジェクトマネジメント

- 広告主の経営層・マーケティング責任者との信頼構築と伴走

- 広告代理店、制作パートナー、社内メディア/プロダクトチームとの協働推進

- 海外チームとの協働による最新ソリューションのローカライズ展開

アカウント成長

- 中長期の成長戦略立案とアカウント責任

- 新規プロダクトを活用した投資拡大と事業成果創出



About the team
Large Customer Sales (LCS) は日本を代表する大手企業を担当する組織です。ブランド認知から購買までのフルファネルで価値提供を行い、生活者行動シグナルに基づくマーケティングの可視化と成果創出を重視しています。広告代理店・各領域のスペシャリストと協業し、独自の価値を提供します。

本ポジションは消費財領域における「Grocery 食品・飲料」カテゴリーを担当します。国内外を代表するブランドを担当する機会があり、日常生活に密接に関わるカテゴリーならではの大きな市場規模と、継続的な需要が特徴です。
同カテゴリーはブランド間での差別化や継続的な需要創出が求められるため、単なる広告提案に留まらず、フルファネルでの戦略設計や長期的なブランド成長に寄与するパートナーとしての価値提供が求められます。
Amazon Adsでは購買・検索・視聴といった豊富なシグナルを活用し、データドリブンに課題を特定しながら、ブランドの事業成長に直結する提案が可能です。

Basic qualifications

- デジタルマーケティング、広告営業、またはブランドマーケティングにおける5年以上の実務経験
- 大手企業の意思決定者レベルとの折衝・提案経験
- データに基づく戦略立案と成果検証の実績
- 複数のステークホルダーを巻き込んだプロジェクト推進力
- 日本語での高いコミュニケーション・プレゼンテーション力、および英語で意思疎通ができるコミュニケーション能力

Preferred qualifications

- 動画広告、プログラマティック広告の知見
- 新規プロダクトの市場導入経験
- クロスファンクショナルチームでのリーダーシップ経験
- 海外チームとの協働経験

title: Solutions Architect , AGS India Public Sector
descriptionHtml:
AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small- and mid-market accounts to enterprise-level customers including public sector.

This job opening is for a Solutions Architect role within the public sector team of AWS, India. We work with the central government ministries, state and local governments, public sector units, education institutions, EdTechs, nonprofits, and healthcare. Our vision is to help public institutions in India to make a significant impact to the lives of citizens, by taking a technology generation leap through use of AWS cloud services within the domains of Skilling, Smart Infrastructure, Healthcare and Inclusion (Physical, Digital and Financial).

As a solutions architect you will provide a consistent approach for customers and partners to evaluate architectures, and implement designs that will scale over time based on five pillars of the AWS Well-Architected Framework — operational excellence, security, reliability, performance efficiency, and cost optimization.

Diverse Experiences
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship and Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Key job responsibilities
This job opening is for a Solutions Architect role within the public sector team of AWS, India. We work with the central government ministries, state and local governments, public sector units, education institutions, EdTechs, nonprofits, and healthcare. Our vision is to help public institutions in India to make a significant impact to the lives of citizens, by taking a technology generation leap through use of AWS cloud services within the domains of Skilling, Smart Infrastructure, Healthcare and Inclusion (Physical, Digital and Financial).
We are known for our unwavering customer obsession. Our solutions architecture teams are on the front line of helping customers succeed using AWS technologies. Our team members leverage their deep knowledge of AWS technologies in collaboration with our sales and partner teams to impact how solutions are proposed, architected and implemented for clients. Helping make customer success a reality and seeing the impact in real-time drives our teams to explore new frontiers in leveraging AWS cloud for both commercial and public sector organizations.
If you have worked with Amazon Web Services technologies or have AWS certifications you would like to leverage, we will help you maximize the impact of your skills and knowledge.

Basic qualifications

- 13+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) experience
- 10+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
- 10+ years of IT development or implementation/consulting in the software or Internet industries experience
- 6+ years of responding to requests for proposals (e.g., determining requirements, matching requirements to technical approach and solutions, developing solutions against requirements) experience
- Experience working with Data & AI related technologies, including, but not limited to, AI/ML, GenAI, Analytics, Database, and/or Storage

Preferred qualifications

- 5+ years of infrastructure architecture, database architecture and networking experience
- Knowledge of SAP systems (like SAP Business Suite, S/4HANA, SAP Business Warehouse, SAP HANA, SAP Business Objects, etc.) and their architecture and infrastructure needs
- Experience working with end user or developer communities
- Experience managing relationships with SAP customers and partners
- Experience in SAP S/4HANA, SAP Cloud Platform, SAP Cloud ERP and Cloud ERP Private
- Experience in SAP clean core design concepts, including design and build using non-SAP technologies in domains such as Generative / Agentic AI, and data & analytics

title: Area Manager, Early Career (2027) – (VA/MD)
descriptionHtml:
Power that runs the world | Discover careers in Operations

Operations roles at Amazon put you at the center of how things move from a click to a doorstep. You'll help design, improve, and run systems that connect people, products, and places, at scale. You'll take ownership early, work closely with teams to solve real-world challenges, and see the direct results of your decisions as they reach customers every day. Here, the impact of what you build isn't abstract, it's visible, immediate, and meaningful - keeping one of the world's most complex operations moving forward. This is where your journey takes shape through action, responsibility, and the opportunity to grow in many directions.

This is not a corporate, remote or office-based position. This is a full-time, early career position located within one of Amazon’s fulfillment centers, sort centers, delivery stations or other operations buildings. Amazon is seeking customer focused individuals to lead a team of hourly employees across our Operations network! Our warehouses are fast-paced environments where standing, walking, and having on-the-production floor conversations are common as a supply chain leader.

As an Area Manager, you will be responsible for engaging, leading and developing your team in a warehouse environment. Your main focus will be motivating, mentoring, and managing your team to meet goals. Amazon provides extensive training and development to become an exceptional people leader. As a people manager, you will ensure that your team has all the tools needed to succeed and maintain the highest levels of safety, quality, attendance and performance at work.

Visit this page to find more information on each of our building types. https://www.aboutamazon.com/workplace/facilities

Please note we are not able to provide sponsorship now or in the future for these positions. Eligible candidates must have work authorization without employer intervention to be considered.

This posting encompasses all openings in the country. Site placement is matched by aligning your location preferences with location availability after your interview. Relocation benefits are offered at time of offer to eligible candidates.

Benefits: Medical, financial, and/or other benefits. Visit this page to learn more about the benefits Amazon offers. https://www.amazon.jobs/content/en/benefits



Key job responsibilities
• Support, mentor and motivate 50-100 direct report Amazon Associates.
• Work independently and operate in an autonomous environment.
• Stand/walk during shifts lasting up to 12 hours.
• Willing and able to regularly work shift patterns that include nights, weekends, and/or holidays based on business needs. While shifts vary site to site, most follow a fixed 4-day work week with 3 days off.
• Oversee truck deliveries, handle and sort packages using pallet jacks, operate PIT. equipment (at applicable facilities) and step in as needed.
• Work in an environment where the noise level varies.
• Lift up to 49 pounds and frequently push, pull, squat, bend and reach.
• Climb and descend stairs (when applicable).


A day in the life
As an Area Manager, no two days look exactly the same, but every shift gives you the chance to lead a team, solve real problems, and directly impact how millions of customers receive their orders.
Start of Shift: Set the Tone
• Get a handoff from the outgoing manager and review what's carrying over so nothing falls through the cracks.
• Lead a team huddle to kick off the shift. Huddles are used to align on goals, safety priorities, and key focus areas.
• Confirm your team is in place, positioned for success, and ready to go before operations begin.
Middle of Shift: Lead from the Floor
• Walk the floor regularly to stay connected to your team, spot issues early, and keep things running smoothly.
• Drive results across safety, quality, and productivity — balancing all three in real time.
• Adjust staffing and resources as volume and priorities shift throughout the day.
• Coach and develop your team members, respond to challenges as they come up, and partner with support teams to remove roadblocks.
• Keep peers and leadership informed on how the shift is tracking and flag risks before they become problems.
End of Shift: Close Strong
• Do a final walkthrough to make sure your area is clean, organized, and set up for the next team's success.
• Review your shift's performance data and capture what went well and what to improve
• Hand off to the incoming manager with a clear picture of priorities, open items, and next steps.
• Wrap up any remaining administrative tasks so you leave the shift with a clean slate.
• Every shift, you'll see the direct results of your leadership: from the energy of your team to the packages that reach customers' doorsteps. This is where your decisions have real, visible impact.

Basic qualifications

- Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining a bachelor’s or master’s degree. (You must have all degree requirements met before your first day).

title: Partner Operations Manager FR, Amazon PARP
descriptionHtml:
Please submit your CV in English

The Partner Operations Manager will support the country lead with all aspects of product installation and maintenance in France as we continue to expand the business. The successful candidate will build and maintain strong relationships with internal and external partners – including service providers, host partners, technology and product management, and the local business development team. The individual must be both analytical and creative, seeking out ways to improve products, processes, and tools, and executing on those ideas. Strong interpersonal skills are also important as the position will have frequent interaction with leadership at Amazon and partner companies. Amazon opened its virtual doors in 1995 and strives to be the world’s most customer-centric company, where customers can find and discover anything they might want to buy online. Amazon Hub PARP is growing and we are working to create a world class delivery experience for customers through alternate delivery options - lockers and pickup points. If you are passionate about delivery operations and look around corners for ways to serve customers, we want your help.

Key job responsibilities
Strategic Leadership & Operations:
• Lead end-to-end installation, maintenance, and post-installation operations (removal, decommissioning, moves, resizing) for Pickup and Return Points across assigned markets
• Drive strategic projects including new product launches (Gen5 lockers), geographic expansion, and process improvements aligned with business objectives
Supplier & Vendor Management:
• Manage complex supplier relationships across installation and maintenance services, negotiating contracts to achieve 90%+ SLA compliance
• Scale supplier capacity strategically, ensuring redundancy on critical services while driving cost reductions
Process Optimization & Automation
• Leverage AI tools and low/no-code solutions to streamline operational processes, targeting 15-30% productivity gains through automation
Financial Management:
• Manage program finance including purchase orders, invoice processing, and P&L ownership for assigned cost centers
• Work within imparted budgets while identifying savings opportunities through supplier optimization and process improvements
Stakeholder Management & Influence:
• Partner with cross-functional teams (Business Sales, Quality, Product/Tech, Finance, Marketing) to support business objectives
• Influence internal and external stakeholders through data-driven insights and strategic recommendations
Data Analysis & Performance Management:
• Conduct deep-dive analyses to identify root causes of operational issues and improvement opportunities
• Monitor and report on KPIs including 99%+ uptime targets, DPMO, FTDS, cycle time, and cost performance
• Establish dashboards and alarming mechanisms to proactively flag performance deterioration
Operational Excellence & Change Management:
• Maintain network reliability through proactive maintenance strategies and quality control mechanisms
• Lead teams through operational transformations, new technology implementations, and process redesigns
• Promote adaptability to rapid business changes and scaling requirements

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in supply chain, business, engineering, finance or related technical or quantitative field
- Speak, write, and read fluently in French
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English
- Experience in operations, supply chain, logistics, or project management (internships count)
- Familiarity with supplier or vendor interactions
- Experience conducting data analysis (e.g., Excel, SQL, or BI tools) to identify trends or operational issues

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree in Engineering, Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, or related field
- Exposure to vendor management processes including SLA monitoring and performance reporting
- Interest in or early experience with AI tools, automation, or low/no-code solutions to improve workflows or productivity
- Experience contributing to cross-functional projects involving product launches, geographic expansion, or process redesign
- Demonstrated ability to present data-driven insights to managers or stakeholders to support decision-making
- Familiarity with P&L, cost tracking, or budget optimization in an operational context
- Demonstrated ability to adapt to rapid changes and manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment

title: Production Workflow Engineer, Production Technology Engineering
descriptionHtml:
Do you like to build? Are you passionate about the Media and Entertainment space? Amazon MGM Studios (AMS) Production Technology Engineering is seeking a Production Workflow Engineer (PWE) who will be responsible for driving adoption of the Studio's production and post production workflows in the cloud.

Key job responsibilities
The AMS Production Workflow Engineer (PWE) is responsible for driving adoption of cloud-based workflows (dailies, editorial, conform, color, mastering, remote production and others). You accomplish this by educating customers, internal partners, and third party production companies about the Studio's suite of creative workflows. You work vendors to validate workflows and integrate local workflow with the cloud. The PWE builds and deploys workflows, acts as a primary contact for our internal stakeholders and end-customers. The PWE communicates gathers and communicates requirements and issues back to the product and engineering team. They work with customers remotely and in person.

You will be a subject matter expert on the Studio's workflows and post production creative workflows in general. You will anticipate future trends and identify applications of emerging technologies and provide information to Product and Engineering to reduce friction, eliminate waste, and support faster workflows. In addition you'll help drive thought leadership around the Studio's cloud-based media and entertainment workflows. You will deliver written and spoken communications to establish AMS as a leader among studios who are using the cloud to expand capabilities globally, enhance capabilities and ensure access to global talent.

A day in the life
You will lead engagements with management and post leadership at partner production and post companies, onboard productions, and help evangelize cloud production at the Studio and in the Media & Entertainment (M&E) industry.

AMS Production & Post Technology deploys and supports the operation the Studio's cloud-based workflows (dailies, editorial, conform, color, mastering, remote production and others). We educate customers, internal partners, and third party production companies about the Studio's suite of creative workflows in order to accelerate adoption of our global, high-performance cloud-based creative tools in support of the Studio's productions.


About the team
Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We are a global team with a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building the next generation of cloud-based content creation workflows together. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects based on what will help each team member develop into a better-rounded professional and enable them to take on more complex tasks in the future.

Prime Video is a first-stop entertainment destination offering customers a vast collection of premium programming in one app available across thousands of devices. On Prime Video, customers can find their favorite movies, series, documentaries, and live sports – including Amazon MGM Studios-produced series and movies Road House, The Lord of the Rings: The Rings of Power, Fallout, Reacher, The Boys, and The Idea of You; licensed fan favorites Dawson’s Creek and IF; Prime member exclusive access to coverage of live sports including Thursday Night Football, WNBA, and NWSL, and acclaimed sports documentaries including Bye Bye Barry and Federer; and programming from partners such as Apple TV+, Max, Crunchyroll, and MGM+ via Prime Video add-on subscriptions, as well as more than 500 free ad-supported (FAST) Channels. Prime members in the U.S. can share a variety of benefits, including Prime Video, by using Amazon Household. Prime Video is one benefit among many that provides savings, convenience, and entertainment as part of the Prime membership. All customers, regardless of whether they have a Prime membership or not, can rent or buy titles, including blockbusters such as Challengers and The Fall Guy, via the Prime Video Store, and can enjoy content such as Jury Duty and Bosch: Legacy free with ads on Freevee. Customers can also go behind the scenes of their favorite movies and series with exclusive X-Ray access. For more info visit www.amazon.com/primevideo.

Are you interested in shaping the future of entertainment? Prime Video's technology teams are creating best-in-class digital video experience.

As a Prime Video technologist, you’ll get to work on projects that are fast-paced, challenging, and varied. You’ll also be able to experiment with new possibilities, take risks, and collaborate with remarkable people.

We’ll look for you to bring your diverse perspectives, ideas, and skill-sets to make Amazon MGM Studios even better for our customers. With global opportunities for talented technologists, you can decide where a career Amazon MGM Studios takes you!

Basic qualifications

- 2+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
- 4+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) experience
- Experience using strong customer service, communication, and interpersonal skills, or experience that includes strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and effective communication abilities
- Production technology and media/entertainment experience, including building and managing post production workflows for films, series and unscripted productions.
- Expertise in the capabilities, use and deployment of leading industry content creation tools like Avid Media Composer, Avid NEXIS Blackmagic Resolve, Colorfront On-Set Dailies, Colorfront Transkoder, Adobe Creative Cloud
- Experience deploying and supporting workflows following industry content security standards.
- Expertise in using and operating AWS Services, like EC2, S3, Route53, VPC

- Experience migrating or transforming legacy customer solutions to the cloud
- Experience with AWS technologies

descriptionHtml:
This position requires in-role training at an operating site which will be 2+ weeks in duration. This training will be located 50+ miles away from the home site location. All travel accommodations for training will be booked and paid for by Amazon.

Please note: this role requires open flexibility to work 10 hour overnight shifts (late afternoon to early morning hours) and will be scheduled on a front-half (Sunday – Wednesday) or back-half (Wednesday – Saturday) schedule. Shifts will be assigned upon starting in the role and could be subject to change based upon business need.

ABOUT AMAZON

Our Worldwide Operations network delivers millions of packages and smiles to Amazon customers every day. We are looking for motivated, customer-focused individuals who want to join our team as an Area Manager. In this role, you will lead a team of hourly employees and will be responsible for engaging your team during their shifts to maintain the highest levels of safety, quality, attendance, and performance. You will also play a key part in maintaining our customer expectations to ensure customer orders are delivered at the right time, to the right location.

Our Operation’s workflow has three major components: First mile - where the product is housed and ready for order; Middle mile - where the order is hauled to your area; and Last mile - when the product is delivered to the customer’s door. Please note that all workflows have slight building variations, but one thing is constant: our vision and dedication to the customer.

Rapid and Rural Logistics (R2L) is an exciting organization within Amazon specializing in delighting our customers with speed in which we can make items appear on their doorsteps. Rural Super Rural (RSR) is a subset of R2L dedicated to ensuring our customers receive their deliveries and are satisfied with their service, even in our most remote area. We are a combination of operations and support teams aligned to continually strive to innovate the last mile delivery process while bringing smiles to our customer’s faces. Come build the future with us!

- Support, mentor, and motivate your team

- Work in an environment where the noise level varies and is subject to variable temperatures and weather (delivery stations include outside loading departments, and grocery locations include refrigerated environments)
- Work a flexible schedule (weekends and/or overnight shifts)

- 2+ years of employee and performance management experience

title: Area Manager, Early Career - (2027) - Iowa
descriptionHtml:
Power that runs the world | Discover careers in Operations
Operations roles at Amazon put you at the center of how things move from a click to a doorstep. You'll help design, improve, and run systems that connect people, products, and places, at scale. You'll take ownership early, work closely with teams to solve real-world challenges, and see the direct results of your decisions as they reach customers every day. Here, the impact of what you build isn't abstract, it's visible, immediate, and meaningful - keeping one of the world's most complex operations moving forward. This is where your journey takes shape through action, responsibility, and the opportunity to grow in many directions.

This is not a corporate, remote or office-based position. This is a full-time, early career position located within one of Amazon’s fulfillment centers, sort centers, delivery stations or other operations buildings. Amazon is seeking customer focused individuals to lead a team of hourly employees across our Operations network! Our warehouses are fast-paced environments where standing, walking, and having on-the-production floor conversations are common as a supply chain leader.

As an Area Manager, you will be responsible for engaging, leading and developing your team in a warehouse environment. Your main focus will be motivating, mentoring, and managing your team to meet goals. Amazon provides extensive training and development to become an exceptional people leader. As a people manager, you will ensure that your team has all the tools needed to succeed and maintain the highest levels of safety, quality, attendance and performance at work.

Visit this page to find more information on each of our building types. https://www.aboutamazon.com/workplace/facilities

Please note we are not able to provide sponsorship now or in the future for these positions. Eligible candidates must have work authorization without employer intervention to be considered.

This posting encompasses all openings in the country. Site placement is matched by aligning your location preferences with location availability after your interview. Relocation benefits are offered at time of offer to eligible candidates.

Benefits: Medical, financial, and/or other benefits. Visit this page to learn more about the benefits Amazon offers.
https://www.amazon.jobs/content/en/benefits


Key job responsibilities
• Support, mentor and motivate 50-100 direct report Amazon Associates.
• Work independently and operate in an autonomous environment.
• Stand/walk during shifts lasting up to 12 hours.
• Willing and able to regularly work shift patterns that include nights, weekends, and/or holidays based on business needs. While shifts vary site to site, most follow a fixed 4-day work week with 3 days off.
• Oversee truck deliveries, handle and sort packages using pallet jacks, operate PIT. equipment (at applicable facilities) and step in as needed.
• Work in an environment where the noise level varies.
• Lift up to 49 pounds and frequently push, pull, squat, bend and reach.
• Climb and descend stairs (when applicable).


A day in the life
As an Area Manager, no two days look exactly the same, but every shift gives you the chance to lead a team, solve real problems, and directly impact how millions of customers receive their orders.
Start of Shift: Set the Tone
• Get a handoff from the outgoing manager and review what's carrying over so nothing falls through the cracks.
• Lead a team huddle to kick off the shift. Huddles are used to align on goals, safety priorities, and key focus areas.
• Confirm your team is in place, positioned for success, and ready to go before operations begin.
Middle of Shift: Lead from the Floor
• Walk the floor regularly to stay connected to your team, spot issues early, and keep things running smoothly.
• Drive results across safety, quality, and productivity — balancing all three in real time.
• Adjust staffing and resources as volume and priorities shift throughout the day.
• Coach and develop your team members, respond to challenges as they come up, and partner with support teams to remove roadblocks.
• Keep peers and leadership informed on how the shift is tracking and flag risks before they become problems.
End of Shift: Close Strong
• Do a final walkthrough to make sure your area is clean, organized, and set up for the next team's success.
• Review your shift's performance data and capture what went well and what to improve
• Hand off to the incoming manager with a clear picture of priorities, open items, and next steps.
• Wrap up any remaining administrative tasks so you leave the shift with a clean slate.
• Every shift, you'll see the direct results of your leadership: from the energy of your team to the packages that reach customers' doorsteps. This is where your decisions have real, visible impact.

Basic qualifications

- Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining a bachelor’s or master’s degree. (You must have all degree requirements met before your first day).

Preferred qualifications

- Strong communication skills, both verbal and written.
- Excellent customer service and interpersonal skills.
- Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's program for Supply Chain, Business/Management, Engineering or another related field.
