title: Engineering Operations Technician (Night Shift), DCEO
descriptionHtml:
Join our dynamic team and become a critical guardian of technological infrastructure! As a Data Center Engineering Technician, you'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of mission-critical technology infrastructure, ensuring seamless operations that power global digital experiences. Your expertise will directly contribute to maintaining an extraordinary 99.999% uptime, keeping the digital world running smoothly and efficiently.

Engineering Technicians are Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting. They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot, Data Center Operation’s Mission Critical Facilities, which includes stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, as well as three phase electrical systems such as: switch gear, UPSs, PDUs, wet cell batteries and associated systems, CRAC, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers/water chemical system, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, & motors.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

NOTE: Amazon does not sponsor for immigration, including for H-1B, TN, and other non-immigrant visas, for this role.

NOTE: Lump sum stipend will be provided to eligible candidates who relocate for this position.

Key job responsibilities
Daily building rounds to monitor and record information from electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment to ensure 24/7 reliability and availability

Monitor Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Management System (EPMS)

Assist in troubleshooting of facility and rack-level events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLA)

Perform rack installs and rack decommissioning within internal SLA

Perform PM, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and repair of electrical and mechanical equipment

Technical writing to support change management program

Monitor daily work requests and manage to resolution, and execute projects from conception to completion

On-site support of contractors, sub-contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices, procedures & local legislation

Work schedule changes depending on specific site needs. Shifts can be up to 12 hours and may rotate on a predefined schedule. Some locations have on-call rotations.

Role may support more than one location/site.

Physical Requirements:

Willingness and demonstrated ability to work in the following physical conditions with reasonable accommodations:

Regularly lift and/or move up to 39 pounds independently

Participate in group lifts for 40+ pounds

Maintain balance and perform construction tasks while on a ladder

Regularly walk, use hands and fingers, handle or feel, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl, climb stairs, twist, bend, work above shoulders, grasp, carry, push and pull objects into position

Work in an environment requiring provided ear protection

This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.

Essential Requirements:

Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed

Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational

Travel frequency will vary based on business needs and operational status of assigned facility

Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs.

A day in the life
This role acts as Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment preventative maintenance (PM) and troubleshooting, reporting to a site’s Data Center Facility Manager (FM). They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot mission-critical data center facility equipment including stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, 3 phase electrical systems such as switchgear, UPS units, PDUs, and wet cell batteries and associated systems. Mechanical equipment includes CRAHU units, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers, water systems, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, and motors. Additional support equipment is included in the scope of the role which includes fire/life safety equipment, building automation systems, and general facilities equipment.

- Work a flexible work schedule including evenings, overnights, and weekends
- 1+ years of electrical facilities maintenance, or 1+ years of mechanical facilities

Preferred qualifications

title: Principal Tech Program Mgr, Items and Relationships Platform
descriptionHtml:
Amazon's Item Identity team is building the definitive product identity for every product in Amazon's catalog: one product, one identity, worldwide, powered by a GenAI platform that reasons about what a product is across text, images, and structured data. We are looking for a Principal Technical Program Manager to own the program's external drive: rolling out the platform to Amazon's businesses and partners through phased, quality-gated launches, running the operating cadence that keeps a large stakeholder set aligned, and owning the customer communication pipeline that keeps the platform trustworthy. This is a role for a technically fluent program leader who can steer a probabilistic, model-driven program where rollouts are gated on quality and adoption depends on partner trust.



Key job responsibilities
Own the phased rollout of the platform to internal business customers and external partners: sequencing, staged adoption, and progress against plan.
Own the go/no-go launch gates, ensuring every production rollout meets its quality bar before it ships and holding the line between speed and customer trust.
Champion AI-native ways of working across the program: use GenAI to run the operating cadence, triage and route escalations, synthesize customer signal, and scale program mechanisms that would otherwise be manual.
Own the program's operating cadence and business reviews: run the forum, surface the hard-to-decide topics, and drive cross-organization alignment and action closure.
Own the customer escalation pipeline end to end: intake, triage, routing to the right team, and turning escalations into lasting product and process improvements.
Own the relationship with partners and internal consumers, including how they integrate with and consume the platform, and set clear expectations.
Drive cross-organization dependencies across engineering, product, and business teams, tracking commitments to completion.
Partner with senior engineering and product leaders to translate between the platform's technical behavior and customers' business needs.
Define and communicate the program's roadmap and operating mechanisms, and raise the program-management bar across the organization while mentoring other TPMs.

A day in the life
You are the single owner of how Amazon's product identity platform reaches its customers. A typical day moves between running the operating cadence (preparing and driving business reviews), unblocking cross-team dependencies, and steering in-flight rollouts. You lean on AI-native ways of working throughout: using GenAI to synthesize customer signal, draft narratives and review docs, triage and route escalations, and automate the program mechanics that would otherwise be manual. You work with engineering and product leaders on rollout readiness, and partner across catalog, seller, abuse-prevention, and retail teams whose work depends on identity. Your customers are Amazon's internal businesses and partners adopting the platform, and the sellers and shoppers who feel identity quality downstream. The problems you solve: sequencing safe, phased rollouts, keeping a broad stakeholder set aligned, and turning customer escalations into lasting improvements.

About the team
Item Identity builds the definitive identity for every product in Amazon's catalog: one product, one identity, worldwide, so shoppers get exactly what they expect, sellers list without needless friction, and every downstream system can trust a single source of truth. We are moving a proven, GenAI-based identity platform from build into broad adoption across Amazon's businesses and partners. We pair strong engineering and product depth with rigorous program execution. Our culture is ownership-driven, data-informed, and deeply customer-obsessed: we debate hard problems openly, earn trust through delivered outcomes, and measure ourselves by the quality and adoption we drive, not the activity we generate.

- 10+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience

- Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules

descriptionHtml:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is looking for a Senior Solutions Architect to join our Commercial Sector Enterprise team in the UAE. You will work directly with customers in Media and Entertainment organizations navigating complex digital transformations where the technology strategy is not yet defined and the right path forward requires both technical depth and business judgment.

This is a builder role. You will go into customer environments, understand their hardest problems, and design solutions that work — from whiteboard architecture through proof of concept to production. You will bring deep expertise across cloud infrastructure, modern application development, data and analytics, and increasingly, generative AI and machine learning. You will earn trust by shipping things that matter, not by presenting slides.

You will be part of a collaborative, supportive team that values curiosity, ownership, and impact. We learn from each other, develop each other, and build an environment where every voice is heard.

Key job responsibilities
Key job responsibilities
As a Senior Solutions Architect, you will own the technical relationship with customers end-to-end. This means:

- Partnering with enterprise Media and Entertainment customers to understand their business objectives, assess their current technology landscape, and architect cloud solutions that deliver real outcomes — in cost optimization, operational efficiency, security, reliability, and innovation.

- Building hands-on: prototypes, proofs of concept, reference architectures, and production-ready designs. You lead by doing, not just advising.

- Helping customers adopt and build with generative AI and machine learning — identifying high-value use cases, designing architectures for foundation models and intelligent applications, and guiding teams from experimentation to production.

- Acting as the customer's technical advocate inside AWS — translating field insights into clear, prioritized feedback that shapes the roadmap for AWS services and features.

No two days look the same. You might spend the morning whiteboarding a cloud-based post-production architecture, then pivot to a hands-on working session helping a broadcaster's engineering team design an IP-based live production workflow. In the afternoon you might review a colleague's streaming platform architecture proposal, draft a blog post on a media supply chain pattern you discovered in the field, or hop on a call with an AWS service team to advocate for a feature your customer needs. You balance depth with breadth, strategic thinking with hands-on execution, and customer urgency with long-term technical direction.

Come work at Amazon!

As a member of Leo MAC-SW, you will be responsible for delivering embedded FW code running on ground networks on customer terminals and on satellites. * Profile and execute the code on RTOS and/or bare-metal embedded environment

* Define, document, test and debug your FW-HW interfaces

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience

- Experience programming with at least one software programming language

title: Senior Customer Solutions Manager, Global Financial Services
descriptionHtml:
We're looking for someone who gets fired up about turning bold customer visions into real, lasting impact through innovation. Someone who can earn the trust of business executives and roll up their sleeves with customer teams to get things done. A savvy problem solver who loves untangling complex challenges, finding creative solutions, and going the extra mile to surprise and delight customers — advocating on their behalf every step of the way.

If you're energized by big challenges, motivated by impact, and ready to shape the future of financial services — we would love to meet you.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is seeking a Senior Customer Solutions Manager (CSM) to come join our Global Financial Services team to work with one or more of our largest financial services industry customers. CSMs help customers realize sustained business value by accelerating their cloud transformation journey.

Key job responsibilities
You'll be a Trusted Advisor to one or more of AWS's largest financial services customers, guiding them through their cloud transformation journey across three pillars:

🎯 Value Realization - Identify and accelerate business outcomes by connecting customers with the right AWS services, partner solutions, and best practices at the right time.

📈 Enablement - Build programs that grow your customer's cloud fluency — think skills guilds, experience-based accelerators, training partnerships, and hands-on learning.

⚙️ Governance - Help customers establish the operating models and structures (Cloud/AI CoE, communities of practice, adoption frameworks) that set them up for long-term, scalable success.

A day in the life
You'll split your time between direct customer engagement, partner collaboration, and internal orchestration across AWS teams. On any given day, you might:

Define strategic opportunities tied to large-scale migrations, AI/GenAI, data & analytics, digital innovation, or product modernization

Drive detailed business and technical discussions with stakeholders at every level

Navigate risks and roadblocks using acceleration frameworks to keep programs on track

Coach customers through their cloud journey and advocate for their needs with AWS leadership, product, and engineering teams

Package your best practices into reusable assets that elevate the entire CSM community

This is an individual contributor (IC) role — your impact comes from influence, expertise, and relationships

About the team
Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.


About the team
👥 About the Team
Global Financial Services CSMs are trusted advisors who bring experience, industry insight, and genuine care for customers. Our culture is built on:

Customer Influence — We deeply understand our customers' business context and proactively guide their cloud journey

Excellence — We bring the best of AWS and our partner ecosystem to every engagement

Agility — We bring clarity to complexity through iterative, experience-based approaches

Growth — We support each other, celebrate diverse perspectives, and create space for everyone to lead

Data-Driven Decisions — We rely on facts and data, contextualized by expertise, to drive priorities

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of leading large-scale, technical or engineering programs with a proven record of thought leadership, business case development, realizing customer benefits, and successful program completion experience
- 2+ years of customer-facing work, engaging with customer executives, technologists or partners to solve business problems with advanced technologies experience
- Bachelor's degree in science, technology, engineering, math, business or equivalent
- Experience leading technical and non-technical transformation project teams with a proven ability to work across broad functional teams

Preferred qualifications

- PMP certification, or SCRUM/Agile, SAFe certification
- Experience implementing cloud services including migrations and modernization projects or similar

title: Senior HW Dev Engineer-Payload, Leo PAA Hardware
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is an initiative to launch a constellation of Low Earth Orbit satellites that will provide low-latency, high-speed broadband connectivity to unserved and underserved communities around the world.

A day in the life:
As an Senior Hardware Engineer, you will have the opportunity to work on some of the most innovative, challenging, and exciting phased array antenna systems in industry right now. You will engage with an experienced team to conceive and design phased arrays aimed at delighting customers with affordable, reliable, high bandwidth connectivity. You will work closely with Amazon Leo’s various sub-teams and engage third party suppliers to drive product definition, design, optimization, implementation, and test. The Senior Hardware Engineer will have a complete understanding of how their design changes impact downstream partners such as operations, supply chain, product management, and reliability. They will make daily high-value judgements on tactical vs. strategic decisions in order to achieve system performance targets and maintain schedules despite unexpected challenges.

Amazon strongly believes in Ownership and you will have the opportunity to own your designs from concept through production. You will own or contribute to the following:

- Own PCBA development from concept through production
- Design and optimize different blocks of electronics sub-systems
- Design high-speed digital circuitry in collaboration with various teams
- Lead and review schematic capture and PCB layout
- Lead PCB vendor engagement for DFM review
- Optimize PCB stack-up for performance and cost
- Generate test plans/procedures based off high level requirement definition
- Complete board bring-up and perform test campaigns for different modules and subsystems
- Design of automated test systems, test fixtures, and factory test
- Support the transition of the designs to production

About the hiring group:
The payload team is responsible for the architecture, design, implementation, validation, qualification, and new product introduction to manufacturing for all satellite payload. These payload systems will meet performance requirements as well as environmental and reliability requirements. To this end, the payload team collaborates closely with all the partner teams including silicon, power, mechanical, thermal, modem, RF/Coms system, and SW teams.

Export Control Requirement:
Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Basic qualifications

- Experience in developing functional specifications, design verification plans and functional test procedures
- Bachelor's degree or above in electrical engineering, computer engineering, or equivalent
- Experience in system-level architecture and board-level design
- Experience in hardware lab equipment such as digital scopes, logic analyzers, and soldering tools
- Experience in layout design
- Experience in motherboard design, PCB design including schematic capture, stackup and circuit board layout
- Experience in high-speed digital design, multi-gigabit SERDES, and signal integrity

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree in electrical engineering, computer engineering, or equivalent
- Experience working with interdisciplinary teams to execute product design from concept to production
- Experience with the project management of technical projects
- Familiarity with analog electronic fundamentals (transistor circuits, op-amps, filters, etc)
- Experience in design, implementation, bring up and debugging of proof of concept HW and prototypes
- Familiarity with power supply design

title: Engineering Operations Technician
descriptionHtml:
Join our dynamic team and become a critical guardian of technological infrastructure! As a Data Center Engineering Technician, you'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of mission-critical technology infrastructure, ensuring seamless operations that power global digital experiences. Your expertise will directly contribute to maintaining an extraordinary 99.999% uptime, keeping the digital world running smoothly and efficiently.

Engineering Technicians are Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting. They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot, Data Center Operation’s Mission Critical Facilities, which includes stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, as well as three phase electrical systems such as: switch gear, UPSs, PDUs, wet cell batteries and associated systems, CRAC, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers/water chemical system, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, & motors.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

NOTE: PDX is an AWS GovCloud region. As required by our contracts with the federal government, effective February 24, 2026, logical access to the AWS GovCloud region will be restricted to Amazon employees who are U.S. Citizens. (GovCloud may NOT be accessed from outside of the United States).

NOTE: Lump sum stipend will be provided to eligible candidates who relocate for this position.

Key job responsibilities
- Daily building rounds to monitor and record information from electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment to ensure 24/7 reliability and availability
- Monitor Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Management System (EPMS)
- Assist in troubleshooting of facility and rack-level events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLA)
- Perform rack installs and rack decommissioning within internal SLA
- Perform PM, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and repair of electrical and mechanical equipment
- Technical writing to support change management program
- Monitor daily work requests and manage to resolution, and execute projects from conception to completion
- On-site support of contractors, sub-contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices, procedures & local legislation
- Work schedule changes depending on specific site needs. Shifts can be up to 12-hours and may rotate on a predefined schedule. Some locations have on-call rotations.
- Role may support more than one location/site.

title: Hardware Reliability Engineer, Amazon Leo - Optical Inter-Satellite Link (OISL)
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is an initiative to increase global broadband access through a constellation of 3,236 satellites in low Earth orbit (LEO). Its mission is to bring fast, affordable broadband to unserved and underserved communities around the world. Amazon LEO will help close the digital divide by delivering fast, affordable broadband to a wide range of customers, including consumers, businesses, government agencies, and other organizations operating in places without reliable connectivity.

We are building the next generation of optical interconnect systems, and reliability is at the heart of what we do. We are seeking a Reliability Engineer to join our OISL Reliability team. In this role, you will develop and execute reliability strategies for complex opto-mechanical, electrical, and electro-optical hardware—ensuring products meet qualification and lifetime requirements for the LEO environment. You will work cross-functionally with design, systems, manufacturing, and test engineering teams to build reliability into products from concept through production. You will have the opportunity to work on state-of-the-art technologies, collaborate with world-class engineers, and make a direct impact on product quality and customer satisfaction.

Export Control Requirement:
Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.


Key job responsibilities
• Develop, implement, and maintain reliability models and frameworks for electrical, mechanical, and optical components and assemblies;
• Conduct failure mode and effects analysis (FMEA), fault tree analysis (FTA), and root cause analysis (RCA) for hardware systems and subsystems;
• Define and execute reliability demonstration testing (RDT), accelerated life testing (ALT), highly accelerated life testing (HALT);
• Apply reliability growth models, Weibull analysis, and other statistical tools to predict and improve product lifetime;
• Establish reliability requirements and verification plans for new product development programs;
• Collaborate with design engineering to implement Design for Reliability (DfR) principles and conduct reliability risk assessments;
• Collaborate with system-level engineering teams to assess and improve overall system reliability and availability;
• Investigate field and test failures to identify failure modes, mechanisms, and root causes; drive corrective actions to closure;
• Develop and maintain reliability documentation including test plans, reports, and specifications;
• Support qualification and validation activities for components and assemblies;
• Communicate reliability findings and recommendations to leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering, material engineering, mechanical engineering or related fields
- Industry experience with reliability engineering principles and methodologies, including reliability models (e.g. Weibull), statistical analysis, fault tree analysis, highly accelerated life testing (HALT), highly accelerate stress screening (HASS), accelerated life testing (ALT), and reliability demonstration testing (RDT)
- Experience with failure analysis techniques and root cause investigation
- Experience with data analysis and scripting (Python, MATLAB, or equivalent)

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree or above in engineering or equivalent
- Experience with optics, opto-electronics, or optical communication systems
- Experience with system-level reliability concepts, including reliability block diagrams and system availability modeling
- Familiarity with industry reliability standards (e.g., Telcordia GR-468, MIL-HDBK-217, MIL-STD-810, JEDEC, IEC 61709)
- Knowledge of space or LEO environmental requirements (thermal vacuum, radiation, atomic oxygen, outgassing)
- Prior experience in a hardware reliability or component engineering role within the optical communications or aerospace industry
- New Product Introduction (NPI) or manufacturing process qualification experience
- Strong written and verbal communication skills

title: Automation Engineer, Prime Video Trust & Safety
descriptionHtml:
At Prime Video, we’re redefining how the world watches entertainment. Our Trust & Safety team protects millions of customers and content creators globally, ensuring a safe, reliable experience. As an Automation Architect, you’ll drive the adoption of automation across our operations, bridging technical innovation with operational needs. You’ll architect solutions that scale content moderation, mitigate abuse, and empower our teams to deliver trusted and safe content to our customers.


Key job responsibilities
* Orchestration Leadership: Champion the integration of AI/automation tools (e.g., Generative AI, intelligent workflows) into Trust & Safety operations. Translate technical possibilities into actionable strategies for operational teams.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Data Science, Engineering, Product, and Legal teams to design solutions that balance speed, accuracy, and compliance.
* End-to-End Solution Design: Own the architecture of AI-driven systems for content moderation, risk detection, and policy enforcement. Move from prototype to production at Amazon scale.
* Operational Enablement: Drive the rollout of new tools, providing training, feedback loops, and iterative improvements to ensure adoption and value delivery.
* Strategic Narrative Development: Create compelling technical narratives (BRDs, PRFAQs, white papers) that align with business outcomes (e.g., reduced moderation latency, improved accuracy).


A day in the life
You start by reviewing emerging abuse patterns in Prime Video’s global platform. You collaborate with a Engineering and Data Science teams to design an Agentic Solutions that flags policy-violating content in real time. By midday, you’re leading a workshop with Trust & Safety analysts to demo the tool, addressing their concerns about false positives. Later, you partner with Engineering to prioritize features for the next sprint, ensuring the solution scales during high-traffic events. By day’s end, you update stakeholders on metrics—like a 20% reduction in moderation workload—and refine the roadmap for upcoming compliance challenges.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of program or project management experience
- 4+ years of technical specialist, design and architecture experience, or AWS Professional level certification
- Experience leading and collaborating with a large cross-functional team
- Experience in written and verbal communication with the ability to present complex technical information in a clear and concise manner to executives and non-technical leaders
- Bachelor's degree or above in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related fields

Preferred qualifications

- Orchestration and Automation Advocacy: Track record of driving automation adoption in operational teams.

title: Sr. Manager, Physical Design Engineering, Annapurna Labs
descriptionHtml:
Annapurna Labs, designs custom silicon powering AWS’s cloud infrastructure. Custom SoCs live at the heart of Amazon ML servers — including Inferentia and Trainium Systems — delivering high-performance ML inference and training at cloud scale.

We’re looking for a Senior Manager, Physical Design Engineering to build and lead a world-class Physical Design team delivering multi-billion-transistor ML accelerator SoCs on latest tech nodes. This is a player-coach role: you will personally engage in the most critical technical decisions; chip-level floorplan architecture, multi-GHz timing convergence, high-speed I/O physical design, power delivery for KW class systems, and 2.5D / 3D integrations; while building a high-performing team and driving rigorous PPA targets, first-pass silicon success, and relentless continuous improvement.

Key job responsibilities
- Build, hire, and develop a physical design team of 10-15 engineers. Own headcount planning, performance management, career growth, and organizational scaling to support multiple concurrent tapeouts.

- Own the physical design strategy and execution roadmap across Inferentia, Trainium, and future products: implementation architecture, hierarchical methodology, PPA target-setting, and technology node adoption.

- Institutionalize continuous PPA improvement: benchmarking frameworks, regression tracking, design-quality dashboards, post-tapeout retrospectives, and structured improvement programs that compound across generations.

- Provide hands-on technical leadership on the hardest problems: multi-GHz timing closure, PDN architecture, high-speed I/O physical design, and 2.5D / 3D cross-die integration.

- Lead technology node enablement for 2nm and beyond: PDK evaluation, reference flow development, PPA pathfinding, and adoption recommendations.

- Define and deploy innovative RTL2GDS methodologies and CAD flows. Champion AI/ML-augmented design automation (RL-placement, ML-guided ECO, predictive analytics). Optimize cloud infrastructure for PD compute.

- Serve as part of senior technical interface with foundry partners and EDA vendors on tool roadmap, co-development, and technology co-optimization.

- Own tapeout execution: readiness reviews, foundry submittal, mask data coordination, and post-silicon yield learning. Drive cross-functional alignment with RTL, DFT, STA, Package, and Validation teams.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years people management leading PD teams of 8+ engineers, including hiring, performance management, and organizational growth.
- 10+ years hands-on ASIC/SoC physical design across multiple advanced nodes (7nm, 5nm, 3nm) with multiple successful tapeouts.
- Technical depth across full RTL-to-GDSII: floorplanning, CTS, routing, timing closure, PDN design, IR-drop/EM signoff, physical verification, and tapeout.
- Mastery of both EDA ecosystems: Synopsys (Fusion Compiler/ICC2, PrimeTime, StarRC, RedHawk-SC) AND Cadence (Innovus, Tempus, Quantus, Voltus). Physical verification with Siemens Calibre (DRC, LVS, PERC).
- Deep expertise in advanced STA (MMMC, POCV/AOCV, SSTA, PBA, IR-aware timing) and power integrity (static/dynamic IR-drop, EM, rush current, Ldi/dt, package-aware analysis).
- Proven expertise in high-speed PD (multi-GHz datapaths, SerDes, DDR5, HBM, PCIe Gen5+, UCIe) and low-power design (UPF, power gating, DVFS, retention).
- Experience with hierarchical methodologies for very large SoCs (>1B transistors). Expert scripting in TCL, Python, Perl.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience leading PD for AI/ML accelerators, GPUs, or high-performance data-center SoCs at leading semiconductor companies or hyperscalers.
- Direct 3nm GAA/Nanosheet experience; 2nm or sub-2nm engagement. Familiarity with CFET and backside power delivery (BSPDN).
- Quantifiable track record of continuous PPA improvement and metric-driven flow development across multiple projects and nodes.
- Strong program execution: managing concurrent tapeouts, milestone tracking, risk identification, and executive communication.
- Hands-on 2.5D/3D integration experience (CoWoS, EMIB, InFO, SoIC, Foveros) and chiplet strategy with UCIe.
- Track record deploying AI/ML-driven design methodologies in production flows.
- Experience with CPO, HBM4, silicon photonics, or CXL physical design.
- Multi-foundry technology assessment experience (TSMC, Samsung, Intel Foundry Services).
- Experience managing geographically distributed teams (U.S., Israel, global).
- Experience scaling PD organizations through 2x–3x growth. Patent portfolio or industry standards contributions (UCIe, IEEE).

title: Design Technologist II, Prime Video
descriptionHtml:
Are you interested in shaping the future of entertainment? Do you want to define the next generation of how and what Amazon customers are watching? Prime Video is changing the way people watch movies and TV. From one service, we’re delivering versatile ways to watch hundreds of thousands of movies, TV series, and live events on the web, mobile, and TV. Our service is available in more than 200 territories globally, and we’re just getting started.

Working closely with business and technology partners, we use research, design, and prototyping to guide early product development, bring clarity to engineering goals, and develop a customer-centric point of view. This is where you come in.

As a Design Technologist, you'll be a key part of our Experience Design organization. Your role will be all about proving, advancing, and evolving forward-thinking UX concepts through prototyping and hands-on product work. You'll work alongside other design technologists to bring design ideas (interactions, visuals, motion) to life.

Key job responsibilities
Build high-quality, functional prototypes that convey and advance the vision of future products
Collaborate with design leadership and key stakeholders throughout the product lifecycle
Work alongside designers, researchers, PMs, and engineers to drive concepts from idea to implementation
Advance design thinking by leveraging your platform expertise (e.g. web, mobile, TV)


A day in the life
As a Design Technologist at Prime Video, you’ll have the opportunity to wear many hats. We build prototypes across the Prime Video customer journey from helping customers discover their favorite content to designing new playback experiences including X-Ray, live sports, and advertising. Our team builds high-fidelity prototypes for TV, mobile and web clients using frontend technologies such as HTML/CSS/JS, React.js, Redux and Motion.js. Our team develops prototypes using AWS Bedrock to envision brand new Gen AI powered experiences for our customers.

About the team
We’re scrappy yet detailed-oriented, knowing when to build quickly versus diving into the details to produce higher fidelity prototypes. We bring our own design vision and support our design and engineering partners to help them ship faster. We also partner closely with UX researchers to create new experiences that our customers get to test and provide feedback on. Our prototypes are demoed to senior leadership to showcase what the future of Prime Video will look and feel like for our customers.

Basic qualifications

- 2+ years of front-end technologist, engineer, or UX prototyper experience
- Have an available online portfolio
- Have coding samples in front end programming languages
- Experience with web, mobile web, or mobile app front-end development
- Experience with UI design for complex workflows and for end users

Preferred qualifications

- Knowledge of technologies such as JavaScript/NodeJS, HTML/CSS, Responsive/Adaptive Design
- Knowledge of Python, Javascript, and source control (Git)
- Experience with AWS Services including EC2, Lambda, S3, DynamoDB, SQS

descriptionHtml:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) seeks a Physical Security Manager — Data Center Security for our ZRH Cluster (Zurich, Switzerland) data centers. This role is the primary physical security contact for assigned sites, reporting directly to the Cluster Security Manager.
In this role, you will execute tactical security operations while being exposed to strategic thinking — managing day-to-day security at your sites, resolving straightforward security challenges, and learning to contribute to cluster-level goals. You will own the security posture of your assigned sites, work on forward-looking tasks, and grow your expertise within one of the world’s largest cloud providers.
We offer comprehensive professional development and a clear growth path within a global security organization.


Key job responsibilities
Security Operations & Vendor Management
1. Own physical security operations for your assigned sites
2. Manage straightforward security problems and components of existing security programs
3. Apply established AWS security standards; resolve straightforward security problems in the absence of SOPs with input from senior management
4. Oversee access control systems, CCTV monitoring, guard force operations, and vendor contracts

title: Startups GTM Operations Lead
descriptionHtml:
AWS is seeking a Startups Go-To-Market Operations (GTM Ops) Lead to join our Startups GTM Ops team. The team delivers strategic insights on global trends in technology, startups, and venture capital, using rigorous analysis to guide the Startup business in how it approaches customers, deploys resources, and competes, all within an environment of rapid growth and increasing complexity. As a key analytical partner to the Startup leadership team, the GTM Ops Lead will conduct in-depth analysis across sales coverage, total addressable market, customer segmentation, competitive dynamics, and resource deployment. This role will build models, develop business frameworks, structure ambiguous problems, run scenario analyses, and translate complex data into clear recommendations that drive leadership decisions. They will apply AI tools daily to accelerate analysis, build automated workflows, and generate insights.

Key job responsibilities
The successful candidate must have exceptionally strong business acumen with the ability to structure ambiguous problems and develop frameworks that drive decisions. They should think like an operator - understanding how sales organizations work, where leverage exists, and how to model trade-offs across coverage, compensation, territory design, and investment allocation. This role will independently identify the right questions, build the analytical approach, and deliver recommendations.

The candidate should be familiar with the dynamics of delivering to senior leaders, where asks are frequently ambiguous, timelines are compressed, and the bar for accuracy and business judgment is high. They should demonstrate genuine interest in cloud and AI competitive dynamics, startup ecosystems, and how technology markets evolve. Strong written and verbal communication skills are essential, including the ability to synthesize complex analysis into concise, decision-ready narratives for executive audiences. In addition, this role presents and defends recommendations directly to senior executives and leads executive-level reviews. Strong collaboration skills and the ability to influence without authority are crucial, as this role works across sales, operations, business development, finance, marketing, and partner teams globally.

The candidate must be an active user of AI tools to accelerate their work; using AI to build models, generate scenarios, automate data pipelines, and produce insights faster. They should have strong judgment on where AI can be trusted and where human validation is essential. The ideal candidate is comfortable building models, creating scenario analyses, developing segmentation frameworks, and presenting structured recommendations to senior leaders under tight timelines.

About the team
About AWS
Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small- and mid-market accounts to enterprise-level customers including public sector. The AWS Global Support team interacts with leading companies and believes that world-class support is critical to customer success. AWS Support also partners with a global list of customers that are building mission-critical applications on top of AWS services.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field
- 5+ years of experience in Sales Operations, Strategy, Finance, Business Development, or analytical roles within technology companies
- Experience building financial models, solving complex problems quantitatively, and developing actionable data-driven business recommendations
- Experience working with large-scale data tools (e.g. SQL, Python, Excel) and producing executive-level written materials for senior audiences
- Experience in GTM strategy, including coverage/segmentation strategy, resource allocation, incentive compensation modeling, or territory planning

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in the startup ecosystem (VC, startup operations, or startup-focused roles at technology companies)
- Familiarity with cloud/AI competitive dynamics and how technology markets evolve
- Experience working in a matrixed environment, influencing strategy and achieving goals across the organization
- MBA or equivalent experience

- Active use of AI/GenAI tools to accelerate analysis, scenario modeling, and workflow automation

title: Engineering Operation Technician, DCC Communities
descriptionHtml:
Join our dynamic team and become a critical guardian of technological infrastructure! As a Data Center Engineering Technician, you'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of mission-critical technology infrastructure, ensuring seamless operations that power global digital experiences. Your expertise will directly contribute to maintaining an extraordinary 99.999% uptime, keeping the digital world running smoothly and efficiently.

Engineering Technicians are Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting. They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot, Data Center Operation’s Mission Critical Facilities, which includes stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, as well as three phase electrical systems such as: switch gear, UPSs, PDUs, wet cell batteries and associated systems, CRAC, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers/water chemical system, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, & motors.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

NOTE: Amazon does not sponsor for immigration, including for H-1B, TN, and other non-immigrant visas, for this role.
NOTE: Lump sum stipend will be provided to eligible candidates who relocate for this position.



Key job responsibilities
- Daily building rounds to monitor and record information from electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment to ensure 24/7 reliability and availability
- Monitor Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Management System (EPMS)
- Assist in troubleshooting of facility and rack-level events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLA)
- Perform rack installs and rack decommissioning within internal SLA
- Perform PM, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and repair of electrical and mechanical equipment
- Technical writing to support change management program
- Monitor daily work requests and manage to resolution, and execute projects from conception to completion
- On-site support of contractors, sub-contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices, procedures & local legislation
- Work schedule changes depending on specific site needs. Shifts can be up to 12-hours and may rotate on a predefined schedule. Some locations have on-call rotations.
- Role may support more than one location/site.

Physical Requirements:
- Willingness and demonstrated ability to work in the following physical conditions with reasonable accommodations:
- Regularly lift and/or move up to 39 pounds independently
- Participate in group lifts for 40+ pounds
- Maintain balance and perform construction tasks while on a ladder
- Regularly walk, use hands and fingers, handle or feel, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl, climb stairs, twist, bend, work above shoulders, grasp, carry, push and pull objects into position
- Work in an environment requiring provided ear protection

This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.

Essential Requirements:
- Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed
- Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational
- Travel frequency will vary based on business needs and operational status of assigned facility

Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs.



A day in the life
This role acts as Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment preventative maintenance (PM) and troubleshooting, reporting to a site’s Data Center Facility Manager (FM). They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot mission-critical data center facility equipment including stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, 3 phase electrical systems such as switchgear, UPS units, PDUs, and wet cell batteries and associated systems. Mechanical equipment includes CRAHU units, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers, water systems, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, and motors. Additional support equipment is included in the scope of the role which includes fire/life safety equipment, building automation systems, and general facilities equipment.

Basic qualifications

- 2+ years of electrical and mechanical facilities maintenance, or 2+ years of electrical facilities maintenance and 1+ years of mechanical facilities maintenance experience
- 2+ years of Microsoft Office products and applications experience

Preferred qualifications

- 2+ years of data center engineering experience
- Experience reading and writing procedures, technical documents, and engineering drawings

descriptionHtml:
This position is part of the AWS Specialist and Partner Organization (ASP). Specialists own the end-to-end go-to-market strategy for their respective technology domains, providing the business and technical expertise to help our customers succeed. Partner teams own the strategy, recruiting, development, and growth of our key technology and consulting partners. Together they provide our customers with the expertise and scale needed to build innovative solutions for their most complex challenges.

Are you passionate about launching programs that raise the bar for partner quality, building automation at scale and working at the intersection of technology and business? The AWS Partner Core Tech team is looking for a Senior Solutions Architect to lead the worldwide technical strategy for AWS Specializations — a portfolio of 44+ competency programs that validate partner expertise and serve as the primary trust signal for customers navigating a 140,000+ partner ecosystem.

This is a unique opportunity to serve as the steward of that trust at scale — ensuring the AWS Specialization badge remains the definitive mark of partner quality while making it faster and easier for qualified partners to earn. You will define automation priorities, build cross-functional mechanisms that span multiple programs, and drive program launches from strategy through post-launch success. You will collaborate directly with AWS business teams and partners to shape the future of specializations at a time of significant program transformation — consolidating legacy specializations, expanding AI-powered validation, and launching the largest competency categories in program history. By leveraging emerging technologies — including AI-powered validation agents — you will scale program integrity and partner experience while pioneering the use of AWS's own AI services to power internal operations.

title: AMER Data Center Delivery Operations Program Manager, Infrastructure
descriptionHtml:
Work hard, have fun, and make history at Amazon Web Services!

The AWS Data Center Delivery Operations team is searching for a passionate and talented Program Manager to own the operating rhythm of our AMER Capacity Delivery organization. AWS is at the forefront of a rapidly changing industry, delivering data center capacity at unprecedented pace and scale. This role owns the mechanisms that keep our leaders informed and our teams aligned, including monthly goal reviews, weekly and cross-organizational business reviews, and the end-to-end headcount planning cycle. This is a high impact role offering the opportunity to work directly with senior leaders, business operations partners, and finance to raise the bar on how we plan, review, and communicate progress against our goals. The ideal candidate is an owner with strong business judgment, exceptional written communication, a bias for building mechanisms that scale, and the ability to align cross-functional teams and drive work to closure.

Key job responsibilities
Owning and running the monthly goal review mechanisms for the organization. This includes preparing and coordinating goal status inputs, driving the standard reporting format, managing the review calendar, and ensuring leaders have a clear, accurate view of progress ahead of each review.

Leading the operating cadence of business reviews across the team and organization, including the Weekly Business Review (WBR) and other cross-business reviews. This involves coordinating content owners, managing deck preparation, and setting and enforcing corrections and submission deadlines so content is decision-ready.

Managing the headcount planning process end to end. This includes operating plan cycles, top-down and bottom-up alignment, and partnering with finance and headcount POCs on artifacts, and timelines.

Serving as the connective tissue between leadership, business operations, finance, and functional teams, translating leadership priorities into clear operating mechanisms and following up to closure on action items and decisions.

Identifying opportunities to simplify, standardize, and automate recurring reporting, reducing manual effort and cycle times while improving quality and consistency.

Communicating clearly to a range of stakeholders and executives through high-quality narratives, executive summaries, and review documents that make the story clear for a senior audience.

A day in the life
Each day you will interact with the teams and leaders responsible for planning and delivering data center capacity. You will prioritize the activities that are most impactful to the operating rhythm and to leadership visibility.

Start your morning finalizing the inputs for an upcoming monthly goal review.
Reconcile a set of WBR corrections against a deadline.
Partner with finance on a headcount comparison for the next planning cycle.
Edit a leadership narrative before it goes out.
Move between the details of a spreadsheet and a room with senior leaders, trusted to run the mechanism so leaders can focus on the decisions.

About the team
Join the AWS Data Center Planning & Delivery team, where we are not just building data centers, we are architecting the future of cloud computing. You will join a tight-knit business operations function supporting AMER Capacity Delivery. We value ownership, clear writing, and mechanisms that scale. This role works across the organization and with partner teams, giving you broad visibility into how AWS plans and delivers data center capacity.

Basic qualifications

- 4+ years of program or project management experience
- 4+ years of defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics experience
- Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps) at an advanced level and SQL
- Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
- Experience working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams

Preferred qualifications

- 4+ years of communicating with and presenting to executive and senior audiences experience
- 4+ years of driving process improvements experience
- Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization
- Experience building processes, project management, and schedules

title: Sr. Innovation and Design Engineer, Worldwide Design and Engineering
descriptionHtml:
Are you an innovative leader that wants to architect the next generation of automated fulfillment solutions before they become reality? Do you want high-level ownership in solving complex, ambiguous problems at the earliest stages of concept development? Does the challenge of designing advanced system integrations that leverage breakthrough technologies, robotics, and material handling equipment appeal to you? If so, we have the job for you!

We're looking to add a high-impact Innovation & Design Engineer to our Advanced Concept Team. In this role, you will drive early-stage concept design and system modeling for next-generation fulfillment architectures. You will own advanced concept projects from initial modeling through design approval, creating the blueprints that guide future network implementation. You will develop functional requirements and collaborate with product development teams, ensuring automation technologies meet holistic fulfillment needs.
Your projects will focus on advanced concept integration across multiple automation technologies, creating solutions that span hardware, software, and operational requirements. You will work on concepts that may become templates for new construction or retrofit strategies across Amazon's global fulfillment network.

You will collaborate with a team of highly skilled engineers in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment where business problems are often undefined. Our team operates horizontally across WWDE's business verticals, with regular senior leadership engagement. You will be challenged to think strategically; you will learn innovative automation technologies; you will work on high-impact, high-visibility concepts that shape Amazon's fulfillment strategy; you will grow as a technical leader through mentoring and cross-functional collaboration.

Key job responsibilities
- Own end-to-end concept design including physical layout, system modeling, and ergonomic assessment for next-generation automated fulfillment solutions
- Design advanced concept integration for ASRS, robotics, and material handling equipment in early-stage development phases
- Create visual prototypes and design artifacts that communicate complex automation concepts to cross-functional stakeholders and leadership
- Develop cost-effective solutions leveraging automated material handling equipment, packaging technologies, and robotics for future network implementation
- Create technical documentation including functional requirements which guide product development for downstream implementation teams
- Author technical white papers that convey highly complex designs and trade-offs to senior leadership audiences
- Iterate on early-stage concept designs through simulation and modeling to optimize space utilization, throughput, and operational efficiency

A day in the life
You start your morning reviewing CAD layouts for a next-generation ASRS concept, refining integration points based on simulation results. Mid-morning, you present visual prototypes of your robotic cell design to the product team, translating complex automation concepts into clear functional requirements. After lunch, you mentor an junior engineer on their first advanced concept design, helping them think through system-level trade-offs and ergonomic considerations. You close the day iterating on layout optimizations for your second active project, a regional distribution center retrofit concept, preparing technical documentation that will guide the implementation team's development phase.

Amazon offers a full range of benefits that support you and eligible family members, including domestic partners and their children can use. Benefits can vary by location, the number of regularly scheduled hours you work, length of employment, and job status such as seasonal or temporary employment. The benefits that generally apply to regular, full-time employees include:

1. Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage
2. Maternity and Parental Leave Options
3. Paid Time Off (PTO)
4. 401(k) Plan

If you are not sure that every qualification on the list above describes you exactly, we'd still love to hear from you! At Amazon, we value people with unique backgrounds, experiences, and skillsets. If you’re passionate about this role and want to make an impact on a global scale, please apply!

About the team
The Advanced Concept Team operates on the leading edge of fulfillment design. We operate in a highly ambiguous space and leverage advanced technologies to create system level concepts that transform Amazon's Logistics network.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of design & innovation, research & development work experience
- Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a foreign equivalent
- Experience in management of engineering design projects
- Experience using business or technical software like MS Excel, MS Project, and CAD software

Preferred qualifications

- 5+ years of specialty (with progressive responsibility) experience
- Knowledge of concepts like system architecture, optimization, system dynamics, system analysis, statistical analysis, reliability analysis, electronic system design, and decision making
- Master's degree in Engineering (any domain), Operations, Business Administration, or a related field

title: Senior Site EHS Manager
descriptionHtml:
At Amazon, we prioritize health, safety, and well-being above all else. There is nothing more important. To support this priority, Amazon is seeking an experienced and innovative Senior Site Workplace Health and Safety (WHS) Manager to join our team. In this position, you will be responsible for partnering with the site level operations team for your designated site in order to execute company WHS policies and ensure compliance to all applicable local and regional regulations. By leveraging lean principles and Kaizen events, you will lead continuous improvement initiatives to reduce conditional and ergonomic risk in Amazon’s processes to ensure a safe and healthful working environment for our associates.

In this role, you must demonstrate the ability to build trust and confidence with the cross functional operations teams, and influence change through providing comprehensive risk assessments and safety data analysis. To do so, you must be an effective communicator and send clear, concise and consistent messages, both verbally and in writing. You will also be required to instruct and train operations leadership and site WHS professionals in company EHS policies while assisting the regional teams in incorporating our safety standards at their sites. Your experience working in safety programs and your relevant safety, environmental and ergonomic knowledge in an operations environment will be crucial.
You will be responsible for developing a team of safety managers and safety professionals at your designated site. Your teams’ success will depend on your ability to create and execute leadership development plans for your larger team. You must demonstrate your ability to clearly communicate organizational direction through your team. As a senior leader in the WHS organization, you will also be responsible for judging and assessing safety talent to select appropriate bench strength for current and future business needs.

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:
- Act as SME of local/regional regulations and company WHS policy.
- Provide guidance and oversight to ensure compliance to all applicable Amazon Safety Policies.
- Measure site performance against published requirements in safety policies. For all deficiencies, identify a plan for the site to implement and fix all identified deficiencies.
- Ensure safety record keeping and data integrity and provides Operations with accurate reporting and metrics to support business safety initiatives.
- Deliver on-time and quality projects to Operations.
- Deep Dive safety metrics and review incident weekly and monthly incident trends to discover trends to justify the allocation of appropriate resources to areas where the safety risk is highest.
- Deep Dive trends and propose action plans to Sr. Leadership on site.
- Audit record keeping practices and Global Safety Database entries to ensure compliance to global safety standards and local regulations.
- Audit the workplace organization and Associate behaviors to ensure that training, auditing and scoring methods are accurate and consistent.
- Manage and mentor the Safety Managers and Safety Associates in your assigned site.
- Engage the Injury Prevention Specialists (IPS) and Site Leadership to drive long-term strategic actions to achieve incident reduction.
- Perform targeted Kaizen events in partnership with the Operations teams based on the risks identified in each task (force, repetition, and awkward postures).
- Ensure site leadership and associates are trained and knowledgeable of their responsibilities under each policy
- Audit the quality, delivery (including qualifications of the trainer), and effectiveness of all required safety training.
- Review for effectiveness the deployed safety tools and revise to ensure continual improvement.
- Partner with corporate and other regional field safety personnel to leverage global safety and environmental best practices into NA network standards.

Additional Job Elements include:
- Lift up to 49 pounds and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach
- Stand/walk for up to 12 hours during shifts
- Work in an environment where the noise level varies
- Work in an environment that is subject to variable temperatures and weather (delivery stations include outside loading departments)
- Continuously climb and descend stairs (applies to sites with stairs)
- Maintain effective care delivery in emergencies and assist emergency response at the site

Those that do not have an adult First Aid, CPR, AED certification from the American Heart Association or American Red Cross must obtain within 3 weeks of start date.

- Willingness to work a variety of shifts, including nights and weekends, as required to support direct reports and site needs

Preferred qualifications

- Demonstrate experience in developing others into higher levels of responsibility in an organization

This role will work closely with the EMEA D&C team and sub-consultants/vendors on project delivery.

The successful candidate is an experienced, and engaging professional who can communicate clearly at all levels, and yet is not afraid to dive deep into details. This role works autonomously and creatively in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment, and will be working on multiple projects and initiatives, most of which have very tight delivery timelines. Attention to detail and ability to inspect issues and processes brings simplified solutions to complex problems is paramount. They should also understand the nuance of being approachable, while at the same time consultative. The candidate must be able to balance frugality with creativity in offering solutions and approach problem-solving with an emphasis on root cause.

This is a Regional role focused on the EMEA region, so requires regional travel approximately 20-30% of the time. At Amazon, we also believe that in-person collaboration is essential to our culture and innovation. While we allow flexibility for personal circumstances, we generally expect employees to work from our offices five days a week. This approach has consistently shown that spontaneous interactions, rapid problem-solving, and the energy of in-person teamwork lead to better results for our customers. In particular, our data shows that teams working together in person are more effective at making complex decisions, onboarding new team members, and fostering the kind of creative collaboration that has driven Amazon's success. The serendipitous hallway conversations and impromptu whiteboarding sessions that happen naturally in an office environment have proven invaluable to our invention process and maintaining our high bar for excellence.

Key job responsibilities
- Oversee and manage the design of post-occupancy tenant improvement projects and small/medium new site projects and expansions, to include (1) leading the design of the space based on customer needs and technical requirements; (2) on some projects of a certain size/scale/priority, collaborate with an external/vendor design team (the Architect of Record) (3) align the design of each project to the overall concept for Corporate Workplace, as developed by the Global Design team; and (4) inform Guidelines and Standards team on design elements needed to translate into global functional Guidelines..
- Identify and implement continuous design refinement, leveraging operational data, customer insights, and success metrics to drive change.
- Work cross functionally with regional peers to ensure a consistent experience for customers, whilst respecting local/cultural nuance.
- Collaborate with GREF partner teams, including Regional Portfolio Management, Sustainability and Environmental Health and Safety, and Travel and Events, to elevate program deliverables and improve the quality of Amazon workspace with a focus on resiliency, efficiency, health, and safety.
- Routinely connect to external industry, professional bodies and communities, ensuring new industry standards, best practices, technology, and innovations are adopted into the program.


A day in the life
Day-to-day, this role will mainly collaborate with the EMEA Constrution team responsible for construction and delivery of projects. Also collaborate with external vendors as local project managers and design team (Architect of Record). Once projects are delivered, this role will work with the Workplace Guidelines & Standards team to indicate what design elements need to be integrated, including producing visuals and narratives that can be translated and published as Guidelines. The role will need also to be able to work in conjunction with other stakeholders to develop any process improvement initiatives or programs related to workplace design.

About the team
The Global Real Estate and Facilities (GREF) team manages Amazon's real estate and facilities globally. It's organized into Regional Portfolio Management, Global Centers of Enablement, and Global Centers of Expertise. Design, Sustainability and Engineering includes Global Design, Workplace Guidelines, Sustainability, and Engineering teams. These teams develop design concepts, implement workplace standards, and deliver various spaces across Amazon's portfolio. GREF emphasizes inclusive team culture, work-life balance, and career growth. The team values diversity and promotes knowledge sharing and mentorship. GREF strives to create spaces that support Amazonians' work while enhancing employee well-being and aligning with the company's strategic vision.

- Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements
- Experience in project and program management

- Experience that includes strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and effective communication abilities
- Experience in written and oral communication, including the ability to communicate with all levels in the organization (technical, business, executive)
