title: Engineering Operations Technician II, Data Center
descriptionHtml:
Join our dynamic team and become a critical guardian of technological infrastructure! As a Data Center Engineering Technician, you'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of mission-critical technology infrastructure, ensuring seamless operations that power global digital experiences. Your expertise will directly contribute to maintaining an extraordinary 99.999% uptime, keeping the digital world running smoothly and efficiently.

Engineering Technicians are Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting. They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot, Data Center Operation’s Mission Critical Facilities, which includes stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, as well as three phase electrical systems such as: switch gear, UPSs, PDUs, wet cell batteries and associated systems, CRAC, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers/water chemical system, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, & motors.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

NOTE: Lump sum stipend will be provided to eligible candidates who relocate for this position.

Key job responsibilities
- Daily building rounds to monitor and record information from electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment to ensure 24/7 reliability and availability
- Monitor Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Management System (EPMS)
- Assist in troubleshooting of facility and rack-level events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLA)
- Perform rack installs and rack decommissioning within internal SLA
- Perform PM, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and repair of electrical and mechanical equipment
- Technical writing to support change management program
- Monitor daily work requests and manage to resolution, and execute projects from conception to completion
- On-site support of contractors, sub-contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices, procedures & local legislation
- Work schedule changes depending on specific site needs. Shifts can be up to 12-hours and may rotate on a predefined schedule. Some locations have on-call rotations.
- Role may support more than one location/site.

Physical Requirements:
- Willingness and demonstrated ability to work in the following physical conditions with reasonable accommodations:
- Regularly lift and/or move up to 39 pounds independently
- Participate in group lifts for 40+ pounds
- Maintain balance and perform construction tasks while on a ladder
- Regularly walk, use hands and fingers, handle or feel, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl, climb stairs, twist, bend, work above shoulders, grasp, carry, push and pull objects into position
- Work in an environment requiring provided ear protection

This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.

Essential Requirements:

- Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed

- Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational

- Travel frequency will vary based on business needs and operational status of assigned facility

Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs.

A day in the life
This role acts as Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment preventative maintenance (PM) and troubleshooting, reporting to a site’s Data Center Facility Manager (FM). They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot mission-critical data center facility equipment including stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, 3 phase electrical systems such as switchgear, UPS units, PDUs, and wet cell batteries and associated systems. Mechanical equipment includes CRAHU units, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers, water systems, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, and motors. Additional support equipment is included in the scope of the role which includes fire/life safety equipment, building automation systems, and general facilities equipment.

Basic qualifications

- 2+ years of electrical and mechanical facilities maintenance, or 2+ years of electrical facilities maintenance and 1+ years of mechanical facilities maintenance experience
- 2+ years of Microsoft Office products and applications experience
- Work flexible schedule including weekends, nights, and holidays

Preferred qualifications

- 2+ years of data center engineering experience
- Experience reading and writing procedures, technical documents, and engineering drawings
- vocational/technical training or an associate degree or above, or 4+ years of military experience

title: Senior Program Manager, AMXL Network Planning, JP AMXL Network Planning

Launch

title: RME Area Manager, RME
descriptionHtml:
Amazon unterhält Hunderte von Betriebsstandorten in ganz Europa. Diese Standorte sind mehr als nur Arbeitsplätze – hier treffen sich unsere Teams und sorgen gemeinsam dafür, dass unsere Kund:innen zufrieden sind. Als Reliability Maintenance Engineering (RME) Area Manager:in bringst Du die Elemente zusammen, die unsere Arbeitsumgebung so unterstützend und effizient wie möglich machen. Du leitest und betreust ein Team technischer Fachkräfte, die dafür sorgen, dass unsere Geräte zuverlässig arbeiten.

Key job responsibilities
- Unterstützung der Kolleg:innen bei der Einhaltung der Sicherheitsrichtlinien und -abläufe am Standort
- Umsetzung des EU-Netzwerkstandards, Planung vorbeugender Wartungsmaßnahmen und Gewährleistung technischer Verfügbarkeit
- Kollaboration mit Kolleg:innen zur Datenerhebung und -analyse, um Prozesse zu verbessern
- Umsetzung und Unterstützung sowohl standortbasierter als auch netzwerkbasierter Projekte
- Leitung, Unterstützung und Mentoring für Dein Team, um die berufliche Entwicklung zu fördern

A day in the life
Du arbeitest an einem unserer Betriebsstandorte, bietest Deinem Team praktische Anleitung und verschaffst Dir einen klaren Überblick über alle Aktivitäten am Standort. Das beinhaltet die Erhebung von Daten und die Lösung von Problemen in einer dynamischen Umgebung. Außerdem erstellst Du einen Betriebsplan, um den Standort produktiver und effizienter zu machen. Dazu führst Du auch neue Projekte ein, die alles von den Betriebsabläufen bis hin zur Gerätewartung optimieren. Neben der Sicherheit ist der wichtigste Aspekt dieser Rolle die Leitung Deines Teams. Das beinhaltet das Management der Leistung und Entwicklung Deiner Teammitglieder ebenso wie die Organisation zusätzlicher Schulungen.

About the team
Unser Wartungs- und Instandhaltungsteam (Reliability Maintenance Engineering Team oder RME-Team) sorgt dafür, dass unsere Geräte und Ausstattung jederzeit optimal funktionieren. Wir sind ein Team von Techniker:innen und Ingenieur:innen, das aus hervorragenden Teamplayern besteht und von erfahrenen Führungskräften geleitet wird. Wir arbeiten gemeinsam daran, die Geräte in unserem gesamten globalen Netzwerk von Fulfillment-Centern zu warten, zu reparieren und ihre Fehler zu beheben. Einige unserer Mitarbeiter:innen sind Führungskräfte, die das Team bei der Arbeit an spannender, innovativer Technologie beaufsichtigen – die es teilweise nur bei Amazon gibt.
Von der Installation automatisierter Verpackungssysteme bis hin zur Beaufsichtigung der allgemeinen Wartungsarbeiten eines Standorts sowie der Reparatur von für den Vertrieb wesentlichen Geräten wickelt unser Team einen Großteil der technischen Aufgaben bei Amazon ab. Unter anderem sorgt es auch dafür, dass Gebäude weiterhin den rechtlichen Auflagen entsprechen, damit alle sicher bleiben und unsere Standorte mit maximaler Effizienz betrieben werden. Es gibt zahlreiche Aufstiegschancen im RME-Team selbst ebenso wie im gesamten Amazon-Unternehmen.

title: Transportation Specialist I, ROC
descriptionHtml:
About Amazon ROC (Relay Operation Centre):
Join a team that offers best learning opportunities and work experience in transportation execution, supply chain and operations management. A place where you can start/restart/advance your career and progress to leadership roles at Amazon.
ROC (Relay Operation Center) is the central command and control center for ‘Transportation Execution’ across the Amazon Supply Chain network supporting multiple geographies like NA and EU. It ensures hassle free, timely pick-up and delivery of freight from vendors to Amazon fulfillment centers (FC) and from Amazon FCs to carrier hubs. In case of any exceptions, ROC steps in to resolve the issue and keeps all the stakeholders informed on the proceedings. In addition to support provided for ATS organization This organization supports externalization of ROC capabilities to external shippers and vendors.
Along with this tactical problem-solving ROC is also charged with understanding trends in network exceptions and then automating processes or proposing process changes to streamline operations. This second aspect involves network monitoring and significant analysis of network data.
Overall, ROC plays a critical role in ensuring the smooth functioning of Amazon transportation network and thereby has a direct impact on Amazon’s ability to serve its customers on time.

Location: Hyderabad, TS, IND
Hours of Operation/Shift Timings: Rotational shifts (Position involves rotational shifts to support 24/7 operations. Schedule accommodations will be considered based on individual needs
Medium of support: Multi-mode (Voice and non-voice)

A synopsis of a ‘Transportation Specialist’ role:
A Transportation Specialist at ROC facilitates flow of information between different stakeholders (
Carriers/Hubs/Warehouses) and resolves any potential issues that impacts customer experience and business continuity. Transportation Specialist at ROC works across two verticals – Inbound and Outbound operations.
• Inbound (IB) Operations deals with Vendor/Shipper/Carrier/Amazon Sites relationship, ensuring that the freight is picked-up on time and is delivered at destination sites as per the given appointment.
• Outbound (OB) Operations deals with Amazon Sites/Carrier/Carrier Hub/Shipper destination sites relationship, ensuring that the outbound truck leaves Amazon sites/Shipper origin sites to deliver customer orders as per promise.
• Transportation Specialists addresses any potential issues such as appointment bookings, reschedules, in-transit disruptions, weather impact situations etc. occurring during the lifecycle of pick-up to delivery.
• In addition to the IB or OB operations, transportation specialists support variety of tasks such as load scheduling, load cancelations, supporting network capacity management, coordinating with non-Amazon transportation organization such as rail, sea organizations, manage remote gate-houses, managing equipment availability, equipment maintenance and such.

A Transportation Specialist provides timely resolution to the issue in hand by researching and querying internal tools and by taking real-time decisions. An ideal candidate should be able to understand the requirements from sites/carriers/shippers/drivers and be able to analyze data and effectively communicate the resolution or actions with an effort to meet the network speed and customer promise. The candidate should have the basic understanding of Logistics and should be able to communicate clearly in the written and oral form. Transportation Specialist should be able to ideate process improvements and should have the zeal to drive them to conclusion.

Key job responsibilities
• Communicate with external customers (Carriers, Vendors/Suppliers, Shippers, Drivers) and internal customers (Amazon sites, business teams and stakeholders)
• Maintain high-standards of quality and productivity standards in all transactions or conversations
• Must be able to understand the size of problem and systemically escalate problems to the relevant owners and teams and follow through the closure of the issues
• Core responsibilities include working with Amazon Internal tools, MS Outlook, Word and Excel
• Must be able to quickly understand the business impact of the trends and make decisions in the best interest of customers and the organization based on available data.
• Work within various time constraints to meet critical business needs
• The organizational support runs across rotational shifts (24*7, 365 days) to support NA and EU regions. Candidates are expected to be flexible with such requirements while there are reasonable accommodations for employees with special circumstances.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in a quantitative/technical field such as computer science, engineering, statistics
- Experience with SQL
- 0–5 years of experience in customer support/operations support

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with Excel

title: Onsite Medical Representative
descriptionHtml:
Join Amazon’s mission to become Earth’s safest place to work! At Amazon, we’ve set the ambitious goal to become the benchmark of safety excellence across all industries in which we operate. The Amazon Workplace Health & Safety (WHS) team sets the strategic direction to provide resources, best practices, and safe environments to proactively manage the health and wellbeing of our workforce. To support these goals, Amazon is seeking an experienced and dynamic Onsite Medical Representative (OMR) to join our team. In this position, you will work closely with the WHS Site Manager, WHS Specialist, and occasionally the Injury Prevention Specialist (IPS). This includes attending weekly associate safety committee meetings, greeting all new hires for the site or through daily one-on-one interaction. Additionally, the OMR will participate in weekly case management review meetings as necessary.

As an OMR, you will independently assess and administer first aid as well as offer guidance to Amazon Associates (AAs) on both occupational and non-occupational injuries or illnesses. You should be passionate about learning and advocating health and wellness principles to consistently support AAs on a daily basis. You will refer care to outside medical providers as needed, and learn about OSHA regulations, risk, and analysis.

The OMR will function as a part of the larger team onsite, assisting with all first aid needs and support safety operations as needed.

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

Provide first aid support and make referrals to outside medical providers as necessary.
Minimize the AA risk of injury through awareness, education, and proactive engagement.
Maintain all records of care provided to AAs.
Coordinate and maintain the workers’ compensation and return to work programs for AAs with work-related injuries.
Provide daily activity logs and end of shift reports.
Engage with AAs and leadership on operations floor to provide coaching regarding observed at-risk work habits.
Maintain a clean working environment and ensure appropriate medical supply inventory is maintained.
Participate in training and certification to facilitate first aid, CPR and AED certifications classes.
Maintain all first aid, CPR, AED credentials.
Work flexible shifts which could include days, nights, holidays, and/or weekends.
Assist with random saliva drug testing protocols.
Maintain effective care delivery in emergencies and assist emergency response at the site.


Additional Job Elements include:

Lift up to 49 pounds and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach
Stand/walk for up to 12 hours during shifts
Work in an environment where the noise level varies
Work in an environment that is subject to variable temperatures and weather (delivery stations include outside loading departments)
Continuously climb and descend stairs (applies to sites with stairs)


For those that do not have an adult First Aid, CPR, AED certification from the American Heart Association or American Red Cross, must obtain within 3 weeks of start date.

Basic qualifications

- High school or equivalent diploma
- Current valid Basic Life Support (BLS) certification by an approved emergency cardiac care (ECC) provider; AND must have one of the following:
- Current valid Emergency Medical Technician (EMT) OR Paramedic Certification from the Department of Health OR the National Registry of Emergency Medical Technicians (NREMT); OR
- Current active Athletic Trainer Certification, by either the Board of Certification (BOC) or equivalent State Certification.

Preferred qualifications

- Certified to teach first aid, CPR, and AED training from American Heart Association or American Red Cross
- Proficient in Microsoft Office
- Experience with an industrial wellness program
- Experience managing musculoskeletal disorders, ergonomics, and coaching on body mechanics
- Demonstrated work experience with OSHA regulations and Workers Compensation
- Proficient in digital recordkeeping
- In the last year, six months job experience in the Military as a Combat Medic (U.S. Army), Field Medic (U.S. Army), Healthcare Specialist (U.S. Army), Hospital Corpsman (U.S. Navy), or Aerospace Medical Service Technician (U.S. Air Force)

title: Data Center Controls Engineer, Controls Deployment Service
descriptionHtml:
As part of the global controls team, you will work with highly motivated experts and innovators in the data center industry. You will be responsible for troubleshooting, project management, and maintaining the building management system (BMS) and electrical power monitoring system (EPMS). Using Amazon leadership principles, you will develop new processes and standards while innovating in the controls space. AWS Data centers have multiple components such as generators, uninterruptable power sources, diesel generators, electrical switchgear, power distribution units, variable frequency drives, automatic/static transfer switches, chillers [air-cooled and water-cooled], pumps, cooling towers, heat exchangers, CRAHs, air economizers, etc. All these components have local control systems that interact with each other via open and/or proprietary communications protocols. The BMS is the primary method of control of all mechanical systems within a data center. The EPMS is the primary method of monitoring all electrical systems within a data center.

This role may require up to 40% travel to support site operations and project needs.

Key job responsibilities
Train and assist internal customers and stakeholders with the creation, design, configuration, validation, installation, commissioning and operation of BMS and EPMS systems.

Provide technical assistance and support to operations during life cycle of the data center.  Review results and action items from the quarterly maintenances for BMS and EPMS and take actions to get them resolved.

Develop BMS & EPMS projects scope of work, schedule, budget, and level of efforts (LOE) to projects requested by customers and stakeholders.

Manage scope, schedule, finance and execution of BMS and EPMS improvement projects in AWS data centers.

Assist in procurement related activities including request for quotation/proposals, responding to request for information, review of vendors proposal and issuance of purchase orders.

Participate in AWS global on-call schedule to provide immediate BMS and EPMS technical support to in-service data centers.  Attend project related meetings, coordinate with project leaders and regularly report status to Controls and stakeholders management.

Support Controls projects related commissioning activities in the data centers.

Review, implement, troubleshoot and iterate on the controls sequence of operation (SOO) and provide necessary feedback to the design team.

Develop and modify controls logic programming and graphical user interfaces.

Manage multiple stakeholder deliverables, requirements and navigate challenging situations.

Financially manage BMS and EPMS service contracts.

Frequently visit (locally) assigned in-operation data centers to troubleshoot, meet customers, supervise vendor’s work to ensure compliance with the scope, design, SOO and applicable local codes.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field
- 4+ years of general contractor and vendor management work (request for proposals, bidding, change orders, quality control, RFI/submittal tracking) associated with construction and project execution experience
- Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering or a related field plus 5+ years of relevant controls experience, OR 10+ years of relevant controls experience in lieu of a degree.
- 5+ years of experience with industrial controls in critical environment (data center, pharmaceutical, manufacturing, oil & gas, petrochemical, laboratory, power, water etc.).

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field
- Experience designing, configuring, programming, installing, troubleshooting or servicing HVAC Controls or Electrical SCADA systems application specific controllers, software and networks.
- Experiencing using common industrial communication protocols (MQTT, BACnet and/or MODBUS).
- Demonstrated understanding of engineering documentation, electrical and mechanical diagrams, and standard operating procedures.
- Ability to manage multiple stakeholder deliverables, requirements, and navigate difficult situations.
- Experience designing data centers or critical MEP infrastructure
- Registered as a Professional Engineer (PE), or certified Project Management Professional (PMP).
- Prior AWS/Amazon experience
- 4+ Yr. Military Service

descriptionHtml:
Amazon's Legal Operations organization is looking for a Program Manager to lead eDiscovery program delivery at a global scale. In this role, you will own the technology roadmap for eDiscovery, drive cross-functional programs across engineering, legal, and vendor teams, and stand up AI-powered capabilities that transform how Amazon manages litigation support. The Legal Operations team is data-driven and systems-oriented— we measure what matters, automate what we can, and build for scale. This role involves access to confidential legal information and requires a high level of professionalism, integrity, and discretion.

Define success metrics for program initiatives and build reporting frameworks that give leadership visibility into matter health, vendor performance, and operational efficiency.

Collaborate with IT, Security, and Microsoft 365/Purview teams on legal hold automation, custodian data collection, and preservation workflows. Your morning might be a program review for a vendor API integration you're managing. By mid-morning you're configuring an AI pilot—tuning recall thresholds on a document review model. After lunch you're drafting a business case for a platform migration, pulling cost and throughput data into a narrative for senior leadership. No two days look the same—some weeks are technical delivery, others are vendor negotiations and program roadmaps. You connect the technical reality to the business outcome, and you own both.

About the Role

Twitch Security Platform builds and operates the foundational software, data, and automation that enable security at scale across Twitch. title: Senior Account Executive, Defence - ADF, ANZ Public Sector
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is seeking a Senior Account Executive to join our ANZ Defence team, focused on the Australian Defence Force (ADF) and the broader national security ecosystem.

This is a mission-first role. Your primary objective is to deeply understand how Defence operates, prepares, and sustains itself, and to work alongside Defence leaders to solve their hardest problems through cloud technology. You will be embedded in the mission conversation: understanding capability gaps, force design challenges, and operational imperatives, then working with AWS teams to bring solutions that genuinely advance Defence outcomes.

Australia's strategic circumstances have fundamentally shifted. The National Defence Strategy demands accelerated preparedness, a focused force structure, and the ability to project and sustain capability across our region. Defence needs technology partners who understand this context, who can operate at pace, within classification, and with the trust that comes from shared purpose.

Applicants must be Australian citizens and must hold, or be able to attain, an Australian Government Security Vetting Agency (AGSVA) clearance at NV2 or above. See: https://www1.defence.gov.au/security/clearances

In this role, you can expect to travel interstate up to 50% of the time.

What Makes This Role Different

- Operate inside Defence's decision-making architecture. You will understand how capability is identified, developed, acquired, and sustained through the Integrated Investment Program, and where cloud technology creates leverage at each stage.
- Build relationships measured in years. You will earn the trust of military commanders, SES-level civilians, and capability managers through demonstrated credibility and commitment to their mission.
- Work across classification boundaries. You will engage across all classification levels, understanding the implications for solution design, data sovereignty, and workforce requirements.
- Connect operational problems to technology solutions. You will listen deeply to mission challenges and orchestrate AWS's technical, professional services, and partner resources to address them.

Key job responsibilities
- Develop and maintain deep understanding of your assigned Defence customers' missions, force structure, capability plans, and operational challenges. Become a credible interlocutor who earns the right to advise.
- Build enduring, trust-based relationships with military personnel of all ranks up to senior military officers and their key staff across capability, operations, and enabling functions.
- Translate operational needs into cloud-enabled solutions without losing fidelity to the customer's intent. Represent AWS with credibility in classified briefings, capability discussions, and senior leader engagements.
- Develop and execute multi-year account strategies aligned to Defence's capability development timelines. Build and manage a qualified pipeline from early-stage shaping through to contract execution.
- Meet or exceed annual revenue targets while building the long-term strategic position that generates sustainable growth.
- Work cross-functionally with Solutions Architects, Professional Services, Security & Compliance specialists, and Partner teams to design solutions that meet Defence's mission, security, and sovereignty requirements.
- Navigate Defence procurement pathways and ensure proposed solutions account for Defence's operating environment: classification requirements, network architectures, integration with Defence systems, and ASD certification pathways.
- Maintain current awareness of Australia's strategic and defence policy environment: the National Defence Strategy, Defence Strategic Review, Integrated Investment Program, and AUKUS implementation.

About the team
Diverse Experiences

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you don't meet all of the qualifications listed below, we encourage you to apply. If your career hasn't followed a traditional path or includes non-linear experiences, that's something we value — don't let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world's most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that's why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture

Here at AWS, it's in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empowers us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth

We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture.

Basic qualifications

- 10+ years of experience in or directly supporting Australia's Defence Organisation: in uniform (ADF), as a Defence APS employee, or in a deeply embedded industry role with genuine mission understanding.
- Demonstrated ability to build trusted relationships with senior Defence leaders (military O-6/1-star equivalent and above, or SES Band 1+) based on credibility, domain knowledge, and shared commitment to mission outcomes.
- Proven experience navigating Defence's organisational complexity. You understand how decisions are made, how capability is developed, and how to operate effectively across Groups, Services, and Commands.
- Track record of translating complex customer problems into actionable solutions in a consultative engagement model.
- Experience in Defence capability acquisition and sustainment.
- Understanding of Defence's ICT environment and classified network architectures.

Preferred qualifications

- Military service in the Australian Defence Force, particularly in roles involving capability development, operations, joint planning, or command.
- Familiarity with AUKUS Pillar II technology domains and their application to ADF capability.
- Experience operating in coalition/Five Eyes environments and understanding interoperability requirements.
- Existing relationships across the Defence Organisation at senior levels.
- Background in one or more of: joint operations, intelligence, special operations, capability development, or defence science.

title: Senior VAT Compliance Analyst, EMEA VAT compliance, ITX EMEA VAT compliance
descriptionHtml:
Amazon's diverse business requires VAT filings in a number of jurisdictions globally. Amazon is seeking a VAT Compliance Tax Analyst to work in its International Indirect Tax Compliance team based in Barcelona, Spain. The Amazon Tax Department is a fast-paced, team-focused, and dynamic environment. This position will be responsible (as part of a larger team) for the preparation of EMEA VAT returns and related filings. This position may also assist in the provision of data to tax authorities and other VAT compliance actions relating to Amazon or third-party sellers.

Work may also include some mainstream VAT compliance activities, supporting internal and external audits, and liaising with colleagues in VAT Compliance and Controllership as well as Tax and the wider business – you will need an understanding of financial systems, and technical accounting awareness for this work. You may also be involved in projects that have a VAT compliance impact. You will be expected to take ownership of your activities, identify process improvement opportunities for existing process and controls, and drive positive change across the organisation.

Key job responsibilities
Working within the International Indirect Tax Compliance team, the Senior VAT Compliance Analyst will be required to:

• Prepare, analyse, review and submit EMEA VAT returns and related filings;
• Prepare, analyse, review and submit Intrastat/EC sales declarations as necessary;
• Organise VAT registrations across various jurisdictions;
• Assist with VAT compliance queries from Amazon businesses operating across EMEA;
• Assist in the mapping of VAT processes, and identify areas for improvement and solutions for VAT issues;
• Prepare and review month-end VAT account reconciliations;
• Provide internal and external audit support, including data analysis;
• Provide VAT compliance support to colleagues throughout the business and, in particular, accounting groups and contributing and driving preparation of Tax Requirement Documents for tech teams;
• Lead and participate in cross-functional projects with a priority on automation and in-housing.
• Supports business growth and on-boarding of new entities to VAT compliance processes.

Basic qualifications

- Knowledge of strong understanding of tax compliance principles, regulations, and reporting requirements across jurisdictions
- Knowledge of knowledge of VAT in EU/UK
- Experience a compliance focused tax role in a multinational and/or professional organization
- Bachelor's degree
- Knowledge of Microsoft Office products and applications at an advanced level

Preferred qualifications

- Knowledge of accounting principles, processes, and entries
- Speak, write, and read fluently in French, Spanish, German or Italian
- Bachelor’s degree in tax, accounting, finance or a professional tax qualification

title: Sr. Creator Partnerships Manager, Creator Services
descriptionHtml:
Amazon's Creator Services team leads creator programs that span media, commerce, and culture. We connect creators and Amazon's diverse businesses, helping bring big ideas to life across Wondery, Amazon Music, Twitch, Audible, Amazon Games, and beyond. Join us in making Amazon the home for creators.

Creator Services is looking for a Creator Partnerships leader to serve as the key executive working frontline with our largest creators and with key cross-functional internal stakeholders to drive value for the creators and Amazon.

As the face of the business to these partners, this individual must be a high-trust leader who can creatively solve problems with great business acumen. In parallel, this individual must be able to demonstrate backbone, show resilience in high-pressure situations, and have experience working on eight figure (or higher) creator relationships. This individual must be entrepreneurial and have the ability to lead multiple projects simultaneously, while managing competing deadlines. No ask is too small, and no vision is too big – in support of our creator partners.

Key job responsibilities
- Manage relationships with top-tier creators and talent representation, in partnership with cross-Amazon teams. (6+ years managing relationships with top-tier talent)

- Manage complex deal structures including understanding and navigating contractual commitments and crafting partnership agreement renewals

- Define and evolve an operating model for best-in-class creator partner relations

- Collaborate with advertising sales partners to maximize sponsor-derived revenue opportunities

- Champion creator needs to internal teams and work with creator teams to ensure execution of advertiser commitments exceeds expectations

- Collaborate on strategic creator account management, engaging with internal teams to design programs/processes to drive the right outcomes with partners. (8+ years of internal stakeholder management)

- Use data to influence decisions, prioritize workloads, and build compelling business cases

title: Senior Program Manager, RBS Brand Experience (BX)
descriptionHtml:
Amazon.com, Inc. (NASDAQ:AMZN), a Fortune 500 company based in Seattle, opened on the World Wide Web in July 1995 and today offers Earth's Biggest Selection. Amazon.com, Inc. seeks to be Earth's most customer-centric company, where customers can find and discover anything they might want to buy online, and endeavors to offer its customers the lowest possible prices. Today, we operate retail websites in nine countries, offering millions of products in more than 40 categories worldwide, and we still like to work hard, have fun and make history!

Retail Business Services (RBS) Brand Experience (BX) leverages technology to improve customer experience and selling partner experience while lowering Amazon’s cost structure. Vision of RBS is to accelerate Amazon’s flywheel by 1) improving the customer experience by fixing detail page catalog defects at scale, 2) improving selling partner listing quality to drive GMS and reducing fulfillment defects to drive profitability and 3) improving store operations efficiency by driving down cost of operations. We strive to eliminate the root cause of the defect and wherever not possible, we leverage machine learning to find and fix at scale or surface to selling partners. RBS has multiple programs/services aimed at reducing the listing friction, improving listing quality, reducing customer returns and improving star ratings of products that are dependent on selling partner support for effective execution.

As the Senior Program Manager, you will own the development and innovation of products and features to improve brand experience for WW brands. You will be expected to identify the brand requirements using primary & secondary research, gather business and systems requirements from internal and external stakeholders, propose and validate solutions, build proof-of-concepts, write specifications, drive roadmap from design to release, and manage the production launch. You will work with our internal/external product, business and technology teams to align on roadmap, prioritization, execution, navigating ambiguity and removing roadblocks while sustaining launch/expansion velocity. You will leverage your team to provide solutions that address peripheral needs (functional, legal, compliance). In addition, you will work closely on driving adoption of the product in your target segments, improving actionability of the insights you share through the initiative, and maintaining the quality of product features. You will own the reporting of metrics, and launches through business reviews at leadership level.

A successful candidate will be an exceptional strategic thinker and will have exposure to customer experience improvement. Key skills for the role include an extraordinary ability to deal with ambiguity, to network effectively and influence partner teams without authority, to overcome unforeseen obstacles, and a passion for developing a deep understanding of the tech product.

Responsibilities:

9. Present strategic program and user insights and recommendations to stakeholders and cross-functional team.

title: Safety Technician
descriptionHtml:
Keeping our people safe and well at work is a top priority at Amazon. Our Safety Technicians play an essential role in making this happen. This role is an opportunity to start your career in workplace safety and develop through a global company. You'll work closely with our experts to monitor your site, which means you'll get to see the difference that you make to people's wellbeing every day.

Key job responsibilities
- Carry out risk assessments and audits

A day in the life
You'll be based at one of our sites. This means that you can closely track what's happening and people can easily ask you any questions throughout their shifts. This role is all about spotting potential issues before they happen. You'll spend a lot of time checking the site and getting to know the way that people use equipment. title: Sr. Mechanical Test Engineer, Hardware Test Engineering, Amazon Robotics
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Robotics is looking for a Sr. Mechanical Test Engineer to own the technical test strategy for a robotics product vertical. You will select what gets tested, why, and how often, and your findings will improve the design and safety of our robotics systems.

This is a hands-on mechanical design role with technical leadership scope. You will design test fixtures and methods yourself, as well as work collaboratively with multi-disciplinary teams to define, scope, architect, and execute testing. You will work with minimal direction on programs while partnering with product development engineers to build test strategy and requirements.

Key job responsibilities
- Own the test strategy for product lines: work with development teams to define what needs to be tested, why, and at what cadence.
- Take tests and fixtures from concept through result, designing the mechanical hardware and converting data into recommendations that improve product design.
- Partner with and guide cross-functional engineering and technical efforts to build, verify, and execute testing.
- Translate incomplete or ambiguous design requirements into testable criteria through all stages of the development process.
- Improve test methods, coverage, and automation, and mentor engineers on test design, engineering fundamentals, and technical leadership.
- Build and execute certified safety testing, certifying under the supervision of a regulatory body for robotics safety standards, demonstrating safety for new product launches.

A day in the life
Your work spans design of experiments for proof of concept and design verification, functional and reliability testing, life and environmental testing, and safety verification. A typical week mixes bench time in the lab with the judgment calls that shape a test program: establishing how to approach testing against identified design risks, reviewing test readiness with hardware development, and turning data into recommendations design teams act on.

Amazon offers a full range of benefits that support you and eligible family members, including domestic partners. About the team
Hardware Test Engineering owns robotics testing end to end. We design it, we build it, and we run it: mechanical, electrical, and software engineers working alongside technicians in our labs. What we find changes the product, shaping design selections early and the reliability our robots deliver at scale. Safety comes first in everything we build and everything we run.

descriptionHtml:

title: Senior Solutions Architect , Nonprofit Financial Institutions and Credit Unions
descriptionHtml:
Are you the kind of Senior Solutions Architect who thrives when paired to a territory of strategic customers and given the runway to become their most-trusted AWS technical advisor? Do you bring both deep AWS technical breadth and the sensibility to operate inside a mission-driven financial-services organization that treats every technology decision as an extension of its values? AWS is hiring a Senior Solutions Architect to serve as the dedicated SA partner for our Financial Institutions and Credit Unions territory in the AWS U.S. Nonprofits NFICU sub-vertical with $12M+ combined Annualized Revenue across 5 active AWS engagement pillars.

In this role, you will d the broader territory account team (including AWS Professional Services, Customer Solutions, and AWS executive sponsors) to lead the territory AWS technical strategy across an integrated multi-pillar engagement: GenAI Full-Stack, Cloud Migration, Professional Services, and Amazon Connect. You will be the territory customer's primary AWS technical-architect-of-record, the Account Executive's technical co-pilot, and the inside-AWS voice that translates customer's mission, regulatory environment, and operating model into AWS architectural decisions that hold up over the long term.

You will join the AWS WWPS U.S. Nonprofits Solutions Architecture organization — a team that has invested heavily in data-driven SA management, Kiro CLI / agentic-AI tooling for territory and account work, the GenAI Innovation Center (GenAIIC) accelerator mechanism for moving customer PoCs to production, and a strong Sales-SA partnership culture that treats AE quota success and SA technical-advisor outcomes as one shared mission.

The right candidate brings 5+ years of customer-facing technical-advisor or Solutions Architect experience, deep multi-service AWS technical breadth with substantive depth in GenAI on AWS (Amazon Bedrock, AgentCore, Amazon Q, Amazon SageMaker), and the judgment and customer-advisor altitude to operate as the technical lead on multi-million-dollar customer relationships. Prior financial services technical experience — fraternal benefit society, life-insurance, wealth-management, or comparable regulated FinServ-adjacent context — is a strong plus, as is direct experience with security-architecture and AI-platform engagements in regulated environments.

If you want to bring your technical depth, customer-advisor instincts, and trusted-advisor patience to a single nonprofit financial-services customer whose mission of helping members live generously aligns with the long-arc patient work that named-account SAs do best, we want to hear from you.



Key job responsibilities
As the Senior Solutions Architect you will:

Own the customer's AWS architectural roadmap end-to-end — discovery → reference architecture → proof-of-concept design → production launch → operational handoff to Customer Solutions Manager (CSM). Author and publish the Workload Solution Document, Architecture Decision Records, and security-and-compliance artifacts that the customer adopts as the canonical AWS-side technical record.

Apply the AWS GenAI Innovation Center (GenAIIC) + AI Development Life-Cycle (AIDLC) accelerator mechanism to move customer GenAI proof-of-concept work into production-launched outcomes.

Partner deeply with AWS Professional Services on customer active ProServe engagements — providing pre-SOW architectural input, mid-engagement technical guidance, and post-engagement production-readiness review.

Translate customer mission, regulatory environment, and operating model into AWS architectural decisions

Operate the Sales-SA partnership cadence with the territory Account Executive — weekly account-team standups, monthly business reviews, quarterly strategic-planning cycles, and ad-hoc executive-engagement support. Mirror the Sales-SA operating model that's already working on the Membership and broader NFICU sub-verticals.

Drive opportunity-pipeline integrity on customer active engagements — keep the multi-pillar opportunity set forecast-honest, keep stale opps moving or honestly retired, and keep the AE bench fed with SA-led architectural advancement actions every week.

Adopt and promote the NPO SA org's Kiro CLI + MCP toolchain for account-management automation — Kiro CLI for customer-engagement preparation, AWSentral / Outlook / TFC-Hub MCP servers for opportunity / activity / TFC tracking. Reduce administrative overhead so technical-advisor hours go to customer outcomes.

Contribute to the AWS NPO Technical Field Community (TFC) — participate in the bi-weekly Kiro demo-build program, the SA-AE mock customer call program, and the GenAI Accelerator Initiative. Where customer engagements yield reusable patterns (e.g., financial-services GenAI architectures), lift those patterns into TFC content that benefits the broader NPO SA bench.

Travel approximately 25-35% for in-person executive briefings, customer workshops, on-site architecture reviews, and joint working sessions, plus AWS / nonprofit industry events such as AWS Imagine for Nonprofits.

A day in the life
A typical week as a territory SA might include a Monday morning standup with the territory Account Executive to review the week's customer-engagement actions; a Tuesday architecture-review session with the customer enterprise architecture team to scope a new agentic-AI use case on Bedrock AgentCore; a Wednesday technical-deep-dive with customer CISO team on the security projects and the AWS Professional Services delivery plans; a Thursday-morning block of Kiro-CLI-automated account-management work that surfaces the multi-pillar opportunity advancement actions; a Thursday-afternoon working session with the AWS Bedrock service team to align customer GenAI roadmap with the latest service capabilities; and a Friday close-of-week cadence with NFICU Sales Manager and SA Manager on customers overall account trajectory and any executive-engagement actions for the next week. Across the month you also block time for in-person trips to customer locations, Workload Solution Document writing on the SCB Financial AI Platform expansion, GenAIIC partner working sessions, and TFC contributions that scale your impact beyond territory accounts into the broader NPO SA org.

About the team
You will join the AWS Worldwide Public Sector U.S. Nonprofits (NPO) Solutions Architecture organization — the team responsible for helping mission-driven nonprofit institutions across the United States use AWS to expand their impact on the communities they serve. Our customers are the country's largest membership associations, federally-aligned nonprofit financial institutions, credit unions, faith-based organizations, healthcare and education foundations, public-broadcasting organizations, environmental and humanitarian nonprofits, and the social-services agencies that operate at the heart of the U.S. social safety net. The technical decisions our customers make — about cloud migration, GenAI adoption, contact-center modernization, data strategy, and security — directly affect the mission outcomes they deliver: members served, donors connected, beneficiaries reached, and lives changed. We treat that responsibility seriously.

You will be a member of the Nonprofits Financial Institutions and Credit Unions (NFICU) sub-vertical SA team within the NPO SA organization. NFICU is the sub-vertical that supports nonprofit financial services foundations, fraternal benefit societies, top U.S. credit unions, and adjacent FinServ-aligned NPO accounts.

How we work is part of what makes this team distinctive. We've invested heavily in data-driven SA management. We've built and adopted the AWS NPO GenAI Accelerator mechanism — a working-group-led initiative that integrates the AWS GenAI Innovation Center (GenAIIC) and AI Development Life-Cycle (AIDLC) frameworks into a repeatable customer-engagement playbook for moving nonprofit GenAI proof-of-concept work into production launches. We run an agentic-AI tooling culture — Kiro CLI, Quick Desktop, and MCP servers (AWSentral, Outlook, TFC Hub) are everyday tools the team uses for territory and named-account management, opportunity progression, customer-engagement automation, and force-multiplied SA hours. We host the AWS Imagine for Nonprofits flagship conference annually and contribute org-wide to its agenda, technical content, and customer round-tables. And we're deeply invested in the AWS Technical Field Community (TFC) — running an SA-AE mock customer call program for SA development, a bi-weekly Kiro demo-build program for SA org-wide capability development, and structured mentoring relationships.

The result is a team where customer obsession isn't a slogan — it's expressed in the way SAs partner with AEs to advance customer outcomes, the way the leadership bench invests in talent growth, the way technical depth and operational rigor are weighted equally, and the way every SA on the bench is given the tools, mentoring infrastructure, and trusted-advisor mandate to do their best work for nonprofit customers whose missions matter. If you want to bring your technical advisor instincts to a single strategic financial-services nonprofit customer whose mission of helping members live generously aligns with the long-arc patient work that named-account SAs do best, this is that team.

Basic qualifications

- 8+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) experience
- 3+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
- 10+ years of IT development or implementation/consulting in the software or Internet industries experience

Preferred qualifications

- 5+ years of infrastructure architecture, database architecture and networking experience
- Knowledge of SAP systems (like SAP Business Suite, S/4HANA, SAP Business Warehouse, SAP HANA, SAP Business Objects, etc.) and their architecture and infrastructure needs
- Experience working with end user or developer communities
- Experience managing relationships with SAP customers and partners
- Experience in SAP S/4HANA, SAP Cloud Platform, SAP Cloud ERP and Cloud ERP Private

title: Operations Manager
descriptionHtml:
Job summary
Our WW Operations network delivers millions of packages and smiles to Amazon customers every day. We are looking for motivated, customer-focused individuals who want to join our team as an Operations Manager. In this role, you will lead and develop a team of salaried and hourly talent. You will be responsible for engaging your team during their shifts to maintain the highest levels of safety, quality, attendance, and performance. To achieve this, managers are expected to provide their team with the tools needed for success while driving improvements in productivity and efficiency through data-driven decisions and analytical problem-solving. You will also play a key role in maintaining our customer expectations to ensure customer orders are delivered at the right time, to the right location.

Our Operation’s workflow has three major components: First mile - where the product is housed and ready for order; Middle mile - where the order is hauled to your area; and Last mile - when the product is delivered to the customer’s door. Please note that all workflows have slight building variations, but one thing is constant: our vision and dedication to the customer.

- Work in an environment where the noise level varies and can be loud

Our fulfillment network launches new Operations sites every year, providing various opportunities for your professional growth. We hire Operations Managers based on location preference and the business’ current openings.

title: Principal Product Manager - Technical, End User Experience, Amazon WorkSpaces
descriptionHtml:
AWS Applied AI Solutions (AAIS) is building toward a future where every business innovates with Amazon AI teammates. To get there, we build AI solutions that improve human capabilities and transform entire business functions. We create end-to-end products that surprise and delight out-of-the-box, making complex things easy and hard things possible, with no cloud experience required. We start with customers who embrace the future and build bridges to meet the rest where they are. We pursue ambitious opportunities with conviction, and we are looking for builders who share that mindset.

The Agentic WorkSpaces organization envisions a world where people teams and AI collaborate securely from anywhere to create unprecedented value for every organization. We build lovable products that empower every business to unlock the full potential of human-AI teamwork driving smarter decisions greater creativity more value and faster innovation with confidence. This vision is realized through the agentic WorkSpace - a secure managed environment purpose-built for human-AI collaboration at enterprise scale where people and AI agents work side by side to deliver results neither could achieve alone.

We are looking for a Principal Product Manager to own End-User Experience across the Agentic WorkSpaces portfolio.

This is a strategic portfolio-level role focused on defining how people and AI agents experience interact with and derive value from our products. You will establish the end-user experience strategy principles and measurable bar across a set of products that span today's human-centered virtual desktop experiences emerging in-product agentic assistance and future fully agentic workloads. You will define the experience paradigms for agentic WorkSpaces across the full spectrum of use cases: human workloads in-app agents that assist people in completing work and headless or autonomous agentic workloads that operate on behalf of users or businesses. You will ensure that agentic interfaces are cohesive across the portfolio that product teams are building from a common set of tenets and guidelines and that the human experience becomes richer and simpler as AI capabilities expand rather than more fragmented or complex.

Key job responsibilities
• : In this role you will develop a deep understanding of our end-user personas their work patterns and the industry contexts in which they operate. You will clarify how the needs of a call center agent differ from those of an engineer how a financial advisor's workflow differs from a contractor's and how autonomous AI agents introduce entirely new experience requirements. You will identify the patterns that cut across personas and industries distinguish them from requirements that are truly unique and translate those insights into product direction that individual teams can adopt and execute. You will partner closely with engineering design product go-to-market and product marketing to shape roadmaps influence product decisions and ensure that end-user experience is treated as a strategic differentiator across the organization. You will also own the KPIs that define whether we are delivering a world-class end-user experience. You will establish the right measures of usability adoption productivity agent effectiveness user trust task completion and business value. You will identify where our products fall short raise the bar across teams and drive the changes needed to close those gaps.
• The ideal candidate is both strategic and deeply customer obsessed. They are curious about how people work how AI agents will change work and how enterprise products must evolve as human and agentic workflows converge. They can move comfortably from customer conversations to product principles from ambiguous future-state thinking to near-term execution and from portfolio-level strategy to the details that determine whether a product feels intuitive trustworthy and indispensable. This is an opportunity to define the end-user experience for a new category of enterprise product: one where humans and AI agents collaborate securely at scale. The person in this role will help shape not just individual features but the experience model product bar and operating principles that guide Agentic WorkSpaces as the portfolio evolves.

About the team
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn't followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don't let it stop you from applying.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world's most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that's why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there's nothing we can't achieve in the cloud.

Here at AWS, it's in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

title: Finance Manager II - Payroll Payments & Audits, Payroll
descriptionHtml:
Finance Manager II – Global Payroll Payments & Audits


Job Title

Finance Manager II – Global Payroll Payments & Audits

Location: Hyderabad, Telangana, India
Work Model: Work from Office
Job ID: 10512609
Level: 5
Job Type: Full-Time, Regular
Function: Finance & Accounting
Team: Global Payroll Payments
Department: Payroll – VAR



Role Overview

Amazon's Global Payroll Payments team is hiring a Finance Manager II to lead and scale payroll payment operations across APAC and North America.

The role sits at the intersection of payments, banking, controls/audit, and technology transformation. You will own the end-to-end payroll payment lifecycle, lead a team of 20+ professionals, manage strategic banking and payment-service-provider relationships, strengthen financial controls and audits, and drive automation and payment modernization through APIs and standards such as ISO 20022.

This is a senior leader who operates at both strategic and operational levels — moving comfortably from executive stakeholder management and banking-partner negotiations to payment incident resolution, operational deep dives, and people leadership. Payroll experience is valuable but not required: strong leaders from payments, banking operations, treasury, or financial operations with people-management and controls depth are encouraged to apply.


Key Role Objectives

Lead global payroll payment operations across APAC and North America.
Manage and develop a high-performing team of 20+ professionals.
Manage strategic relationships with banks, payment service providers, fintechs, and vendors.
Ensure payment accuracy, timeliness, security, reliability, and operational resilience.
Own payment controls, audits, reconciliations, risk management, and compliance mechanisms.
Lead payment infrastructure readiness for new countries and entities.
Drive automation, API-based integrations, monitoring, and payment modernization.
Lead resolution of critical payment incidents and recurring defects.
Build scalable mechanisms, standard work, playbooks, and operating rhythms.
Drive continuous improvement using data, metrics, technology, and customer impact.


Key Job Responsibilities

Global Payroll Payment Operations

Own the end-to-end payroll payment lifecycle across APAC and North America, including payment file generation, validation, bank submission, transaction monitoring, exception management, settlement, and reconciliation.
Establish mechanisms to monitor payment health, service levels, control performance, operational risks, and critical dependencies.
Review operational dashboards and payment metrics to identify emerging issues and prioritize corrective actions.
Lead resolution of payment batch failures, rejected transactions, bank exceptions, processing delays, and other payment-related issues.
Ensure payroll payments are processed accurately, securely, and within defined service-level expectations.
Develop mechanisms that improve payment reliability, resilience, scalability, and employee experience.
Identify systemic issues and drive permanent corrective actions rather than recurring manual fixes.


People Leadership & Team Development

Lead and develop a team of 20+ finance and payments professionals.
Build organizational capability across payment operations, audits, banking controls, reconciliations, monitoring, and issue resolution.
Establish clear goals, performance mechanisms, operating rhythms, and development plans.
Create a culture of ownership, accountability, continuous improvement, and operational excellence.
Coach and mentor team members and build a strong leadership pipeline.
Develop technical, analytical, and business capabilities within the organization.
Build a diverse, inclusive, and high-performing team capable of operating at global scale.


Banking & Payment Partnerships

Build and manage strategic relationships with global and regional banking partners.
Manage relationships with payment service providers, fintechs, financial institutions, and third-party vendors.
Partner with banks on service levels, payment requirements, file specifications, connectivity, format changes, testing, and issue resolution.
Manage payment methods including RTP, ACH, wire transfers, and other applicable payment rails.
Coordinate payment-format and connectivity migrations while maintaining business continuity.
Represent Amazon's payroll payment requirements in discussions with external banking and technology partners.
Lead escalations with financial institutions for critical payment failures and service disruptions.


New Country & Entity Launches

Lead payment infrastructure readiness for new Amazon countries, entities, and business expansions.
Coordinate bank-account onboarding and payment infrastructure requirements.
Define payment-file specifications, banking connectivity, testing, UAT, and go-live requirements.
Partner with Payroll, Treasury, Finance, Technology, Compliance, and other stakeholders to identify dependencies and risks.
Develop reusable launch-readiness frameworks, playbooks, standard work, and deployment mechanisms.
Ensure new markets launch efficiently while maintaining strong financial controls and operational resilience.

Automation & Payment Modernization

Identify opportunities to eliminate manual processes and improve payment scalability, accuracy, control effectiveness, and efficiency.
Partner with Technology and Finance teams to implement automation and scalable payment solutions.
Drive adoption of API-based integrations (REST APIs) and modern payment technologies.
Support adoption of ISO 20022 and other modern payment standards where applicable.
Leverage monitoring frameworks to identify payment issues proactively.
Evaluate and implement AI-enabled solutions for exception management, monitoring, root-cause analysis, and operational productivity.
Reduce operational risk through technology-enabled controls while improving the employee payment experience.

Critical Escalations & Incident Management

Serve as a senior escalation point for critical payroll payment incidents.
Lead resolution of bank-side failures, payment batch rejections, service disruptions, and high-risk exceptions.
Lead structured root-cause analysis for high-impact incidents.
Coordinate cross-functional resolution across Finance, Payroll, Technology, Treasury, Operations, and banking partners.
Establish mechanisms to prevent recurrence and track incident trends to identify systemic payment risks.
Develop and maintain escalation and incident-management playbooks.
Improve payment resilience through lessons learned and continuous improvement.

Continuous Improvement & Operational Excellence

Use data and operational metrics to identify improvement opportunities.
Prioritize initiatives based on customer impact, financial risk, operational risk, and business value.
Simplify complex payment processes and eliminate unnecessary manual activities.
Improve payment accuracy, timeliness, reliability, and control effectiveness.
Establish scalable mechanisms that support increasing payment volumes and geographic expansion.
Drive cross-functional transformation initiatives.
Measure and communicate business impact to senior leadership.

Stakeholder Management

The role works closely with:

Global Payroll
Finance & Controllership
Treasury
Technology / Engineering
Banking & Financial Institutions
Payment Service Providers
FinTech Partners
Compliance
Risk Management
Internal Audit
External Audit
Operations
Country and Entity Launch Teams
Senior Finance Leadership
Business and Corporate Stakeholders

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, Economics, or a related field.
8+ years of experience in finance, payments, banking operations, payroll operations, treasury, or financial operations — including work in complex, high-volume, or multi-country environments.
5+ years of people-management experience, including leading teams or managing managers.
Experience managing relationships with banks, payment service providers, fintechs, financial institutions, or external vendors.
Experience designing or operating financial controls, audits, reconciliations, risk, or compliance mechanisms.
Experience using data and metrics to identify operational issues and drive measurable improvements.
Experience working cross-functionally across Finance, Technology, Operations, Payroll, or Treasury.
Experience communicating complex financial, operational, or technical information clearly to senior leadership.
Experience identifying root causes, implementing corrective actions, and building mechanisms to prevent recurrence.
Experience working in a large, multinational, or highly complex organization.

Preferred Qualifications

Global payroll payments or payment operations.
Banking operations or banking infrastructure.
Treasury operations.
Financial technology / FinTech.
RTP, ACH, wire transfers, or other electronic payment rails.
Payment files and banking connectivity.
API-based payment integrations and REST API-based services.
Knowledge of ISO 20022 or modern payment standards.
Payment infrastructure setup for new countries or entities.
Payment-service-provider and third-party vendor management.
Automation, digital transformation, and AI-enabled operational solutions.
Monitoring and exception-management frameworks.
Launch-readiness frameworks and scalable deployment mechanisms.
Large-scale operational transformation in regulated, multinational, or high-volume environments.
MBA, CPA, CA, CMA, or other relevant professional qualification.

Leadership Competencies

Strategic Thinking: Builds long-term payment and operational strategies.
People Leadership: Attracts, develops, motivates, and retains high-performing teams.
Operational Excellence: Owns accuracy, reliability, controls, and execution.
Customer Obsession: Ensures employees are paid accurately and on time.
Data-Driven Decision Making: Uses metrics to identify trends, risks, and opportunities.
Problem Solving: Solves complex, ambiguous, high-impact operational problems.
Stakeholder Management: Influences senior stakeholders without direct authority.
Banking & Commercial Acumen: Manages strategic relationships with financial institutions and payment partners.
Technology Fluency: Partners effectively with technology teams; understands APIs, payment infrastructure, automation, and data.
Change Leadership: Leads transformation across people, processes, and technology.
Executive Communication: Communicates complex issues clearly and concisely to senior leaders.
Ownership & Accountability: Dives deep, challenges existing mechanisms, and drives issues to closure.

Key Success Metrics

Payroll payment accuracy.
On-time payment performance.
Payment failure and rejection rates.
Critical payment incident resolution.
Reduction in recurring payment defects.
Banking-partner service-level performance.
Control effectiveness.
Audit readiness and reduction in repeat findings.
Reconciliation quality and timeliness.
Automation and manual-effort reduction.
Payment-processing scalability.
New-market launch readiness and execution.
Operational risk reduction.
Team performance, engagement, and talent development.
Delivery of strategic transformation initiatives.

What Success Looks Like

Reliable payments. Strong controls. Scalable infrastructure. Fewer recurring defects. Better automation. Strong banking partnerships. Effective audits. And a high-performing team that operates confidently at global scale.

Early on, the leader establishes strong operational visibility, understands the global payment landscape, strengthens critical mechanisms, and builds trusted relationships with key stakeholders and banking partners. Over time, they transform the organization from a primarily operational model into a scalable, technology-enabled, data-driven global payment organization.
A Day in the Life

Reviewing payment-health dashboards, critical exceptions, audit status, and operational metrics.
Investigating recurring payment or banking exceptions with the team.
Working with Technology on API, payment-file, or connectivity changes.
Engaging banking partners to resolve service issues or payment failures.
Reviewing new-country or entity launch readiness.
Challenging existing controls and reviewing audit findings.
Identifying opportunities for automation and process simplification.
Reviewing business and operational metrics with senior leadership.
Coaching team members and reviewing performance and priorities.
Removing organizational blockers and establishing mechanisms for long-term improvement.

Ideal Candidate Profile

The strongest candidate is typically a senior finance, payments, banking operations, treasury, or financial operations leader who has:

Led large teams, ideally 20+ people.
Managed high-volume payment or financial operations.
Worked directly with banks or payment service providers.
Owned operational controls, audits, reconciliations, and risk.
Operated across multiple countries or geographies.
Partnered extensively with Technology and Finance organizations.
Managed critical incidents and complex operational escalations.
Built scalable processes and operating mechanisms.
Delivered automation or digital transformation.
Demonstrated strong executive presence and stakeholder influence.

Payroll experience is highly valuable but is not the only path into the role. Strong leaders from payments, banking operations, treasury, financial operations, or payment infrastructure with relevant people-management and controls experience should also be considered.
Core Search Keywords

Payments · Payment Operations · Banking Operations · Banking Infrastructure · Payroll Payments · Global Payroll · Payment Processing · Payment Infrastructure · Treasury · RTP · ACH · Wire · Payment Service Provider · PSP · FinTech · Financial Institutions · Banking Partner · Payment Connectivity · Payment Files · ISO 20022 · APIs · REST APIs · Automation · AI · Payment Controls · Audit · Reconciliation · Risk · Compliance · People Management · Team Leadership · Operational Excellence · Launch Readiness · Global Operations · Financial Operations

This is an opportunity to lead a critical financial infrastructure function at Amazon and influence how payroll payments are delivered across multiple countries. The role combines:

Global scale

Finance and controls

Strategic external partnerships

Operational excellence

Executive-level visibility


If you are a finance or payments leader who enjoys solving complex problems, working with banks and technology teams, building high-performing organizations, and creating scalable mechanisms, this role offers the opportunity to shape the future of global payroll payments at Amazon.
