title: Sr. Business Development Manager, Global Selling LatAm
descriptionHtml:
You will design and grow the partner network that brings Latin American businesses into selling on Amazon in the US — building something with regional reach and a direct line to measurable growth.

This role covers Mexico and Latin America. You'll build relationships with agencies, service providers, industry associations, and logistics companies, and turn those relationships into a sustainable, scalable channel for new seller recruitment.

Key job responsibilities
Design and execute the regional partner recruitment strategy: identify which types of organizations have the right relationships and client profile to bring new sellers to the US marketplace, and develop the approach for each category.

Build and develop partner relationships across Mexico and Latin America — understanding what drives each type of organization, what they value, and how to structure engagement that works for both sides long-term.

Develop the lead generation model: determine which channels, co-marketing formats, and outreach approaches grow the seller pipeline most effectively, and evolve the approach as the program scales.

Work across internal teams to ensure sellers entering the program are positioned for strong, sustained performance from day one.

Own program performance end-to-end: partner activity, pipeline health, seller quality, and revenue contribution. Know your numbers and act on them.

Continuously improve the model — operationally, commercially, and structurally — and bring well-reasoned proposals to leadership.

Shape the program's next phase: how to deepen partner engagement, which new categories and markets to enter, and what a more mature version of this program looks like.

A day in the life
The day starts with a read of the pipeline: which partners are active, where seller candidates are in the process, and what needs unblocking.

Mid-morning shifts to partner conversations — agencies, logistics firms, industry associations — assessing portfolio fit, co-designing outreach strategies, and aligning on what each organization needs to convert their clients into US expansion candidates.

The day closes on strategy: translating performance data into program decisions, preparing leadership proposals on market expansion, partner tiering, or new acquisition channels, and defining the next phase of growth.

Basic qualifications

- Experience with Microsoft Office products and applications
- Experience with sales CRM tools such as Salesforce or similar software
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- Experience analysing market opportunities, engaging and negotiating with customers, and defining new areas of innovation
- 5+ years of related industry experience
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English, and have the ability to take direction in English

- 5+ years of B2B or enterprise sales with a focus on hunting new business experience
- 6+ years of working cross functionally with non-tech teams experience

- Master of Business Administration

title: Sr. Design Technologist , eShop Content Services
descriptionHtml:
We are looking for a Design Technologist III to lead the development of Generative AI-powered tools, build custom functionalities from the ground up, and drive foundational model training initiatives tailored to design and creative production tasks. This is a senior individual contributor role for someone who can independently architect and build end-to-end GenAI solutions, lead foundational model training for design-specific use cases, and set the technical direction for AI-driven content creation.

This Role Is for You If You Want To

• Lead the training, fine-tuning, and evaluation of foundational models purpose-built for design and visual content tasks
• Architect and build production-grade GenAI tools and platforms from scratch
• Define the technical roadmap for AI-powered content generation at scale
• Drive adoption of Generative AI across creative production workflows
• Partner with applied scientists, ML engineers, and creative leaders to push the frontier of AI-driven design


Key job responsibilities
• Lead foundational model training - Design, train, fine-tune, and evaluate foundational models and LLMs for design-specific tasks including image generation, video synthesis, style transfer, and content enhancement
• Build custom GenAI functionalities - Architect and develop production-ready tools, APIs, and platforms from the ground up to serve creative teams at scale
• Own the technical roadmap - Define and drive the long-term technical vision for GenAI adoption across visual content production
• Develop and optimize AI pipelines - Build end-to-end inference and training pipelines leveraging cloud-based ML platforms
• Drive experimentation and R&D - Lead research efforts to evaluate emerging models, architectures, and techniques (diffusion models, multimodal models, LoRA/PEFT fine-tuning) for production applicability
• Establish best practices - Define standards for prompt engineering, model evaluation, data curation, and quality benchmarking across GenAI workflows
• Mentor and influence - Provide technical leadership and mentorship to junior design technologists and raise the bar on technical excellence
• Stakeholder partnership - Collaborate with applied science teams, product managers, and creative leadership to align AI capabilities with business goals and customer needs


A day in the life
A typical day as a Design Technologist III could include leading a model fine-tuning session for a custom image generation model, architecting a new service to deliver AI-generated content at scale, evaluating the latest open-source models for production readiness, building custom LoRA adapters for domain-specific style transfer, or reviewing technical designs with engineering and science partners. You might also spend time defining training data strategies, building evaluation frameworks for generated content quality, or prototyping new AI-powered creative tools. You are expected to operate with high ambiguity, make sound technical judgments independently, and influence across teams.

About the team
Our team is building one of the world's best online shopping experiences through photography, video, Generative AI, graphic design, 3D, and usability design - enabling millions of customers to make more informed purchasing decisions. We are a large and fast-growing network of teams focused on fashion and product photography, GenAI, photo retouching, graphic design, video and CGI production, and image services. We continually innovate and set new industry standards for showcasing products across multiple global marketplaces, pushing beyond the boundaries of traditional e-commerce photography and videography.

Basic qualifications

- Experience with Machine Learning and Large Language Model fundamentals, including architecture, training/inference lifecycles, and optimization of model execution, or experience building complex software systems that have been successfully delivered to customers
- Experience with Machine Learning and Large Language Model fundamentals, including architecture, training/inference lifecycles, and optimization of model execution, or experience programming with at least one modern language such as Java, C++, or C# including object-oriented design
- Experience building production software applications or understanding software development, distributed systems, and systems architecture
- Knowledge of architectural concepts and algorithms, schedule tradeoffs and new opportunities with technical team members
- Experience with training and deploying machine learning systems to solve large-scale optimizations, or experience with data infrastructures: relational analytic DBMS, Elastic-Search, and Big Data EMR/EC2/Glue/Lambda
- Have an online portfolio demonstrating strong visual design skills and advertising experience across a range of media and platforms, along with work that reflects your design process
- 6+ years of front-end technologist, engineer, or UX prototyper experience
- Bachelor's degree or above in computer science or equivalent
- Hands-on experience with AI inference and training platforms (Fal AI, Replicate, Hugging Face, AWS SageMaker, or similar)

Preferred qualifications

- Knowledge of databases and AWS database services: ElasticSearch, Redshift, DynamoDB
- Experience with Machine Learning and Large Language Model fundamentals, including architecture, training/inference lifecycles, and optimization of model execution, or experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team
- Experience within specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics).
- Experience architecting/operating solutions built on AWS, or experience as a trainer and ability to manage a classroom of learners

descriptionHtml:
Dział operacji Amazon stanowi podstawę obsługi klienta Amazon. Dzięki ponad 50 centrom logistycznym, setkom stacji dostaw i dziesiątkom tysięcy pracowników zespół ten wspólnie dba o sprawną dostawę produktów do klientów. W centrach logistycznych każdego roku kompletowane i pakowane są miliony produktów, a zespoły dostawcze dokładają wszelkich starań, aby zamówienia dotarły do klientów na czas. Bezpieczeństwo jest najwyższym priorytetem, a kultura operacyjna opiera się na pracy zespołowej, różnorodności i wspólnej etyce pracy, które zapewniają płynne funkcjonowanie firmy. Zespół szczyci się świadczeniem wysokiej jakości usług, z których Amazon słynie na całym świecie.

Uwaga: Warunkiem przyjęcia jest posiadanie prawa do pracy w kraju zatrudnienia przed datą rozpoczęcia pracy.

Należy pamiętać, że jest to stanowisko stacjonarne w pełnym wymiarze czasu pracy.
Stanowisko to jest dostępne w wielu lokalizacjach w Polsce. Oferujemy miesięczny bonus relokacyjny.

Rozważamy zatrudnianie kandydatów do pracy w następujących lokalizacjach:
Bielany Wrocławskie | Dobromierz | Gliwice | Gorzyczki | Łódź | Okmiany | Pabianice | Poznań | Sosnowiec | Szczecin | Świebodzin


Key job responsibilities
Główne obowiązki

Jako stażysta w dziale operacji Amazon będziesz mieć możliwość wykorzystania swoich umiejętności analitycznych w ważnych projektach, które poprawiają funkcjonalność i jakość usług centrów logistycznych, centrów sortowania i stacji dostaw.
Kluczowe obowiązki stanowiska:

* Realizowanie projektów o wysokim priorytecie zgodnie z najwyższymi standardami oraz wykazywanie się umiejętnością osiągania wyników

* Analizowanie danych w celu identyfikacji wyzwań operacyjnych i możliwości poprawy

* Proponowanie i testowanie rozwiązań oraz współpraca z zespołem przy wdrażaniu tych najbardziej skutecznych

* Rozwijanie umiejętności komunikacyjnych i pracy zespołowej poprzez współpracę z przełożonymi, interesariuszami i pracownikami pierwszej linii.

* Przemieszczanie się po budynku w celu współpracy z różnymi zespołami. Obejmuje to aktywne zdobywanie wiedzy poprzez udział w takich działaniach, jak wstępne odprawy, spotkania dotyczące przepływu pracy oraz dyskusje z kierownictwem i współpracownikami.

* Niezbędnym elementem tego stanowiska jest umiejętność poruszania się po miejscu pracy i przemieszczania się między różnymi obszarami.

* Wykazywanie elastyczności w zakresie pracy w różnych harmonogramach i systemach zmianowych stosownie do potrzeb.

* Potencjalna relokacja do wyznaczonego miejsca pracy.



A day in the life
Dzień z życia stażysty
Nasze staże to okazja do zdobycia wiedzy, która pozwoli Ci jako naszemu przyszłemu przełożonemu przekonać się, w jaki sposób zarządzamy zespołami pracowników i rozwijamy ich kompetencje. Poznasz dynamiczny i złożony świat naszych centrów logistycznych, centrów sortowania oraz stacji dostaw i zobaczysz, w jaki sposób nasi kierownicy motywują swoje zespoły do spełniania oczekiwań klientów.

Dzięki temu stażowi znajdziesz się w samym centrum naszych działań, co pozwoli Ci prześledzić drogę zamówienia klienta. Zyskasz realistyczny obraz pracy w pełnym wymiarze czasu, która czeka na Ciebie w naszej organizacji.

Dowiesz się, w jaki sposób nasi przełożeni tworzą bezpieczne i produktywne środowisko pracy, w pełni wykorzystując potencjał swoich zespołów dzięki skutecznym strategiom angażowania pracowników i zarządzania wynikami pracy. To szansa na rozwinięcie umiejętności, które pomogą Ci rozpocząć satysfakcjonującą karierę w Amazon.


About the team
O zespole
Społeczność stażystów:

* Jako stażysta Amazon będziesz częścią dynamicznej, wspierającej społeczności, która pomoże Ci się rozwijać. Będziesz współpracować ze stażystami z całego świata, nawiązywać kontakty i uczestniczyć w wydarzeniach towarzyskich, aby poszerzyć swoje horyzonty. Możesz również dołączyć do specjalistycznych grup zajmujących się takimi obszarami, jak zrównoważony rozwój, co pozwoli Ci rozwijać różnorodne zainteresowania.

Dodatkowo otrzymasz konkurencyjne miesięczne wynagrodzenie, wsparcie w relokacji oraz dostęp do szeregu świadczeń pracowniczych.

title: Ship Clerk
descriptionHtml:
Ship Clerks play a crucial role in the Middle Mile network and are responsible for delivering our mission is to be Earth's most customer-centric company. Ship Clerks are responsible for daily management of department duties including planning loads around standard departure times, load flow control and ensuring proper trailer utilization. Ship Clerks can assign job duties, provide work direction and communicate with internal and external partners.

Ship Clerks will drive and execute standard work in areas impacting Safety, Quality, Productivity, Utilization, and On-time Performance. They will help support daily management of department duties including Load planning, Load Flow Control, Load Quality, TDR, Communicating to Upstream and Downstream Partners, Allocating Labor, Leading Meetings, and Assigning job Duties. Ship Clerks will escalate any barriers to their Operations Leaders and work with them to mitigate issues impacting safety and performance.


Key job responsibilities
• Correspond with multiple shipping companies and their contacts
• Use multiple shipping company’s software to ship and track packages
• Coordinate trailers to corresponding dock doors and cross docks using SSP
• Troubleshoot shipping problems and errors to resolution
• Ensure trailer utilization is maximized to control transportation costs
• Ensure on-time dock performance
• Assist in updating Staging POD 5s and resource allocation
• Oversee Load Flow Control for the building
• Maintain load level performance tracking for load planning, on-time dock performance, utilization, and misloads
•Coordinate with Transportation teams on Driver issues, Trailer Pool needs, Yard Move Delays, Late Inbound volume, and Load Swaps to protect customer experience.

title: IT Support Associate II, OpsTechIT
descriptionHtml:
Ubicación: Carretera el Salto 273. La Alameda Tlajomulco de Zuñiga 45679 Jalisco, Mexico.
Horario: Disponibilidad para rolar turnos día, noche y fines de semana

Nuestra misión en Amazon es ser la empresa más centrada en el cliente de la Tierra, y nuestro galardonado equipo de Ops Tech IT es una parte clave para lograr ese objetivo. Amazon es una de las marcas más reconocidas en el mundo porque distribuimos millones de productos a nuestros clientes. Hacer nuestro mejor esfuerzo por nuestros clientes es de donde obtenemos nuestra energía, y es por eso que encontrará que abordamos las cosas de manera diferente aquí.
Las operaciones están en el corazón del negocio de Amazon. Somos conocidos por nuestra velocidad, precisión y servicio excepcional. Nuestros edificios entregan decenas de miles de productos a cientos de países en todo el mundo, todos los días. OpsTech IT brinda soporte de TI global continuo a las operaciones de Amazon como una pieza vital del rompecabezas. Estamos buscando personas motivadas para asumir nuevos desafíos y motivar a los equipos para fomentar soluciones a los obstáculos que enfrentamos. Juntos, nos hacemos cargo de lo que hacemos, ya sea respaldando la infraestructura de TI, desarrollando nuevas tecnologías internamente, lanzando una nueva instalación de Amazon Operations o deleitando a nuestros clientes entregándoles paquetes directamente.

Sobre el papel

Como asociado de soporte de TI II, utilizará sus habilidades para ayudar al equipo de operaciones a resolver problemas técnicos dentro de una instalación de Amazon Operations que abarca una multitud de disciplinas técnicas. Estamos comprometidos con la mejora; se le alentará a participar en las oportunidades de desarrollo profesional que se presenten para progresar en su carrera en Amazon.

¿Qué ofrecemos?

Amazon ofrece paquetes de compensación competitivos. Pero espera, hay más: ¡no usamos traje y corbata! Ven tal como eres porque jeans, camisetas, zapatillas y, en ocasiones, un chaleco de seguridad de neón serán tu atuendo diario


Key job responsibilities
Las responsabilidades incluyen, pero no se limitan a:

- Asignación, mantenimiento y solución de problemas de equipos de TI utilizados en las instalaciones de Amazon Operations.

- Maneja solicitudes y procedimientos de soporte a través de la red.

- Colaborar en la formación de nuevos empleados.
- Aprendizaje continuo de nuevas tecnologías.

- Capacidad para dar soporte a clientes desde múltiples edificios en el área, así como a clientes remotos.

Basic qualifications

- 1+ years of corporate setting Windows, Mac or Linux Operating systems support experience
- Experience troubleshooting integrated and interdependent computer systems
- Experience maintaining zebra thermal printers, troubleshooting thin clients, PCs, scanners, and portable handheld terminals

Preferred qualifications

- CompTIA A+, CompTIA Network+, Cisco/CCNA, Linux (Redhat), Microsoft hardware (installation), AWS, or other industry relevant certifications
- Experience in a dynamic environment with a high degree of customer service

title: Principal Product Manager -Tech, Amazon Warehousing and Distribution
descriptionHtml:
Are you interested in joining an innovative team that is at the forefront of solving complex business problems? Amazon Supply Chain Services will allow everyone to leverage Amazon’s advanced logistics, supply chain, and transportation to move products from manufacturers to customers, while keeping products in stock, shipping faster, reliably and significantly lowering costs. Come join the team that’s making this vision a reality. Leveraging Amazon’s efficient and state of the art network and technology, we will be offering supply chain as a service to all manufacturers – big and small.

We are looking for an entrepreneurial, results-oriented Principal Product Manager - Tech to join our Amazon Warehousing & Distribution team. This is an opportunity to work in a customer-facing startup like environment within Amazon. We seek a someone who is motivated by a fast-paced and highly entrepreneurial environment looking to make instant impact.

You will leverage your deep product management expertise to work backwards from our customers, identify the right opportunities to help us accelerate at scale, and innovate faster for our customers. If you have a passion for innovation, for thinking big to tackle ambiguous problems, for solving some of the biggest technical challenges in the industry, and for building elegant products that delight our customers, we need you!

Key job responsibilities
As a Principal PM-T, you will own customer research, benchmarking, strategy, and execution for your domain. You will define the product roadmap and bring your vision to life by leading a cross-functional team of engineers, designers, program managers, scientists and other product owners. You will drive day-to-day product development from design through to release. Your product requirements are concise, with clear, measurable success criteria. You are an effective negotiator, make smart trade-offs without sacrificing quality, and drive appropriate schedules. You use data to influence our business strategy and technical priorities and escalate when necessary without damaging relationships. You independently represent your products and the product team and are comfortable communicating with senior executives as well as with business and technical stakeholders

A day in the life
In this role you will drive the strategy and roadmap for solutions that enable the movement of inventory across Amazon's supply chain efficiently. You will be working with world class data science and engineering partners to achieve the same.

You will regularly work cross-functionally and will share and drive best practices across the broader organization. You will be an active mentor and force multiplier, educating broader team members on leading practices.

About the team
The Amazon Warehousing and Distribution team aspires to become a best in class 3PL offering in the year 2024 that drives significant benefits for our customers, sellers and Amazon itself. We like to innovate and move fast in an ambiguous setting.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree
- Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
- Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
- 7+ years of technical product or program management experience

Preferred qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in engineering, statistics, computer science, operations research, business analytics, information systems or equivalent
- Experience contributing to engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
- Experience working with and influencing senior level stakeholders
- Experience in project management methodologies, business analysis, or process improvement

descriptionHtml:

title: Senior Risk Manager, Law Enforcement Engagement, Security Operations Group (SOG)
descriptionHtml:
You'll help build a global law enforcement engagement capability from scratch — designing the architecture that connects Amazon's security operations with policing agencies globally to disrupt organised crime at scale and create lasting purposeful symbiotic law enforcement relationships. As a Law Enforcement Engagement Leader (LEE) for Rest of World, you will own the end-to-end law enforcement engagement strategy across EMEA, APAC, and MEA. You are accountable for building the relationship architecture, engagement frameworks, and intelligence-sharing models that turn connections into a structured, institutionally-owned network. You'll be part of a team securing cross-functional dependencies with Legal, Finance, and GSOC, and represent Amazon at the highest levels of international law enforcement.

There is no existing playbook and no inherited structure. You will help define the operating model, and you enable field teams to execute, maintaining local relationships, acting as the bridge to support.

As a Senior Team Leader, you will own a defined pillar of the Law Enforcement Engagement operating model and act as a country or regional point of contact.

This role requires someone who has operated at the intersection of law enforcement and the private sector, understands the legal and cultural complexity of multi-jurisdictional engagement, and can build frameworks from zero in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment.

Key job responsibilities
- Build, document, and maintain structured law enforcement relationships at regional, and local levels, recording all contacts in the Law Enforcement Engagement Partnership Registry to ensure institutional ownership survives personnel attrition.
- Draft and operationalise standardised engagement playbooks by jurisdiction and scenario, co-designed with Legal, with country-specific regulatory requirements as appendices.
- Operate within the information-sharing authorization-tier matrix, coordinating with Legal Enforcement Response and Legal to ensure all data exchanges meet GDPR and local regulatory requirements.
- Deliver proactive intelligence contributions (threat briefings, advisories, intel packages) to internal teams, shifting Law Enforcement Engagement from reactive to preventative.
- Initiate and co-own Memorandum of Understanding with priority law enforcement agencies.
- Bridge Law Enforcement Engagement and internal customers (field Loss Prevention, Investigations, GSOC, Risk &Resilience, Legal, Public Policy), resolving friction and driving cross-pillar referrals across SOG and partner teams.


About the team
The Law Enforcement Engagement team sits within Amazon's Security Operations Group, building the institutional architecture that connects Amazon's security operations with law enforcement agencies across 30+ international markets to disrupt organised crime targeting global logistics.

We believe relationships built in peacetime pay dividends in crisis. We deploy resources where data shows the greatest exposure, measure ourselves on outcomes — disrupted Mo's, asset recovery, threat disruption — not activity.

This is a team for builders. We are early-stage, high-ambition, and outcome-obsessed. You'll write the playbook, not inherit one.

Basic qualifications

- Knowledge of Microsoft Office products and applications at an advanced level
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- Experience working with global cross-functional teams
- Experience in security service, loss prevention, asset protection, audit, investigations, law enforcement, risk management, data analytics, inventory control, quality assurance or a related field
- Experience working cross-functionally and across regions
- Experience creating and delivering written and oral communications for technical and non-technical audiences
- Deep experience with public-private partnerships and information-sharing programmes across multiple jurisdictions

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree or equivalent

title: Account Manager (Hi-tech/Semiconductor/Manufacturing), High Tech Semiconductor BD Team
descriptionHtml:
Since 2006, Amazon Web Services has been the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud. AWS has been continually expanding its services to support virtually any workload, and it now has more than 240 fully featured services for compute, storage, databases, networking, analytics, machine learning and artificial intelligence (AI), Internet of Things (IoT), mobile, security, hybrid, media, and application development, deployment, and management from 105 Availability Zones within 33 geographic regions, with announced plans for 18 more Availability Zones and 6 more AWS Regions in Malaysia, Mexico, New Zealand, the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, Thailand. Millions of customers—including the fastest-growing startups, largest enterprises, and leading government agencies—trust AWS to power their infrastructure, become more agile, and lower costs.

AWS Global Sales drives adoption of the AWS cloud worldwide, enabling customers of all sizes to innovate and expand in the cloud. Our team empowers every customer to grow by providing tailored service, unmatched technology, and consistent support. We dive deep to understand each customer's unique challenges, then craft innovative solutions that accelerate their success. This customer-first approach is how we built the world's most adopted cloud. Join us and help us grow.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is looking for an experienced Business Development professional who is eager to promote the strategic growth and to shape the future of a world which leverages cloud computing.

You will engage with enterprise clients' CXO/VP level strategically as well as closely collaborate with software developers, IT infrastructure, software designers, architects, data scientists, product development for AWS Cloud and AI/ML adoption. You must also be a self-starter and strategic thinker who is able to initiate and scale up business development and accelerate business progress by enabling the diverse strategic engagements with different key stakeholders in enterprises with a strong execution capability and fear-free to think out of box to find the innovative approach for helping our customers to handle the business and technical challenges.

Key job responsibilities
- Manage and develop a specific territory of strategic named accounts - containing a mix of existing enterprise customers and net new prospects
- Develop and execute against a comprehensive territory plan to speed up business development and deepen the strategic cooperation foundation with enterprise customers
- Influence (or impact) customer adoption, through consultative selling, thought leadership, executive relationship development and sell-in of professional services from customer’s perspective
- Work with AWS partners to extend reach & drive adoption
- Maintain and deliver results against a set of defined revenue and non-revenue targets by obsessing our customers to support them for reaching the success

In a short, you are not only focusing on Business Development to achieve the defined business KPIs but also acting as a Customer Ambassador to assure their success by adopting the right AWS solutions to solve their business and technical pain-points and to drive their business competitiveness.

A day in the life
AWS is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace to deliver the best results for our customers. Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status; we celebrate the diverse ways we work. For individuals with disabilities who would like to request an accommodation, please let us know and we will connect you to our accommodation team.

About the team
Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Basic qualifications

- Experience working with customers with a passion for delivering exceptional service, or experience in managing and troublshooting network and experience that includes strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and effective communication abilities
- 7+ years of full sales cycle, technology sales or equivalent business development, sales engineering/consulting or equivalent experience
- Experience in a business-to-business (B2B) environment, high-tech products/services

Preferred qualifications

- Experience using Salesforce or other CRM tool
- Are enrolled in or have completed a Master's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field
- Experience driving new business in greenfield accounts at the C-suite level or equivalent

title: Staż w dziale operacji i logistyki -  Gliwice 2027
descriptionHtml:
Dział operacji Amazon stanowi podstawę obsługi klienta Amazon. Dzięki ponad 50 centrom logistycznym, setkom stacji dostaw i dziesiątkom tysięcy pracowników zespół ten wspólnie dba o sprawną dostawę produktów do klientów. W centrach logistycznych każdego roku kompletowane i pakowane są miliony produktów, a zespoły dostawcze dokładają wszelkich starań, aby zamówienia dotarły do klientów na czas. Bezpieczeństwo jest najwyższym priorytetem, a kultura operacyjna opiera się na pracy zespołowej, różnorodności i wspólnej etyce pracy, które zapewniają płynne funkcjonowanie firmy. Zespół szczyci się świadczeniem wysokiej jakości usług, z których Amazon słynie na całym świecie.

Uwaga: Warunkiem przyjęcia jest posiadanie prawa do pracy w kraju zatrudnienia przed datą rozpoczęcia pracy.

Należy pamiętać, że jest to stanowisko stacjonarne w pełnym wymiarze czasu pracy.
Stanowisko to jest dostępne w wielu lokalizacjach w Polsce. Oferujemy miesięczny bonus relokacyjny.

Rozważamy zatrudnianie kandydatów do pracy w następujących lokalizacjach:
Bielany Wrocławskie | Dobromierz | Gliwice | Gorzyczki | Łódź | Okmiany | Pabianice | Poznań | Sosnowiec | Szczecin | Świebodzin


Key job responsibilities
Główne obowiązki

Jako stażysta w dziale operacji Amazon będziesz mieć możliwość wykorzystania swoich umiejętności analitycznych w ważnych projektach, które poprawiają funkcjonalność i jakość usług centrów logistycznych, centrów sortowania i stacji dostaw.
Kluczowe obowiązki stanowiska:

* Realizowanie projektów o wysokim priorytecie zgodnie z najwyższymi standardami oraz wykazywanie się umiejętnością osiągania wyników

* Analizowanie danych w celu identyfikacji wyzwań operacyjnych i możliwości poprawy

* Proponowanie i testowanie rozwiązań oraz współpraca z zespołem przy wdrażaniu tych najbardziej skutecznych

* Rozwijanie umiejętności komunikacyjnych i pracy zespołowej poprzez współpracę z przełożonymi, interesariuszami i pracownikami pierwszej linii.

* Przemieszczanie się po budynku w celu współpracy z różnymi zespołami. Obejmuje to aktywne zdobywanie wiedzy poprzez udział w takich działaniach, jak wstępne odprawy, spotkania dotyczące przepływu pracy oraz dyskusje z kierownictwem i współpracownikami.

* Niezbędnym elementem tego stanowiska jest umiejętność poruszania się po miejscu pracy i przemieszczania się między różnymi obszarami.

* Wykazywanie elastyczności w zakresie pracy w różnych harmonogramach i systemach zmianowych stosownie do potrzeb.

* Potencjalna relokacja do wyznaczonego miejsca pracy.



A day in the life
Dzień z życia stażysty
Nasze staże to okazja do zdobycia wiedzy, która pozwoli Ci jako naszemu przyszłemu przełożonemu przekonać się, w jaki sposób zarządzamy zespołami pracowników i rozwijamy ich kompetencje. Poznasz dynamiczny i złożony świat naszych centrów logistycznych, centrów sortowania oraz stacji dostaw i zobaczysz, w jaki sposób nasi kierownicy motywują swoje zespoły do spełniania oczekiwań klientów.

Dzięki temu stażowi znajdziesz się w samym centrum naszych działań, co pozwoli Ci prześledzić drogę zamówienia klienta. Zyskasz realistyczny obraz pracy w pełnym wymiarze czasu, która czeka na Ciebie w naszej organizacji.

Dowiesz się, w jaki sposób nasi przełożeni tworzą bezpieczne i produktywne środowisko pracy, w pełni wykorzystując potencjał swoich zespołów dzięki skutecznym strategiom angażowania pracowników i zarządzania wynikami pracy. To szansa na rozwinięcie umiejętności, które pomogą Ci rozpocząć satysfakcjonującą karierę w Amazon.


About the team
O zespole
Społeczność stażystów:

* Jako stażysta Amazon będziesz częścią dynamicznej, wspierającej społeczności, która pomoże Ci się rozwijać. Będziesz współpracować ze stażystami z całego świata, nawiązywać kontakty i uczestniczyć w wydarzeniach towarzyskich, aby poszerzyć swoje horyzonty. Możesz również dołączyć do specjalistycznych grup zajmujących się takimi obszarami, jak zrównoważony rozwój, co pozwoli Ci rozwijać różnorodne zainteresowania.

Wsparcie:

* Program stażowy obejmuje kompleksowy system wsparcia, w tym cotygodniowe dyżury dla stażystów, specjalistyczne wsparcie IT i HR oraz zespół programowy dbający o Twój sukces. Dzięki temu otrzymasz wskazówki i pomoc niezbędne do osiągnięcia sukcesu.

Sesje szkoleniowe:

* Dzięki specjalnym sesjom szkoleniowym jeszcze bardziej rozwiniesz swoje umiejętności, uzyskując dostęp do najnowocześniejszych platform szkoleniowych Amazon i wiedzy liderów branży. Te ustrukturyzowane możliwości rozwoju przygotują cię do kolejnego kroku w karierze.

Możliwości:

* Po pomyślnym ukończeniu stażu możemy rozważyć zatrudnienie Cię na stanowisku dla absolwentów lub zaproponować drugi staż, co pozwoli Ci kontynuować drogę zawodową w Amazon. Dodatkowo otrzymasz konkurencyjne miesięczne wynagrodzenie, wsparcie w relokacji oraz dostęp do szeregu świadczeń pracowniczych.

Daty rozpoczęcia stażu w ciągu roku:

* Przyjmujemy stażystów, którzy mogą rozpocząć pracę w dowolnym momencie od stycznia do lipca 2027 r. Każdego miesiąca organizujemy 1–2 dni wdrożeniowe dla nowych pracowników.

- Możliwość odbycia stażu w pełnym wymiarze czasu pracy trwającego od 3 do 6 miesięcy.
- Bardzo dobra znajomość języka angielskiego i polskiego w mowie i piśmie (poziom C1 według Europejskiego Systemu Opisu Kształcenia Językowego).

Preferred qualifications

- Doskonałe kompetencje w zakresie rozwiązywania problemów i analizy, umiejętność identyfikowania możliwości usprawnienia procesów i innowacyjnych rozwiązań.

title: Junior Logistik Manager
descriptionHtml:
Als Nachwuchsführungskraft wirst du in unserem 11-wöchigen internen Onboarding Programm auf deine neue Aufgabe als Führungskraft vorbereitet.
Nach dieser umfangreichen Einarbeitung übernimmst du Führungsverantwortung für dein eigenes Team und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Kunden Ihre Waren pünktlich und in guter Qualität erhalten. In dieser Position bist du wichtiger Teil unseres globalen Unternehmens und arbeitest Hand in Hand mit deinen Mitarbeitenden vor Ort. Zudem arbeitest du standortübergreifend an Themen wie Arbeitssicherheit, Prozessoptimierung, Nachhaltigkeit und technischem Fortschritt.


Key job responsibilities
• Sicherstellung der Einhaltung der Arbeitssicherheitsvorschriften und des Umweltschutzes
• Ableitung von Handlungsempfehlungen und konkreten Maßnahmen zur Prozessverbesserung auf Basis von Kennzahlen wie Arbeitssicherheit, Produktivität und Qualität
• Leitung und Weiterbildung eines Teams (bis zu 100 Mitarbeitende)
• Planung und Steuerung der innerbetrieblichen Prozesse
• Teilnahme in übergeordneten Projekten zur Optimierung der Kundenzufriedenheit
• Effektives Ressourcen- und Workflowmanagement
• Zusammenarbeit mit den vor- und nachgelagerten Abteilungen vor Ort


A day in the life
Du arbeitest in einer unserer Schichten (Früh-, Spät- oder Nachtschicht). Dabei ist das Einhalten der Sicherheitsstandards an deinem gesamten Standort für dich höchste Priorität. Als Schichtleitung führst du routinemäßig Teammeetings durch und führst Feedbackgespräche mit deinen Mitarbeitenden und deinen Stakeholdern. Mit Hilfe von Datenauswertungen nimmst Du Einfluss auf die Produktivität und die Qualität deines Standortes. Als wichtiges Mitglied des Teams vor Ort arbeitest Du mit anderen Abteilungen, sowie externen Stakeholdern zusammen und sorgst dafür, dass wir die Anforderungen unserer Kundschaft, ebenso wie unsere eigenen Vorgaben jederzeit erfüllen. Durch die Analyse von Daten mit Führungskräften und die Besprechung der betrieblichen Vor- und Nachteile von technischen Verbesserungen mit den Fachabteilungen trägst du zu „best in class“ Lösungen bei.

About the team
Mit der Erfüllung unserer Kundenbestellungen (Customer Fulfillment oder CF) fing für Amazon alles an. Das Customer Fulfillment Team hat sich mittlerweile von einem Team von Buchhändler:innen hin zu einem hocherfahrenen globalen Team gewandelt, das täglich mehr als 1,5 Millionen Bestellungen bearbeitet. Das Team bildet die Grundlage unseres Geschäfts und hat uns bei der Verbreiterung in neue Regionen und Dienstleistungen geholfen. Mithilfe aufkommender Technologie sind wir stetig auf der Suche nach Möglichkeiten, eine größere und bessere Produktauswahl anzubieten – die schnell und erschwinglich geliefert wird.
Die CF-Teammitglieder sorgen als allererste dafür, dass unsere Kund:innen ihre Bestellungen mit der Geschwindigkeit erhalten, für die wir bekannt sind. Wir arbeiten in Fulfillment-Centern, die das Herzstück von Amazons dynamischem Betriebsnetz bilden. Unsere Fullfilment-Center werden manchmal auch als die „erste Meile“ (First Mile) bezeichnet – hier starten die meisten Amazon-Pakete ihren Versandweg. Wir unterstützen die Verwaltung eines dynamischen Bestands und ermöglichen schnelle Zustellungen rund um die Uhr.
In unseren Fulfillment-Centern sind vielfältige Mitarbeitergruppen beschäftigt. Es gibt zahlreiche Möglichkeiten für Menschen mit den verschiedensten Fähigkeiten. Einige von uns arbeiten mit physischen Produkten. Andere analysieren Daten und helfen unternehmensweit dabei, intelligente Entscheidungen zu treffen.

Basic qualifications

- Erfolgreich absolviertes Hochschulstudium (Bachelor- oder Master) vor Arbeitsbeginn
- Fortgeschrittene Englisch- und Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift
- Relevante Erfahrung in der Durchführung von Datenanalysen

Preferred qualifications

- Aktuelles Studium oder kürzlich erworbener Bachelor- oder Masterabschluss im Bereich Logistik, Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Ingenieurwesen oder in einem vergleichbaren Studiengang
- Interesse eine Führungsaufgabe und ein eigenes Team mit Mitarbeitenden aus der ganzen Welt zu übernehmen
- Erfahrung in der Kommunikation mit verschiedenen Stakeholdern, einschließlich Kolleg:innen und Führungskräften
- Erfahrung in einer Logistikumgebung
- Erfahrung in der Arbeit mit MS Office (Word, Excel, Outlook) im beruflichen Umfeld

title: Technical Account Manager, ES – APJC-ASEAN
descriptionHtml:
AWS Applied AI Solutions (AAIS) is building toward a future where every business innovates with Amazon AI teammates. To get there, we build AI solutions that improve human capabilities and transform entire business functions. We create end-to-end products that surprise and delight out-of-the-box, making complex things easy and hard things possible, with no cloud experience required. We start with customers who embrace the future and build bridges to meet the rest where they are. We pursue ambitious opportunities with conviction, and we are looking for builders who share that mindset.

Do you want to help our customers to adopt cloud computing technology, solve the biggest of "big data" problems, work with Internet scale distributed systems and see the impact of your work with happy and successful customers?

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is looking for motivated technologists who have a desire to work in the cloud computing industry where you will build your technical skills as well as learn from top subject matter experts and industry thought leaders. You will partner with customers and several AWS teams to craft highly scalable flexible and resilient cloud architectures that address customer business problems. As a trusted customer advocate the technical account manager will help organizations understand best practices around cloud-based solutions as well as diagnose and reproduce technical issues with our technology products. You will provide ongoing support and technical guidance to help plan and build solutions using best practices and proactively help in keeping your customers' AWS environments operationally healthy. You will have the opportunity to help shape and execute a strategy to build mindshare and broad use of AWS within organizations ranging from new start-ups to large enterprise customers. The ability to connect technology with measurable business value is critical to a technical account manager. This position will require the ability to travel 10% or more as needed.

Key job responsibilities
• Build a strong foundation of knowledge around AWS cloud services and the cloud ecosystem
• Work with customers of all sizes to execute on the Enterprise Support value proposition of AWS
• Assist with operational support needs for customers already using AWS
• Collaborate with experienced technical account managers to craft and share best-practice knowledge amongst the AWS communities
• Act as a technical liaison between customers service engineering teams and support
• Effectively represent AWS within a customer's environment and drive discussions regarding incidents, trade-offs, and risk management

A day in the life
As a trusted advisor you'll have a direct impact in helping our customers gain the most value from cloud technology. You'll craft and execute strategies to drive our customers' adoption and use of AWS services.

Our Technical Account Managers partner with some of the most iconic businesses in the country. These range from rising startups building their business from scratch through to large enterprises going through significant transformation. You'll provide advice on architecture, support strategy, project and launch planning, as well as ongoing operational issues. Watch a short video about life as a Technical Account Manager team here https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EBA_8o0F9D0

About the team
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn't followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don't let it stop you from applying.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world's most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that's why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there's nothing we can't achieve in the cloud.

Here at AWS, it's in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic qualifications

- Experience as a technical account manager, consultant, solutions architect, platform engineer, systems engineer, cloud architect or in a similar role
- 5+ years of technical engineering experience
- Experience with operational parameters and troubleshooting for three (3) of the following: compute/storage/networking/CDN/databases/DevOps/big data and analytics/GenAI/security/applications development in a distributed systems environment

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in customer-facing technical role or internal enterprise support environment

title: Directeur(trice) d'Exploitation Logistique
descriptionHtml:
Devenez Directeur/trice des Opérations chez Amazon et mettez votre leadership au service de notre mission : diriger l'une des activités clés (réception et stockage des articles ou préparation et expédition des commandes) au sein de l'un de nos plus grands centres de distribution en Europe. Dans ce rôle essentiel, vous combinerez vision stratégique et excellence opérationnelle pour piloter des opérations complexes à grande échelle, tout en développant la prochaine génération de leaders. Vous serez un véritable architecte de la transformation, contribuant à façonner l'avenir de notre réseau logistique européen.

Key job responsibilities
• Définir et incarner une culture d'excellence en matière de sécurité au sein de votre périmètre, en faisant de la santé et du bien-être des équipes une priorité absolue
• Recruter, encadrer et développer une équipe de managers expérimentés (Responsables des Opérations et Responsables d’Equipe) dans votre domaine d'activité spécifique
• Élaborer et exécuter la stratégie opérationnelle pour votre activité, incluant la planification financière, la gestion des ressources et l'optimisation continue des processus
• Concevoir et piloter des projets stratégiques d'amélioration à l'échelle du réseau, en vous appuyant sur une analyse approfondie des données et les meilleures pratiques
• Être un leader visionnaire dans l'innovation des processus logistiques de votre domaine et un acteur clé dans le partage d'expertise au niveau européen



A day in the life
Rejoindre Amazon à ce niveau stratégique, c'est avoir l'opportunité d'influencer l'avenir de nos opérations logistiques. Vous bénéficierez d'un programme d'intégration approfondi au niveau européen et serez accompagné(e) par des leaders seniors. Notre environnement en forte croissance et l'exposition à des défis stratégiques complexes vous permettront de développer des compétences de leadership de haut niveau. Ce rôle ouvre la voie à des opportunités exceptionnelles au sein d'Amazon. Vous pourrez évoluer vers des responsabilités stratégiques au niveau européen, diriger des initiatives d'innovation majeures, ou prendre la direction d'organisations plus importantes - les possibilités sont illimitées.

En tant que Directeur/trice des Opérations, vous dirigerez une activité clé (inbound ou outbound) au sein de l'un des plus grands centres de distribution d'Amazon en Europe, combinant technologies de pointe, automatisation avancée et excellence opérationnelle. Vous serez responsable d'une organisation importante gérant des centaines d'employés et des technologies innovantes pour assurer la satisfaction de millions de clients.


About the team
Notre centre de traitement des commandes (Customer Fulfilment, ou CF), est l’endroit où tout a commencé pour Amazon. D’une modeste équipe de libraires, le CF est devenu une équipe mondiale spécialisée qui traite plus de 1,5 million de commandes chaque jour. L’équipe CF est le moteur de notre entreprise et ses efforts nous ont permis de nous tourner vers de nouvelles régions et de proposer de nouveaux services. Avec l’aide des technologies émergentes, nous sommes en permanence à la recherche de solutions nouvelles pour proposer une gamme de produits plus large et de meilleure qualité, livrée rapidement et à un prix abordable.
L’équipe CF est le premier maillon de la chaîne qui permet aux clients d’obtenir les produits à la vitesse qui fait notre réputation. Nous sommes basés dans les centres de traitement des commandes, qui sont au cœur du réseau des opérations d’Amazon. Nos centres sont parfois appelés le « premier kilomètre », car c’est là que la plupart des colis Amazon commencent leur voyage. Nous aidons à gérer les stocks dynamiques et à faciliter les livraisons rapides, 24 heures sur 24, 7 jours sur 7.
Nos centres de traitement des commandes regroupent des profils variés et les opportunités y sont nombreuses. Certains membres de l’équipe travaillent avec des produits physiques, tandis que d’autres analysent des données. Ensemble, nous travaillons pour que chacun puisse prendre des décisions éclairées dans toute l’entreprise.

title: Sr Integration Experience Mgr, Corporate Development Integration
descriptionHtml:
Corporate Development Integration is seeking an experienced integration communications and onboarding leader to drive adoption of functional and business integration activities in Amazon's mergers and acquisitions (M&A).

Amazon's integration leaders in this space are called Integration Experience (IX) Leads as they focus on minimizing disruption and driving engagement for acquired employees through internal communications, onboarding, training, cultural integration, and employee engagement strategies.

The IX Lead plans, creates, and executes integration enablement programs across the full integration lifecycle, from due diligence through approximately 90-100 days post-acquisition close. This role supports integrations of all sizes, both private and public company transactions, across multiple geographies, and managing multiple concurrent integration programs. Leveraging change management best practices, the IX Lead focuses on accelerating time to productivity for acquired organizations by delivering pragmatic, scalable support that is directly aligned to deal goals, navigating the ambiguity of M&A transactions and synthesizing input from business and cross-functional teams. Central to this role is supporting a culture of inclusion, trust, and respect in all working relationships—with acquired employees, cross-functional partners, and leadership alike.

This role supports global transactions, requiring domestic and international travel approximately 30% of the time. Due to the dynamic nature of M&A timelines, travel may occasionally be planned on short notice.


Key job responsibilities
Change Enablement & Integration Strategy
- Apply change management best practices to assess change readiness, identify potential friction points, and develop tailored enablement strategies based on deal complexity and anticipated change impact
- Translate functional and business integration activities into people-focused experiences through sequencing, prioritization, and stakeholder engagement
- Conduct cultural and change readiness assessments during due diligence, translating findings into actionable recommendations for communication, onboarding, and engagement strategies
- Define the scope of change support required for each transaction in partnership with the Integration Manager and Business Sponsor
- Identify opportunities to improve internal integration processes and scale best practices across the IX portfolio

Internal Communications
- Own the end-to-end employee communication strategy across the integration lifecycle, including employee newsletters and FAQs, leader briefing materials, and targeted messaging for specific employee groups
- Develop and execute comprehensive communication plans for key milestones (Deal Sign & Announcement, Deal Close & Day 1 Orientation), coordinating inputs from cross-functional teams (Business, Legal, PR, HR, IT, Finance, and Real Estate)
- Write and review all employee-facing communications ensuring clarity, consistency, and cross-functional alignment across stakeholders
- Develop executive communications that distill complex integration details into clear, compelling narratives
- Advise on organizational design communications, including sequencing and timing of reporting structure changes to manage employee experience

Onboarding & Training
- Plan and execute Day 1 Orientation events and customized onboarding experiences, including structured onboarding programs, leader onboarding programs, establishing a support network for the acquired population (onboarding buddies and key individuals to meet), and role-specific training
- Design and deliver comprehensive training plans in partnership with cross-functional teams, coordinating timing and sequencing to ensure a cohesive employee experience
- Equip Amazon and acquired company leaders to deliver integration messages through leader briefings and one-on-ones, enabling them to guide their teams through the transition
- Educate cross-functional partners and business teams on IX workstreams, integration milestones, and employee experience considerations

Cultural Integration
- Identify gaps between the acquired organization's operating norms and Amazon's ways of working, and develop integration strategies to bridge them
- Design and execute cultural integration approaches, including education on Amazon's Leadership Principles, Working Backwards methodology, business writing, and other ways of working
- Implement Change Champion Networks for large, complex transactions to support peer-to-peer adoption and sustained engagement

Stakeholder Engagement
- Build trusted relationships with senior leaders (Business Sponsors, VPs, acquired leadership) through direct engagement and consistent, communication
- Influence, advise, and build consensus among senior leadership in ambiguous situations, determining how to achieve the best outcome and knowing when and how to escalate effectively
- Keep cross-functional teams up-to-speed with proactive communication that anticipates questions

Employee Engagement & Measurement
- Own employee engagement measurement, including employee engagement pulse surveys, onboarding surveys, and integration surveys (~90-100 days post-close)
- Analyze employee sentiment data, identify themes, and present recommended actions to leadership, benchmarking results against historical acquisition data
- Use feedback loops to proactively address concerns, remove productivity barriers, and inform ongoing change support

About the team
The Corporate Development Integration team leads Amazon and acquired teams through the definition and enablement of the acquisition rationale and acquired business growth. Integration Experience (IX) Leads support this mission by planning, creating, and executing communications, onboarding, training, cultural integration, and employee engagement strategies that enable acquired organizations to adopt functional and business integration activities. Leveraging change management best practices, IX creates pragmatic integration enablement plans focused on ensuring acquired employees are informed, engaged, and supported throughout their initial integration journey with Amazon. We apply what's helpful, skip what's not, and stay solution-oriented, tailoring our approach based on deal complexity and business need.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree
- 5+ years of developing, negotiating and executing business agreements experience
- 5+ years of professional or military experience
- Experience in advising and influencing executive leadership
- 8+ years of experience in change management, internal communications, employee engagement, organizational development, learning & enablement, or M&A integration – including designing and executing large-scale communication or onboarding programs
- Strong writing skills with the ability to synthesize complex information into clear, compelling written narratives for executive audiences
- Experience applying change management methodologies to support organizational transitions
- Experience managing cross-functional programs with multiple concurrent workstreams

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in M&A integration, organizational transformation, or large-scale business change
- Experience with employee engagement measurement, survey design, and data-driven action planning
- Track record of managing programs across multiple geographies and cultures
- Certification in change management (e.g., Prosci, CCMP), program management (e.g., PgMP, PMP), or strategic communications (e.g., IABC CMP, ABC)

title: Software Development Engineer, Reporting Data Platform
descriptionHtml:
Every number an advertiser sees in Amazon Ads passes through our platform. We process 40 billion records a day and are building the next generation of this system on a Lakehouse architecture — making it the data foundation for AI-powered advertising products that millions of advertisers depend on.

We need an engineer who wants to own that work, write production code, and ship systems at this scale. You're joining at an exciting time: the team is building a new Lakehouse architecture that gives both human-facing reporting surfaces and AI agents the same governed, queryable interface to advertising data. AI agents already query our platform at inference time to answer advertiser questions and power automated campaign management — and that usage is growing fast. You'll build both the core platform and the AI-powered tooling that makes it easier to operate. Engineers on this team have already shipped autonomous operations agents and lineage tracing tools that are in production today.

Key job responsibilities
• Build data pipelines that turn raw advertising events into the metrics advertisers use to measure and grow their businesses
• Design and ship new platform capabilities using table-based architectures that unlock faster onboarding, simpler operations, and broader data access
• Create automated validation and monitoring that keeps data accurate at scale
• Improve infrastructure efficiency and reduce operational costs across a large compute fleet
• Work with partner teams to onboard new advertising products onto the reporting platform
• Build AI-powered tooling and autonomous operations agents that improve platform reliability and developer productivity

About the team
We sit within Amazon Advertising and own the reporting data layer end to end. Our team is 13 engineers across two locations. Core technologies: Java, Python, TypeScript (AWS CDK), Apache Spark on EMR, Apache Iceberg — plus EKS, DynamoDB, Redshift, and Athena. Senior engineers mentor newer team members, and the growth path leads to owning platform-level initiatives, setting architectural direction, and becoming a technical point of contact across the organization.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of big data technologies such as AWS, Hadoop, Spark, Pig, Hive, Lucene/SOLR or Storm/Samza experience
- 2+ years of designing and developing large-scale, multi-tiered, multi-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C#, C++, Java, or Perl experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- 1+ years of software development engineer or related occupational experience
- 1+ years of Object Oriented Design experience
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

title: Procurement Manager, Transportation Procurement Brazil
descriptionHtml:
Transportation Procurement Leader — Last Mile / EDSP (AMZL Brazil)

At Amazon, we're working to be the most customer-centric company on earth. To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright, and driven people. If you'd like to help us redefine the future of last mile delivery in one of the fastest-growing e-commerce markets in the world, this is your chance to make history.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are seeking a senior leader with deep transportation procurement and last mile operations experience to own the end-to-end strategy and execution of Amazon's largest AMZL program in Brazil: EDSP (External Delivery Service Partner). This role sits at the intersection of procurement, supply chain, and network operations — leading the scaling of a carrier ecosystem that delivers millions of packages across 300+ nodes nationwide.

The person in this role will be the single-threaded owner of the EDSP program, managing a portfolio of delivery service providers while driving aggressive network expansion, operational excellence, and delivery performance. You will partner with Operations, Finance, Network Planning, and Carrier Management teams to unlock capacity, negotiate at scale, and continuously improve delivery quality while maintaining 98%+ delivery execution accuracy (DEA).

The ideal candidate is a proven operator who thrives in ambiguity — someone who has scaled programs from zero to hundreds of nodes, built carrier ecosystems from the ground up, and delivered step-function improvements while expanding coverage. You must combine strategic thinking with executional rigor, influence without authority across senior stakeholders, and lead high-performing teams in a fast-paced, ever-evolving environment.


KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS

Share growth: increase EDSP program share of eligible volume while maintaining or improving delivery quality.
Operational efficiency: continuously improve cost-per-package through network design, route density optimization, and supplier performance management.
Network expansion: successfully launch and stabilize new nodes on schedule, expanding coverage to underserved regions.
Supplier performance: maintain 98%+ DEA across the carrier portfolio with clear performance management cadence and consequence management.
Stakeholder trust: earn and maintain the trust of Operations, Finance, and senior leadership as the definitive voice on last mile transportation procurement in Brazil.
Team development: promote talent from within, close capability gaps, and build organizational readiness for next-phase growth.





Key job responsibilities
Own the EDSP category strategy end-to-end: develop and execute sourcing strategies that balance capacity, coverage, and service quality across Brazil's last mile network.
Scale the carrier ecosystem: identify, onboard, develop, and performance-manage delivery service providers to support network growth from current state toward full national coverage.
Drive operational efficiency and network optimization: improve route density, reduce cost-per-package through network design, and identify structural levers that enhance program economics without compromising service quality.
Lead cross-functional alignment: partner with Operations, Network Planning, Finance, and Tech teams to ensure procurement strategy is synchronized with AMZL capacity planning, node launches, and share allocation decisions.
Manage supplier performance with operational rigor: establish SLAs, track DEA/DPMO/speed metrics, drive root-cause analysis on underperformance, and create continuous improvement mechanisms with carriers.
Act as the market intelligence authority: monitor competitive dynamics, capacity constraints, regulatory changes, and emerging delivery models to inform strategic decisions and keep VP-level stakeholders informed.
Negotiate and execute complex contracts: lead high-stakes negotiations with strategic suppliers, structuring agreements that incentivize performance, mitigate risk, and protect Amazon's long-term competitive position.
Build and develop a high-performing team: lead, mentor, and grow a team of procurement specialists and supply chain managers, fostering a culture of ownership, data-driven decision-making, and operational excellence.

Basic qualifications

- Experience demonstrating strong analytical abilities and confidence in the use of data
- Experience in procurement, supply chain, or transportation management, with at least 3 years in a leadership role.
- Track record of scaling programs or supplier ecosystems in high-growth, ambiguous environments.
- Experience with last mile delivery, logistics networks, or transportation operations.
- Fluency in Portuguese and English.

Preferred qualifications

- MBA, or Bachelor's degree in supply chain management, operations, engineering, analytics or related field
- Experience influencing senior leaders/stakeholders
- Experience in emerging markets or rapidly scaling logistics operations.
- Knowledge of Brazilian transportation regulations, carrier landscape, and e-commerce logistics.
- Experience with last mile delivery programs.

At Amazon, we're working to be the most customer-centric company, to be the best employer, and to be the safest place to work on earth. To get there, we need exceptionally talented and driven people. If you'd like to help us build that place, this is your chance to make history.

One focus area of the North America Amazon Logistics (AMZL) network is to provide tools, resources, and environments that support safe, efficient, and healthy behaviors and encourage employees to proactively manage their health and wellbeing. To support this focus area, Amazon is seeking an experienced and innovative person to serve as a Program Manager for AMZL WHS to build and execute programs that create a safe workplace and build a world-class safety culture in the midst of Amazon’s growth. In this role, you will dive deep into Operations processes; identify risks through data and first-hand experience; build and execute programs, and improve processes to eliminate risks; and influence Operations to sustain a culture of safety. This role will focus on coordinating and leading large, strategic projects within AMZL and will be strongly focused on injury and accident prevention as well as improvements across health, safety and wellness.

The WHS Program Manager role will challenge you to push boundaries and lead transformative innovation while having the autonomy to make rapid data-driven decisions and invent on behalf of Operators (operation leaders) and Team Members. In this role, you will work cross-functionally with members from various teams, including Operations; Human Resources, Procurement, Finance, WHS, Reliability, Engineering and Maintenance, Finance and OpEx to deploy solutions at scale. This role calls for an individual who is technically smart to gain credibility with customers and stakeholders at various levels of the organization.

The role will report into the Senior Manager, Strategic Initiatives for AMZL WHS and work collaboratively with other partners across all Amazon BUs and regional geographies to provide innovative solutions across our business. This role is based out of the Seattle, WA, Arlington, VA, or Nashville, TN corporate locations and will require 25% travel to support project deployments, factory acceptance tests (FATs), strategy meetings, and for process improvement Kaizen events.

The ideal candidate has an obsession for customers and a strong interest in building innovative solutions; must have proven analytical capabilities (including ability to deep dive, identify root causes and permanently eliminate hazards and risks); and can thrive in a fast-paced environment with exceptional communication and project management skills. The ideal candidate must have sound judgment, compassion, and interpersonal skills with the ability to work collaboratively with colleagues in many areas across the company.

Key job responsibilities
Develop, review, approve, coordinate, and lead large, strategic projects / programs within Amazon Business Units (BUs) and across different geographies.
Build relationships and partner across many organizations to build and execute on new initiatives and roadmaps each year.
Work and collaborate with stakeholders and partners to align on project /program goals and resources.
Coordinate a portfolio of programs / projects from inception to delivery.
Define and implement metrics to measure and communicate program achievements.
Compile, manage and report on weekly project metrics and be responsible for leading many high profile meetings to align on project requirements.
Communicate the overall program roadmap and provide periodic status updates to the stakeholders, and presenting programs / projects to senior leadership on a regular basis.
Provide programs decision support, insights and recommendations through data gathering and information analyzing.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in supply chain, business, engineering, finance or related technical or quantitative field
- 5+ years of program or project management experience
- Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
- Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree, or Master's degree in supply chain, business, engineering, finance or related technical or quantitative field
- 2+ years of driving process improvements experience

title: Regional WHS Manager
descriptionHtml:
The Regional WHS Manager will lead Amazon FC WHS operations across multiple INFC sites in the South region in India. We are looking for leaders who are passionate about safety and will help build a world class WHS organization and a strong WHS culture. The leader will be responsible for leading a team of safety mangers and partnering with operations teams in Fulfillment Centers to execute the company WHS policies and ensure compliance to all applicable local and regional regulations. By leveraging lean principles and kaizens, this individual will drive continuous improvement initiatives to reduce conditional and ergonomic risk in our processes to ensure a safe and healthful working environment for our Associates. The WHS leader will be required to identify best practices and incorporate these best practices into our standards to continuously improve company safety policies. He will be required to possess excellent safety program and relevant environmental and ergonomic knowledge and demonstrate this expertise when working with Operations. The Regional WHS Manager will be responsible to lead a team of safety managers and safety teams at different INFC site locations in their assigned region. This individual must help execute leadership development plans for their Safety team. They must communicate safety team expectations and give frequent and appropriate feedback to the safety managers/ teams and ensure they are executing to the core competencies of an Amazon safety professional.




Key job responsibilities
• Measure and communicate the site's performance against published requirements in safety policies.
• Ensure site leadership is trained and knowledgeable of their responsibilities under each policy.
• Ensure site leadership is provided with current and regular safety information that enables them to discuss safety with their peers, associates, and contracted workforce.
• Spend time on the floor, yard, and dock seeking input from associates, contracted workforce, and leaders on safety improvement opportunities.
Possess a thorough understanding of local and regional regulations and company policy, including Motor Vehicle and Transport Safety regulations applicable to transportation and operations.
• Inform leadership when they are required to resolve a safety concern or suggestion.
• Lead proactive hazard identification (including road safety, vehicle safety, loading/unloading operations, and yard management), communicate results, and track open items to resolution.
• Ensure a timely, thorough, and accurate response to uncontrolled risks once they are discovered.
• Plan and carry out peer audits to ensure compliance with the organization's safety policies.
• Analyse incident data (including road incidents, vehicle telematics data, and on-site incidents) to identify trends and justify the allocation of appropriate resources to areas where the safety risk is highest.
• Escalate risks that present an imminent danger to life or health, or where the solution is either insufficient to protect associates and contracted workforce from harm or is delayed in being fully implemented.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of increasing responsibilities in EHS or environmental programs in manufacturing, production, or service operations experience
- Bachelor's degree
- Experience leading multiple direct reports or multiple sites

Preferred qualifications

- Experience implementing lean principles and process improvement in an operational environment
