descriptionHtml:
Amazon Shipping is building a high-growth business designed to transform how the world thinks about logistics. We're rapidly expanding our shipping and delivery services to brands and merchants across the U.S., and we're looking for entrepreneurial Business Development leaders who can grow our SMB customer base at scale.

As a Sr. Business Developer on our Unmanaged/SMB team, you will own the growth engine for our existing shipper base -- think customer growth team, built for SMB. You'll drive the stabilization, growth, and retention of thousands of self-service shippers, designing the benefits, enablement, and lifecycle programs that make merchants ship more and stay longer -- without one-to-one account management. You will be goaled on incremental revenue from settled shippers and on retention.


Key job responsibilities
• Own settled-base growth -- segment the existing shipper base, identify expansion opportunity (volume, lanes, services), and build lifecycle programs that grow shipping volume per shipper at scale.
• Build the tiered benefits program -- design and launch a non-pricing benefits program (frequent-shipper tiers) that rewards consistent shipping, with a roadmap of benefits that deepen loyalty year over year.
• Run enablement at scale -- build the webinar, content, and best-practice engine that makes thousands of merchants successful simultaneously -- onboarding deepening, feature adoption, and shipping optimization programs.
• Own retention -- build early-warning signals for at-risk shippers, design proactive and reactive save motions with automation/AI at a scalable ROI, and own the regretted-attrition number.
• Own the voice of the shipper (VOS) -- run a scalable mechanism for collecting shipper feedback, walk the store to find friction in the self-service experience, and translate signals into prioritized Product, Tech, and Operations improvements.
• Define and own growth metrics -- set program OKRs (incremental revenue from settled shippers, retention and regretted attrition, program engagement, benefit-tier progression), track rigorously, and iterate to maximize ROI.
• Work backwards from shipper needs -- earn trust by diving deep into shipper economics, shipping patterns, and pain points to design programs merchants actually value.
• Own your domain end-to-end -- operate as the subject matter expert for your channel, define BD strategy that complements the product strategy, and deliver results through scalable mechanisms rather than one-off effort.
• Think big and innovate -- replace what account management does for enterprise customers with programs, benefits, and automation that scale to tens of thousands of SMBs.


A day in the life
You are a growth operator who thrives on making an installed base more valuable. You spend your time in the data segmenting shippers, designing the next benefit tier, reviewing what the VOS mechanism surfaced this week, and measuring which programs actually moved revenue and retention. You're equally comfortable presenting a retention deep-dive to leadership as you are scripting a webinar for a thousand merchants. You operate with startup speed in a big-company environment -- every program you build should serve thousands of shippers, not one.

About the team
Amazon Shipping is a fast-growing startup within Amazon building the next generation of logistics services for external brands and merchants. We've externalized Amazon's world-class delivery network and are now scaling it rapidly. Our Unmanaged/SMB team owns the self-service segment -- thousands of small and mid-size merchants who ship with us without dedicated account management. We're looking for builders who can create the programs that make this segment grow 10x.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree
- 5+ years of professional or military experience
- 5+ years of customer growth, lifecycle/retention marketing, account management at scale, or business development experience with a track record of measurable revenue outcomes
- Experience designing and running customer programs (benefits, loyalty, enablement, or retention) with data-driven measurement
- Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders and thrive in ambiguity

Preferred qualifications

- Experience building loyalty/benefits or lifecycle programs that drove measurable revenue growth at scale (thousands+ customers)
- Experience with B2B retention, churn prediction, or customer-success operations at scale
- Experience in e-commerce platforms, logistics/shipping, or marketplace ecosystems

title: Data Center Project Manager, Critical Projects Implementation
descriptionHtml:
The Critical Projects Implementation (CPI) team is a project management and execution team that manages construction activity within the operational data center spaces. The CPI team is tasked with critical infrastructure improvement projects to optimize utilization of space, power, and cooling within operation data centers around the globe. These activities are outside of the scope of standard construction delivery and regular preventative maintenance tasks.

We are currently seeking an energetic Data Center Project Manager to serve as a technical resource within Amazon data centers. You will be part of a highly creative, efficient team tasked with tackling the most fascinating and challenges in designing, building, and operating Amazon data facilities. The Project Manager is ultimately responsible for project oversight and review of all disciplines including electrical, mechanical, controls, and architectural. A fundamental understanding of these systems is required, as the individual will be expected to identify areas for improvement as well as act on data provided from other team and organizations. Ideal candidates will possess the ability to design, develop and deploy innovative solutions to address operational challenges. This role requires both independent contribution as well as the ability to work within multi-disciplinary teams. The scope of projects will include but not limited to the improvement of electrical, mechanical, fire detection and building automation system. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

title: Security Engineer, Security for Employee and Legal Systems (SEALS)
descriptionHtml:
The Security for Employee and Legal Systems (SEALS) team protects Amazon's enterprise HR and Legal applications. Millions of Amazonians use these systems to review their pay, manage their benefits, update their personal information, and handle confidential legal matters. Protecting that data is the core of what SEALS does, and the customers who depend on us are the people who work here.
The applications we protect are increasingly built with GenAI, and many of them now embed GenAI features and agentic workflows of their own. That shifts the security work. You will threat model LLM-backed applications, assess risks such as prompt injection, insecure model output handling, and over-broad agent permissions, and secure transitive authentication as agents act on behalf of users. You will also use GenAI to scale your own delivery, from automated code review to detection authoring.
SEALS delivers ambient security. Builders get security feedback while they write code, at commit time, so risks are caught and fixed during development. As a Security Engineer on SEALS, you will be an embedded partner to your builder teams and own the security outcomes for your domain.
Strong candidates bring depth in application security: threat modeling, architecture and design reviews, secure code review, and hands-on remediation. You will contribute autonomously within the team, deliver risk reduction across the full lifecycle, and mentor peers, while seeking guidance from managers and technical leaders on the hardest tradeoffs.


Key job responsibilities
● Own the security outcomes for your assigned SEALS builder teams and the HR and Legal applications they run.
● Threat model GenAI and LLM-backed applications, covering risks such as prompt injection, insecure output handling, data leakage through model context, and excessive agent authority.
● Secure agentic workflows, including transitive authentication and scoped authorization as agents act on behalf of users.
● Author and refine automated detection rules that catch risks at code commit and give builders a fix they can accept immediately.
● Use GenAI to scale delivery across your domain, including AI-assisted code review, detection authoring, and triage.
● Drive paved-path adoption (Secure CDK Blueprints, automated patching, standardized authorization, transitive authentication for agentic workflows) so preventable issues do not occur.
● Hunt for risk the tooling missed through adversarial analysis and manual secure code review in Java, Python, and JavaScript, then turn each escape into a new detection.
● Provide security architecture guidance and lead the security outcomes of design reviews for your team and customers.
● Prioritize remediation by business impact, and escalate to leadership when a builder wants to accept a launch-blocking risk.
● Communicate security outcomes clearly, in writing and verbally, to security and service team leadership.


A day in the life
You are the security engineer your builder teams want in the room. On a given day you might threat model a new LLM feature for an HR application, write a detection rule that closes a gap a production finding revealed, pair with a builder to fix an authorization flaw while the code is fresh, or review the design of an agentic workflow before it ships. You articulate risk clearly to technical and non-technical audiences, prioritize pragmatically, and guide partners toward secure solutions. You mentor other engineers on the team and raise the bar around you.

About the team
SEALS sits within Corporate Services Security (CPSS), the Amazon security team aligned with Finance & Global Business Services, People eXperience & Technology, Legal, and Global Communications and Community Impact. We engage development teams early so our stakeholders can build and scale securely.

You will lead a team of experienced engineers supporting multiple avionics LRUs and will be responsible for establishing priorities, developing technical capability, and ensuring effective engineering support for production.

• Lead a team of engineers responsible for new product introduction and sustaining engineering across Amazon Leo avionics bus LRUs.
• Own the development organization's production-facing engineering support model for released avionics hardware.
• Drive successful transition of new and revised avionics hardware from development into stable production.
• Ensure rapid technical response to production hardware and test issues, including triage, containment, disposition, root-cause investigation, and corrective action.
• Establish clear ownership and operating mechanisms for MRB, production hardware troubleshooting, and acceptance test issues across the avionics bus portfolio.
• Partner with avionics design engineering to ensure recurring production issues result in appropriate design, test, documentation, or process improvements.
• Work closely with manufacturing engineering, test engineering, quality, operations, supply chain, and program teams.
• Use production data including yield, failure trends, test escapes, cycle time, nonconformance trends, and recurring support demand to identify systemic improvement opportunities.
• Drive improvements to manufacturing test flows, troubleshooting methods, engineering documentation, and production support processes.
• Balance immediate production needs with longer-term improvements that reduce technical debt and improve scalability.
• Communicate production engineering health, technical risks, recurring issues, and recovery plans to engineering and program leadership.

A day in the life
As the Avionics NPI & Sustaining Engineering Manager, you will lead a team operating at the boundary between hardware development and production.

Your team may be resolving a production test failure, driving root cause on a recurring issue, or partnering with design or test engineering on corrective actions. You will prioritize work across multiple LRUs, remove execution gaps, and ensure production learning drives better hardware, test, and engineering processes.

About the team
The Avionics Electrical Engineering organization designs and delivers electrical hardware supporting Amazon Leo's satellite bus.

The NPI & Sustaining Engineering team is the production-facing portion of the avionics development organization. We partner with design engineering, manufacturing, test, quality, and operations to introduce new hardware into production and sustain released designs at scale.

Our team works across the avionics hardware portfolio to help ensure designs can be repeatedly built, tested, debugged, and delivered in a high-rate production environment.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or above in electrical engineering, computer engineering, or equivalent
- 7+ years of experience in hardware development, test, sustaining engineering, manufacturing engineering, or a related engineering discipline supporting complex electronic hardware products.
- 3+ years of experience in a management, engineering leadership, or team-lead function.
- Experience supporting electronic hardware across the product lifecycle from development through production.
- Experience leading root-cause investigations and corrective actions for complex electronic hardware issues.
- Experience with PCBA-level hardware, electrical test, hardware bring-up, and troubleshooting.
- Experience working across design engineering, manufacturing, test, quality, and operations organizations.
- Experience prioritizing technical work across multiple simultaneous hardware issues or products.

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree or above in electrical engineering, computer engineering, or equivalent
- Experience leading an NPI, sustaining engineering, liaison engineering, product engineering, or similar production-facing hardware organization.
- Experience supporting avionics, spacecraft, aerospace, automotive, robotics, industrial, or other high-reliability electronic hardware.
- Experience with MRB, nonconformance disposition, failure analysis, and RCCA processes.
- Experience improving manufacturing yield, test robustness, throughput, or recurring failure rates using production data.
- Experience developing or improving manufacturing test systems and test flows.
- Experience leading hardware debug spanning electrical hardware, firmware, software, test equipment, and manufacturing processes.
- Experience introducing complex electronic hardware into production.
- Experience managing technical teams responsible for multiple products or hardware configurations simultaneously.

title: Sr. Construction Manager, GES NA, Design and Construction
descriptionHtml:
As a Sr. Construction Manager within Global Engineering Services (GES) North America (NA) Design & Construction (D&C), you are Amazon's senior owner's representative responsible for the autonomous end-to-end delivery of complex construction projects — including large-scale new builds, retrofits, and expansions for sortation centers, delivery stations, and auxiliary buildings that power Amazon's logistics network.

You operate with a high degree of independence, executing day-to-day operations autonomously and routinely delivering the right outcomes with limited guidance — even when project strategy is not yet well-defined. You deliver a mix of tactical and strategic initiatives that impact multiple teams and/or geographies in support of significant business objectives. You own design oversight, external partner selection, contract negotiations, and project procurement — and you are accountable for the full performance of your external project management partners, architects, design consultants, general contractors, and subcontractors.

Beyond project delivery, you contribute to developing Amazon's internal and external construction networks, drive best practices across the organization, and are learning to force multiply — elevating the performance of the teams and partners around you. You write effective narratives and present complex decisions and trade-offs to Directors and VPs. You actively recruit, mentor, and develop other construction managers.

This role requires approximately 60% regional travel within North America, with potential travel to all North America locations based on business needs.

Key job responsibilities
Safety & Compliance
- Own and enforce Amazon's safety programs and standards across all internal and external project teams; set the standard for safety culture on complex projects
- Lead negotiations with Authorities Having Jurisdiction (AHJ) and regulatory bodies for permitting, regulatory compliance, and approvals
- Proactively identify and eliminate safety and compliance risks before they become project roadblocks

Project & Construction Management
- Oversee end-to-end project management services, design services, and external partner performance for complex projects; contribute to significantly complex projects as part of a team
- Serve as Amazon's senior owner's representative — the primary integrator between construction execution, design, and internal Amazon stakeholders across operations, equipment, IT, and facilities
- Develop project strategies and ensure appropriate resources are allocated to execute in accordance with those strategies
- Oversee design and engineering of complex projects, including design evaluations, design conformance reviews, and value engineering assessments
- Monitor project performance metrics, anticipate roadblocks and risks, manage escalations, and ensure corrective actions are taken
- Resolve complex issues and find a path forward in difficult situations; make trade-off decisions between short-term and long-term needs and defend those decisions to internal stakeholders
- Assess project performance through KPIs for safety, quality, cost, schedule, and sustainability; develop measurable targets and verifiable milestones

Budget, Schedule & Contract Management
- Own project budgets and oversee spend approvals across all assigned projects
- Lead external partner selection, contract negotiations, and project procurement functions
- Review, analyze, and approve or challenge cost and time change requests submitted by external project teams
- Review project requests against business need; provide approvals or recommend alternate solutions
- Ensure contracts are fit for purpose, cost-effective, and incorporate appropriate service level agreements

External Partner & Stakeholder Management
- Align delivery from external project managers, architects, design consultants, general contractors, and subcontractors in line with Amazon priorities
- Hold external project managers accountable for timely accomplishment of deliverables; provide guidance and escalate as needed
- Support crucial relationships and lead negotiations of agreements with customers, suppliers, and external partners
- Collaborate with internal teams and influence them to decouple from dependencies; eliminate risks to innovation or customer satisfaction before they become roadblocks
- Partner with teams responsible for facility transition, base building management, and turnover documentation
- Contribute to developing Amazon's internal and external construction networks

Communication & Reporting
- Manage construction meetings effectively; drive detailed discussions and achieve high-level alignment and consensus across increasingly diverse stakeholder groups (legal, regulatory, operations, engineering, finance, external industry groups, etc.)
- Write effective narratives and present complex decisions, trade-offs, and potential solutions to Directors and VPs
- Communicate budgets, schedules, project status, and priorities clearly to internal teams and external partners
- Maintain clear, concise, and transparent communication across all project stakeholders

Process Improvement, Best Practices & People Development
- Drive continuous improvement and create sustainable, repeatable processes and playbooks for the team and region
- Drive efficiencies, streamline workflows, and mitigate excess process and risk
- Learn to force multiply — drive adoption of best practices and elevate the performance of teams and partners
- Recommend improvements to the way projects are scoped, built, tested, and deployed across the region or organization
- Actively recruit, mentor, and develop other construction managers within your organization and location

A day in the life
Each day, you operate as Amazon's senior owner's representative — autonomously driving the safe, on-time, and on-budget delivery of complex construction projects across your region. Your day may include:
- Reviewing design documents and providing strategic direction to engineering and design partners on complex projects
- Leading negotiations with general contractors, developers, or regulatory authorities
- Presenting project status, risks, and trade-off decisions to senior leadership
- Monitoring project performance metrics and driving corrective actions with external partners
- Collaborating with internal stakeholders across operations, equipment, IT, and facilities on project integration and handover planning
- Developing or updating process playbooks based on lessons learned from current projects
- Conducting site visits to verify construction quality, safety compliance, and schedule adherence

About the team
At Amazon, the GES NA D&C team is a diverse group of engineers, construction managers, and preconstruction professionals who deliver the physical infrastructure behind Amazon's logistics network. We are employee owners who take pride in delivering high-quality, innovative facilities — on time and on budget — for our internal customers and the communities we serve. We are committed to being Earth's best employer and to building a more sustainable future through every project we deliver.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Architecture, Construction Management, Engineering, or a related field
- 7+ years of experience as an Architect, Engineer, Construction Manager, or in a related construction discipline
- 7+ years of project management experience spanning design phase through construction completion and operational handover
- 7+ years of experience negotiating construction, procurement, and/or labor contracts
- 7+ years of proficiency with AutoCAD and/or Building Information Modeling (BIM), and scheduling software (Primavera, MS Project, or similar)

Preferred qualifications

- Experience managing complex, large-scale construction projects ($100M+) end-to-end with full budget and design ownership
- Experience across multiple disciplines within the construction industry (e.g., General Contracting, Owner's Representation, Commercial Development, Engineering & Design)
- Demonstrated success leading contract negotiations and managing external partner performance across concurrent projects
- Experience developing and implementing construction processes, playbooks, or best practice frameworks
- Experience mentoring and developing junior construction professionals
- Demonstrated ability to communicate complex decisions and trade-offs to senior leadership (Director/VP level)
- Project Management Professional (PMP®) certification or equivalent
- CMIT/CMAA or PMP certification or equivalent

title: Tooling Mechanical Design Engineer, Amazon Leo
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is Amazon’s low Earth orbit satellite broadband network. Its mission is to deliver fast, reliable internet to customers and communities around the world, and we’ve designed the system with the capacity, flexibility, and performance to serve a wide range of customers, from individual households to schools, hospitals, businesses, government agencies, and other organizations operating in locations without reliable connectivity.

The Tooling Engineer will support the program on path from R&D, through design validation, into production. You will develop, design, analyze, and implement custom tooling and equipment required for assembling and testing (QTP/ATP) the satellite. You will need to convert the requests from various teams into systems that are easy to use, cost effective, and accurate. In addition, you will be responsible for project management, cost estimate and scheduling. You will manage and support fabrication, testing and commissioning of the tooling into manufacturing.

This is a fast-paced, intellectually challenging position, and you'll work with leaders in multiple technology areas. You'll have relentlessly high standards for yourself and everyone you work with, and you'll be constantly looking for ways to improve your product's performance, quality and cost. We want individuals who are ready for this challenge and want to reach beyond what is possible today.

Everyone on the team needs to be entrepreneurial, wear many hats and work in a highly collaborative environment. We will need to tackle problems that span a variety of domains.

Key job responsibilities
The Tooling Engineer position involves:
- Leading satellite tool development throughout the product lifecycle
- Designing and implementing assembly and test equipment
- Converting technical needs into user-friendly solutions
- Overseeing projects, timelines, and costs

This role demands:
- Strong performance in a dynamic environment
- Excellence in quality and standards
- Problem-solving and innovation skills
- Team collaboration
- Flexibility to handle diverse responsibilities

Export Control Requirement:
Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.


About the team
Amazon Leo is an initiative to launch a constellation of Low Earth Orbit satellites that will provide low-latency, high-speed broadband connectivity to un-served and under-served communities around the world.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering or equivalent
- 4+ years of working in mechanical engineering or equivalent experience
- 1+ years of project management, including resource planning, managing schedules, reporting project status and prioritizing tasks experience
- 3+ years of experience with CAD Design of complex systems including 3D modeling, drawings, and GD&T
- 1+ years of experience of structural analysis including hand calculations and Finite Element Analysis

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in the design of complex mechanical products and equipment at volume
- Experience designing material handling equipment that interfaces with aircraft
- Experience communicating to senior management and customers verbally and in writing
- Strong background in the design of mechanism, bolted and welded structures, assembly fixtures, alignment fixtures, test fixtures, rigging, and material handling
- Strong knowledge of mechanical engineering fundamentals
- Design analysis experience with stiffness/strength, structural dynamics, weldments, and bolted structures.
- Practical knowledge of manufacturing processes and materials used in assembly tooling
- Demonstrated ability to apply critical thinking in complex situations
- Experience with NX 3D modeling package and Simcenter 3D FEA simulation.
- Formal training/certification in Operational Excellence Systems (Lean, 55, Six Sigma, etc.) a plus

title: Brand Designer, Brand Innovation Lab
descriptionHtml:
Have you ever wanted to see your design work come to life across one of the world’s largest advertising canvases? At Amazon Ads’ Brand Innovation Lab, you’ll create and deliver brand-focused digital and physical experiences across Amazon.com. This role also puts working with experienced creatives to bring ambitious, first-of-their-kind ideas to life across Amazon-owned properties, devices, and external platforms.

We’re looking for a customer-obsessed Brand Designer who leads with craft, strong conceptual thinking, and a passion for beautifully executed visual design. Your day-to-day work will include designing, building, and maintaining custom landing pages of the highest craft, brand experiences, banners, presentations, and other campaign assets. Other responsibilities will include contributing to larger integrated campaigns spanning commercial film, products and packaging, Prime Video, Fire TV, Alexa, Twitch, live experiences, social, and emerging AI-driven media.

As part of a multidisciplinary creative team, you’ll work closely with Design Directors, Art Directors, Creative Directors, Design Technologists, Producers, Copywriters, and Strategists—developing concepts, comps, prototypes, design systems, and production-ready assets while learning new tools, techniques, and workflows along the way.

The ideal candidate combines strong graphic design fundamentals with curiosity and a willingness to learn. They understand how to create thoughtful visual solutions, work within and evolve design systems, and maintain a high level of craft across everything they produce.



Key job responsibilities
Create exceptional visual design solutions across digital, motion, print, presentation, environmental, and campaign identity systems.

Develop compelling creative concepts and polished campaign executions that elevate the creative standard across the Brand Innovation Lab.

Apply expert knowledge of typography, composition, color, hierarchy, visual storytelling, and brand systems to every project.

Design scalable creative systems, templates, and assets that adapt seamlessly across multiple channels and campaign formats.

Collaborate with Creative Directors, Design Directors, Art Directors, Copywriters, Design Technologists, and Producers to bring ambitious ideas to life.

Produce motion graphics, light animation, compositing, and video assets in support of integrated advertising campaigns.

Leverage generative AI tools for image and video creation as part of modern creative workflows while applying strong creative judgment and traditional design craft.

Present work confidently to internal stakeholders and clients, articulating design rationale and creative decisions.

Contribute visual concepts, prototypes, mockups, and presentation materials that help win new business opportunities.

Continuously explore new tools, workflows, and technologies that improve creative quality, efficiency, and innovation.

A day in the life
You might…

Create, build, or update web-first digital experiences and media assets across Amazon.com, including custom landing pages and banners, using tools such as Figma and Webflow.

Create 360° campaign assets and design collateral across products and packaging, film, Prime Video, Fire TV, Amazon.com, Alexa, Twitch, live experiences, and social media.

Partner with the Design Director to build design systems, templates, and tools that scale across dozens of deliverables and teams while maintaining a consistent visual language.

Support in creating motion graphics and AI-assisted video content, while learning emerging AI and traditional production workflows.

Support creative and strategy teams by developing design concepts, comps, demos, prototypes, and presentation visuals that help bring ideas to life from pitch through production.

Brand Innovation Lab within Amazon Ads creates one-of-a-kind campaigns and activations for global advertisers including Pepsi, Microsoft, Adidas, Samsung, and Unilever.

By tapping into the full Amazon canvas — including Twitch, Prime Video, Alexa, Amazon.com, and more — we create digital and physical experiences that reach millions of customers across the ways they watch, shop, play, and engage.

We believe innovation happens when exceptional craft meets bold ideas, curiosity, and new technology.

- Experience in visual design expertise with ability to produce fresh, simple, elegant and exceedingly usable layouts and interactions and iconography
- Knowledge of design principles (Typography, Composition, Scale, and Color Theory amongst other) and working knowledge of how those principles work together
- Experience working with fast-moving, high-performance teams and driving innovative solutions tailored to unique business environments
- Experience working on multi-team, cross-disciplinary projects
- 3+ years of design experience
- Ability to develop thoughtful visual solutions, design systems, and creative innovations that solve business problems, strengthen offerings, and elevate the quality of the work.
- Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining exceptional attention to detail and craft.

Preferred qualifications

- Knowledge of Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, Flash, and other design tools at an advanced level
- Knowledge of presentations and whiteboarding skills with a high degree of comfort speaking with internal and external executives, IT management, and developers
- Have an online portfolio demonstrating strong visual design skills and advertising experience across a range of media and platforms, along with work that reflects your design process
- Advanced experience designing digital ads and experiences in Figma and as well as building them in Webflow.

title: Infrastructure TPM, Infra Capacity Delivery
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

We’re seeking an experienced Infrastructure Technical Program Manager in Herndon or Arlington, VA to oversee data center build projects in the Northern Virginia region. You will lead cross-functional and technical teams from conceptual design feasibility through requirements, budget, completed design, implementation, testing, and deployment. Along the way, you will use your judgment, negotiation skills, ability to influence without authority, analytical talent, technical aptitude, and leadership to collaborate with a diverse set of stakeholders across multiple time zones, manage capital budgets, eliminate non-value-add activity, design solutions, remove blockers, and find creative ways to accelerate project delivery.

The candidate must be comfortable managing remote project delivery teams, and possess the ability to facilitate technical whiteboard sessions to troubleshoot project implementation issues, and remove barriers to project success. Being able to stand up cross-functional teams, establish trust with a variety of stakeholders across multiple time zones, manage capital budgets, eliminate non-value-add activity, design solutions, remove blockers, and find creative ways to accelerate project delivery is a must.

The ideal candidate will be an exceptionally strong communicator, both written and verbally, and possess experience in tactical project management of highly technical initiatives, as well as strategic program management. They will be able to apply a variety of project management tools, methodologies and techniques for all phases of the project lifecycle and exhibit demonstrated experience in core project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, resources, quality and risk management, reporting and metric development/tracking. Experience with MS Project, Asana, Tableau, and systems integration a plus.

The candidate will work through ambiguity, competing priorities, and be capable of understanding mechanical/electrical engineering concepts. Experience in managing data center infrastructure deployments is a plus. Candidates possessing a background in architecture/design, mechanical/electrical engineering, software/hardware engineering, data center infrastructure/operations, and/or construction, who have transitioned to a program management discipline will have a distinct advantage.

title: ID - Rack Lifecycle Tech , Rack Lifecycle Team
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Job Summary
We are looking for a detail-oriented, technically skilled Rack Lifecycle Tech to join our Rack Lifecycle Team within AWS Infrastructure Operations. In this individual contributor role, you will be a hands-on executor responsible for the physical installation, cabling, handoff, and decommissioning of racks across your assigned data center site. You are the person on the floor who turns capacity plans into operational reality.

As a Rack Lifecycle Tech, you will execute structured cabling, rack installation, and decommission activities with precision and to standard — following established SOPs, escalating deviations to your team lead, and ensuring every rack you touch is installed correctly, cabled to specification, fully documented, and handed off with zero blockers. This is an individual contributor role with no people management responsibilities.
Your work is foundational to AWS’s ability to deliver infrastructure capacity to customers reliably, safely, and at the lowest possible cost.


Key job responsibilities
🔷 Rack Installation & Cabling
- Execute rack installations including physical placement, power connections, grounding, and cable management per AWS standards and MOPs
- Perform structured cabling including fiber/copper terminations, patch panel connections, labeling, and dressing to specification
- Complete OTDR and power testing; validate results against acceptance thresholds; escalate failures to team lead promptly rather than self-resolving outside approved procedures
- Follow all EHS protocols, lockout/tagout (LOTO) procedures, and safe work practices during installation activities
🔷 Rack Lifecycle Operations
- Execute work orders and tasks assigned by the Rack Lifecycle Team Manager under direct manager direction, maintaining accurate status updates in workflow management tools (e.g., Boost, MARS)
- Perform quality checks on completed cabling work including port map verification, label accuracy, and as-built documentation updates in CMDB/DCIM
- Identify and escalate issues, blockers, or deviations from SOPs encountered during task execution to the team lead or manager promptly; do not self-resolve outside approved procedures
- Support deployment wave readiness by participating in pre-work site walks, material staging, and tool preparation
🔷 Material Handling & Supply Chain Support
- Receive, verify, and stage incoming rack, cable, optics, and hardware deliveries; validate against BOM and flag discrepancies
- Maintain accurate site inventory records for cables, optics, patch cords, and consumables used during deployments
- Support cycle count activities and assist in identifying inventory shortfalls that may impact deployment timelines
🔷 Handover & Documentation
- Complete all required as-built documentation, port maps, test result records, and workflow sign-offs before handoff to Data Center Operations
- Update CMDB/DCIM and IPAM records accurately following rack installation or decommission activities
- Ensure handoffs are clean and fully documented with zero open blockers, enabling smooth transition to the next lifecycle phase
🔷 Rack Decommissioning
- Execute physical decommission activities per assigned MOPs — including cable removal, power disconnects, asset de-tagging, and rack extraction
- Perform device wipe and media destruction in compliance with AWS Secure Media Destruction and EHS policies
- Sort, label, and stage recovered assets (optics, cables, PDUs, hardware) for RMA, redeployment, or secure disposal per AWS Reverse Logistics policy
- Update DCIM/CMDB, IPAM, and port maps post-decom to ensure accurate space, power, and circuit records
- Validate that reclaimed U-space, power, and cooling capacity is accurately recorded in the available pool
🔷 Quality, Safety & Compliance
- Adhere to all site-level SOPs, quality standards, and governance frameworks for cabling, installation, and decommission activities
- Complete all required safety training and certifications; participate in regular EHS audits and team safety briefings
- Contribute to continuous improvement by identifying recurring quality issues, suggesting process improvements, and sharing feedback with the Rack Lifecycle Team Manager
- Use Rack Lifecycle Team tooling (e.g., Boost, MARS, ALM/DCLM) accurately to record work, track assets, and maintain data integrity
🔷 Cross-Team Coordination
- Support coordination with DCO, DCEO, Network Engineering, and facilities teams during active deployment or decom activities under manager guidance to ensure smooth execution
- Participate in daily stand-ups and pre-work briefings; communicate clearly on task status, blockers, and schedule adherence
- Provide accurate, timely updates on task completion and flag risks or delays to the team lead immediately
🔷 Continuous Learning & Development
- Maintain and develop technical proficiency in structured cabling, fiber optics, rack installation, and data center physical infrastructure
- Complete required certifications and training modules including EHS, LOTO, and any Rack Lifecycle Team-specific technical programs
- Proactively seek feedback from leads and managers to improve personal performance and output quality
- Support the onboarding and training of new team members; share knowledge and best practices with peers to build overall team capability and quality standards
- Stay current on AWS infrastructure tooling, cabling standards, and process updates communicated by the Rack Lifecycle Team


A day in the life
As a Rack Lifecycle Tech, your day is on the data center floor. You might start the morning by reviewing your assigned work orders in Boost, checking in with your team lead on priorities, and staging cables and optics for a rack installation wave. By midday, you could be terminating fiber runs at a patch panel, running OTDR tests to validate loss results against acceptance thresholds, or labeling and dressing a freshly installed rack. In the afternoon, you might be updating CMDB records for completed work orders, de-tagging and staging recovered assets from an EOL decom, or helping onboard a new technician by walking them through the SOP. If you encounter a deviation from the approved MOP, you escalate it to your team lead immediately — you don't improvise. Your role is hands-on, technical, and precise — you execute the work that keeps AWS capacity on track.

This is an opportunity to make history with one of the world's largest and most innovative companies, shaping the future of operations and logistics.

Key job responsibilities
Operational Leadership: Oversee daily operations within both AMZL and FC environments, including managing teams of Operations Assistants, Delivery Service Providers, and Associates (ranging from approximately 30-40). This includes allocating labor, leading meetings, assigning job duties, and maintaining exceptional organizational skills.
Team Management: Lead, train, and develop high-performing teams. Foster a positive and motivating work environment, driving engagement and performance while ensuring associate safety and adherence to Amazon's Health and Safety standards.
Performance Management: Be obsessed with metrics, diving deep to identify root causes of performance issues, and implementing effective solutions. Continuously monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) and drive improvements across both AMZL and FC processes.
Process Improvement: Identify opportunities to streamline and improve processes. Find practical and simple solutions to complex problems without compromising quality or functionality. Utilize problem-solving and analytical skills to drive Dive Deep analyses and implement process enhancements. Become a subject matter expert on core operational processes.
Communication & Collaboration: Communicate daily metrics and report exceptions. Effectively communicate with business and technical audiences, influencing decisions and driving alignment. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to solve operational challenges and share best practices. Manage external agency relationships and performance.

title: 2027 MBA Pathways Full-time Operations Manager (Canada-Wide Opportunities)
descriptionHtml:
Launch your career with Amazon by solving complex operational challenges that impact millions of customers worldwide. As an Operations Manager in our Pathways Program — designed for recent MBA or Master's grads ready to make an immediate impact — you'll lead cross-functional teams, manage people, processes, and technology, and drive continuous improvement across one of the most innovative operations environments globally. From Day 1, you'll work on real business challenges, optimizing operations, enhancing the customer experience, and implementing scalable solutions across our global network. This is your opportunity to develop strategic leadership capabilities while building expertise in one of the world's most complex operational environments.

PROGRAM OVERVIEW:
Pathways is Amazon's three-year Operations Leadership Development Program, designed to cultivate the next generation of senior operations leadership at Amazon. Participants will gain high visibility with senior executives while tackling challenging assignments across diverse sites, technologies, and geographies within our world-class operations network. Day to day, participants will collaborate with cross-functional teams to solve complex operational challenges, take on progressively greater responsibilities, and work on real business initiatives that directly impact our operations. Along the way, participants will learn from experienced leaders, participate in cohort-based learning sessions, and build a network of peers who will become their professional community throughout their career at Amazon. This program is designed to build global leadership capabilities and prepare participants for executive-level impact.

- Please note that this posting is for opportunities in Canada only. Ideal candidates are students or recent graduates of an MBA or Master's program in Canada. Students interested in US-based opportunities should apply directly that posting.
- This program is open to external candidates only; current Amazon employees are not eligible to apply. The role appears on Amazon's internal portal solely for employee referral purposes.
- Candidates should be currently enrolled in an MBA or Master's program, or have graduated from one within the past 24 months.
- This role is for Pathways positions at Amazon operations facilities across Canada. Successful candidates will work with their recruiter to be matched to a site prior to receiving an offer.
- Candidates who apply to multiple Amazon MBA roles will only be selected to interview for one.
- Annual Pathways cohorts start between January and July. This application is for opportunities with start dates in 2027.

WHAT TO EXPECT:
Pathways graduates may lead organizations of nearly 4,000 people, manage labor budgets exceeding $2.5 million per week, and oversee $1B+ in capital projects. Here's how the program gets you there:

Step 1: Area Manager - Hit the ground running by leading 50–100 associates on the front lines of one of Amazon's world-class fulfillment, sortation, or delivery centers. This is where you'll build your operational foundation — learning how to lead people and systems at scale.

Step 2: Operations Manager - Take on greater responsibility by leading and developing other managers. You'll drive process improvements and collaborate cross-functionally across your site, region, and network.

Step 3: Senior Operations Manager - Graduate from the program as a senior leader known for operational excellence. In this role, you'll lead through others to execute regional or network-level initiatives — whether that's launching a new business, leading a major project, or running an entire site.

SITE PLACEMENT & EXPECTED HOURS:
- Must be willing to relocate within Canada at time of hire. Placement is driven primarily by business need, with consideration given to individual location preferences.
- The role is based in one of Amazon's operations facilities across Canada, including fulfillment centers, sort centers, delivery stations, Amazon Air, return centers, or other warehouse environments. Successful candidates will work with their recruiter to be matched to a site prior to receiving an offer.
- This is a demanding, hands-on role where hours may vary based on seasonal peaks and operational needs. Candidates should expect to work weekends, holidays, and/or overnight shifts, with overtime as needed.

COMPENSATION:
Total compensation for Pathways Operations includes three elements: (1) Base pay, (2) Sign-on bonus (paid over first two years), (3) Restricted Stock Units (RSUs).


Key job responsibilities
- Lead, coach, and develop your team, fostering a culture of accountability, growth, high performance, and customer obsession
- Partner with senior leadership to identify and solve complex business and operational challenges, thinking both strategically and tactically
- Drive continuous improvement initiatives by analyzing operational data, identifying inefficiencies, and implementing scalable solutions
- Make real-time decisions in a fast-paced environment, balancing competing priorities to meet safety, quality, and productivity goals
- Collaborate cross-functionally with technology, engineering, and supply chain teams to improve end-to-end processes

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of professional or military experience
- Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining, a MBA or equivalent Master's level education degree
- Work flexible hours as business demands, including overnight, weekends and holidays

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of professional work (non-internship) experience
- Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining, an MBA in supply chain management, operations, engineering, analytics, or a related field
- Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining, a Master of Engineering degree in one of the following disciplines: Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial, Systems, or Computer Engineering
- Bachelor's degree in an engineering discipline, particularly Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial, Systems, or Computer Engineering

title: Installation Technician
descriptionHtml:
Transform network infrastructure by joining our dynamic team! You'll be at the forefront of developing innovative solutions that drive network stability and scalability, using your technical expertise to create automated systems that power global technological advancement.

Infra Delivery Install Technicians will collaborate with cross-functional teams, troubleshoot complex technical scenarios, and implement strategic solutions that keep our network running seamlessly. Expect to engage in hands-on technical work that requires creativity, precision, and a passion for technological innovation.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

NOTE: Amazon does not sponsor for immigration, including for H-1B, TN, and other non-immigrant visas, for this role.

NOTE: Lump sum stipend will be provided to eligible candidates who relocate for this position.

Key job responsibilities
Key job responsibilities
- Moving and implementing large enterprise equipment
- Installing Fiber and Copper cabling and patching cabling between equipment
- Ensuring proper safety and security standards are maintained during cabling and rack installation,
- Following well established hardware installation procedures and break-fix activities
- Safely using material handling tools and equipment
- Traveling within and outside of the regional work area is required. You will be responsible for having a reliable personal vehicle and valid driver's license to travel within the regional work area, as company transportation will not be provided

Physical Requirements:
- Regularly lift and/or move up to 40 pounds; and participate in group lifts for 41+ pounds
- Ability to work in an environment that operates 24/7 with an ability to participate in primary responder rotation and provide after-hours support as needed
- Working in cramped and/or elevated and/or noisy environments
- Bending, lifting, stretching, reaching, standing and walking for up to 8+ hours a day
- Ascending and descending ladders, stairs, and gangways safely and without limitation

This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.

Essential Requirements:
- Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed
- Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational
- Travel frequency will vary based on business needs and operational status of assigned facility

Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs.

Basic qualifications

- 1+ years of Computer Hardware Repair, Infrastructure Cabling, Network Deployment, or Data Center Operations experience, or experience in similar technical or vocational roles
- High school diploma or equivalent

Preferred qualifications

- industry standard certification (CompTIA, CCENT, or Network+)
- Experience with cabling infrastructure best practices and methodologies
- Knowledge of network cabling, optic types, and test equipment

title: Junior Treasury Dealer, Trading
descriptionHtml:
Amazon seeks a Junior Treasury Dealer to join the Treasury Strategy and Markets Team, which oversees global foreign exchange trading, commodities, and equities execution. This role provides an opportunity to work alongside experienced traders at the center of Amazon's trading operations, where you will assist in the execution and management of multi-asset class trading strategies across FX, equities, and commodities markets.

As a supporting member of the team, you will help leverage trading platforms and analytics to support efficient execution by senior dealers while learning best-in-class trading practices. The successful candidate should be eager to learn, comfortable with ambiguity, and capable of balancing multiple competing priorities in a fast-paced market environment. You will support the development of relationships with key banking counterparties and work cross-functionally across Amazon's diverse business lines to help meet the company's global trading needs.

This position requires a motivated individual who will assist in continuously improving Treasury processes while maintaining a rigorous control environment and compliance with various Amazon policies.


Key job responsibilities
- Execution Support: Assist senior traders in executing foreign exchange, equity, and commodity trades to support Amazon's global business operations
- Market Monitoring: Support real-time monitoring of market conditions, liquidity, and pricing across multiple venues and counterparties to help ensure optimal execution
- Reporting & Analytics: Create, maintain, and distribute detailed reports that track the performance of execution metrics, including fill rates, rejection rates, and price improvements against internal KPIs
- Transaction Cost Analysis: Assist in conducting regular Transaction Cost Analysis (TCA) to help optimize trading performance and identify areas for improvement
- Trading Dashboard Maintenance: Help design and maintain trading dashboards that provide real-time visibility into execution performance, market conditions, and liquidity metrics
- Counterparty Coordination: Support the management of relationships with key liquidity providers, including helping to compile data for periodic counterparty performance reviews
- Settlement & Operations: Monitor trade settlement processes and assist in resolving any trading-related issues with counterparties in a timely manner
- Process Documentation: Develop and maintain standard operating procedures for trading activities across all asset classes, ensuring documentation remains current and accurate
- Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work with internal groups including Global Payments, Finance Operations, and Technology teams on trading infrastructure improvements and day-to-day operational needs
- Technology & Automation Support: Collaborate with technology teams to help enhance trading platforms, support API connectivity testing, and assist in automating execution processes
- Research: Stay current with market developments, regulatory changes, and new trading technologies that could impact execution strategies, and summarize findings for the broader team
- Compliance Support: Assist in regular reviews of execution policies and procedures to ensure compliance with internal and external requirements
- Ad-Hoc Support: Provide general support to the FX trading organization, including assisting with ad-hoc analysis, preparing materials for management presentations, and contributing to team projects as needed

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of tax, finance or a related analytical field experience
- 4+ years of Accounts Receivable or Account Payable experience
- 4+ years of applying key financial performance indicators (KPIs) to analyses experience
- 4+ years of creating process improvements with automation and analysis experience
- 4+ years of identifying, leading, and executing opportunities to improve, automate, standardize or simplify finance or business tools and processes experience
- Bachelor's degree in engineering, statistics or business, or Bachelor's degree and 5+ years of quantitative role (engineering, process re-engineering, quality assurance) experience
- Experience with advanced use of SQL for data mining and business intelligence
- Experience as a lean sensei, or experience working as a Quality Assurance Engineer

Preferred qualifications

- 4+ years of participating in continuous improvement projects in your team to scale and improve controllership with measurable results experience
- MBA, or CPA
- Knowledge of Tableau
- Experience working with large-scale data mining and reporting tools (examples: SQL, MS Access, Essbase, Cognos) and other financial systems (examples: Oracle, SAP, Lawson, JD Edwards)

title: Sr. GenAI & ML Specialist Solutions Architect, ASPI Auto & Manufacturing
descriptionHtml:
Are you a customer-obsessed builder passionate about helping customers achieve their full potential? Do you have the business acumen and technical pre-sales expertise to help customers evaluate, design, and adopt AWS as their strategic platform for Generative AI and ML workloads? Do you enjoy building impactful AI solutions? Join the Worldwide Specialist Organization (WWSO) within the Data & AI Specialists team for Automotive & Manufacturing as a Senior Generative AI & ML Specialist Solutions Architect—a senior individual contributor role requiring deep technical expertise and executive-level customer engagement.
The Worldwide Specialist Organization (WWSO) is part of the AWS Specialists and Partners organization, responsible for driving revenue and accelerating adoption of cloud and partner services across private and public sector customers. We work backwards from our customers’ most complex and business-critical challenges to develop and execute go-to-market plans that transform ideas into scalable, high-impact businesses. WWSO teams include business development specialists and technical solution architects. As part of WWSO, you will contribute across the full lifecycle of AWS customer initiatives—from shaping new service and solution concepts to accelerating adoption of established offerings. We pride ourselves on thinking big, delivering exceptional customer outcomes, and collaborating seamlessly across AWS as #OneTeam.


Key job responsibilities
In this role, you will translate customer business challenges into solutions leveraging AWS. You will define, design, and deploy targeted architectures that accelerate adoption of AWS Generative AI and ML services. You will engage with senior engineers, architects, product leaders, data scientists, and executives at strategic enterprise customers to influence architectural decisions and provide structured feedback to AWS product teams.
AWS collaborates with a range of partners in the AI ecosystem—including leading third-party foundation model providers (e.g., Anthropic, Meta, Mistral, etc.). You will execute joint go-to-market motions with these partners and build proof-of-concepts for AI- and agent-enabled applications.
As the ideal candidate, you bring a deep technical background and the business acumen required to lead complex engagements with large enterprises. You have hands-on expertise in traditional ML concepts as well as emerging areas such as LLMs, RAG, fine-tuning, AI system evaluation, prompt engineering, agents, and AIOps. You are able to credibly advise senior technical and executive stakeholders on architectural trade-offs, risks, and long-term strategy.

Core Responsibilities:
- Collaborate with business development colleagues to provide technical input into go-to-market strategy and support field marketing through technical events, campaigns, and customer engagements

- Lead complex technical problem solving to unblock customers’ most critical workloads

- Represent the voice of the customer and collaborate with field and central teams to bring customer feedback to product teams

- Act as a thought leader in Generative AI by sharing best practices through AWS blogs, whitepapers, reference architectures, code samples, and public speaking engagements such as AWS Summits and AWS re:Invent

- Guide and support an internal AWS community of technical subject matter experts aligned to your customers, including the creation of field enablement materials for the broader Solution Architect population

title: Sr. Production Operations Manager, Live Sports Production
descriptionHtml:
Come be a part of Amazon's dynamic Live Sports Production team. We are looking for an experienced Sr. Production Operations Manager who brings both strategic business acumen and hands-on production expertise to own the end-to-end lifecycle of multiple live sports properties, from initial financial modeling and vendor strategy through boots-on-the-ground execution.

In this role, you will serve as the centralized operational lead for your assigned properties, driving strategic planning across the full project lifecycle. You will lead financial modeling, shape vendor strategy, and manage engagement with third-party Production Service Partners (PSPs), coordinating backend functions including crewing, payroll, travel, and production accounting while maintaining Amazon's operational standards and ensuring productions launch on time and on budget.

Equally critical is your ability to deliver on the ground. You will work in lockstep with internal crewing, editorial, and technical workstreams to ensure each event or studio show is properly resourced, and will partner directly with PSPs to establish best practices, define operational standards, and ensure alignment across the vendor landscape. You will drive production readiness across all operational workstreams, ensuring each event is prepared for a clean launch and seamless restart.

This role requires deep knowledge of remote, event, and studio production operations, including broadcast positions, industry standard rates, vendor engagement models, and production service agreements. You will be responsible for issue spotting, driving decision making, and escalating matters that carry risk to the Global Head of Production Operations. Our production operation is purpose-built around the needs of an expanding, multi-sport live portfolio rather than modeled after a traditional broadcast network structure. We are defining and building as we evolve, and this person must be excited to roll up their sleeves and help establish the systems, relationships, and workflows that will scale with us.

The successful candidate is a self-starter who thrives in an entrepreneurial environment. You can juggle competing priorities across multiple productions with autonomy, react with urgency when situations demand immediate attention, and bring a proven track record of end-to-end ownership in a fast-paced, evolving business.

Key job responsibilities
• End-to-End Property Lifecycle Management: Own and manage the full project lifecycle for assigned properties, from projected business scope and production roadmap development, through execution and ongoing supervision of day-to-day live event and studio production, to post-mortem and financial reconciliation. Develop milestones, launch schedules, and workback timelines to ensure successful delivery of property launches and season restarts. Lead property transition planning for returning seasons, ensuring operational continuity, vendor re-engagement, and incorporation of prior-season learnings into the restart roadmap.

• Business Strategy and Vendor Management: Develop a deep understanding of organizational business objectives and production priorities to drive vendor evaluation, selection, and strategic recommendations that optimize cost, quality, and scalability across assigned properties. Shepherd the vendor selection process through RFPs and serve as the primary point of contact for vendors defining scope of work, deliverables, and engagement standards. Partner with Legal and Production Finance on contract terms, rate frameworks, and commercial agreements, and monitor vendor performance to ensure accountability against operational standards.

• Budget and Financial Management: Create and manage production budgets from initial scoping through execution. Work closely with Production Finance to track and reconcile all production costs, ensuring external vendors and the production team are aware of overall spend. Coordinate fee reconciliation and payment processing with third-party vendors to ensure accuracy and timeliness. Lead regular financial status updates to senior leadership, flagging variances and recommending corrective action.

• Crewing Coordination via PSPs: Ensure assigned properties are properly staffed by coordinating crew deployment through third-party vendors. Establish consistent frameworks for how Above-The-Line (ATL) and Below-The-Line (BTL) personnel are engaged across productions. Partner with the centralized crewing function to maintain visibility into crew availability, prevent scheduling conflicts, and ensure alignment with creative and editorial vision. Support rate structure consistency and market-competitive positioning across comparable roles.

• On-Site Event Operations and Health & Safety: Oversee on-site event production operations, including venue logistics and coordination with league and arena broadcast groups. Ensure Health & Safety protocols and risk management standards are maintained across all production environments. Work with vendors and internal teams to identify and mitigate operational risks in advance of air, and maintain contingency plans for live production scenarios.

• Labor and Workforce Compliance: Navigate both union and non-union production environments. Ensure third-party PSPs adhere to all applicable labor regulations and collective bargaining agreements. Work closely with Amazon's internal legal and labor teams to stay current on regulatory requirements, workforce compliance standards, and crew classification guidelines across domestic and international markets. Advise on compliance considerations as they arise, including jurisdictional rules and engagement terms.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Collaborate with Amazon teams including Editorial Production, Technical Operations, Business Development, Production Finance, Accounting, and Legal to operationalize properties and drive synergy. Align regularly with production teams across regions to share best practices and integrate new learnings. Support the Global Head of Production Ops in implementing operational strategy across all Prime Video Live Sports properties.

• Escalation and Risk Management: Proactively identify issues and blockers, providing timely solutions to resolve them. Exercise sound judgment in issue spotting and decision making, escalating to senior leadership when matters carry risk or require broader organizational alignment. Lead regular status updates on project timelines, budgets, and production readiness.

• Operational Process Improvement and Scalability: Seek continuous improvements in execution of existing productions. Recommend changes to operational strategy, seek alignment with stakeholders, and implement at regular intervals. Own and leverage internal production management tools to maintain full visibility into productions, track resource deployment, and surface issues. Contribute to frameworks, SOPs, and systems that enable the team to scale with increasing property volume and complexity.

About the team
The Production Operations team is responsible for delivering high-quality event and studio productions on all global live sports properties to Prime Video customers worldwide. We drive production excellence through purpose-built processes and scalable operational frameworks that empower the team to work more efficiently and grow with increasing demand.

Basic qualifications

- 6+ years of budgeting, scheduling and cost reporting experience
- Experience as a producer, production manager, line producer or in production risk management
- 6+ years of creative role understanding consumer trends and creating content experience
- 8+ years of experience in live sports production operations, production management, or operational planning, including hands-on, boots-on-the-ground execution across remote, studio, and event productions. Proven experience managing the end-to-end lifecycle of multiple simultaneous live sports properties, from initial scoping and financial modeling through production execution and post-season reconciliation. Strong command of production processes including vendor management, budgeting, roadmap development, and complex cross-departmental problem solving at scale. Track record of working with third-party production companies, including vendor selection, rate negotiation, and contract management; experience defining service requirements and ensuring commercial terms are captured in production service agreements and statements of work. Experience with both union and non-union crew across live productions, with a working knowledge of applicable collective bargaining agreements and labor guidelines. Experience reviewing and interpreting production service agreements, statements of work, and commercial contracts, with the ability to issue-spot and escalate matters that carry risk to the broader organization

Preferred qualifications

- Experience leading large projects and facilitate group meetings
- Experience working for a production company, studio, or television network

title: Applied Scientist, Prime Video Commerce Insights
descriptionHtml:
Come build the future of entertainment with us. Are you interested in shaping the future of movies and television? Do you want to define the next
generation of how and what Amazon customers are watching?

Prime Video is a premium streaming service that offers customers a vast collection of TV shows and
movies — all with the ease of finding what they love to watch in one place. We offer customers thousands of popular movies and TV shows from Originals and Exclusive content to exciting live sports events. We also offer our members the opportunity to subscribe to add-on channels which they can cancel at anytime and to rent or buy new release movies and TV box sets on the Prime Video Store. Prime Video is a fast-paced, growth business — available in over 240 countries and territories worldwide. The team works in a dynamic environment where innovating on behalf of our customers is at the heart of everything we do. If this sounds exciting to you, please read on.

Prime Video Commerce's mission is to present the right offer to the right customer at the right time — across subscriptions, channels, and transactional video, in every market and on every device. Our science team replaces static business rules with ML-driven decisions that personalise the entire commerce journey, from discovery through checkout and beyond. We operate at scale across hundreds of millions of customers, and we are expanding into new frontiers — combining the latest advances in agentic and generative AI, behavioural simulation, and causal inference to understand the impact of our decisions before they reach customers.

We are looking for an Applied Scientist to join the Prime Video Commerce Insights team in London. You will develop and deploy customer-facing models, understand customer behaviour at scale, and explore emerging techniques that help us make better decisions faster. This is a delivery focused role within a high-visibility multidisciplinary group of engineers and scientists, focused on improving the customer experience for Prime Video.

Key job responsibilities
- Research, design, and implement machine learning approaches (e.g. reinforcement learning and recommendation systems) that personalise across different customer touch points.
- Collaborate with engineers to deploy and integrate successful experiment results into large-scale, complex Amazon production systems with low latency.
- Design and execute rigorous experiments to demonstrate the technical efficacy and business value of your methods.
- Act as a subject-matter expert and help define the science roadmap and research agenda in line with organisational priorities and production constraints.
- Provide machine learning thought leadership to technical and business leaders, thinking strategically about business, product, and technical challenges.
- Work with technical product managers to work backwards from what matters to customers and deliver ML-backed solutions.
- Share results with the team and wider scientific community through documents that are both statistically rigorous and compellingly relevant.



A day in the life
You will be a research leader and innovator within the Commerce Insights organisation. You will collaborate with talented engineers and senior leaders to solve problems that are uniquely challenging at Amazon's scale: personalising commerce decisions across multiple business lines, balancing competing objectives, and positively impacting hundreds of millions of customers worldwide. The problems here are technically deep — combining large-scale ML, causal reasoning, and behavioural modelling in a domain where every decision carries real revenue and customer-experience consequences. Your research will ship to production and move metrics that matter.

About the team
You will join a team of engineers and applied scientists with a proven track record of solving highly complex, ambiguous problems — work that has produced patents and publications at top-tier conferences. The team has direct visibility to senior Prime Video leadership and collaborates broadly across Commerce, Content, and Platform teams to shape how customers discover, subscribe to, and engage with video content. This is a team that operates at the intersection of rigorous research and real-world impact, where your ideas move from whiteboard to production for hundreds of millions of customers.

Basic qualifications

- Experience in patents or publications at top-tier peer-reviewed conferences or journals
- Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language
- Experience in any of the following areas: algorithms and data structures, parsing, numerical optimization, data mining, parallel and distributed computing, high-performance computing
- Experience in building machine learning models for business application
- PhD, or a Master's degree and experience in CS, CE, ML or related field research

Preferred qualifications

- Experience using Unix/Linux
