title: Senior Mechanical/Thermal Engineer, Network Product Development (NPD)
descriptionHtml:
This role is for a highly innovative and hands-on engineer with the ability and drive to design, analyze, and qualify the mechanical and thermal systems that power AWS's next-generation network hardware. You will own the mechanical and thermal design of network devices and racks, from identifying requirements and simulation to building prototypes and driving designs into volume production. This is a hands-on role that requires a self-starter with deep expertise in thermal management and mechanical analysis, and the ability to drive multiple design iterations while diligently converging on the simplest, most reliable, and most cost-effective solution that satisfies the requirements.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we're the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we're looking for talented people who want to help.

You'll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You'll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and reliability while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you'll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

As a Sr. Mechanical/Thermal Engineer within the Network Product Development (NPD) team, you will directly shape how AWS's network infrastructure is built and cooled — at switch, module, and rack level.

Key job responsibilities
- Identify and analyze thermal and mechanical requirements for network platforms and rack assemblies through collaboration with cross-functional disciplines (electrical, firmware, manufacturing, supply chain).
- Conceive and develop trade studies on thermal solutions — including heatsink geometries, fan curves, airflow paths, liquid cooling, and TIM selections — balancing performance, cost, and manufacturability.
- Create and iterate detailed 3D CAD models of mechanical and thermal designs — enclosures, sheet metal, heatsinks, fan assemblies, cable management, and rack mounting.
- Perform thermal simulations (CFD) and mechanical analyses (classical and FEA — static, dynamic, thermal stress, vibration, shock) for all load conditions and compliance.
- Develop test plans throughout development with variable isolation DOEs and statistical analysis for long-term reliability assessments.
- Define qualification plans and identify acceptance testing methods appropriate for volume production. - Produce complete design packages — detailed drawings, analysis reports, BOMs, and assembly documentation.
- Drive root cause analysis on field failures and work with operations to improve quality processes.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering or equivalent
- 5+ years of hardware design and validation of components, subsystems and systems experience
- Experience in 3D CAD
- 2+ years of experience working with ODM/JDM/CM suppliers in a product development environment.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience working with interdisciplinary teams to execute product design from concept to production
- Knowledge of mechanical systems in critical Data Center operations including but not limited to CRAC/CRAHs/AHUs, chillers, cooling towers, storage tanks, chemical systems, heat exchangers, piping systems, pumps, valves, duct systems, fans, or dampers
- Experience with high-power electronics cooling (network switches, servers, or similar platforms with 1000W+ components) using air and liquid cooling
- Expertise in debugging and troubleshooting mechanical and thermal issues in deployed hardware.

descriptionHtml:
Amazon Web Services is seeking a results-driven Account-Based Marketing (ABM) Manager to design and execute high-impact ABM programs for enterprise customers. This role combines strategic thinking with hands-on execution to drive measurable business outcomes through targeted marketing initiatives.

The Account-Based Marketing Manager will own the ABM strategy and end-to-end execution of territory ABM programs, working backwards from customer needs to create data-driven, multi-channel campaigns that accelerate pipeline and revenue growth. This role requires strategic marketing expertise, strong project management skills, analytical capabilities, and the ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders.

We are looking for a marketer who is intellectually curious, analytically grounded and creatively agile; someone who can navigate ambiguity, challenge conventional approaches, and build scalable solutions while maintaining the personalization required for strategic account outreach.


Key job responsibilities
* Develop account-based marketing strategies for priority enterprise customers, translating business objectives, customer insights, account priorities, and market dynamics into actionable 1:1 and 1:few marketing plans.
* Serve as a strategic marketing partner to Sales, working closely with account teams and Sales leaders to understand customer priorities, identify growth opportunities, and determine where marketing can have the greatest impact.
* Build integrated customer engagement initiatives that connect account insights, messaging, content, executive engagement, digital marketing, events, and other channels into cohesive customer experiences.
* Bring creative agility to account challenges, identifying new approaches and developing differentiated programs that engage key decision makers, buying groups, and influencers.
* Own programs from strategy through execution, establishing objectives, developing plans, coordinating cross-functional resources, managing budgets and timelines, and ensuring high-quality delivery.
* Develop account-specific content and messaging that translates account insights, business priorities and AWS capabilities into relevant narratives and assets that engage key decision makers and buying groups.
* Use data and customer intelligence to inform strategy, leveraging engagement data, buying signals, account insights, and market trends to identify opportunities and continuously optimize programs.
* Partner across AWS marketing organizations, including Global CoE, Industry, Partner, Digital, Events, and other teams, to orchestrate AWS capabilities around strategic customer opportunities.
* Identify opportunities to collaborate with AWS partners where joint engagement can strengthen customer value propositions, deepen relationships, or accelerate strategic opportunities.

* Contribute to the evolution of ABM at AWS, sharing insights, experimentation, and best practices with the broader global ABM community.

This position will be part of the Amazon Route 53 team in the Herndon, VA office. Amazon Route 53 is a highly available and scalable Domain Name System (DNS) service offered by Amazon Web Services. We operate in over 50 locations worldwide and provide advanced functionality such as Private DNS, DNS Firewall, DNS resolver and integration with a plethora of AWS services. Our service is quickly growing and we're expanding in multiple directions: adding new features and functionality to our DNS services, better traffic management, new AWS integrations, improving our health check capabilities, and expanding with new security services and routing space.

We work on deep, technical problems that span a variety of core topics in computer science ranging from databases to networking to distributed systems to numerical analysis to security. title: Business Analyst, Buyer Abuse Data Science
descriptionHtml:

Amazon runs one of the most dynamic e-commerce marketplaces in the world, with nearly 2 million sellers worldwide selling hundreds of millions of items in ten countries. BRP safeguards every financial transaction across all Amazon sites. As such, BRP designs and builds the software systems, risk models and operational processes that minimize risk and maximize trust in Amazon.com. BRP organization is looking for a Business Analyst for its Operations Analytics team. The team is being grown to provide insights about its BRP operations and provide analytical solutions to help drive operational efficiencies, uncover the hidden risks and trends, reduce investigation errors and bad debt, improve customer experience and predict & recommend the optimizations for future state of BRP operations.
As a Business Analyst, you will be responsible for modeling complex problems, discovering insights and identifying opportunities through the use of business intelligence, data mining and visualization techniques. You will need to collaborate effectively with internal stakeholders and cross-functional teams to solve problems, create operational efficiencies, and deliver successfully against high organizational standards. The candidate should be able to apply a breadth of tools, data sources and analytical techniques to answer a wide range of high-impact business questions and present the insights in concise and effective manner. Additionally, the candidate should be an effective communicator capable of independently driving issues to resolution and communicating insights to non-technical audiences. This is a high impact role with goals that directly impacts the bottom line of the business.



Key job responsibilities

- Use analytics and data mining techniques to solve complex problems and drive business decisions.

- Employ the appropriate tools, methodologies to discover patterns of risks, abuse and help reduce bad debt

- Design experiments, test hypotheses, and build actionable models to optimize BRP operations

- Solve analytical problems, and effectively communicate methodologies and results

- Build analyses for product launches and operations and help predict workflow and capacity requirements for BRP operations

- Draw inferences and conclusions, and create dashboards and visualizations of processed data, identify trends, anomalies

- Work closely with internal stakeholders such as business teams, engineering teams, and partner teams and align them with respect to your focus area

A day in the life
Pipeline Operations — Monitor and triage Datanet ETL jobs; resolve dependency timeouts, upstream delays, and schema drift; coordinate with data providers on blocked feeds; backfill data when logic changes.

Ad-Hoc Investigations — Query fraud/abuse signal tables for point-in-time analysis; investigate multi-account abuse patterns (linked accounts, ATO, concession leakage); decrypt/trace customer IDs across evaluation systems.

Dashboard & Reporting — Build/maintain QuickSight dashboards on Redshift aggregates for MAA metrics; add dimensions as needs evolve; validate metric definitions against production logic.

Business Reporting — Prepare WBR/QBR inputs (abuse BPS, goal tracking, forecasts); support goal-setting with prior-year reconciliation; generate ad-hoc regional/program splits.

title: ML Kernel Performance Engineer, AWS Neuron, Annapurna Labs
descriptionHtml:
The Annapurna Labs team at Amazon Web Services (AWS) builds AWS Neuron, the software development kit used to accelerate deep learning and GenAI workloads on Amazon’s custom machine learning accelerators, Inferentia and Trainium.

The Acceleration Kernel Library team is at the forefront of maximizing performance for AWS's custom ML accelerators. Working at the hardware-software boundary, our engineers craft high-performance kernels for ML functions, ensuring every FLOP counts in delivering optimal performance for our customers' demanding workloads. We combine deep hardware knowledge with ML expertise to push the boundaries of what's possible in AI acceleration.

The AWS Neuron SDK, developed by the Annapurna Labs team at AWS, is the backbone for accelerating deep learning and GenAI workloads on Amazon's Inferentia and Trainium ML accelerators. This comprehensive toolkit includes an ML compiler, runtime, and application framework that seamlessly integrates with popular ML frameworks like PyTorch, enabling unparalleled ML inference and training performance.

As part of the broader Neuron Compiler organization, our team works across multiple technology layers - from frameworks and compilers to runtime and collectives. We not only optimize current performance but also contribute to future architecture designs, working closely with customers to enable their models and ensure optimal performance. This role offers a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of machine learning, high-performance computing, and distributed architectures, where you'll help shape the future of AI acceleration technology

This is an opportunity to work on cutting-edge products at the intersection of machine-learning, high-performance computing, and distributed architectures. You will architect and implement business-critical features, publish cutting-edge research, and mentor a brilliant team of experienced engineers. We operate in spaces that are very large, yet our teams remain small and agile. There is no blueprint. We're inventing. We're experimenting. It is a very unique learning culture. The team works closely with customers on their model enablement, providing direct support and optimization expertise to ensure their machine learning workloads achieve optimal performance on AWS ML accelerators.

Explore the product and our history!

title: Transportation Specialist, Amazon Intermodal (AZIM)
descriptionHtml:
Amazon’s Intermodal (AZIM) Operations team is seeking highly skilled and motivated Transportation Specialists to join this rapidly growing team. AZIM Operations drives the end to end operational execution of all loads (internal and external) shipped on our 1P network. The team supports regions and shippers across the Supply Chain network and is tasked with ensuring on-time pickup and delivery of freight from vendors, Amazon fulfillment centers (FCs), rail yards and shipper hubs. In the case of disruptions, the Operations team is responsible for addressing the disruption, keeping all stakeholders informed and ensuring timely resolution of the issue. The AZIM Operations team is the first line of defense in understanding network trends, delays, dwells and other exceptions that impact AZIM’s ability to deliver a world class transportation product that serves its customers on time.

Key job responsibilities
- Communication with customers (Carriers, Rail Road partners, Vendors/Suppliers) and stakeholders (Program Managers, Fulfillment Centers, Amazon Managed carrier programs).
- Pull data from numerous databases (using Excel, SQL and/or other data management systems) and to perform ad hoc reporting and analysis as needed.

- Deliver follow through on the resolutions to ensure the information is delivered.
- Work within various time constraints to meet critical business needs, while measuring and identifying activities performed.
- Communication, both verbal and written as their data and findings are critical to tracking trends and performance inefficiencies.
- Identifying possible disruptions in a route and fixing/rerouting it in a timely manner.
- Deliver positive carrier and driver experience/solutions, in a contact center environment, through researching, problem-solving, setting appropriate expectations and working within the Amazon Transportation network to get trailers/trucks back on track when disruptions occur.


A day in the life
The AZIM Transportation Operations Specialist facilitates the continued flow of Amazon’s supply chain by passing information to key stakeholders and resolving disruptions that impact customer experience or the flow of information impacting performance and delivery. The Specialist checks on a list of shipments and makes sure everything is as it should be, then optimizes the driver’s intermodal portions of the trip as much as possible while providing any necessary information to avoid disruptions. Will be required to make real-time decisions to resolve issues and cancelations. Will also be apart of new and inventive programs designed to bridge a gap or improve overall business. The Specialist addresses or escalates any concerns arising during the lifecycle of freight leaving rail ramps, shipper hubs, Amazon fulfillment centers, or transiting between rail to OTR carriers. The day-to day role requires the specialist to provide resolutions by researching and querying internal tools and making real-time decisions in accordance with their guidance and standard work processes. We’re on a quest to empower live communities, so if this sounds good to you, see what we’re up to on LinkedIn and X, and discover the projects we’re solving on our Blog. Be sure to explore our Interviewing Guide to learn how to ace our interview process.

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Manager, Content & Partnerships to lead Twitch's content acquisition and strategic partnership efforts in Brazil, our largest and most dynamic market in Latin America. This role owns the end-to-end partnership lifecycle in Brazil: from identifying and signing high-value creators, media companies, and brands, to managing ongoing relationships that drive platform growth, viewer engagement, and revenue.

Brazil's creator ecosystem is uniquely vibrant, Portuguese-language, culturally distinct, and rapidly evolving across gaming, esports, music, and live entertainment verticals. The right candidate will combine deep market knowledge with commercial acumen and a genuine passion for creators and live content.

This role reports to the VP of Partnerships, LATAM & Iberia, and works closely with cross-functional teams including Legal, Finance, Marketing, Product, and Advertising.

You Will

- Develop and manage cross-functional programs and Partnerships Team workstreams, including goal setting, operational frameworks, next steps, and deliverables.
- Manage regional business operations across finance tracking, tooling, data analysis, documentation, and templates to support regional and operational needs.
- Oversee GTM execution and line management of GTM staff, including training, and support the rollout of global tools and platforms across LATAM & Iberia.
- Communicate organizational strategy, goals, and best practices internally through written, verbal, and facilitated communication.
- Partner with the VP of Content and Partnerships, LATAM & Iberia, to develop strategic change programs that improve and scale initiatives aligned with company priorities.
- Serve as a primary point of contact for large accounts and B2B relationships, including evaluation, contractual logistics, activation, renewals, and amendments.
- Build and manage partner relationships by gathering feedback, presenting recommendations, and developing solutions and next steps to address partner needs.

Perks
* Medical Insurance
* Life Insurance
* Pension Plan
* Maternity & Parental Leave
* Paid Holidays

About the team
The Global Partnerships team lies at the heart of Twitch. Our team is dedicated to serving streamers in our Twitch Partner Program from around the world. Our partner managers are custodians of meaningful and enduring relationships with our Partners. Our operations managers lead the execution and efficiency of critical processes used to support the Partner experience. Our program managers design and implement initiatives that acknowledge and enable Partner success. Collectively, we shape and evolve the Partner Program with meticulous care. Every decision is guided by the diverse needs of our streamers, who are the essence of Twitch's success.

Basic qualifications

- Experience leading cross-functional projects and managing large, complicated programs
- 7+ years of experience in strategy, operations, planning, consulting, or a related function within a technology, media, gaming, or similarly complex organization.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to synthesize complex information into clear insights and actionable recommendations.
- A track record of using curiosity and sound judgment to develop solutions tailored to business and market needs.
- Fluency in both English and Portuguese, with strong written and verbal communication skills.

- Experience working in media, gaming, talent management, the creator economy, or adjacent industries.

title: Finance Manager, Profit Intellegence Finance
descriptionHtml:
Own the controllership, governance, and allocations of Amazon's largest cost pools in Historical Contribution Profit (HCP) — Operations accounts spanning Fulfillment Center Variable, FC Fixed, Central Fixed, Inbound Freight, and Shipping Costs. We're hiring a Finance Manager to join Profit Intelligence Finance (PIF) as the owner of WW Operations cost in CP, responsible for ensuring allocation accuracy between CP and Cognos across all Operations cost lines worldwide. You will lead the audit, validation, and governance of Operations allocation methodologies in HCP, partner directly with Operations Finance to drive alignment across financial systems, and serve as the single point of accountability for Operations cost accuracy within the CP ecosystem. This role sits at the center of Amazon's financial integrity infrastructure — ensuring that the largest cost lines are accurate, consistent, and trusted.

Key job responsibilities
- Operations CP-to-Cognos Bridge Ownership: Own the CP-to-Cognos bridge for all Operations cost lines (FC Variable, FC Fixed, Central Fixed, Inbound Freight, and Shipping Costs. Identify, classify, and quantify variances between CP and Cognos at component level. Drive unexplained variances to root cause and resolution through structured engagement with Marketplace STOs and Operations Finance partners.
- Audit Framework & Execution: Design and execute targeted component audits for Operations cost lines when material CP-to-Cognos variances or accuracy opportunities are identified. Conduct deep-dive analyses of allocation methodologies, rates, mappings, and source data. Document findings with quantified financial impact and recommended remediation actions. Track remediation through to completion.
- Allocation Methodology Governance: Serve as the controllership authority for Operations allocation methodologies within CP. Validate that allocation logic (activity-based costing for FC Variable via GAM, FC Fixed via FAM, transportation via TFS) is producing accurate unit-level outputs. Ensure methodology changes are reviewed, approved, and documented before implementation. Govern the transition of federated ownership to Operations teams while maintaining accuracy standards.
- Improvement Validation & Implementation Oversight: Validate proposed accuracy improvements for Operations cost lines before production launch. Review simulation results, assess edge cases, and confirm that improvements meet controllership standards. Ensure that implemented changes achieve their intended accuracy impact and do not introduce regressions.
- Governance Mechanisms & Reporting: Maintain Operations accuracy metrics and progress reporting for the Governance QBR. Surface non-compliance, unresolved variances, and systemic risks to leadership through structured escalation. Produce governance artifacts including audit documentation, remediation plans, and methodology certification records.
- Cross-Functional Partnership & Influence: Partner with Operations Finance, TFS, GAM/FAM system owners, PI product teams, and regional Marketplace STOs to drive alignment on allocation methodologies. Represent PIF in cross-functional forums on Operations cost accuracy. Influence partner teams without direct authority through quantified impact, structured governance, and escalation mechanisms.


About the team
Profit Intelligence Finance (PIF) is the finance partner to Profit Intelligence — the team that builds Amazon's unit-level profitability products, Historical Contribution Profit (HCP) and Forward-Looking Contribution Profit (FLCP). Together, these products power over 1 billion automated business decisions daily and serve 20,000+ users across Amazon Worldwide Stores. PIF owns the controllership and governance layer that ensures these products are accurate, complete, and aligned to Amazon's official financials. We bridge financial systems, audit allocation methodologies, and drive cost alignment across the enterprise — operating as the single team accountable for how Amazon's unit economics reconcile to the P&L. We are a small, fast-moving team leveraging AI to operate at a scale and speed that belies our size. If you want to own the financial integrity of Amazon's largest cost pools and influence how the company governs profitability data at global scale, this is the team.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in finance, accounting, business, economics, or a related analytical field (e.g., engineering, math, computer science)
- 5+ years of tax, finance or a related analytical field experience
- 5+ years of leading cross-functional initiatives that drive financial performance and strategy experience
- 5+ years of dissecting financial data and identifying patterns that support business strategy experience

Preferred qualifications

- 6+ years of identifying incomplete or inaccurate data, identifying the root cause and creating/implementing an escalation plan experience
- 6+ years of solving complex business challenges by delivering accurate and timely financial models, analysis, and recommendations that have a proven impact on business (e.g., financial savings, operational improvements, or customer benefits) experience
- MBA, or CPA
- Knowledge of SQL/ETL
- Experience working with large-scale data mining and reporting tools (examples: SQL, MS Access, Essbase, Cognos) and other financial systems (examples: Oracle, SAP, Lawson, JD Edwards)
- Experience delivering forecasting, budgeting, and variance analysis, and data interpretation of results

title: Systems Development Engineer, US ADC Security
descriptionHtml:
Amazon's Security team is looking for a Systems Security Development Engineer to design, build, and integrate security automation and tooling for a U.S. Government program delivering a classified AI Factory on a fully air-gapped platform. This is not a traditional cloud environment; there is no AWS control plane, no internet connectivity, and no existing security automation to inherit. You will engineer the systems that integrate security controls into the platform build, including hardening automation, configuration management, log pipeline engineering, and security tool integration across a multi-vendor COTS stack (Kubernetes, ONTAP, NVIDIA, Cisco, Thales). You will work hands-on with infrastructure engineers to ensure security is built into the platform from day one, not bolted on after delivery.

This position requires that the candidate selected be a US Citizen and must currently possess and maintain an active TS/SCI security clearance with polygraph.

Key job responsibilities
• Engineer security automation for platform hardening, STIG application, and configuration enforcement.
• Build and maintain log pipelines and telemetry collection for the air-gapped SIEM.
• Integrate security tooling (endpoint protection, vulnerability scanning, detection) into the platform stack.
• Develop and maintain infrastructure-as-code for security components.
• Support security control implementation and evidence generation for RMF authorization.
• Partner with platform engineering to integrate identity, secrets management, and crypto services.

About the team
Diverse Experiences
Amazon Security values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why Amazon Security?
At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon’s products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores.

Inclusive Team Culture
In Amazon Security, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Ongoing DEI events and learning experiences inspire us to continue learning and to embrace our uniqueness. Addressing the toughest security challenges requires that we seek out and celebrate a diversity of ideas, perspectives, and voices.

Training & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, training, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Basic qualifications

- Knowledge of systems engineering fundamentals (networking, storage, operating systems)
- 3+ years of systems engineering experience
- Current, active US Government Security Clearance of TS/SCI with Polygraph
- Hands-on experience with Linux systems administration, automation (Ansible, Terraform, or equivalent), and scripting (Python, Bash).
- Experience integrating security tooling into infrastructure (SIEM, endpoint, vulnerability scanning).
- Understanding of Kubernetes, containerized workloads, and infrastructure-as-code.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience working in an Agile environment using the Scrum methodology
- Experience in air-gapped, classified, or disconnected environments.
- Familiarity with STIG application, CIS benchmarks, and hardening automation.
- Experience with multi-vendor COTS integration (storage, networking, compute).
- Security certification (e.g., Security+, CySA+, RHCSA).

title: Spacecraft Hardware Development Specialist, Amazon Leo DevOps
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is Amazon's low Earth orbit satellite network. Our mission is to deliver fast, reliable internet connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. From individual households to schools, hospitals, businesses, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will serve people and organizations operating in locations without reliable connectivity.

This role is for a highly dynamic and motivated individual that will work on development hardware to meet the needs of Amazon Leo. We are looking for an individual who works well with engineering teams under minimal oversight to take hardware from concept to production. You'll partner directly with design engineers to iterate hardware quickly and qualify it for space, following that hardware through the full arc of development — initial prototyping, development builds, testing, and rigorous qualification testing. You'll also help shape the lab spaces themselves, adapting layout and equipment as designs change to keep labs clean, well-organized, and set up to serve their engineering customers. This will be an R&D focused position, and the work covers the full range of hardware development lab support — assembly, troubleshooting, testing, equipment upkeep, and documentation — so expect the day-to-day to shift as project needs change.

Export Control Requirement: Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Key job responsibilities
- Able to work with minimal guidance and instruction
- Partner directly with design engineers to iterate hardware quickly, optimize manufacturability, and qualify hardware for space
- Support hardware through the full development arc — initial prototyping, development builds, testing, and rigorous qualification testing
- Mechanical and electrical assembly of various spacecraft mechanisms
- Troubleshoot hardware and test setup issues, working through problems to root cause
- Engineer and adapt lab spaces and equipment to meet evolving customer needs, keeping labs clean, organized, and functioning well for their intended purpose, including tracking equipment calibrations
- Develop custom automation equipment to support test and build needs
- Maintain clear work documentation, including build notes and test records
- Accurately estimate time required to complete tasks, and meet deadlines as assigned
- Participate constructively and take ownership in the success of interdisciplinary projects
- Familiarity with aerospace/space quality standards for mechanical and electrical components

About the team
The Amazon Leo Development Operations (DevOps) team builds and maintains the labs and hardware infrastructure that let engineering teams design, prototype, and test satellite hardware quickly. We support projects from first prototype through qualification testing, and our team members cross-train across assembly, test, and lab equipment so we can flex to wherever the work is needed. Priorities shift fast as designs evolve, and you'll often move between projects to keep pace with what engineering teams need next. We take pride in keeping our labs and equipment in excellent shape, and we hold ourselves to a high standard because the hardware we build and test directly impacts what makes it to space.

Basic qualifications

- Knowledge of tools and measurement devices (oscilloscope, frequency analyzer, or equivalent)
- Can lift up to 49 pounds, stand/walk during shifts lasting up to 12 hours, and be able to frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach
- Associate's degree or equivalent relevant experience in Electronics, Mechanics, -Product Design, Manufacturing Technologies, or other STEM discipline
- 4+ years in a Space/Aerospace/Military/Precision fabrication/Test environment
- 1+ year experience working with precision mechanical and electrical fabrication/testing
- Must be able to climb a ladder and work at heights above 6 feet

Preferred qualifications

- 6+ years in a Space/Aerospace/Military/Precision fabrication/Test environment
- Experience in a R&D/development/Test role highly desirable
- Experience supporting hardware qualification testing (vibration, thermal vacuum, shock, etc.)
- Familiarity with basic machining operations (manual mill, lathe, etc.)
- Experience designing or building custom test fixtures and tooling
- Familiarity with hardware testing procedures and instrumentation setups (data acquisition, strain gauges, load cells, etc.)
- Experience reading and interpreting engineering drawings, schematics, and GD&T
- Experience organizing or maintaining a lab or shop space, including equipment calibration tracking
- Exposure to production equipment and processes
- A&P certificate, IPC 620, 610 or J-STD

title: Buyer, Vendor Management, Sports / スポーツ＆アウトドア事業部 商品戦略部 バイヤー
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Japan / Sports & Outdoors 事業部について
Amazonは「地球上で最もお客様を大切にする企業」をビジョンに掲げ、日本では2000年から事業を展開しています。Sports & Outdoors事業部は、チームスポーツ・アウトドア レジャー・釣り・サイクリング・フィットネス・ゴルフなど幅広いカテゴリーを管掌し、お客様のアクティブなライフスタイルを支えています。このポジションでは、事業部が取り扱うチームスポーツに関連するカテゴリー(野球・バレーボール・バスケットボール・サッカー・卓球等)を担当いただくことを想定しており、担当カテゴリーにおいて、取引先メーカーとAmazonユニークなお客様バリューをJBP(Joint Business Planning)に落とし込み、日々の実行を通じてカテゴリービジネスを継続的に改善・成長させます。
また、担当カテゴリーの品揃えの拡大、売上・利益の最大化を目指し、事業責任者およびシニアバイヤーの方針の下で、成長戦略に基づく施策の立案と成果実現を担い、お客様の利便性と満足度の向上や効率的なオペレーションを追求することで、担当カテゴリーのビジネスを新たな成長ステージに乗せる役割を担います。(カテゴリーは変更となる可能性があるので面接時にご確認ください)
このポジションは、成果達成のために、社内の各職種(ウェブコンサルタント、マーケティング担当、広告担当、購買担当など)と協力しながら、成長戦略に基づく最適なアクションプランを策定し、最適な商品仕入れ・販売促進プロモーション・広告/宣伝を企画し提案し実行します。担当チームの一員として、上記業務を効率的に完遂し、高いパフォーマンスを提供することが求められています。
なお、当ポジションでは、生成AIおよび社内で提供される各種AIツールを日常業務で積極的に活用し、分析・資料作成・意思決定の質とスピードを高めることが求められます。


【職務内容詳細】
1. 担当カテゴリーの売上・利益目標の設定と実行・実現
予算作成・実行プロセスに責任をもち、社内外の関係者からの情報を踏まえて担当カテゴリーの売上・利益目標を設定し、その実行を推進します。

2. 販売データ・市場動向の分析と、それに基づく販売戦略・品揃え拡大の立案、実施、改善
販売データ・市場動向分析を行い、担当カテゴリーの販売戦略および品揃え拡大計画を立案し、それを実行するとともに、必要に応じた改善を行います。

3. 最適な仕入れ先の選定・開拓と、仕入れ条件の最適化
担当カテゴリーにおける仕入れ先の開拓・選定に関して分析を行い、最適な仕入れ計画を立案し、それを実行します。

4. 取引先メーカーとのパートナーシップの確立・維持
ディストリビューター/メーカーの経営層・マネジメント層とのトップエンゲージメントを通じて、担当カテゴリーの中長期的な成長に資する強力なパートナーシップを確立・維持し、JBPをはじめとする戦略的な合意形成を推進します。

5. カテゴリーレベルのプロモーション戦略の推進
担当カテゴリー全体の販売促進・マーケティング戦略を立案し、社内マーケティング/広告部門およびメーカーとの協働を通じて、大型セールイベントや重点販促施策など、カテゴリー全体に影響するプロモーションを推進します。

6. 社内関連部署との連携
社内関連部署（在庫管理担当者、ウェブ制作担当者、出品者事業担当者、およびマーケティング部門など）と密接に連携し、効率化と高質化を目指しながら上記の各業務を遂行します。

7. プロジェクトへの参画
担当カテゴリーおよび事業部全体に関わるプロジェクトに参画し、メンバーとして実績を残します。

8. AI活用による業務推進
生成AIおよび社内AIツール(社内で承認された各種AIアシスタント・分析ツール等)を日常業務に取り入れ、以下を実現します。
- 販売データ・市場動向分析、資料作成、メール・議事録などの定型業務の効率化
- 交渉準備・提案書作成におけるドラフト生成と品質向上
- 業務プロセスの再設計とチーム内での活用ノウハウ共有
なお、社内のセキュリティ・情報開示ポリシーおよびAI利用ガイドラインを遵守した上で活用することが前提です。


■求められる知識・スキル
- 実行・行動力：目標達成への強いコミットメントをもち、全社的な視点で状況を的確に判断し、優先順位を明確にしながら機動的に行動できる。
- 論理的思考・分析力：ロジカルに考え、自らの仮説に基づき、市場領域動向や販売データの的確な分析・検証を迅速に行うことができる。
- 問題解決力：市場領域動向・販売動向を素早く的確にとらえ、社内外の関係者・関連部署と協働し、リスクをとった複雑な問題解決にあたることができる。
- 企画・立案力：常に改善と創造の意識を持ち、効率と高質を目指した企画・立案ができる。他社などのベストプラクティスをもとに、新たな観点での戦略構築に関わる企画・立案ができる。特に、担当カテゴリー全体の販売促進戦略や成長施策を構想し、実行に落とし込むことができる。
- 交渉力：取引先との信頼関係を構築し、複雑な状況下においても有用情報を引き出しながら相手の立場・状況・ニーズを理解し、中長期的な視点に立った折衝・交渉を成功裏に行うことができる。特に、経営視点に立ったWin-Winの関係構築と、メーカー経営層・マネジメント層とのトップエンゲージメントを通じたJBP合意形成ができることを期待。
- コミュニケーション力：対外的な折衝に加えて、社内外のシニアマネジメント層および多様な社内機能（マーケティング、広告、在庫管理、ウェブ制作、出品者事業等）と円滑なコミュニケーションができる。
- AI活用力：生成AIおよび社内で承認されたAIツールを実務で使いこなし、分析・資料作成・意思決定の質とスピードを高めるために活用できる、または高い学習意欲をもって活用に取り組める。※社内のセキュリティ・情報開示ポリシー、AI利用ガイドラインを遵守した上で活用すること。
- PCスキル：Excel（VLOOKUP等の関数操作を含む）、Word/PowerPointによる文書作成スキル
- 日本語力：日本語でのビジネスコミュニケーション能力（必須）


【ダイバーシティ・ワークライフバランスの取り組みについて】
Amazonでは、家族と過ごす時間や、趣味に没頭するなど充実したプライベートの時間を大事にすることは、常にInnovativeであり続けるためにとても重要なことと考えます。
Amazon ライフ＆レジャー事業本部では、出産、育児、介護など、様々なライフステージイベントなどに合わせ、社員が自由な勤務体系を選択できる環境が整備されており、多くの社員がこうした制度を活用しながら活躍しています。

Amazonでは社員ひとりひとりの業務量やライフスタイルに合わせて、メリハリのある働き方を推進します。フレックスタイム制もそのひとつです。

title: Mech & Robotics Tech
descriptionHtml:
About Maintenance at Amazon

Operations is at the heart of Amazon’s business. We are known for our speed, accuracy, and exceptional service. Our buildings deliver tens of thousands of products to hundreds of countries worldwide, every day. Reliability Maintenance & Engineering (RME) are the business partners that work tirelessly behind the scenes to make it all happen. We drive continuous improvement, and maintain all of the Robotics and Material Handling Equipment (MHE) to ensure our customers are met with the Amazon smile. Come join us, on our journey!

About the Role

As a Mechatronics & Robotics Technician, you will use your skills to support the Operations Maintenance team in repairing and maintaining material handling equipment and pneumatic systems throughout the building. You will have the opportunity to install, maintain and repair automated packaging and distribution equipment. In addition to developing your skills, you will mentor junior technicians to grow in their roles.

What Do We Offer?

Amazon offers competitive compensation packages including comprehensive healthcare benefits starting on Day 1, matching 401(k) program, and up to 20 weeks of paid parental leave. But wait, there is more: We provide lightweight fire-resistant daily wear and composite toe safety shoes for your safety!


Here is what you can expect with the Reliability & Maintenance Engineering (RME) selection process for Mechatronics & Robotics Technicians: (Timeframe: Approximately 30-days)

Step 1: Congratulations! You successfully submitted your application!

Step 2: Amazon Recruiting will review your application and invite the most qualified candidate to complete a pre-employment assessment.

Step 3: If you meet the role qualifications, you will receive an invitation from Amazon Recruiting (do-not-reply@criteriacorp.com) to begin your Criteria assessment. You have 5 days to complete.

Step 4: Once you successfully meet the pre-employment assessment requirements, you will be invited to complete a video interview. Your video interview invitation will be from HireVue (interviews@hirevue.com) and you will have 7 days to record your interview.

Step 5: Your video interview will be reviewed by the Amazon Hiring Team and you will be notified of next steps via email within 5 business days.

Key job responsibilities
- You will promote a safe working environment by following all safety procedures
- You will complete preventative maintenance routines with proper documentation
- You will troubleshoot electrical and mechanical problems related to all Material Handling Equipment (MHE) which includes belts, motors, photo-eyes, relays, and more
- You will maintain a positive working relationship across all of the Amazon Operations facility
- You must be able to move up to 49lbs, stand and walk during shifts lasting up to 12 hours, climb ladders and gangways safely, and without limitation, as well as perform regular bending, lifting, stretching, and reaching both below the waist and above the head

Please note that while we strive to accommodate employees' preferences for shift assignments, due to operational requirements and scheduling constraints, we cannot guarantee a specific shift assignment.

Basic qualifications

- High school or equivalent diploma
- 1+ years of Microsoft Office products and applications experience
- Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays
- 2+ years of automated conveyor systems and controls experience, or certification from Amazon's Mechatronics and Robotics Apprenticeship Program
- 2+ years of conducting predictive and preventative maintenance procedures experience
- 2+ years of reading blueprints and electrical schematics experience
- 2+ years of demonstrating safety standards experience
- 2+ years of troubleshooting and diagnostics of material handling equipment (MHE) experience

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with robotic operation and maintenance
- 2+ years of electrical and electronic principles experience
- Associate's degree in Mechatronics, or Associate's degree in related field
- 2+ years of Mechanical or Electrical apprenticeship experience

title: Station Process Excellence Manager
descriptionHtml:
To continue to drive process excellence within our Last mile Delivery business, we are currently looking for an Station Process Excellence Manager.

As an PEx (Process Excellence) Manager, you will drive process standardization on site. You will be the link between station management and the PEx team. As a member of the PEx team itself, you will contribute to the optimization of the delivery stations operations, providing station with sufficient knowledge and appropriate tools to improve performance.
Your goal is to solve complex problems with simple and practical solutions by developing a deep knowledge of the operation processes. Creating effective communication plans to provide visibility to all impacted teams of the organization will help you to enable overall process alignment.

Key job responsibilities
- As firsthand contact for station management regarding process improvements and benchmarking, you will work on effective change processes and contribute to network standardization via best practice sharing.
- You are in charge of monitoring the logistics and delivery success through set in station and on road performance indicators. You will set up actions plans and execute them to drive current performance to benchmark rates.
- In this position, you are a key driver for successful order execution thus positively influence our customer satisfaction.
- You will contribute to audit initiatives and support results-driven action planning, the deployment of Process Standard implementations and upgrades within the delivery station partnering with station management and several stakeholders.
- Ensure station management understand benchmark rates and are trained in technical configurations to drive accurate reporting and productivity boosts.
- During peak time, you will have the responsibility for the day to day management of a Delivery Station, providing leadership to Operations Supervisors, Operations Assistants and Delivery Service Providers, managing external agency relationships and performance.

This role will be based in the delivery station. You will need to be willing to work in non-traditional shift patterns, which include nights.

A day in the life
As a Process Improvement Manager, you’ll be at the forefront of making Amazon’s logistics better – which means improving safety, productivity, and quality. Part of your role will involve running observations and audits to identify where processes could be enhanced. Another part of your role will be recommending changes and using your project management and stakeholder management skills to put new processes in place.

You’ll be based at one of our sites and accountable for positively influencing operational efficiency at the site. If needed, you will carry out analysis at other local or national sites. On top of dealing with productivity and safety, you’ll have the opportunity to share best practices and ideas with our EU network. In this role, you’ll use data to drive improvements and continue to grow our shipping capabilities.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience in Business, Engineering, Supply Chain, Transportation, Mathematics, Economics, Physics or another technical field
- Experience working in a supply chain, transportation, project management or management consulting role
- Experience in project management or management consulting including handling multiple ongoing projects
- Experience working with multiple groups of stakeholders
- Experience using Excel and data analysis
- Speak, write, and read fluently in Spanish

Preferred qualifications

- Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to drive improvements
- Experience in process improvement
- Knowledge of analytic tools
- Knowledge of database systems and SQL

title: Creative Programme Manager , EU XCM
descriptionHtml:
We are looking for a driven and super organised Sr Creative programme manager Project Manager to join our Project Management function in Cross Channel Marketing (XCM) at Amazon. This role will manage the execution and to day-to-day processes of our mass advertising campaigns and fixed marketing initiatives. Responsible for building effective partnerships with our Campaign Managers and Creative teams, they are able to manage creative development, production, localization, and drive cross functional team alignment within our XCM teams, business partners and external agencies.

The Project Manager will manage omni channel integrated campaigns, localised across 13+ European locales. They are able to work independently or alongside other project managers, using their experience to provide solutions for the benefit of the project and the wider team.

To be successful in this role, the candidate will be able to thrive in a dynamic and fast-paced global environment, assess and manage risks on an ongoing basis. They understand project management best practices, are able to clearly define roles and responsibilities of team members and stakeholders, manage multiple end-to end creative workflows, and able to proactively provide thoughtful solutions to address changes in timelines or feedback. They will be an organized self-starter with the ability to develop and implement processes and able to work alongside cross-functional teams to provide guidance for projects.

Critically, this person must bring genuine curiosity about AI and emerging technology — not just awareness, but a proactive desire to apply it to our space. They should be energised by the prospect of reinventing how we work, challenging legacy systems and processes, and proposing bold ideas for how AI can transform campaign delivery, production workflows, and cross-market operations at scale.


Key job responsibilities
This role requires a mixture of responsibilities, in particular:
· Independently manage the development and execution of integrated campaigns of small to medium scale for UK and Europe from end to end.
· Manage campaign and program alignment meetings and creative reviews with senior leaders, stakeholders and global partners.
· Responsible for project timings, costs, meetings, resources, scope, approvals, wash ups etc and functions as the main POC for the project. Determines project risk and over/underutilization on an ongoing basis, escalating issues as needed.
· Partners with and manages creative teams – internal partners and / or external agencies. Manages creative asset development across multiple channels.
· Liaises with local and global teams and media agencies to agree formats and create deliverables lists for all channels.
· Manages transcreation and localisation of all assets through internal team or external agency, and guarantees accurate, timely and approved delivery (trafficking) to media owners.
· Collaborates with Producers, Post Producers, Project Managers, Campaign Managers, and Creative Leads to identify and schedule resources based on campaign and individual initiative needs. Manages own projects and resources.
· Contribute to the continual improvement of process and supporting tools for project management.
· Actively explore and propose AI-driven solutions that can be applied to current workflows — challenging existing systems and processes with a mindset of reinvention, not just optimisation. Bring bigger thinking to how we work, identifying opportunities to work smarter and faster through emerging technology.

Basic qualifications

- Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps) at an advanced level and SQL
- Experience working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams
- Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements
- Experience in program or project management
- Experience implementing repeatable processes and driving automation or standardization
- Experience defining and executing program requirements

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
- Experience leading process improvements
- Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization
- Experience building processes, project management, and schedules

descriptionHtml:
The AWS Worldwide Data & AI Strategy Team is focused on working directly with customers’ business executives to drive alignment across the C-suite on their Agentic AI strategies, business priorities, and use cases. We then develop architectural recommendations that translate those strategies into actionable technical plans using AWS Database, Analytics, AI/ML, and Generative AI services.
As a member of this team, you will partner with enterprise customers to facilitate executive alignment, design technical solutions, collaborate with sales teams to shape engagements, and work with AWS product teams to evolve our offerings based on field insights. This role will have a primary focus on the Telco, Media & Entertainment, Games, and Sports verticals, though you will also engage with customers across other industries as needed.
We are looking for a technical specialist who can bridge business strategy and hands-on execution — someone equally comfortable driving alignment among C-suite executives as diving deep with data engineers and data scientists. You bring a track record of building consensus across senior leadership, solving complex technical challenges with a strategic business lens, and delivering results with an entrepreneurial mindset.

Key job responsibilities
• Drive C-suite alignment on Agentic AI strategies, business priorities, and use cases for enterprise customers across Database, Analytics, AI/ML, and Generative AI domains
• Engage with C-suite executives and technical leaders to accelerate data-driven initiatives and articulate AWS value
• Design and deliver customer workshops, technical briefings, and thought leadership presentations
• Create reference architectures and industry-specific use cases that demonstrate the transformative potential of AWS data and AI services
• Collaborate with AWS product teams to translate customer feedback into product roadmap input
• Partner with sales, Professional Services, and partners to drive pipeline and customer outcomes
• Produce thought leadership content including white papers, blog posts, and demo assets

A day in the life
Your days will be diverse and fast-paced. You might start by developing an industry-specific "art of the possible" demo showcasing integrated AWS data and Generative AI solutions. Later, you could deliver a hands-on workshop guiding customers through real-world scenarios from data ingestion to AI model deployment.
You will author technical content — white papers, blogs, and reference architectures — that positions AWS as the leader in cloud-based data and AI. You will also support internal enablement, helping partners and field teams stay current on AWS data and AI capabilities.

About the team
The Worldwide Data & AI Strategy Team is part of the WWSO Generative AI organization. We are the only team at AWS focused on engaging business executives to align their organizations on Agentic AI strategies and use cases. We create data and AI strategies for customers, build sales plays, leverage partners, and launch new initiatives that drive customer results. We provide critical customer feedback to inform the product roadmap and serve as the "first in" team to build markets for new AWS services, domains, and solutions.

- Experience developing strategies that influence leadership decisions at the organizational level
- 5+ years of working with Data & AI related technologies, including, but not limited to, AI/ML (Artificial Intelligence/Machine Learning), GenAI (Generative AI), Analytics, Database, and/or Storage experience
- 5+ years of solving problems with technology in the Media & Entertainment Industry experience
- 5+ years of Go-To-Market, Business Development, Sales, or Consulting experience
- Bachelor's degree
- Experience explaining complex technical concepts to various business and technical audiences
- Experience presenting to both technical and non-technical executive audiences
- Experience leading complex, multi-year initiatives that may be cross-functional and/or span business and technology

Preferred qualifications

- Experience interpreting data and making business recommendations
- Experience identifying, negotiating, and executing complex legal agreements

title: Systems Development Manager, AWS Managed Operations
descriptionHtml:
Are you ready to transform how support engineering operates at scale? Amazon Web Services (AWS) Operations Management is seeking an experienced Support Engineering Manager to lead a global team that's evolving from reactive troubleshooting to proactive automation and engineering excellence using Agentic Al. In this role, you'll eliminate repetitive toil and create a follow-the-sun support model while building a team culture where engineers grow their careers through strategic problem-solving, not just ticket resolution.

You'll have the opportunity to create transformational impact across AWS by leading incident management at massive scale, championing automation-driven solutions, and mentoring engineers to think beyond immediate fixes. This isn't traditional support management—it's about architecting operational resilience, meeting demanding SLAs through innovation, and shaping how AWS delivers world-class service reliability to millions of customers globally.

AWS Operations Management (AWSOM) handles operational infrastructure responsibility for all services in AWS commercial regions, enabling service teams to focus on customer engagement and innovation development. The team automates operational tasks to eliminate toil and simplify operations without requiring deep service expertise, providing consistent operational experience across AWS. AWSOM is accountable for critical operational metrics including service pipeline freshness, host maintenance, and security campaign remediation.

The team's vision centers on scaling operational excellence through automation and engineering discipline. You'll join a culture that values proactive problem-solving, continuous improvement, and developing engineers who take ownership of complex systems. This is an environment where your leadership directly impacts AWS's ability to maintain the reliability and security that millions of customers depend on daily.

Key job responsibilities
- Lead and develop a support engineering team through career mentoring, performance management, and strategic project assignments that evolve engineers from support mindset to engineering mindset, fostering continuous learning and next-level performance

- Drive incident management and problem-solving at scale by directing technical responses during critical outages, analyzing root causes, and collaborating with engineering teams to advocate for permanent code fixes rather than temporary workarounds

- Establish and optimize follow-the-sun support operations by managing global handovers, coordinating cross-regional resources, and ensuring seamless 24/7 coverage while maintaining work-life harmony for your team

- Build process automation and operational excellence mechanisms by identifying repetitive toil, implementing automation workflows using agentic Al, updating support playbooks, and establishing metrics to measure team performance against SLAs, response times, and resolution rates

- Partner with stakeholders across AWS to define team vision and long-term strategy, working backwards from customer problems to set goals, allocate resources effectively, and balance tactical operational needs with strategic engineering initiatives


A day in the life
- Lead the deployment and operation of services in regions with specialised security needs.
- Report on the health of these services.
- Drive root cause analysis and coach others on performing them.
- Lead local development efforts to improve operational performance.
- Drive continual improvement in systems operations through the development of new tooling and automation.
- Define and drive projects and report on their progress.
- Meet with customers to develop relationships and clarify requirements.
- Create and refine the staffing and support plan for the services that you support.

About the team
About AWS

Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Basic qualifications

- Experience in managing system or software development teams
- Experience (hands-on) in systems engineering and administrative work in networking, storage systems, and operating systems
- Experience in automation or monitoring frameworks, deployment or development
- Experience in systems administration, network engineering, or software development engineering
- Experience in distributed system management

title: RME Technician
descriptionHtml:
Das Wartungs- und Instandhaltungsteam (Reliability Maintenance Engineering Team oder RME-Team) ist für unseren Betrieb von fundamentaler Bedeutung – es sorgt dafür, dass unsere technischen Systeme und Anlagen laufend funktionieren. Als Instandhaltungstechniker:in bist Du für die Wartung und Instandhaltung unserer förder- und haustechnischen Anlagen sowie Produktionsanlagen zuständig. Du hilfst, die höchsten Sicherheitsstandards im Arbeitsschutz zu gewährleisten und Maschinenausfallzeiten zu verhindern. Unser technisches Team stellt eine hohe Verfügbarkeit der technischen Anlagen sicher und verbessert die Qualität unserer Geräte.

Key job responsibilities
- Ausführung präventiver Wartungsmaßnahmen an einer breiten Vielfalt von Geräten an unseren Standorten

- Verwendung neuester Tools zur Maximierung der Geräteeffektivität
- Einhaltung aller Arbeitsschutzrichtlinien und -praktiken
- Unterstützung der Entwicklung und des beruflichen Fortschritts von Auszubildenden am Standort
- Arbeit an Projekten zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung und Einführung von Best Practices an verschiedenen EU-Standorten

Die Stelle beinhaltet die Arbeit in einem rotierenden Dreischichtsystem, welches Samstage, Nachtschichten sowie Rufbereitschaft umfassen kann.

WIR BIETEN:

- Einen unbefristeten Vertrag direkt mit Amazon.
- Vielfältige Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten und die Chance, an verschiedenen Schulungen und Seminaren teilzunehmen, die von Amazon und externen Partnern angeboten werden.
- Übernahme des Deutschlandtickets oder alternativ andere Pendlerangebote wie z.B. Bike Leasing.
- Ein attraktives Vergütungspaket und Mitarbeiterrabatt.
- Zusätzliche Leistungen wie z.B. Unterstützung bei der betrieblichen Altersvorsorge und eine Lebens- und Erwerbsunfähigkeitsversicherung.
- Familienbonus (Einmalzahlung für Mütter sowie Eltern in Elternzeit).
- Ein kostenloses Mitarbeiterhilfeprogramm (auch für Familienmitglieder) für eine Beratung bei beruflichen oder privaten Angelegenheiten.

A day in the life


Als Instandhaltungstechniker:in bist Du vor Ort in einem unserer Logistikzentren tätig, um schnell auf technische Störungen reagieren zu können. Außerdem reagierst Du als Instandhaltungstechniker:in unverzüglich auf Störungen und Ausfälle. Du untersuchst die Ursachen, findest so schnell wie möglich Lösungen und wendest sie an. In Zusammenarbeit mit leitenden Kolleg:innen nimmst Du tägliche Wartungsaufgaben wahr und kommunizierst mit Dienstleistern, falls Du externe Expertise benötigst. Du arbeitest in rotierenden Schichten, damit wir rund um die Uhr unsere Standorte unterstützen – und dafür sorgen, dass Amazon weiterhin in dem Tempo liefern kann, für das wir bekannt sind.

Wir arbeiten in Fulfillment-Centern, die das Herzstück von Amazons dynamischem Betriebsnetz bilden. Unsere Fullfilment-Center werden manchmal auch als die „erste Meile“ (First Mile) bezeichnet – hier starten die meisten Amazon-Pakete ihren Versandweg.

title: Customer Success Manager, Zappos
descriptionHtml:
This role is for a Customer Success Manager (CSM) on the Zappos FBA Preferred Partnerships team. The position is a new headcount designed to serve as a dedicated strategic growth partner for assigned footwear brands within our Preferred Partnership Program (PPP).

The CSM will operate as the primary relationship owner and trusted advisor for their brand portfolio, personally engaging with vendor stakeholders to develop trust, influence strategic decisions, and align brand goals with Amazon growth opportunities. This role requires navigating complex multi-stakeholder environments, influencing without authority across internal teams (Buying & Planning, Supply Chain, Advertising), and building durable partnerships through consistent personal engagement, transparent communication, and accountable follow-through.

This role is highly visible and requires a balance of tactical execution and strategic relationship management. Success in this role means earning the trust of brand partners through reliable personal engagement, driving selection growth through coordinated investment, and strengthening the scalability of the PPP through accountable partnership ownership.

Key job responsibilities
Partnership Ownership & Relationship Management: Serve as the dedicated point of contact for assigned footwear brands, building trusted advisory relationships through regular touchpoints, proactive communication, and responsive issue resolution. Engage with brand stakeholders to understand their business objectives and translate them into actionable growth strategies. Maintain defined response SLAs and conduct quarterly Partnership Health Reviews.

Strategic Growth & Business Planning: Develop Joint Business Plans with buyers and vendors to align growth priorities and partnership commitments. Create one-page Brand Growth Briefs covering demand signals, whitespace opportunities, and exclusivity strategies. Attend market appointments to influence buy depth and surface growth opportunities with brand decision-makers.

Demand Acceleration & Investment Coordination: Coordinate Sponsored Ads, merchandising, promotions, and catalog optimization to drive traffic, conversion, and organic rank growth. Manage deal mechanics and identify cost-engineered opportunities for event eligibility.

Controlled Distribution & Customer Experience: Monitor seller fragmentation, Featured Offer ownership, and pricing consistency. Coordinate Brand Store, A+ Content, and catalog updates to improve listing quality and customer trust.

Reporting & Operational Excellence: Deliver monthly Brand Exposure Reports and weekly business recaps. Build scalable reporting and process improvements to support program growth.

A day in the life
Your day might start reviewing Featured Offer trends and seller fragmentation for a Priority Partner, then shift to coordinating a Sponsored Ads campaign launch with the media team. Mid-morning, you're on a call with a brand stakeholder discussing their quarterly growth plan. After lunch, you're preparing a one-page exclusivity brief for an upcoming market appointment, then submitting deal mechanics for a high-velocity event. You close the day delivering a vendor digest and flagging pricing risks to the buying team. No two days look the same, but every day connects brand strategy to measurable Amazon outcomes.

About the team
The Preferred Partnerships Program (PPP) is a growth and distribution management team within Zappos FBA team. We serve as strategic partners to premium footwear brands, helping them grow on Amazon through controlled distribution, coordinated advertising investment, and accountable ownership. Our Customer Success Managers work alongside Buying & Planning to accelerate demand, expand exclusivity, optimize Featured Offer performance, and improve the customer experience. We manage a tiered portfolio of Priority, Growth, and Emerging partners, scaling investment and support based on each brand's strategic value and commitment level.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- 2+ years in a client-facing role within Customer Success, Account Management, Buying, Merchandising, or Strategic Partnerships owning external client/vendor relationships
- Proven ability to build trusted advisory relationships with external stakeholders
- Track record driving measurable partner outcomes (revenue growth, operational improvements, or adoption)
- Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams to drive partner or business outcomes
- Experience presenting data-backed business reviews to stakeholders
- Strong written and verbal communication skills

Preferred qualifications

- Experience leading partner onboarding and coordinating operational workstreams (e.g., logistics, catalog, supply chain)
- Experience influencing without direct authority across cross-functional teams
- Experience in e-commerce, retail, footwear/apparel, or management consulting
- Comfort operating in ambiguous, fast-paced environments with evolving priorities
- Familiarity with CRM tools (e.g., Salesforce), advanced Excel, and tiered service models
- Usage of generative AI tools to enhance workflow efficiency, with a willingness to learn effective prompting and evaluation practices

title: Program Specialist, NCC, Network Control Center
descriptionHtml:
Customer experience is at the heart of all we do at Amazon, as we strive to be Earth's most customer-centric company. Amazon Customer Service (CS) is at the forefront of customer experience, working relentlessly to provide customers a convenient, high quality, and delightful experience — across all of our CS channels — in every interaction.

Within CS, Network Solutions is responsible for designing, planning, and operating the world's largest customer service network — building intelligent, adaptive systems that anticipate demand, match customers to optimal experiences, and continuously improve service quality. We are transforming CS from a manually operated, reactive model into an AI-native ecosystem that makes CS a growth driver and competitive advantage for Amazon.


We are seeking a Program Specialist to join the Network Control Center (NCC), Amazon's central incident management function for Customer Service. The NCC detects, manages, and resolves high-severity incidents impacting customers, associates, drivers, and brands in real time — coordinating response across dozens of teams to minimize customer impact and restore service. When systems fail at scale, contact volumes spike unexpectedly, or a service disruption threatens millions of customer interactions, the NCC takes command. You will be at the center of that response — running incidents end-to-end, driving cross-functional coordination under pressure, and ensuring leadership has the information they need to make decisions fast.

At Amazon, you'll work alongside the latest AI and GenAI tools that are increasingly woven into how teams operate: from AI-powered capabilities that accelerate decision-making, to Generative AI that helps you focus on work that truly matters. You'll have opportunities and resources to develop AI fluency at your own pace, with continuous learning built into the culture.

Key job responsibilities
- Manage high-severity incidents (Sev1/Sev2) impacting Amazon CS customers by running bridge calls and coordinating with Service Delivery, Product, Engineering, PR, Legal, and Security Operations teams to drive resolution
- Triage technical and operational incidents, assess customer impact, and coordinate with relevant teams to identify root cause and resolution path
- Initiate and manage proactive customer communications including website/app banners, IVR updates, and mass notifications to reduce anxiety contacts during known issues
- Protect contact channels by identifying known-issue volume and ensuring customers with genuine issues can reach Customer Service without congestion
- Provide regular, timely updates to senior leadership with clear customer impact assessments, resolution timelines, and status indicators
- Dive deep into incident data, identify systemic problems, and present solutions and preventive measures to leadership
- Develop, maintain, and execute Standard Operating Procedures for incident response scenarios, including coordination playbooks for cross-functional teams
- Track service health metrics and coordinate with stakeholders to mitigate customer impact during capacity constraints or system degradation

Basic qualifications

- Work flexible shifts including nights, weekends, or holidays in a 24/7/365 environment
- 2+ years of program or project management experience
- Knowledge of Excel at an intermediate level (e.g., pivot tables & charts, multiple criteria lookups, nested logical/IF formulas, data cleansing, array formulas, etc.)
- Experience in Business English skills, both verbal and written
- Speak, write, and read fluently in Japanese

Preferred qualifications

- Knowledge of Lean principles and DMAIC methodology

title: Engineering Operations Technician, DCEO
descriptionHtml:
Join our dynamic team and become a critical guardian of technological infrastructure! As a Data Center Engineering Technician, you'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of mission-critical technology infrastructure, ensuring seamless operations that power global digital experiences. Your expertise will directly contribute to maintaining an extraordinary 99.999% uptime, keeping the digital world running smoothly and efficiently.

Engineering Technicians are Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting. They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot, Data Center Operation’s Mission Critical Facilities, which includes stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, as well as three phase electrical systems such as: switch gear, UPSs, PDUs, wet cell batteries and associated systems, CRAC, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers/water chemical system, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, & motors.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

NOTE: Amazon does not sponsor for immigration, including for H-1B, TN, and other non-immigrant visas, for this role.

NOTE: Lump sum stipend will be provided to eligible candidates who relocate for this position.

Key job responsibilities
Daily building rounds to monitor and record information from electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment to ensure 24/7 reliability and availability

Monitor Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Management System (EPMS)

Assist in troubleshooting of facility and rack-level events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLA)

Perform rack installs and rack decommissioning within internal SLA

Perform PM, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and repair of electrical and mechanical equipment

Technical writing to support change management program

Monitor daily work requests and manage to resolution, and execute projects from conception to completion

On-site support of contractors, sub-contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices, procedures & local legislation

Work schedule changes depending on specific site needs. Shifts can be up to 12 hours and may rotate on a predefined schedule. Some locations have on-call rotations.

Role may support more than one location/site.

Physical Requirements:

Willingness and demonstrated ability to work in the following physical conditions with reasonable accommodations:

Regularly lift and/or move up to 39 pounds independently

Participate in group lifts for 40+ pounds

Maintain balance and perform construction tasks while on a ladder

Regularly walk, use hands and fingers, handle or feel, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl, climb stairs, twist, bend, work above shoulders, grasp, carry, push and pull objects into position

Work in an environment requiring provided ear protection

Essential Requirements:

Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed

Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational

Travel frequency will vary based on business needs and operational status of assigned facility

Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs.

This role acts as Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment preventative maintenance (PM) and troubleshooting, reporting to a site’s Data Center Facility Manager (FM). Additional support equipment is included in the scope of the role which includes fire/life safety equipment, building automation systems, and general facilities equipment.

This role requires equal parts strategic instinct and operational excellence: the ability to conceive a breakthrough campaign beat and then manage every detail required to bring it to life — from pitch through placement, from press day logistics through premiere execution. The successful candidate will be a proactive self-starter who thrives in a fast-paced, collaborative environment, manages multiple high-profile campaigns simultaneously, and brings genuine passion for film and pop culture to everything they do.
