title: Sr. RF Ground Systems Engineer, Leo Ground Systems
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is an initiative to launch a constellation of Low Earth Orbit satellites that will provide low-latency, high-speed broadband connectivity to unserved and underserved communities around the world.

Have you ever wanted to develop aerospace grade ground stations and related products for a high-performance satellite constellation? We are looking for a Ground Systems Engineer to participate in the technical definition, architecture, development, integration, test, qualification, production, and deployment of Leo ground systems with full lifecycle ownership. These systems include state of the art, physically remote, high reliability, aerospace grade full motion tracking antennas, modems, and innovative supporting systems that directly impact the end-to-end ground-space link performance.

Key job responsibilities
- Define, develop, and provide Radio Frequency (RF) technical oversight for integrated ground station products and solutions for gateways and tracking, telemetry, and control systems, working with both internal teams and suppliers.
- Develop solutions to demanding design problems enabling Amazon to fully realize aerospace grade, high reliability ground station Leo connectivity products.
- Support conducting in-depth design reviews including preparing design review documentation and artifacts, and reviewing design materials.
- Develop RF architecture, specifications, requirements, and designs and perform analyses, prepare documentation, and conduct presentations for parabolic LEO tracking TT&C and Gateway Terminal systems.
- Possess Subject Matter Expertise in developing RF hardware equipment and modem products for integration into Ground Gateway and TT&C terminals.
- Assist development of qualification, verification and validation plans and philosophies to ensure our physically remote products meet rigorous technical, functional, performance, reliability, and business requirements across teams and suppliers
- Assist in the development of gateway monitoring and control systems and methodologies, including operational and fault management plans and on-site commissioning methodologies.
- Support identification and analysis of operational faults and performance metrics and trends.
- Perform root cause analysis and anomaly resolution on highly complex system issues.

Export Control Requirement:
Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

A day in the life
In this role as Sr Ground Systems Engineer, you will be actively engaged in developing Amazon Leo’s Ground Gateway terminal products. These products enable space-ground mission critical, high throughput communications with Leo satellites. You will engage with an experienced cross-disciplinary, mutli-domain team to develop, test, qualify, produce, and globally deploy solutions and products enabling Leo’s global network.

About the team
The Ground Systems team is responsible for the architecture, design, build, and installation of Kuiper’s Ground and TT&C Gateways. Our Ground Gateways enable high data rate, low latency communications between Kuiper points of presence (PoP) and our Low Earth Orbit Satellite constellation. TT&C Gateways support satellite Launch and Early Orbit enabling command and control of the satellites during this critical phase. The team works closely with the Networks, Regulatory, Payload Test, and RF Hardware teams to ensure Leo provides a seamless customer experience.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering
- Minimum of 8 years of system engineering experience in development and delivery of satellite communications systems.
- RF systems experience, preferably with ground tracking antennas and systems.
- Experience in RF product design, and/or integration and test as related to antenna systems and their associated ancillary equipment.
- In-depth understanding of satellite communications link budgets.
- Experience supporting Systems Engineering of ground systems development efforts including meeting cost, schedule, and performance goals.
- General computer hardware and software proficiency.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in development and operation of full motion ground gateways and/or TT&C systems.
- Experience in writing and managing RF system and subsystem requirements, including definition and traceability.
- Experience in defining and documenting RF hardware and software and interfaces, between systems and subsystems.
- Experience working with external custom product suppliers
- Experience with satellite modems and satellite ground system integration from RF to Network.
- Minimum of 5 years’ experience in development of LEO/MEO systems.
- Experience in monitoring and controlling operational satellite ground systems, including fault and performance management.
- Experience with satellite communications spectrum monitoring systems and software.
- Experience with analysis and scripting tools such as MATLAB, Python, STK, or Visualyse
- Experience in V-Band and E-Band RF systems.

Are you a technology leader and innovator interested in owning business-critical identity infrastructure that authenticates and authorizes over 3 million Amazonians every day? We have an opportunity for a Software Development Manager in Amazon Foundational Security Services (AFSS), and we're looking for a leader ready to own and evolve Amazon's on-premises Active Directory service.

Amazon Foundational Security Services (AFSS) owns the service portfolio that provides enterprise capabilities for authentication, authorization, directory management, and public key infrastructure (PKI). This includes Amazon's on-premises Active Directory, and the Corporate PKI Service. We work very closely with additional Cloud IDPs, including Azure Active Directory (Entra ID), Google Workspace and AWS Identity Center (IDC). We enable the authentication and authorization needs of every Amazonian: logging into their laptops, authenticating to enterprise services like Exchange, SharePoint, and Microsoft 365, and authorizing access to shared resources such as GitFarm, wiki pages, and Workdocs.

As a Software Development Manager, you will bring strong people/project/program management capabilities, and a good exposure to Identity and Access management concepts (SAML, OAuth2, FIDO2), and Cloud Identity systems (Active Directory, Azure AD, Google Workspace, Okta etc.)

Key job responsibilities
• Own end-to-end delivery and operational health of Amazon's on-premises Active Directory service, supporting authentication and authorization for millions of Amazonians, and providing directory services to millions of devices.
• Lead a team building and rolling out identity and access management capabilities across global regions.
• Proactively partner across business groups and security partners inside Amazon, building and running cross-functional projects that implement secure systems and security controls at scale.
• Drive Amazon's growing footprint across Cloud IDPs (e.g. Azure AD/Entra ID), bringing deep systems and domain experience in these platforms.
• Build Infrastructure as Code and DevOps tooling to drive efficiency and quality across the directory service.
• Create and evolve enterprise infrastructure and security standards, and ensure systems adhere to them.
• Review and implement system changes using thorough test plans, and drive operational excellence for services your team owns.
• Translate security recommendations into business terms (and vice versa), and regularly brief Amazon leadership on security posture and initiatives.
• Make sound two-way-door decisions under pressure, with the backbone to safeguard Amazon's systems, and the ownership to see decisions through.
• Proactively work across different business groups and security partners in Amazon, and build/run cross-functional projects.

title: Data Engineer, SPTC
descriptionHtml:
As we strive to be Earth's most customer-centric company, Amazon has reinvented how hundreds of millions of people shop online – providing customers with the opportunity to find and discover virtually anything they want to buy and providing millions of sellers with a platform for growing successful businesses. We are looking for an exceptional data engineer to help us develop new ways to build trust and loyalty with sellers, a crucial component of our flywheel

Sellers’ trust in Amazon is our top priority and in this role, you will be tasked with building that trust over time by building and maintaining the data sources that power all of our decision making. Amazon’s growth requires leaders who move fast, have an entrepreneurial spirit to create new solutions, have an unrelenting tenacity to get things done, and are capable of breaking down and solving complex problems.

The successful candidate will be a self-starter, comfortable with ambiguity and be able to create and maintain efficient & automated processes. They know and love working with data engineering tools, can model multidimensional datasets, and can partner effectively with business leaders to build the right data pipelines to answer key business questions. They will build efficient, flexible, extensible, and scalable data models, ETL designs and data integration services. They will also be required to support and manage growth of these data solutions. They are analytical and creative, and don’t quit. This is a role with high visibility to senior leadership and with high opportunity for impact for those willing to roll up their sleeves and dive deep to achieve results.

Key job responsibilities
In this role, you will work on unifying fragmented data pipelines, building robust data models, and ensuring reliable data lineage across multiple product areas. You will partner closely with software engineers, product managers, and analytics teams to develop data solutions that drive innovation and operational excellence.

The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in big data technologies, strong data modeling and problem-solving skills, and a track record of delivering scalable, maintainable data systems. If you’re excited by the challenge of shaping data platforms that support real-world hardware, software, and operations, this is the role for you.

-Design and enforce data modeling standards, data lineage, and governance frameworks that ensure consistency, re-usability, and quality across systems.
-Lead design and code reviews, driving engineering best practices across data development, documentation, testing, and monitoring.
-Build data platforms and frameworks that support both batch and real-time processing, enabling flexible, efficient analytics at scale.
-Implement secure and compliant data solutions that meet internal and external regulatory requirements (e.g., GDPR).
-Evaluate and introduce emerging technologies to improve data platform performance, cost efficiency, and scalability.
-Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather data requirements, define solution architectures, and ensure alignment with business needs.
-Mentor junior engineers and contribute to team hiring and onboarding

- 1+ years of developing and operating large-scale data structures for business intelligence analytics using ETL/ELT processes experience
- 1+ years of developing and operating large-scale data structures for business intelligence analytics using OLAP technologies experience
- 1+ years of developing and operating large-scale data structures for business intelligence analytics using data modeling experience
- 1+ years of developing and operating large-scale data structures for business intelligence analytics using SQL experience
- 1+ years of developing and operating large-scale data structures for business intelligence analytics using Oracle experience
- 3+ years of in the job offered or a related occupation experience
- 1+ years of developing and operating large-scale data structures for business intelligence analytics using each of the following: ETL (Extract, Transform, Load)/ELT (Extract, Load, Transform) processes experience
- Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Mathematics, or a related field
- Experience with data modeling, warehousing and building ETL pipelines

- Experience with AWS technologies like Redshift, S3, AWS Glue, EMR, Kinesis, FireHose, Lambda, and IAM roles and permissions
- Experience with non-relational databases / data stores (object storage, document or key-value stores, graph databases, column-family databases)

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

- Manage the dependencies and the interfaces between projects and/or project deliverables, and negotiate any needed trade-offs.
- Provide program progress reporting on a regular basis.
- End to end responsibility for the program’s execution and success.
- Manage multiple competing projects/programs simultaneously.

- Ensure consistency in deployed configurations and track exceptions for follow up.
- Develop and implement scalable, data-driven process improvement/automated solutions.
- Assist in daily operational tasks as part of the overall Data Center Delivery workflow.

A day in the life
The Soapstone TIPM's responsibilities are split between Program or Project related initiatives to support additional scope or process improvement related to capacity delivery, as well as operational ticket-based tasks of creation and configuration of rack positions within the digital data hall inventory system.

About the team
Soapstone plays a critical role in the Data Center delivery workflow. By maintaining accurate server rack position data in the digital data hall inventory system, Soapstone ensures on time rack ordering to fulfill Data Center capacity needs.

- 1+ years of technical program management experience

Preferred qualifications

title: Sr. Manager, Studios Analytics, Prime Video Finance
descriptionHtml:
Amazon MGM Studios is one of the largest and most ambitious content studios in the world, producing and acquiring film and television across every genre and geography. The Prime Video Finance Analytics organization supports this business with a centralized team of 40+ technical specialists spanning data engineering, business intelligence, data science, and product development. This team powers the data platforms and reporting that inform how content is planned, evaluated, and optimized across the entire Prime Video portfolio.

We are seeking a Senior Manager, Studios Analytics to serve as the primary analytics partner to the Amazon MGM Studios Finance and Strategy organizations. Based in Los Angeles and embedded alongside Studios leadership, you will own the analytics relationship with some of the most senior decision-makers in the content business, translating their most pressing questions about content performance, portfolio strategy, and operational efficiency into rigorous, scalable, data-driven solutions.

In this role, you will lead a team of business intelligence engineers and data engineers dedicated to Studios analytics. You will set the vision for how analytics supports the Studios business, own the prioritization of your team's roadmap, and drive delivery of dashboards, automated reporting, and analytical tooling that give Studios leaders real-time visibility into the performance of their content. You will partner closely with centralized data engineering, product development, and financial reporting teams to ensure your team leverages shared infrastructure, governed datasets, and existing platforms rather than building in isolation. Maintaining consistency across the broader Prime Video analytics ecosystem is critical.

You will be a thought leader for analytics within the Studio. You will represent the analytics function in senior leadership forums, influence how content performance data is structured and surfaced, and raise the bar on how data informs content decisions. You will identify opportunities to automate high-volume, manual workflows, including talent-facing presentations, portfolio summaries, and compliance reporting. You will also drive adoption of AI-powered tooling to accelerate delivery and scale your team's impact.

As a senior leader, you will be responsible for building and developing a high-performing team in Los Angeles. This means recruiting top talent, setting technical standards, and fostering a culture of analytical rigor, speed, and customer obsession. You will manage the full lifecycle of analytics delivery, from problem framing and stakeholder alignment through to production-quality outputs that are trusted by Studios leadership.
The ideal candidate brings deep experience in analytics, business intelligence, or data engineering leadership, with a proven track record of partnering with senior business stakeholders in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment. You are equally comfortable diving into the technical details of a data pipeline and presenting insights to a room of VPs. You think holistically across organizational boundaries, build collaborative relationships, and have a bias toward automation and scalable solutions over manual work. Experience in media, entertainment, or content analytics is preferred but not required. What matters most is your ability to translate complex business problems into clear analytical frameworks and deliver results that drive decisions.

Key job responsibilities
1) Serve as the primary analytics partner to Studios Finance and Strategy leadership. Understand their most critical business questions and ensure they have timely, accurate data to inform content and portfolio decisions.
2) Set organizational priorities by balancing stakeholder needs, business impact, and technical feasibility. Define the Studios analytics roadmap and ensure the team focuses on the highest-leverage work.
3) Lead the design, development, and maintenance of dashboards, automated reporting, and analytical tooling that give Studios leaders real-time visibility into content performance and portfolio health.
4) Drive automation of high-volume manual workflows including talent-facing presentations, slate summaries, and compliance reporting.
5) Partner with centralized product development, data engineering, and financial reporting teams to influence platform roadmaps and maintain consistency with enterprise-wide data governance standards.
6) Own AI integration and adoption for Studios analytics, leveraging the broader organization's AI capabilities to accelerate delivery and scale output.
7) Hire, develop, and lead a high-performing team. Set technical standards, mentor team members, and build a culture of analytical rigor and customer obsession.
8) Represent the analytics function in senior leadership forums, communicating insights and providing a point of view on how data should inform content strategy.

Basic qualifications

- Knowledge of SQL and Excel
- Master's degree or above in Operations Research, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, Engineering, Computer Science or related field, or PhD
- 10+ years of business intelligence and analytics experience
- 10+ years of delivering results managing a business intelligence or analytics team, including employee development and performance management experience

Preferred qualifications

- Knowledge of a scripting language (Python, R, etc.)
- MBA
- Knowledge of data engineering pipelines, cloud solutions, ETL management, databases, visualizations and analytical platforms

title: Sr. Network Development Engineer, Satellite Systems Integration and Test, Amazon Leo
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is an initiative to increase global broadband access through a constellation of satellites in Low Earth Orbit. Its mission is to provide fast, reliable, and affordable connectivity to unserved and underserved communities around the world.

The Satellite Systems Integration and Test team validates the complete communications path across the satellite payload, ground gateways, customer terminals, transport networks, and cloud services. We integrate new capabilities, evaluate end-to-end performance, troubleshoot complex failures, and reproduce issues observed during satellite operations.

As a Senior Network Development Engineer, you will lead hands-on integration and testing of satellite communications and ground-network capabilities. You will work across RF, networking, wireless protocols, embedded software, cloud services, and test automation to bring new features from initial lab integration through end-to-end validation.

This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys working directly with complex systems, collecting evidence, analyzing packet captures and logs, understanding RF link behavior, and driving ambiguous problems to root cause. You will collaborate with systems, hardware, software, RF, networking, and operations teams to determine whether failures originate in the satellite payload, RF link, gateway, customer terminal, transport network, or cloud service.

Key job responsibilities
• Lead end-to-end integration and validation of satellite communications features across the satellite payload, ground gateways, customer terminals, transport networks, and cloud services.
• Develop and execute test campaigns covering functionality, performance, reliability, scale, and failure recovery.
• Translate system and product requirements into test plans, use cases, success criteria, and verification matrices.
• Bring up new test configurations by integrating customer terminals, gateway equipment, satellite payload systems, RF equipment, network infrastructure, and cloud services.
• Troubleshoot complex system issues using packet captures, system logs, telemetry, performance counters, RF measurements, and test data.
• Use tools such as tcpdump, Wireshark, iperf, and Linux networking utilities to isolate packet loss, latency, session failures, and throughput degradation.
• Analyze behavior across the communications stack, including RF link conditions, MAC behavior, Layer 2 and Layer 3 networking, transport protocols, and application performance.
• Troubleshoot packet loss and performance degradation caused by retransmissions, congestion, MTU issues, routing behavior, link conditions, and TCP or UDP behavior.
• Correlate RF conditions such as signal level, interference, link margin, channel impairments, and modulation performance with network and application behavior.
• Reproduce functional and performance issues observed during satellite operations in a controlled lab environment.
• Work with RF and test-equipment vendors to expand lab capabilities using spectrum analyzers, channel emulators, vector signal generators and analyzers, and customer-terminal simulators.
• Automate test execution, data collection, log processing, performance analysis, and reporting using Python or similar languages.
• Communicate technical findings clearly and drive cross-functional teams toward root cause, corrective action, and verification.
• Create and maintain test procedures, verification matrices, test records, dashboards, troubleshooting guides, and program-level status reports.
• Mentor engineers and establish repeatable integration, troubleshooting, and validation practices across the team.


Export Control Requirement:
Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or
national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the
U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent work experience
- 10+ years of experience in either satellite communications, cellular systems, wireless systems, modem validation, network integration, or end-to-end communications testing.
- Experience troubleshooting complex systems using packet captures, system logs, performance counters, and telemetry.
- Experience with Linux and network troubleshooting tools such as tcpdump, Wireshark, ping, traceroute, iperf, and standard Linux networking utilities.
- Knowledge of IP networking, including TCP and UDP behavior, routing, VLANs, IP addressing, MTU, packet loss, latency, and throughput analysis.
- Experience integrating and testing systems that combine hardware, software, networking, RF components, and external test equipment.
- Experience developing test automation or data-analysis tools using Python or a similar programming language.
- Experience leading technical investigations across multiple engineering teams and communicating complex findings.

Preferred qualifications

- • Master’s or PhD degree in electrical engineering, computer engineering, computer science, telecommunications, or a related discipline.
- • Experience with satellite payloads, satellite ground systems, gateways, customer terminals, or over-the-air communications testing.
- • Experience with cellular systems and 3GPP protocols, including LTE, 5G NR, Layer 2 and Layer 3 procedures, mobility, and performance testing.
- • Understanding of RF link behavior and its effect on network performance, including link margin, fading, interference, modulation, coding, and retransmissions.
- Experience with RF test equipment such as spectrum analyzers, vector signal generators and analyzers, channel emulators, power meters, and terminal simulators.
- Experience troubleshooting modem or wireless protocol-stack behavior from the MAC layer through the application layer.
- Experience with TCP congestion behavior, UDP loss, Quality of Service, routing, traffic generation, and network-performance analysis.
- Experience querying and visualizing test data using SQL, Grafana, or similar tools.
- Experience with AWS services, cloud networking, software-defined networking, or network automation.
- Experience taking wireless or communications features from initial integration through system validation and production deployment.
- Strong technical leadership, documentation, and cross-functional coordination skills.

title: Construction Manager, GES NA, Design and Construction
descriptionHtml:
As a Construction Manager within Global Engineering Services (GES) North America (NA) Design & Construction (D&C), you are Amazon's owner's representative throughout the full construction lifecycle. You play an integral role in delivering the built facilities and infrastructure that power Amazon's logistics network — including sortation centers, delivery stations, and auxiliary buildings — through new builds, retrofits, and expansions.

In this role, you serve as the primary point of interface between Amazon and its external partners — developers, general contractors, design engineers, and authorities having jurisdiction (AHJ) — while collaborating closely with internal stakeholders responsible for equipping, furnishing, and operating our facilities. You are accountable for the safe, on-time, in scope, and on-budget delivery of construction projects, and you bring a disciplined approach to budget management, schedule oversight, contract execution, and quality assurance.

You operate with a high degree of independence within your assigned region, managing multiple concurrent projects while maintaining clear and transparent communication with all project stakeholders. This role combines construction management, engineering, project planning, contract management, and facilities delivery — and requires approximately 60% regional travel within North America.

This role requires 60% regional travel on a yearly basis. When not traveling, you must have availability to work from a corporate office. Candidates should either live near or be willing to relocate within a reasonable commuting distance of one of the corporate office locations listed. Relocation assistance may be provided.

Key job responsibilities
Safety & Compliance
- Champion Amazon's safety programs and standards across all internal and external project teams; hold all accountable to a safety-first culture
- Interface and coordinate with Authorities Having Jurisdiction (AHJ) to maintain regulatory compliance and ensure seamless project execution
- Lead or assist in negotiations with regulatory bodies as required for permitting and approvals

Project & Construction Management
- Manage multiple concurrent projects simultaneously — ranging from small renovations to large-scale ($100M+) new facility builds — from design phase through construction completion and operational handover
- Serve as Amazon's owner's representative and primary integrator between construction execution teams and internal stakeholders (operations, equipment, IT, etc.)
- Review construction documents, drawings, and specifications for conformance to Amazon's building standards and design guidelines
- Identify and resolve design conflicts, schedule clashes, and coordination gaps with other Amazon execution teams
- Conduct detailed reviews of contractor bid packages, budgets, and schedules to identify and resolve discrepancies
- Assess project performance through Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) for safety, quality, cost, schedule, and sustainability

Budget, Schedule & Contract Management
- Own comprehensive budget tracking, cashflow forecasting, and cost management across assigned projects
- Review, analyze, and respond to all proposed cost and time change requests submitted by external project teams
- Negotiate construction, procurement, and labor contracts with developers and general contractors; present formal documentation for approval when required
- Ensure contracts are fit for purpose, cost-effective, and incorporate appropriate service level agreements
- Advise on the impact of changes in scope, schedule, cost, and permitting

Contractor & Stakeholder Management
- Audit contractor performance to ensure skills, competencies, and resources are appropriate for the work being performed
- Ensure contracted resources deliver work that meets duration and quality targets; address and resolve underperformance issues
- Coach and guide project teams — including developers, design engineers, general contractors, subcontractors, and internal stakeholders — throughout the full project lifecycle
- Inform developers and contractors of projected changes in resource or work demand to enable proactive planning
- Partner with teams responsible for base building management transition and oversight of all turnover documentation

Communication & Reporting
- Maintain clear, concise, and transparent communication with all internal and external stakeholders on project status, risks, and key developments
- Utilize Amazon's information systems to record and update schedule, budget, and other key project data
- Participate in weekly Architect, Owner, and Contractor (AOC) meetings; provide input on root causes and corrective actions
- Prepare reports, specifications, and technical analyses to define design requirements, equipment needs, and services for expansion and remodel projects

Innovation & Continuous Improvement
- Provide critical review of current design standards to identify value engineering and design enhancement opportunities
- Seek sustainable, environmentally responsible solutions throughout the construction process in alignment with Amazon's building practices
- Identify and implement process improvements that drive better outcomes across safety, cost, schedule, and quality


A day in the life
Each day, you act as Amazon's owner on the ground — ensuring the safe, on-time, and on-budget execution of construction projects across your region. Your day may include:
- Coordinating with general contractors on project status, upcoming milestones, and emerging risks
- Reviewing and responding to RFIs, submittals, change order requests, and schedule updates
- Participating in AOC meetings and driving accountability across the project team
- Conducting site visits to verify construction quality and safety compliance
- Updating Amazon's project management systems with current budget, schedule, and status information
- Collaborating with internal stakeholders on facility readiness, equipment coordination, and operational handover planning
- Reviewing design documents and providing feedback to engineering and design partner


About the team
At Amazon, the Global Engineering Services (GES) North America (NA) Design and Construction (D&C) team is a diverse group of engineers, construction managers, and preconstruction professionals who deliver the physical infrastructure behind Amazon's logistics network. We are employee owners who take pride in delivering high-quality, innovative facilities — on time and on budget — for our internal customers and the communities we serve. We are committed to being Earth's best employer and to building a more sustainable future through every project we deliver.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Architecture, Construction Management, Engineering, or a related field
- 5+ years of experience as an Architect, Engineer, Construction Manager, or in a related construction discipline
- 5+ years of project management experience spanning design phase through construction completion and operational handover
- 5+ years of experience negotiating construction, procurement, and/or labor contracts
- 5+ years of proficiency with AutoCAD and/or Building Information Modeling (BIM), and scheduling software (Primavera, MS Project, or similar)
- Position includes travel up to 60% (Nationwide). Travel involves air travel to regional airports and driving to site locations. A valid driver's license is required due to project assignments in areas with limited public transportation and rideshare options.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience across at least two disciplines within the construction industry (e.g., General Contracting, Owner's Representation, Commercial Development, Engineering & Design, or similar)
- Demonstrated success communicating project requirements to diverse audiences including senior leadership, public officials, vendors, and operational teams
- Experience in facilities management, including planning, design review, implementation, and project controls for new and existing structures
- Experience managing concurrent projects in a program management capacity
- CMIT/CMAA or PMP certification or equivalent

descriptionHtml:
The Amazon Web Services (AWS) Professional Services (ProServe) team is seeking an experienced technology leader to serve as a Specialist ProServe Cloud Architect (PCA) within our Healthcare and Life Sciences (HCLS) practice. This is a role requiring deep expertise in Supply Chain & Manufacturing (SC&MFG) — spanning both Manufacturing (manufacturing execution, process control, quality systems, CMC orchestration) and Supply Chain (planning, logistics, procurement, distribution) — and the ability to flex across both domains. The role focuses on Industrial IoT (IIoT), data foundation, and intelligent-automation architectures that unlock manufacturing and supply chain data for AI-native workflows, powered by AI, GenAI, and Agentic AI.

In this position, you'll serve as both a deep domain expert and a hands-on solution architect, counseling senior executives at the world's leading pharmaceutical and life sciences companies on designing AI-driven transformation programs that span the manufacturing-to-supply-chain continuum — e.g., IIoT and edge data architectures, manufacturing data lake and digital twin solutions, MES/MOM modernization, CMC orchestration platforms, and agentic supply chain planning. You'll develop innovative go-to-market (GTM) strategies and perspectives on how AI, GenAI, and Agentic AI unlock value from the shop floor to the distribution network, creating repeatable solutions and accelerators that scale across HCLS customers.

You'll collaborate with colleagues across the ProServe HCLS team and external Partners, working backwards from customer outcomes to design fit-for-purpose solutions and programs across SC&MFG.

This role requires expertise in AI, GenAI, and Agentic AI applied to pharmaceutical and life sciences Supply Chain & Manufacturing, paired with experience in professional services and business development. The ideal candidate can flex seamlessly between manufacturing operations and supply chain contexts — understanding both the regulated manufacturing environment (cGMP, GxP) and the planning-to-fulfillment data landscape. You think big, innovate, focus on customer objectives, execute at high standards, and maintain continuous curiosity.

Key job responsibilities

• Serving as the practice's dedicated specialist and deep domain expert in Supply Chain & Manufacturing — spanning smart manufacturing, IIoT, digital twins, CMC orchestration, and supply chain intelligence — designing and delivering solution architectures that solve complex customer problems across both manufacturing and supply chain
• Developing innovative GTM strategies, offerings, and accelerators for the SC&MFG space spanning manufacturing and supply chain — identifying whitespace, shaping new service offerings, and positioning the practice to capture emerging demand across the manufacturing-to-supply-chain continuum
• Counseling HCLS executive customers to explore the art of the possible with AI-driven transformation across Supply Chain & Manufacturing — pushing the frontiers of innovation in smart manufacturing, autonomous quality, predictive supply planning, and agentic process orchestration to achieve breakthrough operational outcomes
• Collaborating with internal teams to innovate AWS solutions, services, accelerators, and demos that address evolving SC&MFG customer needs — including IIoT edge-to-cloud pipelines, manufacturing data foundations, digital twin architectures, and agentic supply chain systems
• Designing complex, scalable, and secure architectures on AWS to achieve customer business outcomes (CBOs) across Manufacturing and Supply Chain — from shop-floor data ingestion and process automation through enterprise-wide supply chain visibility and planning optimization
• Driving large, complex opportunities — spanning manufacturing, supply chain, or both — from ideation, through vision building and scoping, solution architecture development, all the way to sales closure — owning technical qualification, de-risking delivery, and participating in the Sales-to-Delivery (S2D) motion
• Acting as a trusted advisor and thought leader to customers and internal colleagues on industry trends in SC&MFG AI, industrial data architectures, digital twin technology, CMC orchestration, supply chain resilience, and emerging technologies across the HCLS landscape
• Leading senior engagement on the practice's highest-potential SC&MFG opportunities — including IIoT data platform builds, digital twin programs, MES/MOM modernization, CMC orchestration initiatives, and agentic supply chain deployments — across a portfolio of strategic Life Sciences accounts

title: Sr. Business Intelligence Engineer, AWS Analytics Engineering
descriptionHtml:
AWS is looking for a Sr. Business Intelligence Engineer to join the AWS Analytics Engineering (AAE) team supporting Amazon Quick. Formerly Amazon QuickSight, Quick has evolved from a standalone BI service into a comprehensive, generative-AI-powered business intelligence platform that combines traditional analytics with modern AI assistance. It brings together two complementary experiences. Amazon Quick Sight is the cloud-native dashboarding and visualization engine that powers governed datasets, interactive dashboards, and ML-driven insights such as forecasting and anomaly detection. Alongside it, an agentic AI layer lets users chat with their data, conduct deep research, and automate multi-step workflows across connected enterprise sources through natural language. Available in the browser, as a desktop companion, and through extensions for Slack and Microsoft Office, Quick is used to turn data into decisions and actions, without requiring machine learning expertise. This is your opportunity to shape the analytical foundation of one of AWS's fastest-evolving products.

As a Sr. BIE on this team, you will own the end-to-end analytical roadmap for Amazon Quick. You will generate insights that directly drive adoption, engagement, and growth, and that influence product and feature decisions at the leadership level. You will work with datasets in one of the world's largest data warehousing environments, developing and supporting your hypotheses with data-driven analysis. You will partner closely with product, business, finance, and engineering leaders to tackle non-standard, ambiguous business problems and translate them into actionable output. title: Software Development Engineer, Inventory Genealogy
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Fulfillment Technologies (AFT) powers the physical engine at the heart of Amazon. AFT builds and operates software, hardware, and processes that run the global network of fulfillment centers that move many billions of units of inventory, employ tens of thousands of people, and ensure that customers get what they want when we promised we would get it to them. We do this by building automated solutions to handle things that technology does well, while relying on people to handle things that humans do well.

Our inventory systems are the authoritative source of information for billions of inventory units that Amazon holds in its logistical networks, worldwide. As new inventory arrives to our networks, inventory systems enable Amazon's supply chain to route products to optimal locations based on space availability, customer demand and buying patterns. Inventory systems track the state of all items and their location, and share the availability to upstream systems, to make the items sellable on the Amazon website. When customer orders come in, inventory systems reserve specific items and track them through various stages of order fulfillment, until shipments are delivered to customers. Throughout this end-to-end inventory movement, inventory systems detect discrepancies between virtual and physical states of inventory, and enable corrections of virtual inventory state via both preventative and mitigating mechanisms.

The AFT Inventory org is seeking a highly skilled SDE II to lead our Genealogy platform development. This critical role will shape the future of our inventory Genealogy and defect detection systems, focusing on root cause analysis and process-level insights. As the lead architect, you'll finalize our high-volume data storage infrastructure and develop advanced analytics solutions, handling approximately 1 billion daily inventory events. Your responsibilities will include building and optimizing a sophisticated knowledge graph to track inventory throughout Amazon's fulfillment network, designing scalable storage solutions, and developing high-performance APIs. You'll also spearhead the creation of analytics tools for defect identification, ensuring data security and compliance throughout. This position offers an exciting opportunity to work at the forefront of big data technology, directly impacting Amazon's inventory management efficiency and accuracy. The ideal candidate will bring extensive experience in big data technologies, cloud computing, and database management, along with strong leadership and problem-solving skills to drive innovation in this complex and dynamic field.

This position offers an exciting opportunity to work at the forefront of big data technology, GenAI, directly impacting Amazon's inventory management efficiency and accuracy. The ideal candidate will bring extensive experience in big data technologies, cloud computing, database management, and GenAI, along with strong leadership and problem-solving skills to drive innovation in this complex and dynamic field. If this sounds exciting to you, you’ll find this role to be engaging, challenging, and full of opportunities to learn and grow.

Key job responsibilities
As an SDE, you will be responsible for designing, developing, testing, and deploying scalable solution. You will collaborate closely with a team of engineers to influence our overall strategy and define the team’s roadmap. You will also help drive the system architecture, spearhead best practices that enable a quality product, and help coach and develop junior engineers. A successful candidate will have an established background in Big data analytics, and infrastructure to store TBs of data/events per day.

descriptionHtml:

title: Senior PMT-ES, AI Cost Governance, AWS Insights and Optimizations
descriptionHtml:
We're building the future of cloud financial management, and the hardest unsolved problem in it is AI cost. Customers are moving from experimenting with generative AI to running it in production at scale. Spend is driven by tokens, model choice, inference patterns, and increasingly by agents that make their own consumption decisions. The AWS Billing organization processes millions of events per second to deliver the cost, usage, and optimization insights that power financial decisions at the world's largest enterprises. We are now extending that foundation to give customers the ability to understand, allocate, control, and optimize AI spend with the same rigor they apply to compute and storage today.

As Senior Product Manager, you will execute AWS's strategy for AI cost governance. This is the highest-ambiguity, highest-leverage product space in the organization: the mechanics of tokenomics, attribution, and control for generative AI workloads are still being defined across the industry, and the decisions made here set the direction that partner service teams, enterprise customers, and eventually all industry players respond to. You will own the product bets that define the category.

In this role, you will define what it means to govern AI spend on AWS: how cost is attributed at the token, model, and agent level; how customers allocate that cost to teams, applications, and business units; and how they set and enforce controls before spend, rather than explaining it afterward. You will write the strategy documents and PR/FAQs for the most consequential launches, run the customer conversations, and make the hard trade-off calls on scope, sequencing, and where AWS should lead versus follow. You will pressure-test metering, API, and interface designs directly with engineering, and dig into consumption data and customer telemetry to understand where the real cost drivers and governance gaps are. You will own the measurement of whether these capabilities actually change customer behavior, including adoption, spend under active governance, and the degree to which cost visibility unblocks AI expansion, and build the review mechanisms that hold the organization accountable to it.

You will make the calls on how AI cost governance extends to emerging surfaces, including foundation model inference, agentic workloads, and third-party and marketplace model consumption, and on when AWS should build new primitives versus extend existing cost management constructs. You will partner with engineering leaders, applied science leaders, and product leaders across Bedrock, AgentCore, and the broader AWS generative AI portfolio to ensure cost governance is designed in rather than retrofitted, and you will drive alignment on strategy and investment across multiple organizations without owning the teams that execute it. You will represent this product area to senior AWS leadership, enterprise CFOs and FinOps practitioners, and industry analysts, and you will shape how the market thinks about the economics of running AI in production.

This role requires deep technical judgment, comfort operating with incomplete information on problems that have no precedent, and the influence to move organizations you do not control. If you are excited about defining a product category that does not yet exist — and about the fact that every enterprise scaling generative AI will eventually need what you build — this role offers the opportunity to set AWS's position on the economics of AI.

title: Sr. 5G NTN D2D Phased Array Antenna Architect, Payload Architecture Team
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is Amazon's low Earth orbit satellite constellation initiative designed to bring fast, affordable broadband connectivity to unserved and underserved communities around the world. We are building a next-generation satellite system from the ground up — designing everything from the spacecraft and payload to the ground infrastructure and customer terminals. This is a rare opportunity to join a team that is shaping the future of global connectivity at scale.

We are looking for a D2D Phased Array Architect to join the Payload Architecture team in San Diego. You will be a key technical contributor to the architecture of our Direct-to-Device satellite payload — a cellular-band phased array system designed to deliver connectivity directly to unmodified smartphones from space. You will work alongside experienced architects and engineers, helping shape the D2D phased array architecture as it evolves through current and future satellite generations.

This role requires strong phased array architecture expertise spanning the RF front-end and digital backend — including high-speed serial interconnects, digital beamforming, transmit chain linearization techniques like DPD and CFR, and RF front-end design across multiple semiconductor process technologies. Knowledge of 5G NR and non-terrestrial network communications is important as you will work at the intersection of cellular standards and space-based phased array design.

You will define phased array requirements and work with the verification team to validate them through test. You will collaborate with systems, HW design, communication systems, regulatory, silicon, antenna, calibration, thermal, power, mechanical, reliability, and verification teams to ensure architecture and requirements are achievable within space environment constraints.
Beyond the current payload, you will evaluate emerging technologies and contribute to the architecture roadmap for future satellite generations. This is a hands-on role — you will be in the lab, in the data, and on call when satellites are live. If you have experience with cellular or satellite phased array systems, we want to hear from you.

Export Control Requirement:
Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Key job responsibilities
● Translate high-level service and coverage requirements into D2D payload requirements — accounting for thermal, power, mechanical, reliability, and mass constraints
● Propose and own the D2D phased array architecture spanning the full signal chain from antenna element through RF front-end through digital beamforming backend to modem interface
● Work with systems, HW design, antenna, silicon, and calibration teams to realize the architecture
● Contribute to customer link performance — working with systems and customer terminal teams to meet end-to-end link requirements
● Define phased array requirements that flow from system-level needs down to subsystem and component specifications
● Work with the verification team to develop test plans that validate those requirements
● Define signal integrity requirements for high-speed serial interconnects based on SerDes technology selection, and review analysis performed by the SI team
● Support RF front-end and DPD/CFR architecture trade studies across multiple semiconductor process technologies
● Collaborate with communication systems and regulatory teams to translate 5G NR and NTN standards into phased array requirements
● Evaluate emerging technologies to inform the next generation architecture roadmap
● Support production and on-orbit debug — this role is hands-on and on-call

A day in the life
You split your time between the current program and next generation. On any given day you might translate service requirements into payload requirements, run architecture trade studies, review DPD simulations, define signal integrity requirements for high-speed interconnects, or refine requirements based on verification needs. You contribute to customer link analysis and work across HW design, antenna, silicon, and calibration teams to realize the architecture. Some weeks you evaluate emerging technologies and define the roadmap for future satellites. Other days you are in the lab debugging a test result or on a call resolving an on-orbit issue.

About the team
The Payload Architecture team is part of the Antenna organization at Amazon Leo. We are a small group of senior architects responsible for the phased array architecture across Amazon Leo's satellite programs. We define the architecture, drive requirements, run trade studies, and make sure everything works from prototype through orbit. Our scope extends to customer link performance — working with systems and customer terminal teams to close end-to-end link budgets. We work closely with every engineering team on the payload and pride ourselves on being hands-on problem solvers. We are based in San Diego.

Basic qualifications

- Master's degree in electrical engineering, computer engineering, or equivalent
- Experience in wireless system design and architecture, system integration, and RF system analysis
- Experience in developing link and system level simulators using MATLAB, Python, or C++
- Experience with RF measurement equipment, including: power meters, spectrum analyzers, vector signal generators, network analyzers, oscilloscopes
- 7+ years of experience designing 3GPP-based wireless communication systems for terrestrial or satellite networks
- Experience in phased array design principles, including beamforming, beam steering, and antenna system integration

Preferred qualifications

- 5+ years of Space Vehicle/Satellite Operations, Space Communications or related industry experience
- PhD in electrical engineering, computer science, mathematics or physics
- Experience working across multiple engineering disciplines (SW, RF, digital, thermal, power, mechanical, Reliability, Comsys) and Experience participating in or leading technical collaborations and creating alignment across diverse groups (e.g., hardware engineering, software engineering, program management)
- Experience in 5G NR or non-terrestrial network (NTN) communications standards
- Experience with transmit chain linearization techniques such as DPD or CFR

descriptionHtml:
As a Security Engineer II in Customer Logistics Security (CLS), you'll protect the infrastructure that powers Amazon's global fulfillment network - the systems behind every warehouse, fulfillment center, air hub, and last-mile delivery operation.

You'll perform vulnerability assessments with business context, determine blast radius of security issues across large-scale environments, and drive risk reduction across thousands of accounts and services. You will build AI-powered automation that scales security operations, apply machine learning to vulnerability triage and asset classification, conduct threat hunting, manage security exceptions, and work with engineering teams to ensure timely remediation of risks. Your work directly protects the operational technology and cloud infrastructure that millions of packages depend on every day.

You are expected to deliver autonomously within your team's scope and begin to have cross-team influence. You will own end-to-end security outcomes for your area of responsibility, identify patterns across services, and build scalable mechanisms that reduce risk broadly - not just for individual findings. You will leverage AI and automation to transform how vulnerability management operates at scale, moving from reactive manual processes to intelligent, proactive security operations.

This role is ideal for a security engineer who combines technical depth with operational execution, has a passion for applying AI/ML to solve security challenges, and wants to drive outcomes across a complex, diverse infrastructure spanning cloud services, industrial control systems, and edge compute environments.

Key job responsibilities
AI-Driven Security Automation: Design, build, and deploy AI/ML-powered solutions to scale vulnerability management operations - including intelligent triage, automated severity contextualization, predictive asset classification, and natural language-driven remediation guidance generation.

Vulnerability Assessment & Triage: Perform vulnerability assessments with business context, evaluating blast radius and potential impact across accounts, services, and infrastructure. Contextualize scanner-reported severity against actual control environments to determine real-world exploitability and remediation priorities.

Detection Engineering: Engineer high-quality, scalable vulnerability detection mechanisms - including automated asset-to-vulnerability correlation, compliance monitoring pipelines (e.g., trade sanctions, regulatory requirements), and continuous scanning coverage across diverse environments.

Automated Workflows & Tooling: Design, build, and maintain automated workflows and tooling (Python, AI/ML) to reduce manual toil, improve response times, and enable the team to operate at scale across thousands of accounts and services.

Threat Hunting: Conduct proactive threat hunting across vulnerability and asset data to identify security risks, attack patterns, and gaps in coverage before they are exploited.

Cross-Team Remediation: Drive remediation outcomes by collaborating with engineering teams across multiple organizations - providing technical guidance, root-cause analysis, and remediation recommendations. Influence partner teams without direct authority through technical credibility and clear communication.

Campaign Management: Own security remediation campaigns end-to-end including scoping affected owners, progress tracking, stakeholder communication, and risk tradeoff analysis across large distributed environments.

Exception & Risk Management: Manage security exception processes, evaluating risk justifications, coordinating approvals, and tracking compliance with exception conditions. Make judgment calls on severity reclassification where compensating controls demonstrably reduce risk.

Code Review: Perform security code reviews, root-cause analysis on high-severity findings, and architecture assessments. Validate remediation fixes in code and identify systemic vulnerability patterns that can be prevented upstream.

Operational Excellence: Maintain operational metrics, reporting dashboards, and executive-level risk summaries. Participate in periodic on-call responsibilities for continuous monitoring and time-sensitive vulnerability response.

Documentation & Knowledge Transfer: Maintain clear documentation of processes, review outcomes, security decisions, and runbooks. Mentor team members on technical approaches and operational procedures.

A day in the life
As a Security Engineer II in CLS, you will collaborate with builder teams across Amazon's logistics infrastructure to keep operations secure while enabling rapid innovation. In a given day, you might be:

Building an AI-powered pipeline that automatically triages incoming vulnerability findings, contextualizes their severity against the control environment, and generates personalized remediation guidance for affected teams

Assessing the blast radius of a newly disclosed Critical vulnerability across industrial control systems at hundreds of sites, determining which devices are actually exploitable versus protected by compensating controls

Training a classification model to predict asset ownership across millions of devices, replacing weeks of manual attribution with automated, accurate assignment

Working directly with an engineering team to validate that their proposed code fix correctly addresses the root cause of a security finding

Designing an automated notification workflow that reaches hundreds of system owners with actionable remediation instructions before a vulnerability campaign deadline

Handling a high-severity security escalation involving a nation-state advisory targeting operational technology, sizing the exposure, and coordinating remediation

Presenting vulnerability metrics and AI-driven risk insights to security leadership

Our team ensures security risks are identified, tracked, and remediated within defined timelines, working at the intersection of cloud security, operational technology, and vulnerability management. We partner closely with detection teams, campaign owners, and engineering organizations across the company.

Our team is investing heavily in AI/ML to transform security operations: predictive asset classification, intelligent vulnerability triage, automated severity contextualization, and natural language remediation guidance. title: Network Development Engineer , GCNA-D , AWS Internet Edge
descriptionHtml:
Do you like to design, operate, and implement networks of large scale? Would you like your work to play a key role to support all aspects of connectivity to/from Amazon and the outside world, as well as the connectivity between Amazon’s data centers and services to design and architect innovation so networks are fail-proof, infinitely scale and grow?

The AWS GCNA (Global Connectivity and Network Availability) Organization is looking for a Network Development Engineer to join our EDGE team. Network Development Engineers partner with our broader Infrastructure organization on configurations standards and tools, and collaborate with Systems and Software Engineers to ensure fast, smooth roll-out of new designs and products, and also deploy and sustain networking software tools.

AWS GCNA (Global Connectivity and Network Availability) is the backbone that connects the global AWS network. Focused on managing the internet traffic that allows users to access their information and applications regardless of where they are in the world. GCNA is responsible for building and designing a complex backbone network that allows internet traffic to flow efficiently between data centers and customers.

If you like to work with new technologies, optimizing existing technology, and have experience participating in network/systems support for a large-scale enterprise or service provider environment, we would like to meet you. Your work will play a key role in driving the stability and sustainability of next-generation IP networks.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Key job responsibilities
Network Development Engineers perform high quality network and/or systems operations, deployments, scaling, technology refresh, sustaining engineering, best practices application, optimization, internal/external customer interactions, and produce appropriate technical documentation.
• Create and implement changes on the network according to our change management standards.
• Work closely with our automation teams in defining the tools that allows us to scale at higher volume.
• Lead network projects in the areas of networking sustaining engineering, network deployment/implementation, network scaling, technology refresh, best practices application, and/or network optimization.
• Maintain Amazon Web Services’ next generation networks for significant AWS customers by providing critical network support to diagnose, mitigate impact, and resolve large-scale networking events.
• Operate and troubleshoot network routing, interconnectivity, platforms, performance, and configurations issues; including necessary low-level application interaction, Unix systems, and new age networking software tools.
• Drive and support innovation from Top of Rack to the Network Border, and everything in between.
• Partner with our broader Network/Infrastructure organization in the areas of network engineering, configurations standards, and tools.
• Work closely with our Network/Systems/Software Engineering teams to ensure fast, smooth roll-out of new designs and products, as well as, assist with deployment and sustaining of networking software tools.
• Maintain standards across the networking toolset and ensure that we are fully compliant to those standards and policies.
• Deliver simple, sustainable, and repeatable solutions and processes.
• Collaborate with the highest tier escalation engineers/resolvers.
• Create and review documentation and process regarding network implementation/deployments, recurring issues, new standard operating procedures, knowledge transfer material, etc.

A day in the life
Engineers in the GCNA-D organization have a wide range of responsibilities: we evolve routing policy, implement traffic engineering solutions, grow our peering footprint, secure the “front door” from bad actors on the Internet, and architect the hardware platforms and network design to support any Amazon product that needs to reach end-users worldwide. Our infrastructure moves terabits of traffic to and from the Internet at any given moment, and represents one of the largest edge surface areas in the world, requiring complex solutions to ensure that capacity always stays ahead of demand. To accomplish that, our engineers develop automation, write software, and work with a wide range of partner teams to continually improve and automate our Internet connectivity in areas such as capacity delivery, configuration deployment, impairment detection, and traffic optimization. Internet Edge engineers make decisions on both a day-to-day and long-term strategic basis, which carry a large amount of responsibility and impact across all of Amazon’s products.
• Work in a 24x7 team on call rotation, with ability to drive into workplace for critical events/needs.
• Manage customers during problem resolution and operating efficiently under pressure.
• Sit at the computer during scheduled work hours with appropriate breaks while maintaining a high level of alertness and attention to detail.
• Travel to data center/network sites and Amazon/customer offices as needed.

About the team
GCNA-D provides high-performing Internet connectivity for a wide range of use cases, such as retail (amazon.com), video streaming (Prime Video), content delivery (CloudFront), DNS (Route53), AWS services (such as EC2/S3), consumer devices (such as FireTV/Kindle/Echo), and more.

Within AWS Networking, the GCNA-D organization is responsible for connecting Amazon to the global Internet. With connections to thousands of unique external networks in hundreds of locations across the world, our mission is to deliver an Internet connectivity experience that sets the global standard for performance, availability, security, and cost, making Amazon the clear choice for our customers’ needs.

title: Security Engineer II, Stores AppSec
descriptionHtml:
Amazon’s Stores AppSec Team is seeking a Security Engineer to help keep Amazon secure for its customers. title: Facilities Operations Centre (FOC) Engineer, AWS
descriptionHtml:
G'day! You've found an opportunity that could define your next chapter.

Applicants must be Australian citizens and hold or be eligible to obtain an Australian Government Security Clearance with the ability to successfully complete an Organisational Suitability Assessment. More information regarding security clearances can be found at https://www.agsva.gov.au/.

The Mission - Why This Program, Why Now?

You're joining at the defining moment of one of the most significant technology programmes Australia has ever undertaken. This programme will build and operate the dedicated cloud giving Australia's national security community and its allies the capability to see more, share more, innovate and act faster than ever before.

Your Role in the Mission

Imagine being the eyes and ears of one of the world's most advanced data centre ecosystems. As a Facilities Operations Centre (FOC) team member, you'll sit at the nerve centre of 24/7 infrastructure monitoring the place where every electrical pulse, every mechanical system, and every critical alert converges into a single, unified picture.

This isn't passive monitoring. This is active stewardship of the physical backbone that powers innovation for millions. When a Large Scale Event unfolds or a Critical Site Event demands immediate coordination, you'll be the calm, decisive voice that brings teams together and drives resolution. You'll bridge the gap between IT infrastructure and facilities systems, understanding how these two worlds interlock to deliver unbreakable reliability.

You're joining a team that's being built from the ground up a newly developed capability where your ideas, your processes, and your standards will become the foundation. You'll help shape communication protocols, develop tools that amplify team performance, and drive a culture of operational excellence that ripples across the entire organisation.

Benefits
- Learning & development - AWS training and certification support, access to internal learning platforms.
- Health, income protection and life cover - Amazon subsidises private health insurance premiums, and group salary continuance and life insurance are included at no cost to you
- Military differential pay launching in Australia - Australian employees taking defence reserve leave may receive up to 52 weeks of military differential pay to help cover the difference in pay while serving
- Employee Assistance Program - Free, confidential support 24 hours a day, 7 days a week for you and your family - mental health, financial coaching, legal questions, and everyday life events.
- Family-building benefit - Access to Maven for fertility treatment, adoption support, surrogacy, and parenting coaching
- Amazon Extras & employee discount - cashback and discounts across hundreds of retail, fitness, travel, and lifestyle partners.

Key job responsibilities
You'll be the operational heartbeat of our data centre infrastructure — monitoring, coordinating, and driving excellence across every shift.

Your core mission centres on real-time monitoring of the Amazon facilities infrastructure platform, where you'll interpret signals from electrical and mechanical systems to maintain optimal performance. You'll serve as the trusted point of contact for both internal engineering teams and external partners, ensuring seamless communication flows during normal operations and critical events alike.

When emergencies strike, you'll step into a coordination role that demands clarity under pressure. You'll facilitate recovery efforts during Large Scale Events and Critical Site Events, bringing together the right people with the right information at the right time. Your post-mortem contributions will turn incidents into insights, strengthening the entire operation with every lesson learned.

Beyond reactive response, you'll be a builder. You'll help develop communication and escalation protocols that sharpen team performance, and contribute to creating tools that make the entire FOC more effective. Your meticulous record-keeping will ensure continuity across shifts and provide the data foundation for continuous improvement.

This is shift work in a 24/7 environment.

A day in the life
Your day begins with a handover that's more than a formality - it's a transfer of situational awareness. You absorb the state of play across the entire facility ecosystem which systems are nominal, what's being watched, and where attention might be needed next.

Screens illuminate with real-time data from electrical and mechanical systems across the data centre fleet. You're reading the rhythm of the infrastructure - power distribution, cooling performance, environmental conditions - identifying patterns before they become problems. A temperature anomaly in one zone catches your eye; you investigate, correlate with recent maintenance activity, and determine it's within expected parameters. Documented. Noted. Moving on.

Mid-shift, an alert escalates. A critical system requires coordinated response. You activate the communication protocol you helped design, reaching the right engineers within minutes. As the facilitator, you're tracking actions, updating stakeholders, and ensuring nothing falls through the cracks. The issue resolves cleanly - another testament to preparation meeting execution.

Between events, you're collaborating with peers on improving a monitoring dashboard, drafting a proposal for a new escalation pathway, or reviewing post-mortem findings from last week's incident. You're not just maintaining the status quo - you're actively raising the bar.

As your shift closes, you compile a comprehensive handover that gives the incoming team everything they need to maintain continuity. You leave knowing that your vigilance kept critical systems running, your coordination brought teams together, and your ideas are making the operation stronger every day.

Basic qualifications

- 2+ years of electrical and mechanical facilities maintenance experience
- 2+ years of data center engineering or operations experience
- 1+ years of experience working with Building and/or Electrical Platform Management Systems

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of data center engineering or operations experience
- Strong verbal and written communication skills and strong Microsoft Office skills (Word, Excel, Access)
- Ability to maintain SLAs through the implementation of proactive issue detection and reporting tools and ability to follow and complete support procedures, system documentation, and issue tracking entries, root cause analysis and complex problem solving skills
