title: Software Development Manager, AWS Infrastructure Supply Chain
descriptionHtml:
Role Overview
As an L6 Software Development Manager in AWS Infrastructure Supply Chain, you will define the strategic vision for your team, establish a roadmap, and successfully deliver software that powers one of the world's largest and most complex physical infrastructure supply chains. You will independently manage a team of SDEs building large-scale distributed systems that enable AWS to procure, manufacture, ship, and deploy hundreds of thousands of server and network racks into data centers globally across AMER, EMEA, APAC, and GOVT regions.

Strategic Ownership
Define the strategic vision for your team, partnering effectively with customers and stakeholders across the supply chain lifecycle — from demand planning and material supportability to manufacturing, logistics, and DC deployment.
Establish a roadmap and successfully deliver software that executes that vision, aligned with the end-to-end supply chain needs spanning systems like S&OP POR, RP3, Build Planner, Fulfillment Planner, and the Infrastructure Control Tower.
Make crisp, independent decisions about what projects move forward and in what priority order, balancing competing priorities across demand forecasting, capacity planning, fulfillment optimization, and observability.
Write narratives, PR/FAQs, and other strategic documentation to drive alignment and decision-making.
Technical Domain
Your team will work on one or more of the following areas:

Real-time observability platforms — powering the Infrastructure Control Tower that tracks 100K+ active demands through stage progression, dwell times, blocker reason codes, and checkpoint milestones.
AI/ML-driven forecasting — demand planning, ETA prediction, and supply-demand matching across 130+ component categories and 1,400+ Superset Fungibility Groups (SFGs).
Optimization engines — capacity planning systems that match server/network demand (converted to kW) against DC power supply at lineup, breaker, site, and meter-site levels.
Multi-agent orchestration systems — coordinating fulfillment across vendors, manufacturing sites, and DC positions in priority order (ML → Network → Non-ML).
Data pipelines — processing millions of events daily across the fulfillment pipeline from Purchase Request through to Handoff.
People Leadership
Independently manage a team of SDEs; hire the right mix of engineers to accomplish team goals.
Assess SDE performance effectively; manage both high and low performers and take effective action addressing employee concerns.
Hire, develop, and promote SDEs, delegating appropriately based on the strength and development objectives of individuals on your team.
Build an effective development process that consistently delivers software with minimal defects and system disruption.
Customer & Operational Excellence
Define metrics to measure customer experience, team development progress, and operational excellence across the supply chain systems your team owns.
Establish customer engagement mechanisms to stay connected to the needs of internal customers — service teams (EC2, S3, EBS), supply planners, manufacturing partners, and logistics operators.
Ensure your team adheres to SLAs and effectively manages software operations.
Proactively identify risks and bring them to the attention of your manager, customers, and stakeholders with mitigation plans before they become roadblocks. Know when to escalate to Senior Leaders.
Deliver Results
Consistently deliver software with minimal defects and system disruption.
Improve the quality of software owned by your team and operational performance metrics under your leadership.
Communicate ideas effectively, both verbally and in writing, to all types of audiences — from engineering peers to senior leadership.


A day in the life
Strategic Vision & Roadmap
Define the strategic vision for your team within the supply chain domain — whether that's demand planning, fulfillment optimization, manufacturing observability, or capacity planning
Establish and execute a roadmap that aligns with the end-to-end supply chain lifecycle, translating business needs into engineering deliverables
Make crisp, independent decisions about project prioritization, balancing competing demands across systems like RP3, Fulfillment Planner, Build Planner, and Control Tower
Author narratives, PR/FAQs, and strategic documents to drive alignment with leadership and stakeholders
Technical Delivery & Operational Excellence
Deliver high-quality software consistently with minimal defects and system disruption across large-scale distributed systems processing millions of events daily
Manage software operations effectively — ensuring uptime, reliability, and performance for systems tracking 100K+ active demands
Define and monitor metrics for team development progress, customer experience, and operational excellence (e.g., stage dwell times, on-track/off-track KPIs, manufacturing output trends)
Drive continuous improvement — improve software quality and operational performance metrics under your leadership
People Management & Development
Independently manage a team of SDEs — hire the right mix of engineers to accomplish team goals
Assess SDE performance and manage both high and low performers with effective action
Hire, develop, and promote SDEs — build a talent pipeline and export talent across the organization
Delegate appropriately — assign tasks based on individual strengths and development objectives, stretching engineers into areas like AI/ML forecasting, optimization engines, and real-time observability
Customer Engagement & Stakeholder Management
Partner effectively with customers and stakeholders — internal service teams (EC2, S3, EBS), supply planners, GSMs, manufacturing partners (Jabil, Foxconn, Quanta), and logistics operators
Establish customer engagement mechanisms to stay connected to evolving supply chain needs
Define metrics to measure customer experience across the fulfillment pipeline — from Purchase Request through Handoff
Risk Management & Escalation
Proactively identify risks and bring them to the attention of your manager, customers, and stakeholders with mitigation plans before they become roadblocks
Know when to escalate to Senior Leaders — especially critical in a domain where delays in manufacturing, material shortages, or DC readiness issues can cascade across the global fleet
Ensure your team adheres to SLAs across all systems and operational commitments
Culture & Process
Build an effective development process that enables sustainable, high-quality delivery
Use mechanisms, not good intentions — establish trust-and-verify systems for operational excellence, code quality, and team health
Drive root cause analysis — instill a culture of asking "5 whys," fixing to root cause, and adding missing metrics after incidents

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of engineering team management experience
- 7+ years of engineering experience
- 8+ years of leading the definition and development of multi tier web services experience
- Knowledge of engineering practices and patterns for the full software/hardware/networks development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, certification, and livesite operations
- Experience partnering with product or program management teams
- Experience designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in communicating with users, other technical teams, and senior leadership to collect requirements, describe software product features, technical designs, and product strategy
- Experience in recruiting, hiring, mentoring/coaching and managing teams of Software Engineers to improve their skills, and make them more effective, product software engineers

title: Internal Audit Manager, AWS Infrastructure Operations
descriptionHtml:
At Amazon we're working to be the most customer-centric company on earth, and that includes protecting our customers and their data. To get there, we need exceptionally talented, and driven people. Global Internal Audit is a fast paced, dynamic team. We are one of many mechanisms at the company with the aim of continuous improvement. We focus on business and operational processes and the technologies that support them, looking for risks that could harm the company.

We seek an Internal Audit Manager to join our AWS Internal Audit team and own the **Infrastructure** audit domain — covering data centers and operational infrastructure that underpins AWS's global cloud platform.

You will be part of a team that values business depth, technical curiosity, and the ability to connect audit findings to business outcomes. The ideal candidate brings **strong finance and accounting experience** and can assess how infrastructure controls impact revenue integrity, financial reporting, and operational resilience.

This is a high-visibility role where you will lead the planning, scoping, execution, and reporting of audits across AWS's infrastructure operations. You will dig deep into complex business and technical environments, identify the full range of risks, and translate them into actionable findings for senior leadership — including the CFO and Audit Committee of the Board of Directors.

To be successful in this role, you will demonstrate high judgement, clear communication and a consistent track record of delivering results. You will thrive in a fast-paced environment, work autonomously in an ambiguous environment, and understand the importance of operationalizing key mechanisms and management reporting related to quality and professional practice standards.

Up to 20% travel may be required, including international travel.

This role can be based in Seattle or Arlington.

Key job responsibilities
- Lead end-to-end audits from risk assessment and scoping through fieldwork, reporting, and remediation tracking — managing multiple concurrent engagements

- Design and execute Risk & Control Matrices (RCMs) for infrastructure-related audits, ensuring testing objectives are aligned with the most significant risks

- Draft audit findings that clearly articulate the risk, control gap, root cause, business impact, and recommended remediation — with proper context for both the audit report and Audit Committee (AC) memo

- Ensure all deliverables meet Internal Audit's quality bar with minimal revision

Basic qualifications

- 6+ years of compliance, audit or risk management experience
- 5+ years of program or project Management experience
- Knowledge of Microsoft Office products and applications at an advanced level
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent

Preferred qualifications

- Project Management Professional (PMP) or equivalent certification
- Experience leveraging technology and implementing lean principles / Six Sigma methodologies to drive process improvements or equivalent
- Master's degree or equivalent

descriptionHtml:
The Amazon Web Services Professional Services (AWS ProServe) team is seeking an experienced Delivery Practice Manager (DPM). In this role, you'll manage a team of ProServe Delivery Consultants while supporting AWS enterprise customers through transformative projects. You'll leverage your IT and/or Management Consulting background to serve as a strategic advisor to customers, partners, and internal AWS teams.

As a DPM you will be responsible for building and managing a team of Delivery Consultants and or Engagement Managers working with customers and partners to architect and implement innovative solutions. You’ll routinely engage with Director, C-level executives, and governing boards, whilst being responsible for opportunity capture and driving engagement delivery. You’ll work closely with partner teams; drive business development initiatives through thought leadership; provide portfolio guidance and oversight; and meet and exceed customer satisfaction targets. As a DPM you are primarily focused directly or through their teams, on understanding and defining business outcomes for customers by building trust, identifying applicable AWS Professional Services offerings, and creating proposals and SOW’s.

Your experience gained leading teams within the technology sector, will equip you with the ability to optimize team performance through implementing tailored people development plans, ensuring your teams are aligned to customer needs, and have the skills and capacity to address customer outcomes. Possessing the ability to translate technical concepts into business value for customers and then talk in technical depth with teams, you will cultivate strong customer, Amazon Global Sales (AGS), and ProServe team relationships which enables exceptional business performance. title: Software Dev Engineer, AWS Billing
descriptionHtml:
Build the full-stack experiences that help millions of AWS customers understand and optimize their cloud spending. We own the console surfaces and services behind AWS Cost Explorer, BCM Dashboards, and AWS Budgets — and we're evolving them fast.

As an SDE 2, you'll own features end-to-end — from frontend React components to backend Java services to the operational health of what you ship. You'll design solutions to difficult problems: making cost data intuitive at massive scale, building managed dashboard experiences, and migrating millions of customers to modernized console architectures. You won't just implement specs — you'll work directly with product and UX to understand customer pain, propose approaches, and ship iteratively.

What makes this role compelling: · You'll work across the full stack — React/TypeScript frontends, Java/AWS backend services, CDK infrastructure — with real ownership, not ticket work · The problems are genuinely hard: multi-partition deployments, cost allocation at scale, and UX for data that is inherently complex · Our team uses AI tools daily as development partners · You'll mentor others, lead design reviews, and influence the team's technical direction — this is a role where your voice shapes the architecture

This isn't a maintenance role. We're actively rebuilding and modernizing core billing console experiences while launching net-new dashboard and AI-driven cost insight products. You're joining while the hard decisions are still being made.

Key job responsibilities
· Design and build full-stack features across AWS Cost Explorer, BCM Dashboards, and AWS Budgets — React/TypeScript frontends and Java backend services serving millions of AWS customers. · Own features through the full software lifecycle — from customer problem discovery and technical design through implementation, testing, deployment, and production operations. · Solve difficult problems at scale — cost data visualization, managed dashboard experiences, and console migration for millions of existing customers across multi-partition deployments. · Author technical design documents, lead design reviews, and provide meaningful code reviews that raise the team's code bar. · Drive operational excellence — own alarms, monitoring, runbooks, and on-call rotations for live production services; resolve root causes of systemic issues. · Mentor engineers, onboard new team members, and foster an inclusive environment where diverse perspectives shape technical decisions. · Collaborate with product management and UX to deeply understand customer pain points and translate them into incremental, shippable solutions. · Contribute to team technical strategy and roadmap — help decide where to invest, what to modernize, and what to deprecate. · Write clean, testable, production-ready code using AI-native development practices — leveraging GenAI tools as daily development partners.

A day in the life
You start the morning reviewing a PR from a teammate who's building a new budget threshold visualization — you leave feedback on the API contract and suggest a simpler state management approach on the frontend. After standup, you spend an hour pairing with a junior engineer who's stuck on a CDK deployment issue across partitions.

Mid-morning, you dive into your main project: designing the backend service changes needed to support a new managed dashboard feature. You sketch out the API, think through edge cases (what happens when a customer has hundreds of linked accounts with different dashboard configurations?), and draft a design doc to share with the team.

After lunch, you notice an alarm firing for elevated latency on one of your team's Cost Explorer APIs. You pull up the dashboards, identify a query pattern that's inefficient for a new customer segment, and open a ticket to fix it — writing a quick runbook entry so the next on-call engineer won't have to re-investigate.

Late afternoon, you join a brainstorm with the team about where AI could improve the customer experience — could we use GenAI to help customers interpret cost trends, surface optimization recommendations, or simplify dashboard creation? You prototype a quick proof-of-concept using the same AI tools you've been coding with all day.

You end the day pushing code for a React component you've been building — a widget that makes multi-account cost trends scannable at a glance. It's behind a feature flag, shipping incrementally.

No two days are identical, but most combine: hands-on coding across the stack, mentoring, design thinking, operational awareness, and exploring how AI can make both our development and our customers' experience better.

About the team
We own the console experiences that millions of AWS customers use daily to understand and manage their cloud costs — Cost Explorer, BCM Dashboards, and AWS Budgets. We're not just maintaining these products; we're actively modernizing them while building net-new managed dashboard experiences and exploring how AI can fundamentally change how customers interact with cost data. We think about where GenAI fits — in how we build (AI-assisted development is part of our daily workflow) and in what we build (surfacing insights, simplifying complex data, making cost management conversational rather than dashboard-heavy). The culture is direct, collaborative, and low-ego. We ship iteratively, own what we build end-to-end, and invest in each other's growth. If you want a team where your ideas shape the product direction and your code ships to millions, this is it.

- 2+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred qualifications

- 2+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience

descriptionHtml:
We are seeking an Applied Scientist to contribute to research and development of novel security validation and monitoring techniques for AI systems at scale. You will own and contribute to four critical work-streams:

1. Real-Time Agent Monitoring
Design and implement scientific approaches for continuous behavioral analysis of AI agents in production—detecting anomalous actions, prompt injection exploitation, and policy violations in real time.

2. Protection & Automated Remediation
Invent and deliver novel protection technologies and automated remediation techniques building on research in security, cryptography, privacy, automated reasoning, and others domains, to enable safe and secure agentic AI models and AI applications.

3. AI Application and Capabilities Validation
Invent and deliver scalable methodologies for security testing of AI applications and AI capabilities (e.g. MCP, skills), including adversarial robustness evaluation, safety guardrail bypass detection, tool-use authorization boundaries, and trust boundary verification.

4. AI Asset Discovery & Inventory
Research and build scalable techniques to automatically discover, identify, and catalog all AI-enabled applications, services, and capabilities across the company—maintaining a comprehensive, continuously updated database of AI assets.

Invent

• Deliver solutions that are inventive, maintainable, scalable, and extensible.
Influence

title: Sr Technical Program Manager, Antenna Fleet Operations, Amazon Leo
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is launching a constellation of Low Earth Orbit satellites that will provide low-latency, high-speed broadband connectivity to unserved and underserved communities around the world.

We are looking for a Sr Technical Program Manager to join Amazon Leo's Antenna Fleet Operations team. Our engineers keep a globally distributed fleet of Ground Gateway Antennas healthy and serving customers; you will own the programs that keep that work organized and moving. You will be deep in the day-to-day: running the RMA process for failed hardware, driving open issues with vendors to resolution, and turning fleet and ticket data into the reporting the team runs on. You will independently run the mechanisms behind three areas: the logistics that get engineers and parts to gateway sites, the reporting that shows how the fleet is performing, and the vendor coordination that field work depends on. This role rewards someone who is comfortable with data and tooling like Grafana, SQL, Excel, and AI tools. Using them to organize information, build reports, and surface trends. You will work closely with senior operations engineers and systems engineers to translate the realities of field work into programs that scale as the fleet grows.

This position may require access to information, technology, or hardware that is subject to export control laws and regulations, including the Export Administration Regulations (EAR) and the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR). Employment in this position is contingent upon obtaining any required export licenses or other approvals from the United States government. As such, the successful candidate must be eligible to obtain any necessary export licenses or approvals based on their nationality, citizenship, and any other factors considered by the applicable export control regulations.

Export Control Requirement: Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.


Key job responsibilities
Build and maintain the recurring reporting and dashboards for fleet health, ticket aging, mean time to repair, RMA cycle time, and campaign progress, using tools such as Grafana, SQL, and Excel to organize the data and surface notable failure patterns to the engineering team.

Own vendor and partner coordination, tracking milestones, deliverables, and open items, holding partners to commitments, and driving open vendor issues to resolution before they affect field work.

Own the RMA process for failed antenna hardware end to end: opening return authorizations, tracking units through the vendor repair and replacement loop, chasing status, managing warranty claims, and closing the loop when parts return to service.

Coordinate the logistics behind field work and define the program that keeps it running: equipment shipping, on-site scheduling with local operators and partners, and the mechanisms that keep field visits unblocked.

Own antenna fault remediation and maintenance tracking across a globally distributed gateway fleet, keeping ticket status, ownership, and aging current and accurate.

Plan and schedule maintenance campaigns, software upgrade deployment, and hardware retrofits in partnership with the engineering team, sequencing work across sites and managing the tradeoffs.

Own the team's program cadence mechanics: meeting agendas, notes, action item tracking, and follow-up to closure.

Identify manual processes that would benefit from better tooling or automation, and lead the effort to improve them.


A day in the life
You will start with the state of the fleet: what is broken, what is degraded, what is scheduled, and what is blocked. You will work with operations engineers to keep the plan accurate and correctly sequenced, chase down the open RMAs, shipments, and partner confirmations that field visits are waiting on, and make sure nothing quietly falls off the list. You will keep the reporting current -- pulling fleet and ticket data together in Grafana, SQL, Excel, and AI tools -- so problems surface while they are still small, flag the patterns worth a closer look, and continuously sharpen the mechanisms the team runs on. You will own your programs end to end and be the person the team trusts to keep the operation moving.

About the team
The Ground Systems team is responsible for the architecture, design, build, installation, and operation of globally located Amazon Leo Ground and TTnC terminals. Our Ground Gateways enable high data rate, low latency communications between Amazon Leo points of presence and our Low Earth Orbit Satellite constellation. title: Engineer Operations Technician , DCEO Operations Team
descriptionHtml:
Join our dynamic team and become a critical guardian of technological infrastructure! As a Data Center Engineering Technician, you'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of mission-critical technology infrastructure, ensuring seamless operations that power global digital experiences. Your expertise will directly contribute to maintaining an extraordinary 99.999% uptime, keeping the digital world running smoothly and efficiently.

Engineering Technicians are Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting. They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot, Data Center Operation’s Mission Critical Facilities, which includes stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, as well as three phase electrical systems such as: switch gear, UPSs, PDUs, wet cell batteries and associated systems, CRAC, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers/water chemical system, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, & motors.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

NOTE: Amazon does not sponsor for immigration, including for H-1B, TN, and other non-immigrant visas, for this role.

NOTE: Lump sum stipend will be provided to eligible candidates who relocate for this position.

Key job responsibilities
Daily building rounds to monitor and record information from electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment to ensure 24/7 reliability and availability

Monitor Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Management System (EPMS)

Assist in troubleshooting of facility and rack-level events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLA)

Perform rack installs and rack decommissioning within internal SLA

Perform PM, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and repair of electrical and mechanical equipment

Technical writing to support change management program

Monitor daily work requests and manage to resolution, and execute projects from conception to completion

On-site support of contractors, sub-contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices, procedures & local legislation

Work schedule changes depending on specific site needs. Shifts can be up to 12 hours and may rotate on a predefined schedule. Some locations have on-call rotations.

Role may support more than one location/site.

Physical Requirements:

Willingness and demonstrated ability to work in the following physical conditions with reasonable accommodations:

Regularly lift and/or move up to 39 pounds independently

Participate in group lifts for 40+ pounds

Maintain balance and perform construction tasks while on a ladder

Regularly walk, use hands and fingers, handle or feel, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl, climb stairs, twist, bend, work above shoulders, grasp, carry, push and pull objects into position

Work in an environment requiring provided ear protection

This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.

Essential Requirements:

Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed

Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational

Travel frequency will vary based on business needs and operational status of assigned facility

Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs.

This role acts as Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment preventative maintenance (PM) and troubleshooting, reporting to a site’s Data Center Facility Manager (FM). They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot mission-critical data center facility equipment including stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, 3 phase electrical systems such as switchgear, UPS units, PDUs, and wet cell batteries and associated systems. Mechanical equipment includes CRAHU units, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers, water systems, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, and motors. Additional support equipment is included in the scope of the role which includes fire/life safety equipment, building automation systems, and general facilities equipment.

- 2+ years of electrical and mechanical facilities maintenance, or 2+ years of electrical facilities maintenance and 1+ years of mechanical facilities maintenance experience
- 2+ years of Microsoft Office products and applications experience
- Work flexible schedule including weekends, nights, and holidays

Preferred qualifications

Externally, this role takes ownership of managing utility interactions, coordinating efforts between real estate, engineering and planning teams in site evaluation, project engineering, scheduling and budgeting, including influencing and contracting with the utility, EPC and/or Owner’s Engineer to meet AWS’ needs. The individual will work in an integrated team to implement a strategy that meets and exceeds AWS’ energy program requirements while delivering projects on time, with tangible reliability and cost-saving results.

The ideal candidate will possess a strong energy background and a proven track record of developing and delivering on innovative energy projects. Experience working with regulated electric utilities to develop, contract and deliver medium and high voltage power infrastructure, including related tariffs and supply agreements, is a must. In this role, you will negotiate and execute power supply contracts across AWS regions and create innovative supply structures that integrate our renewable energy portfolio and Support the growth of clean energy via utility partnerships. The right candidate will have a demonstrated ability to think strategically about the business, operations, and technical challenges, with the skill-set to drive tactical execution of project schedules, contracts, initiatives and team goals.

The candidate must have experience in reliably driving initiatives to completion in high speed, constrained and ambiguous environments, with practice in escalating and reporting to many organization leaders and teams across multiple levels. By establishing and growing business and technical relationships, and managing the day-to-day interactions with these partners, you will be responsible for ensuring energy requirements needed to support AWS’s global infrastructure expansion are met.

Key job responsibilities
• Lead the development and execution of a comprehensive utilities strategy for AWS data centers for AMER regions.

• Collaborate with internal teams and regulated utilities on the implementation and management of energy projects to meet the business timelines.

• Responsible for completing due diligence on in-market opportunities and developing those opportunities into cost savings for the business.

Think like a group CEO of Generation, transmission, distribution and backup power companies. We are the ones who are developing the Vision, Strategy and Execution plan of what the future looks like and helping every one in the Energy Value chain to do things differently.

title: Sr. Technical Infrastructure Program Manager, QC Construction, North America Quick Commerce
descriptionHtml:
Application deadline: Nov 7, 2026

The Quick Commerce (QC) Construction team is looking for a Technical Infrastructure Program Manager III (TIPM III) to own the construction delivery strategy and technical construction standards for QC’s rapidly scaling North America network.
QC deploys multiple physical infrastructure formats, including Stand Alone and Co-Located sites, where technical requirements vary by site type, existing building conditions, infrastructure capacity, and deployment scenario.

This role operates at the intersection of engineering design and field execution, defining how new and evolving QC infrastructure is built, determining whether technical designs and construction approaches are appropriate for specific deployment scenarios, and creating repeatable deployment standards where established processes do not yet exist.

The TIPM III will develop and maintain construction specifications, technical execution standards, GC performance requirements, and change-management mechanisms that govern QC construction delivery. You will use technical domain knowledge across mechanical, electrical, refrigeration, fire protection, and building infrastructure to identify constructability and integration risks, challenge technical assumptions, evaluate deployment alternatives, and provide field-based feedback to upstream teams for product and specification improvement.

This role goes beyond executing an approved construction plan. You will define and continuously improve the technical deployment process itself, translating lessons from active builds into scalable infrastructure standards that improve speed, quality, cost, and constructability across the QC portfolio.


Key job responsibilities
• Own and continuously improve QC construction infrastructure deployment standards across formats.
• Develop construction execution standards, specifications, technical scopes, GC performance requirements, and quality standards.
• Define new infrastructure deployment processes where established construction methods or standards do not yet exist.
• Evaluate technical designs, materials, sequencing, and construction approaches for specific deployment scenarios, considering constructability, infrastructure constraints, cost, and operational requirements.
• Partner with Design Engineering, Pre-Construction, SUEX, WHS, Operations, and external partners to resolve complex infrastructure build issues.
• Lead technical development of new delivery models, including design-build, establishing scalable governance and performance mechanisms.
• Root-cause recurring field issues and translate findings into upstream engineering, specification, and deployment-process improvements.
• Drive value engineering and technical cost optimization across the construction portfolio.
• Establish change-management mechanisms ensuring technical changes and field learnings are consistently incorporated into future deployments.
• Develop mechanisms to benchmark construction quality, GC technical performance, and recurring infrastructure failure modes.
• Serve as the technical escalation point for complex construction issues, determining whether failures stem from execution, design, specification, or deployment methodology.


A day in the life
You start by reviewing shortlisted sites, assessing infrastructure capacity, existing building conditions, and technical constraints to inform site selection and determine fit for QC deployment. You partner with internal teams to evaluate constructability, infrastructure requirements, cost, and technical risk before sites move forward. Later, you pressure-test the design-build model and identify opportunities to improve technical standards. When a Construction Manager escalates a complex field issue, you evaluate whether the root cause is design, specification, or execution and determine the appropriate path forward. Your work turns site and construction learnings into repeatable improvements for future QC deployments.

About the team
The QC Construction team builds and retrofit multiple site formats across varying building conditions, jurisdictions, and infrastructure configurations supporting Amazon’s Quick Commerce across North America. TIPMs work alongside Construction Managers, Pre-Construction, Design Engineering, SUEX, WHS, Finance, Operations, and external partners to develop scalable construction solutions. While Construction Managers lead day-to-day construction execution, TIPMs define and improve the technical standards that guide how sites are built: developing specifications, solving infrastructure challenges, evaluating construction approaches, and translating field findings into repeatable standards that improve speed, quality, cost, and constructability across the QC network.

Basic qualifications

- Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership

- Experience managing general contractors, A&E consultants, or technical vendors, including RFPs, bidding, change orders, RFIs, submittals, quality control, and technical issue resolution.
- Experience developing or implementing construction specifications, technical standards, scopes of work, deployment requirements, or construction quality systems.
- Experience evaluating technical designs and infrastructure constraints to determine fit for specific deployment scenarios.
- Experience identifying and resolving infrastructure build issues across mechanical, electrical, refrigeration, fire protection, or related building systems.
- Experience defining or improving technical deployment processes and translating field findings into scalable standards.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience developing new infrastructure deployment processes or technical standards where established solutions did not previously exist.
- Experience with design-build delivery models, infrastructure standardization, value engineering, or technical construction governance.
- Experience reading, interpreting, and developing construction drawings, specifications, technical scopes, and submittal documentation.

- Experience leveraging data and technology to identify systemic infrastructure issues and drive process improvement across a portfolio.
- Experience working across multiple site types, building conditions, jurisdictions, or infrastructure configurations.

title: ファシリティエンジニア - DCEO（データセンターエンジニアリング・オペレーションズ）
descriptionHtml:
DCEO (データセンターエンジニアリング・オペレーションズ) 部門では、ファシリティエンジニア・技術者を広く募集しています。本ポジションは、アマゾンウェブサービス（AWS）のデータセンターを支える、施設内の電力設備や冷却設備などを安定稼働させることが責務です。DCEO部門の一員としてサーバーやネットワークなどのIT機器を収容する施設を運用し、お客様のアプリケーションやWebサイトなどを24時間365日安定稼働することで、社会インフラに貢献できる業務です。 弊社は 2006 年の設立以来、クラウドコンピューティングのパイオニアとして、ITインフラの世界に変革をもたらしました。現在は世界中で何百ものデータセンターを運営しており、急成長中の新興企業、大企業、主要な政府機関など、何百万ものお客様をサポートしています。データセンターがあることで、日本だけでなく世界中でクラウドコンピューティングサービスが利用できるようになり、お客様に信頼していただいている弊社の革新的な技術にいつでもアクセスできるようになっているのです。 本ポジションでは、世界最大級のITインフラの維持管理業務に関わる事ができます。入社者にはデータセンターのキャリア形成に必要なトレーニングやスキルを提供します。データセンターでのキャリアにご興味ある方は是非ご応募ください！

Key job responsibilities
• データセンター施設内の機械及び電気設備の保守管理
• お客様のダウンタイムを最小限に抑えるための設備障害対応
• 設備の故障や保守、拡張等に伴う技術的な問題の調査、解決
• データセンターで使われている機器の設置や撤去

A day in the life
• データセンター内のオフィス、サーバー室、空調機械室、電気室等様々な場所を移動しながら、他のメンバーと一緒にお客様のためにクラウドコンピューティングを24時間365日稼働が継続できるよう取り組みます。

データセンターエンジニアリング・オペレーションズでは、日々安全とセキュリティ、そしてお客様に最高のクラウド体験を提供することに取り組んでいます。私たちはお客様のニーズとビジネス上の要求を満たすために、施設と設備の運用及び保守を担当しています。

私たちのインクルーシブな文化は、あなたがお客様に最高の結果をもたらすことを可能にします。私たちは従業員の多様性を称えるだけでなく、多様な働き方を称賛しています。

title: Senior Software Engineer, Graviton Software
descriptionHtml:
The AWS Graviton Software team is looking for Sr Software Development Engineers to optimize performance for Graviton processors.

AWS Graviton delivers the best price/performance in AWS data centers. For the past 3 years more than half of the new AWS EC2 capacity is Graviton based and it is used by over 98% of our 1000 largest customers.

You'll drive performance optimization across open-source projects, internal services, and customer applications, working on everything from Linux kernel development to C++ and Rust code debugging and optimization. Our team works on a diverse range of applications including databases, web services, compilers, video encoding, ML, and HPC workloads.

Hardware related knowledge is useful, but not required.

Key job responsibilities
- Performance Analysis and Optimization: root cause and enhance software architectures, algorithms
- Optimize software performance for AWS customers and AWS services: S3, Lambda, EMR, ElastiCache, RDS, and others
- Open Source Development: contribute to Linux kernel improvements and other public projects
- Develop analysis frameworks and automation systems

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 5+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience
- 5+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team

Preferred qualifications

- Knowledge of system performance, memory management, and parallel computing principles
- Experience building complex software systems that have been successfully delivered to customers
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

title: Praktikum im Bereich Logistik - Schonefeld - Start 2027
descriptionHtml:
Bitte beachte: Wir haben verschiedene Möglichkeiten in ganz Deutschland und benötigen Flexibilität bezüglich der Standorte. Wenn du dich für die Stelle bewirbst, gib bitte alle deine bevorzugten Standorte in Deutschland an.
Alle unsere Praktika finden vollständig vor Ort statt.
Amazon Operations ist das Rückgrat der Amazon-Kundenerfahrung. Mit über 50 Logistikzentren, hunderten von Zustellstationen und zehntausenden von Versandmitarbeiter:innen arbeitet das Team zusammen, um Artikel effizient an Kund:innen zu liefern. In den Logistikzentren werden jährlich Millionen von Artikeln kommissioniert und verpackt, während die Zustellteams daran arbeiten, Bestellungen pünktlich an die Kund:innen zu bringen. Sicherheit hat oberste Priorität, und die Betriebskultur ist geprägt von Teamwork, Vielfalt und einer gemeinsamen Arbeitsethik, die das Geschäft reibungslos am Laufen hält. Das Team ist stolz darauf, den Qualitätsservice zu liefern, für den Amazon weltweit bekannt ist.

Hinweis: Du musst zum Starttermin die Arbeitsberechtigung für das Beschäftigungsland haben.


Key job responsibilities
Als Amazon Operations-Praktikant:in hast du die Möglichkeit, deine analytischen Fähigkeiten in wirkungsvollen Projekten anzuwenden, die die Funktionalität und den Service von Logistikzentren, Sortierzentren und Zustellstationen verbessern. Wichtige Aspekte der Rolle umfassen:
• Abschluss von Projekten mit hoher Priorität nach höchstem Standard und Nachweis deiner Fähigkeit, Ergebnisse zu liefern
• Datenanalyse zur Identifizierung operativer Herausforderungen und Verbesserungsmöglichkeiten
• Vorschlagen und Testen von Lösungen in Zusammenarbeit mit dem Team zur Umsetzung der effektivsten Ansätze
• Entwicklung von Kommunikations- und Teamfähigkeiten durch die Zusammenarbeit mit Führungskräften, Stakeholdern und Versandmitarbeiter:innen.
• Bewegung im Gebäude, um mit verschiedenen Teams zu interagieren. Das umfasst aktives Wissenssammeln durch Teilnahme an Aktivitäten wie Vorbesprechungen, Ablaufmeetings und Diskussionen mit dem Führungsteam und Versandmitarbeiter:innen.
• Die Fähigkeit, sich im Arbeitsbereich zu orientieren und zwischen verschiedenen Bereichen zu wechseln, ist für diese Position unerlässlich.
• Flexibilität bei verschiedenen Arbeitszeiten und Schichtmustern nach Bedarf zeigen.
• Möglicher Umzug an den vorgesehenen Arbeitsort.


A day in the life
Unsere Praktika sind Bildungsmöglichkeiten, die es dir als unserer zukünftigen Führungskraft ermöglichen, zu entdecken, wie wir unsere Teams von Versandmitarbeiter:innen führen und entwickeln. Du tauchst in die schnelllebige, komplexe Welt unserer Logistikzentren, Sortierzentren und Zustellstationen ein und erlebst, wie unsere Führungskräfte ihre Teams einsetzen, um Kundenerwartungen zu erfüllen.
Dieses Praktikum versetzt dich ins Herz unserer Abläufe und ermöglicht es dir, den Weg einer Kundenbestellung zu verfolgen. Du erhältst einen realistischen Einblick in die Vollzeitchancen, die dich in unserem Unternehmen erwarten.
Du lernst, wie unsere Führungskräfte eine sichere, produktive Umgebung schaffen und das volle Potenzial ihrer Teams durch effektive Einbindung und Leistungsmanagement-Strategien nutzen. Das ist deine Chance, Fähigkeiten zu entwickeln, die dich zu einer lohnenden Karriere bei Amazon führen werden.


About the team
Praktikant:innen-Community:
• Als Amazon-Praktikant:in bist du Teil einer lebendigen, unterstützenden Community, die dein Wachstum und deine Entwicklung fördert. Du arbeitest mit Praktikant:innen aus der ganzen Welt zusammen, knüpfst Kontakte und nimmst an sozialen Veranstaltungen teil, um deinen Horizont zu erweitern. Du kannst auch spezialisierten Gruppen beitreten, die sich auf Bereiche wie Nachhaltigkeit konzentrieren, um deine vielfältigen Interessen zu erkunden.
Unterstützung:
• Das Praktikumsprogramm bietet ein robustes Unterstützungssystem, einschließlich wöchentlicher Praktikant:innen-Sprechstunden, spezieller IT- und HR-Unterstützung sowie einem Programmteam, das sich deinem Erfolg verschrieben hat. Das stellt sicher, dass du die Anleitung und Hilfe hast, die du zum Gedeihen brauchst.
Lernsessions:
• Exklusive Lernsessions werden deine Fähigkeiten weiter verbessern und dir Zugang zu Amazons modernsten Lernplattformen und der Expertise von Branchenführern gewähren. Diese strukturierten Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten bereiten dich auf den nächsten Schritt in deiner Karriere vor.
Möglichkeiten:
• Nach erfolgreichem Abschluss des Praktikums kannst du für eine Absolvent:innen-Stelle oder ein zweites Praktikum in Betracht gezogen werden, was es dir ermöglicht, deine Reise mit Amazon fortzusetzen. Zusätzlich erhältst du ein wettbewerbsfähiges Monatsgehalt, Umzugsunterstützung und Zugang zu einer Reihe von Mitarbeitervorteilen.
Praktikums-Starttermine über das Jahr:
• Wir stellen Praktikant:innen ein, die jederzeit von Januar bis Juli 2027 anfangen können. Jeden Monat führen wir 1-2 Onboarding-Tage für neue Mitarbeiter:innen durch.
Internal job description

Basic qualifications

- Derzeit im vorletzten oder letzten Jahr und auf dem Weg zu einem Universitätsabschluss in Supply Chain, Business/Management, Ingenieurwesen oder einem anderen verwandten Bereich.
- Berechtigt, ein Vollzeit-Praktikum von 3-6 Monaten zu absolvieren.
- Sehr gute Kenntnisse in gesprochenem und geschriebenem Englisch und der Landessprache des Landes, für das du dich bewirbst (Gemeinsamer Europäischer Referenzrahmen C1).

Preferred qualifications

- Starke Problemlösungs- und Analysefähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, Prozessverbesserungen und innovative Lösungen zu identifizieren.
- Ausgezeichnete Kommunikations- und Teamfähigkeiten, fähig zur effektiven Zusammenarbeit mit anderen.
- Bewiesene Neugier, Proaktivität und Bereitschaft, Herausforderungen in einem unklaren, schnelllebigen Umfeld anzunehmen.

title: Transportation Manager, Network and Speed - 3P Operations Transportation
descriptionHtml:
Amazon’s European Expansions Transportation team is looking for an enthusiastic, customer obsessed, Program Manager to manage projects, implement and improve metrics, improve supply chain routes, and ensure that packages move efficiently throughout Europe from fulfillment centers to customers.
To be successful in this role, you need a passion for making data driven decisions which will have direct impact on the customer experience. Some keys to your success are the ability to be an effective communicator to various audiences. The ability to remain flexible and adapt to learning new tools and systems is instrumental your role on the team. Our environment is deadline driven, fast paced and requires you to be detail-oriented and comfortable interacting or working with multiple teams (business and technical).
Responsibilities include (but are not limited to):
• Driving performance improvement with our partner carriers. Completion of root cause analysis on all defects and using these data to drive continuous improvement activities.
• Responding with best in class service to internal clients (Retail/Fulfillment Centers) regarding costs, status of freight, availability of freight and exceptions to the schedule of freight.
• Creating and implementing improvements to our transportation network that deliver flexible and efficient products for our customers (such as expedited and high value freight options).

The ideal candidate has a background of running cross-functional projects. The candidate is as comfortable working on high-level strategy and design, as they are rolling-up their sleeves and working on implementation. They have demonstrated the ability to build customized logistics solutions, drive process improvement, standardize procedures and eliminate the root cause of defects within current systems. This job will require strong communication skills while having the ability to work independently in a high pressure, and often ambiguous, work environment. Passion and drive for customer service is a must.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree
- Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps) at an advanced level and SQL
- Experience in program or project management
- Experience working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams
- Experience in defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics
- Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
- Experience leading process improvements
- Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization
- Experience building processes, project management, and schedules

title: Reliability Maintenance Engineering Technician,
descriptionHtml:
The Reliability Maintenance Engineering (RME) team at Amazon is fundamental to our operations – they’re the ones keeping vital machinery running at all times. As an RME Technician, you’ll maintain a wide range of equipment and workspaces while upholding Health and Safety best practices. You'll help to keep your colleagues safe and prevent machine downtime. Our RME Technicians boost the availability and quality of our equipment and work to enhance the operational environment too.

Key job responsibilities
Proactive and preventative maintenance tasks on a wide range of site equipment
Carry out reactive repairs and fault diagnosis in a live distribution warehouse
Use the latest tools to maximise equipment effectiveness
Uphold all health and safety policies and practices
Support the development and progression of on-site apprentices
Work on continuous improvement projects and roll out best practices across a range of EU sites

A day in the life
Our RME Technicians are based on-site, so they can respond quickly to any machinery issues. You’ll carry out a range of planned preventative maintenance to our sites’ equipment to make sure it’s working safely. As an RME Technician, you’ll also respond promptly to breakdowns, investigating, finding, and implementing solutions as quickly as possible. You’ll also make suggestions for long-term improvements.

Working alongside senior colleagues, you’ll undertake day-to-day maintenance tasks and will liaise with contractors if you need external expertise. You’ll work on a range of shifts to make sure our sites are supported around the clock – allowing Amazon to deliver at the speed we’re known for.

Basic qualifications

- NVQ Level 3/ SVQ Level 3/ IVQ Level 3/ City & Guilds Level 3/EAL Level 3 all specialized in Mechanical, Electrical or Mechatronics
- Relevant experience as a qualified engineer
- Relevant experience working in mechanical and/or electrical maintenance
- Advanced proficiency in the local language verbally and in writing

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in condition-based monitoring
- Experience working with print and apply machines
- Experience in fault-finding and maintaining conveyor or automation systems

Sicherheit hat oberste Priorität, und die Betriebskultur ist geprägt von Teamwork, Vielfalt und einer gemeinsamen Arbeitsethik, die das Geschäft reibungslos am Laufen hält. Das Team ist stolz darauf, den Qualitätsservice zu liefern, für den Amazon weltweit bekannt ist.

Hinweis: Du musst zum Starttermin die Arbeitsberechtigung für das Beschäftigungsland haben.


Key job responsibilities
Als Amazon Operations-Praktikant:in hast du die Möglichkeit, deine analytischen Fähigkeiten in wirkungsvollen Projekten anzuwenden, die die Funktionalität und den Service von Logistikzentren, Sortierzentren und Zustellstationen verbessern. Wichtige Aspekte der Rolle umfassen:
• Abschluss von Projekten mit hoher Priorität nach höchstem Standard und Nachweis deiner Fähigkeit, Ergebnisse zu liefern
• Datenanalyse zur Identifizierung operativer Herausforderungen und Verbesserungsmöglichkeiten
• Vorschlagen und Testen von Lösungen in Zusammenarbeit mit dem Team zur Umsetzung der effektivsten Ansätze
• Entwicklung von Kommunikations- und Teamfähigkeiten durch die Zusammenarbeit mit Führungskräften, Stakeholdern und Versandmitarbeiter:innen.
• Bewegung im Gebäude, um mit verschiedenen Teams zu interagieren. Das umfasst aktives Wissenssammeln durch Teilnahme an Aktivitäten wie Vorbesprechungen, Ablaufmeetings und Diskussionen mit dem Führungsteam und Versandmitarbeiter:innen.
• Die Fähigkeit, sich im Arbeitsbereich zu orientieren und zwischen verschiedenen Bereichen zu wechseln, ist für diese Position unerlässlich.
• Flexibilität bei verschiedenen Arbeitszeiten und Schichtmustern nach Bedarf zeigen.
• Möglicher Umzug an den vorgesehenen Arbeitsort.


A day in the life
Unsere Praktika sind Bildungsmöglichkeiten, die es dir als unserer zukünftigen Führungskraft ermöglichen, zu entdecken, wie wir unsere Teams von Versandmitarbeiter:innen führen und entwickeln. Du tauchst in die schnelllebige, komplexe Welt unserer Logistikzentren, Sortierzentren und Zustellstationen ein und erlebst, wie unsere Führungskräfte ihre Teams einsetzen, um Kundenerwartungen zu erfüllen.
Dieses Praktikum versetzt dich ins Herz unserer Abläufe und ermöglicht es dir, den Weg einer Kundenbestellung zu verfolgen. Du erhältst einen realistischen Einblick in die Vollzeitchancen, die dich in unserem Unternehmen erwarten.
Du lernst, wie unsere Führungskräfte eine sichere, produktive Umgebung schaffen und das volle Potenzial ihrer Teams durch effektive Einbindung und Leistungsmanagement-Strategien nutzen. Das ist deine Chance, Fähigkeiten zu entwickeln, die dich zu einer lohnenden Karriere bei Amazon führen werden.


About the team
Praktikant:innen-Community:
• Als Amazon-Praktikant:in bist du Teil einer lebendigen, unterstützenden Community, die dein Wachstum und deine Entwicklung fördert. Du arbeitest mit Praktikant:innen aus der ganzen Welt zusammen, knüpfst Kontakte und nimmst an sozialen Veranstaltungen teil, um deinen Horizont zu erweitern. Du kannst auch spezialisierten Gruppen beitreten, die sich auf Bereiche wie Nachhaltigkeit konzentrieren, um deine vielfältigen Interessen zu erkunden.
Unterstützung:
• Das Praktikumsprogramm bietet ein robustes Unterstützungssystem, einschließlich wöchentlicher Praktikant:innen-Sprechstunden, spezieller IT- und HR-Unterstützung sowie einem Programmteam, das sich deinem Erfolg verschrieben hat. Das stellt sicher, dass du die Anleitung und Hilfe hast, die du zum Gedeihen brauchst.
Lernsessions:
• Exklusive Lernsessions werden deine Fähigkeiten weiter verbessern und dir Zugang zu Amazons modernsten Lernplattformen und der Expertise von Branchenführern gewähren. Diese strukturierten Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten bereiten dich auf den nächsten Schritt in deiner Karriere vor.
Möglichkeiten:
• Nach erfolgreichem Abschluss des Praktikums kannst du für eine Absolvent:innen-Stelle oder ein zweites Praktikum in Betracht gezogen werden, was es dir ermöglicht, deine Reise mit Amazon fortzusetzen. Zusätzlich erhältst du ein wettbewerbsfähiges Monatsgehalt, Umzugsunterstützung und Zugang zu einer Reihe von Mitarbeitervorteilen.
Praktikums-Starttermine über das Jahr:
• Wir stellen Praktikant:innen ein, die jederzeit von Januar bis Juli 2027 anfangen können. Jeden Monat führen wir 1-2 Onboarding-Tage für neue Mitarbeiter:innen durch.

title: 2027 Area Manager Intern, Amazon Operations
descriptionHtml:

The Amazon University Talent Acquisition Team is looking for ambitious students to join us as Operations Intern, working in one of our core businesses, Amazon Operations.

About this internship

Our internships are educational opportunities intended to allow you, our future managers, to discover how we lead and develop our teams of Associates. As an Operations and Logistics Interns, you will learn how our managers effectively engage their teams to realize their full potential, ensure their performance in order to fulfill our customers’ expectations, and encourage a safe and productive environment within our large and complex Fulfillment Centers, Sortation Centers and Delivery Stations.

Your internship will put you at the heart of our Operations where you will be part of the journey of one of our many customer's orders.

Key job responsibilities
You will put your analytical skills to the test and roll up your sleeves to complete actions that will contribute to improving the functionality and level of service that Fulfillment Centers, Sortation Centers and Delivery Stations provide to our customers.
This will include:

- Offering and testing potential solutions and implementing the best one(s)

Available to commence an internship in Q2 2027.

If you’re successful during your internship, you could be considered for a graduate role after finishing your university studies

Internship length is 3 to 6 months, full-time.

title: Lead Associate, Amazon Now
descriptionHtml:
This role requires open availability seven days a week, and flexibility to work at various sites within 10 miles of the primary Operations site in the San Diego metro area (as needed).

Join our dedicated team and contribute to a dynamic culture based on customer obsession, trust, respect, integrity, continuous learning, and fun. As a Lead Associate, you’ll be at the core of our fastest delivery operation, enhancing customer shopping experience. The ideal candidate possesses strong attention to detail, efficiently prioritizes tasks, demonstrates a willingness to learn, and maintains a commitment to delighting our customers.

What it’s like at our site(s):
1. Safety. Your safety is important to us, so we provide safe working conditions.
2. Surroundings. You'll be working in retail warehouse environment with various equipment– shopping carts, pallet jacks, stock dollies, and a variety of products, including food and alcoholic beverages. You'll also interact with our digital shopping technology.
3. Activity. Work involves frequent movement between different areas, standing while conducting most tasks, and some lifting. You may need to reach into coolers or freezers.
4. Noise level. Sound levels are minimal, what one would expect in a retail warehouse environment.
5. Dress code. Relaxed, with a few rules to follow for safety. Comfortable, slip-resistant, closed-toe shoes are also required for safety. Additional protective and visibility gear may be required.
6. New site opening: If you’re applying to a site that hasn’t opened yet, you’ll help prepare the team for its first customer orders. This may include tasks like setting up shelving and unloading product deliveries. You’ll also have an extended training and onboarding period, which may be at a nearby Amazon site.


Key job responsibilities
- Support, motivate, and model desired behavior for the rest of the team
- Manage operational processes, safety, quality, performance, and customer delivery promises following the Regional Area Manager guidance, and act as their main support at your assigned site
- Maintain a clean, sanitary, safe, and organized workspace
- Provide ongoing training in areas including system and equipment knowledge, quality training, general operations, and assist Regional Area Manager in identifying training needs
- Provide feedback on processes and standards, serving as the escalation point to assist associates and peers in solving issues where appropriate, training, deploying labor, and ensuring the team takes required breaks and lunches
- Maintain a key to the site, and open and close following the proper procedures.
- Handle a wide assortment of products including produce, meat, seafood, and alcoholic beverages
- Receive truck deliveries
- Collaborate with both associates and delivery partners to ensure smooth operations and excellent customer service
- Participate in associate onboarding as required
- Ensure consistent execution of product workflow processes, guiding associates as needed including receiving, stocking, replenishing product, and preparing for delivery
- Perform front-line duties whenever necessary
- Contribute to continuous improvement of customer experience and operations by participating in the development of best practices and continuous product knowledge
- Utilize inventory management systems to scan, process, and count product
- Perform additional duties as assigned
You’ll also need to be:
- At least 18 years old, and authorized to work in the United States
- Able to lift up to 49 pounds, stand/walk during shifts lasting up to 12 hours, and be able to frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach
- Able to use carts, dollies, hand trucks, and other gear to move items around
- Able to go up and down stairs (where applicable)
- Available to work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays
- On site for the entirety of your shift

- Prior experience in training others

title: ITS Systems Engineer, Corporate Infrastructure Services, IT
descriptionHtml:
Corporate Infrastructure Services (CIS) builds and operates the systems that power Amazon's corporate offices globally — the networks, compute platforms, audio-visual systems, and operational tooling that every Amazonian depends on. Our Systems Engineering function owns the operational standards, fleet governance, observability, and engineering practices that keep this infrastructure reliable, secure, and cost-effective across a worldwide footprint.
We are looking for a Systems Engineer with a focus on fleet management and operational excellence. You will own the operational health, compliance, and lifecycle management of infrastructure fleets — ensuring that our infrastructure device estates are accurately inventoried, properly governed, and operating within defined standards. You will be the person who knows what we have, where it is, what state it's in, and what needs attention.
This role combines hands-on systems engineering with fleet-level operational thinking. You will troubleshoot difficult systems problems across hardware, software, networking, and cloud platforms. You will build automation that scales fleet operations — replacing manual processes with repeatable, reliable mechanisms. You will create and maintain the SOPs, runbooks, and documentation that enable consistent operations across a global footprint. You will identify patterns that affect fleet health, performance, and compliance, and drive improvements that deliver measurable results.
You will work autonomously, taking ownership of problems even when they cross domain boundaries. You will be proficient across multiple technology areas — operating systems, networking, compute hardware, cloud platforms, and monitoring tools. You will use AWS services (EC2, Lambda, Systems Manager, CloudWatch, DynamoDB, S3, Fleet Manager) and scripting languages (Python, PowerShell, Bash) to build the automation and tooling that keeps fleet operations efficient and scalable.


Key job responsibilities
• Own the operational health and compliance of infrastructure fleets — maintaining accurate inventory, tracking lifecycle status, and ensuring fleet governance standards are met
• Troubleshoot and resolve difficult systems problems across hardware, software, networking, and operating environments, driving root cause resolution
• Build automation that scales fleet operations — device discovery, compliance scanning, firmware tracking, health monitoring, and lifecycle reporting
• Create, review, and improve SOPs, runbooks, and documentation to ensure consistent, repeatable operations across sites and regions
• Identify patterns that affect fleet performance, reliability, availability, or compliance, and deliver automation that addresses them at scale
• Drive operational excellence initiatives that demonstrate measurable improvements to fleet health, compliance posture, and operational efficiency
• Provide insight to engineers across domains (software, hardware, networking, security) on how their components interact to form a system
• Participate in on-call rotations, diagnosing and resolving operational issues across the infrastructure estate
• Mentor junior engineers, helping them understand systems architecture, operational practices, and fleet management disciplines
• Contribute to team design, scoping, and prioritisation discussions with informed operational and fleet perspective

Basic qualifications

- 4+ years of site reliability engineering (SRE), systems engineering, systems administration, DevOps, security administration, or network administration experience
- 5+ years of Linux experience
- 5+ years of systems engineering experience
- Bachelor's degree in Systems Engineering, Computer Science, or related field or relevant work experience
- Experience in site reliability engineering (SRE), systems engineering, systems administration, DevOps, security administration, or network administration
- Experience in any of the following: Python, Java, Perl, PHP, Ruby, Bash, Shell or equivalent

Preferred qualifications

- Knowledge of TCP/IP and networking protocols such as HTTP and DNS
- Experience designing and developing scripts to automate operational burdens and reviewing scripting changes to ensure they meet the standards for maintainability, scalability and security
- Experience working in 24/7 production environment
- Experience with service-oriented architecture and web services

title: Seller Manager II, Amazon Grocery
descriptionHtml:
We are seeking a talented, dedicated, and highly analytical Seller Manager (Instock) to drive selection and in-stock for Amazon Now. This is a unique opportunity to play a key role on an important initiative at Amazon. This position requires a candidate with proven analytical skills with experience driving process improvement, thought leadership, and delivering results.

The Seller Manager (Instock) will be responsible for executing inventory strategies to optimize customer experience, sales, margin and turns. They will be relentlessly focused on delivering high in-stock rates in order to meet the needs of our customers. They will dive deep core drivers of in-stock performance, and proactively identify opportunities to improve tools and work flows. This role interacts closely with retail and operations business partners across Amazon, and is pivotal to the growth of this strategic initiative.

The successful candidate will communicate effectively across teams and levels, while balancing the needs and requirements of internal and external customers. Flexibility and the ability to prioritize in a changing business environment will also be key. Our team culture is goal-oriented, collaborative and driven to achieve results. We seek an individual who is motivated by a fast-paced and highly entrepreneurial environment who is willing to roll up their sleeves and get things done.

Key job responsibilities

Maintain excellent in-stock rates for owned category and/or region
Execute inventory strategies to optimize sales, turns, and inventory health
Monitor, analyze and own key performance indicators such as in-stock rate, procurement lead time (PLT), fill rate, forecast accuracy and turns
Forecast and manage efficient inbound and outbound inventory flows and health, including forecasting, purchasing, and removing unproductive inventory
Drive root cause analysis/reporting on operational issues, develop action plans and project manage improvements with the ability to manage multiple, competing priorities simultaneously
Work with internal teams collaboratively, to help drive tools and process improvements that affect purchasing and procurement workflows, with emphasis on automating tasks that are currently performed manually.

Collaborate with product leaders to gather insights, ensuring alignment and making informed product selections.
Analyze market trends and competitor activities to provide data-driven insights that shape strategic decisions.

descriptionHtml:

You will be integrated with a global network of H&S professionals including program specialists, Regional Health and Safety Manager and Regional Construction Safety Managers

title: Data Centre Manager, Infrastructure Delivery Operations
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is a fast-paced computing technology company and the world's leading cloud infrastructure provider, operating a global network of mission-critical data centers that power innovation for millions of customers. As we continue our rapid expansion across the Asia-Pacific region to support the demands of our customers, we're seeking an exceptional Data Center Operations Manager to join our Melbourne (MEL) cluster operations and drive operational excellence at scale.

As part of our infrastructure management team, you'll be a proven technology-focused leader with a passion for devising innovative concepts and strategies that will take AWS Data Center Operations to the next level. This is a high-impact leadership role where you'll collaborate with, lead, and mentor diverse teams of skilled data center technicians with a variety of capabilities, driving strategic initiatives and ensuring uptime for critical infrastructure supporting AWS customers globally.

This position will be responsible for data center operations with a relentless focus on continuous improvement to ensure we continue to deliver the highest level of service to our customers. As a successful applicant, you will get to manage the world's largest computing infrastructure. Every day you will innovate and help us solve exciting, challenging, and complex problems—managing complex technical escalations, implementing innovative solutions that set new standards for data center operations across the region, and driving for operational excellence in all areas of your role.



Key job responsibilities
Managing and developing teams of efficient Data Center Technicians, providing both technical and leadership expertise and ensuring highest levels of performance
Maintaining existing co-located and in-house Data Centers.
Help build and bring online new Data Centers.
Constantly improving all our processes and procedures. We believe there is nothing we cannot improve.
Assisting & managing relationships with external vendors & contractors.
Liaising with internal teams & management groups.
