title: Data Center Controls Tech,, Andrews, Texas
descriptionHtml:
The Data Center Global Controls team is looking for exceptional individuals to join our Controls organization as a Controls Technician for Service & Construction of the Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Monitoring System (EPMS) within Amazon data centers. If you are passionate about the Customer Experience, think and act globally and have the ability to contribute to major new innovations in the area of building controls and automation this is the challenge you are looking for!

The candidate will possess technical background and experience in installation, troubleshooting, operations and/or maintenance of field sensors, controllers, wiring, networking and programming associated with the industrial controls systems. The candidate may also have relevant experience operating and maintaining mission critical electrical and mechanical systems. A Controls Technician shall be responsible for participating in the installation, testing, troubleshooting and startup of equipment and controls system associated with the BMS and EPMS system deployment in the data centers. A Controls Technician is expected to actively innovate on behalf of their customers in the area of Data Center building automation.

Key job responsibilities
• Primarily work in and support multiple data centers by deploying, servicing, and upgrading BMS and EPMS systems.
• Mentor and train Facilities team members on the operation and control of BMS and EPMS systems.
• Manage small to medium-sized projects and programs.
• Perform point-to-point checkouts between field devices and controllers.
• Perform first-line diagnostics, troubleshooting, and maintenance of programming code and hardware associated with BMS and EPMS in data centers.
• Execute provisioning processes for servers, controllers, industrial PCs, and network configurations, including communication testing between third-party devices and controllers or servers.
• Install, replace, configure, and calibrate sensors.
• Read and interpret electrical schematics and control panel drawings with a basic understanding of closed-loop controls, field sensor scaling, and functions typically performed by industrial controllers.
• Supervise low-voltage electrical contractors performing wiring and installation of field devices in compliance with AWS requirements.
• Provide commissioning and systems-level testing support.
• Create red-lined drawings and documentation of systems.
• Follow change management processes to generate work requests and methods of procedures.
• Participate in factory witness tests at vendor or panel builder facilities.
• Perform root cause analysis during testing and commissioning.
• Ensure personnel on site utilize proper safety methodology.
• Perform service activities including monitoring and reviewing ticketing systems, conducting root cause analysis, and prioritizing tasks.
• Actively manage service agreements including vendor labor scheduling, quality assurance, and financial invoice review.
• Participate in material handling tasks such as lifting, carrying, or moving up to 50 lbs of equipment, and utilize OSHA-standard safety equipment including limited weight-bearing work platforms, ladders, step stools, and personal protective equipment (PPE) such as safety harnesses.
• Perform other tasks as assigned by manager.


A day in the life
A typical day is attending morning construction/commissioning meetings, assessing and prioritization of project tasks and service tickets for the given day. Field work which requires configuring controllers, testing sensors, troubleshooting, safety site walks, and supporting general startup processes. Technician is responsible for logging their daily efforts in construction and service related AWS tools.
The mission of the Data Center Controls Engineering team is to manage the design, deployment, and service of a highly reliable electrical and mechanical control system for the life-cycle of an AWS data center.

About the team
As a member of the Global Controls Team, you will collaborate with highly motivated operators, engineers and technicians in the data center industry to maintain and optimize critical infrastructure systems. You will be responsible for troubleshooting and maintaining the Building Management System (BMS) and Electrical Power Monitoring System (EPMS) while developing new processes and standards that drive innovation in the controls space.
AWS data centers utilize sophisticated industrial control systems to automatically operate mechanical equipment, maintaining optimal temperature and pressure conditions throughout the facilities. These systems integrate and monitor multiple critical components, including generators, uninterruptible power sources, diesel generators, electrical switchgear, power distribution units, variable frequency drives, automatic and static transfer switches, air-cooled and water-cooled chillers, pumps, cooling towers, heat exchangers, Computer Room Air Handlers (CRAHs), and air economizers. Within this industrial control system infrastructure, the BMS serves as the primary control platform for all mechanical systems within the data center, while the EPMS functions as the primary monitoring platform for all electrical systems. This position offers the opportunity to work with cutting-edge technology in mission-critical environments while contributing to the reliability and efficiency of AWS's global infrastructure.

Basic qualifications

- High school or equivalent diploma
- Associate’s degree, trade school certification, or other certified training in a related technical field with 4+ years of relevant industrial Controls or HVAC controls experience, OR 6+ years of relevant industrial or HVAC controls experience in lieu of a degree.
- Basic understanding of Industrial controls system, knowledge of meters, devices, sensors, relays and troubleshooting utilizing standard hand tools, digital metering, or calibration/diagnostic equipment in a data center, hospitals, large commercial complex, water, power, oil & gas or similar industries.
- 3+ years of experience working with low voltage controls, wiring, networking signals, electrical and mechanical systems, computers and operating systems.

Preferred qualifications

- Associate's degree or above
- International Society of Automation (ISA) Certified Controls System Technician (CCST) Level I or higher certification.
- Experiencing using common communication protocols (MQTT, BACnet, and/or MODBUS).
- 5+ years of experience in controls/automation, construction or related field in a technical environment
- Demonstrated understanding of engineering documentation, electrical and mechanical diagrams, and standard operating procedures.
- Experience in data centers or mission critical environment
- Fundamental knowledge of network design and layout as well as low voltage (copper/ fiber) cabling.
- Prior AWS/Amazon experience
- 4+ Yr. Military Service

title: Safety Technician, WHS
descriptionHtml:
Keeping our people safe and well at work is a top priority at Amazon. Our Safety Technicians play an essential role in making this happen. This role is an opportunity to start your career in workplace safety and develop through a global company. You’ll work closely with our experts to monitor your site, which means you’ll get to see the difference that you make to people’s well-being every day.

Monitor the site to make sure processes are in line with Amazon's safety procedures
Create and update reports on safety metrics for colleagues to review
Work with colleagues in Operations and across the business on safety-related tasks and offer guidance on processes
Support in putting new safety measures in place

A day in the life
You'll be based at one of our sites. This means that you can closely track what's happening and people can easily ask you any questions throughout their shifts. This role is all about spotting potential issues before they happen. You'll spend a lot of time checking the site and getting to know the way that people use equipment. You'll also be one of the people to put safety changes into action, which means you'll get to work closely with lots of people. title: Manager of Construction, Data Center Construction
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

As our Data Center Manager of Construction (CM MGR), you will be a part of a diverse, upbeat, and creative team tasked with solving fascinating problems constructing Amazon Data Centers. Our data centers are industry-leading examples of energy efficient and cost-effective designs.
You will:
• Own project scope, quality, schedule, and budget for construction of new builds or general capital projects.
• Own construction project management and oversight of construction related activities.
• Work alongside partner teams such as Operations, Networking, Controls, Security, and Commissioning to build Data Centers that directly support our Customers.
• Be a leader in your specific discipline (construction management, building services, architectural, electrical or mechanical engineering).
• Represent Amazon’s owner’s representative on construction sites daily, as, interacting with construction trades.

At Amazon, we are all Owners and leverage unique opportunities presented to us by owning everything from the design review to construction bidding, execution, and final hand-off to our customers. We develop innovative data centers for our Customers.

Key job responsibilities
• Be Amazon’s construction representative on multiple data centers building and capital improvement construction project sites from construction start through hand-off to operations.
• Direct interface with construction general contractors during the construction bidding, award, execution, punch-list, and closeout phases.
• Create construction project Scope of Work (SOW) and Request for Proposals (RFP).
• Conduct negotiations with general contractors and evaluate bids and proposals with detail and accuracy.
• Manage and drive cost, schedule, and quality while managing construction contractors and vendors.
• Perform construction project management activities, including management of documents, submittals, RFIs, change orders, invoices, quality, scope, and schedule.
• Drive construction teams to troubleshoot and perform root-cause failure analysis on equipment failures.
• Support commissioning and integrated system testing and oversight.
• Support operations of installed facilities, including review of procedures, best practices, and maintenance initiatives.
• Support capital request creation.
• Analyze and report construction progress and financials.
• Record and report key construction metrics to team members and management.
• Contribute to construction initiatives aimed at improving construction efficiency and increasing data center resiliency.
• Provide constructability reviews for civil, structural, electrical and mechanical designs for new or optimization of existing data centers.

A day in the life

About the team
Diverse Experiences
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship and Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

title: Senior Financial Analyst, Global Prime Finance
descriptionHtml:
We are seeking a Finance Manager to own the rhythm of business (RoB) for the WW Prime Benefits, Pricing, And Constructs Finance (BPCF) team. This role is the operational backbone of the team, responsible for ensuring that the financial scorecards, reporting packages, and planning documents that senior leadership relies on are accurate, timely, and insightful. You will own the end-to-end publication of the BPC Page 0 (our key financial scorecard by locale at country and consolidated WW level), prepare financial packages for Monthly and Quarterly Business Reviews, support OP planning documents, and maintain the tracking systems that keep the team grounded in data. This is a high-visibility role: your outputs will be reviewed by Directors and VPs across Global Prime Finance and WW Prime leadership. You will work directly with a Senior Finance Manager and collaborate across a team of Finance Managers, each owning distinct sub-domains of the Prime BPC business.

Key job responsibilities
Reporting & Page 0 Ownership
- Own the end-to-end publication of the Benefits, Pricing & Constructs Page 0 at country and WW consolidated level on a monthly, quarterly, and annual cadence.
- Prepare and publish financial packages for Monthly Business Reviews (MBR), Quarterly Business Reviews (QBR), and Monthly Finance Reviews (MFR), ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and narrative clarity.
- Support OP1/OP2 document preparation, including initiative sizing inputs and financial summaries.
- Maintain and improve reporting templates, data pipelines, and publication workflows to reduce manual effort and increase reliability.
Planning & Goals Tracking
- Track and report incremental Prime member balance across geographies, identifying trends, variances, and risks to plan.
- Own goals tracking and reporting for the BPC Finance team, including progress against OP targets and key initiative milestones.
- Publish DSI (Daily Sales Intelligence) runs on a regular cadence, ensuring the team and stakeholders have current performance data.
- Proactively flag variances and emerging trends to the Senior Finance Manager, with root-cause hypotheses and proposed next steps.
Cross-Functional Collaboration
- Coordinate with country finance teams across 26 geographies to collect, validate, and consolidate data inputs for Page 0 and business reviews.
- Partner with Finance Managers on the BPC team to integrate sub-domain data (Benefits, Pricing, Constructs, Savings & Rewards) into consolidated reporting.
- Work with Business Intelligence Engineering (BIE) teams to improve data quality, automate data pipelines, and resolve data discrepancies.
- Serve as the primary BIE liaison for the BPC Finance team: own the relationship with BIE to drive data quality improvements, prioritize pipeline fixes, unblock data access requests, and reduce the manual reconciliation burden on senior Finance Managers.
Analytical & Insight Development (Growth Scope)

- Conduct variance analysis and root-cause deep-dives on Page 0 metrics, member balance trends, and benefit cost movements, escalating findings with hypotheses and recommended actions.
- Support ad hoc financial analyses for senior leadership, including opportunity sizing, benefit cost trending, and scenario modeling for business reviews.
- Build and maintain Benefits Usage Index (BUI) tracking and trend analysis to support WW Prime leadership decision-making.
- Develop familiarity with Prime subscription economics, pricing levers, and membership growth drivers to grow into broader analytical responsibilities over time.

BIE Partnership & Data Infrastructure

- Serve as the primary BIE liaison for the BPC Finance team: own the working relationship with BIE to drive data quality improvements, prioritize pipeline fixes, and unblock data access requests.
- Reduce the manual data reconciliation burden on senior Finance Managers by systematizing data validation checks and building repeatable QA processes for published outputs.
- Partner with BIE to identify automation opportunities for Page 0 and recurring reports, with the goal of progressively eliminating manual data assembly.

A day in the life
No two days look exactly the same, but here is what a typical week might include. On Monday, you review the latest Prime Member engagement data across key geographies, flag any variances from plan, and update the tracking dashboard your team relies on. By midweek, you are pulling together inputs from five Finance Managers across Benefits, Pricing, and Constructs to assemble the Page 0 scorecard: reconciling data, chasing down discrepancies with BIE, and making sure the numbers tell a clean story before your Senior Finance Manager reviews them. On Thursday, you publish the MBR financial package and prep the supporting materials, knowing they will be in front of Directors and VPs within days. In between, you field ad hoc data requests from senior leadership, run a DSI publication, and join a working session with your BIE counterpart to troubleshoot a data pipeline issue that has been causing manual workarounds for weeks.
This role sits at the intersection of precision and pace. You will own the outputs that the entire BPC Finance team depends on for credibility with senior leadership. Some weeks are predictable and rhythmic: Page 0 closes, MBR publishes, goals update on schedule. Others are not: a VP asks for a quick member growth cut by locale ahead of an unscheduled review, and you need to pull it together accurately within hours. If you enjoy building reliable systems, thrive on getting the details right, and want to grow into a broader finance analytics role on a team that operates at the center of Amazon Prime's global strategy, this is the role.

About the team
Global Prime Finance owns the financial strategy and analytical infrastructure for Amazon Prime across 26 geographies worldwide. Within this organization, the WW Prime Benefits, Pricing & Constructs (BPC) Finance team is the financial conscience behind every pricing decision, benefit investment, and monetization initiative for Amazon's flagship subscription program. We translate complex, multi-geography subscription economics into clear, actionable financial narratives that drive decisions at the most senior levels of the company.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of tax, finance or a related analytical field experience
- Bachelor's degree in finance, accounting or related field
- 3+ years of contributing to cross-functional initiatives that drive financial performance and strategy experience
- 3+ years of dissecting financial data and identifying patterns that support business strategy experience

Preferred qualifications

- 4+ years of participating in continuous improvement projects in your team to scale and improve controllership with measurable results experience
- MBA, or CPA
- Experience working with large-scale data mining and reporting tools (examples: SQL, MS Access, Essbase, Cognos) and other financial systems (examples: Oracle, SAP, Lawson, JD Edwards)
- Experience working with stakeholders
- Experience working in a large team or fast-paced corporate environment

title: Transportation Associate
descriptionHtml:
Are you ready to help Amazon deliver world class service in its transportation operations? Transportation Associates will perform trailer moves in the trailer yard, coordinate yard activities (such as checking in trailers, traffic flow, internal communications with operations, etc.), conduct yard audits, complete applicable driver training programs (Hostler, Commercial Driver’s License (CDL) School, etc.), and operate multiple vehicle types based on business need (including but not limited to hostlers and day cabs) to support Amazon’s transportation network. Benefits of being a Transportation Associate include the opportunity to work outside and understand the new and exciting world of transportation operations.
As a Transportation Associate you will:
• Make safety a priority by adhering to company rules and regulations. You will follow and enforce safety measures and policies to all who operate vehicles on behalf of Amazon and those who enter the yard, including vendors and senior team members
• Perform various functions within the yard, support site operations teams, internal transportation field teams, and external carriers, as needed, to ensure all trailers arrive and depart on time with zero defects and to maintain workflow for buildings.
• Be professionally trained to operate Commercial Motor Vehicles (CMVs) on non-public roads or in yard to move trailers to/from dock and parking locations.
• Learn Department of Transportation (DOT) regulations and comply with company policies, procedures of those DOT regulations (size, weight, route designations, parking, trailer designations, violation and incident reporting requirements, break periods, etc.)
• Complete driver vehicle inspection reports on equipment and notify managers of any maintenance or delivery issues encountered.
• Follow hostler and delivery schedules, track and report working hours and breaks at appropriate times in compliance with Amazon policy and federal and state regulations, adhere to yard safety policies, obey all applicable traffic laws, and drive in accordance with weather/road conditions.
• Support the business on an as needed basis by serving as a peer trainer and/or working at nearby site locations within the area
• Drive, maneuver, and load/unload a truck using approved equipment (pallet jack, etc.).
What else does the team have to offer? We’re glad you asked!
• Opportunity to work outside and drive different commercial motor vehicles in the yard and over the road
• Exposure to different Amazon site types including NACF, NASC, Air, AMZL & AMXL.
• Long-term growth potential via comprehensive training in transportation with Amazon.
• Dependent on business need, you may have the opportunity to earn your Commercial Driver’s License (CDL) paid for by Amazon.

Join ATS! ATS is one of the fastest growing business lines within Amazon over the past 5 Years with continued growth to come!

If requested due to business need, Transportation Associates must obtain their Commercial Driver’s License (CDL) and Driver Qualification File (DQF) and utilize it as a condition of the role, paid for by Amazon. If Associate is requested to become CDL and DQF certified to drive Over-the-Road for Amazon, this position becomes regulated by the Department of Transportation (DOT) and follows regulations issued by the DOT’s Federal Motor Carrier Safety Administration (FMCSA). Candidate must hold a valid driver’s license for the state in which they reside and be eligible to drive in accordance with DOT requirements. For Department of Labor/Federal Motor Carrier Safety Administration roles (roles for which you receive a CDL), English proficiency is required per federal regulation.
The timing of this requirement is dependent on business need. Continuing in the position with CDL and DQF certification is contingent upon the successful completion of a DOT-regulated pre-employment background screening, a DOT physical and Amazon’s pre-employment drug test.

• Hold a valid and active driver’s license

title: Robotics Systems Eng II, Robotics Delivery & Packaging Innovations (RDPI) Technology Deployment
descriptionHtml:
Join Amazon's Robotics Delivery & Packaging Innovations (RDPI) Technology Deployment team within Amazon Robotics (AR) organization to deploy industrial robotics across North America's fulfillment network. In RDPI, we have the unique role and privilege of deploying leading edge industrial robotics and customer fulfillment technologies across the North America Stores operations. We raise the bar on the speed, quality and cost of deploying industrial technologies at scale across North America, functioning as the field team who plan, execute and launch the technologies that our internal design and product strategy partners in RDPI develop.

As a Systems Engineer in RDPI, you will be overseeing large scale project planning, installation, and launch of industrial automation technologies across Amazons growing Stores network. This field engineering position demands strong technical skills for deploying robotic equipment, including mechanical and electrical systems, network configurations, and software coordination. The ideal candidate has experience with complex electro-mechanical and network systems, large scale installations, and system troubleshooting. You will work with cross-functional partners across the Amazon Fulfillment Technology & Robotics engineering, safety, product strategy, software, supply chain, third-party installers, contracted deployment engineers, construction teams, and internal operations customer teams, functioning as the lead on-site project manager to provide technical oversight on installation Amazon-designed automation equipment. This Systems Engineer position is an individual contributor role, influencing and leading stakeholders from planning through go-live of each project. Project durations vary from a few days to several months each. This is a travel-based role and you will be expected to travel to meet the requirements of your projects across North America, upwards of 75% or more.

**Relocation to Amazon Corporate offices in Seattle, Boston or Austin will be required for the role.

Key job responsibilities
As a Systems Engineer II, a candidate will typically own multiple simultaneous deployments of a single technology across multiple sites or oversee multi-technology deployments within a single site; delivering within documented standards. This role requires a balance of experience both in working with high-complexity industrial technologies, with complex, multi-dependency project management. The ideal candidate is proactive and takes independent initiative in improving system performance and handling end-to-end deployment. In parallel to the execution, candidates will be responsible for driving continuous improvement ideas into both the deployment cycle time (safety, quality and productivity), and will be responsible for sharing engineering design improvements feedback to the hardware engineering and product teams, to simplify the installation. This role will require the ability to build relationships and capture and synthesize the voice of the customer.
You will manage the tactical deployment of large scale industrial automation technologies, ranging in technical complexity and product maturity from early alpha/beta to mature Generally Available.

You will own the tactical execution (onsite coordination of installation and acceptance testing) to achieve the target “go-live” date for each project assigned; delivering independently.

You will collaborate with hardware engineering, technical program managers, product managers, and internal customers including site maintenance and operations teams to convert technical requirements into refined deployment execution documents (schedules, Standard Operating Procedures, dependencies, etc.)

You will improve operational metrics and team processes through automation and optimization

You will independently resolve difficult technical problems during deployment, considering operational burden and making appropriate trade-offs between time, quality, and resources

You will create and improve standard work documents and operational guidebooks, and work towards automating or improving team processes.

You will influence internal and partner teams towards meeting team level goals.

You will develop subject matter expertise in one or more deployment domains

You will mentor junior engineers and participate in technical assessment

You will drive operational excellence initiatives with measurable results



A day in the life
In this role you will be focused on execution of end-to-end deployment and manage technical ambiguity around integration of workcells in fulfillment centers. On a daily basis you will collaborate with hardware engineering, technical program managers, product managers, construction teams, and internal customers including site maintenance and operations teams, to ensure a safe, on time, high quality product is delivered to the internal customer. You will travel to your project sites, collaborate both virtually and in person, to ensure all business stakeholders are aligned on program status. You will manage the day-to-day project execution, and work on continuous improvement activities to improve deployment execution first pass yield. You will work with senior engineers and your manager to develop technical depth and begin building strategic thinking skills for future growth.

Amazon offers a full range of benefits that support you and eligible family members, including domestic partners and their children. Benefits can vary by location, the number of regularly scheduled hours you work, length of employment, and job status such as seasonal or temporary employment. The benefits that generally apply to regular, full-time employees include:

1. Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage

2. Maternity and Parental Leave Options

3. Paid Time Off (PTO)

4. 401(k) Plan

If you are not sure that every qualification on the list above describes you exactly, we'd still love to hear from you! At Amazon, we value people with unique backgrounds, experiences, and skillsets. If you’re passionate about this role and want to make an impact on a global scale, please apply!

About the team
Are you inspired by invention? Is problem solving through teamwork in your DNA? Do you like the idea of seeing how your work impacts the bigger picture? Answer yes to any of these and you’ll fit right in here at Robotics Delivery & Packaging Innovation (RDPI) within Amazon Robotics (AR). We are a smart, collaborative team of enthusiastic doers that work passionately to apply advances in robotics and software to solve real-world challenges that will transform our customers’ experiences in ways we can’t even image yet. We invent new improvements every day. We are RDPI and we will give you the tools and support you need to invent with us in ways that are rewarding, fulfilling and fun

RDPI Tech Deployment are missioned with enabling the delivery of large scale automation technologies designed and manufactured by Amazon. The team is multi-disciplinary, and consists of Field Deployment Engineers, Controls Engineering, Design for Deployment, Product Single Threaded Leaders, and a Program Management Office team, who collaborate on enabling the delivery of new technologies and packaging solutions that delight our customers, and improve the safety, quality and costs within the Amazon fulfillment processes. The team is geographically located across four North America hub locations. The work we deliver directly impact high priority goals set each year to our most senior leadership at Amazon.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or above in engineering or equivalent STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering and Mathematics) field
- 5+ years experience in troubleshooting robotics systems or other complex mechanical-electrical or networked systems to resolve escalations including quality hand-off, live order testing, site acceptance testing, operational readiness testing, and monitoring system performance
- 5+ years experience in project management related to the deployment, retrofits or technical maintenance of large-scale industrial robotics
- 5+ years experience using project management and supply management tools/software including managing Bills of Material, deployment work instructions, and project task management.
- 3+ years experience working in or around a construction, manufacturing, warehouse, or similar environment
- Demonstrated ability to work with PLCs, SCADA systems, and network infrastructure.
- Ability to travel domestically 75% or more of the year

Preferred qualifications

- 5+ years of systems engineering experience
- MBA, or graduate degree in engineering or STEM field
- 5+ years experience with machine Overall Equipment Effectiveness and Key Performance Indicator metrics tools (such as Tableau).
- Experience/certifications in Six Sigma, lean manufacturing and/or PMP
- Experience working in a 24/7 production environment
- Experience in industrial systems engineering, such as building designs including conveyance and industrial robotics
- Experience in building Capital Appropriation Requests for projects exceeding $10M, and working with and managing third party vendors

descriptionHtml:

Instock Managerは社内の商品情報から発注までの一連のシステムや仕組みの改革だけでなく、取引先からFCへの納品までのオペレーションも共に改革することを求められます

Amazon内だと商品情報から始まり、何を買うかを判断する品揃えのシステム、各商品の需要予測のシステム、それを基にターゲット在庫や発注数量を決めるシステム、決めた発注量を基にサプライヤー様に発注する一連のシステム。

このシステム群を改善・Enhanceすることで、発注の自動化や精度を向上させます。Amazon内だと商品情報から始まり、何を買うかを判断する品揃えのシステム、各商品の需要予測のシステム、それを基にターゲット在庫や発注数量を決めるシステム、決めた発注量を基にサプライヤー様に発注する一連のシステム。このシステム群を改善・Enhanceすることで、発注の自動化や精度を向上させます。一方でシステムで対応できない人がやるべきマニュアルでの需要予測の修正や発注なども実施します。

Job Description

You will be responsible for procurement and inventory management of assigned categories within the Amazon Fresh business division. This is a department where you can contribute to maximizing cash flow by optimizing the balance between out-of-stock rates, excess inventory, and procurement methods.

Instock Managers are required not only to reform the series of internal systems and mechanisms from product information to ordering, but also to jointly reform operations from supplier delivery to fulfillment centers (FCs).

Within Amazon, this starts with product information and includes: the assortment system that determines what to buy, the demand forecasting system for each product, the system that determines target inventory and order quantities based on forecasts, and the series of systems that place orders with suppliers based on the calculated order quantities.

By improving and enhancing this system suite, we increase the automation and accuracy of ordering. While systems handle much of this process, manual demand forecast adjustments and ordering that cannot be handled by systems are also performed when necessary.

At Amazon, you'll work alongside the latest AI and GenAI tools that are increasingly woven into how teams operate: from AI-powered capabilities that accelerate decision-making, to Generative AI that helps you focus on work that truly matters. You'll have opportunities and resources to develop AI fluency at your own pace, with continuous learning built into the culture.

title: SDE II, EE Experiences, Everyday Essentials Experiences
descriptionHtml:
Everyday Essentials (EE) is a $100B+ business and one of the fastest-growing categories at Amazon — the household staples, health and personal care, grocery, and beauty products hundreds of millions of customers reorder. We're reinventing how customers discover, buy, and get more value from them, and we're looking for Software Development Engineers who want to build that future.

The EE Experiences organization builds the shopping experience for the products customers come back for most. Our charter is Progressive Discovery and Monetization: helping customers find better products for their needs, complete their baskets, and get more value on every essentials purchase — and giving the world's largest consumer brands new and effective ways to reach those customers and grow with Amazon. We build a durable, profitable business at the intersection of the two, on the surfaces customers use every day.

This is a space where the hardest problems don't have off-the-shelf answers. We're not polishing a solved product — we're inventing experiences that don't exist yet, and the decisions we make now shape a business with room to grow for years. You'll have the freedom to propose new ideas, prototype them, and ship them worldwide. Your work moves from whiteboard to production in front of a very large customer base, with visibility all the way to senior leadership.

We're an AI-first team, and that shows up in two ways. We use AI throughout how we build software, and we expect our engineers to keep learning and applying the latest tools to move faster and raise the quality bar. AI is also at the core of what we build — the intelligence that helps customers find the right product is a modeling and engineering problem we work on hand in hand with scientists. If you're curious about AI, learn quickly, and like using it to solve real customer problems while keeping a clear head about where it helps and where it doesn't, you'll fit right in.

Key job responsibilities
- Design, build, and own software end to end — working backwards from the customer through design, code, testing, deployment, and operations.
- Take on ambiguous problems where the goal is clear but the path is not, bring clarity, and deliver simple solutions to hard problems.
- Partner closely with scientists, product managers, and designers to turn customer problems into products that ship worldwide.
- Use AI tools and modern engineering practices to build faster and at a higher bar of quality, and help the team level up how it uses them.
- Own operational excellence for what you build — monitor it, respond when issues arise, and keep improving the customer and partner experience.
- Raise the technical bar through code reviews, mentoring, and hiring for the best talent.

A day in the life
Most days start with the customer problem in front of you: how to help someone find a better everyday-essentials product, or fill their basket faster. You dig into data, sketch a design, and talk it through with product managers and scientists before writing any code. By the afternoon you might be prototyping an idea that didn't exist yesterday, reviewing a teammate's change, or debugging something in production. Because so much here is new, you won't just pick up tickets. You'll help decide what to build, push for the approach you believe in, and see your work reach customers in weeks, not quarters.

About the team
Our team owns how customers discover and buy the everyday essentials they rely on — and how the brands behind those products reach them. Our mission is to make restocking the things you need effortless, and to help customers find better options along the way. Day to day you'll work with fellow engineers and partner closely with product managers, designers, and scientists, who bring the customer and data insight that shapes what we build. We're a small, fast-moving group solving open-ended problems for hundreds of millions of shoppers — a place where you own problems end to end and your ideas reach customers fast.

- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

title: Manager II Program Management, Global Catalog Operations
descriptionHtml:
Amazon.com operates in a global eCommerce environment without boundaries, and operates a diverse set of businesses worldwide, including Retail, third party marketplaces, eCommerce platforms, web services for developers.

The Amazon product catalog is a set of records; each record being a set of facts describing a physical or digital product. These records are often organized by defined relationships (e.g. variations such as different sizes of the same shoe). Our ability to provide a good product discovery experience and empower our customers to make well informed purchase decisions is dependent on the quality of our product catalog. In a high quality catalog, every product is described with a complete, structured, accurate and correctly normalized set of facts. Every product is represented by a unique record appropriately related to one another.
The Global catalog operations (GCO) team is part of Amazon Selection & Catalog services (ASCS) teams in India focus on leveraging human intelligence, external or internal, to measure and improve the quality of the catalog: Global catalog operations (GCO) charter is to make Catalog engineering programs more effective by providing expert human judgment. Catalog Operations from its inception has been partnering with engineering teams to run programs focused on improving the data quality of catalog in all market places.

We are seeking an experienced people leader to join our rapidly growing team as a Manager II, Program Management. In this role you will build and lead a team of SMEs, auditors and Program Managers responsible for developing insights and eliminating quality defects that affect business metrics. You will own a portfolio of catalog quality programs rather than a single workstream, set the direction and mechanisms your team operates by, and be accountable for the aggregate delivery and business outcomes of the programs under you. As part of this role, you will 1) hire, develop, and lead a team of auditors, SMES and program managers, growing the bench and the capability of the function, 2) own a portfolio of quality programs, prioritizing across competing initiatives and allocating capacity to the highest impact opportunities, 3) set the operating mechanisms, standards, and roadmap that make your team's programs measurable and repeatable, and 4) work collaboratively across partner teams (Science, PMs, Engineering, Business, etc.) and represent catalog quality program management to senior leadership across GCO and partner orgs.

Key job responsibilities
As a Manager II, Program Management you will:

- Build, lead, and develop a team of auditors, SMEs and program managers, owning hiring, performance management, coaching, and career growth
- Own catalog quality programs, setting priorities across competing initiatives and allocating team capacity to the highest impact work
- Establish the operating mechanisms, standards, and roadmap that ensure your team's programs deliver measurable business and operational outcomes
- Be accountable for the aggregate delivery and business/operational metrics of the programs under your team
- Drive quantitative, data-oriented decision making across the portfolio and champion the adoption of technology solutions and process improvements
- Communicate program progress, risks, and results to senior leadership, ensuring transparency and alignment with key business goals
- Identify systemic gaps across process areas and mobilize your team and stakeholders to resolve them
- Serve as an escalation point and senior partner for in-house and customer teams across Science, Engineering, Product, and Business
- Ensure effective risk controls are developed and maintained across programs, with corrective actions that keep commitments on track and minimize losses
- Develop and influence new ideas, establishing procedures and practices that promote long-term, scalable solutions in dynamic environments
- Drive continuous improvement and decision-making strategies across the team and the broader function

- 3+ years of program or project management experience
- 3+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams experience
- 3+ years of delivering cross functional projects experience
- Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements
- 5+ years of team management experience

The Principal Technical Program Manager is a leadership role where you'll set strategic technical direction and drive a transformative, cross-organizational initiative spanning multiple business workstreams, a large portfolio of new deal types, across several engineering organizations, and a broad set of cross-functional stakeholders, with a firm deadline to fully deprecate MGM's legacy ERP and complete the integration.

What You'll Do:
- Own and deliver an ambiguous, very large, and complex program that spans multiple organizations and technology domains, serving as the single-threaded owner for all program-level milestones across several bespoke business workstreams (including international and domestic theatrical distribution, third-party content licensing, development and production, streaming, and production facilities).
- Design and own the end-to-end data migration and cutover strategy that moves all financial data (master, transactional, and reference data) from legacy systems to the consolidated platform, spanning the full stack across business, middleware, financial automation, downstream financial infrastructure, and legacy systems to deprecate.
- Develop workback plans per workstream, sequence migrations to manage operational risk, and coordinate with the studio's legal entity restructure, owning the sequencing trade-offs of its circular dependency with the program's builds.
- Own the standardization and graduation framework — define deal-type primitives, establish system-of-record boundaries, enforce standard-versus-exception rules, and determine when each workstream is ready to transition from the program to BAU ownership.
- Identify risks and opportunities in technical strategies, system architectures, and engineering organizational structures, resolving cross-workstream dependencies and engineering capacity gaps.
- Influence and advise VP-level leadership across multiple Finance Technology and Studios Technology organizations — plus Finance, Accounting, Tax, and FinOps — on technical investment decisions, organizational alignment, and long-term platform strategy, making priority calls based on business value, partner readiness, and platform reuse.
- Author the program's strategic narratives, define program-level tenets, and run the operating cadence (monthly and quarterly business reviews with senior leadership, and ad-hoc executive escalations).
- Drive clarity in a highly ambiguous environment where business strategy, architectural approach, and even the problem definition may not yet exist.

What You Bring:
- 10+ years of technical program management experience, with a demonstrated track record of delivering very large, cross-organizational programs.
- Deep expertise in large-scale systems and platform architecture, and the ability to evaluate and influence architectural strategies across multiple engineering organizations.
- Executive-level communication and influence skills, with experience advising VP-level leaders and aligning competing priorities across organizational boundaries — without direct line authority.
- Strong business acumen with the ability to connect technical decisions to business outcomes at scale.
- Experience making irreversible sequencing decisions in complex migrations and managing controllership and operational risk.

Why This Role Matters:
As the Principal TPM for this program, you won't just execute, you'll define how MGM's financial systems are successfully integrated into Amazon and rebuilt for the next decade. You'll make the irreversible calls: which businesses cut over first, when to freeze legacy systems, how to manage the circular dependency between the entity restructure and the program's builds, and which requirements to simplify without impacting customers. This is a role for someone who thrives in ambiguity, drives alignment across senior leaders with competing roadmaps, and delivers outsized, measurable business value and productivity impact.

This role reports to a Senior Manager of Software Development and regularly presents to VP-level leadership across the program's Steering Committee.

Join us in building the future of entertainment finance!

About the team
Prime Video (PV) Financial Systems (FinSys) calculates, pays, receives payments, accounts for and reports all financial activities to operate a digital streaming and studios business. We manage the onboarding of commercial contractual terms and enable seamless monetization of content and assets through mechanisms like PV related purchases, rentals, subscriptions, ads and theatrical releases. We are successful when we have earned the trust of our customers and they are delighted with our solutions. This drives selection growth for Prime Video and the other businesses we support.

Basic qualifications

- 10+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
- 10+ years of technical product or program management experience
- 5+ years of software development experience
- Experience designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems
- Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
- Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition

Preferred qualifications

- 10+ years of hands-on work managing complex technology projects experience
- Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules
- Experience working at a TV Network, broadcaster, or an online streaming platform, specializing in digital video delivery or streaming media technologies

title: Account Manager, Amazon Global Logistics
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Global Logistics (AGL) is seeking an Account Manager for UK and EU markets to build and scale the next generation of logistics solutions – bring your sales skills and data-driven approach to transform how enterprises move inventory globally.

AGL is an integrated, end-to-end, supply chain solution that simplifies the complex global logistics for enterprise customers and Amazon's selling partners. With AGL, businesses can seamlessly transport their inventory from the factory door (in overseas locations such as China and Vietnam) directly to locations in US, UK, EU and JP - all with a click of a button. AGL's aim is to optimize the end-to-end supply chain, allowing customers to focus on what they do best – building unique product offerings that their customers love.

Ideal Candidate Profile: You thrive in ambiguity and can juggle multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. You possess high levels of creativity, flexibility, and attention to detail. You're deeply data-oriented and know how to translate customer requirements into compelling value propositions. You have a proven track record in pipeline development and sales target achievement.

Key job responsibilities
-Recruit and manage a diverse portfolio of Selling Partners for Amazon Global Logistics suite of supply chain services to meet or exceed sales targets (Sellers launched, volume, revenue, etc.)
-Own sales activities including outreach, sales pipeline management, forecasting, operational troubleshooting, Selling Partner education, etc.
-Identify growth opportunities through solutions-based selling by identifying and understanding Selling Partners' supply chain needs
-Conduct persuasive sales presentations to senior external stakeholder such as Directors and business owners
-Actively prospect for new business opportunities, leveraging market insights and network connections
-Program management responsibilities geared to improve and build upon the Selling Partners experience
-Identify and partner with internal teams ensure seamless seller experience and target achievement


A day in the life
Morning: You join the daily standup, sharing operational updates and learnings from recent seller conversations. You then review your pipeline, prioritising outreach by account tier and revenue potential, and shaping your approach around each prospect's supply chain needs. You also work with partner teams like FBA to align on shared accounts and coordinate joint outreach.

Midday: You pitch 4 to 5 prospective sellers a week on AGL's logistics services, turning supply chain solutions into clear value for senior decision makers. You prepare pipeline metrics for leadership reviews, summarising deal progress, flagging risks, and calling out wins.

Afternoon: You contribute to WBR metric reviews and help align team priorities. You own or support a team initiative, such as improving seller onboarding or internal handoffs. You close the day nurturing seller relationships and supporting new sellers through launch.

About the team
Formed in 2020, the EMEA Sales Team within Amazon Global Logistics works closely with Amazon Selling Partners providing onboarding support, operational insights, and direction for new and existing logistics products & services. Our objective over the next few years is to scale our global supply chain program for Amazon Selling Partners and deliver a logistics experience they love.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- Experience exceeding sales targets using a consultative, solutions-focused approach or equivalent
- Experience influencing at all levels within an organization, particularly at the executive level
- Experience translating customer needs into business requirements
- Speak, write, and read fluently in German

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in sales or marketing work (like e-commerce, retail technology, SaaS) or equivalent
- Experience with MS Office Suite, CRMs (Salesforce) and other systems
- MBA, or Master's degree

title: Account Representative Intern 6 months - Italian Speaker
descriptionHtml:
At Amazon, your career doesn’t follow a straight line. It accelerates, twists, and challenges you in ways you never expected. From the moment you join, you’re part of something big: building products or services that reach millions and shaping how people live, work, and connect every day. This is where your ideas turn into real impact.
You’ll work with world class tools, global platforms, and systems built to operate at an extraordinary scale. You’ll move fast, experiment and launch solutions that matter. With endless opportunities to explore across teams and roles, you’ll learn quickly, apply what you know and discover skills you didn’t know existed. This is an environment designed for builders who want to see the impact of their work in the world. Ready to start your adventure?

What’s in it for you?
An internship at Amazon means real responsibility from day one. You’ll build, test, and learn alongside people who want to see you succeed, while making an impact that reaches far beyond campus.


Key job responsibilities
Work backwards from the customer, identifying inputs to grow brands and improve their performance across Amazon's retail categories.

Support vendor managers and cross-functional teams — including in-stock, marketing, and category teams — to deliver business growth.

Build an understanding of customer pain points, requirements, and potential value that can be delivered through retail, advertising, or merchant services.

Identify target accounts using market data and industry intelligence, and learn the advertising or merchant services portfolio.

Collect, analyse, and review data to develop analytical and problem-solving skills, uncovering insights that drive business improvement.

Identify opportunities to improve products, services, processes, systems, and tools across the business.

Work with product teams and technical support teams to implement improvement projects.

A day in the life
Every day is a little different as an Account Representative Intern. Depending on your team, you might be supporting a vendor manager to grow a strategic brand within a retail category, helping account managers create compelling advertising presentations for clients, or driving new business growth across Amazon's third-party merchants. You might spend your morning analysing market data and customer insights to identify target accounts and growth opportunities, then spend your afternoon working with category or product teams to implement an improvement project.

Amazon is a customer-obsessed business, so no matter which team you join, part of your role will involve working backwards from the customer to understand their pain points and deliver value. You'll gain a deep understanding of Amazon's e-commerce retail business, advertising products, or merchant services portfolio, and partner across functions to deliver results — building your analytical, commercial, and stakeholder management skills in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

Note: You must have the right to work in the country of employment by the start date.

About the team
The Amazon Business team at Amazon is focused on transforming how businesses purchase supplies and equipment by providing a seamless B2B shopping experience.
As an Account Representative Intern, you will work closely with experienced account managers and business development teams who support and grow Amazon Business customers across Europe.

Intern Community:
As an Amazon Intern, you'll be part of a dynamic, supportive community that empowers your growth and development. You'll collaborate with interns from around the world, networking and participating in social events to broaden your perspectives. You can also join specialized groups focused on areas like sustainability to explore your diverse interests.

Support:
The internship program provides a robust support system, including weekly intern office hours, dedicated IT and HR support, and a program team committed to your success. This ensures you have the guidance and assistance needed to thrive.

Learning Sessions:
Exclusive learning sessions will further enhance your skills, granting you access to Amazon's industry-leading learning platforms and the expertise of industry leaders. These structured development opportunities will prepare you for the next step in your career.

Opportunities:
Upon successful completion of the internship, you may be considered for a graduate role or a second internship, allowing you to continue your journey with Amazon. Additionally, you'll enjoy a competitive monthly salary, relocation support, and access to a range of employee benefits.

Internship Start Dates across the year:
We are hiring interns to start anytime from January through September 2027. Each month, we'll hold 1-2 onboarding days for new hires.

- Currently enrolled in University bachelor’s or master’s in Commerce, Business administration, Engineering or similar field
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English and Italian at C1 level or above
- Available for a full-time internship (40 hours/week) and commit to 5 to 6 month internship maximum

Preferred qualifications

- Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to identify process improvements and innovative solutions.
- Excellent communication and teamwork skills, able to collaborate effectively with others.
- Demonstrated curiosity, proactivity, and willingness to take on challenges in an ambiguous, fast-paced environment.

title: Ops Specialist, APEx
descriptionHtml:
チームについて
Amazonは、地球上で最もお客様を大切にする企業となることを目指しています。AMXL プロアクティブ・エグゼキューション（APEx）チームは、大型家具・家電製品の購入、配送、設置に伴う複雑なお客様の問題を解決するチームです。

ポジション概要
APExオペレーションスペシャリストは、大型家具・家電の注文に関連する商品およびサービス体験において、オペレーションチームをサポートします。配送関連の不備を先回りして検知・解決するとともに、エスカレーションに迅速に対応し、常にお客様を起点に行動します。また、配送に関する問題が特定された場合には、お客様に電話で解決策をご案内する業務も担当します。

***
About the Team
At Amazon, we strive to be Earth's most customer-centric company. The AMXL Proactive Execution (APEx) team resolves complex customer problems associated with purchasing, delivering, and installing Heavy-Bulky products such as large furniture and appliances.

Role Overview
The APEx Operations Specialist supports the operations team in delivering exceptional product and service experiences for Heavy-Bulky orders. This role is responsible for proactively identifying and resolving delivery defects, responding to escalations in a timely manner, and always working backwards from the customer. The role also requires direct outbound calls to customers to communicate solutions for identified delivery issues.

Key job responsibilities
- お客様やビジネス関係者に影響を及ぼす問題が発生した際に責任を持って解決に当たり、同様の問題を未然に防ぐ方法を提案する
- 予定配送および突発的な配送における配送不備のモニタリングと先回りでの解決
- 適切なタイミングで正確かつプロフェッショナルなカスタマーサービスを提供し、お問い合わせを解決する
- 配送問題に関するお客様への電話連絡および解決策のご案内
- 文書でも口頭でも分かりやすく丁寧なコミュニケーションスキルを発揮する
- 社内ダッシュボードを効果的に使用し、ビジネスパートナーに対して正確な回答と最高のカスタマーエクスペリエンスを提供する
- システムやプロセスの問題、お客様からのフィードバックの傾向を積極的にマネジメントにエスカレーションする
- お客様の声を代弁して業務プロセスを見直し、より高いレベルのカスタマーエクスペリエンスを推進する

title: Praktikum im Bereich Logistik - Oerlenbach bei Schweinfurt - 2027
descriptionHtml:
Bitte beachte: Wir haben verschiedene Möglichkeiten in ganz Deutschland und benötigen Flexibilität bezüglich der Standorte. Wenn du dich für die Stelle bewirbst, gib bitte alle deine bevorzugten Standorte in Deutschland an.
Alle unsere Praktika finden vollständig vor Ort statt.
Amazon Operations ist das Rückgrat der Amazon-Kundenerfahrung. Mit über 50 Logistikzentren, hunderten von Zustellstationen und zehntausenden von Versandmitarbeiter:innen arbeitet das Team zusammen, um Artikel effizient an Kund:innen zu liefern. In den Logistikzentren werden jährlich Millionen von Artikeln kommissioniert und verpackt, während die Zustellteams daran arbeiten, Bestellungen pünktlich an die Kund:innen zu bringen. Sicherheit hat oberste Priorität, und die Betriebskultur ist geprägt von Teamwork, Vielfalt und einer gemeinsamen Arbeitsethik, die das Geschäft reibungslos am Laufen hält. Das Team ist stolz darauf, den Qualitätsservice zu liefern, für den Amazon weltweit bekannt ist.

Hinweis: Du musst zum Starttermin die Arbeitsberechtigung für das Beschäftigungsland haben.


Key job responsibilities
Als Amazon Operations-Praktikant:in hast du die Möglichkeit, deine analytischen Fähigkeiten in wirkungsvollen Projekten anzuwenden, die die Funktionalität und den Service von Logistikzentren, Sortierzentren und Zustellstationen verbessern. Wichtige Aspekte der Rolle umfassen:
• Abschluss von Projekten mit hoher Priorität nach höchstem Standard und Nachweis deiner Fähigkeit, Ergebnisse zu liefern
• Datenanalyse zur Identifizierung operativer Herausforderungen und Verbesserungsmöglichkeiten
• Vorschlagen und Testen von Lösungen in Zusammenarbeit mit dem Team zur Umsetzung der effektivsten Ansätze
• Entwicklung von Kommunikations- und Teamfähigkeiten durch die Zusammenarbeit mit Führungskräften, Stakeholdern und Versandmitarbeiter:innen.
• Bewegung im Gebäude, um mit verschiedenen Teams zu interagieren. Das umfasst aktives Wissenssammeln durch Teilnahme an Aktivitäten wie Vorbesprechungen, Ablaufmeetings und Diskussionen mit dem Führungsteam und Versandmitarbeiter:innen.
• Die Fähigkeit, sich im Arbeitsbereich zu orientieren und zwischen verschiedenen Bereichen zu wechseln, ist für diese Position unerlässlich.
• Flexibilität bei verschiedenen Arbeitszeiten und Schichtmustern nach Bedarf zeigen.
• Möglicher Umzug an den vorgesehenen Arbeitsort.


A day in the life
Unsere Praktika sind Bildungsmöglichkeiten, die es dir als unserer zukünftigen Führungskraft ermöglichen, zu entdecken, wie wir unsere Teams von Versandmitarbeiter:innen führen und entwickeln. Du tauchst in die schnelllebige, komplexe Welt unserer Logistikzentren, Sortierzentren und Zustellstationen ein und erlebst, wie unsere Führungskräfte ihre Teams einsetzen, um Kundenerwartungen zu erfüllen.
Dieses Praktikum versetzt dich ins Herz unserer Abläufe und ermöglicht es dir, den Weg einer Kundenbestellung zu verfolgen. Du erhältst einen realistischen Einblick in die Vollzeitchancen, die dich in unserem Unternehmen erwarten.
Du lernst, wie unsere Führungskräfte eine sichere, produktive Umgebung schaffen und das volle Potenzial ihrer Teams durch effektive Einbindung und Leistungsmanagement-Strategien nutzen. Das ist deine Chance, Fähigkeiten zu entwickeln, die dich zu einer lohnenden Karriere bei Amazon führen werden.


About the team
Praktikant:innen-Community:
• Als Amazon-Praktikant:in bist du Teil einer lebendigen, unterstützenden Community, die dein Wachstum und deine Entwicklung fördert. Du arbeitest mit Praktikant:innen aus der ganzen Welt zusammen, knüpfst Kontakte und nimmst an sozialen Veranstaltungen teil, um deinen Horizont zu erweitern. Du kannst auch spezialisierten Gruppen beitreten, die sich auf Bereiche wie Nachhaltigkeit konzentrieren, um deine vielfältigen Interessen zu erkunden.
Unterstützung:
• Das Praktikumsprogramm bietet ein robustes Unterstützungssystem, einschließlich wöchentlicher Praktikant:innen-Sprechstunden, spezieller IT- und HR-Unterstützung sowie einem Programmteam, das sich deinem Erfolg verschrieben hat. Das stellt sicher, dass du die Anleitung und Hilfe hast, die du zum Gedeihen brauchst.
Lernsessions:
• Exklusive Lernsessions werden deine Fähigkeiten weiter verbessern und dir Zugang zu Amazons modernsten Lernplattformen und der Expertise von Branchenführern gewähren. Diese strukturierten Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten bereiten dich auf den nächsten Schritt in deiner Karriere vor.
Möglichkeiten:

Zusätzlich erhältst du ein wettbewerbsfähiges Monatsgehalt, Umzugsunterstützung und Zugang zu einer Reihe von Mitarbeitervorteilen.
Praktikums-Starttermine über das Jahr:
• Wir stellen Praktikant:innen ein, die jederzeit von Januar bis Juli 2027 anfangen können. Jeden Monat führen wir 1-2 Onboarding-Tage für neue Mitarbeiter:innen durch.

title: Sr. System Development Engineer, Managed Operations
descriptionHtml:
AWS has recently launched the inaugural European Sovereign Cloud (ESC), marking a significant development in utility computing (UC). To be a key technical contributor to operational excellence of ESC, we are actively seeking experienced senior system development engineers with a strong background in automation and operations. As part of the AWS Managed Operations team, you will play a pivotal role in guiding operations and development teams dedicated to delivering high-availability AWS services, including EC2, S3, Dynamo, Lambda, and Bedrock, exclusively for EU customers. For more information on ESC please check out our blog: https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/aws/in-the-works-aws-european-sovereign-cloud/

Your responsibilities will encompass contributing to the smooth operation of the ESC, working closely with global AWS teams, and influencing the evolution of AWS services and technology. A typical day in this role involves collaborating with technology leaders and engineers on different seniority levels, contributing to the enhancement of day-to-day operations, and ensuring improvements in availability, reliability, latency, performance, and efficiency of the ESC. You will be required to occasionally participate in “on-call” rotations to resolve incidents occurring out-of-hours.

The overarching goal in this role is to deliver scalable services and ensure a high-availability experience for EU customers. If you are an experienced professional ready for a challenging and impactful opportunity, we invite you to join our efforts in building a best-in-class development engineering and operations team that aligns with AWS' commitment to customer satisfaction and continual innovation.

Utility Computing (UC)
European Sovereign Cloud (ESC) is a part of AWS Utility Computing (UC).
AWS Utility Computing (UC) provides product innovations — from foundational services such as Amazon’s Simple Storage Service (S3) and Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2), to consistently released new product innovations that continue to set AWS’s services and features apart in the industry. As a member of the UC organization, you’ll support the development and management of Compute, Database, Storage, Internet of Things (Iot), Platform, and Productivity Apps services in AWS. title: Data Center Controls Engineer, Queretaro
descriptionHtml:
As part of the global controls team, you will work with highly motivated experts and innovators in the data center industry. You will be responsible for troubleshooting, project management, and maintaining the building management system (BMS) and electrical power monitoring system (EPMS). Using Amazon leadership principles, you will develop new processes and standards while innovating in the controls space. AWS Data centers have multiple components such as generators, uninterruptible power sources, diesel generators, electrical switch-gear, power distribution units, variable frequency drives, automatic/static transfer switches, chillers [air-cooled and water-cooled], pumps, cooling towers, heat exchangers, CRAHs, air economizers, etc. All these components have local control systems that interact with each other via open and/or proprietary communications protocols. The BMS is the primary method of control of all mechanical systems within a data center. The EPMS is the primary method of monitoring all electrical systems within a data center.

Key job responsibilities
1. Complex Multi-System Management & Technical Support - Responsible for the entire lifecycle of BMS and EPMS systems including creation, design, configuration, validation, installation, commissioning, operation, and ongoing troubleshooting across multiple data centers.
2. Project Management Under Constraints - Must develop and manage project scope, schedules, budgets, and level of efforts while juggling multiple stakeholder deliverables and navigating challenging situations with competing requirements.
3. Emergency Response & Critical System Support - Required to participate in AWS global on-call schedule to provide immediate technical support to in-service data centers, demanding constant availability.
4. Extensive Vendor & Procurement Coordination - Involves managing procurement activities (RFQs, RFPs, RFIs, purchase orders), financially managing service contracts, and supervising vendor work to ensure compliance with specifications and codes.
5. Frequent Travel & On-Site Presence - Must frequently visit locally assigned data centers (both operational and under construction) for troubleshooting, customer meetings, and vendor supervision, requiring significant time away from desk work.

title: 2027 AWS - Auszubildende/n als Elektroniker/-in für Informations- und Systemtechnik (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Deine Chance: Wo Elektronik auf Cloud trifft

Du willst verstehen, wie Hardware und Software in einem der modernsten Rechenzentren der Welt zusammenspielen und dieses Zusammenspiel aktiv mitgestalten? Dann starte deine Ausbildung zum/zur Elektroniker:in für Informations- und Systemtechnik bei Amazon Web Services (AWS) in der Region Berlin/Brandenburg.

Beginn: 01.08.2027
Dauer: 3,5 Jahre
Standort: Mittenwalde
Berufsschule: Werner-von-Siemens-Schule, Spandau

Diese Ausbildung ist etwas Besonderes: Sie verbindet Elektronik mit Informationstechnologie an einem Ort, wo beides zusammenkommt: unserem Rechenzentrum in Mittenwalde. Du arbeitest an den Systemen, die Server, Netzwerke und sicherheitsrelevante Komponenten miteinander verbinden und den stabilen Betrieb unserer Cloud-Infrastruktur ermöglichen.

Bei AWS lernst du sie dort, wo sie wirklich zählt, in einem Umfeld, in dem deine Arbeit dafür sorgt, dass Millionen von Nutzer:innen weltweit auf die Cloud zugreifen können.

Du interessierst dich für die Schnittstelle zwischen Elektronik und IT, denkst gerne in Systemen und willst von Anfang an an echten Herausforderungen arbeiten? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig.

Key job responsibilities
Was Du lernen wirst:

• Installation, Konfiguration und Wartung elektrischer und IT-gestützter Systeme im Rechenzentrum
• Analyse und Behebung von Störungen an Netzwerk-, Informations- und Sicherheitssystemen
• Arbeiten in den Bereichen Elektrotechnik, Netzwerktechnik, Steuerungstechnik und IT-Systemadministration
• Messen, Prüfen und Programmieren von Komponenten nach Vorgaben und Sicherheitsstandards
• Unterstützung bei der Verkabelung, Inbetriebnahme und Integration neuer Server- und Netzwerkinfrastruktur
• Mitarbeit an der Weiterentwicklung technischer Konzepte und Infrastrukturprojekte gemeinsam mit erfahrenen Techniker:innen

A day in the life
Deine Ausbildung verbindet Theorie und Praxis von Anfang an. Deine theoretische Ausbildung absolvierst du an der Werner-von-Siemens-Schule in Berlin-Spandau, während du die praktischen Kenntnisse direkt bei AWS im Rechenzentrum in Mittenwalde erwirbst.

Ein typischer Tag? Am Morgen besprichst du mit dem Team die offenen Aufgaben. Du überprüfst die Netzwerkverkabelung eines neuen Racks, testest die Verbindungen und dokumentierst die Konfiguration. Am Nachmittag analysierst du eine Störungsmeldung am Überwachungssystem, lokalisierst das Problem und arbeitest an der Behebung. Am nächsten Tag unterstützt du bei der Integration neuer Server-Hardware oder arbeitest an einem Automatisierungsprojekt.

Du arbeitest von Anfang an Seite an Seite mit erfahrenen Techniker:innen, die dich fördern und fordern. Du übernimmst schrittweise mehr Verantwortung, probierst Dinge aus und entdeckst Fähigkeiten, von denen du vorher nicht wusstest, dass es sie gibt.

Das bieten wir:
• Praxisphasen am Standort Amazon Web Services Mittenwalde (Region Berlin/Brandenburg)
• Einblicke in Netzwerktechnik, Server-Infrastruktur, IT-Sicherheitssysteme und Gebäudeautomation
• Besuch der Werner-von-Siemens-Schule in Berlin-Spandau
• Selbstständiges Arbeiten in einem hochmodernen, technologiegetriebenen Umfeld
• Breites Angebot an Betriebssport- und Interessensgruppen (z.B. Firmenläufe, Team-Events)
• Möglichkeit, eigene Ideen einzubringen und neue Standorte von Anfang an mitzugestalten
• Entwicklungsperspektiven nach erfolgreichem Abschluss, z.B. in IT-, Infrastruktur- oder Rechenzentrumsfunktionen bei AWS

Basic qualifications

- Fließende Deutschkenntnisse (mindestens C1) und Englischkenntnisse (mindestens B1)
- Erfolgreicher Schulabschluss (mindestens mittlerer Bildungsabschluss)
- Begeisterung für Elektronik, IT-Systeme und Netzwerktechnik
- Logisches Denkvermögen und Freude am Problemlösen
- Teamfähigkeit, Neugier und Lust, Neues auszuprobieren
- Mindestens 18 Jahre alt zum Ausbildungsbeginn
- Für diese Position musst Du die Staatsangehörigkeit eines EU-Mitgliedstaates besitzen.

Preferred qualifications

- Interesse an der Schnittstelle zwischen Hardware und Software
- Bist Du interessiert? Wir freuen uns darauf, von Dir zu hören! Bitte bewirb Dich mit deinen vollständigen Bewerbungsunterlagen (Anschreiben, Lebenslauf, Zeugniskopie – ein PDF mit 5 MB max.) online unter www.amazon.jobs/apprentices. title: Critical Infrastructure Electrical Engineer, Field Engineering, Field Engineering
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

As an Amazon Field Engineer, you will provide full life-cycle support to AWS Data Centers from design inception through site improvement and maintenance.

Amazon's vision is to be the world's most customer-centric company, and this role is key to that vision. As an Amazon Critical Infrastructure Engineer, you will be leading projects to fit out our data centers to meet ever-evolving customer needs as we continue expanding our fleet to hyper-scale. As an ideal candidate you:
- Possess Strong Engineering Judgement and are able to provide recommendations despite uncertainty/ambiguity.
- Possess excellent communication and writing skills, attention to detail, maintain high quality standards.
- Organized and have the ability to set priorities and meet deadlines and budget
- Have experience solving problems with engineered solutions.
- Have experience managing engineering projects and consultants.
- Build trust and relationships with different stakeholders (e.g., Operations, Controls, Construction, Design, Commissioning, Product Managers, Technical Program Managers, ).
- Are adaptable and inclined to get into the field to see things up close.
- Excited about a mix of office and field work.

Key job responsibilities
You will be the ‘go to’ engineering resource for your region when technical advice is needed, and will use your subject matter expertise and engage with diverse teams to:
- Perform design and equipment submittal review for new Data Centers in your region.
- Troubleshoot, conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and create Corrective Action (CA) documentation for site/equipment failures.
- Directly support operational issues with ad-hoc training, complex operating procedure reviews, including critical equipment, and event support.
- Own the conceptual design for existing data center upgrades and design-solutions, which add capacity, improve availability, increase efficiency and sustainability.
- Interface with internal data center operations team, data center design engineering team, server hardware team, environmental health and safety team to promote standards that maintain consistency and reliability in services delivered.
- Work on concurrent projects, sometimes in multiple geographical regions.
- Initiate and lead engineering audits including on-site visits within Amazon’s data centers. Produce reports outlining risks with recommended mitigations and remediation.
- Act as resident engineer during new construction projects. Support construction, commissioning, and turnover.

To be considered for this role you must be a UK national and able to obtain and maintain a UK Government Security Clearance. Further details found here: https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/united-kingdom-security-vetting-clearance-levels

A day in the life
Each day you will interact with different teams responsible for all aspects of the data centers. You will prioritize your activities to support data center capacity availability and safety focusing on the actions that are most impactful. You will have the opportunity to work on projects locally and globally.

If you meet these qualifications, exude passion, and enjoy the challenge of innovative projects at hyper-scale, this job is for you!
