descriptionHtml:
Amazon is looking for a detail-oriented individual to join our Data Center Engineering Operations (DCEO) Team. This committed group works to maintain the critical physical infrastructure that supports Amazon Web Services. Specifically, this team works to ensure that the data center's MEP operates at 100% availability while maintaining first-class customer service to the teams and groups within the data centers.

As the Data Center Senior Chief Engineer (CE), you will be responsible for ensuring that all electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment within the data center is operating at peak efficiency. This involves both planned preventative maintenance of equipment, daily corrective work, and emergency response to emergent issues. You will serves as an expert technical resource reporting to the cluster leadership and interacting with onsite Engineering Operations Technicians (EOT), Chief Engineers (CE), Facility Managers (FM) and any third party vendors. Being the singular focal point for all facility operations within a given data center, you will support Amazon within its owned and operated data centers. Data center equipment that supports mission-critical servers must maintain better than 99.999% uptime.

As the Senior Chief Engineer you will manage small-to-medium impacting projects at local and/or regional level from conception to completion. These projects involve large amounts of independent work as well as collaboration with external support groups including engineering, automation, processing, and finance in both local and global settings. Creating and delivering on key milestones, obtaining and tracking quotes for all necessary costs, and documenting project results for future implementation at other facilities. The goals of such projects are for the CE to drive innovation and resiliency while reducing operational costs in the facilities.

One of the best parts to this role is that you will direct, train and support Engineering Operation Technicians in their role of providing hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting and operations. Implementation and execution of site/equipment-specific training exercises is also expected. This equipment includes, but is not limited to, stand-by diesel generators, switchgear, UPS’s, PDU’s, AHU’s, chillers, cooling towers, chemical treatment systems, pumps, motors, VFD’s, and building automation systems.


Key job responsibilities
• Setting and maintaining the highest standards for safety and actively promoting a world-class safety culture in all aspects of operational procedure
• Driving continuous improvement efforts on infrastructure through standardisation of procedures and policies, while delivering performance against agreed metrics

title: Robotics Systems Engineer II, Tech Deployment
descriptionHtml:
Join Amazon's Robotics (AR) Technology Deployment team within Amazon Robotics (AR) organization to deploy industrial robotics and automation technologies across North America's fulfillment network. In AR TD, we have the unique role and privilege of deploying leading edge industrial robotics and customer fulfillment technologies across the North America Stores operations. We raise the bar on the speed, quality and cost of deploying industrial technologies at scale across North America, functioning as the field team who plan, execute and launch the technologies that our internal design and product strategy partners in A develop.

As a Systems Engineer in AR TD, you will be overseeing large scale project planning, installation, and launch of industrial automation technologies across Amazons growing Stores network. This field engineering position demands strong technical skills for deploying robotic equipment, including mechanical and electrical systems, network configurations, and software coordination. The ideal candidate has experience with complex electro-mechanical and network systems, large scale installations, and system troubleshooting. You will work with cross-functional partners across the Amazon Fulfillment Technology & Robotics engineering, safety, product strategy, software, supply chain, third-party installers, contracted deployment engineers, construction teams, and internal operations customer teams, functioning as the lead on-site project manager to provide technical oversight on installation Amazon-designed automation equipment. This Systems Engineer position is an individual contributor role, influencing and leading stakeholders from planning through go-live of each project. Project durations vary from a few days to several months each. This is a travel-based role and you will be expected to travel to meet the requirements of your projects across North America, upwards of 75% or more.

**Relocation to Amazon Corporate offices in Seattle, Boston, Nashville or Austin will be required for the role.

Key job responsibilities
As a Systems Engineer II, a candidate will typically own multiple simultaneous deployments of a single technology across multiple sites or oversee multi-technology deployments within a single site; delivering within documented standards. This role requires a balance of experience both in working with high-complexity industrial technologies, with complex, multi-dependency project management. The ideal candidate is proactive and takes independent initiative in improving system performance and handling end-to-end deployment. In parallel to the execution, candidates will be responsible for driving continuous improvement ideas into both the deployment cycle time (safety, quality and productivity), and will be responsible for sharing engineering design improvements feedback to the hardware engineering and product teams, to simplify the installation. This role will require the ability to build relationships and capture and synthesize the voice of the customer.
You will manage the tactical deployment of large scale industrial automation technologies, ranging in technical complexity and product maturity from early alpha/beta to mature Generally Available.

- You will own the tactical execution (onsite coordination of installation and acceptance testing) to achieve the target “go-live” date for each project assigned; delivering independently.
- You will collaborate with hardware engineering, technical program managers, product managers, and internal customers including site maintenance and operations teams to convert technical requirements into refined deployment execution documents (schedules, Standard Operating Procedures, dependencies, etc.)
- You will improve operational metrics and team processes through automation and optimization
- You will independently resolve difficult technical problems during deployment, considering operational burden and making appropriate trade-offs between time, quality, and resources
- You will create and improve standard work documents and operational guidebooks, and work towards automating or improving team processes.
- You will influence internal and partner teams towards meeting team level goals.
- You will develop subject matter expertise in one or more deployment domains
- You will mentor junior engineers and participate in technical assessment
- You will drive operational excellence initiatives with measurable results

A day in the life
In this role you will be focused on execution of end-to-end deployment and manage technical ambiguity around integration of workcells in fulfillment centers. On a daily basis you will collaborate with hardware engineering, technical program managers, product managers, construction teams, and internal customers including site maintenance and operations teams, to ensure a safe, on time, high quality product is delivered to the internal customer. You will travel to your project sites, collaborate both virtually and in person, to ensure all business stakeholders are aligned on program status. You will manage the day-to-day project execution, and work on continuous improvement activities to improve deployment execution first pass yield. You will work with senior engineers and your manager to develop technical depth and begin building strategic thinking skills for future growth.

Amazon offers a full range of benefits that support you and eligible family members, including domestic partners and their children. Benefits can vary by location, the number of regularly scheduled hours you work, length of employment, and job status such as seasonal or temporary employment. The benefits that generally apply to regular, full-time employees include:

1. Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage
2. Maternity and Parental Leave Options
3. Paid Time Off (PTO)
4. 401(k) Plan

If you are not sure that every qualification on the list above describes you exactly, we'd still love to hear from you! At Amazon, we value people with unique backgrounds, experiences, and skillsets. If you’re passionate about this role and want to make an impact on a global scale, please apply!

About the team
Are you inspired by invention? Is problem solving through teamwork in your DNA? Do you like the idea of seeing how your work impacts the bigger picture? Answer yes to any of these and you’ll fit right in here at Tech deployment (TD) within Amazon Robotics (AR). We are a smart, collaborative team of enthusiastic doers that work passionately to apply cutting edge advances in robotics and software to solve real-world challenges that will transform our customers’ experiences in ways we can’t even image yet. We invent new improvements every day. Within AR, we will give you the tools and support you need to invent with us in ways that are rewarding, fulfilling and fun

AR Tech Deployment are missioned with enabling the delivery of large scale automation technologies designed and manufactured by Amazon. The team is multi-disciplinary, and consists of Field Deployment Engineers, Controls Engineering, Design for Deployment, Product Single Threaded Leaders, and a Program Management Office team, who collaborate on enabling the delivery of new technologies and packaging solutions that delight our customers, and improve the safety, quality and costs within the Amazon fulfillment processes. The team is geographically located across four North America hub locations. The work we deliver directly impact high priority goals set each year to our most senior leadership at Amazon.

- 5+ years experience in troubleshooting robotics systems or other complex mechanical-electrical or networked systems to resolve escalations including quality hand-off, live order testing, site acceptance testing, operational readiness testing, and monitoring system performance

descriptionHtml:
Our Worldwide Operations network delivers millions of packages and smiles to Amazon customers every day. We are looking for motivated, customer-focused individuals who want to join our team as an Operations Manager. In this role, you will play a key part in maintaining our customer expectations to ensure customer orders are delivered at the right time, to the right location. You will lead and develop a team of salaried and hourly talent. Our Operation’s workflow has three major components: First mile - where the product is housed and ready for order; Middle mile - where the order is hauled to your area; and Last mile - when the product is delivered to the customer’s door. Please note that all workflows have slight building variations, but one thing is constant: our vision and dedication to the customer.
Rural Super Rural (RSR) is an exciting organization within Amazon specializing in delighting our customers with speed in which we can make items appear on their doorsteps. Our WW Operations network delivers millions of packages and smiles to Amazon customers every day. We are looking for motivated, customer-focused individuals who want to join our team as an Operations Manager. In this role, you will lead and develop a team of salaried and hourly talent. title: Business Intelligence Engineer, Forecasting & Labs Analytics
descriptionHtml:

We need your skills to optimize our supply chain, with the end goal of delighting our customers. title: Content Platform Infrastructure Engineer, XCM
descriptionHtml:
Amazon's Cross Channel Marketing team (XCM) is seeking a Infrastructure Manager to own the systems behind our content platforms, serving marketing, campaign, creative, design, and production. This includes a dedicated AWS environment supporting petabyte-scale storage across multiple tiers, high-performance shared filespace supporting creative production, and the compute and automation that keep it running. This role administers those systems, automates their operation, and extends them to support new integrations with the third-party platforms our teams depend on.

The work spans storage lifecycle, backup, recovery, and continuity planning, identity and access management, and the single sign-on and credential lifecycle behind every third-party platform in the estate. This role automates that administration wherever it can, and maintains the ownership, monitoring, and support structures that keep these systems supportable as the environment grows. It also helps shepherd new tools through Amazon security review and keeps tools already in use compliant as requirements change.

We are looking for a hands-on administrator who thinks in systems and would rather automate an operational burden than absorb it. Curiosity about AI as a working tool is expected, both in applying it to infrastructure automation and in judging where it belongs. Understanding the pace and scale at which marketing and production teams work matters as much as infrastructure depth. Ambiguity is constant here: inherited systems, incomplete documentation, and dependencies that sit with vendors and internal security, identity, and tech partners.

Key job responsibilities
- Manages the AWS environment behind our content platforms, and evolves it as new workloads and integrations arrive
- Designs storage tiering and lifecycle policy across petabyte-scale content and multiple systems, determining what lives where and why
- Owns high-performance shared storage, backup, and archive across creative production and digital asset management
- Automates administration of these systems so the environment scales without adding manual work
- Maintains identity, access, and security compliance across the third-party platform estate, including single sign-on, credential lifecycle, and platform security review
- Establishes and maintains operational standards for these systems, covering ownership records, monitoring, alerting, and support processes
- Builds and secures the infrastructure new integrations run on, including credential storage and access paths for AI and third-party services

- Experience implementing repeatable processes and driving automation or standardization
- Experience directly working with cloud hosting technologies (AWS, Azure, etc.)
- Direct ownership over live production cloud environment, including storage at scale, lifecycle, and compute
- Experience supporting creative, marketing or media teams and their system needs

title: Technical Infrastructure Program Manager - Fiber Deployment, Global Connectivity Infrastructure Development - Fiber Deployment
descriptionHtml:
Bringing a new AWS data center online starts with fiber in the ground. In this role you own that work across high-volume US metro markets, taking a metro fiber route from approved plan to live capacity and managing the construction vendors who build it.

You will run several builds at once, hold vendors to schedule and quality, inspect sites to confirm the work was done right, and keep a wide group of stakeholders current on where each project stands. If you have built fiber before, you will move fast here. If you have run complex physical infrastructure programs, you can succeed here too: the hard part of this job is owning an ambiguous program end to end and driving it to delivery in a highly variable environment.

Key job responsibilities
- Own end-to-end delivery of metro fiber construction projects, from approved plan through in-service handover
- Manage construction vendors to schedule and quality: track milestones, measure performance, and drive corrective action when standards are not met
- Run quality control across the build: inspect conduit and vault installation, validate designs in the field, and review splice and fiber acceptance test results and as-built accuracy before handoff to internal customers
- Deliver weekly status reporting to leadership and internal customers, and manage risk, escalations, and competing priorities across multiple concurrent builds
- Coordinate site access and approvals in security-regulated environments, and travel to field sites up to 50% of the time

A day in the life
Most days your focus is knowing the true status of every build you own and moving each one forward. You will scan vendor progress and open risks, make the calls that unblock a permit or a crew, and update the trackers your stakeholders rely on. You work day to day with construction vendors and general contractors, fiber engineers, data center and networking teams, and permitting authorities. Some weeks you will be on a site confirming the build matches the design and the test results hold up. Beyond the steady work of delivery, you will also help improve the standards and processes the team runs on. This is a field-facing role rather than a remote one, and you will spend real time on site.

About the team
Global Connectivity Infrastructure Development - Fiber Deployment plans, manages, and delivers the physical fiber network that connects AWS data centers. The high-volume metro team delivers the fiber that brings new AWS capacity online across our busiest metro markets. You will work alongside construction vendors, engineers, and the internal customers who depend on that capacity, building large-scale fiber networks on time and to a high quality bar. Our focus for the coming years is scaling delivery without losing that quality, and this role is central to it. New teammates reach independent project ownership quickly, supported by runbooks and mentorship.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of technical infrastructure management experience
- Knowledge of best practices and emerging technologies, related to infrastructure (i.e. network, data center, hardware, software)
- Experience with varying scenarios of infrastructure builds
- 3+ years of experience managing third-party vendors or contractors, including tracking delivery timelines, measuring performance against metrics, and driving corrective action when quality or schedule standards are not met
- 3+ years of experience managing multiple concurrent projects across cross-functional teams, including scope, schedule, risk, and stakeholder communication

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with reporting and automation tools such as SQL, Python, GIS platforms, or business intelligence tools
- Experience delivering physical infrastructure in another domain such as data center, utilities, energy, or large-scale capital construction, and applying it to a new technical field

title: Logistics Specialist
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Be a part of operating the world’s largest cloud computing infrastructure. Amazon Web Services is seeking bright, motivated, hardworking individuals to fill Data center Logistics Specialist positions. The ideal candidate possesses a strong work ethic, attention to detail, the ability to meet deadlines, and a commitment to Safety & Operational Excellence.

Logistics Specialists monitor inventory levels to ensure that proper stock levels are maintained to support build and repair activities. They receive parts, maintain inventory, and check-out parts as needed to Data center Technicians and Engineers. They will also be responsible for loading and unloading shipments and transporting parts between different locations.

This position involves frequent lifting of materials and products. Logistics Specialists will be required to keep precise records of all commodities going in and out of company. They must also maintain the cleanliness, organization, and safety of all work spaces. They must be available to work weekend shift work.

The ideal candidate will have experience working in a warehouse or distribution environment, as well as experience and knowledge of reverse logistics processes. Experience handling vendor relationships is helpful.

NOTE: Amazon is not able to provide sponsorship now or in the future for these positions. Eligible candidates must have work authorization without employer intervention to be considered.

NOTE: If applying for positions in Oregon (OR) and Ohio (OH), these sites are within AWS GovCloud region. Effective May 15, 2017, logical access to the AWS GovCloud region will be restricted to Amazon employees who are U.S. Citizens (GovCloud may NOT be accessed from outside of the United States).

Key job responsibilities
Physical and Environmental Demands

All physical requirements are expected with reasonable accommodation
• Requires standing, sitting, and walking for prolonged periods of time.
• Typically work is in a warehouse or data center environment where the noise level is moderate to loud.
• Occasionally assist in loading and unloading shipments.
• Occasionally exposed to extreme cold or hot weather

Work Environment
• You are a role model for safety behavior and culture
• Thrive and contribute to a work culture that celebrates diversity and inclusion
• Work with and/or around moving mechanical parts
• Noise level varies and can be loud
• Temperature between 60 and 90 degrees, and will occasionally exceed 90 degrees


Key job responsibilities
• Ensure that all billing associated with the Inventory supply chain is accurate, validated and ready for processing
• Assembling, addressing, stamping and arranging for the shipment of merchandise and materials
• Assist in daily scheduling of deliveries and pick-ups to and from production locations
• Keep precise records of all commodities going in and out of company
• Understand all aspects of production, adhere to strict safety standards, maintain very high quality, and be willing and able to work on powered equipment (i.e forklift or cherry picker).

A day in the life
The Logistics Specialist reviews Data Center inventory, in-bound shipments, and ongoing demand to ensure that proper stock levels are maintained in the all locations to support build and repair activities. Working with the Logistics Manager, you will create plans to optimize the flow of parts through their lifecycle; tracking inventory location, movement, age, and turns. You will work closely with Data Center Operations Technicians and Data Center Engineers to fulfill parts quickly and accurately. You will also work with Procurement and Hardware Engineering to purchase new parts and interface directly with vendors to process RMAs and receive replacements. Regular and ongoing communications with vendors to resolve issues and help them understand our business requirements necessitates a high-level communicator.

In addition, Logistics Specialists are expected to understand all aspects of production, adhere to strict safety standards, maintain very high quality, and be willing and able to work on powered equipment (i.e forklift or cherry picker).

All candidates should be willing to work both independently and with a team. Work prioritization, organization skills, effective communication, and the ability to react quickly are critical to being successful.

You will be required to work shift work that will include days/nights/weekends/holidays. Traveling within the regional work area is required. You will be responsible for having a reliable personal vehicle and a valid driver’s license to travel within the regional work area, as company transportation will not be provided.

About the team
AWS is committed to providing a safe and healthy work environment. You will be trained on data center safety, policies, procedures, and
guidelines.

Why AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Diverse Experiences
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.


Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship and Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

title: Senior Industrial Designer
descriptionHtml:
We are seeking a Senior Industrial Designer to translate design vision into production-ready form language for our next-generation robotic platforms. You will own form development from early volumetric exploration through surface refinement — defining what our robots look and feel like while ensuring designs are manufacturable from the start. You’ll work at the intersection of aesthetics and engineering, balancing proportion, character, and visual brand coherence with the realities of complex electromechanical packaging, dynamic articulation, and production tooling.

Key job responsibilities
- Form Development & Surface Refinement: Explore, iterate, and refine complex multi-part robotic enclosures, articulating fairings, and structural chassis using Rhino, SubD, Alias, or Blender — from rapid volumetric studies through production-intent surfacing with Class-A quality standards.
- Design for Manufacturing: Incorporate draft angles, parting line strategy, wall thickness constraints, and tooling considerations into the design process from the start. Develop surfaces with production intent across injection molding, sheet metal, die casting, and composite fabrication processes.
- Unified Design Language: Establish and maintain a cohesive visual brand language across the entire robot — ensuring seamless aesthetic and proportional transitions between static and moving components.
- Dynamic Articulation & Clearances: Explore and resolve how physical panels interact, reveal internal mechanisms, and clear dynamic ranges of motion while maintaining design intent.
- Component Packaging & Integration: Collaborate closely with mechanical engineering, robotics, and manufacturing teams to package high-density motor assemblies, cooling systems, battery modules, and sensor arrays into an appealing, functional, and producible envelope.
- Engineering Handoff: Deliver organized, proportion-locked CAD models (SubD / clean NURBS / production-intent surfaces) with clear design intent documentation — character lines, highlight priorities, parting line intent, and DFM annotations ready for tooling development.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of industrial design experience with a focus on complex physical products (robotics, automotive, medical devices, consumer electronics, or similar electromechanical systems)
- Experience working directly with mechanical engineering and manufacturing engineering teams through production
- Bachelor’s degree in Industrial Design, Transportation Design, Product Design, or related field
- Expert-level proficiency in Rhino, SubD modeling, Alias, Blender, or Plasticity with demonstrated ability to develop refined surfaces efficiently
- Portfolio demonstrating exceptional sense of proportion, visual hierarchy, and unified aesthetic across complex, multi-component mechanical systems where multiple subsystems must integrate and interact
- Working knowledge of manufacturing processes including injection molding, sheet metal forming, die casting, and composite fabrication
- Understanding of dynamic kinematic clearances, packaging volumes for motors/electronics, and thermal management considerations
- Proven ability to maintain clean model organization, logical parting line intent, and deliver production-ready STEP/mesh files

Preferred qualifications

- Experience designing articulated or dynamic mechanical systems (robotics, automotive, powered equipment)
- Class-A surfacing skills in Alias or equivalent
- Experience taking designs from concept through tooling kickoff
- Background in automotive, surgical robotics, or consumer robotics design studios
- Familiarity with GD&T and tolerance stack-up considerations at the industrial design level
- Proficiency in Gravity Sketch, Vizcom AI, or other rapid visualization tools
- Experience with physical prototyping workflows (3D printing, CNC, soft tooling)

descriptionHtml:

As a Sr. Network Support Engineer (NSE) in the eero Support Engineering team, you'll join a global team of NSEs who investigate customer and fleet-impacting issues, serve as subject matter experts across product, engineering, marketing, and CX organizations, and provide escalation support to senior leadership. Your work will directly shape how we identify and resolve issues that impact the customer experience — ensuring we meet our commitments to customers worldwide. This is a high-visibility role where technical depth meets customer obsession: you'll drive resolution on complex networking challenges while influencing the tools, processes, and strategies that elevate our entire support organization.

You'll serve as the organization's expert on networking, fleet monitoring, and customer support practices — handling complex network issues as the escalation point of contact for business leaders, IT staff, and managed service providers. Your technical depth will drive strategy defined by leadership, and you'll model troubleshooting methodologies that agents across all tiers follow.

You'll work collaboratively with stakeholders across the organization, acting as the Voice of the Customer when making technical recommendations. This means investigating customer contacts, drilling into unique and complex networking issues to support T1, T2, and T3 agents, and translating findings into actionable improvements for the broader team.

You'll also visit customer and partner locations to diagnose, repair, and install complex eero networks — bringing hands-on expertise where it's needed most. You'll participate in the on-call roster, handle incidents with urgency, and travel both domestically and internationally (up to 35%) on short notice as defined by leadership, with an emphasis on in-region travel to quickly resolve customer and partner issues.



A day in the life

You'll balance deep-dive investigations into fleet-wide anomalies with real-time escalation support, collaborating cross-functionally with engineering and product teams to drive root-cause resolution. title: Senior Software Engineer, AWS Applied AI Solutions
descriptionHtml:
As part of the AWS Applied AI Solutions organization, we have a vision to provide business applications, leveraging Amazon’s unique experience and expertise, that are used by millions of companies worldwide to manage day-to-day operations. We will accomplish this by accelerating our customers’ businesses through delivery of intuitive and differentiated technology solutions that solve enduring business challenges. We blend vision with curiosity and Amazon’s real-world experience to build opinionated, turnkey solutions. Where customers prefer to buy over build, we become their trusted partner with solutions that are no-brainers to buy and easy to use.

We're building Chorus, a real-time document workspace where AI agents are actual collaborators: an agent gets a cursor in the doc, edits the same CRDT, and shows up in presence right next to you. We wrote it from scratch in Rust and TypeScript, we sync in under 50ms with hundreds of simultaneous editors on a single document, and it costs roughly a dollar per builder per year to run. It's an exciting combination of greenfield work with a massive user base that provides immediate feedback when something doesn't work.

We're a small team with an unusually direct line from idea to thousands of builders using it. If you want to be one of maybe a dozen people in the world shipping production CRDT infrastructure that treats AI as a peer, this is the job.

Key job responsibilities

* Own end-to-end technical architecture for a service that is scaling from early customers to AWS-wide adoption

* Work directly with internal and eventually external customers to understand integration needs, set expectations, and turn real-time feedback into service direction

* Drive technical consensus across partner teams with competing priorities and constraints

* Make judgment calls on when to solve a problem scrappily for one customer and when to build the abstraction that serves many

* Mentor and develop junior and mid-level engineers through code reviews and design reviews

* Drive operational excellence: define monitoring and alarming standards, ensure production readiness for new features, and build a culture where the team can sustain what it ships

* You own a problem space end to end, identify the most salient problems now and deliver solutions quickly without sacrificing long-term scalability

* Inventive usage of LLMs in software development. You find ways to deliver code with agents at high speed, but without sacrificing the quality of the code or the software.

* Deep experience in Rust or systems-level TypeScript, or the track record to show you'll get there fast. We care more about how you think about correctness under concurrency than which language you learned it in.

A day in the life
Your mornings are usually free for focus work - architecture, deep dives, and hard problems. Around 11 you'll have standup, then grab lunch with the team (if you like) before the afternoon opens up for design reviews, CR feedback, or unblocking an engineer. Some days you're deep in code; others you're on a call with a customer team working through how their system integrates with yours. You're the person who knows the system most deeply - and you work to ensure you're never the bottleneck. The problems are hard and the stakes are high - but we believe we can move fast, do exceptional work, and have a full life outside of it.

We're a small team building two greenfield projects within Agentic WorkSpaces. We're moving fast enough that our team name is still taking shape — but our engineering culture is well established.

title: Regional Learning Manager, ATS
descriptionHtml:
Amazon's Learning & Development (L&D) team within IN ATS Operations is seeking a highly experienced and results-oriented Learning Manager to lead and scale strategic L&D initiatives across our rapidly growing operations network. This is a pivotal role that sits at the intersection of talent strategy, learning innovation, and operational excellence — directly influencing how Amazon builds, develops, and retains world-class talent at scale.

The role will own end-to-end program management of high-impact initiatives spanning the full L&D value chain: from shaping the hiring strategy and building organizational capability (associates and managers) through programs, to driving content development, expanding centralized learning systems, and leading change management across the network. You will be the single-threaded owner for programs such as Flex (ALFA), global learning benchmarks, and defect reduction — translating data into actionable learning interventions that move the needle on associate performance and operational quality.

This role demands a leader who can operate at both the strategic and tactical level — someone who can present compelling L&D narratives in Quarterly Business Reviews and Operational Planning forums to senior leadership, while simultaneously diving deep into data cuts to identify root causes and scope improvement opportunities. You will manage the L&D budget with fiscal discipline, drive the expansion of learning technology infrastructure, and navigate the learning implications of externalization changes — all while maintaining focus on the associate experience.

The ideal candidate brings a rare combination of program management expertise, analytical horsepower, learning domain knowledge, and the ability to influence without authority across operations, HR, quality, and technology teams. You thrive in ambiguity, move fast with purpose, and are energized by the opportunity to build mechanisms that scale learning impact across one of the world's most complex fulfillment networks.

Key job responsibilities
Hiring Strategy: Own the end-to-end L&D hiring strategy, including workforce planning, talent pipeline development, and role-specific competency frameworks. Partner with Talent Acquisition to ensure timely and quality hiring aligned to business growth plans.
ALFA Strategy: Evaluate and iterate on Flex Fulfillment Associate strategy — identify what is working, diagnose gaps, and drive continuous improvement through mechanism-based interventions.
Capability Building (GB & BB): Design, launch, and scale capability building programs. Define success metrics, track certification throughput, and ensure programs are tied to operational improvement outcomes.
Program Management: Own program management for new programs, global benchmarks. Drive cross-functional alignment, establish milestones, manage risks, and report progress to senior leadership.
QBR & OP1: Prepare and present L&D performance narratives for Quarterly Business Reviews (QBR) and OP1 planning. Own the data story — translate learning metrics into business impact language that resonates with senior leaders.
Defect Reduction: Lead defect reduction initiatives by generating data cuts that identify scope of improvement. Partner with operations and quality teams to prioritize high-impact defect categories and design targeted learning interventions.
Content Development: Own the end-to-end content development strategy and execution. Define content standards, manage the content creation pipeline, and ensure learning materials are current, engaging, and aligned to operational needs. Drive content effectiveness measurement and continuous improvement.
Change Management: Lead change management initiatives related to learning programs and processes. Develop communication plans, stakeholder engagement strategies, and adoption frameworks to ensure smooth rollout of new learning initiatives across the network.
Central Learning Systems Expansion: Drive the expansion and optimization of centralized learning systems and technology infrastructure. Evaluate platform capabilities, manage vendor relationships, and ensure systems scale to meet growing organizational needs.
Learning: Manage learning implications of ATS externalization changes. Assess impact on training requirements, develop transition learning plans, and ensure associates impacted by externalization are equipped with the right skills and knowledge.
L&D Cost and Budgeting: Own the L&D budget and cost management process. Develop annual budgets, track spend against plan, identify cost optimization opportunities, and provide regular financial reporting to leadership.

Basic qualifications

- Experience analyzing business metrics and training data to measure program effectiveness
- Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams
- Experience developing and implementing training programs
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent, or 2+ years of Amazon (blue badge/FTE) experience

Preferred qualifications

- Experience creating learning content and driving learning through a Learning Management System

title: Controls Engineer, Amazon Dedicated Cloud
descriptionHtml:
As part of the global controls team, you will work with highly motivated experts and innovators in the data center industry. You will be responsible for troubleshooting, project management, and maintaining the building management system (BMS) and electrical power monitoring system (EPMS). Using Amazon leadership principles, you will develop new processes and standards while innovating in the controls space. AWS Data centers have multiple components such as generators, uninterruptible power sources, diesel generators, electrical switchgear, power distribution units, variable frequency drives, automatic/static transfer switches, chillers [air-cooled and water-cooled], pumps, cooling towers, heat exchangers, CRAHs, air economizers, etc. All these components have local control systems that interact with each other via open and/or proprietary communications protocols. The BMS is the primary method of control of all mechanical systems within a data center. The EPMS is the primary method of monitoring all electrical systems within a data center.

This position requires that the candidate selected be a US citizen and currently possess and maintain an active Top Secret security clearance with SCI eligibility. The position further requires that, after start, the selected candidate obtain and maintain an active TS/SCI security clearance with polygraph and satisfy other security related requirements.

Key job responsibilities
- Train and assist internal customers and stakeholders with the creation, design, configuration, validation, installation, commissioning and operation of BMS and EPMS systems.
- Provide technical assistance and support to operations during life cycle of the data center. Review results and action items from the quarterly maintenances for BMS and EPMS and take actions to get them resolved.
- Develop BMS & EPMS projects scope of work, schedule, budget, and level of efforts (LOE) to projects requested by customers and stakeholders.
- Manage scope, schedule, finance and execution of BMS and EPMS improvement projects in AWS data centers.
- Assist in procurement related activities including request for quotation/proposals, responding to request for information, review of vendors proposal and issuance of purchase orders.
- Participate in AWS global on-call schedule to provide immediate BMS and EPMS technical support to in-service data centers.
- Attend project related meetings, coordinate with project leaders and regularly report status to Controls and stakeholders’ management.
- Support Controls projects related commissioning activities in the data centers.
- Review, implement, troubleshoot and iterate on the controls sequence of operation (SOO) and provide necessary feedback to the design team.
- Develop and modify controls logic programming and graphical user interfaces.
- Manage multiple stakeholder deliverables, requirements and navigate challenging situations.
- Financially manage BMS and EPMS service contracts.
- Frequently visit (locally) assigned in-operation and/or under construction data centers to troubleshoot, meet customers, supervise vendor’s work to ensure compliance with the scope, design, SOO and applicable local codes.

A day in the life
As a Data Center Controls Engineer, your primary customers are Data Center Engineering Operations (DCEO), who depend on you to deliver reliable, well integrated Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Monitoring Systems (EPMS). The problems you solve are technical: modifying controls logic to address operational issues, developing Methods of Procedure (MOPs) for firmware upgrades, or investigating complex alarm discrepancies across monitoring systems. For new builds, you own the controls scope from vendor submittal review through commissioning and turnover. You manage vendor relationships, budgets, and schedules for both service contracts and capital projects. Your internal stakeholders include your Controls Manager, Controls Technicians you provide technical direction to, and partner teams (Construction, Critical Projects Implementation, Commissioning, DCEO).

About the team
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic qualifications

- Experience with Industrial control systems, both hardware and software
- 2+ years of general contractor and vendor management work (request for proposals, bidding, change orders, quality control, RFI/submittal tracking) associated with construction and project execution experience
- Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or an equivalent engineering science plus 3+ years of relevant controls experience, OR 8+ years of relevant controls experience in lieu of a degree
- 3+ years of experience with industrial controls in critical environment (data center, pharmaceutical, oil & gas, petrochemical, laboratory, power, water etc.)
- Current, active US Government Security Clearance of Top Secret with SCI eligibility or above

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree or above in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering
- Experience reading and writing procedures, technical documents, and engineering drawings, or experience in electrical or mechanical engineering
- Experience leading projects across multiple stakeholders
- Experience directly related to the design or construction of data centers or critical infrastructure or large-scale mechanical and electrical plants
- Professional Engineer License
- 4+ years of military experience
- Experience designing, configuring, programming, installing, troubleshooting or servicing HVAC Controls or Electrical SCADA systems application specific controllers, software and networks.

descriptionHtml:
This role supports Whole Foods Market stores, within the Worldwide Grocery Stores organization.

Amazon is seeking a strategic and solution-focused Human Resources Business Partner (HRBP) to power the trajectory of our business by ensuring we have the right talent mix, leadership, and capabilities to innovate and deliver exceptional customer and Team Member experiences. As an HRBP, you will serve as a leader of people and organizational strategy — accelerating business outcomes through diagnosis, development, and execution of integrated solutions.

You will build trusted relationships with leaders and act as the client face of TMS (Team Member Services), interfacing and liaising with Recruiting, Team Member / Team Leader Development, Compensation, Benefits, HRIS, and the Legal organization. You will coach, act as a change agent, and influence critical decisions around talent and organizational design to drive business results while ensuring compliance with corporate policies, government regulations, and statutory requirements.

This role requires travel up to 25% of the time.


Key job responsibilities
Organizational Effectiveness

Leverage deep knowledge of the business — including P&L, retail operations, and the competitive grocery/retail landscape — to tailor people-focused solutions that drive business outcomes

Interpret key people metrics and trends, utilizing mechanisms to inspect, monitor, and proactively mitigate organizational risks

Design, recommend, and implement effective organizational structures that align with business strategy, strengthen culture, and enable inclusive decision-making

Partner with leaders to build customer-centric, Team Member–focused organizations that foster agility and empower frontline decision-making

Ensure dynamic assessment of organizational capability — strengths, weaknesses, and opportunities — on a forward-looking basis

Recommend new approaches, policies, and procedures to drive continual improvement in TMS service delivery

Leader and Leadership Team Effectiveness

Assess both long-term and immediate leader talent needs to achieve business goals

Develop strategies to build required leader skills and establish inclusive talent pipelines

Coach and advise individual leaders and leadership teams on improving management abilities, addressing business challenges, and strengthening culture

Challenge leaders when necessary to break mental models on ways of working, biases, structure, and talent decisions

Reinforce difficult decisions that align with organizational strategies and values

Change Management

Use listening mechanisms to identify trends, risks, and hotspots to inform change plans and maximize both customer and Team Member experience

Drive effective change environments by leveraging multiple perspectives and inclusive communication strategies

Influence and coach leaders as they build their teams' ability to navigate organizational changes

Monitor and evaluate implemented changes to assess effectiveness and durability

Talent Planning & Workforce Strategy

Build long-term, inclusive workforce plans aligned with business objectives; proactively identify current and anticipated workforce capability gaps and develop strategies to close them

Coach and support leaders in executing workforce plans and making resource-allocation decisions

Anticipate industry trends and talent needs, determining gaps in current and future capabilities

Team Member Relations & Compliance

Provide sound policy interpretations and practice decisions; ensure adherence to company policies and applicable federal, state, and local regulations (including FMLA, ADA, HIPAA, and Leaves of Absence)

Serve as a neutral, approachable TMS professional who recognizes and proactively resolves potential people and organizational issues — escalating as appropriate

This role requires balancing strategic thinking with hands-on execution. You must be comfortable dealing with ambiguity while building structured approaches to drive successful and equitable outcomes.
The HRBP serves as a trusted advisor and member of the business leadership team — expected to bring perspectives on the intersections of people strategy and business performance. You will engage as a subject matter expert on TMS-related topics and model a commitment to customer service, Team Member well-being, and the values that set our organization apart.

title: Applied Scientist, Catalog System Services Science
descriptionHtml:
At Amazon Selection and Catalog Systems (ASCS), our mission is to power the online buying experience for customers worldwide so they can find, discover, and buy any product they want. We innovate on behalf of our customers to ensure uniqueness and consistency of product identity and to infer relationships between products in Amazon Catalog to drive the selection gateway for the search and browse experiences on the website. We're solving a fundamental AI challenge: establishing product relevant information at unprecedented scale with Frontier Models and Agents. The scale is staggering: billions of products, petabytes of multimodal data, millions of sellers, dozens of languages, and infinite product diversity ranging from electronics to groceries to digital content.

The research challenges are immense. GenAI and VLMs hold transformative promise for catalog understanding, but we operate where traditional methods fail: ambiguous problem spaces, incomplete and noisy data, inherent uncertainty, reasoning across both images and textual data, and explaining decisions at scale. Enriching product information requires sophisticated models that reason across text, images, and structured data, all while maintaining accuracy and trust for high-stakes business decisions affecting millions of customers daily.

Amazon's Catalog System Services Science team is looking for an innovative and customer-focused applied scientist to help us make the world's best product catalog even better. In this role, you will partner with technology and business leaders to build new state-of-the-art algorithms, models, and services. You will pioneer advanced GenAI solutions that power next-generation agentic shopping experiences, working in a collaborative environment where you can experiment with massive data from the world's largest product catalog, tackle problems at the frontier of AI research, rapidly implement and deploy your algorithmic ideas at scale, across millions of customers.

Key job responsibilities
- Formulate novel research problems at the intersection of GenAI, multimodal learning, and large-scale information retrieval. In essence, translating ambiguous business challenges into tractable scientific frameworks
- Design and implement leading models leveraging frontier models, and agentic architectures to enrich catalog information at billion-product scale
- Pioneer explainable AI methodologies that balance model performance with scalability requirements for production systems impacting millions of daily customer decisions
- Own end-to-end ML pipelines from research ideation to production deployment, processing petabytes of multimodal data with rigorous evaluation frameworks
- Represent the team in the broader science community - publishing findings, delivering tech talks, and staying at the forefront of GenAI, VLM, and agentic system research

Basic qualifications

- PhD, or Master's degree and 4+ years of CS, CE, ML or related field experience
- Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language
- 2+ years of building machine learning models or developing algorithms for business application experience
- Prior experience in the domains of LLMs, or large-scale deep learning systems

Preferred qualifications

- Publications in top-tier venues such as NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, CVPR, ICCV, EMNLP, ACL, NAACL, COLING, KDD, SIGMOD, WWW, AAAI, or similar
- Experience with multimodal LLMs, including hands-on post training techniques

title: Supplier emissions and Scope 3 measurement lead, AWS Global Sustainability
descriptionHtml:
Are you passionate about using data to drive climate action at scale? AWS is looking for a Scope 3 Inventory Manager Lead to own the end-to-end management of supplier-level greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions data that feeds into AWS's upstream Scope 3 carbon inventory. In this role, you will be the single-threaded owner of supplier carbon data quality, accuracy, and process improvement — directly supporting Amazon's commitment to The Climate Pledge and reaching net-zero carbon by 2040.

You will work at the intersection of decarbonization strategy, emissions measurement, and strategic inventory quality — partnering with suppliers, internal engineering teams, and cross-functional stakeholders to continuously improve how AWS collects, validates, and operationalizes Scope 3 emissions data. Your decisions on data quality and inventory methodology will directly shape AWS's ability to set credible decarbonization targets, prioritize abatement actions, and maintain confidence in reported emissions reductions. This is a high-visibility role where your work will directly influence AWS's carbon footprint reporting and decarbonization strategy.

Key job responsibilities
Own Scope 3 supplier data inventory management: Manage the collection, ingestion, and reconciliation of supplier-reported GHG emissions data (Scope 1, 2, and upstream Scope 3) allocated to AWS products, ensuring alignment with the GHG Protocol Scope 3 Standard and AWS's Supply Chain GHG Data Collection Guidance.



Model forward-looking emissions trajectories: Develop and maintain supplier-level emissions forecasting models that integrate historical allocated emissions data, committed decarbonization pathways, and projected abatement actions to estimate future Scope 3 inventory trends. Use these models to support target-setting, scenario analysis, and progress-to-goal tracking against AWS's supplier decarbonization milestones (e.g., 2030 intensity reduction targets).



Drive data accuracy and quality improvement: Design and implement data validation frameworks, quality scoring mechanisms, and anomaly detection processes to identify and resolve discrepancies in supplier-reported emissions data. Establish and track data quality metrics over time.



Improve technology and automation processes: Partner with engineering and business intelligence teams to identify opportunities for automating manual data workflows, improving data pipelines, and scaling Scope 3 measurement capabilities. Define requirements for tooling improvements and track delivery.



Manage supplier data validation cycles: Lead the annual supplier data validation process, including reviewing attribution methodologies (e.g., top-down physical/economic allocation, bottom-up LCA models), identifying gaps, and working directly with suppliers to improve data submissions.



Serve as Scope 3 measurement subject matter expert (SME): Act as the team's go-to expert on Scope 3 carbon accounting methodologies, calculation approaches (supplier-specific, hybrid, average-data, spend-based), and emissions factor selection. Stay current on evolving GHG Protocol standards and industry best practices.



Support cross-functional collaboration and reporting: Partner with Procurement, Finance, ISP, and the broader Sustainability organization to ensure Scope 3 data supports corporate reporting, regulatory compliance, and internal decision-making. Contribute to narratives and business reviews as needed.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Environmental Science, Engineering, Sustainability, Data Science, or a related quantitative field
- 5+ years of experience in carbon accounting, GHG emissions measurement, or environmental data management
- 3+ years of experience working with Scope 3 emissions data, including supplier-reported GHG data collection and validation
- Experience applying the GHG Protocol Corporate Standard and Scope 3 Standard in a corporate or consulting setting

Preferred qualifications

- Experience working with engineering and technical teams to build automated solutions
- Experience with data visualization using Tableau, Quicksight, or similar tools
- Experience in written and verbal communication with the ability to present complex technical information in a clear and concise manner to executives and non-technical leaders
- Master's degree in Environmental Science, Sustainability, Industrial Ecology, or related field
- Experience managing large-scale supplier data collection programs across global supply chains
- Familiarity with life cycle assessment (LCA) methodologies and emissions factor databases (e.g., DEFRA, EPA, ecoinvent)
- Knowledge of emerging sustainability reporting frameworks and regulations (e.g., CSRD, SEC Climate Disclosure, ISSB)

descriptionHtml:

For someone to be successful in this role, they need to embody the following:

Growth Marketing Executor: They must be a marketing professional with experience in partner-focused growth marketing. Relationship Builder: They excel at fostering and maintaining strong relationships across all levels — from partner contacts to internal stakeholders — demonstrating strong communication skills and the ability to earn trust and influence.

Data-Driven Decision Maker: They have a natural curiosity for analytics and metrics, with the ability to translate data into actionable insights. They dive deep into performance data to identify trends and optimize campaign performance across the customer lifecycle.

Results Oriented & Operationally Excellent: They take ownership and drive initiatives from concept to completion, mitigating immediate risks and making trade-offs between time, quality, and resources. descriptionHtml:

title: Certified Pharmacy Technician, Fulfillment - Amazon Pharmacy
descriptionHtml:
Innovation is at the core of what we do. We believe that by removing and reducing the barriers that prevent people from taking their medications, we can help customers conveniently get the medications they need when they need them and take them as prescribed. We have provided customers with the ability to find transparent and simple pricing, receive 24/7 customer service support and have their meds delivered to their doorsteps while creating programs and products that embody our mission and position ourselves in becoming the world’s safest and fastest online pharmacy.
We are looking for a Certified Pharmacy Technician to join us on our journey to make it drastically easier for customers to find, choose, afford, and engage with the services, products, and professionals they need to get and stay healthy!
This position offers a unique blend of on-the-road independence and in-pharmacy teamwork! In this role, you will be responsible for both kiosk management and working within our pharmacy operations, including driving from the Pharmacy to our Kiosk locations, refilling inventory and maintaining Pharmacy Kiosk Machines in regionalized areas. You will also be working in the physical Pharmacy location preparing orders for customer shipments.
#everydaybetter

Key job responsibilities
• Drive from physical Pharmacy locations to our remote Pharmacy Kiosk locations with company
provided vehicle
• Refill Pharmacy Kiosks with medication and paper, clean machine, and collect discarded inventory
for return
• Prepare inventory shipments for Kiosk replenishment
• Assist pharmacist in filling prescription items, as permitted by the state board of pharmacy
• Maintain a safe and clean pharmacy by complying with procedures, rules and regulations
• Work daily with leadership to ensure the right medications are put in the right orders
• Run automated machinery required to pre-sort and package medications
• Fill exception trays with appropriate medication
• Transition Amazon Pharmacy orders through different workflow stages from initial dispense through quality control
• Count and fill prescription vials and affix labels on bulk prescription items
• Pack and ship completed orders, including printing and affixing appropriate labels on dispenser and shipping boxes
• Sort and triage the right boxes to ship at the right time
• Aid the Pharmacy Manager and Staff Pharmacists with receiving, shipping, counting, and packing
• Clean and help maintain equipment and work areas within the pharmacy
• Package medications for dispensing and for delivery
• Work a flexible schedule - shifts will possibly start and end outside of normal site business hours
Physical Requirements:
During Peak/high demand, shifts last up to 12 hours (standard full-time shifts are 8-10 hours, excluding overtime):
• Driving and transporting medications from Pharmacy locations to Kiosks for long periods of time (8+hrs)
• Standing, bending, reaching above the head, kneeling, crouching and/or stretching
• Lifting and moving products up to 49 lbs in weight
• Manual dexterity of hands and wrists

Basic qualifications

- High school diploma or equivalent
- 6+ months of working with computer and web based tools experience
- Must be at least 21 years old
- Active and unrestricted Pharmacy Technician license in state of employment
- National Pharmacy Technician Certification (PTCB or NHA)
- Ability to communicate effectively with coworkers and supervisor
- Ability to read and understand English language labeling on product cartons and prescription labels
- Active and unrestricted in-state driver’s license
- Clean driving record that passes Amazon’s Motor Vehicle Record (MVR) Checks (to be rechecked annually). Driving privileges will be revoked if your DMV reports indicates you have received a ticket for one or more of the following violations:
- Evading responsibility
- Being at fault in a fatal accident
- Having two or more motor vehicle accidents in the last three years
- Having a motor vehicle accident resulting in greater than $5,000 in damages
- Driving under the influence or in any way impaired by alcohol or drugs
- Reckless Driving
- Recurrent speeding violations
- Recurrent driving suspensions
- Three or more driving violations within the last three years

Preferred qualifications

- Demonstrated ability to work as an effective team member
- Demonstrated organization skills and attention to detail
- Ability to recognize and identify patient medications
- Experience working under pressure in a fast-paced work environment while consistently meeting standards for productivity and quality

title: Senior Data Center Electrical Engineer , Mechanical Products and Services
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Are you passionate about designing and optimizing the critical systems that power some of the world's largest and most reliable infrastructure? As a Senior Data Center Infrastructure Electrical Engineer, you will serve as a technical leader responsible for the design, architecture, and continuous improvement of data center infrastructure systems. Your work will directly influence the availability and efficiency of the physical backbone that supports millions of customers worldwide.

In this role, you will tackle complex, ambiguous problems across global projects, driving solutions that are inventive, scalable, and maintainable. You will collaborate with cross-functional engineering teams, influence facility strategy, and set standards for engineering excellence. Whether you are leading the design of new infrastructure systems or resolving root causes of endemic issues, your contributions will have a meaningful, long-term impact on how Amazon builds and operates its data centers.

Key job responsibilities
• Support the Data Center Design Engineering, Principal Engineering, and Hardware Engineering teams to design and develop innovative concepts into new mechanical cooling products (AHUs, chiller, pump skids, ADACs) used in AWS data centers.
• Lead the electrical aspect of new product design and development for mechanical cooling equipment, including motor controls, VFDs, power distribution panels, control wiring, and instrumentation integration.
• Collaborate with other disciplines such as mechanical engineering, structural engineering, controls/automation, reliability, QA/QC, and compliance to create well-thought-out products.
• Design and specify electrical systems for rotating equipment including fans, pumps, and compressors, ensuring proper motor sizing, protection, and control schemes.
• Create designs which meet or exceed our quality requirements while delivering a return on investment.
• Work with global suppliers and manufacturers to specify appropriate electrical components, devices, and bill of materials for AHUs, skids, and ADACs.
• Ensure compliance with federal, state, and municipal requirements and building codes across different countries, including UL, CE, IEC, NEC/NFPA 70, and other applicable standards for mechanical cooling equipment.
• Prepare, review, and approve product design and drawings including electrical schematics, single-line diagrams, wiring diagrams, panel layouts, cable schedules, and bill of materials.
• Define project scope and provide technical support for information requests prior to, and during manufacturing phases.
• Work with field engineering and commissioning teams to properly set up test processes and validate installation, operation, and performance of electrical systems within mechanical cooling products.
• Develop and review control logic, interlocks, and safety circuits for AHU, skid, chillers and ADAC assemblies in coordination with controls engineers.
• Ability to work on concurrent projects in multiple geographical regions.
• Support of Operations including failure mode and root cause analysis, maintenance and troubleshooting support, and operating procedure review for electrical systems in cooling equipment.
• Be a leader within the group as well as within internal and external teams that support the data center.
• Ability and willingness to travel domestic and internationally for up to 25% of the year.

A day in the life
You might start your morning reviewing design documents for a new infrastructure deployment, providing feedback that strengthens the overall architecture. By midday, you could be leading a cross-team project review, aligning engineers across regions on a shared technical approach. In the afternoon, you may dive into root-cause analysis of a recurring facility issue, proposing a mechanism to prevent future occurrences. Throughout it all, you will coach teammates, share expertise, and help shape the direction of critical infrastructure at Amazon.

About the team
Our team is focused on ensuring that Amazon's data center infrastructure is reliable, efficient, and ready to meet the demands of tomorrow. We work at the intersection of electrical engineering, mechanical systems, and operational technology to design and maintain the physical environments that support Amazon's global services.

We value collaboration, creative problem-solving, and a commitment to continuous improvement. If you are excited about working on large-scale infrastructure challenges alongside a talented group of engineers, we would love to hear from you.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a related field
- 6+ years of data center design, construction, operations, or facility maintenance experience
- Experience in industrial or commercial engineering in mission critical facilities including but not limited to: data centers, power generation or oil and gas facilities
- Experience researching new designs, technologies, and construction methods of data center equipment and facilities
- Knowledge of building codes and regulations for your region

Preferred qualifications

- Professional Engineering or Architectural License
- Experience carrying design concepts through exploration, development, and into deployment or mass production
- Experience reading, interpreting, and creating construction drawings, specifications, and submittal documents
- Knowledge of critical data center mechanical and electrical equipment

title: Senior CDR Network Planning Performance Manager, AWS Infra Supply Chain
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on.
