title: Sr Product Manager - Growth, Amazon Now
descriptionHtml:
Amazon is building the fastest shopping experience in Brazil: Amazon Now, our Quick Commerce business that delivers in as little as 15 minutes from dark stores. This is one of the highest-growth in the Brazil Stores portfolio, and it is run by a team that owns the full commercial and product surface end to end.

We are looking for a Product Manager to own a core piece of the Amazon Now business — sitting at the intersection of selection, pricing, promotions, customer experience, and operations. You will be responsible for the metrics that define whether we win. You will run the weekly and daily business reviews, translate performance signals into concrete actions, unblock cross-functional dependencies across BI, tech, legal, finance, and external partners, and make the day-to-day judgment calls that move the P&L. If you are energized by owning outcomes in a fast-moving business where the playbook is still being written, this role is for you.

Key job responsibilities
- Own the business rhythm. Author and run the recurring business reviews. Publish the input reviews and newsletters that keep the broader organization aligned week over week.
- Drive selection and category growth: Coordinate vendor onboarding, and resolve selection and catalog issues.
- Own pricing and promotions execution. Manage the pricing pipeline, and promotional mechanics
- Improve the customer experience: Partner with tech and design on CX — ensuring the fastest possible path from open-app to order-placed.
- Unblock cross-functionally: Work daily across BI, tech/product, legal, finance, and external partners to remove blockers.
- Contribute to planning and strategy: Lead the business narratives, demand sessions, and financial inputs.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
- Experience with end to end product delivery
- Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
- Experience as a product manager or owner
- Experience owning technology products
- Experience in product or program management, product marketing, business development or technology

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in influencing senior leadership through data driven insights
- Experience working across functional teams and senior stakeholders

title: Program Manager Intern FRANCE 2027
descriptionHtml:
Un univers d'opportunités chez Amazon.
Chez Amazon, votre carrière ne suit pas une ligne droite. Elle accélère, prend des tournants et vous met au défi d'une manière que vous n'auriez jamais imaginée. Dès votre arrivée, vous faites partie de quelque chose de grand : créer des produits ou des services qui touchent des millions de personnes et façonnent la manière dont elles vivent, travaillent et interagissent au quotidien. C'est ici que vos idées se transforment en un véritable impact.
Vous travaillerez avec des outils de premier plan, des plateformes mondiales et des systèmes conçus pour fonctionner à une échelle extraordinaire. Vous avancerez vite, expérimenterez et lancerez des solutions qui comptent vraiment. Grâce à des opportunités infinies à explorer au sein de différentes équipes et fonctions, vous apprendrez rapidement, mettrez en pratique vos connaissances et découvrirez des compétences dont vous ignoriez l'existence. C'est un environnement pensé pour les bâtisseurs qui veulent voir l'impact concret de leur travail dans le monde.

Prêt(e) à commencer votre aventure ?
Qu'est-ce que cela vous apporte ?
Un stage chez Amazon, c'est de vraies responsabilités dès le premier jour. Vous construirez, testerez et apprendrez aux côtés de personnes qui veulent vous voir réussir, tout en ayant un impact qui va bien au-delà du campus.


Key job responsibilities
Vous collaborerez avec différentes parties prenantes internes pour apprendre à améliorer l'offre d'un programme ainsi que ses avantages pour nos clients. Ce stage offre l'opportunité de travailler avec des équipes transversales et de développer des compétences en gestion de projet dans un environnement commercial compétitif et dynamique.
Vous travaillerez sur un ou plusieurs projets au sein de votre équipe d'accueil afin de suivre les actions en cours, mener des analyses approfondies, fournir des recommandations basées sur les données, analyser les processus pour identifier les points critiques et anticiper les risques.
Vous accompagnerez l'équipe dans la recommandation et la mise en œuvre d'améliorations au sein du réseau.
Vous contribuerez en proposant des solutions innovantes, durables et bénéfiques pour l'ensemble de l'équipe.

A day in the life
Chaque jour est différent en tant que stagiaire Program Manager. Vous travaillerez aux côtés de votre mentor dédié et de votre équipe sur de véritables projets d'amélioration et d'innovation qui soutiennent la croissance du réseau européen d'Amazon. Vous pourriez passer votre matinée à analyser un large jeu de données pour identifier des goulots d'étranglement opérationnels, puis consacrer votre après-midi à échanger avec des parties prenantes de différents pays sur un plan de déploiement. Vous collaborerez avec des équipes transversales, suivrez les jalons des projets et partagerez des mises à jour avec la direction.
Amazon est une entreprise guidée par les données : quel que soit le projet sur lequel vous travaillez, une partie de votre rôle consistera à en extraire des enseignements pour orienter les décisions. Vous développerez des solutions à de véritables défis opérationnels, testerez différentes approches et présenterez vos conclusions à la direction, renforçant ainsi vos compétences analytiques, en communication et en gestion de projet dans un environnement international au rythme soutenu.
Remarque : Vous devez disposer du droit de travailler dans le pays d'emploi à la date de début du contrat.

About the team
Communauté des stagiaires : En tant que stagiaire Amazon, vous ferez partie d'une communauté dynamique et solidaire qui favorise votre croissance et votre développement. Vous collaborerez avec des stagiaires du monde entier, en tissant des liens et en participant à des événements sociaux pour élargir vos perspectives. Vous pourrez également rejoindre des groupes spécialisés axés sur des domaines tels que le développement durable, afin d'explorer vos centres d'intérêt variés.

Accompagnement : Le programme de stage offre un système d'accompagnement solide, comprenant des permanences hebdomadaires dédiées aux stagiaires, un support informatique et RH dédié, ainsi qu'une équipe programme engagée pour votre réussite. Cela garantit que vous disposez de l'orientation et de l'assistance nécessaires pour vous épanouir.

Sessions de formation : Des sessions de formation exclusives renforceront davantage vos compétences, en vous donnant accès aux plateformes d'apprentissage de référence d'Amazon et à l'expertise de leaders du secteur. Ces opportunités de développement structurées vous prépareront à la prochaine étape de votre carrière.

Opportunités : À l'issue d'un stage réussi, vous pourrez être considéré(e) pour un poste en CDI jeune diplômé ou pour un second stage, vous permettant de poursuivre votre parcours chez Amazon. De plus, vous bénéficierez d'un salaire mensuel compétitif, d'une aide à la relocalisation et d'un accès à une gamme d'avantages sociaux.

Dates de début de stage tout au long de l'année : Nous recrutons des stagiaires pour des prises de poste à tout moment entre janvier et septembre 2027. Chaque mois, nous organiserons une à deux journées d'intégration pour les nouveaux arrivants.

Basic qualifications

- Parler, écrire et lire couramment le français et l'anglais, niveau C1 ou supérieur
- Être actuellement en avant-dernière ou dernière année d'études et préparer un diplôme universitaire avec une date de diplôme prévue après la fin du stage
- Être disponible pour commencer un stage entre janvier et septembre 2027. Oui, nos dates de début sont flexibles ! Vous devez ensuite être disponible pour une durée de 3 à 6 mois, à temps plein (35h/semaine). La durée du stage est soumise à la disponibilité
- Maîtrise avancée de Microsoft Excel (par ex. macros, tableaux croisés dynamiques, fonctions de recherche, VBA)
- Vous devez disposer du droit de travailler dans le pays d'emploi
- Vous serez basé(e) à Clichy pendant toute la durée du stage. Une aide à la relocalisation pourra être proposée, sous réserve de critères d'éligibilité
- Études pertinentes en ingénierie, gestion de projet, gestion d'entreprise ou discipline similaire

Preferred qualifications

- Solides compétences en résolution de problèmes et en analyse, avec la capacité d'identifier des améliorations de processus et des solutions innovantes
- Excellentes compétences en communication et en travail d'équipe, avec la capacité de collaborer efficacement avec les autres
- Curiosité, proactivité et volonté démontrées de relever des défis dans un environnement ambigu et au rythme soutenu

Amazon est un employeur engagé pour l'égalité des chances. Nous sommes convaincus qu'une main d'oeuvre diversifée est essentielle à notre réussite. Nous prenons nos décisions de recrutement en fonction de votre expérience et de vos compétences. Nous apprécions votre envie de découvrir, d'inventer, de simplifier et de construire. La protection de votre vie privée et la sécurité de vos données constituent depuis longtemps une priorité absolue pour Amazon. Veuillez consulter notre Politique de Confidentialité pour en savoir plus sur la façon dont nous collectons, utilisons et traitons les données personnelles de nos candidats.

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. title: Supply Chain Operations, Process Operational Excellence Team (POET)
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we're the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensures our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we're looking for talented people who want to help.

You'll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You'll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you'll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

The ISCaP team is looking for an exceptional Supply Chain Operations Specialist to help us build on this mission as the volume of products, services, and locations continues to grow. The ideal candidate is one who thrives in ambiguity, is very customer obsessed, focused on operational excellence and is willing to take high degree of ownership for their program vision and execution of ideas. The ability to effectively communicate at all levels of the organization, make data driven decisions, and apply good judgement to manage escalations, competing priorities, and deliverables is essential to this role. Successful candidates will be able to balance think big with realities of delivering on customer promises today. They will also have excellent analytical and creative thinking skills, and the ability to break down complex problems with no clear answers (and at times, conflicting data) into simple, innovative solutions and/or clear, measurable implementation plans.

Do you enjoy solving very complex problems while seeking to invent and simplify? Are you excited by large complex supply chain? Do you enjoy leveraging your creativity to solve real world analytical and capacity delivery problems? Come work with smart people and make major contributions towards enhancing our infrastructure for millions of customers world-wide.

Why you will enjoy it:
In this highly visible and critical role, you will be the voice of the customer in developing operational excellence plans and work extensively with AWS teams including operations, engineering, product management, and finance to help grow the business. You will use your operational and analytical skills to set a vision for the future, translate this vision into reality, and innovate on behalf of our customers. You will have ownership, not just responsibility. In addition, you will be part of a growing, fast paced, and fun team.

Role Responsibilities:

- Serve as a key member of the Supply Chain Operational Excellence (POET) team in helping to manage and deliver Infrastructure capacity to select regions around the world..
- Understand the technical requirements of our partners and work closely with the internal development teams to guide the direction of supply chain activities.
- Develop new analytical models for supply chain solutions.
- Execute strategic business objectives while working with key internal stakeholders to improve the supply chain with the latest internal and external information.
- Prepare and give detailed data-driven business reviews to senior management, focused on improving forecasting accuracy and associated impacts.
- You will be a positive influencer across diverse teams, be able to effectively rally support for your initiatives, and be able to help deeply technical teams create simple solutions to meet your program goals.
- Keys to success in this role include exceptional analytics, judgment, and communication skills.


About the team
Why AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Diverse Experiences
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship and Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or above in Supply Chain Management, Engineering, Math, Business or other related quantitative disciplines
- 2+ years of procurement, supply chain, inventory management, contract management, lease administration or operations experience
- 2+ years of process improvement, operational analysis, and financial analysis experience
- Experience leveraging data through at least one tool such as excel, SQL, Tableau, QuickSight, or Python to influence cross-functional prioritization, identify improvement opportunities, and drive solutions
- Experience managing cross-functional teams in a fast-paced consumer electronics product company

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Computer Science, or a related field
- Experience in data centers, infrastructure service providers, or related technology companies
- Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt certification
- Experience with value stream mapping or process flow analysis to identify systemic improvement opportunities

Ofrece variedad de funciones, oportunidades de desarrollo profesional dentro de la red de Amazon, y un paquete de compensación y beneficios atractivo.

Key job responsibilities
Como miembro de pleno derecho del equipo de Higiene, Seguridad y Medio Ambiente (HSE), sus responsabilidades abarcan un amplio perímetro:

1 - Seguimiento Médico y Acompañamiento de los Colaboradores:
- Organizar y realizar las entrevistas de enfermería y los reconocimientos médicos reglamentarios, y asegurar su seguimiento a través de nuestros programas informáticos dedicados
- Llevar a cabo acciones de asesoramiento en salud y campañas de sensibilización específicas (TME, gestos y posturas, hábitos de vida saludables).
- Apoyar al departamento de RRHH y a los responsables en la adaptación de los puestos de trabajo para favorecer el mantenimiento en el empleo, en estrecha colaboración con un equipo multidisciplinar (psicólogo/a, trabajador/a social, osteópata, ergónomo/a)
2 - Gestión de Situaciones de Emergencia y Formación en Primeros Auxilios:
- Formar y supervisar a los Socorristas Laborales, y realizar los cuidados de urgencia según los protocolos médicos.
- Analizar las intervenciones para identificar ejes de mejora y participar en las investigaciones de accidentes laborales y enfermedades profesionales.

3 - Prevención de Riesgos Laborales:
- Apoyar el análisis ergonómico y garantizar la prevención de riesgos sobre el terreno.
- Gestionar el seguimiento estadístico de los accidentes laborales.
- Realizar observaciones periódicas para identificar situaciones de riesgo, asegurar su trazabilidad a través de nuestras herramientas internas y contribuir a la implantación de acciones correctivas
4 - Contribución Activa al Enfoque de Seguridad:
- Más allá de sus funciones sanitarias, participar activamente en el enfoque de seguridad del centro: realización de auditorías, apoyo a programas específicos y contribución a los análisis de riesgos. Realiza rutinas de seguridad, analiza datos y despliega de forma autónoma planes de acción

5 - Coordinación y Gestión de la Enfermería:
- Asegurar el enlace entre el servicio de salud interempresarial y los equipos operativos.
- Gestionar la enfermería (farmacia, material) y mantener los registros reglamentarios en soporte digital (cuidados de enfermería, accidentes leves, registros de incidentes).
- Coordinar el aprovisionamiento de primeros auxilios y las fichas de exposición a riesgos, e intercambiar buenas prácticas con la red de enfermeros/as.



A day in the life
Ocupas un papel clave dentro del equipo de Higiene, Seguridad y Medio Ambiente (HSE). Tu día a día será dinámico e impactante, centrado en la creación de un entorno de trabajo saludable y seguro. Alternarás entre la realización de entrevistas de salud, la prestación de asistencia médica, y el análisis, la anticipación y el tratamiento proactivo de los retos de salud laboral. Una parte de tu tiempo también estará dedicada a tareas administrativas a través de nuestras herramientas informáticas: gestión de visitas médicas, análisis de datos en hojas de cálculo y uso de las herramientas internas de Amazon.

About the team
El equipo de Workplace Health and Safety (WHS) desempeña un papel fundamental para garantizar el bienestar mental y físico de nuestro personal en el trabajo. Nuestro equipo trabaja con responsables, asociados y administraciones locales en todos nuestros centros, asegurando el cumplimiento de las políticas de Amazon y las normativas legales, y garantizando la seguridad de nuestros entornos de trabajo. title: Product Manager - Tech, Amazon Optics
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Optics operates the physical security infrastructure that protects the most sensitive computing environments on Earth: AWS data centers, Amazon corporate offices, and Leo ground stations. We manage more than 600K access control devices and 300K cameras. We integrate video management, access control, and intrusion alarming into one platform, and we strengthen it with AI analytics. Our job is to make every physical space Amazon operates continuously understood, proactively protected, and programmatically extensible.

We are looking for a Principal Product Manager - Technical (PM-T) to own the holistic product strategy for Optics, own its profit and loss (P&L), and drive the platform toward the future state.

You will own the product narrative for the entire Optics platform, comprised of divisions for access control technology, incident response, video surveillance and analytic capabilities. You will
define the product strategy that replaces a fragmented customer ecosystem with an automated, extensible platform, and you will sequence the investments that get us there.

You will make sure Optics serves its internal customers first while shaping the platform foundations that keep our longer-term options open. You will partner directly with the Optics organization leader, with directors and VPs across our customer organizations, and with security and infrastructure leaders throughout Amazon. You will operate where product strategy, physical security, and platform architecture meet.

The ideal candidate is a systems thinker who is comfortable with deep technical ambiguity, fluent in translating customer problems into product requirements, financially literate enough to own a P&L and defend a cost model, and credible with both principal engineers and VP-level stakeholders.

Key job responsibilities
- Own the product strategy and roadmap for the Optics platform
- Own the Optics P&L and the financial narrative
- Shape the market offering
- Represent the voice of the internal customer
- Own the platform strategy that lets customers move at their own pace
- Own the resource allocation model between platform and features
- Establish the responsibility contract with customers
- Write the narratives that align the organization
- Define and own the metrics that measure product and business success
- Raise the product bar for the organization

A day in the life
Your days blend deep strategic work, customer discovery, financial modeling, and cross-organizational partnership. No two look the same, but a representative day includes:

Morning - You block your first hours for the work that needs uninterrupted focus: drafting the product strategy narrative for an upcoming leadership review.

Mid-morning - You meet with your finance partner to pressure-test the P&L and refine the cost-per-site model, reconciling the savings that our first-party hardware and quantifying the opportunity cost of deferring the platform investment another quarter.

Afternoon - You meet with a director from a customer organization and a peer leader from an adjacent Amazon infrastructure team.

Late afternoon - You review the platform's product and business health metrics. Cost per site is trending the right way. You draft the mechanism to track it so the signal reaches the right people to make business decisions, and close the loop with engineering to ensure the target goal is achieved.

About the team
Amazon Optics develops the software that gives security operators actionable situational awareness in the physical domain. Our vision is simple and ambitious: Anticipate threats. Redefine physical security. Build a safer world. We build simple, scalable systems that automate safety and security, giving security operators the tools to measure and monitor their environment.

We are the singular enterprise security product that integrates the three core sectors of physical security into one platform: video management, access control, and intrusion alarming and perimeter protection. We strengthen all three with AI analytics. We eliminate hard dependencies on third-party and disparate systems, so our customers get a cohesive, flexible solution and never need intricate knowledge of the systems underneath to get value from what we build.

We protect the environments that matter most: customer data, cryptographic material, and the people who work alongside them. We do it at a scale no one else operates, and we build the cloud infrastructure it runs on. That combination is our right to win. We solve our own hardest problems first, at a scale that makes the solution durable and the economics compound.

Culturally, we are a team that leads with people. We invest in growth, we celebrate wins by name, and we make sure everyone has a voice. We value builders who bring warmth alongside backbone, who can disagree and commit, and who care as much about developing the people around them as about shipping the product. We move fast, we hold a high bar, and we protect a sustainable pace while we do it. If you want to own the product strategy and the economics for a platform that protects Amazon's most critical spaces, and you want to do it on a team that will invest in you, this is the place.

Diverse Experiences
Amazon Security values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why Amazon Security?
At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon’s products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores.

Inclusive Team Culture
In Amazon Security, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Ongoing DEI events and learning experiences inspire us to continue learning and to embrace our uniqueness. Addressing the toughest security challenges requires that we seek out and celebrate a diversity of ideas, perspectives, and voices.

Training & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, training, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree
- Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
- Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
- Experience technical product management
- 10+ years of product or program management, product marketing, business development or technology experience
- Experience contributing to engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
- Experience working with and influencing senior level stakeholders
- 3+ years of P&L management and pricing experience

Preferred qualifications

As a Software Development Engineer in S3, you get to deliver these capabilities and delight our customers through teams of talented engineers and leaders.

descriptionHtml:

title: Software Development Engineer II, Unified Auth SDK
descriptionHtml:
UnifiedAuth is the authentication and authorization backbone for Amazon's service ecosystem. We secure service-to-service communication, ensuring that every call between Amazon services is authenticated and authorized against the right identity and policy. As Amazon's systems evolve toward autonomous agents, we provide agentic authentication and authorization — establishing verifiable identity and scoped, policy-governed access for AI agents acting on behalf of users and services. We also own transaction token management, issuing, propagating, and validating the tokens that carry identity and authorization context across multi-hop request chains. Together, these capabilities let Amazon's services trust who is calling them, what those callers are permitted to do, and on whose behalf they act — protecting customer data and maintaining the integrity of every transaction across the fleet.

We are looking for a Software Development Engineer II to design, build, and operate components of our authentication SDKs and supporting services. You will own features end-to-end: design through production operations across Java, Python, NodeJS, and Rust client libraries. You will collaborate with security teams, service owners, and business teams to close authentication gaps at scale.

This role suits an engineer who wants to own ambiguous, high-impact problems in a domain where correctness and availability are non-negotiable.

Key job responsibilities
- Design and deliver features across Security SDKs, owning them from design document through production launch.

- Improve the static stability of authentication — ensure services continue operating through service outages via persistent caching, eager token refresh, and bounce-safe recovery.

- Build and maintain telemetry and compliance mechanisms that measure token propagation and detect gaps across the fleet.

- Diagnose and resolve production issues as part of the on-call rotation, and drive root-cause analysis and corrections for operational events.

- Own pipeline and release health for SDK components — keep pipelines fresh, unblock releases, and reduce time-to-deploy.

- Write clear design documents and participate in Operational Readiness Reviews (ORRs) and security reviews.

- Mentor SDE1s and interns; raise the technical bar through code reviews and design feedback.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- 3+ years of Video Games Industry (supporting title Development, Release, or Live Ops) experience
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience

title: Software Development Manager, AWS Network Fabric Engineering, MONA - Management Networks
descriptionHtml:
MONA builds and operates the management plane, out-of-band (OOB) network, and automation systems that keep AWS's global network infrastructure running. Today that means the tooling and platforms network engineers and automated systems use to deploy, monitor, and remediate the physical and logical network ,spanning device management, out-of-band connectivity, Initial Access and network automation at scale.

But the bigger opportunity ahead of us is bigger than keeping the lights on: we are building the next generation of management networks for AWS, purpose-built to support Resilient Network Graphs (RNG), Machine Learning, and Intent-Driven Controls. That means designing and developing controllers across every layer of the business, from device-level control planes to fleet-wide orchestration systems and using software, not manual process, to solve problems that have historically been solved by people, runbooks, and tickets. This is a green-field, product-building mandate as much as an operations one: we want engineers who see a recurring network problem and build a product to solve it, not just a fix.

We're hiring a Software Development Manager to lead a team based in San Jose, combining software engineers and network development engineers. This is a hybrid technical/network organization: you'll manage people who write production automation and controller software alongside engineers who own network-facing systems and integrations, and you're expected to be credible with both disciplines. You'll set the technical bar for how we design controllers, and the product bar for how we turn internal network pain points into reusable solutions for the rest of AWS.

Key job responsibilities
Own delivery and technical direction for a team of SDEs and NDEs designing and building the next generation of management network controllers, spanning device, fabric, and fleet-level control planes
- Set technical strategy for evolving MONA's network platforms to support Resilient Network Graphs (RNG), Machine Learning, and Intent-Driven Controls, moving from manual/runbook-driven operations to software-driven, intent-based control loops
- Drive a product mindset on the team: identify recurring network problems across the business, turn them into reusable controllers and platforms, and own their adoption as internal products with real customers
- Partner with peer SDMs, NDMs and Sr. Managers across MONA's other sub-teams to align controller architecture, roadmaps, and dependencies
- Drive hiring, performance management, and career growth for a team spanning two disciplines (software and network engineering)
- Represent SJC-based engineering in org-wide planning, ensuring the site has a strong technical voice in controller architecture and prioritization decisions
- Balance operational excellence (on-call, incident response, fleet health) with delivery of new controller products and automation roadmaps
- Contribute to MONA's broader network, using data (dwell times, ticket throughput, fleet growth) to decide which network problems get solved with a new controller/product vs. incremental automation

A day in the life
You start with fleet signals, a change shipped caught a degrading link before it became an incident, and you dig into the one case it missed. Mid-morning is a design review on how customers are actually utilizing the network and planning port capacity, and how that translates into clean platform API contracts between device-level hardware and controller software. Afternoons mix cross-team architecture alignment with peer SDMs, 1:1s and promotion coaching, and strategising how to present your team's progress and roadmap to leadership. You close the day deciding which recurring network problem becomes the next product.

About the team
MONA sits inside AWS Network Fabric Engineering (NFE) and owns the management plane, out-of-band networks, and automation that keep AWS's global network running. The org currently spans four sub-teams, expanding to six, each a blend of network and software engineers working side by side rather than in separate disciplines. This role leads the San Jose site, one of four hubs alongside Sydney, Seattle, and Dublin, reporting to the Sr. Manager for MONA. title: Senior Investigation Specialist, Last Mile - Flex VoD
descriptionHtml:
The Rabbit App Bug Triage (RABT) team is part of the Voice of Driver (VoD) organization within Worldwide Flex Driver Partner Insights & Experience (WW DPIX). VoD is responsible for identifying, interpreting, and acting on signals that indicate friction in the Delivery Partner (DP) experience across the Amazon Flex journey.

RABT owns the operational mechanism for identifying, validating, and triaging potential defects in the Rabbit application. The team consolidates feedback from multiple sources, including Driver Support contacts, station escalations, country teams, social media, and app reviews, and converts those signals into structured, evidence-based technical investigations.

The team’s role is not limited to defect intake. RABT determines whether a reported issue is actionable, reconstructs the affected DP journey using available operational and technical signals, assesses recurrence and potential blast radius, removes duplicate noise, and provides engineering teams with sufficiently complete evidence to accelerate root-cause analysis and resolution. The team also identifies systemic gaps in product behavior, operational mechanisms, and diagnostic coverage, and works with partner teams to improve both defect detection and the quality of upstream signals.

RABT is looking for a Senior Investigation Specialist who can independently manage complex investigations, work through incomplete or ambiguous information, and translate large volumes of DP feedback and operational data into clear technical findings.

The ideal candidate will combine strong investigative judgment with analytical capability and operational rigor. The role requires regular use of SQL, dashboards, logs, case history, system signals, and internal diagnostic tools to validate hypotheses and quantify impact. The successful candidate will also work closely with Program Managers, Product Managers, Software Development Managers, Engineers, Operations teams, and other stakeholders across geographies.

In addition to managing individual investigations, the role will contribute to improving RABT’s broader operating mechanisms, including SOPs, quality controls, taxonomy, automation, AI-assisted triage, and defect-intake processes.

Key job responsibilities
1. Independently investigate and triage complex Rabbit app issues using DP feedback, operational data, logs, system signals, and internal diagnostic tools.
2. Determine issue actionability, identify failure patterns, distinguish product defects from operational or expected behavior, and assess potential blast radius.
3. Create clear, evidence-backed technical tickets that enable Product and Engineering teams to investigate and resolve issues efficiently.
4. Analyze trends and recurring defects using SQL, Excel, dashboards, and other analytical tools to identify emerging risks and systemic problems.
Partner with Program, Product, Engineering, Operations, and country teams to drive high-impact issues through investigation, escalation, and closure.
5. Improve RABT operating mechanisms, including SOPs, quality controls, taxonomies, investigation frameworks, and knowledge repositories.
Support automation and AI-driven triage by defining investigation logic, validating outputs, identifying failure modes, and reducing repetitive manual work.

About the team
The Rabbit App Bug Triage (RABT) team is part of Voice of Driver (VoD) within Worldwide Flex Driver Partner Insights & Experience (WW DPIX). RABT Team identifies, validates, and triages potential Rabbit app defects using feedback from Driver Support, stations, country teams, social media, and app reviews. The team partners closely with Product, Engineering, Operations, and Program teams to improve issue actionability, reduce defect-resolution time, and strengthen the DP experience. RABT also develops scalable mechanisms across quality, automation, AI-assisted triage, and defect detection to improve how app issues are identified and resolved globally.

Basic qualifications

- high school diploma or bachelor's degree

Preferred qualifications

- Experience pulling data from databases using Excel, Access, SQL and/or other data management systems
- Experience using SQL

title: TIPM, Electrical Engineering, Electrical Engineering
descriptionHtml:
Are you ready to manage a large-scale electrical preventive maintenance program that keeps 1,300+ facilities running safely and reliably? The Global Energy Sustainability and Automation Electrical Engineering team is looking for a Technical Infrastructure Program Manager to own the full execution lifecycle of planned electrical outages across North America. In this role, you will coordinate multi-tier vendor partnerships, develop site-specific scopes of work for medium and low voltage distribution systems, and drive year-over-year cost optimization. You will work at the intersection of electrical engineering, program management, and operational planning, translating complex technical requirements into actionable schedules and clear stakeholder communications.

Key job responsibilities
- Manage the full execution lifecycle of planned electrical preventive maintenance outages from site selection and scope development through vendor coordination, outage scheduling, and post-outage closeout — across 200+ facilities annually.
- Coordinate across a three-tier vendor model (Project Management Vendor, Owner's Representative, and High Voltage Specialty Vendor) to deliver on-time, on-budget electrical testing and maintenance that meets NETA and Amazon standards.
- Develop and manage site-specific scopes of work for medium- and low-voltage electrical distribution systems, including switchgear, transformers, automatic transfer switches, panelboards, and associated power distribution equipment.
- Oversee utility coordination, permitting, and lockout/tagout planning for planned facility de-energization events, and partner with operations, field reliability and maintenance engineering, and site leadership to align outage windows with operational constraints.
- Manage program budgets, purchase orders, change orders, and vendor invoicing; perform cost analysis and support competitive bidding processes to drive continuous cost optimization.

A day in the life
Your morning might start with a status call alongside your vendor partners to confirm readiness for an upcoming outage at a fulfillment center, reviewing scope documents and safety plans. By midday you are analyzing deficiency reports from a recently completed outage, identifying trends, and coordinating remediation timelines with the responsible vendors. In the afternoon you join a planning session with operations and site leadership to lock in the next quarter's outage calendar, balancing maintenance needs against throughput targets. Throughout, you communicate progress and risks to cross-functional stakeholders, keeping everyone aligned.

About the team
The Global Energy Sustainability and Automation Electrical Engineering team is dedicated to maintaining safe, reliable, and cost-effective electrical infrastructure across Amazon's North American facility network. We partner closely with operations, field reliability and maintenance engineering, central planning, and external vendors to ensure our power distribution systems perform at the highest level. Our focus in the coming years is scaling our preventive maintenance programs, improving deficiency identification and remediation processes, and driving measurable cost avoidance. If you are energized by large-scale technical challenges and want to make a tangible impact on facility safety and uptime, this is the team for you.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field, or experience working in electrical engineering field
- Experience working in a fast-paced and ambiguous environment
- Knowledge of NETA testing standards (ANSI/NETA MTS, ATS, and EAM) and acceptance/maintenance testing protocols for electrical equipment
- Familiarity with power systems studies (arc flash, short circuit, coordination, load flow)

Preferred qualifications

- 5+ years of conducting predictive and preventative maintenance procedures experience
- Experience with outage planning and coordination, including vendor management and de-energization scheduling
- Knowledge of infrared thermography, power quality analysis, or transformer oil analysis techniques

descriptionHtml:
We are seeking a Supply Chain Manager II to help scale Amazon SEND, a cross-border logistics solution for FBA sellers worldwide. In this role, you will work backwards from customer problems and partner closely with carriers to elevate the seller experience on Amazon SEND.

You will sit at the core of supply chain innovation, where your ability to drive alignment across internal and external teams directly shapes both seller and carrier outcomes.

title: Logistics Supervisor
descriptionHtml:
Your responsibilities:
First and foremost, support the overall, daily management of operational duties. This will mean deputizing for the Operations Manager, as and when required: you’ll step in on their behalf where necessary.
You will be expected to prioritize and continually improve the safety at the delivery station. You will be supervising logistics assistants, coordinators and delivery associates to ensure that every shipment is delivered meeting and exceeding the set operational KPIs.
You will be monitoring the coordinator and associate performance and coaching them when needed, partnering with supporting departments to improve logistics processes and operations, communicating with our delivery service providers to set our expectations and raise the bar on quality on their deliverables.
You will be expected to interview candidates for associate roles.
You will be responsible for briefing and monitoring the workload of all drivers and associates. Therefore, you’ll maintain a keen eye for detail, ensuring that all administrative tasks are accurately and fully completed. Moreover, you will measure and monitor overall workflows and daily metrics. This will enable you to assist the Operations Manager with tracking, trending and reporting on site performance, on a regular basis.
In addition to your day-to-day responsibilities, you will also help with training and mentoring new Associates, ensuring that they are provided with the knowledge needed to successfully carry out their tasks. Further to this, you’ll follow-up on and resolve any process-related issues as and when required.
You are expected to be flexible to work in different shifts and to do overtime when needed.
Finally, together with the Operations Manager, you will sufficiently resource your function from a personal standpoint. Resourcing, in this context, means multiple things: call-outs for training needs, absence and performance management, coaching and continuous monitoring of department productivity and many more.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in supply chain/logistics or related field
- Experience with planning, performance metrics, and process improvement
- Experience managing teams

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in logistics
- Experience with data analysis

title: Directeur/Directrice d'Entrepôt logistique
descriptionHtml:
Les opérations représentent la force motrice d’Amazon. Ce service clé de notre activité nous permet d’exécuter et d’expédier les commandes de manière efficace afin que nos clients reçoivent leurs articles en temps et en heure. Il est chapeauté par les responsables de centre de livraison qui rassemblent l’équipe afin de promouvoir l’excellence en matière de sécurité, de qualité et de productivité sur l’ensemble de nos sites. Sur votre site, vous dirigerez d’autres responsables et créerez le planning opérationnel qui aidera vos équipes à atteindre leurs objectifs. Ce rôle consiste à favoriser l’excellence opérationnelle pour créer la société Amazon de demain.

Key job responsibilities
Vous avez sous vos ordres un centre de livraison entier. Vous dirigez des équipes, suivez les performances du site et cherchez en permanence à améliorer l’expérience client. Cela signifie que vous gérerez de près les opérations quotidiennes du site, mais aussi que vous contribuerez à de nouvelles méthodes d’innovation.
Lors d’une journée type, vous collaborerez avec différentes parties prenantes, mènerez une analyse approfondie des indicateurs de performance et de risque pour les sites, et réfléchirez aux meilleurs moyens de se préparer à différents niveaux de demande. Il vous appartiendra d’encadrer et de coacher votre équipe pour obtenir les meilleurs résultats possibles.

A day in the life
Gérer et développer une équipe de chefs de secteur
Gérer l’ensemble du site, traiter les problèmes et avoir un impact positif sur les performances du site
Analyser les performances du site par rapport aux objectifs de l’entreprise et mettre en place des actions pour améliorer notre excellence opérationnelle
Travailler en étroite collaboration avec d’autres équipes de support, y compris les équipes PxT (HR), * Finance, Delivery Service Partners (DSP), IT, Amazon Customer Excellence System (ACES) et nos ingénieurs
Concevoir et mettre en œuvre des initiatives sur l’ensemble des sites afin d’améliorer les performances opérationnelles

About the team
Amazon Logistics, ou AMZL, s’occupe des activités de livraison du « dernier kilomètre » en partenariat avec des entreprises de distribution tierces. Nous faisons appel à la créativité et aux initiatives visant à l’amélioration continue pour acheminer des millions de produits physiques jusqu’à nos clients. Notre objectif est de rendre l’expérience de livraison de nos clients aussi fluide que possible et de déployer des solutions de livraison globales pour nos concepts les plus récents, tels qu’Amazon Fresh, Prime Now et Amazon Restaurants. Notre travail s’effectue de deux manières. Nos collaborateurs·trices « sous le toit » traitent des millions de produits avant de les envoyer à nos équipes de livraison. La dimension humaine est au cœur des activités de l’équipe. Nous jouons essentiellement un rôle de soutien, y compris de nuit. Nous nous concentrons principalement sur les opérations, avec des équipes présentes 24 heures sur 24, 7 jours sur 7 dans la plupart de nos sites. Quant à nos collaborateurs·trices « sur la route », ils travaillent avec Amazon Flex, un réseau d’entreprises de livraison. Chaque année, nous plaçons la barre toujours plus haut en matière d’expérience client grâce à de nouveaux services de livraison. Nous recherchons de nouveaux moyens de relever les défis logistiques du secteur et de nouvelles idées pour réduire notre empreinte carbone, en nous appuyant sur un parc de véhicules (y compris des véhicules électriques) et des technologies de pointe.

Basic qualifications

- Un diplôme universitaire
- Une expérience significative dans la gestion des ressources humaines et des parties prenantes
- Parfaite maîtrise de l’anglais à l’oral et à l’écrit
- Une expérience significative dans l’utilisation de données ou de témoignages pour influencer la prise de décisions de l’entreprise
- Une expérience significative dans les domaines clés de la production et des chaînes d’approvisionnement

Preferred qualifications

- Connaissance des techniques Lean, Six Sigma et Kaizen
- Une expérience dans un environnement de travail logistique similaire
- Bonne maîtrise de la suite MS Office (Word, Excel, Outlook) dans un environnement professionnel

Amazon est un employeur engagé pour l'égalité des chances. Nous sommes convaincus qu'une main d'oeuvre diversifée est essentielle à notre réussite. Nous prenons nos décisions de recrutement en fonction de votre expérience et de vos compétences. Nous apprécions votre envie de découvrir, d'inventer, de simplifier et de construire. La protection de votre vie privée et la sécurité de vos données constituent depuis longtemps une priorité absolue pour Amazon. title: Speed Programs Manager - FTC 18 months, Sr Same Day Programs
descriptionHtml:
This is an 18-month fixed-term contract.

We are looking for a Speed programs manager to own end-to-end capacity planning for High Volume Events (HVE) across the EU5 Same Day network. This role sits
within the Speed Programs team and is responsible for ensuring our stations are resourced, planned, and ready to deliver on our customer promise during the most
demanding periods of the year — Prime Day, Peak (Black Friday/Cyber Monday), and other high-volume events.

You will work backwards from demand forecasts to build station-level capacity plans, identify gaps before they become misses, and drive cross-functional alignment
with Last Mile, Middle Mile, Operations, and partner teams to close them. You will own the planning calendar, mechanisms, and governance that ensure the network
moves from "plan" to "ready" with full accountability at each milestone.

This role requires someone who is comfortable operating in ambiguity, can translate large data sets into clear capacity decisions, and can hold partner teams
accountable to shared commitments under time pressure. You will be the single-threaded owner for HVE capacity readiness across EU5 Same Day — when Peak arrives,
your plans are what the network executes against.

**Key responsibilities:**

- Own the EU5 Same Day HVE capacity planning process end-to-end: demand ingestion, gap identification, action tracking, and readiness sign-off
- Build and maintain station-level capacity models for all Peak events, working with forecasting, operations, and network teams
- Identify capacity gaps (mechanical, OTR, UTR) early and drive resolution through established levers (DILO changes, route additions, overlap jurisdiction, CPT
shifts)
- Create and run the governance mechanisms (WBRs, readiness reviews, escalation paths) that ensure the network hits readiness milestones on schedule
- Partner with Operations, Last Mile, Middle Mile, and Tech teams to align inputs and commitments
- Produce clear, data-driven recommendations for senior leadership when trade-offs are required
- Build post-event retrospectives that feed learnings back into the next planning cycle

Basic qualifications

- Experience in one or more of the following areas: data center or network capacity planning, data center or network infrastructure program/project management, or related technical fields
- Experience in program or project management
- Knowledge of Excel at an advanced level
- Bachelor's degree, or BS degree
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English

Preferred qualifications

- Knowledge of general AI tools
- Experience in stakeholder and communication management

title: Data Center Project Manager, Critical Projects Implementation
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

The Critical Projects Implementation (CPI) team is a project management and execution team that manages construction activity within the operational data center spaces. The CPI team is tasked with critical infrastructure improvement projects to optimize utilization of space, power, and cooling within operational data centers around the globe. These activities are outside of the scope of standard construction delivery and regular preventative maintenance tasks.

We are currently seeking a Data Center Project Manager to serve as a technical resource within Amazon data centers. You will be part of a highly creative, efficient team tasked with tackling the most fascinating and challenges in designing, building, and operating Amazon data center facilities. The Project Manager is ultimately responsible for project oversight and review of all disciplines including electrical, mechanical, controls, and architectural. A fundamental understanding of these systems is required, as the individual will be expected to identify areas for improvement as well as act on data provided from other team and organizations. Ideal candidates will possess the ability to design, develop and deploy innovative solutions to address operational challenges. This role requires both independent contribution as well as the ability to work within multi-disciplinary teams. The scope of projects will include but not limited to the improvement of electrical, mechanical, fire detection and building automation system. The Project Manager is responsible for the overall direction, coordination, implementation, execution, control and completion of specific projects ensuring consistency with company strategy, commitments and goals.

About the team
*Why AWS*
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

*Diverse Experiences*
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

*Work/Life Balance*
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

*Inclusive Team Culture*
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

*Mentorship and Career Growth*
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Our Data Center Engineering Operations team maintain and operate our critical infrastructure systems so that they are prepared to stand up against any situation.

title: Graduate Logistik Manager - Kitzingen
descriptionHtml:
Als Nachwuchsführungskraft wirst du in unserem 11-wöchigen internen Onboarding Programm auf deine neue Aufgabe als Führungskraft vorbereitet.
Nach dieser umfangreichen Einarbeitung übernimmst du Führungsverantwortung für dein eigenes Team und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Kunden Ihre Waren pünktlich und in guter Qualität erhalten. In dieser Position bist du wichtiger Teil unseres globalen Unternehmens und arbeitest Hand in Hand mit deinen Mitarbeitenden vor Ort. Zudem arbeitest du standortübergreifend an Themen wie Arbeitssicherheit, Prozessoptimierung, Nachhaltigkeit und technischem Fortschritt.


Key job responsibilities
- Sicherstellung der Einhaltung der Arbeitssicherheitsvorschriften und des Umweltschutzes
- Ableitung von Handlungsempfehlungen und konkreten Maßnahmen zur Prozessverbesserung auf Basis von Kennzahlen wie Arbeitssicherheit, Produktivität und Qualität
- Leitung und Weiterbildung eines Teams (bis zu 100 Mitarbeitende)
- Planung und Steuerung der innerbetrieblichen Prozesse
- Teilnahme in übergeordneten Projekten zur Optimierung der Kundenzufriedenheit
- Effektives Ressourcen- und Workflowmanagement
- Zusammenarbeit mit den vor- und nachgelagerten Abteilungen vor Ort

A day in the life
Du arbeitest in einer unserer Schichten (Früh-, Spät- oder Nachtschicht). Dabei ist das Einhalten der Sicherheitsstandards an deinem gesamten Standort für dich höchste Priorität. Als Schichtleitung führst du routinemäßig Teammeetings durch und führst Feedbackgespräche mit deinen Mitarbeitenden und deinen Stakeholdern. Mit Hilfe von Datenauswertungen nimmst Du Einfluss auf die Produktivität und die Qualität deines Standortes. Als wichtiges Mitglied des Teams vor Ort arbeitest Du mit anderen Abteilungen, sowie externen Stakeholdern zusammen und sorgst dafür, dass wir die Anforderungen unserer Kundschaft, ebenso wie unsere eigenen Vorgaben jederzeit erfüllen. Durch die Analyse von Daten mit Führungskräften und die Besprechung der betrieblichen Vor- und Nachteile von technischen Verbesserungen mit den Fachabteilungen trägst du zu „best in class“ Lösungen bei.

About the team
Die Logistikabteilung bei Amazon (AMZL) ist für die „Last-Mile-Logistik“ zuständig – also die Auslieferung unserer Pakete in Partnerschaft mit Drittanbietern. Wir denken kreativ und realisieren Initiativen zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung, um Millionen von physischen Produkten an unsere Kund:innen zu liefern. Unser Ziel ist es, das Liefererlebnis für unsere Kund:innen so reibungslos wie möglich zu machen und globale Lieferlösungen für unsere neuesten Angebote einzuführen, darunter Amazon Fresh, Prime Now und Amazon Restaurants.
Diese Tätigkeiten werden von zwei Mitarbeitergruppen ausgeführt. Unsere „internen“ Mitarbeitenden bereiten Millionen von Produkten auf den Versand an unsere Lieferteams vor. title: Robotics Systems Engineer I, Tech Deployment
descriptionHtml:
Are you enthusiastic about the latest advancements in industrial automation and robotics? Would you like to play a vital role in Amazon's investment in advanced technologies? If you have a passion for making an impact on the future today, consider joining Robotics Delivery & Packaging Innovations (RDPI) Technology Deployment team within Amazon Robotics (AR) org.

In RDPI, we have the unique role and privilege of deploying leading edge industrial robotics and customer fulfillment technologies across North America Stores operations. We raise the bar on the speed, quality and cost of deploying industrial technologies at scale across North America, functioning as the field team who plan, execute and launch the technologies that our internal design and product strategy partners in RDPI develop.

Project durations vary from a few days to several months, with travel across North America. This is a travel-based role and you will be expected to travel to meet the requirements of your projects across North America, upwards of 75% or more.

As a Systems Engineer in RDPI, you will be overseeing large scale project planning, installation, and launch of industrial automation technologies across Amazons growing Stores network. This field engineering position demands strong technical skills for deploying robotic equipment, including mechanical and electrical systems, network configurations, and software coordination. The ideal candidate has experience with complex electro-mechanical and network systems, demonstrating leadership in installation, maintenance, upgrades, and troubleshooting of technologies being deployed across North America. You will work with cross-functional partners across our engineering, product strategy, software, supply chain, third-party installers, contracted deployment engineers, construction teams, and internal operations customer teams, functioning as the lead on-site project manager to provide technical oversight on installation Amazon-designed automation equipment. This Systems Engineer position is an individual contributor role, influencing and leading stakeholders from planning through go-live of each project. Candidates should have a proven track record of successfully leading multiple concurrent projects across one or more automation solutions.

**Relocation to Amazon Corporate offices in Seattle, Boston, Nashville or Austin will be required for the role.

Key job responsibilities
As a Systems Engineer I, you will work with a team of 1-5 engineers and collaborate with an on-site project manager to provide technical oversight on the installation of both third party and Amazon designed robotics equipment that may be in various phases of the product life cycle. These deployments require extensive collaboration with various stakeholders, including third-party installers, contracted engineers, construction, hardware, software, IT, and other partner teams. Strong communication skills are essential for interacting with both internal and external partners and customers. As an Amazonian, you must demonstrate independent initiative to identify and solve problems in real time during deployments. A strong technical understanding, love for field work, and a keen interest in diving deep into the understanding of Amazon’s robotics systems are key attributes for this role.

Responsibilities Include:

- You will support and guide installation of robotics, packaging and sortation technologies at Amazon fulfillment centers
- You will develop detailed knowledge of the operation of robotic systems and guide installation, commissioning, and troubleshooting of these systems both on site and remotely
- You will manage technical ambiguity around integration of work cells in fulfillment centers
- You will collaborate with hardware engineering, technical program managers, product managers, and internal customers including site maintenance and operations teams
- You will travel to project sites and collaborate both virtually and in person to ensure all business stakeholders are aligned on program status
- You will manage day to day project scheduling and budget management
- You will work on continuous improvement activities to improve the projects in your space
- You will generate and implement continuous improvement ideas around work-scopes
- You will lead teams of other engineers on projects
- You will travel to both live warehouses and new construction sites, the scopes may vary significantly in length and include heavy travel
- You will travel to project sites across North America, upwards of 75% or more

A day in the life
In this role you will be focused on execution of end-to-end deployment and manage technical ambiguity around integration of workcells in fulfillment centers. On a daily basis you will collaborate with hardware engineering, technical program managers, product managers, and internal customers including site maintenance and operations teams, to ensure the product you are deploying, is both ready for deployment and capable of achieving the business requirements. You will travel to your project sites, collaborate both virtually and in person, to ensure all business stakeholders are aligned on program status. You will manage the day-to-day project execution, and work on continuous improvement activities to improve the projects in your space. You will spend time with mentors and your manager to develop your professional skills and collaborate amongst your team to move the needle on the services you are accountable for.

Amazon offers a full range of benefits that support you and eligible family members, including domestic partners and their children. Benefits can vary by location, the number of regularly scheduled hours you work, length of employment, and job status such as seasonal or temporary employment. About the team
Are you inspired by invention? Is problem solving through teamwork in your DNA? Do you like the idea of seeing how your work impacts the bigger picture? Answer yes to any of these and you’ll fit right in here at Robotics Delivery & Packaging Innovation (RDPI) within Amazon Robotics (AR). We are a smart, collaborative team of enthusiastic doers that work passionately to apply innovative advances in robotics and software to solve real-world challenges that will transform our customers’ experiences in ways we can’t even image yet. We invent new improvements every day. We are RDPI and we will give you the tools and support you need to invent with us in ways that are rewarding, fulfilling and fun

RDPI Tech Deployment are missioned with enabling the delivery of large scale automation technologies designed and manufactured by Amazon. The team is multi-disciplinary, and consists of Field Deployment Engineers, Controls Engineering, Design for Deployment, Product Single Threaded Leaders, and a Program Management Office team, who collaborate on enabling the delivery of new technologies and packaging solutions that delight our customers, and improve the safety, quality and costs within the Amazon fulfillment processes. The team is geographically located across four North America hub locations. The work we deliver directly impact high priority goals set each year to our most senior leadership at Amazon.

- 1+ year’s experience with technical drawings and/or reading CAD models (mechanical and electrical)
- 1+ year’s Experience working on mechanical, electrical, IT networked, or software systems

- Ability to read technical drawings and/or reading CAD models to resolve on-site clash issues using 3D clash detection reports
- Ability to troubleshoot robotics systems to resolve escalations including quality hand-off, live order testing, site acceptance testing, operational readiness testing, monitoring robotics system performance, etc.

descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. You are able to execute small projects on your own and work with your manager in planning and executing larger local projects. You act as an escalation point for junior technicians. You understand all aspects of the equipment you support.

title: Demand Planning Manager
descriptionHtml:
Amazon's technology supply chain supports a complex and rapidly evolving portfolio of infrastructure, end-user equipment, and technology products across thousands of locations globally. As the business scales, accurate and forward-looking demand planning is critical to ensuring supply availability, managing inventory investment, and delivering predictable outcomes for customers.

We are seeking a Manager, Demand Planning to lead the demand planning capability within Supply Chain Planning. This leader will manage a team responsible for developing and continuously improving demand plans across the existing customer business segments, while establishing scalable mechanisms that can support new businesses, products, and fulfillment models.

The successful candidate will build a demand planning organization that combines strong planning fundamentals with data, technology, and automation. This includes improving forecast quality, integrating customer and business signals, identifying structural sources of forecast error, and partnering with Product, Data, Analytics, and Technology teams to reduce manual planning activity and enable increasingly intelligent forecasting capabilities.

The ideal candidate combines strong supply chain expertise, analytical depth, customer orientation, business judgment, and people leadership. They must be comfortable challenging assumptions, navigating incomplete or conflicting signals, and influencing stakeholders across Supply Chain, Finance, Technology, Operations, Procurement, and customer organizations.

Key job responsibilities
- Lead, coach, and develop a team responsible for demand planning across Launch, KTLO, and Programs.
- Own the end-to-end demand planning mechanism, including forecast creation, validation, consensus, performance measurement, and continuous improvement.
- Translate customer, business, historical, operational, and market signals into credible forward-looking demand plans at the appropriate product, geographic, and time horizons.
- Establish clear accountability for demand inputs and challenge assumptions, overrides, and changes that are not supported by measurable business signals.
- Define and improve forecast accuracy, bias, forecast value-add, and other metrics that distinguish true demand variability from process, data, and system defects.
- Partner with Supply Planning and Enterprise S&OP to surface demand uncertainty, quantify risks, and support scenario and trade-off decisions.
- Develop segmented planning approaches appropriate for different demand patterns, including launches, steady-state replenishment, and program-driven demand.
- Partner with Product, Data, Analytics, and Technology teams to automate forecast ingestion, validation, anomaly detection, and planner workflows.
- Advance the use of statistical forecasting, machine learning, and AI to improve forecast quality and reduce dependence on manual reconciliation and judgment.
- Simplify fragmented demand signals and processes, with a long-term goal of connecting Planning more directly to customer and business demand signals.
- Build scalable mechanisms that support new products, businesses, regions, and planning paradigms without creating parallel planning processes.
- Communicate demand outlook, uncertainty, structural risks, and recommended actions clearly to senior stakeholders.

A day in the life
In this role, you may begin the day reviewing forecast performance and emerging demand changes with your team, determining whether movement reflects a true change in customer demand or a defect in the underlying signal.

You may work with customer teams to challenge assumptions behind a forecast, partner with Supply Planning to understand the implications of a significant demand shift, or support Enterprise S&OP with scenarios where demand uncertainty requires a broader business decision.

You may also spend time with Product or Technology teams improving how demand signals are ingested, automating a repetitive planner workflow, or defining how machine learning and AI can augment planner judgment.

The role balances near-term planning performance with the longer-term objective of creating a scalable, technology-enabled demand planning capability where planners spend less time collecting and reconciling information and more time understanding customers, evaluating uncertainty, and improving the quality of the plan.

- 5+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams experience
- 5+ years of team management experience
- 5+ years of cross functional project delivery experience
- 5+ years of program or project management experience
- 5+ years of supply chain experience
- Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements
- Bachelor's degree
- Experience in forecasting, budgeting, variance analysis, and interpreting financial results across multiple business areas, or experience building and managing financial models for business forecasting and problem solving

Preferred qualifications

- Experience implementing repeatable processes and driving automation or standardization
- Experience managing teams of 3 or more
- Master's degree
- Experience with ERP systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle, Workday), or experience working with Excel, reporting tools, and large-scale data mining tools, such as Power BI, Python, SQL, or Tableau
