title: Principal Partner Marketing Manager - Compute, AI & SUP Partner Marketing
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is seeking a Principal Partner Marketing Manager to own the partner marketing strategy for AWS's compute and semiconductor partnerships. This individual contributor role sits within the WW AI & SUP Partner Marketing team and owns the go-to-market relationship with AWS's strategic silicon partners, with NVIDIA as the anchor partnership and a growing remit across AMD and Intel.

This is the senior marketing counterpart to AWS's most significant compute partner relationships. You will own joint marketing planning, co-marketing investment governance, and demand generation across the compute portfolio, and you will set the standard that regional and geo-based marketing teams execute. The role carries direct accountability for a large co-marketing investment pool and for the mechanisms that convert that investment into measurable customer adoption and pipeline. As the compute remit scales, this role is expected to grow a supporting resource over time; the successful candidate will help define and mentor that role as the team builds out.

The ideal candidate combines deep partner or alliance marketing expertise at scale with subject-matter credibility in compute, accelerated computing, cloud infrastructure, and enterprise B2B go-to-market. You are comfortable operating in high ambiguity, setting direction where none exists, and driving alignment across senior stakeholders who do not report to you, including specialist sales, product marketing, and partner development organizations.

Key job responsibilities
Own NVIDIA partner marketing strategy as the anchor compute partnership, setting multi-year vision and JMPs aligned to AGIs, OP2, and compute roadmap.

Extend and formalize marketing across AMD and Intel, establishing JMPs, governance, and activation where coverage is maturing.

Own and govern MDF for the compute portfolio, a pool in the tens of millions, bringing ROI discipline and oversight to unmanaged spend.

Serve as senior AWS marketing counterpart to compute partner leads, building VP/SVP relationships driving co-investment, launches, and multi-year alignment.

Own the launch playbook for compute announcements (new silicon, instance families, accelerated computing), ensuring consistent messaging and pipeline impact.

Drive demand generation delivering measurable PSQL and partner-sourced pipeline across enterprise, mid-market, and digital-native segments, with portfolio-level attribution.

Coordinate joint workshops, planning cadences, and regional execution across Americas, EMEA, and APJ.

Partner with WWSO specialist sales and HPC teams to align investment to competency-based motions and high-value pipeline.

Own portfolio KPIs and executive reporting on pipeline, campaign performance, and co-marketing ROI to VP/SVP leadership.

Build mechanisms that scale: playbooks, templates, measurement models, and rhythms the broader team executes consistently.

- Experience using data and metrics to drive improvements
- Experience with Excel or Tableau (data manipulation, macros, charts and pivot tables)
- Experience building, executing and scaling cross-functional marketing programs
- Experience driving direction and alignment with cross-functional teams

Preferred qualifications

- Experience working cross-functionally with partner teams to drive adoption and usage of brand assets and messaging
- Experience in strategic marketing management and market analysis and demonstrated ability to build and execute a strategy with clear goals and objectives to align to business and service objectives, and support portfolio objectives

title: Delivery Station Customer Service Associate, DSL
descriptionHtml:
At Amazon, our mission is to be Earth’s most customer-centric company. To achieve this goal, we strive to exceed expectations by innovating and providing best-in-class customer support as we expand our logistics products and services including improving how we fulfill and deliver customer orders. We’re making history and the good news is that we’ve only just begun. At Amazon you get to Work with smart, passionate people who are building new products and services every day on behalf of our customers.

As a Delivery Station Customer Service Associate, you will help improve the customer experience by providing in station real-time, hands-on support to ensure our customers receive their packages on time, as promised. The role will also help connect customers with experts who can provide them the most accurate and up-to-date information about their packages. The work is beyond fulfilling and delivering customer orders; it’s making sure we put smiles on customer’s faces.

Key job responsibilities
As a Delivery Station Customer Service Associate, you will be responsible for:
• Communicating with customers directly in-person, in addition to communicating via phone and email
• Empathizing with and prioritizing customer needs
• Upholding company values and respecting every customer
• Resolving issues and setting appropriate expectations with customers
• Clearly understanding and responding appropriately to the issues that customers present
• Consistently composing grammatically correct, concise, and accurate written responses to customer issues
• Approaching problems logically and with good judgment to ensure the appropriate customer outcome
• Making quick and effective decisions on behalf of the customer
• Working a flexible Full-Time (40+ hours per week) schedule
Performing the following tasks, with or without reasonable accommodation
• Carry, lift, push and pull up to 49 pounds
• Frequently push, pull, squat, bend and reach
• Stand and walk during shifts lasting up to 12 hours
• Work in an environment where the noise level varies and can be loud (hearing protection will be provided)
• Work in an environment where the temperature may vary due to outside weather conditions and is not controlled.

A day in the life
You’ll be based at one of our last-mile delivery warehouses, where Amazon’s leading logistics system operates. As orders are dispatched and delivered, you’ll be in contact with our warehouse, associates, delivery partners and customers when they need guidance. Where a customer needs to reschedule a delivery, you’ll be informing our delivery partners. Where you notice a delivery issue, you’ll get to work resolving it straight away, so that our customers get a great experience every time without having to contact Amazon.

Operating at the heart of Amazon’s logistics, you’ll develop logistical and customer expertise that sets Amazon apart. You’ll connect with our customers every day, using your in-depth understanding of our supply chain and local knowledge of delivery connections and warehouses.

About the team
Our mission is to be Earth’s most customer-centric company, and few departments have as direct an impact on that mission as our Customer Service team. We're an inclusive team who empower and look after our people, so they have the time and energy to focus on our customers’ happiness. Our goal is to reduce customer effort every way we can, helping them get the best results quickly and efficiently. We support our self-service channels to offer expert insights into our customers’ most complex issues.

Within Customer Service, there are opportunities in process improvement, customer experience, data analysis and customer retention. The CS team is always looking for ways to make Amazon’s customer service even better, and we need excellent people to make that happen.

Basic qualifications

- High school or equivalent
- Experience in Customer Service
- Experience working with computers and Microsoft Office (including Outlook, Word, and Excel)
- Experience prioritizing and managing time effectively in dynamic environments
- Experience working with computer and web based tools

Preferred qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- Experience in understanding performance metrics and developing them to measure progress against key performance indicators
- Experience with written and verbal communication and presentation
- Experience working on a merchandising/brand ambassador team for a nationally recognized consumer brand

title: Marketing Manager, Attraction, Influence & Marketing (AIM)
descriptionHtml:
Are you passionate about connecting people to opportunity? Do you thrive using creative sourcing and marketing channels to deliver real hiring outcomes — at a pace and scale few organizations can match?

At Amazon, we are reinventing how to attract and hire exceptional talent at scale. The Attraction, Influence, and Marketing (AIM) organization is seeking a well-organized, data-driven, and self-motivated Marketing Manager to execute and scale Talent Marketing programs for India.

You are equal parts executor and analyst — comfortable building an integrated marketing plan with agency partners one day and presenting campaign results to leadership the next. You thrive in a fast-paced environment, take full ownership of your workstreams, and know how to coordinate across partner teams whose roadmaps don't report to you. You understand that recruitment marketing isn't just advertising — it's hiring infrastructure — and you're energized by delivering measurable, repeatable results at scale. This role requires operational rigor, creative problem-solving, and a bias for action on a team that works hard and has fun.

This role supports the Talent Marketing India leader in developing and executing India's sourcing and marketing strategy across all Amazon sites — profiling target candidates, identifying appropriate channel levers, and building top-of-funnel demand to efficiently attract hourly talent. You will develop and execute local and national community engagement strategies, operationalize plans against KPIs tied to growing the hourly talent pipeline, reducing reliance on paid advertising. Additionally, you will author candidate communications, hiring event content, onboarding collateral, offer templates, and other marketing materials.

You'll collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders on data-driven candidate attraction initiatives, track market shifts in hourly candidate behavior, and contribute to market mapping and intelligence efforts. To succeed, you'll need to see the big picture while executing rapidly on the ground.


Key job responsibilities
• Work with internal and external agency teams to develop and execute integrated marketing programs tailored for local markets, messaging on the employee value proposition and branding at country and business line levels
• Use data to rigorously assess channel and media effectiveness, prioritize based on business requirements, and optimize to achieve marketing goals
• Maintain local staffing agency and marketing agencies including onboarding, project briefs, vendor management and payment processing
• Monitor channel analytics to measure effectiveness and forecast future spend and required activity by site/region
• Support multiple marketing programs end-to-end — from self-serve infrastructure to targeted activation for priority hiring domains
• Establish pre-pilot baselines in partnership with analytics teams, manage evaluation cycles, and present results to leadership
• Support tech integration requirements such as the transition from third-party tooling to Amazon-native infrastructure
• Serve as a reliable point of contact for assigned programs across analytics, PR, creative, and Central teams; contribute to cadenced reporting (WBR, MBR, HBR)
• Partner with analytics, performance marketing and other teams to validate attribution methodology, track baseline metrics, and translate data into actionable recommendations
• Maintain a thorough understanding of local employment trends and continually monitor competitor/industry developments
• Document processes, create playbooks, and maintain SOPs that enable programs to scale without proportional headcount growth



About the team
Amazon's Attraction, Influence, and Marketing (AIM) organization is a dynamic team of marketing professionals dedicated to attracting and engaging talent across Amazon's diverse business segments. AIM achieves high-volume hiring goals by delivering exceptional, multi-channel candidate experiences, engaging and hiring job seekers with maximum efficiency and precision. Leveraging paid digital advertising, owned channels, web experience, and local grassroots efforts, AIM delivers quality candidates at scale. Practicing transformational thinking empowered by leading-edge tech and tool development, this team constantly innovates new processes to increase marketing efficacy.
Description

Basic qualifications

- Master's degree
- 6+ years of professional non-internship marketing experience
- Experience experience using data and metrics to measure impact and determine improvements
- Experience with strong project management skills and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment
- 3+ years of working with or evaluating AI systems experience

Preferred qualifications

- Experience using customer research, hard data and metrics to back up assumptions, generate forecasts, and assess the efficacy of marketing programs
- Experience utilizing systems and tools involving email, web, analytics, and CRM (Marketo, Tableau, Salesforce, etc.) for targeting, segmentation, reporting for demand generation
- Experience in creating process improvements with automation and analysis

title: Industry Solutions Product Manager, Industry Builder Team
descriptionHtml:
About Amazon Web Services Since 2006, Amazon Web Services has been the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud. AWS has been continually expanding its services to support virtually any workload, and it now has more than 240 fully featured services for compute, storage, databases, networking, analytics, machine learning and artificial intelligence (AI), Internet of Things (IoT), mobile, security, hybrid, media, and application development, deployment, and management from 105 Availability Zones within 33 geographic regions, with announced plans for 18 more Availability Zones and 6 more AWS Regions in Malaysia, Mexico, New Zealand, the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, Thailand. Millions of customers—including the fastest-growing startups, largest enterprises, and leading government agencies—trust AWS to power their infrastructure, become more agile, and lower costs. To learn more about AWS, visit aws.amazon.com.
AWS Global Sales drives adoption of the AWS cloud worldwide, enabling customers of all sizes to innovate and expand in the cloud. Our team empowers every customer to grow by providing tailored service, unmatched technology, and consistent support. We dive deep to understand each customer's unique challenges, then craft innovative solutions that accelerate their success. This customer-first approach is how we built the world's most adopted cloud. Join us and help us grow.


Amazon Web Services came to China in 2013, and has been relentlessly investing and expanding our infrastructure and business since then. Amazon Web Services launched its China (Beijing) Region (operated by Sinnet) in September 2016 and its China (Ningxia) Region (operated by NWCD) in December 2017. In 2019, Amazon Web Services added a new region in Hong Kong, making China the only country with three Amazon Web Services regions aside from the U.S. In 2022, Amazon Web Services launched Local Zone in Taipei. Amazon Web Services has also established an AI lab in Shanghai and two IoT labs in Shenzhen and Taipei. The Amazon Web Services Partner Network has thousands of Partners in China. Amazon Web Services has supported over 10,000 local startups and has provided cloud skills training to over 700,000 talents. Amazon’s first two utility-scale renewable projects—a solar farm and a wind farm—are also generating clean energy to the country’s grid.

As an Industry Solutions Product Manager at AWS, you will own the strategy, roadmap, and lifecycle of industry-specific solution assets that accelerate customer adoption and drive industry revenue growth. Working across a virtual industry squad of Solutions Architects, Builders, and specialists, you will translate deep customer and industry insights into a prioritized portfolio of reusable, increasingly GenAI-powered solutions — taking each asset from hypothesis to validated, scaled offering.

Key job responsibilities
Define and maintain the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for industry solution assets. Gather and synthesize customer insights, industry trends, and competitive intelligence to identify and prioritize use cases.
Own the asset backlog; make data-driven prioritization and investment decisions.
Partner with Solutions Architects, Builders, and specialists to take solutions from concept to scaled adoption.
Define success metrics and track adoption, reuse, and revenue impact of the portfolio.
Manage the asset lifecycle, including sunsetting and versioning decisions.
Act as the voice of the customer and the industry across a matrixed, cross-functional organization.

About the team
The Industry Builder team is the core engineering force within AWS, dedicated to turning industry solutions into working, reusable assets through rapid code delivery. Through rapid validation, demo building, asset code delivery, and shared-capability development, the team transforms industry insights and solution designs into runnable, reusable industry solution assets.

Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.


Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of customer-facing product development and product management, including defining, launching, and optimizing product and services experience
- Experience in customer-facing product development and product management, including defining, launching, and optimizing product and services
- Experience coordinating complex products with stringent technical requirements, development cycles and schedules
- Bachelor's degree

Preferred qualifications

- Knowledge of agile product development and life-cycle management process
- Experience leading cross-functional teams to deliver products and online services on tight deadlines

title: Software Development Manager, PV Sports and Linear Tech / Live Events Publishing
descriptionHtml:
Want to change the way people watch Live Sports? Passionate about building, owning and operating massively scalable systems? Prime Video is re-inventing the live sports experience by merging high-quality live streaming, immersive interactive features, and exclusive access to some of the world's most loved sports properties — including the NFL, NBA, English Premier League and UEFA Champions League soccer, Roland-Garros (French Open), the US Open and more. We move at the speed of live events, shipping fast, iterating constantly, and building across a rapidly expanding set of technologies. And we're doing it at a scale only Amazon is capable of. The Prime Video Sports team is a single-threaded owner for Sports experiences, uniquely positioned to execute our vision across the entire Prime Video stack to deliver the most compelling experiences to our customers.

We are a team of builders — from new graduates to seasoned architects — who value ownership, open debate, and learning through experimentation. We make decisions together, move fast, and hold each other to a high bar. If you're a leader who thrives in that kind of environment, read on.

Who are we:
The Live Events Publishing team is part of Prime Video Sports & Linear org, responsible for the end-to-end systems that bring live sports content to customers. We are the owner, steward, and authority responsible for the sports catalog that powers the live sports experience for Prime Video customers worldwide. We build the automation, tooling, and AI-powered capabilities that enable operators and systems to publish content quickly and accurately for events like NBA, Fox Sports, and other major live programming. Our Bangalore team is a growing engineering hub, and this role is central to scaling our impact.

About the role: As a Software Development Manager on the LEP team, you will lead a team of engineers building and operating the suite of services that fulfill our vision: the world's richest, most reliable, and lowest-latency catalog — enabling sports fans worldwide to discover, purchase, and consume sports content in any format, on any device. You will set the technical direction, hire and grow engineers, and drive the bar for all phases of the software development lifecycle.

What we're looking for:
We are looking for a highly talented Software Development Manager to help build fast, scalable, robust systems to crystallize and execute this vision. The successful candidate is expected to be a hands-on technical manager who sets a high bar for all phases of the software development lifecycle, while hiring, coaching, developing, and growing a team of engineers. We seek someone with an insatiable curiosity and appetite for learning, who can build and nurture an AI-native engineering team capable of leveraging emerging AI technologies in our solutions. We value a proactive mindset and a genuine passion for making complex systems simple. Your ability to build a culture of innovation and adaptability will be key as we integrate AI throughout our engineering practices.

Key job responsibilities
Lead and grow a team of software engineers, owning their project assignments, performance coaching, and career development while building a strong hiring pipeline
Define and communicate your team's roadmap and technical strategy to management, principal stakeholders, and partner teams, aligning priorities with customer needs
Facilitate systems design, architecture, and scaling discussions, making sound trade-offs across reliability, latency, and maintainability for the live sports catalog
Partner with product management and peer engineering managers to scope work, estimate effort, and deliver high-quality software that improves the live sports viewing experience worldwide
Champion operational excellence by establishing metrics, monitoring practices, and automation that keep your team's services healthy and your customers well-served

A day in the life
You start by syncing with product and partner engineering leads to scope upcoming work or unblock in-flight deliveries. Mid-morning you might review a design document with your engineers, pressure-testing assumptions around latency and scale for a new publishing workflow. After lunch you check operational dashboards, then shift to a one-on-one where you coach a team member through a promotion plan. Later you contribute to your team's technical strategy, weighing customer impact against engineering cost before wrapping up with a status update to stakeholders.

About the team
The Prime Video Sports Publishing (LEP) team is the owner, steward, and authority responsible for the sports catalog that powers the live sports experience for Prime Video customers worldwide. The team builds and operates the suite of services behind our vision to be the world's richest, most reliable, and lowest-latency catalog — enabling sports fans to discover, purchase, and consume sports content on any device.

We are a team that values inclusiveness, respect, and mentorship. Our technology choices and designs are driven by engineers, not handed down from above. We have a strong voice in shaping the product, pitching ideas up the chain rather than the other way around.

Basic qualifications

- 8+ years of engineering experience
- 3+ years of engineering team management experience
- 8+ years of leading the definition and development of multi tier web services experience
- Knowledge of engineering practices and patterns for the full software/hardware/networks development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, certification, and livesite operations
- Experience partnering with product or program management teams
- Experience designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems
- 3+ years of designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience

title: Sr. Specialist, GenAI, Frontier Models GTM
descriptionHtml:
Do you want to help define the future of Go to Market (GTM) at AWS using generative AI (GenAI)? You will be part of the core worldwide GenAI Training and Inference team, responsible for defining, building, and deploying targeted strategies to accelerate customer adoption of our services and solutions across industry verticals. You will have the opportunity to define GTM strategies and lead cross-functional initiatives to expand existing markets, develop scalable programs to drive adoption, and identify new opportunities. This involves activities include market sizing, building an opportunity pipeline, working with customers to understand technical requirements for proof-of-concepts, creating content to train the field teams, driving industry thought-leadership, working with product teams to define new features, and identifying partners and potential acquisitions.

title: Software Development Engineer II, Amazon FinAuto - Travel & Events
descriptionHtml:
The Amazon Travel & Events (AT&E) Tech team, part of Finance Automation, is driving a multi-year transformation of the end-to-end Travel & Expense experience for over 500,000 Amazon employees across 64 countries. We are consolidating previously fragmented travel, events, payments, and expense systems into a unified, AI-powered experience within AtoZ, organized around four interconnected modules: Plan, Book, Pay, and Expense. Our platform leverages machine learning, natural language processing, and GenAI to deliver context-aware policy guidance, proactive compliance recommendations, fraud detection, and sustainability intelligence embedded into employee workflows. The transformation eliminates significant administrative burden across the organization while delivering substantial cost savings and recovering employee productivity at scale.

We are seeking a passionate Software Development Engineer who can help us build the next generation of unified Travel & Expense systems and support the AT&E organization.

As a Software Development Engineer on the team, you will design and build services that power AI-driven policy guidance, intelligent booking experiences, automated expense workflows, centralized payment mechanisms, and real-time T&E analytics serving a global customer base. You will collaborate with product managers, data scientists, and senior and peer-level software engineers across Finance Automation and partner organizations including Accounts Payable and Global Corporate Procurement. This role provides you with autonomy and ownership over decisions, working backwards directly from customers. There is ample opportunity for growth due to the high-visibility work and presence of senior engineering talent for guidance and mentorship. The team operates in cross-functional two-pizza team structures that lead T&E technical transformations.

descriptionHtml:

We believe that advertising, when done well, can connect the right brands with the right consumers while delivering holistic value.

Twitch is the world's leading live-streaming platform, home to a highly engaged, hard-to-reach audience that spends billions of minutes each month watching gaming, entertainment, sports, music and creator-led content. As Twitch continues to scale its advertising proposition across EMEA, the ability to articulate the unique value of Twitch audiences to advertisers is a critical growth lever - and a capability we are building from the ground up.

This is an individual contributor role embedded within the Twitch Go-to-Market (GTM) team who will focus on Insights and Measurement. You will work extensively with the Twitch sales specialists, GTM leads, product and ad-tech teams to develop and deliver insights that directly fuel revenue growth.

This is not a backend role. You will actively participate in customer meetings as the subject matter expert on Twitch audience insights & measurement, and leverage Amazon's rich array of insights and measurement solutions - combined with Twitch-native data - to deliver media strategies that position Twitch as an essential part of the advertising mix.

Key job responsibilities
- Build the Twitch insights playbook from scratch: Develop a scalable library of Twitch audience insights, competitive benchmarks and measurement case studies that the sales team can deploy across pitches, QBRs and strategic conversations.

- Equip the sales team to sell with confidence: Translate complex Twitch audience data (viewership, engagement, demographics, content affinities) into clear, compelling narratives that articulate the unique and incremental value of Twitch to advertisers.

- Establish and advance senior-level relationships: Build relationships with senior marketing decision makers (e.g. Senior Director, C-level) by positioning yourself as the go-to expert on Twitch audience intelligence and at least one advanced analytical area of advertising.

- Generate data-driven insights: Leverage Amazon's proprietary data, Twitch-native signals, third-party research and ad measurement solutions to generate actionable insights that prove the impact of advertising on Twitch.

- Develop Twitch measurement expertise: Develop expertise in Twitch-specific metrics and Amazon's proprietary measurement tools, working to constantly evolve how we analyse and communicate the value of Twitch audiences to advertisers.

- Directly support revenue growth: Partner with GTM and sales leadership to identify the highest-impact insight gaps, prioritise your roadmap accordingly, and measure your work against pipeline and revenue outcomes.

- Advocate for data-driven decision-making: Guide advertisers to implement recommended solutions, with a particular focus on demonstrating Twitch's role in full-funnel and cross-platform strategies.

- Influence product and go-to-market strategy: Write internal documents with strategic recommendations that influence the direction of Twitch advertising products, measurement capabilities and go-to-market working mechanisms with internal stakeholders.

- Scale your analyses: Actively scale your analyses to other categories or locales through AI-native solutions.



A day in the life
No two days at Amazon are the same. You will have the flexibility to work with your stakeholders and define a book of business that will maximise your impact on Twitch revenue. On any given day, you might find yourself:
- Building a bespoke audience profile to help a seller win a competitive brief in colaboration with our Audience&Insights organization

title: MHLS Sr. Advisor, Work Ev [S], MHLS Sr. Advisor, WE [A], MHLS, My HR Live Support VAR
descriptionHtml:
This is a contract role

The My HR Live Support (MHLS) team is currently seeking to hire an MHLS Sr. Advisor to support our Tier 2 Specialty Operation. The MHLS Tier 2 Specialty Team primarily provides customer service to Amazon employees through phone, chat, ticketing, and cases related to payroll, disability, policies, among others. This role will act as a point of contact for the team, offering immediate assistance on complex issues and handling challenging contacts. The Sr. Advisors provide case consultations and overall resolution and support for all types of leaves of absence and disability life events to our Amazon employees. They are highly skilled in answering questions, obtaining the right information from SOPs and knowledge centers, providing direct support through different live and written channels, understanding the employee’s situation, applying appropriate benefits, responding to changing circumstances; and paves the way for a connected and trusted case management experience. The Sr. Advisor will also escalate trends to management to address any training or quality gaps identified.

The ideal candidate will possess exceptional communication and organizational skills, a keen attention to detail, the ability to prioritize in a fast-paced environment, strong relationship-building and influencing abilities, robust analytical and critical thinking skills, and a customer service focus that aligns with Amazon's global standards.

Key job responsibilities

• Respond to inquiries about disability and leave events, time-off, payments, and work-related situations available to employees.
• Inbound and Outbound phone, chat and case support through the Specialized Support Queues.
• Serve as a point of contact for employees to provide holistic case management services, including medical documentation review to adjudicate compliance with corresponding leave plans, federal and state laws and benefit plans as defined by Amazon.
• Critically assess and adjust the case management plan to an employee’s changing needs.
• Address and respond to sensitive situations in benefit of employee experience and attempt to de-escalate complex cases.
• Manage own workload effectively to meet productivity goals and escalate when significant changes or gaps in assigned workload arise.
• Troubleshoot issues and seek to remove barriers before, during, or after a leave event.
• Respond to employee impacting issues that may arise during the leave event and ensure the right communication and documentation occurs, even when information is limited.
• Use good judgement and rationale to balance process adherence with employee’s needs to analyze and decide on disability, leave and benefits requests.
• Facilitate a smooth return to work and ramp-back plan for employees returning to the workplace.
• Educate managers and business partners on employee concerns and needs prior to starting a leave or returning back to work.
• Communicate regular updates to employees and stakeholders both verbally and in writing.
• Ensure compliance with standard work, federal/state regulations, and company policy.
• Maintain system records to ensure accurate and timely information/documentation.
• Consult, coordinate and partner with our third-party administrator, local HR, Safety, Legal, Payroll, Benefits team members and other support units as appropriate.

A day in the life
In a typical day, you will manage a mix of escalated cases from Tier 1 advisors and direct employee contacts, researching and resolving immigration inquiries, processing documentation and letter requests, managing leave-related concerns, and supporting employees through accommodation processes. You own each case from first contact through resolution, proactively following up and removing roadblocks rather than passing issues along. Every interaction matters — you listen with empathy, anticipate what the employee needs next, and go beyond the immediate question to ensure a complete and trusted experience. In qualità di RME Technician, ti occuperai della manutenzione di una vasta gamma di macchinari e postazioni di lavoro, assicurando sempre il rispetto delle normative di salute e sicurezza. Aiuterai a tutelare la sicurezza dei colleghi, prevenendo fermi macchina. Il nostro team di RME ottimizza la disponibilità e la qualità dei nostri macchinari e migliora l’ambiente operativo nel complesso.
Verrà valutata positivamente una conoscenza pregressa dei sistemi di refrigerazione.

Il contratto collettivo nazionale di lavoro applicabile a questo ruolo è Logistica e Trasporti. La posizione è inquadrata al livello 3.

Principali responsabilità

• Interventi di manutenzione preventiva su un’ampia gamma di macchinari in sede.

• Sovraintendere a progetti di miglioramento continuo e implementare procedure chiave in una gamma di sedi europee.

A day in the life
La giornata tipo
I nostri RME Technician operano sul campo, in modo da intervenire prontamente nell’eventualità di problemi ai macchinari. A intervalli prestabiliti, eseguirai una serie di interventi di manutenzione preventiva sui macchinari delle nostre sedi, per assicurarne il corretto funzionamento. Affiancando i colleghi senior, ti occuperai della manutenzione ordinaria, come la tinteggiatura o l’idraulica, con il supporto di professionisti esterni se necessario. title: Brand Specialist - German
descriptionHtml:
About Amazon

Amazon strives to be Earth's most customer-centric company where people can find and discover virtually anything they want to buy online. By giving customers more of what they want - low prices, vast selection, and convenience – Amazon continues to grow and evolve as a world-class e-commerce platform. Amazon's evolution from website to e-commerce partner to development platform is driven by the spirit of innovation that is part of the company's DNA. The world's brightest technology minds come to Amazon to research and develop technology that improves the lives of shoppers and sellers around the world.

About the Role

Account Management- Brand Specialist

As a Brand Specialist you would be a part of Amazon Vendor Services (AVS) Team of Retail Business Services, you will have the exciting opportunity to help shape and deliver on a strategy for managing Amazon AVS vendors.

AVS team is looking for a bright, customer centric, driven, and creative candidate to join our team. You will interface internally with leaders from our Retail and Vendor Services teams and will be responsible for all aspects of the vendor’s business with Amazon. You will engage directly with multiple internal teams to optimize the product line for key manufacturers (vendors) on Amazon.

You will conceive, create and analyze a wide range of marketing activities/campaigns to grow the vendor’s traffic, brand awareness, customer conversion, and revenue on Amazon. title: Operations Engineer Intern (Field)
descriptionHtml:
Job Summary

This role can be based in: FRA3, DTM1, ERF1, BRE4, BER8, HAJ1, SCN2, HAJ8, LEJ5, HAM2, ERF3 OR DUS4

Amazon Operations is the backbone of the Amazon customer experience. With over 50 fulfilment centres, hundreds of delivery stations, and tens of thousands of employees, the team works together to efficiently deliver items to customers. In the fulfilment centres, millions of items are picked and packed annually, while delivery teams work to get orders to customers on time. Safety is the top priority, and the operations culture is defined by teamwork, diversity, and a shared work ethic that keeps the business running smoothly. The team takes pride in delivering the quality service Amazon is known for globally.
Note: You must have the right to work in the country of employment by the start date.

Key job responsibilities
Key Job Responsibilities
An engineering internship in Amazon will provide you with an unforgettable experience in a dynamic and international environment. Our internships serve to be an educational experience, where you will put your skills and bias for action to the test, to complete a project that will support your own learning in the engineering field.
The engineering team in Amazon maintain and optimize all technologies in the Global Amazon Warehouse & Delivery Network ranging from large, modern, purpose-built warehouses utilizing robotics and high-volume conveyance all the way through the value chain to small, high speed, delivery stations placed as close to our customers as possible.
We provide professional growth, opportunities to solve for complex engineering challenges, Material Handling Equipment, and opportunities to build your skills working with various teams and stakeholders. Our Operations Engineering Interns must be comfortable interfacing with and driving various functional teams and all stakeholders at all levels of the organization.
As an Engineering intern, you could have the opportunity to join one of the following teams: Project Management, Change Management, People Management, Planning, Contracting Management, Infrastructure, Reliability Maintenance and more. You will work on a project with real impact within Amazon. This could include:
* Design, build, improve, and innovate order fulfilment infrastructure throughout the large-scale supply chain network.
* Manage, design, and implement small to medium scope integrated automation projects with system elements such as high-speed sortation, multiple conveyors, package lines, and/or robotic work cells.
* Working on a program to train technicians in the basics of control systems fault finding in order to raise the level of knowledge within the site.
* Support within the EU Controls network on a project to enhance the capability to monitor MHE metrics and provide visualization and data to internal customers.
* Develop alongside global teams to support the installation and commission of new equipment, including project managing implementation of new processes
* Potential relocation to the designated work location.

A day in the life
A Day in the Life
Our internships are educational opportunities that allow you, our future managers, to discover how we lead and develop our teams. You'll immerse yourself in the fast-paced, complex world of operations, either from a corporate perspective or from our Fulfillment Centers, Sortation Hubs, and Delivery Stations, witnessing how our managers engage their teams to fulfill customer expectations.
This internship will place you at the heart of our operations, enabling you to trace the journey of a customer order. You'll gain a realistic job preview of the full-time opportunities awaiting you within our organization.
You'll learn how our managers cultivate a safe, productive environment, harnessing the full potential of their teams through effective engagement and performance management strategies. This is your chance to develop skills that will propel you towards a rewarding career with Amazon.
About the Team

* As an Amazon Intern, you'll be part of a vibrant, supportive community that empowers your growth and development. You'll collaborate with interns from around the world, networking and participating in social events to broaden your perspectives. You can also join specialized groups focused on areas like sustainability to explore your diverse interests.
Support:

Learning Sessions:
* Exclusive learning sessions will further enhance your skills, granting you access to Amazon's cutting-edge learning platforms and the expertise of industry leaders. These structured development opportunities will prepare you for the next step in your career.
Opportunities:
* Upon successful completion of the internship, you may be considered for a graduate role or a second internship, allowing you to continue your journey with Amazon. Additionally, you'll enjoy a competitive monthly salary, relocation support, and access to a range of employee benefits.
Internship Start Dates across the year:

title: Applied Scientist, International Seller Services
descriptionHtml:
Are you fascinated by the power of Natural Language Processing (NLP) and Large Language Models (LLM) to transform the way we interact with technology? Are you passionate about applying advanced machine learning techniques to solve complex challenges in the e-commerce space? If so, Amazon's International Seller Services team has an exciting opportunity for you as an Applied Scientist.

At Amazon, we strive to be Earth's most customer-centric company, where customers can find and discover anything they want to buy online. Our International Seller Services team plays a pivotal role in expanding the reach of our marketplace to sellers worldwide, ensuring customers have access to a vast selection of products.

As an Applied Scientist, you will join a talented and collaborative team that is dedicated to driving innovation and delivering exceptional experiences for our customers and sellers. You will be part of a global team that is focused on acquiring new merchants from around the world to sell on Amazon’s global marketplaces around the world. The position is based in Seattle but will interact with global leaders and teams in Europe, Japan, China, Australia, and other regions.

Join us at the Central Science Team of Amazon's International Seller Services and become part of a global team that is redefining the future of e-commerce. With access to vast amounts of data, emerging technology, and a diverse community of talented individuals, you will have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact on the way sellers engage with our platform and customers worldwide. Together, we will drive innovation, solve complex problems, and shape the future of e-commerce.

Please visit https://www.amazon.science for more information


Key job responsibilities
Apply your expertise in LLM models to design, develop, and implement scalable machine learning solutions that address complex language-related challenges in the international seller services domain.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including software engineers, data scientists, and product managers, to define project requirements, establish success metrics, and deliver high-quality solutions.
Conduct thorough data analysis to gain insights, identify patterns, and drive actionable recommendations that enhance seller performance and customer experiences across various international marketplaces.
Continuously explore and evaluate state-of-the-art NLP techniques and methodologies to improve the accuracy and efficiency of language-related systems.
Communicate complex technical concepts effectively to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, providing clear explanations and guidance on proposed solutions and their potential impact.


A day in the life
Push the boundaries of applied science - fine-tune large language models and develop novel NLP techniques to crack complex challenges in seller acquisition, content generation, and catalog understanding

Work with data at massive scale - tap into some of the richest e-commerce datasets in the world to uncover patterns, generate insights, and drive real business impact

Turn research into reality - prototype bold ideas, then partner with engineers to bring your models into production, balancing scientific rigor with real-world scalability

Think globally, deliver worldwide - collaborate with leaders and teams across Europe, Japan, China, and Australia to build solutions that generalize across international marketplaces

Solve problems that matter - translate ambiguous business challenges into well-scoped science problems that directly serve sellers and customers around the globe

Collaborate with the best - engage in design reviews, contribute to technical thought leadership, and learn from a diverse community of world-class scientists and engineers

Never stop learning - stay at the frontier of NLP, LLMs, and applied ML, bringing the latest research advances into your work

Own your impact - operate with a customer-obsessed mindset where every model you build helps sellers thrive and expands selection for customers worldwide

Basic qualifications

title: ファシリティエンジニア - DCEO（データセンターエンジニアリング・オペレーションズ）
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services はすべての AWS グローバルインフラストラクチャの設計、計画、提供、運用を担当しています。私たちは、クラウドを稼働させ続ける人々です。すべての AWS データセンターとお客様がイノベーションに継続的にアクセスできるようにするすべてのサーバー、ストレージ、ネットワーク、電源、冷却設備をサポートしています。私たちはサプライチェーンに影響を与える数千もの要因を考慮しながら、最も困難な課題に取り組んでいます。そして私たちと共に支援したいと考える優秀な人材を探しています。

ソフトウェア、ハードウェア、ネットワークエンジニア、サプライチェーンスペシャリスト、セキュリティエキスパート、オペレーションマネージャー、その他の重要な役割を担う多様なチームに参加していただきます。AWS 全体の人々と協力して、お客様に最低コストで無限の容量を提供しながら、安全性とセキュリティの最高基準を提供できるよう支援していただきます。そして、大胆なアイデアを歓迎し、それを完成まで自分のものとして進める力を与える包括的な文化を体験していただけます。

Data Center Operationsチームは AWS のバックボーンであり、急速に成長する AWS ビジネスとお客様を 24 時間 365 日サポートしています。私たちは AWS の物理インフラストラクチャを維持し、安全性、セキュリティ、可用性、生産性、容量、効率性、コストの分野における運用パフォーマンスの基準を確保することに取り組んでいます。



Key job responsibilities
主な職務内容

Facility Engineer - Data Center Engineering Operations (DCEO) の役割は、大規模で高密度のデータセンターにおいて、施設（電気/機械システム、制御/消火システムなど）の展開、運用、保守、および関連プロジェクトの管理を担当します。
日常業務では、以下の業務に携わります:
• 建物システムの点検と監視、および施設の問題のトラブルシューティング
• 運用効率の改善とエネルギー削減
• ベンダーやパートナーとの定期メンテナンスと修理の計画と実施。これには、ブレーカー操作、機械/電気設備操作などの重要な施設運用が含まれます
• プロジェクトチームメンバーと協力してテストなどをサポート

勤務時間

12時間のシフト勤務 (うち2時間休憩)など、標準外の時間帯勤務が可能な方（4勤3休のシフトで働ける方。標準勤務時間は 8:00 ～ 20:00、20:00 ～ 8:00、または 9:00 ～ 21:00、21:00 ～ 9:00 です）



About the team
多様な経験

AWS は多様な経験を重視しています。職務内容に記載されているすべての資格やスキルを満たしていなくても、応募することをお勧めします。キャリアが始まったばかりの場合、従来の道を歩んでいない場合、または関連しない経験がある場合でも、応募をためらわないでください。

なぜ AWS なのか?

Amazon Web Services (AWS) は、世界で最も包括的で広く採用されているクラウドプラットフォームです。私たちはクラウドコンピューティングのパイオニアであり、イノベーションを止めることはありません。だからこそ、最も成功しているスタートアップから Global 500 企業まで、幅広いお客様が当社の堅牢な製品・サービスを信頼し、ビジネスを推進しています。

包括的なチーム文化

AWS では、学び、好奇心を持つことが私たちの本質です。従業員主導のアフィニティグループは、私たちが自分たちの違いを誇りに思える包括的な文化を育んでいます。Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) や AmazeCon (ジェンダーダイバーシティ) カンファレンスを含む継続的なイベントや学習体験は、私たちが独自性を受け入れることを決して止めないよう刺激を与えてくれます。

メンターシップとキャリア成長

私たちは、地球上で最高の雇用主になるために、継続的にパフォーマンスバーを引き上げています。だからこそ、ここには、より多角的な専門家に成長するのに役立つ、無限の知識共有、メンターシップ、その他のキャリア向上リソースがあります。

ワークライフバランス

私たちはワークライフハーモニーを重視しています。仕事での成功は、家庭での犠牲を伴うべきではありません。だからこそ、柔軟な勤務時間と勤務体制が私たちの文化の一部となっています。職場と家庭でサポートされていると感じるとき、クラウドで達成できないことは何もありません。

Basic qualifications

- 2+ years of relevant work experience
- Work shifts longer than eight hours in duration
- ミッションクリティカルな設備の運用と保守に関する 2 年以上の関連実務経験（例: 24 時間稼働の工場、変電所、病院など）
- メンテナンス、変更管理、インシデント管理、ベンダー管理の経験または基本的な理解、およびポリシー、プロセス、手順を遵守して作業する方法
- 12時間のシフト勤務 (うち2時間休憩)など、標準外の時間帯勤務が可能な方（4勤3休のシフトで働ける方。標準勤務時間は 8:00 ～ 20:00、20:00 ～ 8:00、または 9:00 ～ 21:00、21:00 ～ 9:00 です）
- 補助機器を使用して18 kg程度の機器を安全に持ち上げて移動できること

Preferred qualifications

- 機械システムに関する高度な理解力（CRAC/CRAH、AHU、チラー、冷却塔、貯蔵タンク、熱交換器、配管システム、ポンプ、バルブ、ダクトシステム、ファン、ダンパー、火災検知・消火システム、排水システム、ビル監視システム、自動制御システム）

descriptionHtml:

title: Associate Corporate Counsel, AWS Legal
descriptionHtml:
Amazon's Legal Department is looking for a talented attorney to support Amazon Web Services (AWS). AWS is at the forefront of the cloud computing industry, providing IT infrastructure services such as on-demand compute capacity, storage, content delivery, database services, and more. AWS also offers a comprehensive suite of artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) services, infrastructure, and tools to help users build, train, and deploy AI models.

Key job responsibilities
This Associate Corporate Counsel will be based in Singapore and will primarily support AWS’s Sales and Marketing activities across ASEAN and the broader Asia-Pacific region.

A day in the life
You will negotiate strategic enterprise agreements with a focus on ASEAN customers and resellers, provide compliance training and awareness, handle pre-litigation disputes and inquiries, assist with responses to bid proposals/tenders, and work proactively on regulatory and policy matters. Typical transactions will range from enterprise contracts to complex, high-dollar-value strategic procurement vehicles. International travel may be required.

We don’t expect you to have experience in data centers or cloud computing, and we are looking for candidates who are eager to learn and develop as part of our team. Basic qualifications

- Experience in transactional work, including drafting and negotiating commercial contracts or equivalent
- Law degree from a reputable university or college.
- Admitted to practice law with 2 - 6 years of post-admission legal experience.
- Strong written and oral communication skills with the ability to summarize complex issues and ideas clearly and concisely.
- Efficient organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects at once, follow through, and meet deadlines using pragmatic judgment.
- Ability to work independently and proactively, while also collaborating effectively with other legal team members and global business teams.
- Creative analytical skills.

Preferred qualifications

- In-house experience at a technology company or in a private practice technology group.
- Familiarity with IT infrastructure, outsourcing, telecommunications, cloud computing, AI/ML, or consulting contracts
- Knowledge of ASEAN laws and regulations and experience working with public policy stakeholders.
- Experience working across multiple APJ jurisdictions
- Working knowledge and capability in other ASEAN country languages (e.g. Vietnamese, Bahasa Indonesia, Bahasa Melayu, Thai or Tagalog) preferred but not required.

title: Manager III, Solutions Architecture, EMEA Cloud Sales Center Technology
descriptionHtml:
Do you want to shape how customers across EMEA adopt AI and cloud technology? Amazon Web Services (AWS) is looking for an experienced technical manager to coach, grow, and partner with a team of customer-facing Solutions Architects. You will enable your team to design and present cloud architectures of varying size and complexity, coach them on solution selling and presentation skills, and help them develop into well-rounded technical professionals.

As customers accelerate their AI and cloud transformations, this role sits at the intersection of people development and customer impact. In collaboration with Sales, Business Development, and Partner teams, you will drive revenue growth and ensure customers receive architectures that solve real business challenges. If you are motivated by growing talent while helping customers succeed, we want to hear from you.

Key job responsibilities
- Coach and develop a team of Solutions Architects on best practices for solution design, AI workloads, and cloud migration, enabling them to deliver high-quality customer engagements across EMEA.
- Partner with Sales, Business Development, and Partner teams to drive revenue growth by aligning architectural recommendations to customer business outcomes.
- Manage stakeholder relationships across customers, partners, and internal teams, ensuring clear communication of technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
- Hire, onboard, and train new Solutions Architects, building a structured ramp plan that accelerates their readiness and long-term career growth.
- Define team goals, track progress through operational metrics, and prioritize work across projects to balance short-term customer needs with longer-term strategic initiatives.

A day in the life
You start the morning reviewing your team's upcoming customer engagements and preparing coaching notes for a Solutions Architect presenting a migration architecture later that day. Mid-morning you join a call with a Sales counterpart to align on an AI opportunity for a key account. After lunch you run a one-on-one with a newer team member, discussing their development plan and reviewing a whitepaper draft they are writing. The afternoon wraps with a cross-functional planning session where you help prioritize next quarter's initiatives alongside Business Development and Partner leads.

About the team
Our Solutions Architecture team within AWS helps customers across EMEA transform their businesses using AI and cloud technology. We work closely with Sales, Business Development, Partners, and Service Engineering to ensure every customer engagement delivers lasting value. The team is focused on growing early-career and experienced architects alike, creating an inclusive environment where builders learn from each other and advance quickly. If you are excited about coaching technical talent while shaping how organizations adopt the cloud, this is the team for you.

Basic qualifications

- Experience leading and growing teams of senior technology professionals, ideally in customer facing roles
- Experience with enterprise IT application work that includes software development or DevOps engineering
- Experience architecting/operating solutions built on any cloud service provider like Azure, AWS, GCP, OCI, etc.
- Experience developing technology solutions and evangelising end-to-end technology roadmaps that guide IT transformations toward cloud computing
- Bachelor's degree

Preferred qualifications

- Experience architecting, migrating, transforming or modernizing customer requirements to the cloud
- Speak, write, and read fluently in French, Spanish, German or Italian

title: Lead Associate
descriptionHtml:
This site will be co-located with SAZ2.

This role requires open availability seven days a week, and flexibility to work at various sites within 10 miles of the primary Operations site in the Tolleson metro area (as needed).

Join our dedicated team and contribute to a dynamic culture based on customer obsession, trust, respect, integrity, continuous learning, and fun. As a Lead Associate, you’ll be at the core of our fastest delivery operation, enhancing customer shopping experience. The ideal candidate possesses strong attention to detail, efficiently prioritizes tasks, demonstrates a willingness to learn, and maintains a commitment to delighting our customers.

What it’s like at our site(s):
1. Safety. Your safety is important to us, so we provide safe working conditions.
2. Surroundings. You'll be working in retail warehouse environment with various equipment– shopping carts, pallet jacks, stock dollies, and a variety of products, including food and alcoholic beverages. You'll also interact with our digital shopping technology.
3. Activity. Work involves frequent movement between different areas, standing while conducting most tasks, and some lifting. You may need to reach into coolers or freezers.
4. Noise level. Sound levels are minimal, what one would expect in a retail warehouse environment.
5. Dress code. Relaxed, with a few rules to follow for safety. Comfortable, slip-resistant, closed-toe shoes are also required for safety. Additional protective and visibility gear may be required.
6. New site opening: If you’re applying to a site that hasn’t opened yet, you’ll help prepare the team for its first customer orders. This may include tasks like setting up shelving and unloading product deliveries. You’ll also have an extended training and onboarding period, which may be at a nearby Amazon site.


Key job responsibilities
- Support, motivate, and model desired behavior for the rest of the team
- Manage operational processes, safety, quality, performance, and customer delivery promises following the Regional Area Manager guidance, and act as their main support at your assigned site
- Maintain a clean, sanitary, safe, and organized workspace
- Provide ongoing training in areas including system and equipment knowledge, quality training, general operations, and assist Regional Area Manager in identifying training needs
- Provide feedback on processes and standards, serving as the escalation point to assist associates and peers in solving issues where appropriate, training, deploying labor, and ensuring the team takes required breaks and lunches
- Maintain a key to the site, and open and close following the proper procedures.
- Handle a wide assortment of products including produce, meat, seafood, and alcoholic beverages
- Receive truck deliveries
- Collaborate with both associates and delivery partners to ensure smooth operations and excellent customer service
- Participate in associate onboarding as required
- Ensure consistent execution of product workflow processes, guiding associates as needed including receiving, stocking, replenishing product, and preparing for delivery
- Perform front-line duties whenever necessary
- Contribute to continuous improvement of customer experience and operations by participating in the development of best practices and continuous product knowledge
- Utilize inventory management systems to scan, process, and count product
- Perform additional duties as assigned
You’ll also need to be:
- At least 18 years old, and authorized to work in the United States
- Able to lift up to 49 pounds, stand/walk during shifts lasting up to 12 hours, and be able to frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach
- Able to use carts, dollies, hand trucks, and other gear to move items around
- Able to go up and down stairs (where applicable)
- Available to work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays
- On site for the entirety of your shift

Basic qualifications

- 1+ years of Microsoft Office products and applications experience
- High school or equivalent
- Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays
- Can lift up to 49 pounds, stand/walk during shifts lasting up to 12 hours, and be able to frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach
- Work 40 hours/week, and overtime as required

Preferred qualifications

- 2+ years of production, warehouse or other leadership, or 1+ years of Amazon experience
- Experience managing inventory in a retail or distribution setting
- Prior experience in training others
- Strong verbal communication and customer service skills
- Previous experience in providing peer-to-peer feedback
- Demonstrated success in problem solving and delivering results

title: RME Automation Engineer, Reliability Maintenance Engineering
descriptionHtml:
Amazon is seeking an experienced Automation Engineer to join our Reliability Maintenance Engineering (RME) team at IST2 Fulfillment Center in Istanbul. As we expand our capacity to 350,000 units with advanced automation systems including tote sorters, Ambaflex spirals, and extensive conveyor networks, you'll play a critical role in maintaining and optimizing our automated material handling systems. This is an exciting opportunity to work with cutting-edge technology in one of the world's largest e-commerce operations, ensuring24/7 uptime and reliability of mission-critical automation systems.

Key job responsibilities

Troubleshoot and repair automated material handling equipment including tote sorters, conveyors, Ambaflex spirals, and sortation systems
Program, maintain, and optimize Programmable Logic Controllers (PLCs) including Allen Bradley, Siemens, and other industrial control systems
Monitor and maintain SCADA systems, HMIs, and building management systems
Perform root cause analysis on automation failures and implement corrective actions to prevent recurrence
Respond to emergency breakdowns and provide technical support for automation systems across all shifts
Collaborate with Controls Engineering, Operations, and RME teams to implement automation improvements
Develop and maintain documentation including electrical schematics, PLC programs, and standard operating procedures
Lead automation projects including system upgrades, installations, and commissioning of new equipment
Train and mentor technicians on automation systems, troubleshooting techniques, and safety protocols
Ensure compliance with electrical codes, safety standards, and Amazon's maintenance best practices


A day in the life
As an Automation Engineer at IST2, you'll start your day reviewing system performance metrics and automation issues. You'll work closely with shift RME teams to prioritize critical repairs, troubleshoot PLC faults on the tote sorter, and optimize conveyor flow rates. You'll spend time on the floor diagnosing sensor failures, updating ladder logic programs, and collaborating with Operations to minimize downtime. Your internal stakeholders include RME Managers, Area Managers, Shift Supervisors, and the Maintenance Planning team. You'll solve complex problems ranging from intermittent control system faults to full system integrations, ensuring our customers receive their orders on time through reliable automation performance.

About the team
The IST2 RME team consists of 20 dedicated professionals responsible for maintaining a 350,000-unit capacity fulfillment center with advanced automation systems. Our mission is to deliver world-class reliability through proactive maintenance, continuous improvement, and technical excellence. We foster a culture of safety, innovation, and collaboration where every team member's expertise is valued. As the first dedicated Automation Engineer at IST2, you'll have the opportunity to build automation standards, mentor technicians, and shape the future of our maintenance operations during this exciting expansion phase.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Electrical-Electronical Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering, Automation Engineering, or related technical field with bachelor degree.
- 2+ years of experience programming and troubleshooting PLCs (Siemens, or equivalent platforms)
- Experience with automated material handling equipment, conveyor systems, or sortation systems
- Knowledge of electrical systems including3-phase power, motor controls, VFDs, and industrial sensors
- Ability to read and interpret electrical schematics, P&IDs, and control system documentation
- Proficiency in English for technical communication and documentation

Preferred qualifications

- Advanced PLC programming skills including structured text, function blocks, and HMI development
- Experience with SCADA systems, industrial networks (Ethernet/IP, Profinet, DeviceNet), and building automation systems
- Familiarity with automated material handling systems (conveyors, sorters, pack machines, robotic systems)
- Lean Manufacturing, or TPM (Total Productive Maintenance) certification
- Experience leading automation projects including system design, installation, and commissioning
- Knowledge of safety systems including light curtains, safety PLCs, and machine guarding standards
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with experience using data to drive maintenance decisions
- Ability to work flexible hours including on-call support for critical automation issues
- Turkish and English language proficiency

title: EU Area Manager (Night Shift) - Fixed Term Contract, EU Central Ops - Risk and Flow
descriptionHtml:
*This is a Fixed Term Contract role

The goal of Amazon Logistics is to build a world class last mile delivery operation. Amazon aims to exceed the expectations of our customers by ensuring that their orders are delivered quickly, accurately, and in the most cost effective way possible.

As a EU CO Night Shift Area Manager, you will lead a team of Managers and Logistics Associates to drive performance on day to day operations and projects for EU CO. Your role will be to focus on key KPIs in terms of forecast accuracy and process adherance/improvement playing a key role in deliverables to both our Delivery Station and Delivery Service Partner Management team.

This position offers an exciting opportunity to make history and become a member of a team whose purpose is to solve complex challenges and create unprecedented customer experiences. We’re looking for creative leaders with a passion for innovation, knack for problem solving, and dedication to creating world-class customer experiences.

You will be be accountable for daily, weekly and monthly KPIs and metrics. You will be responsible for driving program scoping, roll out and compliance/monitoring and stakeholder experience. In addition, you will be instrumental in developing best practices and standard work for the network.

You will play a proactive role in written and verbal communication with various departments, as you maintain Amazon’s exceptionally high levels of service, both for our customers and suppliers, facilitating the flow of information between different stakeholders and resolving any potential issues that impact business continuity. We need you to step back at strategic intervals to take in the bigger picture and to be comfortable conducting research into process improvement initiatives and taking real-time decisions. You will also maintain and report up to date and accurate statistics, management reports and analysis.

Key job responsibilities
Managing daily operations of the team, ensuring all the required tasks are executed on time, adhering to the standard practices.
Monitor and report on daily and weekly performances. Deep dive on trends, identify the gaps in performance metrics and take corrective actions.
Execute best practices that improve customer, cost, and delivery partner outcomes· Develop processes and systems to achieve metrics, often requiring scrappy solutions to temporarily overcome technical limitations. The ability to scale will be critical to all processes.
Create and drive scalable standard work that enables remote support of a complex business area.
Proactively identify and lead process improvement initiatives though quantitative analysis and data-driven decision making.
Create, manage, support recognition and communication programs for scheduling team.

A day in the life
As Area Managers, you will lead the Night Shift team in Central Operations, overseeing Sorting and Flow Management tasks. You will ensure that teams of Shift Managers and Schedulers deploy the latest forecast updates, container plan optimization, and risk mitigations for the entire EU network on a daily basis. You must guarantee execution excellence, accurate reporting, and continuous process improvements in operations.

About the team

Central Operations (CO) refers to a new approach within Amazon Logistics (AMZL) to define a scalable solution to run the increasingly complex and growing last mile delivery network. CO is a key strategic initiative with a vision to transform the way AMZL executes forecasting, route planning, demand scheduling and last mile delivery. - Experience in people management
- Experience communicating with a wide range of stakeholders, including your peers and leadership

- Experience in a logistics/operations environment

title: Sr. Technical Program Manager, AWS Product Compliance Engineering
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is looking for an experienced Sr. Technical Program Manager who will be responsible for providing global product compliance technical program management and leadership to ensure that all electrical, mechanical, material, and other regulated performance specifications are satisfied in all countries where AWS business exists or will expand.

AWS is at the forefront of providing a broad set of global cloud-based services including compute, storage, databases, networking, and enterprise applications, to help organizations move faster, lower IT costs, and scale. You will be a part of a dynamic business within Amazon.com, and one of the world’s fastest growing and evolving companies, with a team of exceptionally talented, bright and innovative people. GTPC is responsible for ensuring that the infrastructure equipment necessary to support the AWS services are developed, imported, exported, and operated in a compliant manner across the global countries where AWS operates and will expand, including all product certification/safety regulations.


Key job responsibilities
You will be part of the AWS Product Compliance Engineering team within AWS Global Trade and Regulatory Compliance team (GTPC) that collaborates with Datacenter Engineering, Product Engineering, Compliance Engineers, Regulatory Analyst, legal, trade strategy, and supply chain to implement compliance specifications and policies, provide product compliance support during product development, builds compliance programs to support AWS Datacenter Engineering, Design Engineering, Power Generations, Advanced Robotics, Region Service Business, and Health & Safety businesses including Datacenter Basis of Design (BOD) lifecycle management, hardware technology development and deployment, new region planning and launches. You will develop compliance specification and plan, troubleshoot and resolve compliance issues that arise in the course of AWS’s NPI and other business processes.

Key job responsibilities

• End-to-end compliance program ownership for AWS datacenter infrastructure equipment — including compute, storage, networking, security hardware, power and cooling infrastructure, and advanced robotics — ensuring all products meet applicable safety, electromagnetic compatibility (EMC), security, energy efficiency, and material compliance requirements and approvals across global jurisdictions.
• Drive compliance specification development and execution for new and existing infrastructure products, defining compliance requirements, test plans, certification timelines, and acceptance criteria.
• Own the compliance critical path and overall strategy for AWS hardware deployments, proactively identifying risks, resolving blockers, and ensuring compliance milestones are met to support on-time regional launches.

title: Transportation Representative, AmazonNowCO, RoW APEX
descriptionHtml:
Job Description for Transportation Representative – NOC
NOC Overview

NOC (Network Operation Center) is the central command and control center for ‘Transportation Execution’ across the Amazon Supply Chain network supporting multiple geographies like NA, India and EU. It ensures hassle free, timely pick-up and delivery of freight from vendors to Amazon fulfillment centers (FC) and from Amazon FCs to carrier hubs. In case of any exceptions, NOC steps in to resolve the issue and keeps all the stakeholders informed on the proceedings. Along with this tactical problem solving NOC is also charged with understanding trends in network exceptions and then automating processes or proposing process changes to streamline operations. This second aspect involves network monitoring and significant analysis of network data.
Overall, NOC plays a critical role in ensuring the smooth functioning of Amazon transportation and thereby has a direct impact on Amazon’s ability to serve its customers on time.

Purview of a Trans Ops Representative:
A Trans Ops Representative at NOC facilitates flow of information between different stakeholders (Trans Carriers/Hubs/Warehouses) and resolves any potential issues that impacts customer experience and business continuity. Trans Ops Specialist at NOC works across two verticals – Inbound and Outbound operations.
Inbound Operations deals with Vendor/Carrier/FC relationship, ensuring that the freight is picked-up on time and is delivered at FC as per the given appointment. Trans Ops Specialist on Inbound addresses any potential issues occurring during the lifecycle of pick-up to delivery.
Outbound Operations deals with FC/Carrier/Carrier Hub relationship, ensuring that the truck leaves the FC in order to delivery customer orders as per promise. Trans Ops Specialist on Outbound addresses any potential issues occurring during the lifecycle of freight leaving the FC and reaching customer premises.

A Trans Ops Representative provides timely resolution to the issue in hand by researching and querying internal tools and by taking real-time decisions. An ideal candidate should be able to understand the requirements/be able to analyze data and notice trends and be able to drive Customer Experience without compromising on time. The candidate should have the basic understanding of Logistics and should be able to communicate clearly in the written and oral form.

Key job responsibilities
Trans Ops Representative should be able to ideate process improvements and should have the zeal to drive them to conclusion.
Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

· Communication with external customers (Carriers, Vendors/Suppliers) and internal customers (Retail, Finance, Software Support, Fulfillment Centers)
· Must be able to systematically escalate problems or variance in the information and data to the relevant owners and teams and follow through on the resolutions to ensure they are delivered.
· Excellent communication, both verbal and written as one may be required to create a narrative outlining weekly findings and the variances to goals, and present these finding in a review forum.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- Experience managing and or coordinating projects in a fast pace environment
- Experience in Excel with advanced proficiency (pivots, lookups, etc.)

- Master's degree or equivalent in operations research, applied mathematics, theoretical computer science, or equivalent, or a Master's degree and experience working for Amazon or any Amazon subsidiary or affiliate
