* Stand/walk for up to 12 hours during shifts
* Work in an environment where the noise level varies and can be loud
* Work in an environment that is subject to variable temperatures and weather (delivery stations include outside loading departments)
* Continuously climb and descend stairs (applies to sites with stairs)

Our fulfillment network launches new Operations sites every year, providing various opportunities for your professional growth. We hire Area Managers based on location preference and the business’ current openings.

Basic qualifications

- 2+ years of employee and performance management experience
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent, or 2+ years of Amazon (blue badge/FTE) experience
- Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays

- 1+ years of performance metrics, process improvement or lean techniques experience
- Experience managing a team of 20+ employees
- Experience with process improvements (Lean process, Kaizen, and/or Six Sigma)

descriptionHtml:
Amazon Robotics is seeking an exceptional Applied Scientist to join our Foundation Models and Agentic AI team. This role presents an opportunity to shape the future of robotics through innovative applications of large vision-language-action (VLA) models, reasoning and task planning models, and reinforcement learning.

At Amazon Robotics, we leverage advanced robotics, machine learning, and artificial intelligence to solve complex operational challenges at unprecedented scale. Our fleet of robots operates across hundreds of facilities worldwide, working in sophisticated coordination to fulfill our mission of customer excellence.

We are pioneering the development of robotics foundation models that:

- Enable unprecedented generalization across diverse tasks
- Integrate multi-modal learning capabilities (visual, depth, force, tactile, linguistic)
- Accelerate policy skill acquisition through imitation learning and reinforcement learning
- Enhance robotic perception and environmental understanding
- Streamline development processes through reusable capabilities

The ideal candidate will contribute to research that bridges the gap between theoretical advancement and practical implementation in robotics. You will be part of a team that's revolutionizing how robots learn, adapt, and interact with their environment.

Key job responsibilities

- Data Management: Process and prepare training data, including data governance, provenance tracking, data quality checks and creating reusable data pipelines.

descriptionHtml:
About Maintenance at Amazon

Operations is at the heart of Amazon’s business. We are known for our speed, accuracy, and exceptional service. Our buildings deliver tens of thousands of products to hundreds of countries worldwide, every day. Reliability Maintenance & Engineering (RME) are the business partners that work tirelessly behind the scenes to make it all happen. We drive continuous improvement and maintain all of the Robotics and Material Handling Equipment (MHE) to ensure our customers are met with the Amazon smile. Come join us on our journey!

About the Role

As a Mechatronics & Robotics Technician, you will use your skills to support the Operations Maintenance team in repairing and maintaining material handling equipment and pneumatic systems throughout the building. You will have the opportunity to install, maintain, and repair automated packaging and distribution equipment. In addition to developing your skills, you will mentor junior technicians to grow in their roles.

What Do We Offer?

Amazon offers competitive compensation packages including comprehensive healthcare benefits starting on Day 1, matching 401(k) program, and up to 20 weeks of paid parental leave. But wait, there is more: We provide lightweight fire-resistant daily wear and composite toe safety shoes for your safety!

Here is what you can expect with the Reliability & Maintenance Engineering (RME) selection process for Mechatronics & Robotics Technicians: (Timeframe: Approximately 30-days)

Step 2: Amazon Recruiting will review your application and invite the most qualified candidate to complete a pre-employment assessment.

Step 3: If you meet the role qualifications, you will receive an invitation from Amazon Recruiting (do-not-reply@criteriacorp.com) to begin your Criteria assessment. You have 5 days to complete.

Step 4: Once you successfully meet the pre-employment assessment requirements, you will be invited to complete a video interview. Your video interview invitation will be from HireVue (interviews@hirevue.com) and you will have 7 days to record your interview.

Key job responsibilities

- You will promote a safe working environment by following all safety procedures

title: Antenna & RF Engineer, Amazon Leo
descriptionHtml:
Amazon LEO is an initiative to increase global broadband access through a constellation of 3,236 satellites in low Earth orbit (LEO). Its mission is to bring fast, affordable broadband to unserved and underserved communities around the world. Amazon LEO will help close the digital divide by delivering fast, affordable broadband to a wide range of customers, including consumers, businesses, government agencies, and other organizations operating in places without reliable connectivity.

As an Antenna Engineer, you will design, integrate, and characterize antennas and arrays across multiple domains (phased arrays, reflectors, aperture antennas, and other relevant topologies).

You’ll split your time between EM design tools, RF system analysis, and lab validation, working on high volume antenna design from concept to deployment.

- Support prototype builds, bring-up, and test campaigns for active antennas, including chamber testing and over-the-air validation.
- Provide DFM and DFT feedback for antenna boards, modules, and test fixtures.
- Write design reports, test summaries, and present results to leadership and cross-functional partners.
- Develop and deploy code to support testing, simulation, and validation of antenna systems.

Export Control Requirement
Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering or equivalent
- Coursework in RF and electromagnetics

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree in electrical engineering or equivalent
- 1-2 years Internship or professional experience in RF and/or electromagnetics

title: Robotics Systems Engineer I, Robotics Delivery & Packaging Innovations (RDPI) Technology Deployment
descriptionHtml:
Join Amazon's Robotics Delivery & Packaging Innovations (RDPI) Technology Deployment team within Amazon Robotics (AR) organization to deploy innovative industrial robotics across North America's fulfillment network. In RDPI, we have the unique role and privilege of deploying leading edge industrial robotics and customer fulfillment technologies across the North America Stores operations. We raise the bar on the speed, quality and cost of deploying industrial technologies at scale across North America, functioning as the field team who plan, execute and launch the technologies that our internal design and product strategy partners in RDPI develop.

As a Systems Engineer in RDPI, you will be overseeing large scale project planning, installation, and launch of industrial automation technologies across Amazons growing Stores network. This field engineering position demands strong technical skills for deploying robotic equipment, including mechanical and electrical systems, network configurations, and software coordination. The ideal candidate has experience with complex electro-mechanical and network systems, large scale installations, and system troubleshooting. You will work with cross-functional partners across the Amazon Fulfillment Technology & Robotics engineering, safety, product strategy, software, supply chain, third-party installers, contracted deployment engineers, construction teams, and internal operations customer teams, functioning as the lead on-site project manager to provide technical oversight on installation Amazon-designed automation equipment. This Systems Engineer position is an individual contributor role, influencing and leading stakeholders from planning through go-live of each project. Project durations vary from a few days to several months each. This is a travel-based role and you will be expected to travel to meet the requirements of your projects across North America, upwards of 75% or more.

**Relocation to Amazon Corporate offices in Seattle, Boston, or Austin will be required for the role.

Key job responsibilities
As a Systems Engineer I, you will work with a team of 1-5 engineers and collaborate with an on-site project manager to provide technical oversight on the installation of both third party and Amazon designed robotics equipment that may be in various phases of the product life cycle. These deployments require extensive collaboration with various stakeholders, including third-party installers, contracted engineers, construction, hardware, software, IT, and other partner teams. Strong communication skills are essential for interacting with both internal and external partners and customers. As an Amazonian, you must demonstrate independent initiative to identify and solve problems in real time during deployments. A strong technical understanding, love for field work, and a keen interest in diving deep into the understanding of Amazon’s robotics systems are key attributes for this role.

- You will support and guide installation of robotics, packaging and sortation technologies at Amazon fulfillment centers
- You will develop detailed knowledge of the operation of robotic systems and guide installation, commissioning, and troubleshooting of these systems both on site and remotely
- You will manage technical ambiguity around integration of work cells in fulfillment centers
- You will collaborate with hardware engineering, technical program managers, product managers, and internal customers including site maintenance and operations teams
- You will travel to project sites and collaborate both virtually and in person to ensure all business stakeholders are aligned on program status
- You will manage day to day project scheduling and budget management
- You will work on continuous improvement activities to improve the projects in your space
- You will generate and implement continuous improvement ideas around work-scopes
- You will lead teams of other engineers on projects
- You will travel to both live warehouses and new construction sites, the scopes may vary significantly in length and include heavy travel
- You will travel to project sites across North America, upwards of 75% or more

A day in the life
In this role you will be focused on execution of end-to-end deployment and manage technical ambiguity around integration of workcells in fulfillment centers. On a daily basis you will collaborate with hardware engineering, technical program managers, product managers, construction teams, and internal customers including site maintenance and operations teams, to ensure a safe, on time, high quality product is delivered to the internal customer. You will travel to your project sites, collaborate both virtually and in person, to ensure all business stakeholders are aligned on program status. You will manage the day-to-day project execution, and work on continuous improvement activities to improve deployment execution first pass yield. You will work with senior engineers and your manager to develop technical depth and begin building strategic thinking skills for future growth.

Amazon offers a full range of benefits that support you and eligible family members, including domestic partners and their children. Benefits can vary by location, the number of regularly scheduled hours you work, length of employment, and job status such as seasonal or temporary employment. The benefits that generally apply to regular, full-time employees include:

1. Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage
2. Maternity and Parental Leave Options
3. Paid Time Off (PTO)
4. 401(k) Plan

If you are not sure that every qualification on the list above describes you exactly, we'd still love to hear from you! At Amazon, we value people with unique backgrounds, experiences, and skillsets. If you’re passionate about this role and want to make an impact on a global scale, please apply!

About the team
Are you inspired by invention? Is problem solving through teamwork in your DNA? Do you like the idea of seeing how your work impacts the bigger picture? Answer yes to any of these and you’ll fit right in here at Robotics Delivery & Packaging Innovation (RDPI) within Amazon Robotics (AR). We are a smart, collaborative team of enthusiastic doers that work passionately to apply innovative advances in robotics and software to solve real-world challenges that will transform our customers’ experiences in ways we can’t even image yet. We invent new improvements every day. We are RDPI and we will give you the tools and support you need to invent with us in ways that are rewarding, fulfilling and fun

The team is multi-disciplinary, and consists of Field Deployment Engineers, Controls Engineering, Design for Deployment, Product Single Threaded Leaders, and a Program Management Office team, who collaborate on enabling the delivery of new technologies and packaging solutions that delight our customers, and improve the safety, quality and costs within the Amazon fulfillment processes. title: Area Manager II
descriptionHtml:
Our WW Operations network delivers millions of packages and smiles to Amazon customers every day. We are looking for motivated, customer-focused individuals who want to join our team as an Area Manager. In this role, you will lead a team of hourly workforce and will be responsible for engaging your team during their shifts to maintain the highest levels of safety, quality, attendance, and performance. You will also play a key role in maintaining our customer expectations to ensure customer orders are delivered at the right time, to the right location.

Our Operation’s workflow has three major components: First mile - where the product is housed and ready for order; Middle mile - where the order is hauled to your area; and Last mile - when the product is delivered to the customer’s door. Please note that all workflows have slight building variations, but one thing is constant: our vision and dedication to the customer.

Key job responsibilities
* Support, mentor, and motivate your hourly workforce
* Manage safety, quality, productivity, and customer delivery promises
* Collaborate with all support teams including Safety, Engineering, Loss Prevention, Quality Assurance, Human Resources to develop plans to meet business objectives
* Lift up to 49 pounds and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach
* Stand/walk for up to 12 hours during shifts
* Work in an environment where the noise level varies and can be loud
* Work in an environment that is subject to variable temperatures and weather (delivery stations include outside loading departments)
* Continuously climb and descend stairs (applies to sites with stairs)

Our fulfillment network launches new Operations sites every year, providing various opportunities for your professional growth. We hire Area Managers based on location preference and the business’ current openings.

Basic qualifications

- 2+ years of employee and performance management experience
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent, or 2+ years of Amazon (blue badge/FTE) experience
- Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays

Preferred qualifications

title: Strategic Account Manager, US Global Selling Team
descriptionHtml:
We are seeking a candidate with a passion for e-commerce and a desire to make a real impact on global customers in a Day One business. Our mission is to expand selection from US-based retailers and brand owners worldwide. Although we are already a multi-billion-dollar business, we believe we are just getting started, as less than 5% of US-based sellers have started their international journey. This role offers the opportunity to innovate and elevate the seller and customer experience on a global scale.
As a Strategic Account Manager on the Amazon Global Selling team, you will work with top Amazon.com sellers, helping them expand their online retail business to Amazon's stores worldwide. You will work with sellers leadership teams, identifying key decision-makers and aligning them to prioritize actions required to expand their online retail business to Amazon's global stores such as Amazon.co.uk, Amazon.de, Amazon.com.mx. You will build and cultivate strong relationships with sellers in your portfolio and be a trusted e-commerce and global sales advisor to the leadership in seller organizations. You will partner with external service providers to help your sellers obtain the required tax and product-level compliance certifications for selling in new markets. You will be comfortable with long sales cycles, often lasting more than 8 months, taking sellers through step-by-step processes to launch in a new market. Success in this role will be evaluated based on the scale of the sellers you manage, the number of new markets into which you help your sellers expand, unique selection additions in global markets, and the global sales revenue you drive from sellers in your portfolio. You will utilize a wide range of sales and negotiation skills and work across cross-functional areas to drive the performance of sellers in your portfolio.
In addition to your day-to-day role working with sellers, you will also contribute to business development and identify the correct input metrics that drive business growth for sellers in Amazon's global stores. You will use customer feedback, market growth trends, competitive best practices, and Gen AI developments to suggest new features required in our products and promotional programs to accelerate seller growth or improve the selling partner experience.
Ideal candidates will thrive in an ambiguous and dynamic environment where they must develop, evolve, and implement business strategies to deliver results, have relentlessly high standards, and operate as business owners with end-to-end responsibility to deliver business growth.

The Amazon Global Selling team's vision is to be the first choice for all US retail businesses to go global. title: Cloud Hardware Development Engineer - Manufacturing Test Engineering, Annapurna Labs, Manufacturing Test Engineering
descriptionHtml:
Shape the future of AI infrastructure! Join AWS as we scale our Manufacturing Test Engineering team developing comprehensive testing solutions for our innovative AI acceleration hardware, deployed across our global server fleet. Annapurna Labs (our organization within AWS) designs hardware and software that accelerates innovation. Our custom chips, accelerators, and software stacks enable breakthrough performance in cloud computing, helping customers solve previously impossible challenges.

We're expanding our AI Hardware Test Organization and seeking a Manufacturing Test Engineer to develop, deploy and sustain the tests that qualify the boards, sleds and systems inside our machine learning training systems. In this role you will own test development for assigned products and test insertions — writing test plans, building automated test suites, validating them against known-good and known-bad units, and deploying them to our manufacturing partners. You will work alongside hardware designers, software engineers, and manufacturing operations throughout the product development cycle, and you will own your tests once they are running on the line: triaging failures, closing coverage gaps, and keeping stations healthy at multiple sites.

Our training systems are built from several kinds of hardware — accelerator baseboards, switching and interconnect sleds, trays, and complete racks — and your assignment will follow the program's needs rather than a single fixed product. What stays constant is the work itself: taking a new or changed design through test development, proving the test catches real defects, and keeping it healthy once a factory is running it at volume.

The ideal candidate pairs a solid understanding of computer systems — host software, firmware, buses and the high-speed interfaces between them, and the board underneath all of it — with solid programming ability, hands-on hardware debug skill and a dedication to quality. You are comfortable driving a board or system under real workload rather than only measuring it, and you want to see your test catch a defect before a customer does.

Key job responsibilities
- Develop and execute test plans for boards, sleds, trays and systems — from prototype through high-volume production
- Own the functional test content for your assigned products: device and interface enumeration, bring-up, and stability under sustained load
- Design and build automated test suites and station software using Python, C/C++ and shell scripting
- Deploy your tests into high-volume manufacturing and sustain them once deployed, including remote triage of station and test failures at partner sites
- Drive system-level and workload-based functional testing across hardware, firmware and software integration
- Debug failures across the hardware/firmware boundary and perform failure analysis to physical root cause
- Validate new and changed tests against known-good and known-bad units, and correlate testers before release to production
- Analyze test and yield data to identify coverage gaps, and own the corrective action that closes them
- Partner with our contract manufacturers and ODM functional teams to implement test solutions and scale them across sites
- Maintain clear test documentation and procedures for manufacturing teams

A day in the life
Work/Life Balance — We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there's nothing we can't achieve in the cloud.

Mentorship and Career Growth — We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

About the team
Annapurna Labs is a wholly owned subsidiary of AWS, focused on developing custom silicon and servers including the Nitro, Graviton, Inferentia, and Trainium families of processors. Machine Learning Annapurna (MLA) functions as a vertically integrated team including software, firmware, hardware, and silicon design in a single organization. We are the Training Servers and Systems organization under MLA, focused on Hardware Development, Software Development, Fleet Ops Systems, and Manufacturing, Quality, and Reliability. This position is in the Manufacturing Test Engineering team.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering or a related field
- 3+ years of integration, testing and automation experience
- Experience building test automation frameworks and tools
- Experience with any programming language such as Python, Java, C++
- Experience in a Linux or Unix environment
- Experience with general troubleshooting/debugging of hardware
- Experience in manufacturing, process, or industrial engineering

Preferred qualifications

- Knowledge of computer hardware components and operating systems
- Experience programmatically testing products, measuring test coverage, developing the best automation, driving testability and diagnostic
- Experience in gathering test requirements to create detailed test plans and defining quality metrics to measure product quality
- Experience collecting, analyzing, and utilizing data to drive process and system improvements
- Experience with performance and stress testing methods and frameworks
- Experience developing functional, workload-based or system-level tests for boards, servers or systems in production
- Experience in high-volume manufacturing operations, including test insertions, yield and first-pass-yield, DPPM or escape-rate metrics
- Experience working with contract manufacturers or ODMs to deploy and sustain test solutions
- Experience in hardware design and validation of components, subsystems and systems, including signal-integrity and high-speed digital work

Key job responsibilities

Operations Managerは、大きな組織をリードしリージョンやネットワークの取り組みを実行する次のSite LeaderまたはSenior Operations Managerへと成長することが期待されます。また、Supply Chain、Transportation、およびLogisticsなどAmazon のオペレーションのあらゆるOpportunityを模索することもできます。

descriptionHtml:
In Germany (DE), there are two sites supporting Customer Services (CS) and, with your help, we will leverage HR best practices, standardize strategy and processes, and ensure a great employee experience for our CS population across the DE network.
We are looking to hire a talented and committed Senior HR Business Partner who has the ability to lead by example, demonstrate hustle, resolve issues at multiple levels, and act strategically with the utmost integrity. Our mission is to take good care of our internal customers (our employees), so they can take good care of our Amazon customers! This role will support and shape the HR and employee relations agenda across DE Customer Services, including works council engagement and partnership. Strong communication, influencing and interpersonal skills are essential to develop and deliver a robust people strategy. The position supports the DE CS network and is based in Berlin.
The Senior HRBP will partner with the wider business (Operations, ER, and Legal) to understand planned organizational changes and develop plans to address those needs, and will work closely with senior leadership teams and the wider HR operations team to drive employee engagement and manage change.

title: Systems Dev Engineer, European Sovereign Cloud
descriptionHtml:
AWS has successfully launched the European Sovereign Cloud (ESC), marking a significant development in Utility Computing (UC). To spearhead this initiative, we are actively seeking experienced system development engineers with a strong background in automation and operations. As part of the AWS Managed Operations team, you will play a pivotal role in building, operating and evolving operations and development teams dedicated to delivering high-availability AWS services, including EC2, S3, Dynamo, Lambda, and Bedrock, exclusively for EU customers. For more information on ESC please check out our blog: https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/aws/in-the-works-aws-european-sovereign-cloud/

Your responsibilities will encompass overseeing the ongoing operations and expansion of the ESC, working closely with global AWS teams, and influencing the evolution of AWS services and technology. A typical day in this role involves collaborating with technology leaders, contributing to the enhancement of day-to-day operations, and ensuring continuous improvements in availability, reliability, latency, performance, and efficiency of the ESC. You will be required to occasionally participate in "on-call" rotations to resolve incidents occurring out-of-hours.

The overarching goal is to deliver scalable services and ensure a high-availability experience for EU customers. If you are an experienced professional ready for a challenging and impactful opportunity, we invite you to join our efforts in operating and scaling a best-in-class development engineering and operations team that aligns with AWS' commitment to customer satisfaction and continual innovation.

Utility Computing (UC)
European Sovereign Cloud (ESC) is a part of AWS Utility Computing (UC).
AWS Utility Computing (UC) provides product innovations — from foundational services such as Amazon’s Simple Storage Service (S3) and Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2), to consistently released new product innovations that continue to set AWS’s services and features apart in the industry. As a member of the UC organization, you’ll support the development and management of Compute, Database, Storage, Internet of Things (Iot), Platform, and Productivity Apps services in AWS. Within AWS UC, Managed Operations engineers engage with AWS customers who require specialized security solutions for their cloud services.

Eligibility requirement
- Fluency in written and spoken English is required.
- Candidate must be a national of an EU member state and residing in the EU to operate the AWS European Sovereign Cloud.
- Amazon will provide relocation support for successful applicants relocating within the European Union.
- Employees will participate in an On-Call rota.

A day in the life
A typical day in this role involves collaborating with technology leaders, contributing to the enhancement of day-to-day operations, and ensuring improvements in availability, reliability, latency, performance, and efficiency of the ESC. You’ll spend roughly 50% of your time operating production systems and 50% working with your team to make long-term improvements to the reliability, availability, and performance of those software systems. Over the course of a week, you will root cause why some deployments recently failed, and fix those bugs. Later in the week you may execute a highly sensitive time-critical change to production. You can round off the week by participating in design discussions by another team, writing code, and providing actionable feedback to your team’s code. You will be required to occasionally participate in “on-call” rotations to resolve incidents occurring out-of-hours.

About the team
Why AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Inclusive Team Culture
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic qualifications

- Experience in Linux OS and network troubleshooting, or experience in networking administration and troubleshooting
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language, or experience contributing to the architecture and design (architecture, design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and current systems
- This role requires you to be a national of an EU member state

Preferred qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or other technical degree or related experience
- Able to execute standard operating procedures and following operational best practices
- Knowledge or experience operating 24x7 high-availability, distributed software applications, performance tuning software applications and optimizing fleet utilization and monitoring frameworks (such as CloudWatch, Datadog, Grafana, Elastic or similar)
- Knowledge or experience with Infrastructure as Code, (such as CDK, CloudFormation, Puppet, Chef, Ansible, or similar)
- Experience with CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices, and Generative AI technologies, including automated deployment, configuration management, continuous integration workflows, prompt engineering, model deployment, and AI-powered automation tools

title: Operations Designer, Operations Design Team
descriptionHtml:
Amazon's Global Engineering Services (GES) is seeking an experienced Operations Designer to join the International Operations Design Team (ODT). This individual will be responsible for leading composite design delivery for a portfolio of fulfillment center projects within the EMEA network.

The Operations Designer owns the end-to-end design collaboration process within their assigned portfolio (defined by building type or technical capability), ensuring high quality of deliverables, standards applicability and quantities compliance of composites. They participate actively from Concept Design phase (REVO) through As-built, identifying challenges and influencing their resolution before composite initiation.

The ideal candidate will have strong experience in warehouse/logistics design using BIM and CAD tools, with a detail-oriented and data-driven mindset. They will possess problem-solving skills and knowledge of operations processes, design dependencies and execution for construction and fit-out environments. The role requires an 80% tactical / 20% strategic focus, with the designer addressing innovation (clash detection) and value engineering opportunities while supporting cost and speed-to-serve objectives.

The role will be based in Spain, with travel expected for up to 50% of the time depending on the project portfolio

Key job responsibilities
You will lead the full design coordination lifecycle for a portfolio of fulfillment center projects, managing architectural, mechanical handling equipment, and mechanical/electrical/plumbing models with vendors to deliver detailed design packages on time and within specification

You will coordinate warehouse layout designs — from complex machinery placement to floor markings — collaborating with internal and external stakeholders to identify requirements and resolve design challenges from concept through as-built phases

You will assess and communicate project design status to relevant stakeholders and forums, fostering collaboration across programs to address inconsistencies and deliver consistent execution across all sites in your portfolio

You will support field teams by providing layout designs that solve on-site challenges, while tracking the resolution of design issues and facilitating timely design reviews to meet regulatory compliance

You will contribute to the standard design library and drive continuous improvement activities, identifying opportunities to enhance quality and efficiency across the design process

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Engineering (any domain), Operations, Business Administration, or a related field
- Knowledge of IE fundamentals (e.g., basic spatial layouts of processing lines, process paths, etc.)
- Experience as an industrial engineer, operations engineer, manufacturing engineer, or project engineer in a manufacturing environment
- Experience using one or more of the following technologies (e.g., AutoCAD, Rhino, Revit, SolidWorks, CREO, SketchUp, KeyShot, etc.) to deliver high quality models and designs

Preferred qualifications

- Knowledge of concepts like system architecture, optimization, system dynamics, system analysis, statistical analysis, reliability analysis, and decision making
- Experience with design-in-safety
- Experience with process design based on Lean Principles
- Experience working with the designs of complex automated material, handling equipment, packaging technologies, and systems including robotics and high-speed manufacturing
- Experience communicating technical concepts and processes using clear, simple language and visuals
- Additional language skills (French, German, Polish, Arabic, Portuguese, Turkish, Chinese (Mandarin), Afrikaans and Zulu ) are beneficial for cross-regional project coordination across EMEA

title: Operations Manager
descriptionHtml:
Job summary
Our WW Operations network delivers millions of packages and smiles to Amazon customers every day. We are looking for motivated, customer-focused individuals who want to join our team as an Operations Manager. In this role, you will lead and develop a team of salaried and hourly talent. You will be responsible for engaging your team during their shifts to maintain the highest levels of safety, quality, attendance, and performance. To achieve this, managers are expected to provide their team with the tools needed for success while driving improvements in productivity and efficiency through data-driven decisions and analytical problem-solving. You will also play a key role in maintaining our customer expectations to ensure customer orders are delivered at the right time, to the right location.

Our Operation’s workflow has three major components: First mile - where the product is housed and ready for order; Middle mile - where the order is hauled to your area; and Last mile - when the product is delivered to the customer’s door. Please note that all workflows have slight building variations, but one thing is constant: our vision and dedication to the customer.

Key Responsibilities and Job Elements:
- Support, mentor, and motivate your salaried and hourly workforce
- Lead large-scope projects with site and regional impact
- Build and execute productivity plans through forecast reviews, determining productivity requirements, and partnering with other Leaders to load balance
- Manage safety, quality, productivity, and customer delivery promises
- Collaborate with all support teams including Safety, Engineering, Loss Prevention, Quality Assurance, Human Resources to develop plans to meet business objectives
- Lift up to 49 pounds and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach
- Stand/walk for up to 12 hours during shifts
- Work in an environment where the noise level varies and can be loud
- Work in an environment that is subject to variable temperatures and weather (delivery stations include outside loading departments)
- Continuously climb and descend stairs (applies to sites with stairs)
Our fulfillment network launches new Operations sites every year, providing various opportunities for your professional growth. We hire Operations Managers based on location preference and the business’ current openings.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of employee and performance management experience
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent, or 2+ years of Amazon (blue badge/FTE) experience

descriptionHtml:
Join Amazon’s mission to become Earth’s safest place to work! At Amazon, we’ve set the ambitious goal to become the benchmark of safety excellence across all industries in which we operate. title: Engineering Operation Technician
descriptionHtml:
Join our dynamic team and become a critical guardian of technological infrastructure! As a Data Center Engineering Technician, you'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of mission-critical technology infrastructure, ensuring seamless operations that power global digital experiences. Your expertise will directly contribute to maintaining an extraordinary 99.999% uptime, keeping the digital world running smoothly and efficiently.

Engineering Technicians are Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting. They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot, Data Center Operation’s Mission Critical Facilities, which includes stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, as well as three phase electrical systems such as: switch gear, UPSs, PDUs, wet cell batteries and associated systems, CRAC, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers/water chemical system, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, & motors.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

NOTE: Amazon does not sponsor for immigration, including for H-1B, TN, and other non-immigrant visas, for this role.
NOTE: Lump sum stipend will be provided to eligible candidates who relocate for this position.


Key job responsibilities
- Daily building rounds to monitor and record information from electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment to ensure 24/7 reliability and availability
- Monitor Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Management System (EPMS)
- Assist in troubleshooting of facility and rack-level events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLA)
- Perform rack installs and rack decommissioning within internal SLA
- Perform PM, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and repair of electrical and mechanical equipment
- Technical writing to support change management program
- Monitor daily work requests and manage to resolution, and execute projects from conception to completion
- On-site support of contractors, sub-contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices, procedures & local legislation
- Work schedule changes depending on specific site needs. Shifts can be up to 12 hours and may rotate on a predefined schedule. Some locations have on-call rotations.
- Role may support more than one location/site.

Physical Requirements:
- Willingness and demonstrated ability to work in the following physical conditions with reasonable accommodations:
- Regularly lift and/or move up to 39 pounds independently
- Participate in group lifts for 40+ pounds
- Maintain balance and perform construction tasks while on a ladder
- Regularly walk, use hands and fingers, handle or feel, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl, climb stairs, twist, bend, work above shoulders, grasp, carry, push and pull objects into position
- Work in an environment requiring provided ear protection

This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.

Essential Requirements:
- Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed
- Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational
- Travel frequency will vary based on business needs and operational status of assigned facility

Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs

A day in the life
This role acts as Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment preventative maintenance (PM) and troubleshooting, reporting to a site’s Data Center Facility Manager (FM). They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot mission-critical data center facility equipment including stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, 3 phase electrical systems such as switchgear, UPS units, PDUs, and wet cell batteries and associated systems. Mechanical equipment includes CRAHU units, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers, water systems, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, and motors. Additional support equipment is included in the scope of the role which includes fire/life safety equipment, building automation systems, and general facilities equipment.

Basic qualifications

- 1+ years of electrical facilities maintenance, or 1+ years of mechanical facilities maintenance experience
- 1+ years of Microsoft Office products and applications experience
- Work flexible schedule including weekends, nights, and holidays

Preferred qualifications

- 2+ years of data center engineering experience
- Experience reading and writing procedures, technical documents, and engineering drawings
- Associate's degree in related field, or technical degree in related field

Employee Experience & Engagement

Effektive Koordination mit Shared Services und funktionsübergreifenden Partnern zur Gewährleistung einer nahtlosen Serviceerbringung.



Data-Driven Decision Making & Technology

Führende Nutzung von Analysen und KI-Tools zur Aufdeckung verborgener Muster, Antizipation aufkommender Risiken und Förderung datenbasierter Entscheidungsfindung. Umwandlung von Erkenntnissen in überzeugende Narrative, die Senior Stakeholder beeinflussen und messbare Verbesserungen im Mitarbeitererlebnis und in der Unternehmensleistung vorantreiben. Strategische Förderung der Nutzung von HR-Technologielösungen und Self-Service-Tools für Effizienz und Exzellenz – unter Nutzung von Automatisierung bei gleichzeitiger Beibehaltung eines persönlichen Service für sensible Anliegen, die menschliches Urteilsvermögen und Empathie erfordern.

Regelmäßige Partnerschaft mit Standortleitungen und General Managers zur Balance zwischen operativen Anforderungen und Amazons Werten sowie Personalstrategie – mit fundiertem Urteilsvermögen bei komplexen organisatorischen Herausforderungen. title: Sr. Product Manager - Technical, WW Prime - Benefits, Pricing & Constructs, WW Prime - Benefits, Pricing & Constructs
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Prime is a core pillar of Amazon’s consumer businesses and aspires to be the world’s most engaging, satisfying, and loved membership program which delivers profitable growth by improving the Amazon experience. Prime currently serves over 200 million members worldwide, and relentlessly innovates to bring move value, convenience, and entertainment to our members. We have been investing in transformational capabilities that will:

• Accelerate Prime’s growth by reaching new customer segments and countries.
• Strengthen and differentiate the Prime value proposition, for all customers and for key growth segments.
• Empower every Amazon business to accelerate its growth through Prime.
• Lead the way and accelerate customers’ adoption of Amazon in new locations and segments.



Key job responsibilities
•Guide engineering on the architectural direction for the platform. 
• Define and own the API contracts for core platform services — formal specifications with SLAs, versioning, and support models that partner teams across Amazon rely on as the system of record. 
• Establish a federation model where the platform owns the shared experience shell and partner teams own their individual modules through well-defined integration contracts, so new businesses can integrate without ad hoc coordination. 
• Build the platform primitives that other product teams design customer experiences on top of. 
• Influence senior leadership decisions through data-driven recommendations, business cases, and structured analysis frameworks.
• Establish the documentation, runbooks, and architecture-decision records that keep globally distributed engineering teams aligned.

About the team
WW Prime has two core product pillars: Member Growth and Value Proposition. The Benefits, Pricing and Constructs team owns the value proposition for Amazon Prime, defining the benefits, tiers and price points, as well as communicating that value to customers. title: Senior Solutions Architect, Coalition Accelerator Builder, GNSD
descriptionHtml:
The Coalition Accelerator Builder team is the conversion layer between qualified defence-cloud demand and reusable, deliverable capability. The NSD mission threads and field identify customer challenges and generate demand; this team turns that demand into proven accelerators that ProServe, partners, and regional teams can deliver repeatedly without a specialist in the room.

The accelerator portfolio includes C2CMA (Command and Control Cloud Mission Accelerator), Trusted Secure Enclaves, and CEGA (Cloud Edge Global Access), linked together by the AMF (AWS Mission Framework) to deliver holistically for the mission rather than as isolated point solutions.

You will be one of the first builder hires into this team. Your job is to build, prove, and scale the accelerator portfolio: helping build best-practice guidance and reference architectures, hands-on in the codebase, embedded in live customer delivery, and then codifying what works into repeatable approaches that the wider field can own.

How You Work: The Prove-Then-Scale Model

Your initial validation is direct involvement in customer delivery. You embed alongside ProServe and partner engineers on live engagements, contribute code, solve real deployment problems, and understand what breaks in production defence environments. You then extract that experience into repeatable, tested patterns: infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD pipelines, demo platforms, contribution guides, and enablement collateral. The credibility of everything you produce comes from having built it against real operational need, not in a lab.

What This Role Is NOT

This is not a traditional customer-facing SA role with occasional prototyping. It is a build role. You will write code, own pipelines, and maintain a codebase. Customer exposure comes through embedded delivery, not through pre-sales presentations. If your instinct is to architect on a whiteboard and hand off to someone else to implement, this is not the right fit.

Key job responsibilities
- Build and own the accelerator codebases. Terraform, CI/CD, container orchestration and infrastructure-as-code for the shared core every deployment depends on. Set contribution standards for ProServe and partners, review pull requests and enforce Architecture Decision Records so country-specific extensions stay consistent with the core.
- Prove the patterns in live delivery. Work alongside ProServe and partner teams on funded engagements to validate patterns, fix what breaks and build credibility before scaling.
- Run demo and reference platforms. Keep environments running that support sales conversations, give partners a validated starting point and show secure-by-design patterns to customers and accreditation bodies.
- Automate compliance evidence. Build tooling that maps deployed infrastructure to NATO, NCSC and national control frameworks and produces evidence that can be audited.
- Enable the field. Write technical collateral, not marketing material: deployment guides, runbooks, architecture walkthroughs, accreditation evidence templates and hands-on workshops that let non-specialist SAs, Tech BDs and delivery teams work on their own.
- Deliver the roadmap across the collaboration model. Work to the priorities set by the Product Owner and STL and turn demand from the field into shipped capability. Act as the bridge between the team that sets direction and ProServe, partners, regional SAs, Tech BDs and AWS Security.

About the team
The Coalition Accelerator Builder Team sits within GNSD and governs the accelerator portfolio that underpins the AWS defence-cloud go-to-market across allied nations. The team is deliberately small and high-leverage: it builds each capability once, to a standard that holds, and it becomes a repeatable delivery vehicle. You will work directly with the STL, Product Owner, and fellow engineers, and interface daily with BD, ProServe, and partner teams across multiple countries. Each accelerator compounds: what one nation builds, the next fields rather than rebuilds.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
- 10+ years of IT development or implementation/consulting in the software or Internet industries experience
- Strong software engineering fundamentals, including version control workflows, automated testing, code review, CI/CD pipelines and containerisation (Docker, ECS/EKS)

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in defence, national security or government cloud environments, including multi-classification architectures, secure-by-design patterns and strict data separation, ideally with an active or recently held security clearance in a NATO nation (UK SC/DV, US Secret/TS or equivalent).
- Deep DevOps experience, including CI/CD pipeline design, GitOps, automated testing, release management and observability at scale, applied in regulated environments with audit trails and automated compliance evidence or security posture validation, ideally using generative AI or RAG for evidence extraction.
- Deep knowledge of AWS security services (GuardDuty, Security Hub, IAM Access Analyzer, KMS, Nitro Enclaves, CloudTrail), container orchestration (EKS/ECS/Kubernetes) and event-driven serverless architectures (Lambda, Step Functions, EventBridge) across cloud and edge.
- Experience with mission systems (TAK Server/ATAK, geospatial pipelines, C2) or mesh, SD-WAN and overlay networks for contested environments, deployed in field exercises or austere conditions, and a track record of building enablement (documentation, workshops, partner certification) for partner delivery teams in more than one country.

title: Manager III, Network Development Engineering, Bespoke Solutions
descriptionHtml:
Are you ready to lead a team that builds and scales the automation, tooling, and infrastructure that keeps Amazon running? As a Network Development Engineering Manager, you will own the strategy and execution for systems that power critical services, driving reliability and operational excellence at massive scale. You will define the vision for your team, set goals that work backwards from customer needs, and build the mechanisms that turn complex technical challenges into streamlined, automated solutions.

The Bespoke Solutions team is looking for a hands-on engineering leader to build and run the development, test, and tooling backbone for a family of high-assurance security devices built for government customers within AWS. You will manage a multidisciplinary software and infrastructure team responsible for the classified cloud development environment, the device test infrastructure, network, and the device management software and engineering tools that the entire program depends on.

This is not a role for someone who manages from a distance. You will own three tightly coupled charters: (1) building and operating a classified cloud development environment that lets cleared engineers develop, build, and integrate at speed under the most rigorous government security controls; (2) designing, building, and operating high-speed device test infrastructure spanning a hybrid of physical lab benches and cloud-based tooling; and (3) designing and building the critical device management software, engineering tools, and automation used to provision, configure, and operate the devices.

You will set the technical direction for development and test infrastructure as code, CI/CD, and automation — and then build and lead the team that delivers it. Your success is measured by how fast and how reliably the hardware, FPGA, firmware, and software teams can build, test, and ship certified production hardware on top of the environment and tools your team provides.

You will work across organizational boundaries — with hardware, FPGA, firmware, software, systems engineering, security/compliance, and program management — to understand what the program needs to move fast, and translate that into resilient development environments, automated test infrastructure, and engineering tools. When complex problems arise — across classified environment authorization (ATO), hybrid lab/cloud test automation, or high-speed device bring-up — you will have the technical depth to engage meaningfully and the judgment to drive the right trade-offs.

If Arlington, VA (Arlington HQ2):

This role will sit in our new headquarters in Northern Virginia, where Amazon will invest $2.5 billion dollars, occupy 4 million square feet of energy efficient office space, and create at least 25,000 new full-time jobs. Our employees and the neighboring community will also benefit from the associated investments from the Commonwealth including infrastructure updates, public transportation improvements, and new access to Reagan National Airport.

By working together on behalf of our customers, we are building the future one innovative product, service, and idea at a time. Are you ready to embrace the challenge? Come build the future with us.

This position requires that the candidate selected must be a US Citizen and obtain and maintain a security clearance at the TS/SCI with polygraph level. Upon start, the selected candidate will be sponsored for a commensurate clearance for each government agency for which they perform AWS work.

Key job responsibilities
Classified Cloud Development Environment (CDE)

- Build and operate the classified cloud development environment that cleared engineers use to develop, build, and integrate
- Drive the environment from authorization (IATT/ATO) through full operational development, partnering with security and compliance
- Establish infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD, and automation so the environment is reproducible, auditable, and fast
- Own availability, access control, and configuration management for the classified development environment

Device Test Infrastructure (Hybrid Lab + Cloud)

- Design, build, and operate high-speed device test infrastructure spanning physical lab benches and cloud-based tooling
- Build hardware-in-the-loop (HITL) test benches and automated test frameworks for high-speed devices
- Establish automated verification coverage and continuous test for hardware, FPGA, and firmware
- Own lab infrastructure, test instrumentation, and the cloud tooling that aggregates, analyzes, and reports test results

Device Management Software & Engineering Tools

- Design and build the critical device management software and tools used to provision, configure, monitor, and operate the devices
- Own the lifecycle of device management and engineering tooling from architecture through production deployment
- Build automation and internal tooling that accelerates the hardware, FPGA, firmware, and software teams
- Partner with firmware and systems teams to define device interfaces, telemetry, and operational workflows
- Lead model-based systems engineering tooling development

Team Leadership & Development

- Manage and grow a multidisciplinary team spanning CDE, test infrastructure, and device management software and tools
- Hire, develop, and retain top software and infrastructure engineering talent
- Create an environment where engineers with fundamentally different expertise collaborate effectively and challenge each other
- Set clear goals, remove obstacles, and hold the team to high standards on delivery, reliability, and security
- Mentor and develop senior technical contributors — help them think bigger and grow toward principal-level impact
- Establish engineering best practices, review cadences, and development lifecycle processes

Cross-Organization Collaboration

- Partner with hardware, FPGA, firmware, software, and systems engineering to deliver the environments, test infrastructure, and tools they depend on
- Work with security and compliance teams to navigate classified environment authorization and certification evidence
- Coordinate with program management to align infrastructure and tooling milestones with the delivery schedule
- Influence peer teams and senior leadership on technical direction, investment priorities, and trade-offs
- Represent your team's work and roadmap to Director-level and above

A day in the life
You will start your morning reviewing operational dashboards and system health metrics, then shift into working sessions with your engineers on architecture reviews or automation initiatives. You will spend time in one-on-ones coaching team members on their growth, unblocking technical challenges, and aligning on priorities. Expect to collaborate with partner teams to scope upcoming projects, write narratives that articulate your team's strategy, and dive into the details when troubleshooting complex system issues that require your expertise.

About the team
About AWS

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Why AWS?

Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge-sharing and mentorship. Our senior members enjoy one-on-one mentoring and thorough, but kind, code reviews. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects that help our team members develop your engineering expertise so you feel empowered to take on more complex tasks in the future.

AWS Infrastructure Services (AIS)

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

Diverse Experiences

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Inclusive Team Culture

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship & Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
- 7+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
- 3+ years of managing network, systems or software development teams experience
- Experience in any of the following: Cloud Architecture, Network Engineering, Systems Design, Software Development, Infrastructure Architecture, Data Engineering or DevOps
- Experience designing and building test infrastructure and automation (including hardware-in-the-loop)
- Experience delivering tools used by other engineering teams (device management, tooling, or platforms)

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or Electrical Engineering
- 10+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and network or infrastructure experience
- Experience building classified or regulated development environments and driving them through ATO/authorization
- Experience with hybrid physical-lab + cloud test infrastructure for high-speed hardware
- Experience building networking / device management / provisioning / telemetry software for embedded or hardware devices
- Experience building internal engineering tools and automation that accelerate cross-discipline teams
- Experience with government compliance frameworks or security evaluation processes
- Track record of developing senior technical talent (growing engineers to Staff/Principal level)

title: Senior Finance Analyst, Selling Partner Services, Central FP&A
descriptionHtml:
Amazon's Worldwide Seller Partner Services (SPS) Finance team is hiring a Senior Financial Analyst to help embed AI directly into financial planning and analysis. You'll work across a 3P business spanning FBA and MFN, NA and International — where your modeling and automation work shapes how sellers are priced, forecasted, and reported on.

This isn't a reporting-support role. You'll partner directly with finance managers on ASP and profitability analysis, build sensitivity models that inform investment decisions, and turn dense data into narratives that hold up in front of senior leadership. You'll also build AI workflows that replace hours of manual work — freeing capacity for deeper analysis, not just faster output.

Key job responsibilities
- Build AI-powered workflows that automate recurring financial analysis — trend reporting, variance commentary, data extraction — cutting manual cycle time while improving accuracy
- Run deep-dive analysis on ASP and profitability trends across size bands, flagging trend breaks that need manager or leadership attention
- Build sensitivity models and dynamic forecasts that let leadership stress-test scenarios before committing to a plan
- Partner with finance managers to convert raw data into decision-ready narratives for executive reviews
- Mentor peers on analytical rigor and AI tool adoption, raising the bar on both without sacrificing data integrity

A day in the life
No two weeks look the same here. Some days you're heads-down building or refining an AI workflow; others you're in a business review defending a forecast assumption to a finance manager who'll push back on every input. You'll move between quiet analytical work and live collaboration — often in the same afternoon.

You'll sit close enough to the business to see how a pricing change or seller trend actually shows up in the numbers, and close enough to leadership reviews to know what questions they'll ask before they ask them. The team is small enough that your work gets noticed and used quickly, and collaborative enough that you're rarely solving a hard problem alone.

About the team
The SPS FP&A team supports the financial operations for 3rd Party Sellers, one of Amazon's largest businesses. We're building the tools and processes that let financial planning scale globally while holding the precision that billion-dollar decisions require — including embedding AI directly into core workflows rather than treating it as a side project. The team values analytical rigor, mentorship, and a genuinely diverse set of perspectives on hard problems.

- 3+ years of dissecting financial data and identifying patterns that support business strategy experience

title: Software Development Engineer II, AWS Compute Optimizer
descriptionHtml:
Do you want to build the large-scale data systems that help millions of AWS customers cut their cloud costs and run more efficiently? Join a team that turns massive streams of infrastructure and usage data into the intelligent recommendations customers rely on every day.

We are the Optimization Data team, the data backbone behind AWS Compute Optimizer and AWS's broader cost optimization products. Our job is to identify customer resources, collect the utilization metrics that describe how they run, and turn that raw telemetry into clean, reliable, well-labeled signals that our science and engine teams use to model cost-savings recommendations. Every day we ingest and process enormous volumes of metrics and billing data across EC2, Auto Scaling groups, EBS, Lambda, ECS, EKS, RDS/Aurora, DynamoDB, and networking resources — sourcing data from internal systems like CloudWatch, EBS Stats, Lambda Stats, and the Fargate control plane, as well as third-party products such as Datadog. If you enjoy working at the intersection of big data, distributed systems, and real customer impact, this is the place for you.

title: Onsite Medical Representative
descriptionHtml:
Join Amazon’s mission to become Earth’s safest place to work! At Amazon, we’ve set the ambitious goal to become the benchmark of safety excellence across all industries in which we operate. The Amazon Workplace Health & Safety (WHS) team sets the strategic direction to provide resources, best practices, and safe environments to proactively manage the health and wellbeing of our workforce. To support these goals, Amazon is seeking an experienced and dynamic Onsite Medical Representative (OMR) to join our team. In this position, you will work closely with the WHS Site Manager, WHS Specialist, and occasionally the Injury Prevention Specialist (IPS). This includes attending weekly associate safety committee meetings, greeting all new hires for the site or through daily one-on-one interaction. Additionally, the OMR will participate in weekly case management review meetings as necessary.

As an OMR, you will independently assess and administer first aid as well as offer guidance to Amazon Associates (AAs) on both occupational and non-occupational injuries or illnesses. You should be passionate about learning and advocating health and wellness principles to consistently support AAs on a daily basis. You will refer care to outside medical providers as needed, and learn about OSHA regulations, risk, and analysis.

The OMR will function as a part of the larger team onsite, assisting with all first aid needs and support safety operations as needed.

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:
- Provide first aid support and make referrals to outside medical providers as necessary.
- Minimize the AA risk of injury through awareness, education, and proactive engagement.
- Maintain all records of care provided to AAs.
- Coordinate and maintain the workers’ compensation and return to work programs for AAs with work-related injuries.
- Provide daily activity logs and end of shift reports.
- Engage with AAs and leadership on operations floor to provide coaching regarding observed at-risk work habits.
- Maintain a clean working environment and ensure appropriate medical supply inventory is maintained.
- Participate in training and certification to facilitate first aid, CPR and AED certifications classes.
- Maintain all first aid, CPR, AED credentials.
- Work flexible shifts which could include days, nights, holidays, and/or weekends.
- Assist with random saliva drug testing protocols.
- Maintain effective care delivery in emergencies and assist emergency response at the site.

Additional Job Elements include:
- Lift up to 49 pounds and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach
- Stand/walk for up to 12 hours during shifts
- Work in an environment where the noise level varies
- Work in an environment that is subject to variable temperatures and weather (delivery stations include outside loading departments)
- Continuously climb and descend stairs (applies to sites with stairs)

For those that do not have an adult First Aid, CPR, AED certification from the American Heart Association or American Red Cross, must obtain within 3 weeks of start date.

Basic qualifications

- High school or equivalent diploma
- Experience with OSHA regulations
- Experience in the Quality Assurance/testing domain
- Current valid Basic Life Support (BLS) certification by an approved emergency cardiac care (ECC) provider; AND must have one of the following:
- Current valid Emergency Medical Technician (EMT) OR Paramedic Certification from the Department of Health OR the National Registry of Emergency Medical Technicians (NREMT); OR
- Current Active Athletic Trainer Certification by either the Board of Certification (BOC) or equivalent State Certification

Preferred qualifications

- Certified to teach first aid, CPR, and AED training from American Heart Association or American Red Cross
- Proficient in Microsoft Office
- Experience with an industrial wellness program
- Experience managing musculoskeletal disorders, ergonomics, and coaching on body mechanics
- Demonstrated work experience with OSHA regulations and Workers Compensation
- Proficient in digital recordkeeping
- In the last year, six months job experience in the Military as a Combat Medic (U.S. Army), Field Medic (U.S. Army), Healthcare Specialist (U.S. Army), Hospital Corpsman (U.S. Navy), or Aerospace Medical Service Technician (U.S. Air Force)

title: Senior Mechanical Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Amazon is seeking exceptional talent to help develop the next generation of advanced robotics systems that will transform automation at Amazon's scale. We're building revolutionary robotic systems that combine cutting-edge AI, sophisticated control systems, and advanced mechanical design to create adaptable automation solutions capable of working safely alongside humans in dynamic environments. This is a unique opportunity to shape the future of robotics and automation at an unprecedented scale, working with world-class teams pushing the boundaries of what's possible in robotic manipulation, locomotion, and human-robot interaction.

We're looking for a Senior Mechanical Engineer to lead mechanical design for advanced manufacturing facilities infrastructure. This role drives the development of new production facilities, delivering scale and efficiency in manufacturing. If you thrive in dynamic environments and enjoy solving complex challenges, this is your opportunity to help shape the future of advanced manufacturing.

In this role, you'll serve as the Senior Mechanical Engineer, guiding the design and engineering work that supports infrastructure construction, from initial concept through full production.


Key job responsibilities
- Oversee the complete mechanical design process, guiding concept evaluations and final decisions that result in fully developed construction drawings ready for permitting and construction. This responsibility spans both wet systems for cooling water and dry systems for air distribution.
- Address RFIs and resolve design changes during construction.
- Collaborate with external Engineering, Procurement, and Construction firms throughout bid and project execution phases to verify that all designs and specifications align with our Engineering Standards. Lead and support both internal teams and third-party engineers to maintain project quality and compliance.
- Proactively share project requirements, updates, and status with both internal and external teams to keep everyone aligned. Guide and develop junior engineers through hands-on mentorship and professional growth opportunities.
- Deliver comprehensive updates on design concepts and project progress during structured milestone reviews at the 30%, 60%, 90%, and IFC stages, engaging stakeholders and multidisciplinary teams to ensure alignment and transparency.
- Deliver quantity take-offs and cost estimates for projects within tight deadlines while applying core engineering principles and a comprehensive mechanical engineering toolkit to solve complex technical challenges. This drives the creation of detailed designs for diverse mechanical and process systems.
- Create comprehensive design packages including detailed basis of design documents, sequence of operations, and contract-ready construction drawings to guide accurate project execution and stakeholder alignment.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering or equivalent
- 7+ years of professional experience designing and constructing mechanical systems for large-scale advanced manufacturing and industrial applications.
- Professional design experience spanning HVAC, cooling, and mechanical systems for advanced manufacturing facilities and large-scale industrial plants.
- Deep knowledge of mechanical systems including: Dehumidification Units, Heat Exchangers, Pumps, Compressors, Air Handling Units, DOAS Units, Fans/Blowers, and Heat Recovery Systems.
- Working knowledge of industry standards and regulations, including ICC codes (Building, Mechanical, Plumbing, Energy Conservation, Fuel Gas, Fire), ASHRAE guidelines, SMACNA specifications, NFPA standards, and relevant ASME and ANSI codes.
- Proficiency with Revit, Revizto, and Navisworks.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience delivering mechanical designs through all milestone review stages for large capital construction projects.
- Experience collaborating with external EPC firms across bid and project execution phases.
- Demonstrated ability to mentor and develop junior engineers.
- Experience producing quantity take-offs and cost estimates under tight deadlines.
- Knowledge of mechanical systems including: Chillers, Cooling Towers,  process gas/fluid systems, Control Valves and Instrumentation, and Hazardous Exhaust Systems

title: Operations Manager III
descriptionHtml:
Amazon's Last Mile network delivers millions of packages to customers' doorsteps every day, and our Rural Super Rural (RSR) team takes on some of the most challenging delivery territory — longer routes, lower stop density, and greater distances between stops. We are looking for an Operations Manager to run an entire delivery station, owning everything from cost and budgeting to productivity, quality, and on-time delivery. In this role, you will operate as the general manager of your building, leading a team of exempt leaders and frontline associates while applying Lean continuous improvement methods to solve complex problems unique to rural logistics.
