title: Software Development Engineer II, Silicon Scan & Fleet Diagnostics, Machine Learning Accelerator Technology Team
descriptionHtml:
Annapurna Labs designs silicon and software that accelerates innovation. Customers choose us to create cloud solutions that solve challenges that were unimaginable a short time ago—even yesterday. Our custom chips, accelerators, and software stacks enable us to take on technical challenges that have never been seen before, and deliver results that help our customers change the world.

In Annapurna Labs we are at the forefront of hardware/software co-design not just in Amazon Web Services (AWS) but across the industry. The MLA Technology team is looking for candidates who are excited to write software that tests silicon itself—running structural scan (DFT) tests across a huge fleet of machine learning accelerator servers, and turning the results into insights about some of the largest chips ever built.

Do you like the idea of testing billions of transistors and finding the one that’s misbehaving? Great! Ever talked to a chip over JTAG just to see what it would say? Great! Do you read data sheets like others read the news? Great! Written a script to automate something tedious, then kept improving it just because you could? Great! Enjoy turning a mountain of raw data into a dashboard that tells a story? Great! Did this make you smile? Awesome.

Our team writes software that tests the most advanced machine learning chips in the world, at a scale and speed few systems anywhere can match. If that interests you, come join our team!

Key job responsibilities
- Own and evolve the software that speeds up structural scan (DFT) test execution across a large fleet of ML accelerator servers
- Design and deliver improvements to the tools and workflows used to bring new scan test patterns to production, from architecture through deployment
- Build data analytics and dashboards that track test pattern execution across the fleet
- Automate silicon debug and large-scale investigation workflows
- Partner with the teams that run and validate scan testing at scale, turning their needs into maintainable, tested, reusable software
- Mentor early-career engineers and raise the bar through design discussions and thorough, but kind, code reviews

A day in the life
As an SDE II on the team, you’ll own problems end to end—designing the solution, writing the code, testing it against real hardware, and shipping it to a fleet. One day you might be profiling scan execution to shave seconds off a test that runs across thousands of machines; another day you might be building a dashboard that shows how a new test pattern is behaving across the fleet, or automating complex silicon investigations. No software is too low level for us. No software is too high level for us. You’ll work alongside senior engineers deep in silicon test, and help early-career engineers on the team grow through your designs and code reviews.

About the team
We are not a team of machine learning practitioners—we are a software team focused on testing and understanding the silicon that enables accelerated machine learning workloads at scale, including the chips behind AWS Trainium and AWS Inferentia.

Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge-sharing and mentorship. Our senior members enjoy one-on-one mentoring and thorough, but kind, code reviews. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects that help you develop your engineering expertise so you feel empowered to take on more complex tasks in the future.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
- Experience in embedded development in C/C++
- Knowledge of computer architecture, operating systems, and parallel computing
- Experience writing low level drivers
- Experience in debugging, profiling, and implementing software engineering best practices in large-scale systems

title: Reliability Engineer, Amazon Leo
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is Amazon's low Earth orbit satellite network. Our mission is to deliver fast, reliable internet connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. From individual households to schools, hospitals, businesses, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will serve people and organizations operating in locations without reliable connectivity.

We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Reliability Engineer to drive design for reliability in Amazon Leo hardware systems. This role will be responsible for developing and leading various reliability activities during product development and through the life of the product. It will require interfacing closely with subsystem teams, providing technical input and guidance on designs, and supporting as needed for reliability analysis and testing.

The ideal candidate will have experience in using Physics-of-Failure based models to develop and implement both analytical and empirical solutions for product quality/reliability risk identification and assessment during the product design, manufacturing, testing and deployment stages. The candidate should be able to drive Amazon Leo's requirements by carrying out stress driven risk analysis, including thermal, electrical and mechanical stresses in order to identify over-stress and fatigue-related product weaknesses. They should also be comfortable in assessing electronics manufacturing process related quality/reliability issues.

At the component level, the individual will drive critical component identification, support vendor selection and define component qualification requirements. The candidate will also be expected to use their knowledge of PCBA manufacturing, electronic component derating, as well as system-level performance requirements to establish critical quality and reliability metrics.

At the system level, the candidate will support development of system level reliability models and perform reliability assessments and risk analyses for optimization of design. The candidate will be also be expected to be familiar with system reliability engineering tools, such as reliability block diagram, statistical modeling and on orbit data analytics.

Export Control Requirement:
Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.





Key job responsibilities
- Assist with building a center of excellence for reliability analysis and testing
- Develop HALT, HASS and accelerated life test campaigns
- Define sample sizes and test specifications to demonstrate target reliability and confidence numbers
- Develop subsystem reliability models and establish reliability allocations across components to meet reliability targets.
- Review, guide, and support subsystem team component selections, derating and FMEAs
- Support component and manufacturing process qualification
- Drive root cause investigation and failure analysis for hardware failures

Basic qualifications

- Experience in developing functional specifications, design verification plans and functional test procedures
- Bachelor's degree or above in Mechanical Engineering, Materials Engineering, Reliability Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
- 3+ years of experience in hardware reliability engineering, preferably with a focus on satellite systems or space applications.
- Knowledge of reliability engineering principles, methods, and tools.
- Knowledge of environmental testing
- Proficiency in failure analysis techniques and materials characterization methods.
- Familiarity with electronics (PCBs, PCBAs, electronic components) and moving mechanical assemblies.

Preferred qualifications

- Master's or Doctorate degree or above in Mechanical Engineering, Materials Engineering, Reliability Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
- Experience with environmental testing, including temperature cycling, vibration, highly accelerated limit testing (HALT), and highly-accelerated stress screening (HASS).
- Basic knowledge of PCB fabrication, SMT, and polymerics application manufacturing processes.
- Familiarity with relevant industry standards, including IPC, JEDEC, AIAA, AEC, MIL, and SMC standards.

title: Product Manager Business Bulk Fulfilment, Amazon Business Operations - Analytics and Tech
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Business customers buy at a scale most retail systems were never built for: a school district ordering 2,000 chairs, a contractor ordering 900 boxes of fasteners, a hospital restocking an entire floor. Today those orders often arrive as dozens of separate boxes over many days, and we are rebuilding how Amazon fulfills them.
You will own the product roadmap for bulk and large order fulfillment at Amazon Business. The goal is simple to state and hard to build: a customer places one large order, picks one date, and receives it once, in the form factor that fits their dock and their crew. Getting there means changing how Amazon sources, consolidates, packs and ships large orders, working shoulder to shoulder with the engineering teams that own fulfillment planning and fulfillment center operations. This is a builder role with a funded roadmap and direct exposure to senior leaders across Amazon Business, supply chain and operations.

Key job responsibilities
Own the product roadmap for bulk and large order fulfillment, from customer problem through launch and measured outcome.
Write the documents that get the work funded and built: PRFAQs, business requirements documents, and annual and three year planning inputs.
Act as the requirements owner with partner engineering teams in fulfillment planning and fulfillment center technology, not a ticket filer. Negotiate scope, sequence and dependencies directly with their product and engineering leaders.
Define how Amazon consolidates a large order into as few deliveries as possible, including palletized delivery and customer selected delivery dates.
Define how a request for many individual units can be served from cases and pallets of the same product, working through the inventory, receive and pick changes that requires.
Build the case for dedicated bulk fulfillment capacity, including moving product from suppliers to customers without a putaway step.
Replace manual operator work with automation across sourcing, consolidation and promise, and track the reduction.
Own the metrics: deliveries per order, delivery date accuracy, ship cost per unit and contribution profit per unit. Pull your own data and defend your own numbers.

A day in the life
You will spend your day between customers and builders. Mornings often start in the data, checking how last week's large orders actually shipped and where they fragmented. From there it is working sessions with fulfillment planning and fulfillment center engineering teams on requirements, a review with operations leaders on the manual work still left in the flow, and time with Amazon Business sales and customer teams on what large buyers are asking for. You will write often, and you will present what you write to directors and above.

About the team
Amazon Business (AB) launched in the United States in April 2015 with the vision of delivering a comprehensive procurement solution for business customers of all sizes. In the US, AB now serves Fortune 500 companies, hospital systems, local governments, and education organizations. To support AB's mission, the AB Operations team owns end to end customer experience for AB customers right from checkout to final mile delivery and sits under the broader Global Transportation Services (GTS). We are the Single Threaded WW Ops team driving B2B operations, developing products and programs unique to business customers, and enhancing the business delivery capabilities.

- Experience managing technical products or online services
- Experience in product, program, or project management in leading cross-functional teams in delivery of major new products or services
- Bachelor's degree

Preferred qualifications

descriptionHtml:
Amazon Extra Large (AMXL) is a single-threaded organization with ownership of the end-to-end customer experience for large, heavy, and bulky products. AMXL consolidates the complete supply chain including strategy, data analytics, technology, operations, warehousing, order fulfillment, transportation, and delivery. AMXL also offers special handling services such as Room of Choice delivery, Haul-Away, and Installation/Assembly for select items. AMXL currently operates in North America, Europe, Japan, and India with plans for further expansion.

We are seeking a highly skilled and results-driven Design Engineer to join our dynamic AMXL Worldwide Industrial Design Engineering (WIDE) team. In this critical role, you will drive analysis, design, and deployment of high-impact retrofit programs and process re-engineering projects for AMXL Fulfillment Centers, Delivery Stations, and Sort Centers. The individual will primarily own the capacity models for Last Mile and will help improve and automate the model refreshes going into organizational quarterly guidance and planning cycles. Additionally, the role requires driving concept designs that enhance our customer and associate experience by introducing new capabilities and re-engineering processes while increasing the overall safety and efficiency of our operations.

We are looking for someone who possesses a blend of customer-facing and technical skills and will own retrofit programs and projects from ideation through execution and validation. Successful candidates will possess a strong background in facility design, material handling equipment, automation, and process engineering with a blend of deep skills in program managing complex projects, strong technical aptitude, troubleshooting capabilities, and customer-facing skills, along with a passion for innovating and simplifying processes. You are able to work successfully across multiple large engineering and operations teams at a strategic level and at an operations integration level.

Key job responsibilities
- Own end-to-end process design and site layout creation for each new business initiative and process improvement/re-engineering project in delivery station and sort center network
- Own the capacity models for LM BU.
- Determine all resources required for each retrofit project in terms of site layout, traffic plans, optimal material flow, equipment specification, and operations scheduling/ops clock
- Consolidate all retrofit efforts from change management to post-launch support for each site to streamline launch work, minimize disruption, and reduce launch costs
- Collaborate with internal teams and external vendors to generate high quality, cost effective solutions in very short periods of time
- Simultaneously manage multiple high visibility projects and tasks while effectively influencing, negotiating, and communicating with internal and external business partners, contractors and vendors
- Cross-pollinate best practices between engineering and operations teams.
- Provide technical leadership for large-scale engineering projects
- Lead ergonomic design improvements leveraging ergonomics, safety, and field ACES team resources
- With each retrofit, drive standardization, documentation of core design and process elements for scalable network growth across North America Logistics using strong process management and Lean principles
- Own and deliver on post-launch reviews and customer feedback, and incorporate feedback into future project plans

A day in the life
The role will require daily interactions with Operations, Safety, Process/Design Engineering, Launch, Finance, Supply Chain Execution, and Planning teams to ensure delivery station and sort center retrofit programs are well-defined in terms of aligning on the launch calendar, determining capacity requirements, identifying resources, clarifying roles and responsibilities, and leading the change management process. The role needs to have a deep understanding on both business needs and operational standards to be able translate business inputs to operational designs and operational constraints into business plans. There will be daily/weekly calls with Design and Launch teams to review retrofit designs and to collaborate with business/program owners to ensure the success of strategic initiatives implemented on time at the highest quality. Once a retrofit is completed and handed over to Launch/Startup teams, the role requires documentation of these changes and updates in respective capacity management systems with follow ups on the approval chains with Ops and Business leaders.

Amazon offers a full range of benefits that support you and eligible family members, including domestic partners and their children. Benefits can vary by location, the number of regularly scheduled hours you work, length of employment, and job status such as seasonal or temporary employment.

At Amazon, we value people with unique backgrounds, experiences, and skillsets. If you’re passionate about this role and want to make an impact on a global scale, please apply!

About the team
As AMXL WIDE, our vision is to build the fastest, most effective & efficient, and most agile heavy/bulky delivery services operations and designs in the world. We provide best-in-class engineering solutions for heavy/bulky operations, which is one of the most difficult types of logistics operation in supply chain, to address its unique challenges, high costs, and complex operational requirements. One our most important tenets is to innovate yet remain practical with our solutions through process/layout designs, material handling solutions, and capacity management to deliver results with the best customer and associate experience. Our team provides standards, guidelines, and templates that are easy-to-understand, implement, and replicate to for a scalable and robust network growth. We centralize designs, modules, and capacity information for the success of business teams in short and long term.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of Design/Innovation, research & development, manufacturing, process, industrial engineering, or related experience
- Experience in management of engineering design projects
- Experience leading engineering design projects and interacting with cross-functional teams
- Experience designing complex systems for automation in logistics or manufacturing, or experience with product development in automotive, aerospace, automation equipment or related field
- Experience in AutoCAD 3D
- Experience in engineering and estimating material handling and storage systems
- Experience modeling or simulating large-scale, high-volume distribution centers

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree in Engineering (any domain) or foreign equivalent, Operations, Business Administration, or a related field
- Knowledge of concepts like system architecture, optimization, system dynamics, system analysis, statistical analysis, reliability analysis, and decision making
- Experience with complex automated material handling equipment, packaging technologies, and systems and high-speed manufacturing
- Experience with design-in-safety
- Experience with process design based on Lean Principles

title: Senior Software Development Engineer, Robotics
descriptionHtml:
Amazon is seeking exceptional talent to help develop the next generation of advanced robotics systems that will transform automation at Amazon's scale. We're building robotic systems that combine cutting-edge AI, sophisticated control systems, and advanced mechanical design to create adaptable automation solutions capable of working safely alongside humans in dynamic environments. This is a unique opportunity to shape the future of robotics and automation at an unprecedented scale, working with world-class teams pushing the boundaries of what's possible in robotic dexterous manipulation, locomotion, and human-robot interaction. This role presents an opportunity to shape the future of robotics through innovative applications of the latest software and AI tools for robots.

At Amazon we leverage advanced robotics, machine learning, and artificial intelligence to solve complex operational challenges at an unprecedented scale. Our fleet of robots operates across hundreds of facilities worldwide, working in sophisticated coordination to fulfill our mission of customer excellence.

We are building the brains of our next-generation robots - a stack that:
- Enables deployment of robots at Amazon scale
- Enables unprecedented generalization across diverse tasks
- Seamlessly integrates with large models and optimal control techniques
- Integrates with human-safe safety solutions

As a Senior Software Development Engineer on our on-robot software team, you will design and build the software that runs on our robots and turns perception, planning, control, and machine learning models into reliable behavior on real hardware. You will partner with applied scientists and hardware engineers, lead designs across teams, and help set the technical direction for your area. Relevant backgrounds include perception, SLAM and navigation, controls, autonomy and task execution, and real-time robotics software, as well as experience deploying learned behavior models such as vision-language-action (VLA) models or VLM- and LLM-based planners on robots.

Join us in building the next generation of intelligent robotics systems that will transform the future of automation and human-robot collaboration.

Key job responsibilities
- Lead the design and delivery of on-robot subsystems, such as perception, SLAM and navigation, dexterous manipulation, low level controls, or task execution, from architecture through deployment on robots, and guide the engineers building it with you
- Prototype quickly with applied scientists, then take the algorithms and learned models that work to production components that meet the robot's real-time, compute, and safety constraints on embedded GPU platforms
- Define the interfaces, timing, and data contracts between perception, planning, control, and the learned policies that run alongside them
- Make your components observable with metrics and telemetry, and lead system-level debugging of failures seen on real robots
- Lead design reviews for the team and partner teams, and write documents for both technical and non-technical audiences
- Mentor engineers on the team in robotics and software engineering, and raise the bar for how we build, test, and operate robot software

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 5+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience
- 5+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team
- Bachelors or Master's degree and 10+ years in CS, ME, EE or related field experience
- Experience with robotics middleware like ROS, ZCM, or Zenoh
- Experience designing and shipping software for physical robots or other real-time embedded systems, with deep expertise in at least one robotics area such as perception, SLAM, navigation, controls, or autonomy

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree or PhD in Robotics, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field
- Experience taking robotics algorithms or machine learning models from research prototype to production on real hardware, in close partnership with applied scientists
- Experience with mobile manipulation, locomotion, or dexterous manipulation
- Experience integrating learned policies on a real robot (e.g., imitation or reinforcement learning, vision-language-action models, LLM-based task planning)
- Experience with real-time systems, including scheduling, deterministic timing, and sensor synchronization
- Experience deploying and optimizing models and perception pipelines on embedded GPUs (e.g., PyTorch, CUDA, TensorRT, NVIDIA Jetson)
- Experience with test-driven development and automated testing of robotics software, including regression testing of robot behavior with logged data, simulation, and hardware-in-the-loop testing
- Experience using AI coding assistants and agents to speed up development, with sound judgment about reviewing and verifying their output
- Excellent written and verbal communication, with a track record of leading technical work across science and engineering teams

title: Spacecraft Design CAD, Mech Engineer, Configuration Management
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is Amazon's low Earth orbit satellite network. Our mission is to deliver fast, reliable internet connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. From individual households to schools, hospitals, businesses, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will serve people and organizations operating in locations without reliable connectivity.

We’re working on the future. If you are seeking an iterative, fast-paced environment where you can drive innovation, apply state-of-the-art technologies to solve real-world challenges, and provide visible benefit to end-users, this is your opportunity.

We’re looking for a Mechanical Design Engineer who combines superb 3D CAD capabilities with a demonstrated ability to get the right work done quickly and effectively. This person must have experience working in a multidisciplinary environment and producing top-notch CAD designs for spacecraft-class hardware. This person must be comfortable working with large databases with complex constraints—managing the full lifecycle of mechanical design data from concept through production release within Siemens NX and Teamcenter.

You will be embedded within a team of engineers driving the mechanical design of satellite systems—translating engineering intent into production-ready CAD models, drawings, and BOMs that flow cleanly through our product lifecycle management infrastructure. Your work directly enables the velocity of satellite development and production.

Export Control Requirement: Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Key job responsibilities
• CAD Design Creation & Management: Create, iterate, and manage CAD designs for large spacecraft system databases; maintain model integrity across complex assemblies with hundreds of interdependent components
• Drawing Production & Release: Manage the creation, checking, issuing, and revision of engineering drawings for parts and assemblies—ensuring compliance with Leo drawing standards and GD&T best practices
• BOM Lifecycle Management: Manage CAD BOM through the product lifecycle management system (Teamcenter); ensure BOM accuracy from design through release to manufacturing
• Multidisciplinary Collaboration: Work with a team of engineers across multiple disciplines—mechanical, thermal, electrical, structural, manufacturing, metrology, tooling, assembly, and test—in the ideation and creation of system concepts
• Supplier & Vendor Interface: Engage with suppliers and vendors as needed for CAD definition of sourced components and systems; develop procurement-ready technical data packages
• Manufacturing Source Review: Work with procurement and sourcing in identification and review of manufacturing sources; ensure designs are optimized for producibility
• Configuration Control: Support change management workflows, revision control, and design data integrity within the PLM ecosystem
• Database Organization: Maintain CAD database organization, naming conventions, and file management standards to enable team-wide efficiency at scale

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering, or 1+ years of electrical or mechanical engineering experience
- 3+ years of CAD experience in complex mechanical/electro-mechanical assemblies, machines, structures, or systems
- 1+ years of experience in the creation, manipulation, iteration, and optimization of mechanical designs with complex interactions and constraints
- 1+ years of experience interfacing with a range of engineering disciplines, and understanding the scope of those inputs and requirements

Preferred qualifications

- Expert-level capability with Siemens NX (4+ years of experience in advanced CAD assemblies)
- Manufacturing and test knowledge (forming, machining, finishing, tooling, assembly, testing)
- Awareness of adhesives, finishes, material properties, and selection criteria that influence selection for harsh environments (space-grade thermal cycling, radiation, vacuum)
- Experience optimizing design features for part cost (material handling, manufacturing, finishing, measurement)
- Hands-on experience with manufacturers, machinists, and part producers
- Experience developing fabrication drawings for a range of manufacturing methods (rapid prototyping, machining, forming, composite manufacturing)
- Experienced in CAD database management, CAD Bill of Materials management, and Product Life Cycle Management (PLM) using Teamcenter
- Experience with change control and management through ERP/MRP systems to manufacturing/assembly personnel
- Hands-on support in prototyping, assembly, and test
- Excellent CAD database organization and management skills
- Organized, with demonstrable ability to set priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced satellite development environment

title: Manager, Programmatic Solutions Consultants, Amazon Ads
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Ads is seeking an experienced Manager for our Programmatic Solutions Consultants team to join our growing business based in Chicago.

Amazon Ads helps brands create experiences that delight customers and deliver meaningful results. With 300+ million worldwide active customer accounts, and first-party insights based on shopping, streaming and browsing signals, brands can craft relevant campaigns that enhance customer experiences. Our solutions on Amazon.com, services like Twitch, IMDb TV, Alexa, Amazon Music, and partnerships with third-party publishers and exchanges make Amazon Ads the ultimate amplifier for brands to reach the right audiences in the right places, both on and off Amazon.

Our programmatic advertising platform, the Amazon Demand Side Platform (DSP), is becoming increasingly popular with major advertisers and agencies worldwide. We believe we understand e-commerce advertising better than anybody else and want to turn it into a science of its own that all users can leverage for their programmatic advertising.

As a manager, you will own a critical portion of our DSP Services team, which works with enterprise customer and direct advertiser. You will own a team of Programmatic Solutions Consultants with expertise in advertising technology, programmatic advertising, and the Amazon DSP, who are leveraging this expertise to develop our customers into proficient users. Your team provides services ranging from custom training programs, to product and campaign strategy sessions, to technical troubleshooting. We help our customers understand how to integrate our technology into their workflow, driving self-sufficiency within the Amazon DSP.

You have experience managing a team and are able to work and inspire directly and indirectly across the US and WW teams. You have a great track record of delivering complex projects and have impressed your stakeholders at all levels with your ability to communicate both written and verbally. You have demonstrated problem-solving capabilities across both technical and non-technical teams. The right candidate also possesses strong analytical acumen and is comfortable drawing metric-based conclusions by managing an extensive amount of data. You stay on top of industry and competitive trends, and you are able to execute at both a tactical and strategic level to drive customer satisfaction.


Key job responsibilities
- Navigate a high level of ambiguity. You love whitespace, and treat this space as your own company. You identify key business problems to prioritize then present the solutions to solve them on behalf of the business.
- Take ownership of managing a team of Programmatic Solutions Consultants, including resource planning and driving success for the team’s customer category, possessing a complete understanding of internal and external variables that impact the business
- Work tactically and strategically. Determines the right strategy and where to simplify or extend solutions for the best outcome of the assigned category
- Be comfortable working with data to develop new opportunity areas, track program metrics, and use findings to influence business decisions
- Set goals and direction for the team, ensuring alignment with broader business goals and vision
- Hire, develop, and lead a team of technical and non-technical Programmatic Solutions Consultants
- Thrive on technology and data and have expertise in monitoring and managing a services organization to maximum efficiency, productivity, and quality.
- Generate and implement big ideas to drive business improvement, innovation, and scale within the team and across the business as a whole. Lead cross functional collaboration to get big ideas implemented.
- Anticipate bottlenecks, assess risks, mitigate issues, provide escalation management, anticipate and make trade-offs
- Have strong communication skills and experience working across diverse stakeholder groups
- Represent Amazon when meeting with senior executive teams from top customers and build long term strategic relationships

A day in the life
- You lead the frontline team tasked with enabling trading desk customers to be successful in using the Amazon DSP.
- As a results-oriented supervisor, you attend a meeting with client leadership to review customer certification and support plans.
- You join a call with Ad Tech Sales stakeholders to determine strategy and coverage for specific accounts.
- You meet with Product and partner teams to review a document you and your team wrote, proposing feature upgrades to unblock customer needs and influence roadmap prioritization.
- You attend a one-on-one with a direct report, and discuss where they are headed in their career path, as well as the rollout of a new tool
- You prepare your section of a weekly business review document, to review data-driven insights and spark discussion with leadership on team wins and areas for improvement.

About the team
- Here at Amazon Ads, we embrace our differences. We are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion. We have 13 employee-led affinity groups, reaching 40,000 employees in over 190 chapters globally. We have innovative benefit offerings, and host annual and ongoing learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences. Amazon’s culture of inclusion is reinforced within our 16 Leadership Principles, which remind team members to seek diverse perspectives, learn and be curious, and earn trust.
- Our team puts a high value on work-life balance. We believe striking the right balance between your personal and professional life is critical to life-long happiness and fulfillment. We offer flexibility in working hours and encourage you to find your own balance between your work and personal lives.
- Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. - We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects based on what will help each team member develop into a better-rounded professional and enable them to take on more complex tasks in the future.

Basic qualifications

- Experience in digital advertising and client facing roles with a focus on data analysis
- Experience analyzing data and best practices to assess performance drivers
- Experience influencing internal and external stakeholders
- Bachelor's degree
- 6+ years of relevant professional experience
- 3+ years of direct management experience
- Experience in written and oral communication, including the ability to communicate with all levels in the organization (technical, business, executive)
- Experience leading prioritization of tasks, team scheduling, time management, and meeting deadlines
- Experience working in fast paced environments, and managing workload even during times of stress, or escalated activity

Preferred qualifications

- 5+ years of work in a management position with 5 or more direct reports experience
- Experience communicating results to senior leadership, or experience working in a fast-paced and ambiguous environment
- Experience in account management, brand management, performance marketing, digital marketing, sales or consulting
- Experience in an online advertising role and have familiarity with advertising products and ad serving technologies
- Experience using data, reporting, or tools to measure performance and make adjustments accordingly

- Experience in e-commerce, retail or advertising

title: Sales Representative, BRA CSC - Vaga Afirmativa para Mulheres, AGS LATAM Brazil CSC
descriptionHtml:
A Amazon Web Services (AWS) está buscando profissionais para integrar a equipe de vendas Cloud Sales Center (CSC) no Brasil, focada em aumentar a adoção da AWS em contas Enterprise e SMB.

Esta é uma requisição para múltiplas posições de vendas dentro da equipe CSC Brasil, incluindo:

• Representante de Vendas Internas (Inside Sales Representative) – Impulsionar o crescimento de receita por meio do engajamento com contas Enterprise, SMB Midsize e Startups execução de planos de território e aceleração da adoção da AWS através de vendas consultivas.
• Representante de Geração de Demanda (Demand Generation Representative) – Planejar e executar campanhas de geração de demanda que conectam empresas com soluções AWS, em parceria com equipes de vendas, marketing e desenvolvimento de negócios para identificar oportunidades de alto impacto.
• Gerente de Território (Partner Territory Manager) – Impulsionar a aquisição de clientes e o crescimento de receita por meio de Parceiros no segmento de pequenas empresas, desenvolvendo planos de negócios sell-through e viabilizando soluções lideradas por parceiros.





Key job responsibilities
• Desenvolver e executar planos de território/campanha para acelerar a adoção dos serviços AWS e impulsionar o crescimento de receita.
• Engajar com clientes e prospects por múltiplos canais (telefone, e-mail, reuniões online) para articular propostas de valor sobre os serviços AWS, incluindo Inteligência Artificial Generativa (GenAI).
• Colaborar com equipes multifuncionais (Gerentes de Conta, Arquitetas de Soluções, Parceiros, Marketing) para alinhar metas, mensagens e roteamento de leads.
• Gerenciar pipeline, acompanhar métricas de desempenho e atingir metas mensais/trimestrais/anuais de oportunidades qualificadas e receita.
• Para funções focadas em Parceiros: trabalhar com Parceiros para definir e implementar planos de desenvolvimento de negócios, impulsionar pipeline de oportunidades e ser responsável pela receita de vendas de parceiros e KPIs.
• Para funções de Geração de Demanda: executar campanhas direcionadas, desenvolver listas estratégicas de contatos e garantir que leads qualificados recebam acompanhamento oportuno.
• Manter dados precisos no Salesforce.com incluindo registros de clientes, logs de atividades e informações de oportunidades.


A day in the life
Você começará seu dia revisando métricas de pipeline e desempenho de campanhas, identificando oportunidades de otimização e planejando atividades de alcance. Ao longo do dia, você engajará com clientes, parceiros e stakeholders internos por diversos canais. Você colaborará com equipes regionais e parceiros para refinar estratégias, conduzir demonstrações de produtos e garantir que prospects avancem efetivamente pelo funil de vendas. Seu trabalho abrange múltiplas iniciativas simultâneas, exigindo que você equilibre prioridades enquanto mantém relacionamentos sólidos com stakeholders internos e externos. Todas as atividades devem ser registradas em nosso CRM.


About the team
• Diversidade de Experiências
A AWS valoriza experiências diversas. Mesmo que você não atenda a todas as qualificações preferenciais e habilidades listadas na descrição da vaga, encorajamos candidatas a se inscreverem. Se sua carreira está apenas começando, não seguiu um caminho tradicional ou inclui experiências alternativas, não deixe que isso impeça você de se candidatar.

• Por quê AWS?
A Amazon Web Services (AWS) é a plataforma de nuvem mais abrangente e amplamente adotada do mundo. Fomos pioneiras em computação em nuvem e nunca paramos de inovar — por isso clientes desde as startups mais bem-sucedidas até empresas do Global 500 confiam em nosso robusto conjunto de produtos e serviços para impulsionar seus negócios.

• Cultura de Equipe Inclusiva
A AWS valoriza a curiosidade e a conexão. Nossos grupos de afinidade liderados por funcionários e patrocinados pela empresa promovem a inclusão e empoderam nossas pessoas a terem orgulho do que nos torna únicos. Nossos eventos de inclusão fomentam equipes mais fortes e colaborativas. Nossa inovação contínua é impulsionada pelas ideias ousadas, perspectivas frescas e vozes apaixonadas que nossas equipes trazem para tudo o que fazemos.

• Mentoria e Desenvolvimento
Oferecemos compartilhamento de conhecimento, mentoria e recursos de desenvolvimento profissional para apoiar o crescimento de carreira.

• Equilíbrio Trabalho/Vida
Valorizamos a harmonia entre trabalho e vida pessoal. Buscamos flexibilidade como parte de nossa cultura de trabalho para que nossas pessoas possam ter sucesso profissional e pessoal.

- Experiência em vendas de tecnologia, desenvolvimento de negócios ou engenharia de vendas/consultoria.
- Experiência em navegar contas prospectivas desde e até o nível executivo sênior para identificar novas oportunidades de clientes.
- Fluência em inglês (fala, escrita e leitura).
- Experiência utilizando uma ferramenta de CRM (Customer Relationship Management).
- Graduação em área relevante ou experiência profissional equivalente.

Preferred qualifications

- Eexperiência com vendas diretas e planos de desenvolvimento de negócios.
- Experiência em vendas consultivas trabalhando com Parceiros por meio de gestão de contas, gestão de produtos, gestão de programas e engajamentos de desenvolvimento de negócios.
- Certificação em Vendas ou equivalente.
- Experiência utilizando Salesforce.
- Experiência com produtos e aplicações Microsoft Office.
- Conhecimento de tecnologias existentes e emergentes, incluindo computação em nuvem e Inteligência Artificial Generativa.
- Experiência em construir e executar campanhas GTM programáticas.
- Excelentes habilidades de apresentação, comunicação (oral e escrita) e construção de relacionamentos em todos os níveis de gestão.

title: Solutions Architect, Amazon Publisher Services
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Publisher Services (APS) helps digital publishers around the world build and grow thriving businesses. We provide services and advanced technologies to web, mobile app and advanced TV publishers of all sizes, including many of comScore’s global top 100, to help them monetize their content with demand from multiple buyers. Our server-side header bidding solutions are fast and reliable across devices, handling billions of queries per day, delivering ads in milliseconds. The result is more profitable advertising related systems for publishers and more relevant ads/content for customers.

We are seeking a seasoned Solutions Architect to help continue to scale and improve our publisher integrations across the APS ecosystem. In this role you will oversee launching, optimizing, and scaling technical integrations across web and mobile-inapp integrations. The ideal candidate will also bring experience in working with international customers, as well as experience and knowledge around international requirements such as GDPR.

Key job responsibilities
* Own and develop processes for providing technical solutions to publishers including evaluating, on-boarding, integrating, troubleshooting, and scaling.
* Identify areas for automation, improvement and scalability to support the technical integrations and work with the team to drive these to execution.
* Drive features to optimize integrations and improve operational excellence by collaborating with Engineering, Product, and Account teams.
* Be the voice of the publisher and translate partner feedback into product and engineering requirements.
* Own and analyze long-term vs. short-term opportunities and recommend the right trade-offs that will ultimately benefit our partners.
* Own technical agenda for business reviews with partners.
* Produce and oversee comprehensive technical documentation to simplify and scale partner integrations.
* Champion new product requirements and features for development.
* Be a subject matter expert on advertising integrations and handling privacy requirements such as GDPR.

Basic qualifications

- 2+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
- 4+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) experience
- 4+ Years of hands-on experience in solutions architecture, software development or ad ops at top-tier programmatic bidders (SSPs or DSPs).
- 4+ years of experience working with browser debugging tools such as Chrome Dev Tools, Charles Proxy or Wireshark.
- 4+ years of experience working with client-side web technologies such as JavaScript, HTML, CSS.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience working within software development or Internet-related industries
- Experience in written and verbal communication skills to communicate with technical and non-technical audiences, including senior leadership
- Knowledge of programmatic advertising space, including header bidding.
- Knowledge and experience working with international privacy requirements such as GDPR.
- Analytical and data-driven – familiarity with data analysis tools to process and analyze large data sets with AI or at least one database query language

title: Associate Account Executive , SMB
descriptionHtml:
This is not your typical entry-level sales role — it's a launchpad.

At Amazon, our peculiar culture and obsession with delighting customers extends to everything we do, including what we call our teams. While the industry knows this role as a SDR, BDR, Associate Account Executive, Amazon's customer-first DNA means we call our team members "Customer Acquisition Representatives" (CARs). It's more than a name, it reflects our belief that every interaction should start and end with the customer. As a CAR, you'll accelerate pipeline growth, navigate complex customer landscapes, shift gears between strategic thinking and high-impact execution, and put customers in the driver's seat of their cloud journey. Every CAR needs fuel, yours will be curiosity, coaching, and the full support of the world's leading cloud platform.

As a CAR, you will take the lead in unlocking growth potential for both new and existing AWS customers. We are one of the principal sources of new pipeline that fuels the AWS engine – engaging the unengaged accounts and contacts to drive pipeline that turns into revenue. Using cutting-edge AI tools and data-driven insights, you'll identify whitespace opportunities and develop innovative strategies to reach unengaged accounts at scale. You'll be part of shaping how technology is deployed across thousands of organizations, from enabling rapid, individually customized cancer treatments to helping Fortune 500 companies meet their carbon emissions goals. The AWS technology stack is the backbone of some of the most innovative solutions to the world's most pressing problems.

Your career path is clear. This role is designed as the entry point into AWS's North American sales organization. We don't need the perfect candidate, but we do want people who are curious, coachable, and willing to learn. We've developed hundreds of early-career professionals into full cycle sellers as Cloud Sales Representatives (CSRs), many within 18–24 months. You'll be paired with mentors and have access to structured development programs that accelerate your growth from day one.

According to Gartner, AWS is the leading cloud provider in both ability to execute and completeness of vision. With only 5% of all IT spend in the cloud, we are still in the early stages of what is possible, and with the explosion of generative AI, the opportunity has never been larger. You'll be at the forefront, equipped with the most advanced AI-powered sales technology in the industry. Consider this your pit crew advantage — the tools, training, and teammates that keep you performing at your best.


Key job responsibilities
•Partner closely with Account Teams to develop a deep understanding of the primary industries, accounts, and personas within your territories — building relationships from technical admins to Line of Business executives.
•Lead top-of-funnel activity: conduct high-quality account research and source net-new contacts at scale to execute high-volume prospecting, lead qualification, and opportunity generation across your assigned territories.
•Drive net-new business via customer acquisition by leveraging one-to-one and one-to-many outbound campaigns, in addition to qualifying leads from marketing and partner channels.
•Expand services breadth and consumption within your existing customer base via account planning and territory management.
•Deliver results against input and output goals, including: contacts sourced, leads qualified, customer calls completed, meetings scheduled, and opportunities created and launched.
•Leverage AI-powered sales intelligence platforms, predictive analytics, and automation tools to identify high-propensity accounts, prioritize outreach, and optimize pipeline development in Salesforce.
•Stay ahead of the curve with next-generation engagement strategies using generative AI, agentic workflows, and advanced personalization engines — you'll be on the cutting edge of how AI transforms B2B sales, continuously testing and iterating on new approaches to reach unengaged accounts.
•Collaborate with teammates to share best practices, contribute to team learning, and collectively raise the bar for customer engagement.

We know great candidates don't always check every box. If you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't perfectly match, we encourage you to apply.


About the team
Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in a relevant field or equivalent work experience
- 2+ year(s) of experience in sales, business development, lead generation, or customer-facing roles (internships and non-traditional experience count)

Preferred qualifications

- 1+ years of experience in technology sales, SaaS, or cloud services
- Experience with outbound prospecting tools and techniques (cold calling, social selling, email sequencing)
- Experience leveraging or interest in leveraging AI tools to enhance sales workflows, research, and outreach

Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

The base salary range for this position is listed below. Your Amazon package will include sign-on payments, restricted stock units (RSUs), and sales incentives. Final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, qualifications, and location. Amazon also offers comprehensive benefits including health insurance (medical, dental, vision, prescription, Basic Life & AD&D insurance and option for Supplemental life plans, EAP, Mental Health Support, Medical Advice Line, Flexible Spending Accounts, Adoption and Surrogacy Reimbursement coverage), 401(k) matching, paid time off, and parental leave. title: Senior Program Manager, Bespoke Solutions
descriptionHtml:
The Bespoke Solutions Teams is looking for an experienced Senior Program Manager to own contractor operations, vendor management, and lab/manufacturing coordination for a high-assurance hardware program within AWS Infrastructure Services — the team building security and encryption devices for government customers.

This is a hands-on operational leadership role. You will consolidate contractor hiring and management, own vendor and license agreements, and serve as the operational backbone that lets our senior engineers stay focused on delivery. You will be the connective tissue across engineering, supply chain, security, and external manufacturing partners — removing friction and reducing key-person dependencies on a fast-moving classified program.

You will own the end-to-end contractor lifecycle, manage vendor and license agreements, coordinate contract manufacturing (including onboarding a new contract manufacturer), and serve as the lab owner. Your success is measured by smooth operational execution, reduced administrative load on engineering leads, and reliable delivery of contractor and manufacturing support as the program scales toward production.

If Arlington, VA (Arlington HQ2):

This role will sit in our new headquarters in Northern Virginia, where Amazon will invest $2.5 billion dollars, occupy 4 million square feet of energy efficient office space, and create at least 25,000 new full-time jobs. Our employees and the neighboring community will also benefit from the associated investments from the Commonwealth including infrastructure updates, public transportation improvements, and new access to Reagan National Airport.

By working together on behalf of our customers, we are building the future one innovative product, service, and idea at a time. Are you ready to embrace the challenge? Come build the future with us.

This position requires that the candidate selected must be a US Citizen and currently possess and maintain an active TS/SCI security clearance. The position further requires that, after start, the selected candidate obtain and maintain an active TS/SCI security clearance with polygraph or commensurate clearance for each government agency for which they perform AWS work.

Key job responsibilities
Contractor & Resource Management

- Consolidate contractor hiring and management responsibilities.
- Own the end-to-end contractor lifecycle — sourcing, onboarding, performance tracking, and off-boarding
- Reduce key-person dependencies by establishing repeatable contractor management processes

Vendor, License & Lab Ownership

- Manage vendor and license agreements
- Take ownership of the unclassified lab and similar work-streams
- Serve as the lab owner

Contract Manufacturing

- Own contract manufacturing for the program, including onboarding a new contract manufacturer
- Handle associated administrative tasks including purchasing coordination.
- Partner with supply chain and manufacturing teams to keep prototype and production builds on schedule

Cross-Organization Coordination

- Partner with engineering, systems engineering, security, and leadership to keep operational execution tight
- Serve as primary operational liaison for contractor, vendor, and manufacturing matters
- Provide program status, risk, and resourcing visibility to engineering leads and program leadership

A day in the life
You will join a team within AWS Infrastructure Services that designs, develops, and delivers high-assurance security and encryption hardware for highly regulated government use cases. The team executes against a multi-year roadmap spanning hardware, firmware, programmable logic, and systems engineering — with a growing contractor base and expanding manufacturing footprint. This Program Manager role is the operational anchor that keeps contractor, vendor, and manufacturing execution running smoothly as the program scales from prototype into production.

About the team
About AWS

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Why AWS?

Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge-sharing and mentorship. Our senior members enjoy one-on-one mentoring and thorough, but kind, code reviews. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects that help our team members develop your engineering expertise so you feel empowered to take on more complex tasks in the future.

AWS Infrastructure Services (AIS)

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

Diverse Experiences

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Inclusive Team Culture

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship & Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in supply chain, business, engineering, finance or related technical or quantitative field
- 7+ years of program or project management experience
- Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
- Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
- Experience managing contractors, vendors, and/or external manufacturing partners
- Experience managing vendor and license agreements and purchasing/procurement coordination
- Current, active US Government Security Clearance of Top Secret with SCI eligibility or above

Preferred qualifications

- PMP, or Master's degree
- Experience in regulatory compliance management with government agencies
- Experience in a hardware, FPGA, or manufacturing program environment
- Experience onboarding and managing contract manufacturers (CM/NPI)
- Experience owning lab operations and badge/facility access ownership

title: Transportation Associate
descriptionHtml:
Are you ready to help Amazon deliver world class service in its transportation operations? Transportation Associates will perform trailer moves in the trailer yard, coordinate yard activities (such as checking in trailers, traffic flow, internal communications with operations, etc.), conduct yard audits, complete applicable driver training programs (Hostler, Commercial Driver’s License (CDL) School, etc.), and operate multiple vehicle types based on business need (including but not limited to hostlers and day cabs) to support Amazon’s transportation network. Benefits of being a Transportation Associate include the opportunity to work outside and understand the new and exciting world of transportation operations.
As a Transportation Associate you will:
• Make safety a priority by adhering to company rules and regulations. You will follow and enforce safety measures and policies to all who operate vehicles on behalf of Amazon and those who enter the yard, including vendors and senior team members
• Perform various functions within the yard, support site operations teams, internal transportation field teams, and external carriers, as needed, to ensure all trailers arrive and depart on time with zero defects and to maintain workflow for buildings.
• Be professionally trained to operate Commercial Motor Vehicles (CMVs) on non-public roads or in yard to move trailers to/from dock and parking locations.
• Learn Department of Transportation (DOT) regulations and comply with company policies, procedures of those DOT regulations (size, weight, route designations, parking, trailer designations, violation and incident reporting requirements, break periods, etc.)
• Complete driver vehicle inspection reports on equipment and notify managers of any maintenance or delivery issues encountered.
• Follow hostler and delivery schedules, track and report working hours and breaks at appropriate times in compliance with Amazon policy and federal and state regulations, adhere to yard safety policies, obey all applicable traffic laws, and drive in accordance with weather/road conditions.
• Support the business on an as needed basis by serving as a peer trainer and/or working at nearby site locations within the area
• Drive, maneuver, and load/unload a truck using approved equipment (pallet jack, etc.).
What else does the team have to offer? We’re glad you asked!
• Opportunity to work outside and drive different commercial motor vehicles in the yard and over the road
• Exposure to different Amazon site types including NACF, NASC, Air, AMZL & AMXL.
• Long-term growth potential via comprehensive training in transportation with Amazon.
• Dependent on business need, you may have the opportunity to earn your Commercial Driver’s License (CDL) paid for by Amazon.

Join ATS! ATS is one of the fastest growing business lines within Amazon over the past 5 Years with continued growth to come!

If requested due to business need, Transportation Associates must obtain their Commercial Driver’s License (CDL) and Driver Qualification File (DQF) and utilize it as a condition of the role, paid for by Amazon. If Associate is requested to become CDL and DQF certified to drive Over-the-Road for Amazon, this position becomes regulated by the Department of Transportation (DOT) and follows regulations issued by the DOT’s Federal Motor Carrier Safety Administration (FMCSA). Candidate must hold a valid driver’s license for the state in which they reside and be eligible to drive in accordance with DOT requirements. For Department of Labor/Federal Motor Carrier Safety Administration roles (roles for which you receive a CDL), English proficiency is required per federal regulation.
The timing of this requirement is dependent on business need. Continuing in the position with CDL and DQF certification is contingent upon the successful completion of a DOT-regulated pre-employment background screening, a DOT physical and Amazon’s pre-employment drug test.

• Hold a valid and active driver’s license
• High School or equivalent diploma
• Candidates must be 21 years or older with the ability to understand and adhere to all job requirement and safety guidelines in English.

• Work 40 hours/week, and overtime as required

• Excellent written and verbal communication and interpersonal skills with diverse audiences
• Experience building strong, collaborative relationships with colleagues and outside vendors

title: Software Development Engineer, Amazon Search Navigation AI
descriptionHtml:
The Amazon Search Navigation AI team helps customers go from a broad search intent to the few products that fit their needs, so they can make a confident purchase decision. We generate highly relevant, context-aware, and personalized search refinements. We also decide the order they appear in across Amazon's Search Navigation experiences, guiding customers to the most relevant results. The team owns Search Navigation's P0 metrics and defect guardrails, which keep performance and reliability high for hundreds of millions of customers.


We are reinventing search refinement with generative AI. Our recently launched Smart Refinement experience uses large language models (LLMs) served online to turn product specifications into natural-language suggestions that match how customers think, such as "for colder weather" or "lightweight for travel." Each suggestion is personalized to the customer's context. Next, we are building multi-turn, conversational refinement, where each interaction builds on the last and helps customers narrow their intent in fewer steps.

We build and run the engineering systems behind this work, including the Navigation Experience Service (NES). NES connects to Amazon's core search systems, serves more than 3 billion queries worldwide every day, and runs real-time LLM inference at global scale under strict latency and cost limits. Our platform supports launches of new navigation content and UIs, and it makes fast offline and online experimentation possible.

We are looking for a Software Development Engineer who is a pragmatic problem solver, comfortable with ambiguity, and curious about applied science. You will build and improve the Search Navigation platform, including the systems that serve LLMs in real time, and work closely with Applied Scientists to take new models from research into production.

Key job responsibilities
1. Design, build, and operate large-scale, distributed, low-latency services that power Amazon Search Navigation experiences worldwide
2. Build and optimize online LLM serving for Smart Refinement and multi-turn conversational refinement, with a focus on latency, reliability, and cost
3. Work with Applied Scientists, Product Managers, and Program Managers to define requirements and integrate models into production systems
4. Build scalable data pipelines that process large volumes of search and behavioral data for feature generation, model training, and evaluation
5. Design, run, and analyze online A/B experiments to measure the impact of new models and features
6. Contribute to operational excellence for critical services, including monitoring, on-call, and P0 metrics and defect guardrails
7. Write high-quality, well-tested code and take part in design and code reviews

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 3+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- 3+ years of software development engineer or related occupational experience
- 3+ years of designing and developing large-scale, multi-tiered, multi-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C#, C++, Java, or Perl experience
- 3+ years of Object Oriented Design experience
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
- Experience in developing and deploying LLMs in production on GPUs, Neuron, TPU or other AI acceleration hardware
- Experience in machine learning, data mining, information retrieval, statistics or natural language processing
- Experience with Machine Learning and Large Language Model fundamentals, including architecture, training/inference lifecycles, and optimization of model execution

Amazon’s Global Medical & Health (GMH) team is seeking a licensed physician to serve as Sub-Regional Medical Lead (SRML) for a geographic cluster of approximately to 10 Amazon sites in Mexico. This role is the designated clinical authority and Sanitary Officer —in accordance with the General Health Law and its applicable regulations— for all occupational medical services within the assigned sub-region, providing physician-level supervision of On-Site Medical Representatives (OMR)—Licensed Nurses and Nursing Technicians—and ensuring compliance with Mexican federal health and labor regulations.

The SRML addresses a critical regulatory gap: the Federal Labor Law (Article 504), NOM-019-SSA3-2013, and COFEPRIS requirements mandate continuous physician-led clinical supervision at each site. This role directly fulfills that obligation, serving as the authorized signatory for Operational Notices, nursing supervision per NOM-019-SSA3-2013, and all COFEPRIS regulatory documentation within the assigned zone.

You will work with the Regional Medical Lead to implement evidence-based health programs and standardize clinical protocols. You will supervise OMR teams and drive improvements in associate health outcomes and regulatory compliance posture.
They will assist with the implementation of programs at the site level, reporting directly to the Regional Medical Lead.


Key job responsibilities
As the Regional Occupational Health Physician, you will serve as the designated Sanitary Officer and clinical authority for all sites within your assigned sub-region. Your core responsibilities include:

Regulatory Compliance: Serve as the designated Sanitary Officer under the General Health Law and COFEPRIS requirements. Sign and maintain Operational Notices and regulatory documentation, ensure compliance with applicable NOMs and labor/health laws, conduct compliance audits, attend regulatory inspections, and safeguard clinical records and personal data.

Clinical Supervision of OMR Operations: Provide direct physician supervision (NOM-019-SSA3-2013) to nursing staff in AMCARE spaces, act as the clinical authority for diagnoses, restrictions, and prescriptions, oversee daily OMR activities, and review Return-to-Work plans, fitness-for-duty determinations, and workplace accident management.

Medication Governance: Establish a formal medication approval process aligned with COFEPRIS, standardize formularies across the sub-region, approve clinical protocols for medication administration, and audit medication and controlled-substance records.

Epidemiological Surveillance & Prevention: Execute occupational surveillance programs, implement prevention campaigns based on regional data, lead vaccination and early-detection drives, and support heat-stress and exposure-control strategies in coordination with WHS.

Medical Surveillance & Occupational Health Exams: Support surveillance programs (NOM-030-STPS-2009 / RFSST), periodic health exams, pre-employment and fitness-for-duty assessments, biological monitoring, and PPE compliance, while ensuring medical record confidentiality.

OMR Team Development: Mentor and train OMR staff, standardize clinical protocols and documentation across the sub-region, and ensure competency in emergency equipment, inventory management, and Safety and Hygiene Committee participation.

Strategic Leadership: Participate in Monthly Business Reviews, collaborate with WHS, PXT, Operations, and Legal, support the Regional Medical Lead's national agenda, and drive improvements in associate health outcomes and attrition mitigation.

This role requires regular travel (60–80%) within the assigned sub-region of Mexico.

A day in the life
No two days look exactly alike in this role, but here's a glimpse of what yours might involve:

You start your morning reviewing overnight incident reports and care statistics across the sites in your sub-region. A workplace injury was logged at one location last night, so you connect with the OMR nurse on site to review the initial care documentation, confirm the ST-7 was properly managed, and begin coordinating a Return-to-Work plan that aligns the associate's medical restrictions with available job functions.

Mid-morning, you travel to one of your assigned sites for a scheduled compliance audit. Walking the AMCARE space, you verify that the infrastructure and equipment meet NOM-005-SSA3-2018 requirements, review clinical records for traceability and retention compliance, and spot-check medication logs and controlled-substance documentation. You identify a minor deviation in the formulary and work with the nursing staff on a corrective action plan on the spot.

Over lunch, you join a remote Monthly Business Review, presenting your sub-region's health metrics, injury/illness trends, and compliance status to leadership — and flagging an emerging musculoskeletal trend that you recommend addressing with a targeted ergonomics prevention campaign.

In the afternoon, you provide clinical supervision and mentorship to the OMR team: reviewing a complex fitness-for-duty case that exceeds their scope, validating a medical clearance for work at heights, and running a short teaching session on NOM-035 mental health screening and referral pathways. You close the day collaborating with WHS and PXT colleagues on a heat-stress mitigation strategy for the upcoming season, and reviewing a Privacy Notice update to ensure associate health data stays protected.

Throughout it all, you are the clinical and regulatory anchor for your region — balancing hands-on physician leadership with the strategic, preventive, and compliance work that keeps associates healthy and sites compliant.

About the team
Inclusive team culture
 
At Amazon we embrace our differences and we are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion. We host annual and ongoing learning experiences. Amazon’s culture of inclusion is reinforced within our 14 Leadership Principles, which remind team members to seek diverse perspectives, learn and be curious, and earn trust.  
 
Work Life Balance
 
We believe striking the right balance between your personal and professional life is critical to life-long happiness and fulfillment. We offer flexibility in working hours and encourage you to find your own balance between your work and personal lives.  
 
Mentorship & Career Growth
 
Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects based on what will help each team member develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic qualifications

- Experience working to appropriate health & safety standards and regulations
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English, and have the ability to take direction in English
- - Medical degree from a Mexican institution recognized by the Ministry of Public Education (SEP)
- - Valid Professional License issued by the General Directorate of Professions
- - Specialty or postgraduate training in Occupational Medicine, Epidemiology, or Public Health
- - Legally authorized to sign regulatory filings and assume personal legal responsibility for health operations across multiple sites
- - Minimum 2 years of occupational health experience.
- - Experience providing physician supervision of nursing staff in a clinical or occupational health setting
- - Willingness to travel 60–80% within Mexico

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in operations management
- - Prior experience as COFEPRIS Sanitary Officer
- - Experience with IMSS regulatory processes including workplace accident reporting and ST form management
- - Knowledge of the Regulation of the General Health Law on Medical Care Services and NOM-005-SSA3-2018 (infrastructure and equipment for ambulatory care facilities)
- - Experience supporting occupational epidemiological surveillance programs
- - Experience with clinical auditing, quality assurance, and continuous improvement methodologies
- - Knowledge of NOM-019-STPS-2011 (Safety and Hygiene Committees) and its application in operational environments
