title: Commissioning Engineer, AWS Commissioning, AMER-West
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Are you experienced in Critical Infrastructure Commissioning and looking for a fast paced environment to work in? As a Data Center Commissioning Engineer (CxE), you will be part of highly creative, efficient team tasked with tackling fascinating and challenging problems building and supporting the operations of Amazon owned data centers. The Amazon Commissioning team (ACx) understands, evaluates, defines and manages the expectations of construction quality in accordance to engineering designs to meet the customer requirements. The CxE is responsible for supporting vendors, contractors, and other teams involved in the construction and commissioning of various systems such as:

-Medium and low voltage power systems
-Generators
-UPS
-HVAC (Air Handlers / Exhaust Fans / VFD)
-Chilled Water Systems
-Building Management systems (BMS)
-Electrical Power Monitoring Systems (EPMS)
-Testing and balancing
-Pumps and Hydronic systems

Physical Requirements
Walk job sites in uneven terrain
Work at heights and from ladders
Regularly walk, use hands and fingers, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl
Lift and/or move up to 49 pounds; and participate in group lifts for 50 pounds or more
Carry objects weighing up to 49 pounds for short distances
Work shifts longer than eight hours in duration with potential for night and weekends
Perform physical tasks throughout the day without becoming overly tired
Ability to manipulate small wires and objects easily
Work in a noisy environment
Work in environments that are colder or hotter than a normal office environment

Additional Job Requirements
· Ability and willingness to travel domestic and internationally for up to 80% of the year.
· Hold a US passport or have the ability to acquire one.
· Required to provide personal transportation for meetings and job visits away from the office; reimbursed.

U.S Citizenship Required

Key job responsibilities
The Commissioning Engineer (CxE) provides testing and validation oversight of AWS data center electrical and mechanical infrastructure. CxEs review design documents, lead Factory Witness Testing (FWT), and manage third-party commissioning vendors in the performance of onsite pre-functional, functional, and integrated systems testing. They take Ownership of their projects’ successes by Diving Deep to resolve technical issues and having Bias for Action to address everchanging schedule and coordination demands onsite. Additionally, CxEs communicate lessons learned and continuously collaborate on program improvements.

The CxE shall provide multi-discipline input into the scheduling, test script development, designing, and planning of projects. In addition, the CxE will be required to review component submittal packages, lead Factory Witness Testing (FWT), perform system level and integrated system testing. During commissioning the CxE will continuously audit activities to ensure compliance with environmental, quality, and safety requirements. Additionally, the individual will be responsible for comprehensive weekly reporting of status of all ongoing projects and lessons learned to continually improve the quality of our program. This position will include coverage of multiple inflight projects and short timelines.

A day in the life
On a typical project, the CxE works across AWS engineering, capacity delivery, operations, and contractor teams to coordinate site activities, prioritize tasks, and ensure each issue has clear path to resolution. The CxE manages the project commissioning vendor whose primary scope is to identify issues, determine criticality, propose solutions, and document their findings. If project turnover is at risk, the CxE escalates to the appropriate stakeholders. Upon project completion, the CxE will communicate lessons learned to help peers on similar projects in flight and participate in initiatives that drive improvement to the commissioning program.

About the team
The AWS Data Center Commissioning Team (ACx) is a wholly independent business within the DCGS organization. This team of veteran professional Electrical Engineers, Mechanical Engineers, Controls Engineers, Architectural Engineers, Project Managers, Operators and seasoned Amazonians are uniquely positioned to provide deeply detailed engineering and operational review and testing of equipment designs, operational functionality and construction practices. We are focused on ensuring the rapid delivery of a quality product while maintaining full transparency, recording metrics of manufacturer/contractor/equipment issues pre-PFHO, and identifying opportunities for all our peers and customers.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

#DCCD_AMER

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of engineering, installation, or startup/commissioning of electrical and mechanical systems experience
- Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical/Electrical Engineering or 5 years of relevant discipline work experience
- High technical competency in either mechanical or electrical or control systems utilized in critical infrastructures, with the capability to learn and be trained in the others.
- Understand the design concept and intent by reviewing mechanical or electrical design documentation, including drawings, specifications, vendor submittals and sequences of operations and provide feedback on the same in accordance with Amazon standards for basis of design.
- Develop but majorly review commissioning documentation such as test plans, scripts and reports developed by vendors to ensure accuracy in accordance with the design requirements.

Preferred qualifications

- Advanced knowledge Microsoft Office Suite - Word, Excel, Outlook required; advanced knowledge of SharePoint (or similar) preferred
- Strong communication skills, detail oriented, highly organized, and able to work in high stress environments to maintain calm and respectful interaction with multiple teams
- Advanced knowledge of mechanical, electrical, and controls systems for critical infrastructures
- Ability to read and edit construction documents (design drawings, control diagrams, specifications, etc.)
- Experience developing and executing test procedures for mechanical or electrical systems/components based on design intent and approved equipment submittals

title: Software Development Engineer II, AWS Vulnerability Management - Remediation Engineering (PitCrew), Remediation Engineering Team (PitCrew), AWS Vulnerability Management (AVM)
descriptionHtml:
At Amazon Web Services (AWS), Security is our highest priority. AWS Vulnerability Management (AVM) is accountable for the end to end vulnerability lifecycle across all of AWS: finding, contextualizing, and assessing vulnerabilities, and driving remediation at machine speed, without manual work from builders and at the lowest cost to AWS.

The Remediation Engineering Team (PitCrew) builds and operates the capabilities that close the gap between a finding being known and it being gone. Our mandate is to automate mitigation, remediation, and assessment. We develop capabilities for mitigation and remediation outside of patching: recognizing potentially vulnerable and unused software components and retiring them on behalf of service teams, delivering remediations to builders as changes they can review and approve, and acting on hosts and their payloads within minutes when a patch is unavailable or too slow. We also build the tooling AVM security engineers use to codify, classify, and track the blockers that keep service teams from remediating on time, and the automation behind assessment and attestation: contextualizing findings with asset-level signals such as network reachability and compensating controls so that severity reflects true risk and every critical finding is a true critical, attesting to accepted residual risk, and generating evidence of those decisions continuously for auditors and customers.

As a Software Development Engineer II on PitCrew, you will design, build, and operate services that act on hosts and containers across AWS at fleet scale. You will own features end to end: working with security engineers to understand a problem, writing the design, implementing it, deploying it, and operating what you ship. The work sits at the intersection of distributed systems, host and container internals, and security, and much of it is about making changes to production systems safely and reversibly at scale.

Key job responsibilities
- Design, implement, and operate services and automation that mitigate, remediate, and assess vulnerabilities across AWS fleets, reducing the attack surface and mean time to remediate without a human in the loop.
- Build the contextualization that turns raw findings into accurate, prioritized risk for builders, so service teams act on true criticals first.
- Own the full lifecycle of your software: requirements, design reviews, implementation, testing, deployment, metrics, alarms, and on-call.
- Build tooling that security engineers use daily, and work closely with them to turn investigation, remediation, assessment, and attestation workflows into software.
- Make changes to production hosts and containers safe by default: reversible, observable, attested, and gated appropriately.
- Raise the bar on operational excellence through metrics, dashboards, and continuous improvement of the systems you own.
- Mentor other engineers and contribute to the team's technical direction through design reviews and documentation.

A day in the life
You will spend most of your time designing and writing software, reviewing designs and code from teammates, and working with AVM security engineers and the partner teams that consume what we build. You will participate in the team's on-call rotation for the services we operate.

title: Sr. Product Designer, Prime Video Experience Design
descriptionHtml:
Are you interested in shaping the future of live entertainment experiences?

Prime Video is redefining how customers discover, follow, and engage with the content and moments that matter most to them. Across live sports, breaking news, linear channels, and special events, we are creating more intuitive, personalized, and connected ways for customers to find what is happening now, understand why it matters, and stay engaged before, during, and after the live experience.

The Prime Video Experience Design (PVXD) studio is seeking a strategic, hands-on Senior Product Designer to help define the next generation of live and intelligent entertainment experiences. You will lead high-impact design initiatives across sports, news, and live TV categories, shaping how customers move from discovery and anticipation to live viewing, catch-up, and re-engagement.

This role is ideal for a senior individual contributor who thrives in ambiguity, combines strong product thinking with exceptional interaction design craft, and can turn emerging opportunities into tangible customer experiences. You will partner closely with Product, Engineering, Research, Science, and Design teams to develop experience visions, build interactive prototypes, test hypotheses, and influence product direction.

You are equally comfortable framing a long-term customer vision, designing polished cross-device interactions, and rapidly prototyping new approaches. You recognize that great live experiences are not only about what customers see, but how the product responds to context, timing, personal interests, and the unfolding story.

Key job responsibilities
- Lead end-to-end product design for high-impact initiatives across sports, news, live channels, and other real-time entertainment experiences.
- Define customer journeys and interaction patterns that connect live discovery, event anticipation, viewing, key moments, catch-up, and ongoing engagement.
- Translate ambiguous opportunities into clear customer problems, hypotheses, experience principles, and scalable design frameworks.
- Design intuitive, personalized experiences that help customers understand what is live, what matters now, and what to watch next.
- Explore AI-enabled and context-aware experiences, including personalized storytelling, recommendations, insights, and natural-language interactions, in close collaboration with technical partners.

A day in the life
As a Senior Product Designer on the Sports, News & Linear Experiences team, your work will span strategy, detailed product design, and hands-on experimentation.

One day, you may be shaping an intelligent live hub that helps customers navigate games, news coverage, channels, and special events. Another day, you may be prototyping how fans discover an important moment across simultaneous games, or exploring how a news viewer can quickly catch up on a developing story. You may work with engineers and scientists to test a context-aware experience using real signals, then translate those learnings into clear design direction.

You will own meaningful customer problems while collaborating across multiple initiatives and surfaces. Success requires strong individual design ownership, a bias toward learning through making, and the ability to bring clarity and alignment to complex, fast-moving opportunities.

- Experience designing data-rich and real-time interaction experiences

descriptionHtml:

We are looking for motivated, customer-focused individuals who want to join our team as an Area Manager. Amazon Supply Chain Services (ASCS) brings together Amazon Shipping, Amazon Freight, and Multi-Channel Fulfillment to transform how businesses move goods through Amazon's logistics and transportation network.

You'll design and implement lightweight mechanisms for regular planning, goal-setting, and portfolio management that accelerate our ability to respond to customer feedback and market opportunities. A day in the life
You might start the morning reviewing portfolio health and emerging dependencies before working with teams to unblock an at-risk initiative or refine plans for an upcoming quarterly planning cycle. title: Applied Scientist, Amazon Ads
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Ads runs one of the largest real-time decision systems in the world. To meet advertiser goals, we process >4 million ad requests per second, and this team decides which of them are worth the compute. We mine a petabyte-scale stream of traffic to tell in-demand, valuable requests apart from wasteful ones, filtering out the noise and forwarding only what brings value to advertisers, all within milli-seconds. Our solutions save millions in compute costs and drive long-term growth for Amazon's Retail and Marketplace businesses.

Why you'll love this role: The scientific challenge here is scale and signal: large-scale ML on enormous, high-velocity data, optimization and auction dynamics, and causal measurement of what actually moves the business. Generative AI and LLMs are tools you reach for when they help, not the point of the work. The impact also reaches beyond Amazon: we donated the Dynamic Traffic Engine (DTE) to the IAB Tech Lab as an open-source framework that lets demand-side platforms signal which bid requests they value, so supply-side platforms send fewer wasteful ones and QPS waste drops across the whole programmatic supply chain. We are a highly motivated, collaborative team with an entrepreneurial spirit and a broad mandate to experiment and innovate. You will work alongside talented engineers, product managers, and scientists in a culture that rewards bias for action, innovation, and experimentation. What makes this role unique is the combination of scientific rigor with real-world impact at a scale very few systems reach.

Your impact and career growth: Amazon Ads is investing heavily in AI and ML, creating room for scientists to innovate and make their mark. As an Applied Scientist, you will own the science for well-defined supply-optimization problems and take your work end to end, from framing the approach through experimentation and into production with measured business impact. You will partner closely with engineers to productionize your models and with product managers to tie your science to customer and advertiser outcomes. You will share your findings, begin to mentor teammates, and grow your influence on the team's technical direction over time. This is your opportunity to do high-rigor applied science in one of the fastest-growing businesses at Amazon.

Learn more about Amazon Ads: https://advertising.amazon.com/

Key job responsibilities
As an Applied Scientist in Amazon Ads, you will:

- Conduct hands-on data analysis and build large-scale ML models and pipelines for supply optimization.
- Take your models end to end, from proof of concept through experimentation, optimization, and deployment into production, working closely with software engineers to productionize them and with product managers and fellow scientists along the way.
- Design and run A/B experiments and causal analysis to validate hypotheses, draw insights from petabyte-scale data, and measure real business impact.
- Research and apply advanced ML, including generative AI and large language models, to demand prediction and traffic filtering.
- Drive end-to-end optimization projects that tackle ambiguous problems at massive scale, developing scalable, efficient processes for model development, validation, and deployment that optimize traffic monetization while maintaining customer experience.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of building models for business application experience
- PhD, or Master's degree and 4+ years of CS, CE, ML or related field experience
- Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language
- Experience in any of the following areas: algorithms and data structures, parsing, numerical optimization, data mining, parallel and distributed computing, high-performance computing

Preferred qualifications

- Experience using Unix/Linux
- Experience in professional software development

descriptionHtml:
Join Amazon’s mission to become Earth’s safest place to work! At Amazon, we’ve set the ambitious goal to become the benchmark of safety excellence across all industries in which we operate. As a WHS Manager, you'll be the site's safety champion, leading our Global WHS Program implementation. Your role bridges the gap between safety requirements and operational success, requiring both technical expertise and strong interpersonal skills. Working closely with Operations leadership, you'll drive safety initiatives that make a real difference. Strategic Partnership & Influence - Build partnerships with Operations leadership to integrate safety into every aspect of our business. descriptionHtml:
About US
Amazon Interactive Video Service (Amazon IVS) is AWS's fully managed live streaming service, built on the same battle-tested technology that powers Twitch and trusted by thousands of enterprises across gaming, social, live commerce, sports, and entertainment.

Our mission: enable developers to build communities around live video. We handle everything from ingest to processing to delivery at global scale, so developers can focus on creating interactive, engaging live experiences for their audiences. Whether you're streaming to tens of millions of concurrent viewers or just getting started, Amazon IVS removes the complexity so developers can move fast.

About The Role
As a Software Development Engineer on the Amazon IVS Control Plane team, you will build customer-facing experiences and highly scalable, reliable, and secure systems that power Amazon IVS.

The IVS Console is the primary interface through which customers configure, monitor, and manage their IVS resources, while the IVS Control Plane provides the APIs and backend systems that orchestrate those resources at AWS scale. You will work across both to build seamless end-to-end experiences for IVS customers. Your work will directly empower developers, broadcasters, and businesses around the world to deliver low-latency, interactive video experiences.

Key job responsibilities
- Design and develop intuitive user interfaces for the IVS Console using modern web technologies
- Design and develop scalable backend services and public APIs for Amazon IVS
- Build distributed systems that manage the configuration, orchestration, and lifecycle of live video streaming resources using TypeScript, Go or similar modern programming languages
- Define and maintain infrastructure using infrastructure as code practices, primarily with AWS CDK
- Work closely with engineers, product managers, UX designers, and applied scientists to deliver seamless customer experiences
- Ensure systems are highly available, scalable, and secure at AWS scale
- Apply engineering best practices across testing, performance optimization, observability, and code quality
- Collaborate with other AWS teams to integrate shared services and deliver consistent customer experiences across AWS services
- Participate in code reviews, architecture discussions, design reviews, and on-call rotations
- Drive operational excellence through automation, metrics, alarms, and runbooks

You might start the morning by checking how the service is running and investigating an issue that surfaced overnight. Later, you could join a design discussion for a new customer feature, thinking through the experience from the public API, console, all the way to the backend systems that make it work. After lunch, you might work through an interesting technical problem with a teammate, review a change, or meet with product to refine how a feature should work for customers. Some days are focused on building intuitive customer experiences, while others take you deep into distributed systems and large scale service operations. You’ll have the opportunity to follow problems across the stack and see the features you build through from idea to launch.

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience

- Experience building web applications with React and modern web technologies
- Experience with both frontend and backend development
- Experience building backend services using Go or similar modern programming languages
- Experience building/designing UIs with multilingual support in mind
- Experience with frontend security best practices

Preferred qualifications

- 4+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience

descriptionHtml:
アマゾンジャパン トランスポーテーション部門では常識を覆すような革新的な配送網を一緒に作り上げることに意欲的なシニアプログラムマネージャーを募集します。
アマゾンジャパンでは年々の売上増加に伴い、お客様への配送荷物数が増加しています。これからもお客様に確実に商品をお届けしていくために配送ネットワーク構築と強化を行っています。一方で、2024年問題と呼ばれる、トラックドライバーの働き方改革、人口減少、これらに付随する国内のトラック輸送力の相対的減少というチャレンジングな環境下にあります。当社は、“地球上で最もお客様を大切にする企業”をミッションに掲げる企業として、お客様の荷物をどこでも、迅速に、正確に、持続的に届けることを実現する、究極のイノベーターであり続けたいと考えています。
上記のような課題に対し、Chief Logistic Officer (CLO)チームのシニアプログラムマネージャーは、同社のロジスティクス最適化と輸送能力拡大への取り組みを牽引する重要な役割を担います。経営層への報告に加え、部門横断的な取り組みの調整、政府をはじめ対外的なステークホルダーとの対話、政策反映、提携/連携を目指し、Amazon Japanの野心的な成長目標をサポートします。

title: Senior UX Designer, Amazon Delivery Customer Experience
descriptionHtml:
Have you ever experienced the delight of knowing you'll get a delivery exactly when and how you wanted it? Amazon's Customer Experiences team (ADX CX) is seeking our next Senior UX Designer to build on this delight and reimagine how millions of customers engage with their purchases after checkout. In this role, you'll explore new ways for shoppers to understand and manage their orders, working directly with senior leaders and multi-disciplinary teams to connect evolving customer needs with emerging technologies. Your work will focus on crafting innovative features and scalable design systems that adapt to evolving expectations for convenience, control, and confidence in post-purchase experiences. By uncovering insights and crafting intuitive solutions, you'll help re-shape how people think about and interact with their orders - from the moment they complete a purchase until it arrives and what happens next - turning these all into moments customers can look forward to in shopping.

Key job responsibilities
As a key driver in designing solutions and up-leveling the quality of our customer experiences, you will:

• Quickly and thoroughly creating user flows, wire frames, visual designs, and prototypes to effectively concept and communicate detailed interaction behaviors that support decision making and development 
• Assess and optimize the effectiveness of new and existing features by proactively planning, performing, and advocating validation techniques like usability testing, user research, and interpreting analytic data.

About the team
The Amazon Delivery’s Customer Experience team (ADX CX) team is a diverse group of designers and researchers that share our experiences and help each other succeed. We operate within the broader Amazon Delivery Experience design organization that includes teams focused on operational and transportation experiences critical to the success of the holistic delivery journey. We value individuals who drive inspiration, collaboration, and connection by bringing their authentic selves to work and respecting everyone’s unique voices. We love complex problems, growing in fast-evolving environments, taking action, and learning from mistakes. We champion the customer voice (spoken and unspoken) through objective insights that inform the collective design and increase customer empathy across Amazon. Our creative work impacts millions of customers worldwide and we are proud to be a part of it.

title: Software Development Manager, Amazon Neptune
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Neptune is a fast, scalable, fully-managed graph database service that makes it easy to build and run applications that work with highly connected datasets. The core of Amazon Neptune is a purpose-built, high-performance graph database engine optimized for storing hundreds of billions of relationships and querying with milliseconds latency, allowing you to easily build queries that efficiently navigate highly connected datasets. Neptune works actively with the Apache TinkerPop Gremlin open-source project.

Neptune powers graph use cases such as recommendation engines, fraud detection, knowledge graphs, drug discovery, network security, and many more. Amazon Neptune is built for cloud scalability, durability, availability, and performance.

To learn more about Amazon Neptune visit: https://aws.amazon.com/neptune/

descriptionHtml:
Ubicación: Carretera el Salto 273. La Alameda Tlajomulco de Zuñiga 45679 Jalisco, Mexico.
Horario: Disponibilidad para rolar turnos día, noche y fines de semana

Nuestra misión en Amazon es ser la empresa más centrada en el cliente de la Tierra, y nuestro galardonado equipo de Reliability Maintenance Engineering es una parte clave para lograr ese objetivo. Amazon es una de las marcas más reconocidas en el mundo porque distribuimos millones de productos a nuestros clientes. Hacer nuestro mejor esfuerzo por nuestros clientes es de donde obtenemos nuestra energía, y es por eso que encontrará que abordamos las cosas de manera diferente aquí.

El equipo de Ingeniería de Mantenimiento y Confiabilidad (RME) de Amazon es fundamental para nuestras operaciones: son ellos quienes mantienen la maquinaria vital en funcionamiento en todo momento. Como técnico de RME, mantendrá una amplia gama de equipos y espacios de trabajo manteniendo al mismo tiempo las mejores prácticas de salud y seguridad. Ayudará a mantener seguros a sus colegas y evitará el tiempo de inactividad de la máquina. Nuestros técnicos de RME aumentan la disponibilidad y la calidad de nuestros equipos y también trabajan para mejorar el entorno operativo.

Key job responsibilities
- Tareas de mantenimiento proactivo y preventivo de una amplia gama de equipos de obra.
- Realizar reparaciones reactivas y diagnóstico de fallas en un centro de distribución en funcionamiento.
- Utilizar las herramientas más recientes para maximizar la efectividad del equipo.
- Mantener todas las políticas y prácticas de salud y seguridad.
- Apoyar el desarrollo y progresión de los aprendices en sitio.
- Trabajar en proyectos de mejora continua e implementar mejores prácticas en varios sitios en México.

A day in the life
Nuestros técnicos de RME están ubicados en el sitio para que puedan responder rápidamente a cualquier problema con la maquinaria. Llevará a cabo una serie de mantenimiento preventivo planificado en los equipos de nuestros sitios para garantizar que funcionen de manera segura. Como técnico de RME, también responderá con prontitud a las averías, investigando, encontrando e implementando soluciones lo más rápido posible. También hará sugerencias para mejoras a largo plazo.

Trabajando junto a colegas más experimentados, llevará a cabo tareas de mantenimiento diarias y se comunicará con contratistas si necesita experiencia externa. Podrá trabajar en una variedad de turnos para garantizar que nuestros sitios tengan soporte las 24 horas del día, lo que permitirá a Amazon realizar entregas a la velocidad por la que somos conocidos.

About the team
Nuestro equipo de Ingeniería de Mantenimiento y Confiabilidad o RME mantiene nuestros equipos funcionando con su mejor rendimiento. Somos un equipo con mentalidad técnica, formado por excelentes jugadores de equipo y guiados por líderes experimentados. Trabajamos juntos para mantener, solucionar problemas y reparar equipos en nuestra red global de centros de distribución. Algunos de nuestros empleados son líderes que supervisan el equipo mientras trabajan en tecnologías interesantes, algunas de las cuales solo existen en Amazon.

Desde la instalación de sistemas de embalaje automatizados hasta la supervisión del mantenimiento general de un sitio web y la reparación de equipos de distribución clave, nuestro equipo maneja la mayoría de los aspectos técnicos de Amazon. Esto incluye mantener los edificios cumpliendo con la ley, garantizar que todos estén seguros y que nuestros sitios funcionen con la máxima eficiencia. Hay muchas oportunidades de progresión, tanto dentro del equipo de RME como en general en Amazon.

Trabajamos para reducir el tiempo de inactividad en los sitios de operaciones críticos de Amazon para que los clientes reciban sus pedidos a tiempo. Si identificamos una mejor manera de hacer algo, tenemos las habilidades y la oportunidad de desarrollar e introducir procesos completamente nuevos o tecnologías de vanguardia.

#AmazonMexico

- Experiencia en sistemas de mantenimiento preventivo/correctivo/predictivo
- Experiencia en tareas de mantenimiento mecánico y/o eléctrico
- Experiencia en búsqueda de fallas de sistemas de cintas transportadoras (MHE, del inglés: Material Handling Equipment) y Automatización
- Trabajar en horario/turno/área de trabajo flexible, incluyendo fines de semana, noches y/o días festivos
- Educación secundaria completa o diploma equivalente
- Experiencia con productos y aplicaciones de Microsoft Office

- Experiencia con estándares de seguridad de equipos de manipulación de materiales (MHE) de acuerdo con el fabricante de equipos originales (OEM) y estándares de seguridad.

title: Technical Customer Solutions Manager, India CSM Team
descriptionHtml:
Sales, Marketing and Global Services (SMGS)
AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small- and mid-market accounts to enterprise-level customers including public sector.

As a Customer Solution Manager you will work with the largest and most complex enterprises in the world, to enable their multi-year journey to the cloud. In this new, highly visible, role you will ensure that all AWS teams work together effectively and efficiently to deliver migration, modernization and GenAI outcomes for the customer in relation to Amazon Web Services (AWS) Cloud.

Key job responsibilities
You will be a trusted advisor to the customer. You will leverage your complex program management, technical, organizational, and transformation expertise to understand customer's business and strategic goals, translate them into an executable plan, and drive the implementation to success by working with the customer, AWS, and our partners. You will understand your customers' biggest IT challenges and provide prescriptive guidance, based on AWS best practices, to guide them through their migration and modernization journey to AWS at scale.

You will take end-to-end ownership of multiple migration, modernization and GenAI projects within a single enterprise or across several enterprises, utilizing your communication skills to interface with and influence a broad range of multi-disciplinary teams (Business development, solutions architecture, support, product, professional services, and partners). The Customer Solution Manager role is responsible for cloud migration and modernization programs (incl. technical, operational, organizational, and education) that span across traditional IT teams and business units.

Engaging from the inception stage onwards, you will have a deep understanding of your customer's business vision, culture, and processes, you will be your customer's voice within AWS, ensuring that their needs are accurately communicated to AWS leadership, product, and engineering teams. Engaging during the latter stages of the business cycle you will be responsible for ensuring consistent best-practices are applied, including: (1) ensuring Migration Readiness Assessment (MRA) is conducted and bringing in SMEs to deliver the migration foundations (e.g. landing zone build, security controls, operating model, training etc.), (2) Migration kick off workshops are conducted (including stakeholder alignment), and (3) Executive Steering Committees and reporting are established, including customer, partner, and AWS Cloud exec sponsors and ensure mechanisms are in place to identify and mitigate any identified risks. You should be passionate about delivering a great customer experience by delivering successful IT transformation programs. You will ensure that the customer IT and business stakeholders are aligned, to ensure broad adoption of the migration and modernization across the customer organization. You will use AWS mechanisms to inform the customer migration journey. Where required, you will lead the interaction with specialist teams, ProServ and Partners for handoffs, especially with respect to migreation, modernization and GenAI implementation.

In addition to your customer facing responsibilities, you will help shape the rapidly growing Customer Solution Management function, where your passion to define and implement standard processes, methodologies, and tools will be highly valued. Passionate about customer value creation, you will be adept at measuring and quantifying customer value realization and ensuring it stays on path. Successful candidates will have a technical program management background, technology foundation and consultative mindset, be detail driven, and have experience in managing teams to deliver complex programs. You will be a passionate and proven leader with the ability to gain stakeholder buy-in, communicate confidently at both the executive and project team level, and collaborate with a wide range of technical and non-technical teams, regardless of geographical or organizational boundaries to ensure compliance with AWS Standards, policies and best practices. You will be comfortable in working with diverse teams to ensure appropriate partners are on-boarded and involved in the migration as required. Be an active participant of steering committees and governance structures regardless of who is leading the migration and modernization and act as the point of contact for escalations if the migration and modernization hits barriers. You will be proactive in assessing Migration and modernization progress and design and implement plans to mitigate any risks or delays. Along with project management cadence, you will support the people and process pillars of migration including CCOE design and be the overall owner of reporting and system updates related to the health of migration. You will be a natural problem solver with a cool head that can deal with ambiguity, work autonomously to drive the deliver results for your customer, build IP, and share best practice across geographies.

Amazon is seeking a collaborative electrical maintenance professional for our Amazon Web Services Team.

This engineering operations technician position serves as the on-site maintenance technician and operator for an AWS data centre.

The Data Centre Engineering Operations Technician (EOT) is responsible for operating and maintaining all electrical, mechanical, emergency generator, and fire/life safety equipment within the data centre. The EOT serves as a technical resource to support Amazon within its data centres. Data centre equipment that supports mission-critical servers must maintain better than 99.999% uptime. EOT’s are also tasked with driving innovation while reducing operational costs in the facilities.

EOT’s are Amazon’s front line responders for hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting and operation. This equipment includes, but is not limited to, stand-by diesel generators, switchboards/switch-gears, UPS’s, PDU’s, AHU’s, pumps, motors, VFD’s, and building automation systems.

title: Responsable Facility Management (F/H), Maintenance, Robotique & Systèmes Automatisés
descriptionHtml:
Construisez l'avenir d'Amazon dès la première pierre.
Nous lançons un nouveau site fin 2027, et tout reste à bâtir. Dès le premier jour, vous serez au cœur de l'action : de la mise en service des installations CVC, incendie et air comprimé à l'aménagement des espaces verts, en passant par la définition des premiers standards de maintenance, vous poserez les fondations techniques de ce qui deviendra un maillon essentiel de notre réseau logistique.

Au sein de l'équipe RME (Reliability Maintenance Engineering), vous intégrerez le moteur de l'innovation chez Amazon. Notre mission ? Faire en sorte que chaque infrastructure, chaque installation technique, chaque espace évolue au rythme d'Amazon pour garantir que des millions de clients reçoivent leurs commandes à temps, chaque jour.

En tant que Responsable Facility Management, vous aurez l'opportunité unique de construire, dès l'origine, l'organisation Facility Management du site : Vous piloterez l'ensemble des installations techniques du bâtiment et dirigerez une équipe de 30 experts techniques pluridisciplinaires en gestion directe, tout en supervisant plus de 20 prestataires externes.

Vous évoluerez dans un environnement où l'excellence opérationnelle n'est pas une ambition, mais une exigence, et où chacune de vos décisions impacte directement la sécurité et la satisfaction de vos équipes et de nos clients.

Si vous êtes passionné(e) par les projets de création de site, le pilotage multi-technique de bâtiments, le management d'équipes et de prestataires, et l'amélioration continue au quotidien, alors ce poste est fait pour vous.

Key job responsibilities
Participer à la mise en service du site : Contribuer à la réception, aux tests et à la mise en route des installations CVC, incendie, air comprimé et espaces verts avant l'ouverture officielle du site fin 2027
- Assurer la santé et la sécurité de votre équipe et du bâtiment : Déployer dès l'origine une culture de sécurité exemplaire (protocoles LOTO, Safety Curriculum, toolbox talks), garantir la conformité des installations incendie, CVC et air comprimé, et instaurer l'objectif zéro incident grave
- Piloter la gestion multi-technique du bâtiment : Superviser les systèmes CVC (Chauffage, Ventilation, Climatisation), les installations de sécurité incendie, les réseaux d'air comprimé, ainsi que l'entretien des espaces verts, en garantissant leur disponibilité et leur conformité réglementaire
- Construire et développer vos équipes : Recruter, coacher et manager directement une équipe de 30 techniciens et superviseurs dès les premiers mois du projet, et créer une culture d'équipe forte dès le lancement du site
- Mettre en place la gestion des prestataires : Sélectionner, superviser et coordonner plus de 20 prestataires externes (maintenance CVC, incendie, espaces verts, air comprimé, etc.), définir les contrats, les SLA et les standards de qualité et de sécurité Amazon dès l'ouverture
- Garantir l'excellence opérationnelle : Mettre en place les processus de maintenance préventive et corrective, et piloter la disponibilité technique des équipements et installations du bâtiment dès les premiers jours d'activité
- Piloter l'amélioration continue et l'innovation : Analyser les données de performance des installations, identifier les opportunités d'optimisation énergétique et opérationnelle, et mener des projets Kaizen/QCC en lien avec les équipes européennes
- Gérer les budgets et les projets : Élaborer et suivre le budget Facility Management dès la phase de lancement, piloter les projets d'amélioration des infrastructures, et collaborer avec les équipes internes (GES, GPO, Central RME) ainsi que les parties prenantes externes

A day in the life
Vous serez basé·e sur le futur site, au cœur du projet de création depuis ses premières étapes jusqu'à son ouverture fin 2027. Vous participerez à la mise en service des installations techniques du bâtiment, coordonnerez vos équipes internes et vos prestataires externes pour garantir le bon fonctionnement des systèmes CVC, incendie, air comprimé et espaces verts. Vous collecterez des données, résoudrez les problèmes techniques et contractuels, et élaborerez des plans d'action pour construire, dès l'origine, la performance et la conformité du bâtiment. Après la sécurité, la fonction la plus importante de votre rôle consistera à bâtir et diriger votre équipe de 30 personnes et à mettre en place la supervision de l'ensemble de vos prestataires, en veillant à leur performance, leur conformité et leur développement.

About the team
Notre équipe d’ingénieurs RME (Reliability Maintenance Engineering) veille à ce que nos équipements fonctionnent au mieux. Guidés par des responsables expérimentés, nous sommes une équipe à l’esprit analytique. Nos collaborateurs·trices possèdent à la fois des connaissances techniques poussées et un bon esprit d’équipe. Nous travaillons ensemble pour assurer l’entretien, le dépannage et la réparation des ressources de notre réseau mondial de centres d’expédition. Certains de nos employé·es occupent des postes à responsabilités et sont chargés de superviser l’équipe dans son travail sur des technologies passionnantes, dont certaines n’existent que chez Amazon.

De l’installation de systèmes d’emballage automatisés à la supervision de la maintenance générale d’un site, en passant par la réparation d’équipements de distribution essentiels, notre équipe assure le bon fonctionnement de la plupart des éléments techniques d’Amazon. Nous veillons, par exemple, à ce que les bâtiments soient conformes à la législation, afin d’assurer la sécurité de tous et le fonctionnement à plein régime de nos sites. Les possibilités d’évolution sont nombreuses, tant au sein de l’équipe RME qu’à l’échelle d’Amazon.

Tout ce que nous faisons vise à réduire les temps d’arrêt dans les principaux sites logistiques d’Amazon, afin que les clients reçoivent leurs commandes à temps. Nous travaillons souvent tôt ou tard pour effectuer les tâches de maintenance avec un minimum de perturbations, y compris en équipes de nuit. Si nous voyons qu’il existe une méthodologie plus aboutie pour faire les choses, nous avons les compétences nécessaires pour développer et introduire des processus nouveaux ou des technologies de pointe, comme Amazon Robotics ou notre robot de tri ultra sophistiqué.

Basic qualifications

- Une expérience préalable en Facility Management ou gestion multi-technique de bâtiments (CVC, incendie, air comprimé, espaces verts)
- Une expérience préalable dans le management direct d'une équipe (idéalement 20+ collaborateurs)
- Une expérience préalable dans la gestion et la coordination de prestataires externes multiples
- Une expérience préalable dans des projets de création ou d'ouverture de site est un plus
- Parfaite maîtrise du français et niveau courant anglais à l'oral et à l'écrit
- Connaissance des réglementations statutaires telles que les contrôles de conformité et les protocoles de sécurité incendie et des installations techniques

Preferred qualifications

- Connaissance approfondie des systèmes CVC, des installations de sécurité incendie et des réseaux d'air comprimé
- Expérience dans la gestion de contrats de prestations et le pilotage de SLA
- Expérience dans la mise en service (commissioning) de bâtiments ou d'installations techniques
- Connaissance des outils d'analyse de données et des systèmes de gestion technique du bâtiment (GTB)
- Expérience préalable dans la gestion de projets ou des processus Kaizen, Lean, Six Sigma
- Connaissance des systèmes de gestion de la maintenance assistée par ordinateur (GMAO)

Amazon est un employeur engagé pour l'égalité des chances. Nous sommes convaincus qu'une main d'oeuvre diversifée est essentielle à notre réussite. Nous prenons nos décisions de recrutement en fonction de votre expérience et de vos compétences. Nous apprécions votre envie de découvrir, d'inventer, de simplifier et de construire. La protection de votre vie privée et la sécurité de vos données constituent depuis longtemps une priorité absolue pour Amazon. Veuillez consulter notre Politique de Confidentialité pour en savoir plus sur la façon dont nous collectons, utilisons et traitons les données personnelles de nos candidats.

title: Financial Planning PM, JCFS
descriptionHtml:
JCFSでは、JCFSプロジェクト担当者、Finance、Procurementと連携し、複数チームをまたいで小規模な財務計画・予算管理プログラムをオーナーするFinancial Planning PMを求めています。難易度の高い部門横断的な計画業務を自立的に、期限と品質を守ってデリバリーすることがミッションです。
このロールでは、プロジェクトコストのモニタリングとコントロール、四半期メカニズムによるコスト超過・乖離の早期発見、そして迅速な是正アクションの推進を通じて、JCFSのプロジェクト財務管理の強化を支援します。財務計画サイクル全体のコミュニケーションをオーナーし、ブロッカーを解消し、適切にエスカレーションしてデリバリーを軌道に乗せます。また、JCFSの投資計画とプロジェクト財務ステータスをAmazon Japanオペレーションリーダーシップに対して明確に報告します。グローバルのカウンターパートから優れた財務管理のベストプラクティスを学び、計画プロセスについて他者へのメンタリングを始めることも期待されます。

JCFS seeks a Financial Planning PM to own a small, well-defined financial planning and budgeting program for JCFS projects, working across teams in close partnership with JCFS project owners, Finance, and Procurement. You will deliver cross-functional planning work on time and to quality.
In this role you help JCFS strengthen project financial management by monitoring project costs, identifying cost overruns or variances early through a quarterly mechanism, and driving timely corrective actions. You own program communication for the financial planning cycle, clearing blockers and escalating appropriately to keep delivery on track. You also prepare and deliver clear reporting on JCFS’s investment plans and project financial status to Finance and Operations Leadership. You are encouraged to learn best financial-management practices from your global counterparts and begin to mentor others on the planning process.


Key job responsibilities
• JCFSの各チームリーダーおよびプロジェクト担当者、Financeと連携し、財務計画・予算・コストコントロールのプロセスを設計・運用します。迅速かつ明快な意思決定を推進し、業務のスコープをコントロールします。
• 四半期メカニズムを活用し、コスト超過・乖離・プロジェクト遅延の可能性を先回りで特定し、適切な問いを投げかけ、コストを計画通りに保つための投機を実行します。
• Operations FinanceおよびProcurementと連携し、プロジェクト予算計画や収益性見込み、物品調達状況を確認し、プロジェクト毎の財務リスクを見える化します。
• JCFSのプロジェクト投資計画、収益性、四半期のリスク・オポチュニティ評価を明確かつ簡潔なビジネスドキュメントにまとめ、Leadershipへ報告します。改善が必要な場合は、プロジェクト関係者と連携して実行計画とアクションを策定・推進します。
• グローバルステークホルダーと連携し、優れたプロセスやツール、方法論を積極的に学び、JPへの導入を推進します。
• Create and run a financial planning, budgeting, and cost-control process with JCFS stakeholders (team leaders and project owners) and Finance; drive crisp, timely decisions and keep the scope of effort under control.
• Using the quarterly mechanism, proactively identify potential cost overruns, variances, or project delays, surface the right questions, and implement appropriate measures to keep costs in line.
• Partner with Operations Finance and Procurement to validate project budget plans, profitability outlooks, and procurement status, and make project-level financial risks visible.
• Prepare a clear, concise business document reporting JCFS’s project investment plan, financial viability, and quarterly risk-and-opportunity assessment to Leadership; where improvements are needed, coordinate with stakeholders to define and drive action plans.
• Seek and learn best practices from other geographies and work with global stakeholders to adopt their tools, standard processes, and methodologies in Japan.

A day in the life
・ 毎週のPMチームミーティングを開催し、JCFSのビジネス状況に関する情報をアップデートします。
・ 他チームや組織との連携が必要な場合は、関係部門の担当者と協力して要件を明確化し、ビジネスゴールに沿って優先順位を整理し、リーダーの意思決定を支援します。
・ JCFSメンバーとともにFCやSort Centerなどのオペレーション拠点を訪問し、JCFSのビジネスと技術を学びます。
・ Hold a weekly PM team meeting to update information about the JCFS business situation.
・ When collaboration with other teams or organizations is needed, work with representatives from other departments to clarify requirements and align prioritization with business goals to support leadership decision-making.
・ Visit operational sites such as FCs and Sort Centers together with JCFS members to learn about JCFS business and technology.

About the team
オペレーション技術統括本部（JCFS: Japan Customer Fulfillment Solutions）はAmazon Japanオペレーションの技術・ソリューション開発部門として、物流プロセス、設備、自動化技術の設計・開発・導入・改善を行います。JCFSのミッションは技術革新を通じて「品揃え」「低価格」「利便性」を継続的に向上させること、そして顧客ニーズに合わせた次世代のFulfillment Solutionsを創出し最高の購買体験を実現することです。JCFS PMチームはJCFSを横断したリソース（ヒト・モノ・カネ）計画の策定と管理、プロジェクト財務の予実管理、プロセス標準化と変更管理といったプロジェクトマネジメント機能を担います。
Japan Customer Fulfillment Solutions (JCFS) develops innovative fulfillment and automation solutions to deliver an excellent customer experience. Our mission is to continuously improve item selection, convenience, and price through technological innovation, and to update our fulfillment solutions to meet fast-changing customer needs. The JCFS PM team manages JCFS resource plans to deliver projects, controls project budgets, and standardizes the change management process.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of program or project management experience
- 3+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams experience
- 3+ years of defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics experience
- Bachelor's degree
- Knowledge of Excel at an intermediate level (e.g., pivot tables & charts, multiple criteria lookups, nested logical/IF formulas, data cleansing, array formulas, etc.)

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience
- Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization
- Experience building processes, project management, and schedules
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English

title: Junior Formal Verification Engineer, Annapurna Labs
descriptionHtml:
Annapurna Labs, part of AWS, designs the silicon behind AWS infrastructure, including AWS Graviton processors and the AWS Nitro System. What you prove here runs in millions of servers worldwide.

Formal verification is everywhere in our projects. Each project has hundreds of formal environments, from small blocks with sophisticated data crunching or complex FSMs up to chip-fabric deadlock verification.

The Role:
As a Formal Verification Engineer, you'll own FV for blocks within a Graviton or Nitro subsystem, end to end from architecture to sign-off. You'll work with technical leads and serve as a mentor and knowledge source for other engineers.

Your Ideas Shape the Team:
If a technique works, we adopt it, whoever proposed it. We're pushing AI and agentic flows into everyday verification work, and your ideas will decide how far it goes. Senior engineers on our team are co-inventors on formal verification patents.

What We Offer: A role we count on: formal results drive sign-off decisions, and other teams plan around them

Involvement from day one:
FV engineers join at architecture, define what must be proven, and shape designs to be provable before RTL is written.

A real partnership with design: we define verification intent together

A team where senior FV leaders work alongside early-career engineers who bring energy and fresh ideas.
We like the work, and we like working together.

Key job responsibilities
* Own formal verification of your blocks from architecture through sign-off
* Write the formal plan and define what must be proven
* Build formal environments covering FPV, sequential equivalence, connectivity, X-prop, security, and liveness
* Solve convergence problems with abstraction, invariants, and decomposition
* Report clearly what is proven, what is bounded, and what is still open
* Work with design teams to define verification intent and improve design quality
* Bring new techniques, including AI and agentic flows, into team flows

A day in the life
In this role, you'll engage in pre-silicon verification work that connects every phase of our product development journey- from initial product definition through firmware and software development.
You'll collaborate with hardware designers, software engineers, and cross-functional teams to validate complex semiconductor architectures and protocols.
Your days might include developing and executing verification test plans, analyzing simulation results, troubleshooting design issues, and participating in design reviews.
You'll work with advanced verification methodologies and tools, gaining exposure to cutting-edge technologies that define the next generation of cloud infrastructure.

About the team
We are a collaborative verification team that serves as the connective tissue across our entire product development lifecycle. Our mission is to ensure the reliability and performance of innovative semiconductor platforms that power AWS services globally. We work closely with hardware design, firmware, and software teams to validate complex systems before they reach production. We're committed to continuous improvement and seek opportunities to enhance our verification processes and deliver better solutions to our customers. Joining our team means becoming part of a group dedicated to technical excellence and supporting the infrastructure that enables millions of cloud customers worldwide.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field
- Abstraction and complexity-reduction techniques
- Cover-based and semi-formal verification, and helper assertions
- Protocol knowledge: APB, AXI, CHI, networking related
- Experience or strong interest in applying AI to engineering work
- Experience mentoring other engineers

Preferred qualifications

- Knowledge of the following programming languages: Perl/Bash/TCl/Python/
- Knowledge of PCIe, Processors, Ethernet, DDR
- Sound understanding and knowledge of object-oriented programming concepts
- Verilog/SystemVerilog/Specman

descriptionHtml:
The AWS Professional Services (ProServe) Telco, Media & Entertainment, Gaming and Sports (TMEGS) Delivery Practice is seeking a Sr. Engagement Manager (EM) to own the delivery of complex, outcome-based cloud and AI programs for our customers. In this role you are accountable for business outcomes, not just project milestones. You will help shape what we commit to, negotiate it with customer executives, and deliver it profitably.

Most of our engagements are delivered on a fixed-price, outcome-based model. You will turn customer ambitions into measurable outcomes, clear acceptance criteria and a milestone plan that both the customer and AWS can stand behind. You will work with sales and solution architects before signature to make sure what we sell is deliverable. After signature, you will manage scope, change and commercial performance with discipline: tracking earned value, protecting margin, and negotiating trade-offs with customer executives when priorities shift. descriptionHtml:

In this role, you'll work closely with customers to design, implement, and manage AWS solutions that meet their technical requirements and business objectives. You'll be a key player in driving customer success through their cloud journey, providing technical expertise and best practices throughout the project lifecycle.

Possessing a deep understanding of AWS products and services, as a Delivery Consultant you will be proficient in leading large-scale portfolio assessment and application disposition for enterprise data centre exit programmes spanning multiple countries and regulatory jurisdictions. You'll work closely with stakeholders to gather requirements, assess current infrastructure through discovery tooling and application owner interviews, and propose effective migration strategies to AWS — assigning R-strategies (Rehost, Replatform, Refactor, Retire, Retain, Relocate) and designing wave plans that respect dependency groupings, capacity constraints, and regulatory frozen zones. As trusted advisors to our customers, providing guidance on migration best practices, risk mitigation, and innovative solutions, you will be responsible for leading the end-to-end migration assessment process, ensuring adherence to AWS well-architected principles, optimizing wave sequencing, and managing risks throughout the programme lifecycle.

The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using the AWS Cloud. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing initiatives. Our team provides assistance through a collection of offerings which help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption. We also deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries.

Key job responsibilities
As the senior technical authority on the team, you will be responsible for:

- Owning the overall migration architecture and strategy for the portfolio and designing complex, scalable, and secure AWS solutions tailored to the customer's estate and setting the technical standards other leads build to
- Providing technical direction, deep-dive troubleshooting, and escalation support across all workstreams throughout delivery, unblocking the hardest technical problems
- Partnering with customer and AWS stakeholders to shape requirements and define migration strategy wave sequencing, R-strategy patterns, and target-state architecture across the 1,000+ server estate
- Acting as the customer's trusted senior advisor on migration approach, industry trends, and emerging AWS technologies, influencing executive and architecture decisions
- Raising the technical bar across the organization through mentoring the tech leads and engineers, running enablement, and creating reusable artifacts, patterns, and accelerators
- Governing cross-cutting concerns (security, networking, replatform, data) end to end so dependencies are resolved consistently across waves and teams
Experience
- Deep, hands-on large-scale migration and modernization leadership across heterogeneous estates
- Portfolio- or program-level technical ownership
- Strong AWS solution architecture (migration, networking, security)
- Proven ability to lead and mentor senior technical staff
- Telco customer experience - nice to have
221100

About the team
Diverse Experiences: AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job below, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS? Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture - Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth - We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance - We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

The position may require up to 50% travel to customer sites.

title: Marketing Operations Manager, Amazon Leo
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is Amazon's low Earth orbit satellite network. Our mission is to deliver fast, reliable broadband connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. From households to small businesses, schools, hospitals, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will serve communities and organizations operating in places without dependable internet access.

We are seeking a Marketing Operations Manager to run the consumer marketing operations that power how Amazon Leo reaches households and individual customers. You will be the owner and administrator of our consumer engagement platform (currently Braze) and the tools and integrations connected to it, keeping the platform healthy, governed, and ready for regional performance marketing teams to build and launch their own campaigns.

Your job is to build and maintain the foundation these teams rely on: platform configuration and access, reusable templates and lifecycle journey frameworks, deliverability, data flow, and the documentation, training, and standards that keep a growing multi-region program consistent and compliant. When a regional team needs to move fast, the reason they can is the operational groundwork you've put in place.

You will also own the integrations and capabilities that extend consumer marketing beyond the core platform, from personalization and dynamic content to promotional offers, surveys and customer feedback, and connections into Amazon's own infrastructure. That means evaluating new tools, standing them up, and making them usable for the teams who depend on them. You will work closely with the audience management, marketing automation, and business intelligence functions to keep data clean, audiences well defined, and measurement accurate. As Leo's consumer marketing grows into new markets and channels, you will scale the platform, onboard new teams, and keep the enablement model working.

Key job responsibilities
* Administer and govern the consumer engagement platform (currently Braze): workspace and environment setup, user access and permissions, subscription and channel configuration, and platform standards
* Own the integrations and adjacent capabilities tied to consumer marketing, including personalization and dynamic content, promotional and offer mechanisms, surveys and customer feedback, and connections to relevant Amazon Leo infrastructure
* Set and maintain the governance standards that keep a multi-region program coherent: naming conventions, tagging, template usage, and brand and compliance guardrails
* Run deliverability operations, including subscription management, sending infrastructure health, and opt-in and privacy compliance across markets
* Write the documentation, run the training, and build the enablement resources that get regional teams up and running and keep them self-sufficient
* Work with the audience management function so regional teams have accurate, activation-ready audiences in the platform
* Work with marketing automation, audience management, and business intelligence teams to keep data flowing cleanly and measurement consistent across the consumer journey
* Act as the platform expert and escalation point, troubleshooting issues and unblocking regional teams
* Own the consumer marketing operations roadmap, prioritizing platform improvements, integrations, and enablement as the program grows
* Contribute to cross-functional marketing operations initiatives as team priorities require

A day in the life
You might start the morning getting a regional team set up in Braze, walking them through the template library and the standards so they can build their next campaign without you. From there you check platform health and deliverability, fix a subscription or configuration issue, and update your documentation to cover a new guardrail. In the afternoon you might build a lifecycle journey framework several regions can adapt, scope an integration that brings a new capability into the platform, or sit with the audience team to line up the segments for an upcoming send. In between, you are looking for the manual steps worth automating and the standards worth tightening, so the operation holds together as more teams and markets come online.

About the team
The Amazon Leo Marketing team is responsible for building a world-class brand and driving global demand for a transformational connectivity service. The Marketing Ops & Analytics team builds the systems, data flows, measurements, and insights that support a multi-LOB global business. We operate with the agility of a startup inside Amazon, partnering closely with Engineering, Product, Science, and global marketing teams to ensure our decisions are grounded in high-quality data.

Basic qualifications

- 4+ years of professional non-internship marketing experience
- Experience using data and metrics to drive improvements
- Experience with Excel or Tableau (data manipulation, macros, charts and pivot tables)
- Experience in setting up and leading marketing operations functions
- Experience building, executing and scaling cross-functional email and push marketing campaigns (including automated flows) from concept to completion

Preferred qualifications

- Experience managing external partners to develop marketing programs
- Experience presenting ideas to various levels of an organization to gain support for initiatives
- Experience using email platforms and editing HTML
- Experience working within a global company, with multi-country responsibilities

title: Cluster Service Technician, AMZL
descriptionHtml:
Summary

The Reliability Maintenance Engineering (RME) team at Amazon is fundamental to our operations – they're the ones keeping vital machinery running at all times. As an RME Technician, you'll maintain a wide range of equipment and workspaces while upholding Health and Safety best practices. You'll help to keep your colleagues safe and prevent machine downtime. Our RME Technicians boost the availability and quality of our equipment and work to enhance the operational environment too.

Shift Pattern: This role includes working in non-traditional shift pattern, which may include nights and weekends



Key job responsibilities
- Proactive and preventative maintenance tasks on a wide range of site equipment
- Carry out reactive repairs and fault diagnosis in a live distribution warehouse
- Use the latest tools to maximise equipment effectiveness
- Uphold all health and safety policies and practices
- Support the development and progression of on-site apprentices
- Work on continuous improvement projects and roll out best practices across a range of EU sites



A day in the life
Our RME Technicians are based on-site, so they can respond quickly to any machinery issues. You'll carry out a range of planned preventative maintenance to our sites' equipment to make sure it's working safely. As an RME Technician, you'll also respond promptly to breakdowns, investigating, finding, and implementing solutions as quickly as possible. You'll also make suggestions for long-term improvements.

Working alongside senior colleagues, you'll undertake day-to-day maintenance tasks and will liaise with contractors if you need external expertise. You'll work on a range of shifts to make sure our sites are supported around the clock – allowing Amazon to deliver at the speed we're known for.

As a Cluster Technician, you'll be assigned a nodal home site that serves as your primary base. However, the role includes an element of travel within your designated cluster of sites. This means you'll move between locations as needed to provide maintenance support, respond to breakdowns, and carry out planned preventative work across multiple facilities. This travel element ensures our sites receive consistent, high-quality technical coverage and gives you the opportunity to broaden your experience across a variety of operational environments.

About the team
Amazon Logistics, or AMZL, handles ‘last mile’ delivery duties in partnership with third-party distribution businesses. We utilise creative thinking and continuous improvement initiatives to get millions of physical products into the hands of our customers. Our goal is to make our customers’ delivery experience as smooth as possible and roll out global delivery solutions for our newest concepts, like Amazon Fresh, Prime Now and Amazon Restaurants.

There are two sides to what we do. Our ‘under the roof’ associates process millions of products for dispatch to our delivery teams. Our team is people-focused and supportive, particularly as lots of our people work through the night. We focus mostly on operations, with 24/7 shifts in most of our locations.

Meanwhile, our ‘on the road’ people work with Amazon Flex - a network of delivery contractors. Every year, we continually raise the bar for customer experience with new, innovative delivery services. We look for new ways to overcome industry wide logistics challenges and new ideas to reduce our carbon footprint, supported by a portfolio of vehicles (including Electric Vehicles) and technology to help us do just that.

Basic qualifications

- NVQ Level 3 in Mechanical, Electrical or Mechatronics, or completed a 4-year UK certified apprenticeship
- Valid Full UK Driving License is Essential

Preferred qualifications

- Associate's degree in Mechnical or Electrical
- Experience with material handling equipment (MHE) safety standards accordance with original equipment manufacturer (OEM) and safety standards
- Experience with robotic operation and maintenance

descriptionHtml:

And you'll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

As a Software Development Manager for ELB Data Plane, you will lead a team building the systems that route, scale, and deliver every byte of customer traffic through Elastic Load Balancing. You will own technical vision, drive operational excellence, and grow top engineering talent — all while shipping next-generation capabilities at internet scale.

Key job responsibilities
- Lead a team of engineers in designing, building, and operating ELB data plane systems at massive scale
- Define technical vision and roadmap for data plane capabilities including routing, scaling, and deployment
- Drive operational excellence across the team, maintaining high availability for a service that underpins millions of customer workloads
- Partner with senior AWS leaders, product managers, and cross-functional teams to align on priorities and deliver business outcomes
- Hire, develop, and retain top engineering talent while fostering a culture of ownership and innovation
- Make sound trade-offs between short-term delivery and long-term architectural investments
- Establish goals, prioritize work across your team and partner teams, and focus on the inputs that drive the most impactful results

A day in the life
You will split your time between technical leadership and people development. On any given day, you might review a system design for a new scaling mechanism, meet with a principal engineer to align on architecture direction, conduct a 1:1 with a direct report on career growth, and join an operational review to assess service health. Your stakeholders include senior AWS executives, partner service teams, and customers ranging from startups to the largest enterprises in the world.

About the team
The ELB Data Plane team builds and operates the software that processes every byte of customer traffic flowing through Elastic Load Balancing. We are a group of builders who care deeply about performance, reliability, and customer trust. We operate with high ownership, move fast on what matters, and support each other in delivering results at scale.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of engineering team management experience
- 5+ years of working directly within engineering teams experience
- 3+ years of designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- Knowledge of engineering practices and patterns for the full software/hardware/networks development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, certification, and livesite operations

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in communicating with users, other technical teams, and senior leadership to collect requirements, describe software product features, technical designs, and product strategy
- Experience in recruiting, hiring, mentoring/coaching and managing teams of Software Engineers to improve their skills, and make them more effective, product software engineers

title: Senior Financial Analyst, North America Launch Finance
descriptionHtml:
Amazon seeks a highly motivated finance professional with an AI-first mindset to play a lead role in Operations Finance supporting the North America Launch Finance team. Launch Finance owns the financial planning, governance, and controllership for new fulfillment sites across the NA network from pre-launch cost planning through post-launch performance review. This is a great opportunity to work in a role with high impact and visibility to business-critical decisions, requiring regular interaction with Director and above leadership across Operations, Global Engineering Services (GES) Launch, and Finance. Everyone on the team needs to be entrepreneurial, wear many hats, and work in a highly collaborative environment that's more start-up than big company. Excellent verbal and written communication skills are critical in this role. The successful candidate has demonstrated the following abilities: they are a self-starter who proactively pursues AI-driven solutions to automate, scale, and simplify finance work; have a strong sense of ownership; collaborate with and influence business partners; support thoughtful decision-making in a rapidly-evolving and ambiguous environment; and think long-term.

Key job responsibilities
- Develop partnerships across Operations, GES Launch, and Regional Finance and use data to influence leadership decision-making on launch timing, readiness, and cost
- Own Operating Plan and Quarterly Guidance rate plans, headcount forecasts, and cost projections for new launch sites, ensuring alignment with rate planning standards and network benchmarks
- Lead pre-launch financial planning and post-launch performance reviews, including variance analysis and financial bridges for WBR/MBR/QBR reporting to senior business partners (Director and above)
- Quantify the financial impact of launch risks and provide independent Finance review of labor planning assumptions
- Apply AI and automation tools to eliminate manual work, accelerate analysis, and improve the accuracy and consistency of launch finance deliverables
- Manage competing priorities to complete both ad-hoc and strategic projects across a portfolio of concurrent launches
- Seek opportunities to resolve defects, standardize processes, and reduce cost
- Improve, scale, and simplify finance tools and standard work across teams and organizations
- Communicate financial insights (both written and verbal) in a clear and concise manner; adapt communication based on intended audience to clearly articulate complex financial considerations
- Promote a positive and collaborative culture

About the team
Amazon operates an industry-leading logistics network across the world. The North America Launch Finance team is the financial owner for every new site entering the network, partnering with GES Launch, Site Operations, and Regional Finance to plan, govern, and review launch performance. Finance is looking for individuals who enjoy tackling challenges and have a desire for professional growth opportunities. Experience on this team opens up several career opportunities across Amazon and within the broader Finance organization. Individuals in this role have advancement opportunities to support different businesses and multi-functional teams, to lead new programs and initiatives, and to manage larger teams within the company.
