- 3+ years of finance, accounting, or related analytical field experience
- Experience in forecasting, budgeting, variance analysis, and interpreting financial results
- Bachelor's degree in finance, accounting or related field
- Experience using AI-assisted development tools in academic or professional settings
- 3+ years of contributing to cross-functional initiatives that drive financial performance and strategy experience
- 3+ years of dissecting financial data and identifying patterns that support business strategy experience

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree (MBA or related discipline)
- Experience in creating process improvements with automation and analysis, or experience or equivalent experience in finance roles
- Experience working with, presenting to and influencing senior executives up to VP level
- Ability to operate independently in ambiguous, fast-moving environments

title: Data Center Controls Tech, Andrews, Texas
descriptionHtml:
The Data Center Global Controls team is looking for exceptional individuals to join our Controls organization as a Controls Technician for Service & Construction of the Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Monitoring System (EPMS) within Amazon data centers. If you are passionate about the Customer Experience, think and act globally and have the ability to contribute to major new innovations in the area of building controls and automation this is the challenge you are looking for! The candidate will possess technical background and experience in installation, troubleshooting, operations and/or maintenance of field sensors, controllers, wiring, networking and programming associated with the industrial controls systems. The candidate may also have relevant experience operating and maintaining mission critical electrical and mechanical systems. A Controls Technician shall be responsible for participating in the installation, testing, troubleshooting and startup of equipment and controls system associated with the BMS and EPMS system deployment in the data centers. A Controls Technician is expected to actively innovate on behalf of their customers in the area of Data Center building automation.

Key job responsibilities
• Primarily work in and support multiple data centers by deploying, servicing, and upgrading BMS and EPMS systems.
• Mentor and train Facilities team members on the operation and control of BMS and EPMS systems.
• Manage small to medium-sized projects and programs.
• Perform point-to-point checkouts between field devices and controllers.
• Perform first-line diagnostics, troubleshooting, and maintenance of programming code and hardware associated with BMS and EPMS in data centers.
• Execute provisioning processes for servers, controllers, industrial PCs, and network configurations, including communication testing between third-party devices and controllers or servers.
• Install, replace, configure, and calibrate sensors.
• Read and interpret electrical schematics and control panel drawings with a basic understanding of closed-loop controls, field sensor scaling, and functions typically performed by industrial controllers.
• Supervise low-voltage electrical contractors performing wiring and installation of field devices in compliance with AWS requirements.
• Provide commissioning and systems-level testing support.
• Create red-lined drawings and documentation of systems.
• Follow change management processes to generate work requests and methods of procedures.
• Participate in factory witness tests at vendor or panel builder facilities.
• Perform root cause analysis during testing and commissioning.
• Ensure personnel on site utilize proper safety methodology.
• Perform service activities including monitoring and reviewing ticketing systems, conducting root cause analysis, and prioritizing tasks.
• Actively manage service agreements including vendor labor scheduling, quality assurance, and financial invoice review.
• Participate in material handling tasks such as lifting, carrying, or moving up to 50 lbs of equipment, and utilize OSHA-standard safety equipment including limited weight-bearing work platforms, ladders, step stools, and personal protective equipment (PPE) such as safety harnesses.
• Perform other tasks as assigned by manager


Physical Requirements:
· Walk job-sites in uneven terrain and work at heights and from ladders.
· Regularly walk, use hands and fingers, handle or feel, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch
or crawl.
· On occasions, lift and/or move up to 49 pounds; and participate in group lifts for 50 pounds or more.

A day in the life
A typical day is attending morning construction/commissioning meetings, assessing and prioritization of project tasks and service tickets for the given day. Field work which requires configuring controllers, testing sensors, troubleshooting, safety site walks, and supporting general startup processes. Technician is responsible for logging their daily efforts in construction and service related AWS tools.

The mission of the Data Center Controls Engineering team is to manage the design, deployment, and service of a highly reliable electrical and mechanical control system for the life-cycle of an AWS data center.

About the team
As a member of the Global Controls Team, you will collaborate with highly motivated operators, engineers and technicians in the data center industry to maintain and optimize critical infrastructure systems. You will be responsible for troubleshooting and maintaining the Building Management System (BMS) and Electrical Power Monitoring System (EPMS) while developing new processes and standards that drive innovation in the controls space.
AWS data centers utilize sophisticated industrial control systems to automatically operate mechanical equipment, maintaining optimal temperature and pressure conditions throughout the facilities. These systems integrate and monitor multiple critical components, including generators, uninterruptible power sources, diesel generators, electrical switchgear, power distribution units, variable frequency drives, automatic and static transfer switches, air-cooled and water-cooled chillers, pumps, cooling towers, heat exchangers, Computer Room Air Handlers (CRAHs), and air economizers. Within this industrial control system infrastructure, the BMS serves as the primary control platform for all mechanical systems within the data center, while the EPMS functions as the primary monitoring platform for all electrical systems. This position offers the opportunity to work with cutting-edge technology in mission-critical environments while contributing to the reliability and efficiency of AWS's global infrastructure.

Basic qualifications

- High school or equivalent diploma
- Basic understanding of Industrial controls system, knowledge of meters, devices, sensors, relays and troubleshooting utilizing standard hand tools, digital metering, or calibration/diagnostic equipment in a data center, hospitals, large commercial complex, water, power, oil & gas or similar industries
- 1+ years of experience working with low voltage controls, wiring, networking signals, electrical and mechanical systems, computers and operating systems
- Ability to work non-standard hours and differing work rotations/shifts and overtime as required.

Preferred qualifications

- High School or equivalent diploma
- International Society of Automation (ISA) Certified Controls System Technician (CCST) Level I or higher certification.
- Experiencing using common communication protocols (MQTT, BACnet, and/or MODBUS).
- 5+ years of experience in controls/automation, construction or related field in a technical environment
- Demonstrated understanding of engineering documentation, electrical and mechanical diagrams, and standard operating procedures.
- Experience in data centers or mission critical environment
- Fundamental knowledge of network design and layout as well as low voltage (copper/ fiber) cabling.
- Prior AWS/Amazon experience
- 4+ Yr. Military Service

descriptionHtml:

You'll move beyond executing defined procedures to analyzing why things break, designing fixes for novel contract structures, and partnering with engineering to make ingestion smarter and more resilient. You'll bring judgment to partially defined problems, experiment with AI and automation to improve accuracy, and help move the team toward the next generation of controllership. If you love diving into details, solving problems at the root, and building processes that scale — this is your role.

Key job responsibilities
Ingest customer contracts accurately and on time — acknowledge tickets within 1 business day, resolve standard issues within 5 days per SOP, and execute with ≥98.6% accuracy

Analyze ingestion failures and propose systemic fixes rather than one-off workarounds
Design solutions for new and non-standard contract structures, applying judgment where SOPs don't yet exist

Lead ingestion-related discussions in weekly business reviews with leadership
Partner cross-functionally with engineering and design teams to translate ingestion needs into system requirements

About the team
The AWS Billing Contract Onboarding team makes sure every customer contract is ingested into our billing systems accurately and on time — the foundation of a correct first bill. We're a collaborative, customer-obsessed group that partners closely with engineering, design, and finance to solve hard problems at scale. title: Senior Account SA, AGS Tech
descriptionHtml:
This is the role where architecture meets impact. The Account Solutions Architect (SA) is the trusted technical advisor that customers rely on from first engagement through production and beyond - building sustained technical relationships, understanding customer objectives, and guiding them toward solutions that deliver measurable business outcomes. Through ongoing technical credibility and a commitment to the customer's success, the Account SA drives adoption and deepens engagement in ways that produce lasting business outcomes as the enduring technical voice that earns and maintains customer trust as a member of the account team.

​​The Account SA validates recommendations through hands-on building, turning architectural insight into working solutions that earn customer trust.​

The Account SA provides prescriptive technical guidance - selecting services, designing secure, resilient and scalable architectures, optimizing for cost and performance, and surfacing risks early. Operates as a hands-on builder in the customer's [non-production] environment, validating solutions through working proof points (PoCs, prototypes, reference implementations) because working solutions earn trust that documents cannot. The role scales impact beyond individual engagements by contributing reusable assets other practitioners adopt, orchestrating access to deeper expertise when needed, and transferring capability so customers achieve self-sufficiency rather than dependency.

Key job responsibilities
Technical Solution Design & Customer Advisory
- Designs secure end-to-end solutions for customer workloads, making trade-off decisions across scalability, reliability, performance, cost, and operational efficiency while navigating constraints, operational maturity, and competing business priorities.
- Acts as a trusted technical advisor to the customer's technical and business stakeholders, understanding business objectives, technology landscape, and industry context to recommend fit-for-purpose solutions that connect architectural decisions to long-term business outcomes.
- Advances customer decisions across complex stakeholder groups by making business outcomes (cost reduction, time-to-value, return on investment) tangible and credible through the appropriate combination of architectural reasoning, technical proof, or working demonstrations.
- Evaluates existing customer architectures to identify gaps, risks, modernization and optimization opportunities; delivers actionable remediation guidance and modernization roadmaps.

Building & Demonstrating Solutions
- Operates as a hands-on builder who develops and validates solutions through working proof points in own sandbox and customer non-production environments - leveraging emerging technologies and AI-assisted development to accelerate proof-of-value delivery while maintaining security and operational rigor.
- Applies a production mindset from the outset, integrating governance, security, resiliency, observability, and human validation of critical deliverables into all demonstrable artifacts. Delivers solutions to Amazon Coding Bar (technical standards): tested, secure, and maintainable by others.

Cross-Functional Collaboration
- ​​Partners with sales, business development, professional services, support, product/engineering teams, and external partners teams to move solutions from adoption through launch, orchestrating multi-team delivery against a shared architecture.​
- Provides technical input to product teams by translating customer evidence into clear, actionable requirements that tighten the feedback loop between Account engagements and product direction.

Enablement & Organizational Development
- Improves how the team operates by driving process changes, knowledge transfer, mentoring others, leading design reviews, creating reusable assets (code, tooling, reference implementations) that scale best practices, and recruiting technical talent to sustain a high-performing team.

Thought Leadership & Content Development
- Develops and delivers prescriptive technical content - reference architectures, workshops, white papers, blog posts, and presentations - that shifts how other technical practitioners deliver and educates the broader technical community.
- Represents the organization at industry events, customer forums, and technical conferences as a recognized technical voice.

Recommended Functional Skills

AI-Assisted Development & Tooling, Data Engineering, Emerging Technology Fluency, Hands-on Building & Proof-of-Concept Development, Instructional Design, Sales Presentation / Sales Solution Creation, Software Development & Code Delivery, System Architecture, Technical Communication, Technology & Security Architecture

A day in the life
Your day starts with context - reviewing where your customers are in their technical journey, what's changed in their environment, and what's next. You might open with a design session where you're whiteboarding architecture options with a customer's engineering team, making trade-off decisions together, and committing to a direction. By mid-morning, you're building - writing code, deploying infrastructure, or extending a proof of concept in a sandbox to validate what you recommended yesterday.

After lunch, you're in a customer strategy session with your account team - advising on technical direction, connecting technical progress to business outcomes, navigating competing priorities, and aligning on what proof point will give the customer's decision-makers confidence to move forward. Not everything is clear-cut; you often work with incomplete information, shifting requirements, and stakeholders who don't yet agree on the problem - and you move things forward anyway.

descriptionHtml:

AWS is looking for a leader to head our Defence Solutions Architecture team in Australia — someone who understands how Defence operates, the environment it works within, and how cloud technology can genuinely advance mission outcomes.

We're looking for someone with broad familiarity across the Australian Defence Organisation and the Defence Industrial Base, and a genuine interest in the Defence mission — whether that experience was gained inside Defence or working adjacent to it (for example, in consulting, systems integration, defence industry, or a technology provider serving Defence customers). In this role, you will lead a team of senior AWS solutions architects who partner with customers across the Defence sector to design and implement cloud-based systems that meet some of the most demanding security and compliance requirements in the industry. This is a player-coach position — you will guide your team's engagements while also working directly with customers when your expertise can drive the greatest impact.

Applicants must be Australian citizens and must hold or be able to attain an Australian Government Security Vetting Agency clearance (see https://www1.defence.gov.au/security/clearances).

Above all, this is a people-leadership role. You will build, grow, and develop a high-performing team of solutions architects — hiring and retaining strong talent, coaching your people through complex engagements, and creating an environment where they can do their best work. Australia's strategic circumstances have fundamentally shifted, and Defence is modernising at pace. Success in this role depends on genuine credibility across the Defence community — the ability to earn trust with senior Defence leaders, understand their mission and operational challenges, and translate those challenges into secure, compliant, cloud-enabled solutions. You will set the strategic direction for your organisation, prioritise where AWS invests its time for maximum customer outcomes, and build a team culture grounded in technical excellence and deep customer understanding.

A working knowledge of Australian Government security policy, including the Essential Eight and the Information Security Registered Assessors Program (IRAP), is essential. If you are ready to lead where cloud technology meets Defence, we want to hear from you.

Key job responsibilities
- Build, grow, and develop a high-performing team of senior solutions architects — hiring and retaining strong talent, actively coaching and mentoring your people, and investing in their career growth.

- Build enduring, trust-based relationships with senior Defence stakeholders, operating as a credible partner who understands their mission, operating environment, and capability priorities.

- Establish processes that enable your team to operate independently, make sound decisions, and continuously improve how they deliver outcomes for customers.

You start your morning reviewing key metrics and customer engagement updates from your leadership team. After lunch, you lead a talent review discussion, identifying development opportunities for emerging leaders across your organisation. Later, you connect with cross-functional partners to align on an upcoming product launch, ensuring your team's roadmap supports shared objectives.

title: Embedded Software Development Engineer, Amazon Leo Optical Inter-Satellite Link
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is Amazon's low Earth orbit satellite network. Our mission is to deliver fast, reliable broadband connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. From households to small businesses, schools, hospitals, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will serve communities and organizations operating in places without dependable internet access.

Innovation is part of our DNA! Our goal is to be Earth's most customer-centric company, and we are just getting started. We need people who want to join this ambitious program that continues to push the state of the art in distributed systems and software design. Come work at Amazon!

Export Control Requirement: Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.



Key job responsibilities
Design, implement, and enhance the switch-management software — from translating routes received from a centralized SDN controller into forwarding-table entries, to building MAC-learning and loop-prevention logic for a redundant switch topology — that enables deterministic, low-latency packet forwarding across the constellation

Design and optimize the networking layers of flight software for optical inter-satellite link systems, spanning network device drivers and protocol implementations on embedded Linux

Collaborate with cross-functional teams — including hardware, optics, systems, communications, and operations engineers — to integrate, test, and deploy high-speed optical communication systems and the networking stack that underpins space-based connectivity

Build and extend operational tooling for network diagnostics and observability — including routing-table inspection, packet capture and analysis, structured logging, and metrics emission — that enables rapid fault isolation and performance trending across the satellite mesh



A day in the life
As a Software Engineer on the Optical Inter-Satellite Link team, you won't just write code — you'll see it fly. Your software will control and monitor high-speed laser communications between satellites moving at orbital velocities, and you'll be there for every stage of the journey: from early design and ground-based verification to watching your code commission an optical link for the first time in orbit. On the networking side, you'll design and debug the switching fabric that routes traffic across the constellation — ensuring packets traverse inter-satellite links with minimal latency and maximum reliability.




About the team
You will join a multi-disciplinary team of exceptional engineers whose work spans an unusually broad scope: embedded flight software running on satellites in orbit, cloud-based systems powering mission and network operations, automation frameworks that keep a growing constellation healthy, and AI-driven capabilities that make our optical links smarter with every orbit. We collaborate closely with optical, electrical, firmware, opto-mechanical, and operations teams — and with partner organizations including Mission Operations and Optical Network Operations — to deliver one of the most advanced optical communication systems ever built.



Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
- Experience in Linux and Networking protocols

Preferred qualifications

- Experience developing embedded software for space systems, including optical communication systems, laser terminals, or high-speed serial interfaces
- Experience with ARM-based SoCs

title: Reliability Maintenance Engineering Technician
descriptionHtml:
The Reliability Maintenance Engineering (RME) team at Amazon is fundamental to our operations – they’re the ones keeping vital machinery running at all times. As an RME Technician, you’ll maintain a wide range of equipment and workspaces while upholding Health and Safety best practices. You'll help to keep your colleagues safe and prevent machine downtime. Our RME Technicians boost the availability and quality of our equipment and work to enhance the operational environment too.


Key job responsibilities
- Proactive and preventative maintenance tasks on a wide range of site equipment
- Carry out reactive repairs and fault diagnosis in a live distribution warehouse
- Use the latest tools to maximise equipment effectiveness
- Uphold all health and safety policies and practices
- Support the development and progression of on-site apprentices
- Work on continuous improvement projects and roll out best practices across a range of EU sites


A day in the life
Our RME Technicians are based on-site, so they can respond quickly to any machine issues. You’ll carry out a range of planned preventative maintenance to our sites’ equipment to make sure it’s working safely. As an RME Technician, you’ll also respond promptly to breakdowns, investigating, finding and implementing solutions as quickly as possible. You’ll also make suggestions for long-term improvements.
Working alongside senior colleagues, you’ll undertake day-to-day MHE and facilities maintenance tasks and will liaise with contractors if you need external expertise. You’ll work on a range of shifts to make sure our sites are supported around the clock – allowing Amazon to deliver at the speed we’re known for.


About the team
Our Reliability Maintenance Engineering or RME team keep our equipment performing at its best. We're a technically minded team, made up of excellent team players and guided by experienced leaders. We work together to maintain, troubleshoot and repair equipment across our global network of fulfilment centres. Some of our people are leaders, who oversee the team as they work on exciting technology – some of which only exists at Amazon.

From installing automated packaging systems to overseeing the general maintenance of a site to repairing key distribution equipment, our team handles most aspects of Amazon’s technical side. title: Quality Audit Representative, ICMRS Auditing
descriptionHtml:
NOC (Network Operations Center) is the centralized command and control center for ‘Transportation Execution’ across the Amazon Supply Chain network supporting India. It ensures timely tracking procurement and movement between various Amazon hubs. In case of any exceptions, NOC steps in to resolve the issues by keeping the stakeholders informed on the proceedings. Along with this tactical problem-solving NOC is also charged with understanding trends in network exceptions and then automating processes or proposing process changes to streamline operations. This second aspect involves network monitoring and significant analysis of network data. Overall, NOC plays a critical role in ensuring the smooth functioning of Amazon transportation and thereby has a direct impact on Amazon’s ability to serve its customers on time.

Key job responsibilities
Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:
1. Watch CCTV camera recordings from Amazon operations sites and check whether the activities on video follow the correct process, by answering a set of defined audit questions for each site.
2. Use the camera viewing software to find and open the right camera for a given location and time, and look closely at the footage to spot any process gaps or incorrect handling.
3. Complete the number of audits assigned for your shift each day, keeping both speed and accuracy at the expected level.
4. Build familiarity with how each site is laid out, how packages move through it, and how the cameras are named and positioned, so that you can quickly locate the correct footage to review.
5. Record your findings in the audit system, take screenshots as proof wherever a process is not being followed, and save that proof in the right place within the required time.
6. Follow the step by step checks defined for each audit question, and raise anything unclear or unusual to your team lead or manager.
7. Share your audit results on the schedule set for each audit type, whether that is daily, weekly, or once in two weeks.
8. Treat all video footage and findings as confidential, and follow the rules on data privacy and camera access at all times.
9. Take part in the training and practice when you join, including watching experienced auditors at work and then being observed yourself, and learn to handle more than one type of audit.
10. Meet the quality standards set for audit accuracy, and take part in the review sessions that check and improve the quality of audits.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- Experience with the Microsoft Office Suite including Word, Outlook, and Excel
- Experience that includes strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and effective communication abilities, or experience in managing and troublshooting network

Preferred qualifications

- Experience managing contract security and physical security operation programs such as access control/intrusion detection and CCTV surveillance systems
- Experience working with customers with a passion for delivering exceptional service, or experience that includes strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and effective communication abilities
- Experience working in a fast-paced and ambiguous environment
- Experience prioritizing and managing multiple responsibilities

title: Spezialist/in für Arbeitssicherheit
descriptionHtml:
Arbeitsschutz und Wohlbefinden unserer Mitarbeitenden haben bei Amazon höchste Priorität. Unsere Safety Specialists spielen dabei eine entscheidende Rolle. In dieser Funktion sorgst Du proaktiv dafür, dass alle Mitarbeitenden an Deinem Standort in einem sicheren und gesunden Umfeld arbeiten. Du hast die Möglichkeit, jeden Tag einen Unterschied für Menschen zu machen. Indem Du proaktiv für ihre Sicherheit sorgst, gibst Du ihnen Zuversicht in ihrer Rolle und motivierst sie zu Höchstleistungen.

Das Workplace Health and Safety (WHS) Team spielt eine entscheidende Rolle bei der Gewährleistung des mentalen und körperlichen Wohlbefindens unserer Mitarbeitenden am Arbeitsplatz. title: Associate Solutions Architect Internship 2027
descriptionHtml:
Join Amazon Web Services (AWS) as an Associate Solutions Architect Intern and launch your career in cloud computing. Available to work full-time for either 3 or 6 months during 2027, you'll gain hands-on experience designing cloud and generative AI solutions, learning from experienced architects, and working on real AWS projects that impact millions of customers worldwide.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world's leading cloud computing platform, helping millions of customers — from startups to global enterprises — build and run applications without managing physical servers. We're seeking motivated individuals for our Associate Solutions Architect Intern program, a structured learning experience designed to develop the next generation of Cloud Solutions Architects.

This internship serves as a pathway to our Solutions Architect Graduate Program, offering you the opportunity to build foundational knowledge in cloud computing, AWS services, and solutions architecture principles in a supportive, education-first environment. You'll learn to understand customer requirements, build working cloud and AI solutions, and communicate technical recommendations effectively while being mentored by experienced Solutions Architects.

Key job responsibilities
Complete a structured training curriculum to build cloud architecture foundations and develop expertise in AWS services
Analyze customer requirements and learn to translate them into technical solution recommendations
Participate in solution design sessions and observe customer engagements with experienced Solutions Architects
Work on a real AWS project, applying architecture principles and building hands-on experience with AWS services
Develop communication skills by learning to present technical concepts effectively to diverse audiences

A day in the life
As an Associate Solutions Architect Intern, you'll engage in a mix of structured learning and practical application. Your day might include attending training sessions on AWS services and the Well-Architected Framework, then applying those concepts to a real project you're building on AWS. You'll participate in solution design discussions, observing how experienced architects translate customer needs into technical recommendations. You might shadow customer engagements to see how solutions are presented to diverse audiences, then return to work on your own project, experimenting with AWS services and architecture principles. Throughout your internship, you'll develop presentation skills by communicating technical concepts to colleagues and mentors, receiving feedback that helps you grow as a solutions architect.

About the team
We are the EMEA Student Programs Team within AWS, dedicated to nurturing emerging talent in cloud computing. Our team collaborates across the organization to create meaningful internship experiences that bridge the gap between academic learning and real-world cloud architecture. We work with experienced Solutions Architects who are committed to mentoring the next generation of cloud professionals. Together, we're building a community of architects who understand how to solve complex business problems through innovative cloud solutions. When you join us, you'll be part of a team that values your growth, supports your learning journey, and helps you develop the skills needed to succeed in cloud consulting and solutions architecture.

- Speak, write, and read fluently in English at C1 level or above
- Currently enrolled in penultimate or final year of a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related technical field, graduating in 2027 or 2028

title: InfraOps Support Engineer, Operations Management Center (OMC)
descriptionHtml:
The InfraOps Support Engineer is a Tier 1 support engineer in Amazon's Operations Management Center (OMC) - a 24/7/365 team that keeps the technology inside Amazon's 400+ corporate office buildings running across Networking, Audio-Visual (AV), and Print services. This engineer is the first line of response for office-infrastructure incidents.

Operating within the Amazon Support Engineer (SupEng) job family, the engineer provides high-quality support across all three service areas while beginning to develop deep subject-matter expertise in one or more focus areas, for which they become the technical point of contact on their team. They respond, triage and resolve incidents within target times using established procedures, detect trends before they become problems, contribute to and refine the team's operating procedures, and mentor more junior engineers. Success requires the ability to work in a fast-paced, collaborative, shift-based environment.

Key job responsibilities
On a typical shift, an InfraOps Support Engineer will:

1. Monitor, Detect & Triage

Be the first line of response and keep ahead of problems.

Triage incoming incidents (tickets) within defined target response times, using judgment to resolve in place or route to the responsible team.

Use dashboards, alarms, and other tools for Networking, AV, and Print services across the global building fleet, interpreting what those signals indicate to solve incidents.

Detect ongoing trends or emerging problems before they occur and define proactive actions to prevent customer impact.

Assess incident scope and severity, correlate related incidents into a single parent incident, and prioritise work against SLAs.

2. Troubleshoot & Support

Resolve issues and support the team's products and systems.

Provide high-quality Tier 1 support for the products and systems in the team's scope, resolving straightforward problems with limited documentation and minimal escalation.

Support critical issues using existing runbooks; maintain composure through difficult interactions until the issue is resolved.

Perform on-call duties on a rotating schedule and respond to emergent events.

Escalate appropriately when resolution requires significant deviation from procedure or when an issue becomes a risk.

3. Subject-Matter Expertise & Technical Leadership

Grow into the go-to person for a focus area.

Develop and apply expertise in one or more focus areas (e.g., Networking, AV, or Print), acting as the technical point of contact for that area within the team.

Give technical direction to others and impart knowledge to users, customers, and teammates.

Lead internal team projects and deliver on defined goals and timelines.

4. Documentation & Operational Improvement

Improve how the team operates.

Identify areas to improve support documentation and processes, and author new runbooks/SOPs and knowledge-base articles where gaps exist.

Identify improvements to existing and new support tools that increase operational efficiency, and help drive their implementation.

Help develop and refine the operational policies and procedures used by the team.

5. Mentoring & Collaboration

Raise the bar for the team.

Serve as a mentor to junior engineers and act as a training buddy for new hires; may assist in hiring activities.

Maintain good working relationships across Amazon and work cross-functionally with partner teams to solve problems and improve processes.

Communicate infrastructure health and trends clearly, both in real time and as inputs to weekly/monthly business reviews.

Basic qualifications

- 1+ years of Windows Server technologies: AD, DFS, Print Services, SCCM experience
- 1+ years of troubleshooting in a multi-user high availability environment experience
- 1+ years of IT client, server, and network service delivery experience
- 1+ years of networking (such as DNS, DHCP, SSL, OSI Model, and TCP/IP) experience
- 1+ years of corporate setting Windows, Mac or Linux Operating systems support experience
- 1+ years of supporting and maintaining a corporate network environment experience
- High school diploma, or equivalent

Preferred qualifications

- 2+ years of computer networking experience, or experience in computer networking
- Experience supporting video conference and teleconference equipment
- Experience that includes strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and effective communication abilities, or experience in Network protocols like DNS/DHCP/TCP

title: Sr Security Assurance Specialist Australia, AWS Security Assurance
descriptionHtml:

You will be responsible for defining and developing an audit and assurance program for our customers in Australia, along with hiring and managing the team that will work in specific markets.

At our scale, we are committed to inventing new ways to provide the highest level of assurance to our most security conscious customers. You have a strong foundation in audit principles, as well as a diverse technology, privacy and assurance background.

You have led teams and delivered challenging and complex audit and assurance programs. We have a team culture that encourages ownership, diversity, inclusion, and innovation. We expect team members and management alike to take a high degree of ownership for their program, vision and execution.

We expect this person to balance their unique perspective with those of the diverse perspectives of the team and its stakeholders. You will have an opportunity to work directly with most divisions across AWS as we build the tools and evidence needed to demonstrate assurance for our customers.  Your technical and audit background will help bridge security, technology, and compliance, and facilitate the scale of the program.

This role, as part of the AWS Compliance & Security Assurance team in Australia, requires the ability to develop long-term projects and define processes and methods to ensure execution and productivity across multiple internal and external stakeholders, including customers and regulatory agencies.

Key job responsibilities
- Delivery of commercial and cleared audits programs in Australia  (SOC, IRAP, DISP, etc.)
- Support audit evidence collection and project delivery as needed for other APAC countries
- Serve as an expert to AWS, customers, auditors, and regulators on regional and domestic regulations on security, critical infrastructure, cybersecurity, technology, outsourcing and operational resilience in the industry.
- Innovate to develop mechanisms that continuously improve the customer experience of security assurance;
- Performing compliance impact and market assessments of emerging compliance programs;
- Tracking and reporting on changes to security controls and requirements standards across the region;
- Manage tight deadlines and drive for results, while being extremely detail orientated
- Prepare project plans and track projects through fruition.
- Support metrics, implement data collections mechanisms, analyze data and make recommendations.

**Successful applicant must hold or be able to attain an Australian Government Security Vetting Agency clearance (see https://www.agsva.gov.au/applicants/eligibility-and-suitability)**

If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS Security
At AWS, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of AWS’s products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at Amazon, we embrace our differences. We are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion. We have ten employee-led affinity groups, reaching 40,000 employees in over 190 chapters globally. We have innovative benefit offerings, and host annual and ongoing learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences. Amazon’s culture of inclusion is reinforced within our 16 Leadership Principles, which remind team members to seek diverse perspectives, learn and be curious, and earn trust.

Our team puts a high value on work-life balance. It isn’t about how many hours you spend at home or at work; it’s about the flow you establish that brings energy to both parts of your life. We offer flexibility in working hours and encourage you to find your own balance between your work and personal lives.

Mentorship & Career Growth
Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects based on what will help each team member develop into a better-rounded professional and enable them to take on more complex tasks in the future.

title: HR Business Partner, PXT, PXT
descriptionHtml:
In pursuit of being Earth's Best Employer, our global Human Resources teams, known as People Experience and Technology (PXT), drive business success by fostering a safe, inclusive, and innovative culture. The HR Business Partner is responsible for operational excellence and organizational health at assigned site(s), serving as an individual contributor partnering directly with Field Leaders and site leadership teams. You will strengthen culture and deliver business results by translating organizational priorities into actionable plans, executing business goals through data-driven decision making, and partnering with campus leaders to improve the employee experience. This role is accountable for the end-to-end employee experience, owning site-level feedback mechanisms, recognition programs, and environment standards that shape trust, engagement, and performance.
You will be expected to work onsite at an Amazon facility, supporting multiple sites within your region (campus) with regular mobility across assigned locations.

The applicable collective agreement for this role is CBA for employees of Logistics, Delivery and Shipping Sector . The position is classified at level 1 or above, depending on the candidate's skills, competences and experience.


Key job responsibilities
Employee Experience & Engagement

Foster two-way communication between employees and leaders through feedback mechanisms like Voice of the Associate, roundtables, and GEMBA walks

Execute and monitor employee engagement strategies and recognition programs, including budget planning and employee appreciation activities

Build an environment where employees feel safe and included, establishing Employee Resource Groups and ensuring equitable talent practices

Maintain meaningful floor presence across the site, gathering insights and identifying early signs of disengagement

Operational Excellence & Site Standards

Conduct regular site walks to assess workplace conditions and maintain facility standards in alignment with Amazon standards

Partner with site leaders and safety teams to ensure consistent execution of safety programs

Lead community initiatives at your site(s), partnering across your node and with Public Policy and Public Relations teams

Improve site effectiveness by identifying systemic patterns, addressing root causes, and ensuring consistent, fair application of policies

Data-Driven Decision Making & Technology

Use data analytics to identify emerging trends, predict challenges, and implement proactive solutions

Drive adoption of HR technology solutions, AI, and self-service tools while maintaining high-touch service delivery in critical moments

Strategic PXT Leadership

Partner with site leadership to balance operational needs with Amazon's values and people priorities

Coach Business Leaders on effective people management practices, including performance feedback, team development, and employee relations matters

Support change implementation by reinforcing messaging, addressing resistance, and helping leaders translate change into local routines

Execute core PXT processes while building trust and influence through sound business acumen

A day in the life
Your day will be a dynamic blend of strategic thinking and data-driven decision-making. You'll leverage advanced analytics and AI-enabled tools to identify trends, anticipate business needs, and develop solutions that enhance workplace experience. From coaching leadership teams on workforce management to driving HR process excellence, you'll collaborate with Field leaders on operational objectives and team effectiveness. You'll maintain strong floor presence, building partnerships across all levels while contributing to meaningful workplace improvements through site walks, employee feedback sessions, and strategic initiatives.
Success comes from your ability to navigate organizational dynamics, lead change initiatives, and make high-judgment decisions in ambiguous situations. Through business acumen, data-driven insights, and strategic partnerships, you'll help create a workplace culture where employees feel valued and empowered.

title: Sr. Product Marketing Manager, Amazon Fire TV
descriptionHtml:
Why This Role Matters

The way customers watch television is changing. Alongside broadcast TV, the growth of streaming content has diversified what customers want from a TV. Fire TV is expanding beyond streaming devices into the television itself. In this role, you'll plan and execute the marketing strategy in Japan for the growing Fire TV built-in smart TV business. You'll drive the business end-to-end — from product launch through post-launch growth — taking comprehensive ownership across business planning, sales promotion to hit targets, and the design and execution of marketing initiatives on both online and offline channels.

Who You Are

You're an experienced professional who has independently led marketing and sales-promotion programs and delivered results - ideally at a consumer-electronics manufacturer, a global tech company, or a similarly fast-moving business. You can build marketing plans together with partner companies - TV manufacturers, consumer-electronics retailers, and others - and communicate the value Fire TV brings to customers. You commit to results, and you can design and execute the promotions and channel marketing that grow the numbers. Working with senior management and global teams, you bring cross-functional stakeholders along, make sound judgment calls even when the situation is ambiguous, and move fast when the opportunity demands it. This role drives strategy locally while partnering with global teams. Native-level Japanese and business-level English are both required.

このポジションの魅力

お客様のテレビの楽しみ方は変わりつつあります。テレビ放送に加え、ネット動画コンテンツが増え、お客様のニーズも多様化しています。Fire TVは、ストリーミングデバイスの枠を超え、テレビそのものへと広がっています。このポジションでは、成長を続けるFire TV搭載スマートテレビ事業における、日本のマーケティング戦略を立案・実行します。商品の立ち上げからローンチ後のビジネス推進までを一気通貫でドライブし、事業計画の策定、予算達成に向けた販売促進、オンライン・オフラインでの各種マーケティング施策の企画・実行まで、包括的な責任をもって事業を推進します。

求める人物像

家電メーカー、グローバルテックなど、変化の速い業界で、マーケティングおよび販売促進のプログラムを自ら主導し、成果を出してきた経験豊富な方を求めています。テレビメーカー、家電量販店などのパートナー企業と共にマーケティングプランを描き、Fire TVがもたらす価値をお客様に伝えていける方。結果にコミットし、数字を伸ばすプロモーションやチャネルマーケティングを企画・実行していける方。シニアマネジメント、グローバルチームと連携し、部門を超えたステークホルダーを巻き込み、曖昧な状況でも的確な判断を下し、機会が求めるときには素早く動ける方。日本市場の戦略をローカルで推進しつつ、グローバルチームと連携するポジションです。日本語（ネイティブレベル）と英語（ビジネスレベル）の両方が必要です。

Key job responsibilities
1. Partner Brand Marketing Strategy & Execution: Lead the go-to-market and marketing strategy for the Fire TV built-in smart TV business in Japan. Develop marketing plans with TV-brand partners and drive integrated initiatives across online and offline channels. Review and approve customer-facing assets to ensure consistent messaging and branding.
2. Business Planning & Ownership of Results: Be accountable for the business results and targets. Develop short- and mid-term business plans based on market trends, customer needs, and financial data, and drive them from planning through execution.
3. Marketing Budget Management & Optimization: Manage marketing and media investments with partners and agencies. Use analytical insights to optimize budget allocation, monitor KPIs, and identify opportunities for growth.
4. Customer Insights & Value Proposition: Act as the voice of the Japanese customer. Commission research, analyze customer behavior, and translate the value Fire TV brings into propositions relevant to the Japan market.
5. Stakeholder Collaboration & Strategic Leadership: Work with internal teams and the US Fire TV team to execute initiatives, and build strong relationships with TV-brand partners. Set roadmaps, track goals, and present high-quality documents to senior leadership.

1. パートナーブランドマーケティングの戦略・実行: Fire TV搭載スマートテレビ事業における日本のGTM・マーケティング戦略に責任を持つ。テレビブランドのパートナーとマーケティングプランを策定し、オンライン・オフラインを横断した統合施策を推進する。顧客向けクリエイティブ素材のレビュー・承認を行い、一貫したメッセージングとブランディングを担保する。
2. 事業計画と成果責任: 事業の成果・目標に責任を持つ。市場動向、顧客ニーズ、財務データをふまえ、中長期・短期の事業計画を策定し、計画から実行まで推進する。
3. マーケティング予算の管理・最適化: パートナーおよび広告代理店と連携し、マーケティング／メディア投資を管理する。分析的知見を活用して予算配分を最適化し、KPIをモニタリングして成長機会を特定する。
4. カスタマーインサイトと付加価値提供: 日本のお客様の声を代弁する存在として、リサーチを企画し、顧客行動を分析する。Fire TVがもたらす価値を、日本市場に即した提案へと落とし込む。
5. ステークホルダー連携と戦略的リーダーシップ: 社内チームおよび米国のFire TVチームと連携して施策を実行し、テレビブランドのパートナーと強固な関係を構築する。ロードマップを策定して目標を管理し、シニアリーダーシップに向けた質の高いドキュメントを作成・提示する。

About the team
Amazon Devices has brought some of the most beloved products to customers in Japan — from Kindle to Echo to Fire TV — and this team operates with the energy and ownership of a startup backed by the resources of Amazon. You'll have a seat at the table to shape strategy, not just execute it. You'll own outcomes, not just activities — with the autonomy to propose bold ideas, build the case, and bring them to life across channels that reach millions. This is a team that values independent thinking, high judgment, and a bias for action. If you're ready to step into a role with real strategic ownership and visible business impact — working on products you'd proudly recommend — we'd love to hear from you.

Amazon Devicesは、KindleからEcho、Fire TVまで、日本のお客様に愛される革新的なプロダクトを届けてきました。このチームは、Amazonのリソースを背景に持ちながら、スタートアップのようなエネルギーとオーナーシップで動いています。戦略を実行するだけでなく、戦略を形づくる側に立てるポジションです。活動ではなく成果にオーナーシップを持ち、大胆なアイデアを提案し、根拠を構築し、何百万人ものお客様に届くチャネルで実現する——そんな自律性があります。独立した思考、高い判断力、そしてBias for Actionを大切にするチームです。真の戦略的オーナーシップと目に見えるビジネスインパクトを求め、自信を持っておすすめできるプロダクトに携わりたい方——ぜひご応募ください。

Basic qualifications

- 8+ years of professional non-internship marketing experience
- Experience with Excel or Tableau (data manipulation, macros, charts and pivot tables)
- Experience leading go-to-market for consumer software or hardware product launches
- Experience prior success in driving execution of large-scale project plans with multiple teams in support of business goals
- Experience presenting metrics and progress to goal to senior leadership
- Experience in marketing or marketing research
- Bachelor's degree
- Speak, write, and read fluently in Japanese at a business level or above (N1+)
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English

Preferred qualifications

- MBA
- Experience in consumer electronics or technology sector
- Experience in partnership and product marketing
- Experience working in a fast-moving consumer business
- Experience applying strong numerical and analytical abilities to develop product/program strategies and evaluate complex processes and financial scenarios
- Experience in ownership of projects and communicating timelines and executing independently

title: Teamleiter Instandhaltung (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Unser Wartungs- und Instandhaltungsteam (Reliability Maintenance Engineering Team oder RME-Team) ist der Kern von Amazons Engagement für Innovation. Amazon entwickelt sich weiter und dieses Team sorgt dafür, dass dies auch die von uns verwendeten Technologien und Tools tun. Als Senior RME Technician hilfst Du uns, der Entwicklung einen Schritt voraus zu bleiben. Du setzt die neuesten Technologien ein und identifizierst neue, effiziente Arbeitsmethoden. In dieser Rolle achtest Du genau auf unsere Prozesse und trägst dazu bei, dass wir unsere höchsten Sicherheitsstandards befolgen und weiter erhöhen.

Key job responsibilities
- Best Practice und Unterstützen im Bedienen von Geräten und Anlagen mit den höchsten Sicherheitsstandards
- Verfolgen der Geräteleistung durch visuelle Prüfungen, zustandsorientierte Überwachung und vorbeugende Wartungsmaßnahmen und Einplanen zusätzlicher Wartung je nach Bedarf
- Verantwortung für das technische Team während seiner Schicht und dessen Unterstützung und Weiterentwicklung
- Lösung von Problemen an Anlagen, um Betriebsausfallzeiten zu reduzieren und die schnellstmögliche Abfertigung von Paketen zu ermöglichen
- Unterstützung bei der kontinuierlichen Verbesserung von Systemen und Standardisierung von Prozessen im ganzen EU-Netzwerk

A day in the life


Du betreust ein Instandhaltungsteam innerhalb einer Schicht und sorgst dafür, dass alle Mitarbeitenden die erforderlichen Werkzeuge zur Verfügung haben und diese einwandfrei funktionieren. Das beinhaltet die Überwachung von Prozessen, damit Vorschriften und Richtlinien befolgt werden, ebenso wie die Gewährleistung der Durchführung vorbeugender Wartungsmaßnahmen, um die Betriebszeit unserer Anlagen zu maximieren.
Durch Deine Beobachtungen während der Schichtarbeit machst Du Verbesserungsvorschläge, um unsere Systeme noch effizienter und produktiver zu gestalten, und setzt diese Verbesserungen EU-weit um. Außerdem nutzt Du Tools wie SCADA zur Überwachung von Prozessen, um deren Leistungsfähigkeit zu gewährleisten, und unterstützt administrative Aufgaben in enger Zusammenarbeit mit Deinen Führungskräften.
Du arbeitest vor Ort in einem unserer Logistikzentren. Du arbeitest in Schichtmodellen, die Nächte und Wochenenden umfassen können. Mit den Kenntnissen und Erfahrungen, die Du sammelst, wirst Du Dich zu weiteren Führungspositionen weiterentwickeln.

About the team
Unser Wartungs- und Instandhaltungsteam (Reliability Maintenance Engineering Team oder RME-Team) sorgt dafür, dass unsere Geräte und Ausstattung jederzeit optimal funktionieren. Wir sind ein Team von Techniker:innen und Ingenieur:innen, das aus hervorragenden Teamplayern besteht und von erfahrenen Führungskräften geleitet wird. Wir arbeiten gemeinsam daran, die Geräte in unserem gesamten globalen Netzwerk von Fulfillment-Centern zu warten, zu reparieren und ihre Fehler zu beheben. Einige unserer Mitarbeiter:innen sind Führungskräfte, die das Team bei der Arbeit an spannender, innovativer Technologie beaufsichtigen – die es teilweise nur bei Amazon gibt.
Von der Installation automatisierter Verpackungssysteme bis hin zur Beaufsichtigung der allgemeinen Wartungsarbeiten eines Standorts sowie der Reparatur von für den Vertrieb wesentlichen Geräten wickelt unser Team einen Großteil der technischen Aufgaben bei Amazon ab. Unter anderem sorgt es auch dafür, dass Gebäude weiterhin den rechtlichen Auflagen entsprechen, damit alle sicher bleiben und unsere Standorte mit maximaler Effizienz betrieben werden. Es gibt zahlreiche Aufstiegschancen im RME-Team selbst ebenso wie im gesamten Amazon-Unternehmen.
Alle unsere Aktivitäten sind darauf ausgerichtet, die Ausfallzeiten an Amazons wichtigsten Betriebsstandorten zu reduzieren, damit Kund:innen ihre Bestellungen rechtzeitig erhalten. Oft arbeiten wir früh morgens, spät abends oder in der Nachtschicht, um Wartungsarbeiten mit den geringstmöglichen Störungen vorzunehmen. Falls wir eine bessere Möglichkeit finden, eine bestimmte Aufgabe zu erledigen, verfügen wir über die Fertigkeiten und Gelegenheiten, vollständig neue Prozesse oder bahnbrechende Technologie wie Amazon Robotics oder unseren Complex Item Sorter einzuführen.

Basic qualifications

- Abgeschlossene technische Berufsausbildung, anerkannt durch die Industrie- und Handelskammer (IHK) oder Handwerkskammer (HWK) oder Nachweis eines erfolgreich abgeschlossen Hochschulstudium im Ingenieurwissenschaftlichen Bereich (Maschinenbau / Elektrotechnik oder artverwandt) einer deutschen Hochschule oder anerkannte ausländische Hochschulabschlüsse (BA, B. Sc., MA, M. Sc., Dipl.-Ing.)
- Zusätzlich, eine abgeschlossene Qualifikation als Industriemeister, Handwerksmeister oder Staatlich Geprüfter/Anerkannter Techniker oder mehrjährige einschlägige Berufserfahrung

title: Innovation lab Lead, Fulfillment Centre Operations
descriptionHtml:
At Amazon, we strive to be Earth's most customer-centric company where people can find and discover anything they want to buy online. We hire the world's brightest minds, offering them an environment in which they can relentlessly improve the experience for customers. Innovation and creativity are built into the DNA of the company and are encouraged at all levels of employment. Every day we solve complex technical and business problems with ingenuity and simplicity. We're making history and the good news is we've only just begun.

Summary: Amazon is a highly data-driven company that is passionate about its customers. As our operations network grows across Fulfilment Centres, Sort Centres, IXDs, Return Centres, Last Mile Stations, Quick Commerce hubs and Micro Fulfilment Centres, automation is key to delivering orders on time, with quality, safely and at lower cost. The Innovation Lab at BLR8 is where new automation solutions, such as Autonomous Mobile Robots (AMRs), automated packing equipment and internally developed tools, are piloted, tested and proven on a live floor before they scale across the network.

The Team Lead is a hands-on role at the centre of every pilot. They run the trials themselves, keep the pilot area safe, collect the data that proves or disproves each solution, and turn what works into standard work that other sites can adopt. This role suits someone with strong operations floor experience who is curious about technology, works well without direct supervision, and can get engineering, vendor and site teams moving toward the same outcome without having authority over them.

A day in the life
**Job Deliverables:**
- Pilot execution:
- Run pilots on the floor to the agreed test plan, including operating and testing the equipment yourself
- Set up pilot stations, material flow and test scenarios before each trial window
- Flag deviations from the test plan, and equipment or process failures, the same day they happen
- Safety in automation zones:
- Enforce the safety controls for the pilot area
- Carry out pre-trial safety checks and risk assessments for every new setup or process change
- Report and investigate near-misses and incidents in the pilot area
- Data and reporting:
- Collect physical pilot data (time studies, cycle times, downtime and fault logs, exception counts) according to the Business Analyst's data plan
- Check data accuracy at the end of each trial day and publish the daily pilot report
- Keep a live issue log (equipment faults, process gaps, user feedback) and follow up with Engineering, Controls and vendors until each item is closed
- Standard work and scale readiness:
- Draft and update SOPs and Standard Job Instructions (SJIs) for each pilot as the process changes
- Build training material and train site associates and teams on new equipment when a pilot moves to a live site
- Capture floor learnings for the deployment package that goes with a solution when it scales to other sites
- Conduct 4M and 5S audits on pilot workstations every day and keep the lab audit-ready for leadership and vendor visits
- Coordinate vendor and engineering teams on the floor during installation, trials and troubleshooting windows
- Work with site operations teams to schedule trials at their sites without disrupting their production
- Deep-dive on pilot metrics and propose clear actions and process improvements
- Stand in for the Ops Lead when needed

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English
- Experience with Microsoft Office products and applications
- Experience with Excel

Preferred qualifications

- 1+ years of customer-facing environment, warehousing, logistics or manufacturing experience

title: Software Development Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Join our team of innovative Software Engineers and build the next generation service platforms for AWS, EC2 and our customers. These services are key components of the Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2) web service.

Our platform handles a significant load of Internet traffic generated by internal and external customers that build their solutions on EC2. On any given day we use Java, Kotlin, Typescript, Python, Ruby, Go and C++ as well as various Native AWS services and Amazon-internal tools. We don't expect you to be an expert in, or know all these technologies, but we do expect you to have strong programming fundamentals and be excited to learn about these technologies.

Our team invents, designs and builds software that is stable, scalable and performant. We write and support code that is easy to understand with solutions that are pragmatic. We keep a high bar in code reviews to ensure high quality code.

Engineers in our teams have great ownership, a drive to innovate and aim to have resounding impact in whatever we build.

As a member of this team, you will own and contribute to the development of quality designs & solutions, solving complex problems. You are able to operate with limited guidance and take a long term view of your team’s services and how they fit into the broader architecture. The services that your team own are used by many teams and you will have opportunities to work and influence engineers and teams outside of your own team to build out EC2 architecture that supports Amazon scale business needs.

We follow a DevOps model and we assign projects and tasks based on what will help each team member develop into a more well rounded engineer that will enable them to take on more complex tasks in the future. This position includes on-call duties which is on rotation with the rest of the team. Our team values work-life balance.

As an Amazonian, you will enjoy interacting with some of the most talented engineers in our industry through breakfast talks and demos, internal communities and extensive training material that spans all aspects of our business.

title: Software Development Engineer, AWS Quick Business Intelligence
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) QuickSight is looking to hire an experienced Software Development Engineer to support the fast growing organization that builds world class experiences and services for our customers. AWS QuickSight is a fast, easy-to-use, cloud-based, serverless Business Intelligence (BI) service designed for easy deployment to tens of thousands of users. As a fully-managed SaaS application, there's no need to buy, manage, and scale servers and no software to deploy and upgrade. QuickSight is deeply integrated with AWS data sources, allowing companies to deploy secure and scalable BI on their data in AWS.

You will be part of a QuickSight team to grow its business intelligence platform. The team is innovating the next generation of business intelligence, leveraging agentic AI to reinvent how customers explore, analyze, visualize, and act on their data through a unified, serverless BI experience. We have just started on this journey and have a lot of autonomy in delivering the future of cloud-based business intelligence. You'll have the opportunity to influence decisions related to system architecture, feature development, and product strategy, and to design and build complex distributed systems with AWS Serverless and microservice architecture. The team has plenty of opportunities to learn from the best in the industry and grow your career, since this is a high visibility and strategic project.

Our next journey is agentic AI. We are building and delivering the foundational AI services that let customers transform their businesses and harness the potential of AI to solve their most complex challenges, bringing agentic experiences to the way they explore and act on their data. You'll work alongside a dynamic team of AI/ML practitioners, applied scientists, software engineers, and solution architects who work backwards from customer needs to create innovative technologies. If you're passionate about shaping the future of AI while making a meaningful impact for customers worldwide, we want to hear from you.

Key job responsibilities
In this role, you will:

- Help define the system architecture and technical direction for our business intelligence platform, owning and implementing significant components end to end while shaping the broader connectivity and integration roadmap.
- Design and build complex, scalable distributed systems using AWS Serverless and microservice architecture, making decisions that impact the platform's long-term vision.
- Drive work across the full software lifecycle, planning, design, implementation, testing, operations, and continuous process improvement, as a member of an autonomous, high-ownership team.
- Take responsibility for technical problem-solving, creatively meeting product goals under ambiguity and balancing near-term delivery with long-term maintainability.
- Define, document, and champion engineering best practices, raising the bar for code quality, operational excellence, and team-wide technical standards.
- Collaborate with product managers, applied scientists, and fellow engineers to translate customer needs into differentiated capabilities, including the agentic AI experiences that define the next generation of BI.
- Mentor and elevate other engineers through design reviews, code reviews, and technical guidance, multiplying the impact of the team.


A day in the life
A typical day mixes focused building with close collaboration. You might begin at a design review, working through an architecture proposal with fellow engineers, then sit with product managers and UX designers to shape how a new capability should look and behave for customers. From there you move into planning and designing your own components, then building and testing them, from the query and semantic layer through visualization and the agentic AI experiences that let customers explore their data conversationally. Because you own what you build, you also monitor your services in production, investigate issues, and keep improving how the platform scales to tens of thousands of users worldwide.

About the team
We are the team building the next generation of QuickSight's business intelligence platform. Our mission is to reinvent how customers explore, analyze, visualize, and act on their data, moving beyond dashboards toward a unified, serverless, agentic BI experience. We are early in this journey, so the work is high-ownership and high-impact. We work backwards from customer needs, care deeply about technical excellence, and give every engineer room to grow. We value work-life harmony. Success at work should never come at the expense of home, which is why flexibility is part of our culture.

title: System Development Engineer, Astra ADC
descriptionHtml:
This is an excellent opportunity to join Amazon's world-class technical team at HQ2 in Arlington, VA, working with some of the best and brightest engineers while developing your skills and furthering your career within one of the most innovative technology companies anywhere.

Amazon Software Builder Experience (ASBX) Astra ADC provides the foundational services that every Amazon builder depends on to develop, deploy, and operate software from continuous deployment orchestration to testing infrastructure and configuration management. Our team owns and operates critical ASBX services across Amazon's most secure and isolated environments, including Apollo (deployment), Pipelines (continuous delivery), Test on Demand/Hydra (integration testing), AppConfig (feature management), Multi-Region (resource replication), Builder MCP, and AIM (AI agent infrastructure). We ensure these services maintain parity, reliability, and security across all partitions.

A successful Engineer joining the team will do much more than write code and triage problems. They will operate services at scale in air-gapped environments where standard commercial tooling doesn't exist, drive cross-partition deployment parity, and build the automation that keeps Amazon's most sensitive workloads shipping safely. They will dive deep into complex distributed systems issues and work diligently to improve the builder experience.

The ideal candidate will:

- Be great fun to work with. Our company credo is "Work hard. Have fun. Make history." The right candidate will love what they do and instinctively know how to make work fun.
- Have strong Linux & Networking Fundamentals. The ideal candidate will have deep experience working with Linux, preferably in large-scale, distributed environments. You understand networking technology, how services communicate across isolated boundaries, and regularly take part in deep-dive troubleshooting and technical post-mortem discussions to identify root causes of complex issues.
- Love to code. Whether it's building deployment automation, creating AI-powered operational tooling, or solving complex cross-partition orchestration problems, the ideal candidate will love using technology to solve problems. You have a solid understanding of software development methodology and CI/CD practices.
- Think Big. The ideal candidate will build and deploy solutions that enable thousands of Amazon builders to ship software reliably across multiple isolated regions. You will strive to improve and streamline processes to allow delivery at massive scale.
This position requires that the candidate selected must currently possess and maintain an active TS/SCI security clearance. The position further requires that, after start, the selected candidate obtain and maintain an active TS/SCI security clearance with polygraph or commensurate clearance for each government agency for which they perform AWS work.


A day in the life
You start the morning reviewing deployment health across isolated regions, checking alarms and on-call handoffs. Mid-morning, you're deep in a code review for a cross-partition automation fix, then jump into a design discussion on how to bring a new ASBX service capability to air-gapped environments. After lunch, you troubleshoot a deployment pipeline issue, tracing it from orchestration logs to a configuration mismatch, and ship the fix before end of day. Between the technical depth and the autonomy to own problems end-to-end, no two days look the same.

title: NERC Compliance Specialist, AWS Energy Portfolio Operations
descriptionHtml:
The Amazon Energy Portfolio Operations (EPO) Risk & Compliance team is looking for a NERC Compliance Specialist to join us. EPO manages renewable power purchase agreements (PPAs) and data center energy supply agreements (ESAs) post-execution, provides controllership for financial and operational performance, and ensures our supply portfolio is compliant with external regulations, contract obligations, and internal policies.

As a NERC Compliance Specialist, you will be a critical member of the team building and operationalizing AWS's NERC compliance programs. You will build the day-to-day management of NERC compliance obligations across AWS's data center portfolio, working closely with engineering, facility operations, power generation solutions (PGS), legal, and external stakeholders to establish and ensure readiness, on-going compliance, and audit preparedness.

This is a unique opportunity to shape a first-of-its-kind compliance program at the intersection of cloud infrastructure and grid reliability regulation. The right candidate brings NERC domain expertise, a track record of establishing and overseeing compliance programs, and the ability to operate across multiple stakeholders and jurisdictions with limited guidance

Key job responsibilities
- Compliance Program Execution: Support the design, build, and operationalization of the AWS NERC Compliance Program, including emerging requirements for large load.
- Registration & Filings: Manage NERC registration filings, annual self-certifications, and compliance evidence across registered sites. Track registration boundary determinations (cluster vs. individual site) and coordinate with Regional Entities. Support the mapping and ongoing management of NERC obligations across applicable functional registrations.
- Compliance Assessment & Remediation: Serve as SME for assessment, design and drive remediation plans to closure. Track progress against Reliability Standards and Essential Actions.
- Audit Readiness: Develop and maintain Reliability Standard Audit Worksheets (RSAWs), compliance evidence repositories, and documentation in support of a scalable compliance program. Prepare for and support NERC audits, spot checks, and mock audits.
- Cross-Functional Coordination: Serve as the NERC compliance subject matter expert to internal teams across AWS, including Engineering (protection coordination, disturbance monitoring), Operations (operating instructions, communications protocols), Operations (load modeling, telemetry), and Legal (registration, interconnection agreements).
- ISO/RTO Requirements: Map and track ISO/RTO-specific compliance requirements that layer on top of NERC baseline standards across applicable regions. Identify where regional obligations diverge and ensure site-level compliance.
- Energy Deal Registration Analysis: Assess NERC registration triggers for energy contracts and supply strategies . Evaluate whether deal structures trigger GO/GOP, DP, or other NERC functional registrations and advise on compliance implications. Support FAC-001/FAC-002 interconnection and facility connection requirements as applicable.
- Regulatory Monitoring: Track NERC standards development activities (including Phase 2 items: VRT/FRT, CIP applicability, performance standards), FERC orders, and state/regional regulatory changes that may impact the compliance program.
- Reporting & Communication: Provide regular compliance status reporting to stakeholders and senior leadership. Write clear documentation including compliance narratives, risk assessments, and corrective action plans.
- Process Improvement: Identify and implement process improvements to scale compliance operations across a growing portfolio of registered sites. Develop procedures, templates, and mechanisms for repeatable compliance evidence collection.

title: Software Development Engineer, Fulfillment Planning and Execution
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we're the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we're looking for talented people who want to help.

You'll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You'll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you'll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Our team is at the heart of AWS compute fulfillment — we build the mission-critical systems that translate demand from major AWS services (EC2, S3, EBS, Networking, and more) into actionable plans for material procurement, data center capacity allocation, rack building, and rack landing across AWS's global infrastructure. We are looking for a proven Software Development Engineer who thrives in a fast-paced, high-ambiguity environment and can hit the ground running.

You will own and build systems that are responsible for:
- Rack Building & Rack Landing — orchestrating the end-to-end lifecycle from plan to physical delivery
- Plan-to-Execution Convergence — proactively identifying deviations between planned and actual execution, surfacing root causes, and driving corrective actions
- Fulfillment Explainability — building intelligent systems that explain "why" plans miss targets, enabling planners and operators to take timely, informed action

These are high-impact, globally-scoped systems where reliability and accuracy directly affect AWS's ability to meet customer demand. You will work on challenging distributed systems problems at massive scale, leveraging modern AWS-native architectures.

Key job responsibilities
1. Design, build, and operate large-scale distributed systems that power AWS infrastructure fulfillment planning and execution.
2. Architect solutions that detect and explain deviations between build plans and execution outcomes, enabling proactive intervention.
3. Write high-quality, modular, testable code and set the standard for engineering excellence on the team.
4. Solve complex architecture and business problems with extensible, scalable solutions built on native AWS services.
5. Formally mentor engineers on design, coding, operational excellence, and troubleshooting.
6. Collaborate cross-functionally with demand planning, supply chain operations, and partner engineering teams in a global environment.

About the team
The Fulfillment Planning and Execution team within Infrastructure Supply Chain Automation builds intelligent systems that plan and execute to AWS global compute need and provide visibility, explainability, and actionable insights across AWS's fulfillment supply chain. We handle compute needs from every major internal AWS department — our systems are mission-critical and operate at global scale. We are a fast-moving team that values ownership, bias for action, and delivering results that directly impact AWS's ability to scale for customers worldwide.

Basic qualifications

- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 1+ years of software development engineer or related occupational experience
