descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

Amazon is seeking a motivated and data-driven category manager to support the Americas data center construction space. The candidate should have strong supply chain and procurement skills, engineering design, architecture, construction, analytical and financial acumen , and passion to dive-deep. Additionally, candidate must have proven skills in managing large-scale supply chain and procurement improvement projects.
As a Procurement Manager, you will create and implement sourcing strategies for at least one services category and collaborate with internal business partners and suppliers to drive efficiencies, reduce risks, and costs for Amazon. You will develop mechanisms and metrics to hold suppliers accountable for performance and delivery. You will drive results through methods that include competitive bidding, negotiating, and analyzing data and market trends for your category.
The ideal candidate thinks long term, drives multiple initiatives, communicates appropriately and influences customers and suppliers at all levels. You will be collaborative, but also work with significant autonomy. To be successful in this role you will be highly analytical; think strategically and globally; exhibit curiosity and learning drive; have a sense of urgency to meet customer timelines, succeed in a fast-paced environment; and have a high level of customer focus and business judgement. It will be critical to embrace and model Amazon’s Leadership Principles and have an entrepreneurial spirit.
A successful candidate will demonstrate:
· Proven experience driving large-scale process improvements resulting in measurable value
· High attention to detail including proven ability to manage multiple, competing priorities simultaneously
· Ability to think strategically and execute methodically
· Demonstrated ability to influence teams to adopt change utilizing smart technologies
· Ability to work in a fast-paced environment where ambiguity exists and continuous innovation is desired
· Committed to learning and expanding professional and technical knowledge
· Demonstrated analytical, financial and quantitative skills and ability to use hard data and metrics to back up assumptions and develop business cases
· Willingness to roll up your sleeves and do whatever is necessary; general manager / owner mentality
· Demonstrated ability to dive deep in understanding the product, our business, and the competitive landscape
· Ability to see ahead comprehensively and devise a strong plan of action, and ensure execution happens on time, every time
· Ability to get things done and produce conclusive, measurable results within time commitments
· Strong influencing skills




A day in the life

As a Procurement Manager on the Data Center Construction Procurement team, you will own the end-to-end commercial relationship with General Contractors (GCs) delivering AWS data centers. No two days look the same — you might be negotiating a Guaranteed Maximum Price in the morning, reviewing schedule recovery options with a project team at midday, and evaluating GC proposals for a new campus RFP by close of business.

Day to day you will:

Drive competitive sourcing events — develop RFP strategies, evaluate contractor qualifications, and lead award recommendations for some of the largest construction programs in the industry.
Negotiate and manage contracts — structure contract amendments, negotiate change orders, and hold GCs accountable to cost, schedule, and safety commitments.
Partner cross-functionally — work alongside Construction, Design, Legal, Finance, and Program Management to remove blockers, align on delivery milestones, and ensure data center capacity comes online on time.
Analyze cost and risk — benchmark GC pricing, identify cost-savings opportunities, and flag commercial risks before they become schedule impacts.
Influence at scale — develop procurement playbooks, contract standards, and lessons-learned that raise the bar across AWS's global data center portfolio.
You will support projects across multiple regions and have the opportunity to shape how AWS procures and delivers data center construction — locally and globally.

About AWS Infrastructure Services (AIS)

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure — in other words, we're the people who keep the cloud running. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain, and we're looking for talented people who want to help.

You'll join a diverse team of engineers, supply chain specialists, construction professionals, security experts, and operations managers. title: Arquiteto(a) de Soluções, Brazil Solutions Architecture, Enterprise Cross Industry
descriptionHtml:
Você está em busca de uma carreira com grandes desafios? Possui curiosidade e persistência? Você quer se desenvolver em um ambiente inovador, onde experimentamos coisas novas e sonhamos grande? Quer fazer parte do futuro da computação em nuvem com uma equipe obcecada por ajudar os clientes?

Se sim, junte-se à nossa equipe AWS no Brasil como Arquiteto(a) de Soluções e ajude nossos clientes a mudarem o mundo! A AWS é a plataforma de nuvem mais adotada e mais abrangente do mundo, suportando milhões de clientes, incluindo startups, grandes empresas e órgãos governamentais.

Nesta função, sua criatividade conectará tecnologia a soluções tangíveis. Você trabalhará todos os dias para ajudar clientes a aproveitarem ao máximo os serviços da AWS, para que possam inovar, prosperar e transformar nosso país. Você terá a oportunidade de aprender novas habilidades e aprimorar as suas existentes. Você criará e compartilhará conteúdo técnico, arquiteturas de referência e práticas recomendadas. Você divulgará e educará sobre a tecnologia da AWS.

Esperamos de você motivação, trabalho em colaboração com pessoas ao redor do mundo, disposição para enfrentar desafios, paixão pelo que faz e se divertir ao fazê-lo. Você deve gostar de treinar, desenhar e criar soluções em nuvem para um conjunto diversificado e desafiador de clientes.

Key job responsibilities
As equipes de Arquitetura de Soluções possuem 4 responsabilidades principais:

1. Atuar de forma consultiva para clientes. Em parceria com a equipe de contas, formular e executar uma estratégia para viabilizar o sucesso do cliente. Ajudar clientes a adotar os serviços da AWS e fazer o melhor uso deles, gerando receita como resultado. Educar clientes sobre a proposta de valor da AWS e participar de discussões de arquitetura para garantir que as soluções sejam desenhadas para uma implantação bem-sucedida na nuvem. Criar confiança com equipes técnicas dentro de clientes para que sejam cloud advocates.
2. Ser referência técnica. Transferir conhecimento para clientes. Capturar e compartilhar conhecimento e boas práticas na comunidade de arquitetura de soluções da AWS. Contribuir com publicações para o cliente da AWS, como whitepapers, postagens ou blogs. Apresentar e contribuir em workshops, grupos de usuários, vídeos online e conferências.
3. Estar em crescimento profissional contínuo. Manter a curiosidade e o aprendizado. Demonstrar seu aprendizado através das Certificações da AWS. Trabalhar com outras pessoas para ajudá-las a entregar mais. Participar de encontros e conferências.
4. Desenvolver e executar melhorias organizacionais. Atuar como um elo técnico entre clientes e equipes de engenharia de serviços para melhorar os serviços e recursos da AWS. Contribuir com suas ideias para inovação para times internos e clientes. Simplificar processos que podem ser simplificados. Ajudar a contratar e desenvolver talentos.

About the team
A Amazon Web Services Brasil valoriza a Diversidade, Equidade e Inclusão (DE&I) em todas as nossas posições de trabalho, e por isso atuamos com intencionalidade para que nosso ambiente interno reflita a pluralidade dos mercados em que atuamos e clientes que atendemos.

Aqui na AWS, abraçamos nossas diferenças. Estamos comprometidos em promover nossa cultura de inclusão. Temos 13 employee led groups globalmente, que reúnem os funcionários da Amazon entre organizações e países ao redor do mundo. No Brasil, alguns exemplos incluem o Women@Amazon, o Glamazon (LGBTQIA+) e o Black Employee Network (BEN). A cultura de inclusão da Amazon é reforçada em nossos 16 Princípios de Liderança, que lembram as pessoas a buscar perspectivas diversas, aprender, ter curiosidade e ganhar confiança.

Se você quiser solicitar uma acomodação para a entrevista ou o processo de integração, avise seu recrutador(a) e ele(a) o conectará à nossa equipe de acomodação.

Mentoria e Crescimento profissional
Nossa equipe é dedicada a apoiar as pessoas recém contratadas. Temos uma equipe com ampla variedade de níveis de experiência e cargos, e estamos construindo um ambiente que celebra o compartilhamento de conhecimento e a mentoria. Nós nos preocupamos com o crescimento de sua carreira e nos esforçamos para atribuir projetos que contribuam para que cada pessoa da equipe se desenvolva e possa liderar iniciativas mais complexas no futuro.

A AWS valoriza experiências diversas. Mesmo que você não atenda a todas as qualificações e habilidades preferidas listadas na descrição da vaga, incentivamos os candidatos a se candidatarem. Se sua carreira está apenas começando, não seguiu um caminho tradicional ou inclui experiências alternativas, não deixe que isso o impeça de se candidatar.

Por que AWS?
A Amazon Web Services (AWS) é a plataforma de nuvem mais abrangente e amplamente adotada do mundo. Fomos pioneiros na computação em nuvem e nunca paramos de inovar — é por isso que clientes, desde as startups mais bem-sucedidas até empresas da Global 500, confiam em nosso robusto conjunto de produtos e serviços para impulsionar seus negócios.

Cultura de Equipe Inclusiva
Aqui na AWS, está em nossa natureza aprender e ser curioso. Nossos grupos de afinidade liderados por funcionários promovem uma cultura de inclusão que nos capacita a ter orgulho de nossas diferenças. Eventos contínuos e experiências de aprendizado, incluindo nossas Conversas sobre Raça e Etnia (CORE) e conferências sobre diversidade, nos inspiram a nunca parar de abraçar nossa singularidade.

Mentoria e Crescimento Profissional
Estamos continuamente elevando nosso padrão de desempenho enquanto nos esforçamos para nos tornar o Melhor Empregador da Terra. É por isso que você encontrará aqui compartilhamento infinito de conhecimento, mentoria e outros recursos para desenvolvimento de carreira para ajudá-lo a se desenvolver como um profissional mais completo.

Equilíbrio entre Trabalho e Vida Pessoal
Valorizamos a harmonia entre trabalho e vida pessoal. Alcançar sucesso no trabalho nunca deve vir à custa de sacrifícios em casa, por isso buscamos flexibilidade como parte de nossa cultura de trabalho. Quando nos sentimos apoiados no local de trabalho e em casa, não há nada que não possamos alcançar na nuvem.

Basic qualifications

- Experiência em áreas específicas de tecnologia (por exemplo, desenvolvimento de software, computação em nuvem, engenharia de sistemas, infraestrutura, segurança, redes, dados e análises)
- Experiência em design, implementação ou consultoria em aplicações e infraestruturas
- Experiência em desenvolvimento de TI ou implementação/consultoria nas indústrias de software ou internet
- Habilidade de comunicação efetiva em inglês (escrita e oral)

Preferred qualifications

- Experiência em vendas, pré-vendas ou consultoria de tecnologia/software
- Experiência em desenvolvimento de software ou em setores relacionados à internet
- Experiência em migração ou transformação de soluções legadas de clientes para a nuvem
- Experiência com tecnologias AWS

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. title: Technical Account Manager , TAM Public Sector (BRA)
descriptionHtml:
AWS Applied AI Solutions (AAIS) is building toward a future where every business innovates with Amazon AI teammates. To get there, we build AI solutions that improve human capabilities and transform entire business functions. We create end-to-end products that surprise and delight out-of-the-box, making complex things easy and hard things possible, with no cloud experience required. We start with customers who embrace the future and build bridges to meet the rest where they are. We pursue ambitious opportunities with conviction, and we are looking for builders who share that mindset.

Would you like to join one of the fastest-growing organizations within Amazon Web Services (AWS) and help customers of all industries and sizes gain the best value and service from AWS? At AWS Enterprise Support we're looking for a Technical Account Manager to work with our customers' creative and transformative spirit of innovation across all technologies. This is a technical role in which you will have an opportunity to be the principal technical advisor and 'voice of the customer'.

As a Technical Account Manager you will help craft and execute strategies to drive customer adoption and use of AWS services. Your technical acumen and customer-facing skills will enable you to effectively represent AWS within a customer's environment and drive discussions with senior leadership regarding incidents, trade-offs, proactive scope, and risk management. You will provide advocacy and strategic technical direction to help plan and build solutions using standard methodologies and enthusiastically keep your customers' AWS environments operationally healthy. The closer relationships developed with your customers will empower you to understand their business/operational needs and technical challenges and help them achieve the greatest value from AWS.

Key job responsibilities
• Every day will bring new and exciting challenges on the job while you:

title: Lab Test Engineer, Environmental Test, Amazon Leo
descriptionHtml:
Amazon LEO is Amazon’s low Earth orbit satellite broadband network. Its mission is to deliver fast, reliable internet to customers and communities around the world, and we’ve designed the system with the capacity, flexibility, and performance to serve a wide range of customers, from individual households to schools, hospitals, businesses, government agencies, and other organizations operating in locations without reliable connectivity.

Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

The Lab Test Engineer role is responsible for keeping aerospace environmental test production running smoothly. You will troubleshoot issues that technicians encounter during daily testing, resolving problems with test setup, equipment, and IT infrastructure. The Lab Test Engineer will be an expert for our various Automated Test Equipment (Test Racks) used during environmental testing. With your expertise in environmental testing procedures, equipment, and basic Python scripting, you will identify root causes and implement corrective actions to maximize productivity and product quality. Additionally, you are responsible for production support activities including ticket management, change management, monitoring, metrics, documentation, process development, host provisioning, and hardware management. You may also debug, evaluate, and resolve software issues for applications and services that will improve availability and performance. You will develop scripts and applications to automate redundant tasks and to improve operational efficiency. You will work cross-functionally with Development, QA, and other Support teams to maintain and improve availability and performance of Amazon LEO's production Automated Test Equipment.

Key job responsibilities
- Maintain, troubleshoot and improve test automation hardware supporting production testing
- Troubleshoot electrical, mechanical or software problems on the fly, working with an integrated cross-functional team of manufacturing engineers, test engineers, lab technicians and maintenance teams to resolve
- Perform RCCA of issues in production testing and implement corrective actions to prevent recurrence
- Develop and maintain calibration procedures for RF test equipment
- Define and implement solutions to optimize and automate environmental testing
- Work with other engineers to refine test requirements and the methodologies to achieve those requirements
- Willing to “roll up sleeves and do what needs to be done” in a small, specialized, team environment
- Must be willing to work off shifts and weekends as required



A day in the life
The primary goal of this role is to ensure all automated production test racks remain fully operational, properly calibrated, and ready for use by production technicians. Daily responsibilities include planning and coordinating preventive maintenance with schedulers, organizing and tracking all rack calibration activities, and maintaining accurate documentation and hardware configuration data in partnership with supporting engineering teams.

This role also oversees the readiness of spare test racks, ensuring they are maintained, functional, and available for rapid swap-in when needed. It includes coordinating any required repairs to return equipment to operational status. Additional responsibilities include cataloging test harness requirements, monitoring inventory and life-usage of harnesses, and ensuring adequate spare coverage.

The engineer is expected to respond quickly to escalations from technicians, providing troubleshooting support and resolving operational issues with the test racks to minimize production downtime.

Basic qualifications

- 2+ years of hardware development, test lab, space/aerospace maintenance or hands-on engineering environment experience
- 2+ years of experience testing, troubleshooting, and debugging automated test systems including electrical, mechanical, electronic, networking, and software systems
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering or a related field and/or equivalent experience
- 2+ years of production test station (automated test equipment) hardware/software design and factory deployment
- 2+ years of experience with electrical test equipment, data acquisition, and control software
- Experience writing/reading/debugging software in Python, C, C# or other language

Preferred qualifications

- 4+ years of hardware design, development, validation and delivery of embedded hardware product experience
- 2+ years of experience with environmental testing focusing on thermal and vacuum test processes
- 2+ years of experience working with RF test systems

title: Data Center Facility Manager II - Nights
descriptionHtml:
Join our dynamic team and become a critical technical leader who ensures the heartbeat of our global infrastructure remains strong and resilient. In this pivotal role, you'll be the guardian of our data center operations, driving reliability and performance while optimizing operational efficiency across complex technical environments.

Data Center Facility Manger role acts as Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting. They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot mission-critical data center facility equipment including electrical support equipment such as stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, 3 phase electrical systems that include but not limited to switchgear, UPS units, PDUs, and wet cell batteries and associated systems. Mechanical equipment includes CRAC units, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers/water chemical systems, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, and motors. Additional support equipment is included in the scope of the role which includes fire suppression systems, building automation systems, and general facilities equipment.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

title: Sr Program Manager - Change Management, Hub Delivery
descriptionHtml:
At Amazon, we are working to be the most Customer-centric company on earth. One customer experience we are constantly looking to take to the next level is how we fulfill and deliver orders. We are doing so by building a world-class last mile operation that exceeds the expectations of our customers by ensuring their orders are delivered quickly, accurately, and cost-effectively.

Hub Delivery is looking for a Change Management Sr. Program Manager to run the day-to-day governance operation through which all operational, technology, and policy changes impacting Hub Delivery partners and delivery associates are assessed, approved, and deployed across 7+ countries. - Process and manage all change management intakes end-to-end: assess scope and risk, size complexity, prioritize, and route through the appropriate governance and approval path

- Collaborate with worldwide delivery program Change Management teams to align frameworks and drive process consistency across delivery channels
- Identify patterns across intakes to codify repeatable components, close parity gaps between regions, and eliminate scale blockers

- Operate autonomously with minimal oversight, managing a high volume of concurrent changes across multiple regions and stakeholder groups

The Hub Delivery program is part of Amazon's fast growing last mile delivery program worldwide. We partner with customer obsessed small business owners who then deliver to Amazon customers. Our partners raise the bar for the delivery experience, in some of the most complex last mile scenarios!

title: Robot Technician, RIVR
descriptionHtml:
We are seeking a hands-on, resourceful, and detail-oriented Field Technician to support the maintenance, testing and operation of our advanced robotic systems. As a Field Technician, you will be responsible not only for preparing and maintaining the robotic platforms but also for representing our company in the field, adapting to unexpected challenges, and directly supporting testing with professionalism and technical expertise. As part of this role, you will also assist with production processes for the business and provide continuous improvement in terms of processes and instruction guides. For this position, we can unfortunately only accept applications from citizens of Schengen Area countries.

Key job responsibilities
● On-site Troubleshooting and First Response: Independently diagnose and resolve mechanical, electrical, and software issues, often under time pressure and changing conditions, utilizing established ticketing systems.
● Customer Interaction and Reporting: Serve as the technical point of contact for customers during field operations, providing clear communication, professional support, and post-mission reporting to internal teams.
● Data Collection and Reporting: Collect operational data, monitor system logs, and provide insights to engineering teams for system refinement.
● Preventive Maintenance and Inspection: Perform scheduled maintenance routines, visual inspections, and component replacements to maximize system uptime and extend hardware life.
● Production and Assembly Support: Assist with robot assembly, sub-system integration, and quality checks during production runs, ensuring builds meet engineering specifications.
● Process Documentation and Continuous Improvement: Create, update, and refine work instructions, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and deployment checklists based on field learnings and evolving best practices.
● Inventory and Spare Parts Management: Track spare parts, consumables, and tooling; coordinate restocking and ensure field kits are complete and deployment-ready.
● Safety and Compliance: Uphold workplace health and safety standards across workshop and field environments, including proper handling of batteries, electrical systems, and heavy equipment.
● Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with software, hardware, and operations engineers to relay field observations, validate fixes, and support iterative design improvements.
● Test Execution and Validation: Support structured testing campaigns—both in the lab and in the field—by following test protocols, recording results, and flagging anomalies for engineering review.


About the team
RIVR is a Swiss robotics company pioneering Physical AI and robotic solutions to revolutionize last-mile delivery, giving 1 human the power of 1000. Through the combination of artificial neural networks and innovative robot designs with wheels and legs, RIVR aims to enhance efficiency, sustainability, and scalability in last-mile delivery. Founded as Swiss-Mile, the company rebranded to RIVR in 2025 to better reflect its mission of driving the future of intelligent robotics. Join our innovative team, renowned for pioneering robotic design and neural network applications in robotics that improve environmental understanding and decision-making. With a robust research foundation and notable contributions from ETH Zurich, we are leaders in translating artificial intelligence and robotics into practical, real-world applications.
RIVR is committed to building a diverse and inclusive team that values every perspective. If you’re passionate about driving innovation in robotics and creating meaningful impact, we encourage you to apply and bring your unique self to our team.

Basic qualifications

- Experience in customer-facing work, engaging with customer executives, technologists or partners to solve business problems with advanced technologies
- Degree or apprenticeship in mechatronics, robotics, or equivalent.
- Proven ability to work independently in the field, diagnose problems under pressure, and perform quick, effective repairs without immediate supervision.
- Ability to follow structured procedures, deployment checklists, safety protocols, and quality standards even in dynamic environments.
- Willingness and ability to travel to field locations - sometimes on short notice. Interest in both maintaining and operating robotics systems.

Preferred qualifications

- Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays
- Experience with robotic operation and maintenance

title: Business Coach, Amazon, VAS-Category
descriptionHtml:
Equal parts advisor and operating partner, Amazon’s team of Business Coaches assist and guide our Delivery Service Partner (DSP) business owners as they build and grow successful last mile package delivery businesses during a transformational time.

The Business Coach finds and executes value-creation opportunities and manages the DSP relationship across the entire lifecycle of the business. As trusted advisors, Business Coaches work alongside DSPs to help solve their biggest challenges at a programmatic level; influence their business planning and strategy; and look around corners to identify obstacles and recommend solutions, ensuring DSP owners make effective business decisions and are setup for success.

Our Business Coaches are leaders and collaborators. They are analytical and creative; deadline-driven, organized and able to multi-task; and have strong interpersonal skills including a demonstrated ability to earn trust, inspire others, and be empathetic. You’ll be at the center of cross-functional teams, all working together to deliver the highest quality experience to Amazon customers.

Key job responsibilities

Supporting owners as they onboard to the program and prepare to launch.
Guiding owners as they scale their business and manage operational issues, ensuring they have resources in place to effectively ramp-up operations and prepare for peak periods.
Coordinating Business and Financial Health Reviews to discuss business performance and new opportunities, as well as to provide benchmarking data and insights.
Identifying workflow inefficiencies and working to formulate and implement operational improvements at the network level and to improve the individual DSP owner experience.

A day in the life
As a Business Coach, you will partner with 20-40 DSP owners assigned to delivery stations across IN. You’ll work closely with a portfolio of owners at different stages as they set strategy, help drive accountability and engagement, and motivate and track key performance metrics. このポジションの勤務地は、岐阜県にある多治見FC（フルフィルメントセンター）になります。

Amazonの入荷・出荷のプロセスを行うFCには、世界最先端の自動化物流設備が導入されています。コンベア、ロボット、自動仕分けシステムなど、最新テクノロジーを活用し、商品の入出荷を効率的に行っています。このような先進的な環境で、次世代の物流技術に携わることができます。
　
RME（Reliability and Maintenance Engineering）部門は、日々物流設備の保全と保守、改善を行い、お客様に満足いただけるように努めております。 今回、RME部門が募集する職種はFCに導入されている物流設備の保全と保守、および設備の安全性や生産性を向上させるための改善を担当いただく「サイトメンテナンスシニアテクニシャン」というポジションになります。
　
本ポジションは物流設備の保全経験者だけでなく、異業界・異職種からのキャリアチェンジをお考えの方も広く募集しています。これまでのエンジニアとしての経験を活かしながら、次のステージへと成長できる環境をご用意しております。入社後は体系的な教育プログラムに加え、豊富な経験を持つ先輩社員によるさぽーとにより、確かな技術力と自信を着実に身につけていただけます。
　
RMEにて技術力と現場感を身に着けることで将来的なキャリア選択肢は大きく広がります。マネジメント職や技術スペシャリストへのキャリアアップはもちろん、社内公募制度を通じて設備導入、設計、開発など、幅広いフィールドでの活躍も可能です。
　
【More Information】
■メンテナンス部門について
　・メンテナンスエンジニア特設サイト
　・社員インタビュー/堺FC勤務の社員T.S.さん
　・社員インタビュー/堺FC勤務の社員E.M.さん
■勤務地について
　・フルフィルメントセンター (FC)
　・勤務地:多治見FC
　
Amazon は多様かつインクルーシブな職場づくりを目指しています。Amazonは男女雇用機会均等法を順守しています。人種、 出身国、性別、性的指向、障がい、年齢、その他の属性によって差別することなく、平等に採用選考の機会を提供しています。障がいをお持ちの方は、以下をご覧ください。https://www.amazon.jobs/disability/jp
オペレーション部門のDEIの取り組み

Amazonでは、最新のAI Tool, 生成AIを日々の業務の中に積極的に取り入れています。AI Toolは私たちの意思決定のスピードを加速させ、私たちを本当に重要な「判断」と「議論」に集中させることを可能にしています。Amazon では学習を継続する文化が根付いているため、ご自身のペースでAIに関する知識を深めることができるリソースが用意されています。

Key job responsibilities
【具体的な業務内容】
下記業務をチームで対応いただきます。
■60%：日常点検・異常対応…稼働監視/巡回による設備点検/異常対応、故障復旧/オーバーホール、部品修繕
■20%：メンテナンス業務…予防保全/定期保全/状態保全/事後保全
■10%：安全対策…設備・作業環境の安全対策/5S活動
■5%：カイゼン活動…機械、電気、制御（PLC）と広い範囲でカイゼンや改造を実施
■5%：その他…メンテナンス計画/デザインレビュー
　
【取り扱う設備の一例（FCによって異なる）】
■Amazon Robotics（商品棚を持ち上げて移動させるロボット）
■荷合わせシステム（同じお客様が注文された商品を一つにまとめる設備）
■パッキング設備（荷合わせした商品をまとめて梱包する設備）
■仕分け設備（宛先ラベルの印刷と貼り付けを行い、配送方面毎に仕分けを行う設備）

A day in the life
【教育・研修】
・入社後は、体系化された教育プログラムに沿って、安全ルール、保全作業、専門的な技術習得（機械・電気・制御）を進めていただきます。同時に所属拠点ではOJTを通して実務を習得いただきます。まずは物流設備の軽微なエラー対応や保全・保守の補佐業務を担当いただき、バディー制度により先輩社員がサポートをいたしますので、不明点の確認や相談がしやすい環境となります。その後は今までのキャリアの中で培ってきたスキルを応用し、改善や安全対策、効率化施策を手掛けることで幅広い領域で活かしていただくことができます。
　
【働き方】
本ポジションは、シフト勤務になり「3交代・早番専属・夜勤専属」のシフトパターンがあります。
シフトパターンは希望を考慮の上、決定させていただきますが、将来的なシフト勤務形態の変更の可能性もございます。
＜シフト例＞※シフトは拠点によって異なります。
　・3交代 　6:00-15:00, 14:30-23:30, 23:00-8:00
　・早番専属　6:00-15:00
　・夜勤専属　23:00-8:00
シフトは1か月以上前に事前に周知される為、休暇の計画が立てやすく、チームで調整することで休暇が取得しやすい環境です。
退勤時間には次の班が出勤し引継ぎを行う為、残業時間が少なく、急な呼び出しも発生しません。
公共交通機関が運行しない時間帯でも交代勤務に出社できるようお願いいたします。
（自家用車・自転車は可（入社前に要申請・許可制）、バイク・タクシーは不可）

Basic qualifications

- 機械や電気機器の保全や保守、または生産技術・設備導入や立ち上げを1年以上ご経験された方
- PCを使用した作業のご経験のある方。（エクセル、ワード、Outlook）
- ビジネスレベルの日本語力（メールの読み書き、報告、連絡、相談ができる）

Preferred qualifications

- 物流設備の保守保全、もしくはフィールドエンジニアの経験
- 機械部品の取扱経験・知識（モーター・エアシリンダー・動力伝達機構・バルブなど）
- 電気部品の取扱経験・知識（インバーター・光学センサー・BCR・温度センサーなど）
- 制御機器の取扱経験・知識（PLC・サーボアンプ・タッチパネル・調節計など）
- 機械工学、もしくは電気工学の基礎知識 （工業高校または専門学校卒業程度）
- 労働安全衛生基礎知識　（製造工場・生産設備での安全知識）
- 英語でのコミュニケーション能力
- オーナーシップ：自ら課題を見つけ、責任を持って解決できる。
- 探究心と向上心：いままで経験がない業務においても新しい知識を学ぶことに意欲的で、何事にも前向きに取組むことができる。
- チームワーク：リスペクトを持ってメンバーと協働でき、報連相ができる。
- 機敏性と柔軟性：変化する状況や環境に機敏、且つ柔軟に対応できる。
- インクルーシブなカルチャーへの貢献や多様性に富んだグループで働くことに対して前向きであること。

title: Employee Relations Manager, Amazon Flex, Amazon Flex
descriptionHtml:
Are you passionate about shaping the future of work? At Amazon, we're working to be the most customer-centric company on earth. One customer experience that we're constantly looking to take to a new level is how we fulfil and deliver their orders. Our goal is to exceed the expectations of all our customers by ensuring that their orders, no matter how large or small are delivered where and when they need them, as quickly, accurately, and cost effectively as possible. To meet this goal, Amazon is continually striving to innovate and provide best in class service levels through the introduction of pioneering new products and services in the last mile delivery space. We're doing this by building a world class last mile operation, significantly complimented by Amazon Flex. Amazon Flex works directly with independent contractors – called delivery partners – to make deliveries to our customers. With Amazon Flex, individuals can now be their own boss delivering Amazon packages. This role affords an opportunity to work on the cutting edge of innovation, while directly contributing to driving an improved experience for Amazon customers and Delivery Partners.

In this role you will play a pivotal role in representing Amazon Flex in processes before the Australian Fair Work Commission (FWC) and/or other labour arbitration bodies/regulators. You will be responsible for case intake and management. Additionally, you will collaborate closely with our legal team and service level standards team to mitigate risks, prepare case files, and recommend strategic outcomes.

Key job responsibilities
- Represent Amazon at Fair Work Commission proceedings by clearly articulating the company's position, policies, and procedures, and play a key role in securing mutually beneficial resolutions while safeguarding the company's interests and adhering to legal guidelines.
- Collaborate with the legal, enforcement, and policy teams to assess and mitigate risks associated with labour disputes, compliance issues, and regulatory changes. Conduct thorough analyses of claims and evidence, liaise with internal and external legal teams on policies and procedures, and provide closed loop feedback to enforcement program owners to continue proactive risk mitigation initiatives.
- Gather, organise, and maintain comprehensive case files, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and confidentiality. Conduct deep dives, gather evidence and liaise with relevant stakeholders to support case preparation and defence. Coordinate with internal departments and external counsel to align on case strategies and timelines.
- Identify emerging risks, regulatory trends, and arbitration case outcomes. Cross-functionally develop proactive risk mitigation strategies and policy recommendations to enhance compliance. Develop and provide guidance and training to internal stakeholders on best practices when participating in Fair Work Commission proceedings.
- Monitor compliance of internal policies relating directly to the Digital Labour Platform Deactivation Code (DLDP). Prepare regular reports and presentations for senior management and legal on enforcement-related risks, trends, and claim outcomes.

A day in the life
You'll start your day by reviewing ongoing cases and prioritising your workload. You help the team prepare for a conciliation meeting with the Fair Work Commission, where you will articulate Amazon's position. You will collaborate with the legal team to analyse potential risks and develop mitigation strategies. You will also spend time preparing case files, gathering evidence, and conferencing with stakeholders to ensure we are well-prepared for upcoming proceedings.

About the team
You will be joining an inclusive and supportive team of professionals dedicated to ensuring fair practices and positive outcomes for both Amazon and delivery partners. We value collaboration, innovation, and a commitment to excellence. Our team works closely with various departments across Amazon, including legal, operations, and policy, to drive continuous improvement in our last-mile delivery services.

Basic qualifications

- Experience representing an organisation in Fair Work Commission (FWC) proceedings, conciliation, or other labour arbitration/tribunal settings in Australia
- Experience in employee relations, labor relations, human relations or labor/employment law
- Working knowledge of Australian employment/labour law and regulatory frameworks (e.g. Fair Work Act, Digital Labour Platform Deactivation Code or equivalent gig-economy regulation)

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree or equivalent
- Open to candidates from a HR or Legal background

Acknowledgement of country:
In the spirit of reconciliation Amazon acknowledges the Traditional Custodians of country throughout Australia and their connections to land, sea and community. We pay our respect to their elders past and present and extend that respect to all Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples today.

IDE statement:
Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: DCO Program Tech – L&D Specialist People with Disability (PwD), ICN
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

We are the DCO Program team within Data Center Operations (DCO). Our team supports a broad range of programs essential to data center operations — including education and talent development, operational support for stable and reliable data center operations, and community engagement activities. We are one of the most active and dynamic teams in the organization, constantly planning, building, and executing initiatives that make a real impact across the business and the community.

Position Overview
This role focuses on Learning & Development (L&D) — one of the most exciting and diverse areas within our team. You will gain hands-on experience across a wide spectrum of L&D responsibilities, including data center talent development through industry-academia partnerships, social contribution education programs, new hire onboarding and training, and corporate language program management. This is a unique position where you can explore and grow your career in L&D while making a meaningful impact on both our workforce and the broader community.

Key job responsibilities
Industry-Academia Partnership & Talent Pipeline Programs
• Operate and develop industry-academia collaboration education programs to build a sustainable talent pipeline for data center operations roles
• Design and iterate on training curricula for data center talent development, collaborating with subject matter experts across operations and engineering teams
• Manage end-to-end program operations including partner institution coordination, candidate recruitment, curriculum development, evaluation, and program improvement
• Coordinate with multiple internal stakeholders (Recruiting, HR, Operations, Engineering) and external partners (universities, technical colleges, training institutions) to ensure program alignment and effectiveness
• Track program metrics (e.g., candidate conversion rates, training completion, time-to-productivity) and drive continuous improvement
Corporate Language Program Management
• Own and operate the in-house English language program for employees who need English proficiency support
• Manage relationships with external language education vendors, including vendor selection, contract management, program scheduling, and quality assurance
• Design program structure (levels, cohorts, schedules) based on employee needs assessment
• Monitor program participation, progress, and outcomes; report on ROI and effectiveness

New Hire Onboarding & Training Support
• Operate and support new hire training and onboarding programs, ensuring a smooth and engaging experience for all new employees joining the data center operations team
• Coordinate and facilitate New Hire Orientation (NHO) sessions and manage cohort-based onboarding programs across multiple sites
• Maintain and continuously improve onboarding materials, training content, and support resources (e.g., new hire Q&A channels, buddy programs)
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to align onboarding programs with organizational needs and employee feedback

Career Mentoring Program for Students
• Plan and execute a career mentoring program targeting students interested in the data center industry
• Develop mentoring frameworks, session content, and engagement models that provide meaningful exposure to data center career paths
• Recruit and coordinate internal mentors from across the organization
• Build partnerships with universities and career development organizations to expand program reach

External Training Sourcing & Operations
• Research and identify external training programs, courses, and resources that meet the organization's skill development needs
• Evaluate and select qualified external training providers, manage vendor relationships, and coordinate program logistics
• Operate and manage external training programs end-to-end, including enrollment, scheduling, budget management, and post-training evaluation
• Continuously assess organizational training needs and proactively source relevant learning opportunities to bridge skill gaps

Community Engagement & Social Contribution Education Programs
• Plan and execute social contribution (CSR) education programs in partnership with diverse external organizations including libraries, schools, local government, NGOs, and community institutions
• Design and manage year-long education programs in collaboration with public libraries and community partners — including curriculum development, scheduling, instructor coordination, and program evaluation
• Identify new partnership opportunities and build sustainable relationships with community organizations to expand the reach and impact of social contribution initiatives


About the team
Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

#aws-kr-dc
#awskorea

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in a relevant field or equivalent work experience
- 1+ years of human resources experience, or Bachelor's degree in business, HR, or a related field

Preferred qualifications

- Experience managing and negotiating contracts and vendor relationships
- Experience in English-language communication skills, both written and verbal
- Experience designing training curricula or educational programs
- Experience with new hire onboarding or orientation program management
- Experience with community engagement programs

title: EasyShip プログラムサポートスペシャリスト, Easy Ship, AMZL
descriptionHtml:
[English followed by Japanese]

役割概要

プログラムマネジメント（PM）チームの日常的な業務運営、事務管理、レポーティング、データ分析、およびデータ管理活動をサポートし、細部に注意を払い、主体的に行動できるプログラムサポートスペシャリストを募集しています。本ポジションは、PMが戦略的なプログラム推進に集中できるよう、チームの業務およびデータ基盤を管理する重要な役割です。

主な職務内容
レポーティング＆データサポート
PMチーム向けの週次/月次ビジネスレポートおよびダッシュボードの作成、維持、配信
複数のソースからデータを収集、クリーニング、整理を行い、プログラムのトラッキングおよびレビューをサポート
プログラムのマイルストーン、成果物、アクションアイテムに関するトラッカー（Excel、Quip、社内ツール等）の構築および維持管理の支援
PMの要望に応じた臨時データ抽出およびサマリーの作成

データ分析
プログラムおよび業務データにおけるトレンド、パターン、異常値を特定するための初級～中級レベルのデータ分析の実施
ビジネスレビュー（WBR、MBR、QBR）に向けたデータに基づくインサイトの準備においてPMを支援
ピボットテーブル、チャート、ビジュアルサマリーを作成し、生データを実用的なインサイトに変換
データの不整合に対する根本原因分析を実施し、PMに問題を先回りして指摘・エスカレーションする
定期レビューサイクル向けの標準化された分析テンプレートの構築および維持管理
複数のソースからデータを収集・統合し、構造化された形式で調査結果を提示することで、ディープダイブ分析を支援

データ管理
チームレベルのトラッカー、データベース、共有リポジトリにおけるデータの正確性・整合性の維持に一貫して責任を持つ
チームファイル全体にわたるデータ入力基準、命名規則、バージョン管理プロトコルの策定および徹底
重複、欠損、不整合を特定するための定期的なデータ監査の実施
共有データフォルダ、Wiki、ナレッジリポジトリのアクセス権限管理および整理
PMの指示に基づくデータ移行、統合、およびアーカイブ作業の支援
主要プログラムメトリクスおよび業務データの信頼できる唯一の情報源（Single Source of Truth / SSOT）の維持管理
プログラムトラッキングのためのタイムリーかつ正確なデータ入力を確保するための部門横断チームとの連携

事務サポート
定例会議（WBR、MBR、プログラムレビュー）のスケジュール調整、運営管理（アジェンダ作成および議事録を含む）
チームドキュメント、Wiki、共有ドライブの整理整頓および最新状態の維持管理
新規チームメンバーのオンボーディングロジスティクス支援（アクセス申請、ツールセットアップ、オリエンテーションのスケジュール調整）
必要に応じた発注書、調達申請、ベンダー関連書類の処理
チームレベルのコミュニケーション、配信リスト、カレンダー調整の管理

プログラム運営サポート
レビューからのオープンアクションアイテムをトラッキングし、期限超過アイテムをPMにエスカレーション
複数のワークストリームにわたるプログラムタイムラインおよびステータス更新の維持管理
ビジネスドキュメント（BRD、ステータスアップデート、ステークホルダー向けプレゼン資料）の作成およびフォーマッティングの支援
ステークホルダーへのフォローアップによる、プログラム成果物に対する部門横断インプットの調整

ビジネス＆プロセス改善
繰り返し発生するプロセスの効率化機会を特定し、シンプルな自動化またはテンプレートソリューションを提案
チームSOP、テンプレート、レポーティングフォーマットの標準化を支援
チームイベント、オフサイト、ナレッジシェアリングセッションの企画運営を支援

----------------------------------------------------
Role Summary:
We are looking for a detail-oriented and proactive Program Support Specialist to support the Program Management team, in day-to-day operational, administrative, reporting, data analysis, and data management activities. This role is critical in enabling PMs to focus on strategic program delivery by managing the operational and data backbone of the team.

Key Responsibilities:
Reporting & Data Support:
• Prepare, maintain, and distribute weekly/monthly business reports and dashboards for the PM team.
• Collect, clean, and organize data from multiple sources to support program tracking and reviews.
• Assist in building and maintaining trackers (e.g., Excel, Quip, internal tools) for program milestones, deliverables, and action items.
• Generate ad-hoc data pulls and summaries as requested by PMs.

Data Analysis:
• Perform basic to intermediate data analysis to identify trends, patterns, and anomalies in program and operational data.
• Support PMs in preparing data-backed insights for business reviews (WBRs, MBRs, QBRs).
• Create pivot tables, charts, and visual summaries to translate raw data into actionable insights.
• Conduct root cause analysis on data discrepancies and flag issues proactively to PM owners.
• Build and maintain standardized analysis templates for recurring review cycles.
• Support deep-dive analysis by compiling data from multiple sources and presenting findings in a structured format.

Data Management:
• Own the end-to-end data hygiene and integrity of team-level trackers, databases, and shared repositories.
• Establish and enforce data entry standards, naming conventions, and version control protocols across team files.
• Perform regular data audits to identify duplicates, missing entries, and inconsistencies.
• Manage access permissions and organization of shared data folders, wikis, and knowledge repositories.
• Support data migration, consolidation, and archival activities as directed by PMs.
• Maintain a single source of truth (SSOT) for key program metrics and operational data.
• Coordinate with cross-functional teams to ensure timely and accurate data inputs for program tracking.

Administrative Support:
• Schedule, coordinate, and manage recurring meetings (WBRs, MBRs, program reviews) including agenda preparation and meeting notes.
• Maintain team documentation, wikis, and shared drives in an organized and up-to-date manner.

title: SLP Specialist, WWOS INTL Field
descriptionHtml:
Our operations network, known for our speed, accuracy, and exceptional service, delivers millions of packages and smiles to Amazon customers every day. To keep our operations network secure and assure operational continuity, we are looking for a hands-on and detail-oriented professional who wants to join our team as Security and Loss Prevention (SLP) Specialist. In this key role, you will be responsible for the day-to-day execution of security operations, delivering concrete on-the-ground contributions through direct operational support to our sites. You will deliver security as a service to our operational sites across the end-to-end supply chain to protect our people and prevent loss.


Key job responsibilities
Key job responsibilities
• Execute day-to-day security operations and conduct regular physical security checks at assigned sites
• Support resilience of our business operations by contributing to emergency and crisis planning for sites within your area of responsibility
• Contribute to the identification of vulnerabilities (e.g., loss, associate experience, process improvement) and define appropriate mitigating actions while ensuring compliance with legal and ethical standards
• Serve as point of contact for and coordinate measures to manage risk with local and external management (e.g., law enforcement agencies and industry associations) on all security-related matters
• Ensure compliance of your assigned sites with Amazon global security standards


A day in the life
As an SLP Specialist, you will join a team of Security and Loss Prevention professionals providing security as a service to business customers across multiple business units within a dedicated geographical area. Your daily focus will be on hands-on execution of security operations, including conducting physical security rounds, monitoring CCTV systems, and responding to immediate security concerns. You perform regular physical security audits and investigate policy violations, security-related incidents, and loss events. During your investigations, you collect information by monitoring systems and tools, analysing data reports, and conducting interviews. You execute established procedures to address security incidents and implement approved solutions for identified vulnerabilities. Your findings help to identify vulnerabilities in our processes, for which you contribute to the development of mitigating measures. You play a key role in maintaining the physical integrity of our sites by auditing and monitoring the health status of our systems and, jointly with subject matter experts and external suppliers, maintain their functionality. You interact on a daily basis with our external security service providers to ensure delivery of high-quality security services and a smooth customer experience. You also act as point of contact for multiple internal and external departments (e.g., legal, HR, security service providers, local law enforcement) and subject matter expert in Security and Loss Prevention-related matters. Finally, you deliver loss prevention-related education and awareness programs to other teams and liaise with various stakeholders on policy and procedure across all management levels.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of security and loss prevention experience

Preferred qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English

title: Safety Design and Engineering Continuous Improvement Manager, WHS Design & Engineering
descriptionHtml:
At Amazon, safety is our top priority. We are looking for a WHS Risk Engineer to own machinery safety across multiple sites. In this role you will lead machinery safety inspections and risk assessments, apply the EU Machinery Directive and harmonised standards, and influence engineering and operations leaders to build safe-by-design into our equipment and processes. You'll turn machinery-safety findings into consistent standards that protect our people across the network.



Key job responsibilities
- Lead machinery safety inspections and risk assessments across multiple sites.
- Apply and interpret the EU Machinery Directive (2006/42/EC) and associated harmonised standards.
- Identify machinery and MHE risks and drive the implementation of effective control measures.
- Use data and metrics to identify gaps and drive improvements across sites.
- Engage and influence functional leaders to build buy-in to Health & Safety standards and change.

A day in the life
You work across several sites, moving between machinery inspections, risk assessments and working sessions with engineering and operations leaders. You dig into how equipment and MHE is designed, installed and used, spot risks that others miss, and drive agreement on the control measures needed. You use data to see patterns across sites and to prioritise where safety effort has the biggest impact. A large part of your day is influencing — helping functional leaders understand machinery risk and building buy-in to the Health & Safety standards and changes you recommend.

About the team
The Workplace Health and Safety (WHS) team plays a crucial role in keeping our people mentally and physically well at work. Our team works with managers, associates and local governments across our sites, ensuring compliance with Amazon's policies and legal regulations, and guaranteeing the safety of our work environments. The team offers a variety of opportunities, from Safety Technicians to Programme Managers. Regardless of your role, you'll contribute to the development and implementation of the safety strategy across the entire network.

Basic qualifications

- Experience conducting machinery safety inspections and risk assessments across multiple sites, applying the EU Machinery Directive (2006/42/EC).
- A Bachelor's degree, or equivalent level of qualification in-line with the European Qualifications Framework (EQF) in electrical, mechanical, civil or industrial engineering.
- Practical understanding and application of WHS risk assessment and safety standards.
- Experience in English language communication skills (B2/C1), both written and verbal.
- Experience engaging and influencing functional leaders to build buy-in to Health & Safety standards.

Preferred qualifications

- Preferred qualifications are not required to apply for a position at Amazon. If you have all the basic qualifications above, we'd love to hear from you.
- Experience with Lean, 5S or Kaizen methodologies and continuous improvement.
- Experience using data and metrics to identify gaps and drive improvements.
- CMSE (or equivalent Machinery Safety certification), or experience working for/with a Notified or Approved Body for Machinery Safety.
- NEBOSH certificate (or equivalent safety certification).

title: Technical Program Manager II, ICON
descriptionHtml:
Amazon ICON is looking for a Technical Program Manager to join our Dublin team. Our team is responsible for hosting Amazon’s websites, which includes all of Amazon’s global marketplaces and partner portals as well as consumer experiences like Kindle, Alexa, Amazon Video, and the Mobile Application. We’re a diverse international team made up of engineers, developers, administrators and managers. Furthermore, we’re obsessed with operational quality, security, reducing cost, increasing availability and keeping the largest eCommerce infrastructure purring.

This role is unique to Amazon and offers excellent career opportunities. Our worldwide fleets serve 10s of billions of customer requests per day through Amazon retail websites, Kindle, Amazon instant video, Amazon subsidiaries and more, giving you a unique scale of impact opportunity for your career. You will need to demonstrate great passion for customers, agility, and adaptability in the face of fast changing business requirements and innovation across the company.

As a Technical Program Manager you will require technical vision, ability to dive deep into problems and excellent verbal and written communication skills. You will have a strong understanding of internet technologies and protocols and a passion for building and operating technology systems at scale. You will have a strong understanding of build and deployment pipelines as well as operations monitoring pipelines. You will have proven abilities in leading multi-discipline engineering teams without direct authority. You will demonstrate creativity in identifying, scoping and building innovative tools to solve our unique operations problems.

About the team
We own connecting Amazon worldwide websites and other experiences such as Kindle, Amazon Video, and Alexa to the internet, as well as ensuring the highest level of availability, security and privacy of the web services that power the experience we deliver to our customers worldwide. We abstract, centralize and optimize the infrastructure management from individual service teams and operate 120+ Tier-1 services on behalf of teams in the Worldwide Amazon Stores org. We own the routing layer built on top of AWS technology that connects traffic at low latency and protects the web services against malicious robot and DDoS attacks.

descriptionHtml:

title: シフトアシスタント
descriptionHtml:
※このポジションの勤務地は埼玉県三郷市を予定しています。

私たちのグローバルオペレーションネットワークは、日々何百万もの荷物と笑顔をアマゾンのお客様にお届けしています。私たちは、シフトアシスタントとして私たちのチームに加わってほしいと考え、意欲的で顧客重視の人材を探しています。この役割では他業種・職種も含めこれまでの経験、スキルを活かし、改善点を模索しながら、より便利でお客様に満足いただける高い品質のサービスを提供できるビジネスをつくる事、安全・快適・楽しい職場環境の構築を行う、将来の組織のリーダーを目指していただける事を期待しています。また、お客様の注文が適切な時間に適切な場所へ確実に配送されるよう、お客様の期待に応えることにおいても重要な役割を担います。

私たちの業務の流れには3つの主要な要素があります。
商品が保管され注文に備える「ファーストマイル」、注文品をお客様のエリアまで輸送する「ミドルマイル」、そして商品をお客様の玄関先までお届けする「ラストマイル」です。各拠点で運営方法に若干の違いはありますが、一貫して変わらないものが一つあります、それは顧客を第一に考える私たちのビジョンと献身的な姿勢です。

本ポジションはアマゾンの新しいエキサイティングな配送拠点で業務を行います。可能な限り最速でお客様のご自宅に商
品をお届けすることでお客様のカスタマーエクスペリエンスを向上します。私たちと一緒に歴史をつくりましょう！


■業務内容■
具体的にはマネージャーのサポートのもと、以下の業務に責任をもち遂行いただきます。

① 安全・品質・作業効率の向上
安全安心な作業環境の維持・向上のため、日々の安全活動、品質チェックに加え、標準作業手順書の作成や多岐にわたる問題解決・改善活動を行います。

② 日々のオペレーション対応
商品を入荷、在庫として管理し、注文があった商品を出荷するという一連の流れを各工程間で連携をとりながら、業務を円滑に進める事が求められます。お客様とお約束した期日までに商品を迅速かつ正確にお届けするため、時間ごとの計画に沿ってオペレーションを実施することに責任を持ちます。

③ 新規プロジェクトの導入・セール時など、オペレーション拡大時の準備
新しいサービスやシステムの導入に備え、現場での手順変更・導入方法を検討し円滑な導入に向けて準備を行います。また、新規入職者でもAmazonの標準作業に則った手順がスムーズに身につくためのトレーニング構築やマニュアルを作成します。

④ イレギュラーへの対応
作業で発生する様々な課題の原因を追求し問題解決を行います。また、再発防止策案の検討、実施を行います。
※上記業務はマネージャーやチームのサポートのもと実施していただきます
※配送ステーション内での配送を通じて、物流の仕組みやマネジメントについて学ぶことができます
※社内公募により、マネージャーへのキャリアアップや他部署への異動機会もあります
※勤務は交代制（夜勤あり）です
※1日の流れ：以下ページをご参照ください。
先輩社員インタビュー

■福利厚生■
下記ページをご確認ください。
福利厚生 | アマゾンジャパンキャリアサイト

■教育制度■
入社後、約1週間はAmazonのリーダーとして必要な会社のカルチャーや、配送拠点の基本的な業務を一通り学ぶことができる座学の機会を提供します。各部署へ配属後は、トレーナーのもと、OJTで工程知識やツールの使用方法など基礎知識を学んでいきます。トレーニング資料も完備しており、相互に進捗を確認しながら独り立ちまでしっかりとサポートしますので、未経験者も安心してスタートができる環境です。
最先端の物流システムを学ぶことはもちろん、年齢・性別・国籍問わず様々な仲間と日々の業務を通して、次のステップとなるピープルマネージメントやビジネススキルを学ぶことができます。

■キャリアパス■
シフトアシスタントからキャリアをスタートし、チームマネージャー、統括マネージャー、そして配送拠点の拠点長となった実績も多数あります。また、Amazonでは社内公募制度があり、国内外問わず他部署や異なる職種への異動にチャレンジし、社内で多様なキャリアを築くチャンスもあります。Amazonではご自身で学び成長することを推奨し、キャリア開発できるようサポートを行っています。

Amazonでは全員がリーダーです。個人の裁量に任される部分が多く、社員の個々の可能性を最大限に伸ばす事を重視しています。様々なバックグラウンドを持った社員が前職で培った多様な経験やスキルを活かして職位や役割に関わらず誰もがチャレンジできる環境です。

失敗に寛容な文化：まずは試してみることにこだわります。好奇心を持って学びます。時にはリスクを取り、計画通りいかなかったとしても、よりよい成果に繋げられることが私たちの強みだと信じています。

descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services ansvarar för design, planering, leverans och drift av AWS globala infrastruktur. Vi ser till att molnet fungerar – dygnet runt, världen över.

Vi ansvarar för infrastrukturen i AWS datacenter, inklusive servrar, lagringslösningar, nätverksutrustning samt kraft- och kylsystem. Det är denna infrastruktur som säkerställer att våra kunder har tillförlitlig och kontinuerlig tillgång till de molntjänster och den innovation de förlitar sig på.

Vi tar oss an komplexa utmaningar där tusentals faktorer påverkar allt från leveranskedjor till den dagliga driften. Nu söker vi engagerade och kompetenta medarbetare som vill vara med och utveckla, driva och säkra den infrastruktur som får AWS att fungera.

Du blir en del av ett mångsidigt team med mjukvaru-, hårdvaru- och nätverksingenjörer, specialister inom leveranskedjan, säkerhetsexperter, driftchefer och andra nyckelkompetenser. Tillsammans med kollegor inom hela AWS bidrar du till att upprätthålla högsta standard inom säkerhet och driftsäkerhet, samtidigt som vi levererar skalbar kapacitet till våra kunder på ett så kostnadseffektivt sätt som möjligt.
Hos oss möter du en inkluderande kultur där nya idéer uppmuntras och du får möjlighet att omsätta dem i praktiken.

Vi söker nu datacentertekniker (Data Center Technician) som vill bli en del av vårt växande team inom Data Center Operations (DCO).

Som datacentertekniker arbetar du med drift, underhåll och felsökning av den IT-infrastruktur som ligger till grund för AWS molntjänster. Du ansvarar för att identifiera och lösa tekniska problem inom bland annat serverhårdvara, nätverksutrustning, fiberanslutningar och relaterade system.

Du blir en viktig del av teamet och fungerar som en central resurs vid teknisk felsökning och incidenthantering. I rollen utvecklar du din kompetens inom både hårdvara och mjukvara samtidigt som du arbetar självständigt med att identifiera, analysera och åtgärda olika typer av infrastrukturproblem.

Du förväntas kunna hantera och lösa de flesta vanligt förekommande tekniska problemen. Vid mer komplexa ärenden samarbetar du med specialiserade supportteam för att säkerställa effektiva lösningar och minimera påverkan på driften.

Key job responsibilities
Säkerhet

Du följer och upprätthåller AWS höga säkerhetsstandarder och bidrar aktivt till att utveckla och stärka en säkerhetskultur i världsklass. Du tar ansvar för säkerhetsinitiativ och projekt som främjar ett säkert arbetssätt och bidrar till en trygg arbetsmiljö.

Datacenterdrift (DCO)
Du diagnostiserar och felsöker problem med hårdvara och nätverksutrustning och utför nödvändiga fysiska reparationer. Du hanterar incidenter inom fastställda servicenivåavtal (SLA) och genomför rotorsaksanalyser vid utrustningsfel för att identifiera bakomliggande problem och bidra till långsiktiga lösningar.

Arbetet kan innebära manuell hantering och lyft av utrustning i enlighet med gällande arbetsmiljöföreskrifter. Du arbetar enligt ett roterande skiftschema som omfattar morgon- och nattskift samt helger, eftersom datacentren behöver fungera dygnet runt.
Plats och körkort.

AWS datacenter är ofta belägna i områden med begränsad tillgång till kollektivtrafik. Därför krävs ett körkort giltigt inom EU för den här tjänsten.
Arbetsplats och arbetsschema
Detta är en helt platsbaserad tjänst där arbetet utförs på datacentret. Närvaro på plats är nödvändig eftersom rollen innebär praktiskt arbete med verksamhetskritisk IT-infrastruktur.

A day in the life
I rollen arbetar du med AWS ärendehanteringssystem för att prioritera, hantera och följa upp tekniska ärenden. Du felsöker och löser komplexa problem med serverhårdvara och arbetar strukturerat för att återställa funktion och minimera påverkan på driften.

Du blir en del av ett samarbetsinriktat team som säkerställer att AWS molninfrastruktur fungerar tillförlitligt. Du hanterar automatiserade arbetsorder och instruktioner från teamledningen, samtidigt som du planerar och prioriterar ditt arbete utifrån verksamhetens behov.
Din förmåga att hantera tekniska ärenden, följa eskaleringsrutiner och samarbeta med andra supportteam är viktig för att uppfylla AWS höga krav på teknisk kompetens och operativ kvalitet. Genom ditt arbete bidrar du till att upprätthålla tillgängligheten, effektiviteten och tillförlitligheten i datacentrets infrastruktur.

Vi söker engagerade och tekniskt kunniga medarbetare som vill lösa problem, utveckla sin kompetens och bidra till nästa steg i utvecklingen av AWS molninfrastruktur.

About the team
Olika erfarenheter är en styrka - På AWS värdesätter vi olika erfarenheter, perspektiv och kompetenser. Även om du inte uppfyller alla kvalifikationer som anges i annonsen uppmuntrar vi dig att söka tjänsten. Oavsett om du är i början av din karriär, har en annan yrkesbakgrund än den traditionella eller har skaffat dig erfarenhet på alternativa vägar vill vi att du ska känna dig välkommen att söka.

Varför AWS? - Amazon Web Services (AWS) är världens mest omfattande och mest använda molnplattform. Vi var pionjärer inom molnteknik och fortsätter att utveckla nya lösningar som driver den digitala utvecklingen framåt. Från snabbväxande startups till några av världens största företag förlitar sig våra kunder på AWS breda utbud av produkter och tjänster för att utveckla och driva sina verksamheter.

En inkluderande arbetskultur - På AWS värdesätter vi nyfikenhet, samhörighet och olika perspektiv. Våra medarbetarledda och företagssponsrade intressegrupper bidrar till en inkluderande arbetsmiljö där alla får möjlighet att vara stolta över det som gör oss unika. Genom evenemang och initiativ som främjar inkludering stärker vi samarbetet och gemenskapen i våra team.
Vår innovationskraft bygger på djärva idéer, nya perspektiv och engagerade medarbetare som bidrar med sin kompetens och sina erfarenheter i allt vi gör.

Mentorskap och karriärutveckling - Vi höjer kontinuerligt våra ambitioner och strävar efter att bli världens bästa arbetsgivare. Därför erbjuder vi goda möjligheter till kunskapsdelning, mentorskap, utbildning och andra karriärfrämjande insatser som hjälper dig att utvecklas både professionellt och personligt. Hos oss får du möjlighet att bygga nya kompetenser, bredda din erfarenhet och ta nästa steg i karriären.

Balans mellan arbete och privatliv - Vi värdesätter en hållbar balans mellan arbete och privatliv. Att lyckas i arbetet ska inte behöva ske på bekostnad av livet utanför jobbet. Därför strävar vi efter en arbetskultur som präglas av flexibilitet, stöd och respekt för individens olika behov. När våra medarbetare får förutsättningar att må bra och utvecklas, både på och utanför arbetet, skapar vi tillsammans bättre resultat.

Basic qualifications

- Du har god samarbetsförmåga och kan arbeta effektivt tillsammans med andra i ett team.
- Du är strukturerad, har god förmåga att planera och prioritera ditt arbete och kan följa instruktioner från både automatiserade arbetssystem och teamledare.
- Du kan hantera och förflytta utrustning som väger upp till 18 kg och har ett körkort giltigt i EU.
- Du har minst ett års teknisk arbetslivserfarenhet, grundläggande kunskaper i felsökning av serverhårdvara samt grundläggande erfarenhet av nätverk.

Preferred qualifications

- Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av ärendehantering, prioritering av arbetsuppgifter och etablerade eskaleringsrutiner.
- Du har gärna förståelse för planerade underhållsfönster och rutiner för ändringshantering samt grundläggande kunskaper om datacenters tekniska miljö och stödsystem.
- Erfarenhet av nätverksadministration eller relevanta certifieringar är också meriterande, exempelvis CCENT, CCNA, Network+ eller A+.
- Kunskaper i skript och kodning är ytterligare en fördel.

title: Ingeniero/a de Automatización Industrial
descriptionHtml:
Operations is at the heart of everything Amazon does, and automation is one of the ways we optimise our processes. As an Automation Engineer, you’ll make sure that our automated systems are working at their best so that our customers get their orders on time. By exploring data on everything from control systems to sensors, you’ll maximise the availability of equipment at your sites. This role puts you at the forefront of Amazon’s emerging technology to solve complex productivity challenges.

Key job responsibilities
Monitor, troubleshoot and repair issues with key systems
Work with the EU Controls network to monitor Material Handling Equipment (MHE) metrics
Provide data visualisations of troubleshooting to internal stakeholders
Own or actively participate in continuous improvement projects run by the EU Controls network
Work with different departments to ensure all systems are correctly documented and that accurate backup libraries are maintained
Work with global colleagues to install and commission new equipment
Support other sites in the EU Controls network as needed
Interpret mechanical and electrical drawings, and develop improvement strategies for code conforming to IEC 61131-3

A day in the life
As an Automation Engineer, you’ll be the site expert when it comes to keeping key automated systems running smoothly. You’ll be working with our automation machinery, from conveyors to sortation systems, and ensuring they’re working efficiently. If something has gone wrong or can be done better, you’ll take the lead in coming up with and implementing a solution.

You’ll also share your expertise with your close colleagues. You’ll be keeping your Engineering Technicians up to date with device troubleshooting and preventative maintenance control training, so that your team can keep our automation systems in order.

About the team
Nuestro equipo de ingenieros de mantenimiento y fiabilidad (RME) se encarga de que nuestros sistemas funcionen a pleno rendimiento. Nos caracterizamos por nuestra gran aptitud técnica y nuestra excelente capacidad para el trabajo en equipo, liderados por unos responsables con gran experiencia. Nuestro trabajo comprende el mantenimiento, la reparación y la solución de problemas relacionados con los equipos en toda nuestra red mundial de centros de distribución. El equipo cuenta con una serie de perfiles de dirección que se encargan de supervisar el desarrollo de tecnologías fascinantes, algunas de las cuales solo existen en Amazon.
Nuestro equipo se ocupa de la mayoría de los aspectos técnicos de Amazon, desempeñando tareas que van desde la instalación de sistemas automatizados de embalaje hasta la supervisión del mantenimiento general de un centro o la reparación de equipos clave de distribución. Esto incluye adaptar los edificios a la legislación vigente, para que todo el personal esté seguro y nuestras instalaciones funcionen con la mayor eficiencia posible. El equipo de RME, al igual que ocurre en otros departamentos de Amazon, ofrece numerosas oportunidades de progresar profesionalmente.
Todo nuestro trabajo gira en torno a reducir los periodos de inactividad en los centros de operaciones cruciales de Amazon, para que los clientes reciban sus pedidos a tiempo. Con frecuencia, trabajamos de madrugada o a altas horas de la noche para poder realizar las tareas de mantenimiento ocasionando las mínimas molestias, por lo que hacemos turnos nocturnos. Si descubrimos que hay una forma mejor de hacer algo, tenemos la capacidad y la posibilidad de desarrollar e introducir procesos totalmente nuevos o tecnología punta, como Amazon Robotics y nuestro clasificador de artículos complejos.

Basic qualifications

- Relevant experience with PLC-controlled automation and issue diagnosis in a continuous process or production environment
- Relevant experience supporting different conveyors and sortation systems
- Relevant experience dealing with material handling, flow and capacity visualisation, and monitoring
- Experience with at least one of the following tools:
- Microsoft Office, project management tools and EPLAN
- Ladder Logic and structure programming from Siemens, Allen-Brady or Codesys PLCs
- Ignition SCADA or similar platform and Human Machine Interface (HMI)
- EthernetIP, Profinet, Profibus and AS-i or other fieldbus networks
- VFDs, safety gateways and input and output devices
- Advanced proficiency in verbal and written English and local language

Preferred qualifications

- A degree in computer science, electrical engineering, industrial electronics or another technical subject
- Experience working within ISO 13849 and ISO 62061 frameworks
- Experience working in a multi-site environment
- Project management experience with multiple frameworks such as Agile and Waterfall
- Experience of Six Sigma, data analysis or process improvement techniques

title: Delivery Consultant - Cloud Application Development, Application Migration, Modernization and Management (AM3)
descriptionHtml:
The Amazon Web Services Professional Services (ProServe) team is seeking an experienced Application Developer to join our team at AWS. In this role, you'll work with our customers to architect, develop, and re-engineer applications that fully leverage the AWS Cloud. You'll be at the forefront of cloud technology adoption, working on business-critical projects that drive innovation and customer success.
As an Application Developer, you'll design and implement cloud-native solutions that embrace AWS best practices for elasticity, horizontal scalability, automation, and high availability. You'll work with various AWS services including Amazon EC2, Auto Scaling, Elastic Load Balancing, AWS Elastic Beanstalk, Serverless Architectures, and Amazon Elastic Container Services to create robust, scalable applications.

Key job responsibilities
As an experienced technology professional, you will be responsible for:

1. Design and develop cloud-native applications using modern architectural patterns
2. Implement full-stack solutions leveraging AWS services and best practices
3. Architect, design and build scalable, secure, and highly available systems
4. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver customer solutions
5. Provide technical guidance and mentorship within the team
6. Drive adoption of cloud-native development practices

A day in the life
Diverse Experiences: AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job below, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS? Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture - Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth - We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance - We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

About the team
You'll join AWS Professional Services, a global team of experts who help customers achieve their desired business outcomes using AWS Cloud. We work alongside customer teams and AWS Partners to execute enterprise cloud computing initiatives through focused guidance and hands-on implementation.

Basic qualifications

- Experience as technical specialist in design and architecture
- Bachelor's degree, or experience in a professional field or military
- Experience in database (eg. SQL, NoSQL, Hadoop, Spark, Kafka, Kinesis)
- Experience in consulting, design and implementation of serverless distributed solutions
- Experience in software development with object oriented language
- Experience in cloud based solution (AWS or equivalent), system, network and operating system
- Experience in external or internal customer facing, complex and large scale project management

Preferred qualifications

- AWS Associate level certification
