title: Bilingual/ Mandarin Technical Account Manager, ES - CN-AWS, ES - CN, AWS Enterprise Support
descriptionHtml:
AWS Applied AI Solutions (AAIS) is building toward a future where every business innovates with Amazon AI teammates. To get there, we build AI solutions that improve human capabilities and transform entire business functions. We create end-to-end products that surprise and delight out-of-the-box, making complex things easy and hard things possible, with no cloud experience required. We start with customers who embrace the future and build bridges to meet the rest where they are. We pursue ambitious opportunities with conviction, and we are looking for builders who share that mindset.

Would you like to join one of the fastest-growing teams within Amazon Web Services (AWS)? Join us in helping customers across all industries to maximize the value and benefits of AWS services and Generative AI solutions.

As a Technical Account Manager (TAM) in AWS Enterprise Support you will play a crucial role in fostering our customers' innovative and transformative endeavors across various technologies including GenAI, AI/ML, Compute, Storage, Database, Big Data, Application-level Services, Networking, Serverless, Deployment, Security, and more. This is not a sales role - it offers you the opportunity to serve as the primary technical advisor and 'voice of the customer' for organizations ranging from start-ups to Fortune 500 enterprises.

Based in the United States you will provide bilingual AWS technical support to Mandarin-speaking enterprise customers who have established or are expanding their presence in the US market. These customers span industries including E-commerce, Gaming, FinTech, AI/ML, SaaS, and Social Media. You will work closely with Account Team and AWS Support and Service teams to deliver exceptional customer outcomes.

Full professional proficiency in Mandarin (speaking and writing) is required for this role. Strong working proficiency in English is also required. You will ensure customers receive seamless technical support in their preferred language while navigating the US AWS infrastructure landscape.

This is an exciting time to join - our customers are rapidly adopting Generative AI and AI/ML services on AWS, from Amazon Bedrock and SageMaker to custom model training on GPU infrastructure. As a TAM you will be at the forefront of helping customers navigate this transformation guiding them on architecture operational readiness and best practices for AI workloads in production. You will also leverage AI-powered tools in your own workflow to deliver faster more proactive support.

Key job responsibilities
• Act as a single point of contact for Enterprise Support customers building trusted advisor relationships
• Provide strategic technical guidance across the full cloud adoption lifecycle - from migration planning to operational optimization
• Make recommendations on how new AWS offerings (including GenAI AI/ML) fit into customer strategy and architecture
• Complete analysis and present periodic reviews of operational performance to customers
• Provide detailed reviews of service disruptions metrics and prelaunch planning
• Champion and advocate for customer requirements within AWS (e.g., feature requests, service improvements)
• Participate in customer meetings (onsite or remote) and maintain regular engagement cadence
• Leverage customer resolution tools across all service groups to facilitate rapid resolution of customer concerns
• Work directly with AWS service engineers to ensure customer issues are resolved expediently
• Collaborate with internal teams including DSE SBAS and account teams to deliver holistic support
• Available for non-business hours support to handle urgent issues and critical events

About the team
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn't followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don't let it stop you from applying.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world's most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that's why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there's nothing we can't achieve in the cloud.

Here at AWS, it's in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- 3+ years of technical engineering experience
- Experience with operational parameters and troubleshooting for three (3) of the following: compute/storage/networking/CDN/databases/DevOps/big data and analytics/security/applications development in a distributed systems environment

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with AWS services or other cloud offerings

locations: Cabo De Santo Agostinho, PE, Brazil
descriptionHtml:
O Coordenador de WHS será responsável por atuar em parceria com a equipe de operações do site em Fullfillment Center para executar as políticas de segurança da empresa e garantir a conformidade com todas as regulamentações locais e regionais aplicáveis. O Coordenador de WHS liderará iniciativas de melhoria contínua para reduzir riscos condicionais e ergonômicos em nossos processos, assegurando um ambiente de trabalho seguro e saudável para os associados dentro das operações.

Você irá instruir e treinar Líderes de Operações nas políticas de segurança da Amazon e auxiliar as equipes operacionais do site na incorporação dos nossos padrões de segurança em suas unidades. Você trabalhará para identificar melhores práticas e incorporar essas metodologias padronizadas em nossos padrões para melhorar continuamente a cultura de segurança.

*Responsabilidades do Coordenador de WHS:*

- Fornecer orientação e supervisão para garantir a conformidade com todas as Regulamentações Locais aplicáveis e as Políticas de Segurança da Amazon.
- Medir o desempenho do site em relação aos requisitos publicados nas políticas de segurança. Para todas as deficiências, identificar um plano para o site implementar e corrigir.
- Entregar projetos com qualidade e dentro do prazo para as Operações.
- Entregar projetos de melhoria contínua e do Sistema de Gestão de Saúde e Segurança no Trabalho.
- Analisar métricas de segurança e revisar incidentes diários, semanais e mensais para descobrir tendências e racionalizar a alocação de recursos apropriados para as áreas onde o risco de segurança é mais alto.
- Realizar auditorias frequentes de segurança no site para identificar todos os equipamentos e/ou processos em não conformidade. Implementar soluções para eliminar a exposição a esses riscos e prevenir lesões.
- Auditar as práticas de manutenção de registros e as entradas no Banco de Dados Global de Segurança AUSTIN para garantir alinhamento com os padrões globais de segurança e a regulamentação local.
- Auditar a organização do local de trabalho e os comportamentos dos Associados para garantir que os métodos de treinamento, auditoria e pontuação sejam precisos e consistentes.
- Realizar e reportar investigações de incidentes.

- Experience with Microsoft Office products and applications
- Experience with Excel
- Experience working with computers and Microsoft Office products (including Outlook, Word, and Excel)
- High school or equivalent diploma
- Work flexible schedules including weekends, nights, and holidays
- Experience in customer-facing environment, warehousing, logistics or manufacturing
- Technical course in Occupational Safety with registration at the Ministry of Labor and Employment (MTE).

title: Brand Specialist - AVS, Paid Selling Partner Services
descriptionHtml:
About Amazon

Amazon strives to be Earth's most customer-centric company where people can find and discover virtually anything they want to buy online. By giving customers more of what they want - low prices, vast selection, and convenience – Amazon continues to grow and evolve as a world-class e-commerce platform. Amazon's evolution from website to e-commerce partner to development platform is driven by the spirit of innovation that is part of the company's DNA. The world's brightest technology minds come to Amazon to research and develop technology that improves the lives of shoppers and sellers around the world.

About the Role

Brand Specialist - Amazon Vendor Services, Australia

As an Account Manager you would be a part of Amazon Vendor Services (AVS) Team of Retail Business Services. You will have the exciting opportunity to help shape and deliver on a strategy for managing Amazon AVS vendors.

AVS team is looking for bright, customer centric, driven, and creative candidates to join our team. You will interface with Ecommerce/Digital teams of your assigned vendors and also internally with stakeholders across our Retail Vendor Management and Vendor Services teams, while being responsible for multiple aspects of the vendor’s business with Amazon. You will engage directly with multiple internal teams to optimize and trouble shoot to grow business for your vendors on Amazon.

You will utilize a wide range of skills and work across major functional areas such as, selection, catalogue quality, buying, inventory management, finance, operations, to drive the performance of vendor partners at Amazon. In this role you will be focused on driving numerous aspects of managing the customer relationships with vendors.

You will conceive, create and analyze a wide range of deal activities to grow the vendor’s traffic, brand awareness, customer conversion, and revenue on Amazon. Also, you will look into operational aspects of vendor’s business with Amazon, root cause analysis of issues and opportunities impacting business.

Timings will be : 6 AM IST to 3:00 pm IST


Key job responsibilities
•Establish long term partnerships with key vendor partners for the group of vendors handled.

• Partnering with the Retail Category Team and build successful communication channels at all levels, set proper expectations, provide clear status communications, and manage towards a growth plan for the vendors.

• Build and execute on a vendor growth plan that delivers on key business opportunities and relevant KPIs for the vendors and Amazon.

• Conduct deep dive analysis on vendor issues and publish recommendations and action plans based on data, to improve vendor experience.

• Success will be measured by the performance of your vendors on input metrics and impact on creating a great customer experience for buying consumers.

• Conduct regular business reviews with the vendors, highlight business metric performance and build action plans.

Basic qualifications

- 2+ years of sales or account management experience
- Experience with Excel
- Experience analyzing data and best practices to assess performance drivers

Preferred qualifications

- Experience analyzing key open issues and resolution metrics for each of the managed accounts
- Experience in relationship management within technology, start-ups, or SaaS Platforms

title: Data Analyst, Third Party Carrier Procurement
descriptionHtml:
アマゾンは「地球上で最もお客様を大切にする企業になること」を使命とし、高品質な輸送ネットワーク・サービスの拡大に投資を行っています。物流業界の変化を見据え、従来の型にとらわれない自社独自の輸送ネットワーク・サービスの構築を進めており、これまでにない革新的な幹線輸送ネットワークを一緒に作り上げる意欲的なメンバーを募集します。

アマゾンジャパンの物流輸送企画事業部では、自社輸送網の幹線輸送に関わる事業企画・管理の中核を担っています。社内の事業計画・実行部門、システム開発部門、財務部門に加え、大手を含む運送会社や3PLといった取引先企業と連携しながら、アマゾンの成長を支える幹線輸送ネットワーク・サービスの維持・拡大のための重要な任務を遂行しています。具体的には、幹線輸送のコスト構造の可視化と最適化、輸送拠点や輸送サービスの立ち上げプロジェクトの推進、そして中長期的な幹線輸送戦略の立案と策定を行います。

本ポジションでは、幹線輸送事業における分析・改善、コスト最適化、プロジェクトリードなど複数の業務を、社内外のステークホルダーと調整しながら実行していただきます。データ分析に基づく仮説検証やコスト低減施策の立案・実行を通じて、幹線輸送事業の継続的な改善に貢献していただきます。

Amazonでは、最新のAI Tool, 生成AIを日々の業務の中に積極的に取り入れています。
AI Toolは私たちの意思決定のスピードを加速させ、私たちを本当に重要な「判断」と「議論」に集中させることを可能にしています。Amazon では学習を継続する文化が根付いているため、ご自身のペースでAIに関する知識を深めることができるリソースが用意されています。


Key job responsibilities
アマゾンは「地球上で最もお客様を大切にする企業になること」を使命としています。そのため、高品質な輸送ネットワーク・サービス拡大に投資を行っています。特に物流業界の変化を見据え、従来の型に捕らわれない自社独自の輸送ネットワーク・サービスを構築中です。 アマゾンジャパンの物流輸送企画事業部では、その自社輸送網の幹線輸送に関わる事業企画・管理の中核を担うメンバーを求めています。

本ポジションは、社内の事業計画・実行部門、システム開発部門、財務部門に加え、大手を含む運送会社やサードパーティーロジスティクス（3PL）といった様々な取引先企業と協力しながら、アマゾンの成長を支える幹線輸送ネットワーク・サービスの企画・管理を行います。 具体的には以下の中から、複数の業務を遂行していただきます。

■幹線輸送事業の分析と改善　
幹線輸送の複雑な事業構造を理解し、そのコスト構造を見える化するためのレポーティングを行います。具体的には、週次サイクルでコストの変化を捉え、その要因の仮説を立て、データ分析に基づき仮説を検証、対応策の立案および実行を担うことで、幹線輸送事業におけるコスト低減に貢献して頂きます。

■幹線輸送コストの最適化
幹線輸送の調達方法に応じたコストの最適化を目指します。車両費や人件費などの固定費、走行距離に応じた燃料費など、市況から適正なコストを算出し、コストの妥当性検証と必要に応じて幹線輸送業者とコスト低減に向けた折衝を行います。

■プロジェクトリード・参加
新たな輸送拠点や輸送サービスの立ち上げなどのプロジェクトをリード、もしくは参加します。関連部署と連携し、プロジェクトごとの要件を整理し、タイムラインを管理しながら、プロジェクトの完遂に責任を持ちます。立ち上げの際のコスト分析、立ち上げ管理など、様々なタスクにハンズオンで対応します。

title: Senior Software Development Engineer, Shopping Personalization AI
descriptionHtml:
Amazon's Personalization organization builds the AI systems behind how hundreds of millions of customers discover and shop. We extract and reason over customer signals in real time, power LLM-driven recommendation experiences, and build AI-native discovery surfaces that combine products, content, and contextual recommendations. Our work sits at the intersection of generative AI, large-scale distributed systems, and customer-facing products, delivered through high-performance web and mobile experiences at Amazon scale.

In this role you'll design and build features that shape how customers discover products - tailored to their preferences, helping them find exactly what they need, even before they know they need it. We're defining how LLMs integrate into real-time personalization, how noisy behavioral signals become durable customer understanding, and how AI-powered experiences ship reliably at scale. You'll work across multiple technical teams, ship iteratively, and see your work in the hands of customers quickly. This organization values experimentation, moves fast, and gives engineers real ownership over what they build.

We are looking for a Senior Software Development Engineer who leads through technical depth and sound judgment. Someone who owns team-level architecture, provides system-wide design guidance, and brings perspective on both current and future technology choices. You take on customer problems where the technological strategy is not yet defined, and you drive productive discussions to align teams on the best path forward. You don’t just deliver high-quality software yourself - you set the standard that others follow. You actively mentor multiple engineers, drive adoption of engineering best practices, and ensure your team has strong operational foundations. You make the team permanently stronger, not dependent on your presence. When the right solution isn’t technical - when it’s a process change, a culture shift, or a staffing decision - you recognize that and act accordingly.

Key job responsibilities
- Own team architecture of personalized recommendation system operating at Amazon scale
- Lead the design and delivery of cross-teams projects end-to-end, with focus on maintainability, scalability, performance, and reliability
- Collaborate with Product and Science to define technical roadmap and experiences based on data
- Build AI-powered experiences including personalized recommendations, relevance explanations, and knowledge-driven features using LLMs and generative AI
- Define and drive measurement strategies including analytics events and experiment configurations to track business and technical metrics
- Create clarity from ambiguity and make sound technical decisions in a problem space where established patterns don't apply
- Drive adoption of engineering best practices through exemplary personal coding practices
- Proactively simplify existing systems and resolve endemic, root-cause problems

About the team
Our team is part of Amazon's Personalization organization, a high-performing group that leverages Amazon's expertise in machine learning, big data, distributed systems, and user experience design to deliver the best shopping experiences for our customers.

Our vision is to enhance customer shopping experience on Amazon by leveraging personalization techniques. We strive to save customers valuable time by tailoring their journey to their individual needs, interests, and preferences. Our goal involves identifying personalization opportunities to develop and optimize customer experiences, thereby improving the overall search and discovery process across Amazon.

Basic qualifications

- Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team
- Experience leading the architecture and design (architecture, design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and current systems
- Experience programming with at least one modern language such as Java, C++, or C# including object-oriented design

Preferred qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

title: Sr. Risk Manager, Finance Operations, Finance Operations Risk, Governance, & Experience
descriptionHtml:
Amazon is seeking a Senior Risk Manager to support the Finance Operations (FinOps) Controllership team at Amazon. We’re looking for someone who can take lead in understanding complex FinOps processes and identify the full range of risks related to processes, regulatory compliance, organization, policy, and technology. This individual will ensure FinOps processes stay ahead of risks associated with process design, internal control effectiveness, computer system integration, and other relevant areas.
As a Senior Risk Manager on the FORGE team, you won't just find problems, you'll architect solutions. You will lead high-impact audits and risk programs across Finance Operations (FinOps), with a primary focus on Global Real Estate & Facilities. Your work will directly strengthen the control environment, protect Amazon from material risk, and drive the kind of operational excellence that lets Finance scale with confidence.

In this role, you will lead and oversee projects, such as inspections, risk assessments, and advisory services, that shape process and control design to mitigate risk and drive a continuous controllership culture. Responsibilities will also include preparation of findings and engagement with stakeholders to complete action items. Your subject matter expertise is critical to develop strong working knowledge of processes, current initiatives, and organizational changes.

This role requires strong leadership skills to influence others and/or self-serve in order to achieve critical inspection objectives. You will be expected to identify risks in our processes and work with the appropriate owners to mitigate risks. You will need to dive deep to understand Amazon’s disparate and complex processes and related applications and work through ambiguity to deliver results.

Key job responsibilities
Successful candidates must be eager to dive deep into processes and have a proven record of delivering meaningful risks and recommendations to the business. The candidate should have strong auditing skills, problem solving skills, systems and process knowledge, and a passion for customer service. Specific core responsibilities are below:
• Perform risk assessments of the organization
• Perform end to end audits, including scoping, fieldwork, and reporting
• Evaluate design and effectiveness of FinOps controls
• Evaluate policy and process exceptions
• Prepare clear, compelling audit reports, executive narratives, and leadership-ready communications. Present findings, recommendations, and risk trade-offs to senior leaders (Director and above) with precision and confidence
• Provide training that improves and raises the bar on controllership with respect to policies and other requirements
• Support ad hoc inspections, deep dives, and reviews across broader FinOps and upstream business processes as new risks emerge or business needs evolve
• Provide strategic perspective on risk-related business and technology decisions. Help stakeholders see around corners, prioritize the right mitigation investments, and avoid building risk into new processes

A day in the life
• Lead scoping, planning, and execution of complex audits and risk assessments across FinOps processes.
• Own end-to-end lifecycle of high-impact, cross-functional risk programs.
• Identify control gaps, evaluate control effectiveness, and drive sustainable remediation plans.
• Define project objectives, success criteria, and risk reduction metrics.
• Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to prioritize risk initiatives, influence decisions, and drive execution.
• Develop data-driven audit reports and executive communications presenting findings and recommendations to senior leadership.
• Influence stakeholders to implement scalable, automated controls and eliminate recurring risks.
• Leverage data, automation, and technology to improve risk detection and audit efficiency.

About the team
Finance Operations Risk, Governance & Experience (FORGE)’s mission is to improve controllership across Finance Operations (FinOps) by identifying risks, protecting assets, designing to-be controls, testing existing controls, and as appropriate, assisting process owners with risk mitigation or remediation. In addition, FORGE collaborates with teams within and beyond FinOps on risk assessments, compliance, corporate social responsibility, regulatory, and governance matters. FORGE also serves as FinOps's program manager for the global external audit, provides controllership support for non-integrated subsidiaries, and is the contact for FinOps owned Internal Audit findings.

Basic qualifications

- 7+ years of compliance, audit or risk management experience
- Knowledge of Microsoft Office products and applications at an advanced level
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree or equivalent
- Experience at consulting firms or equivalent
- Experience working across teams and influencing teams that are not your own
- Experience in relevant finance roles, or experience in identifying, leading, and executing opportunities to improve, automate, standardize or simplify finance or business tools and processes

title: Senior Product Designer, Prime Video
descriptionHtml:
Are you interested in shaping the future of entertainment? Do you want to define the next generation of how and what Amazon customers are watching?

Prime Video is changing the way people watch movies and TV. From one service, we're delivering versatile ways to watch hundreds of thousands of movies, TV series, and live events on the web, mobile, and TV. Our service is available in 240+ territories globally, and we're just getting started.

Working closely with business and technology partners, we use research, design, and prototyping to guide early product development, bring clarity to engineering goals, and develop a customer-centric point of view.
This is where you come in. As a Senior Product Designer, you'll join our Enterprise team within Prime Video Experience Design and lead design for a suite of products that uses AI to plan, manage, and optimize Prime Video's marketing at scale. The ambition is a progressively hands-off-the-wheel experience: a system that learns from every campaign, recommends the categorization, tiering, budget, channels, and creative that will move engagement, and takes on more of the planning and execution over time so people supervise and decide rather than assemble. This is a suite rather than a single product, and much of it is being defined now. You'll own the design direction across it, from framing problems that nobody has framed yet through detailed interaction design, developer handoff, launch, and what we learn afterwards.

The hard part is not the automation. It is the judgement around it. When a system can plan and produce more than any person can check, the design problem becomes how someone trusts it: what they see to make a decision quickly, where confidence, provenance, and the reasoning behind a recommendation surface, how they correct rather than reject, and what happens when the system is wrong. A hands-off-the-wheel experience only works if the human can see what the machine is about to do, understand why, step in at the right altitude, and stay accountable for the outcome.

You'll co-own that behavior with engineering, and you'll set the line for the team on where the system can drive and where a human still has to. If designing for probabilistic systems and the trust, control, and recovery they demand is the work you want to be doing, there is a great deal of unsolved ground here.

You'll establish the interaction and visual standards that hold this portfolio together, and build the patterns and mechanisms that make the designers around you faster. You'll use AI-assisted design workflows to move quickly, from rapid prototyping through to designing generative and agentic AI capabilities into the products themselves.

You'll partner closely with Product Management, Engineering, UX Research, Design Technology, and the marketing, brand, creative, sports, and portfolio teams who depend on this work, taking a clear position and arguing for it in writing and in the room. You'll be surrounded by senior designers, researchers, and design technologists working the same domain, on problems complex enough to build real depth in.

Key job responsibilities
- Lead end-to-end design across a suite of AI-driven marketing planning, management, and optimization products, from problem framing through handoff, launch, and iteration
- Design toward a progressively hands-off-the-wheel experience: define the levels of automation, what the system does on its own versus what it proposes for approval, and how that boundary moves as trust is earned
- Co-own the AI behavior with engineering: how people trust recommendations, see the reasoning and provenance behind them, review at volume, correct rather than reject, and recover when the system is wrong
- Design the intelligence layer that closes the loop, connecting strategy, goals, spend, and outcomes so the system learns from every campaign and surfaces benchmarks and recommendations that drive the next one
- Design AI-assisted and increasingly automated planning across the campaign lifecycle: categorization and tiering across territories, budget and channel allocation, work-back and scheduling, team assignment, and the brief
- Design the AI creative capabilities within the suite: generating marketing assets at scale, and the review, correction, and quality bar that make generated output shippable
- Define where the system's output, from a recommended plan to a generated asset, is good enough to ship and where human craft and human decision are still required
- Map the full marketing lifecycle across formats, languages, and territories, and design for its real constraints: scale, variants, multi-team processes, and edge cases
- Set the interaction and visual standards that give the portfolio coherence, and feed them back into our design system
- Lead workstreams with other designers, and build the patterns and tooling that make them faster
- Tie design decisions to measurable outcomes, and prioritize ruthlessly
- Present and defend recommendations to senior leadership, and write the narratives that move decisions without you in the room
- Partner across product, engineering, research, design technology, marketing, brand, sports, portfolio, legal, and data science
- Run discovery with the marketers, strategists, channel owners, portfolio planners, and operators doing this work today
- Mentor the designers around you and raise the team's practice

About the team
You'll be joining the Enterprise team within Prime Video Experience Design. We design the tools and workflows used by the content partners, marketers, operators, and internal teams who power the Prime Video content supply chain. Our products span marketing planning and portfolio management, channel strategy, campaign execution, marketing creative production, partner-facing content management, content acquisition, partner onboarding, publishing, and analytics. GenAI is the connective tissue across all of it, changing both what we deliver and how we deliver it, and moving these tools from systems people operate toward systems that increasingly plan and act on their own. We've built an enterprise design system that brings coherence and quality to a growing portfolio of tools. We're scrappy but detail-oriented, and we know when to move fast versus when to dive deep. We work alongside UX Researchers and Design Technologists, and our enterprise customers are close enough to test what we build and tell us what needs to change.

- 8+ years of design experience
- Have an available online portfolio
- Experience with design tools such as Photoshop, Illustrator and InDesign and prototyping in HTML, JavaScript, CSS, Ajax

Preferred qualifications

- Experience applying scrum to visual or UX design processes
- Experience with UX design of complex workflows

title: Onsite Medical Representative
descriptionHtml:
The Amazon Workplace Health & Safety (WHS) team is deeply committed to the safety and wellbeing of our people. WHS sets the strategic direction to provide resources, best practices, and safe environments to proactively manage the health and wellbeing of our workforce. To support these goals, Amazon is seeking an experienced and dynamic Onsite Medical Representative (OMR) to join our team. In this position, you will work closely with the WHS site manager, WHS specialist, and occasionally the Wellness Specialist (WS). This includes attending weekly associate safety committee meetings, greeting all new hires for the site or through daily one-on-one interaction. Additionally, the OMR will participate in weekly case management review meetings as necessary.
As an OMR, you will independently assess and administer first aid as well as offer guidance to Amazon Associates (AAs) on both occupational and non-occupational injuries or illnesses. You should be passionate about learning and advocating health and wellness principles to consistently support AAs on a daily basis. You will refer care to outside medical providers as needed, and learn about OSHA regulations, risk, and analysis.
The OMR will function as a part of the larger team onsite, assisting with all first aid needs and support safety operations as needed.
Responsibilities include but are not limited to:
• Provide first aid support and make referrals to outside medical providers as necessary.
• Minimize the AA risk of injury through awareness, education, and proactive engagement.
• Maintain all records of care provided to AAs.
• Coordinate and maintain the workers’ compensation and return to work programs for AAs with work-related injuries.
• Provide daily activity logs and end of shift reports.
• Engage with AAs and leadership on operations floor to provide coaching regarding observed at-risk work habits.
• Maintain a clean working environment and ensure appropriate medical supply inventory is maintained.
• Participate in training and certification to facilitate first aid, CPR and AED certifications classes.
• Maintain all first aid, CPR, AED credentials.
• Work flexible shifts which could include days, nights, holidays, and/or weekends.
• Assist with random saliva drug testing protocols.
• Maintain effective care delivery in emergencies and assist emergency response at the site.
Additional Job Elements include:
• Lift up to 49 pounds and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach.
• Stand/walk for up to 12 hours during shifts.
• Work in an environment where the noise level varies.
• Work in an environment that is subject to variable temperatures and weather (delivery stations include outside loading departments).
• Continuously climb and descend stairs (applies to sites with stairs).

Amazon is committed to providing employment accommodation in accordance with the Ontario Human Rights Code and the Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act. If contacted for an employment opportunity, please advise Human Resources if you require accommodation.

title: Senior Systems Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Amazon is seeking a talented, enthusiastic, and motivated Interdisciplinary Senior Systems Engineer to join a dynamic team that provides leadership for concept development, architecture, and design of robotics systems and industrial equipment. This candidate should be motivated to adapt well-tried systems engineer principles into a new and emerging industry. The preferred candidate would have demonstrated experience in robotics, mechatronics, experience with machine safety and/or functional safety standards, and possess excellent communication skills. This position reports directly to the System Architect.

Key job responsibilities
The Senior Interdisciplinary Systems Engineer will:
- Define, expand, and explore the design space for complex, multidisciplinary robotics and automation problems
- Identify and analyze the cross-functional tradeoffs between design alternatives, including impact on performance, schedule, cost, risk, complexity, and scale
- Break down and frame problems using con-ops, use cases, structural/functional decompositions, and other system representations to clarify needs and align technical teams
- Identify design choices to ensure our products are safe, reliable, and usable, and can be deployed and supported at Amazon scale
- Build quantitative models and analyses (Excel, MATLAB, Python, internal tools) to conduct trade studies, refine requirements, and understand key system drivers across the integrated systems of systems
- Perform technical risk assessments (such as TRL, Gap Analysis, FMEDA, HARA, etc.), devise mitigation plans, and create system test strategies
- Develop and communicate system integration and evaluation strategies and plans in support of program learning, technical risk reduction, verification, and validation
- Drive and prioritize execution of system test campaigns that span lab and field testing environments in collaboration with subsystem development and test teams (test readiness reviews, test execution, post-test analysis and reporting)
- Guide and inform, via analyses, cross-functional architecture definition
- Mentor junior engineers in engineering best practices, and participate in hiring of new team members


Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or above in engineering or equivalent STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering and Mathematics) field
- 7+ years of professional experience
- Experience with eliciting and clarifying business and end user needs, and connecting those needs to system concepts, requirements, and designs
- Experience leading technical collaborations and creating alignment across diverse groups (e.g. hardware engineering, software engineering, controls, functional safety, program management)
- Experience identifying and analyzing dependencies, tradeoffs, and sensitivities across multi-disciplinary systems

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with industrial robotics and automated material handling solutions
- Experience with machine learning systems
- Experience developing and supporting hardware/software systems across the product life cycle
- Experience with scalable production systems
- Experience with developing safety-critical systems and supporting related regulatory compliance needs
- Experience with 1 or more relevant domains: Industrial Automation, Robotic Vehicles/Manipulation, Autonomy, Perception and Controls
- 9+ years of experience in integrated system design

title: Embedded Software Engineer II, Ring
descriptionHtml:
Ring is growing in Poland and we are looking for experienced Embedded Software Engineers to join our team in Gdansk. You will work on firmware for IoT devices used by millions of customers worldwide, developing new features and shipping products from concept to production.

As an Embedded Software Engineer, you will own the design and implementation of firmware subsystems running on resource-constrained hardware. You will work across the full development cycle: architecture, implementation, code review, testing on real devices, and production release. Our team operates with high autonomy and a strong feedback culture.

The ideal candidate:

- Has shipped embedded products to production and understands what it takes to go from prototype to millions of devices in the field.
- Writes clean, maintainable C/C++ for constrained environments and cares deeply about code quality.
- Communicates proactively, raises technical risks early, and drives solutions across teams.
- Thrives in a fast-paced environment where priorities shift as customer needs evolve.
- Is curious about the full stack, from hardware registers to cloud connectivity, and enjoys learning new domains.


Key job responsibilities
- Design, implement, and maintain embedded firmware in C/C++ for Ring devices.
- Specify and implement functionality for embedded subsystems (connectivity, streaming, power management, sensors, or security).
- Collaborate with hardware, QA, cloud, and app teams to deliver integrated product experiences.
- Participate in code reviews, technical design discussions, and cross-team architecture decisions.
- Debug complex issues across hardware and software boundaries using JTAG, UART, and protocol analyzers.

A day in the life
You start the morning reviewing a code change from a colleague working on a new sensor driver. After your team standup, you spend focused time implementing a feature for an upcoming product launch, testing it on real hardware at your desk. In the afternoon, you dig into a tricky issue that only reproduces on one board variant, tracing it from application code down to a register misconfiguration. You push your fix, verify it on the device, and close the day knowing it will ship to customers in the next release.

Basic qualifications

- BA/BS degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering or related field, or equivalent practical experience
- Extensive embedded development experience in C or C++
- Familiarity and experience with ARM CPUs
- Experience with writing low-level drivers, interrupt service routines and general troubleshooting/debugging with hardware

Preferred qualifications

- Master’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering or related field
- Experience with one of more commercial wireless protocols like BLE or WiFi
- Experience in firmware development and testing of battery powered products
- Experience with development tools like IAR/Keil and Git version control system
- Experience with common bus protocols such as SPI, I2C, and UART
- Experience with software testing (unit, regression and system testing)
- Knowledge of embedded Linux and FreeRTOS
- Comfortable in some scripting language such as Python
- Experience in building GenAI applications

title: EU Head of Regulatory Approvals, Drone Delivery, EU/UK Regulatory Affairs Prime Air
descriptionHtml:
Prime Air is bringing drone delivery to Europe and needs someone to secure the approvals that make it legal to fly. You will own the EU regulatory approval programme end to end, from first authority conversation to authorisation granted.
You will be our named point of contact to EASA and national aviation authorities, sign our submissions, and own both the operational and the airworthiness sides of each application. You will build the safety cases, run the in-country consultants who support them, and carry the accountability they cannot. Success is authorisations in hand for our first European sites, strong authority relationships behind them, and a route to scaling across EU Member States after that.

Key job responsibilities
Own Operational Authorisation and airworthiness applications for EU site approvals, from scoping to grant.
Build and own relationships with EU National Aviation Authorities; sign submissions and represent Prime Air in authority meetings.
Act as Prime Air's EU airworthiness point of contact to EASA, working with the wider Regulatory Affairs and Engineering teams on design validation inputs (Design Verification Report, type validation, system-level airworthiness).
Own the complete application package and its submission for every EU site, integrating the airspace and air risk work delivered by the EU Regulatory Affairs Specialist.
Own the SORA safety case: ground risk assessment, SAIL determination, Operational Safety Objective compliance and the environmental evaluations each application needs.
Manage in-country regulatory consultants for local-language filing, safety-case drafting and authority logistics, owning the accountability that consultants cannot.
Build the evidence base and authority track record that positions Prime Air for a Light UAS Operator Certificate (LUC) and scaled operations across Member States.

A day in the life
You will spend your time in front of authorities, inside safety cases, and across our engineering, safety and operations teams pulling the evidence together. Expect regular travel to authority meetings and candidate sites in the EU.

About the team
How do you get items to customers quickly, cost-effectively, and—most importantly—safely, in less than an hour? And how do you do it in a way that can scale? Our teams of hundreds of scientists, engineers, aerospace professionals, and futurists have been working hard to do just that! We are delivering to customers and are excited for what's to come.
If you are seeking an iterative environment where you can drive innovation, apply state-of-the-art technologies to solve real world delivery challenges, and provide benefits to customers, Amazon is the place for you.
Check out more information about Prime Air on the About Amazon blog (https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/transportation/amazon-prime-air-delivery-drone-reveal-photos).

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent in a related technical field
- Experience in program or project management
- Can work proactively and independently, meet deadlines, and deliver on projects and tasks
- Experience with high-level negotiation and successful internal and external relationship management
- Extensive experience working directly with an EU National Aviation Authority on Operational Authorisations, type certification, airworthiness or operational approval project.
- Working knowledge of the EU UAS framework (2019/947 and 2019/945), SORA methodology, Operational Authorisations and U-Space, and the associated acceptable means of compliance and guidance material.

Preferred qualifications

- Speak, write, and read fluently in English
- Experience engaging multiple national aviation authorities simultaneously.
- Engineering or operations experience in drone operations.
- Experience with EASA design verification of drones, Special Conditions for Light UAS (SC-Light UAS) and SAIL determination.
- Experience implementing scalable compliance solutions (technology, procedures, processes, etc.) in a regulated environment.
- Understanding of how airspace access, operational approval and airworthiness certification interact for drone operations.
- Experience coordinating environmental permitting and spectrum or communications licensing at national level.

title: Operations Supervisor
descriptionHtml:
Il team Operations è il cuore pulsante di Amazon ed è grazie al suo operato impeccabile che riusciamo a elaborare e spedire gli ordini ai nostri clienti in tempi record. Nel ruolo di Operations Lead/Supervisor avrai l’opportunità di toccare con mano l’interazione tra le diverse componenti delle nostre attività operative, contribuendo in prima persona a garantirne un funzionamento efficiente.
Sarai il punto di riferimento per i colleghi durante il turno di lavoro e li aiuterai a seguire i processi introdotti dai manager. Key job responsibilities
- Misurare e monitorare i flussi di lavoro e le performance del sito, nonché fornire rilevanti informazioni ai manager di prima linea per garantire l’eccellenza operativa in tutti i turni.
- Supportare e formare il personale affinché assicuri un servizio d’eccellenza e supervisionarlo nello svolgimento delle mansioni quotidiane.
- Supportare l’Area/Shift Manager nell’ambito di progetti per migliorare i processi, creare un ambiente di lavoro sicuro e aumentare il coinvolgimento del personale.
- Collaborare con altri reparti per individuare soluzioni tese a risolvere problematiche frequenti o soddisfare le necessità, laddove la produttività è cruciale.
- Analizzare i dati per identificare piani volti all’ottimizzazione della sicurezza, qualità e produttività.

A day in the life
Il tuo lavoro di Operations Lead/Supervisor si svolgerà in uno dei nostri siti operativi. Affiancherai l’Area/Shift Manager nell’esecuzione del piano per il turno. Le mansioni di cui ti occuperai spazieranno dall’organizzazione delle riunioni di inizio turno con il team al monitoraggio delle procedure, per assicurare che tutti rispettino le norme di sicurezza, i processi di qualità e le priorità della giornata.
Segnalerai eventuali criticità ai manager, ma talvolta sarai tu la figura più senior durante un turno e spetterà a te fornire le indicazioni per portare a termine ogni incarico. A volte affiancherai l’Area/Shift Manager nella definizione dei turni, in modo da assicurare la presenza di personale a sufficienza anche nei periodi di massima attività.

- Conoscenza avanzata dell’italiano, scritto e parlato.

title: Data Center Controls Tech, Controls Deployment Service
descriptionHtml:
As a member of the Global Controls Team, you will collaborate with highly motivated operators, engineers and technicians in the data center industry to maintain and optimize critical infrastructure systems. You will be responsible for troubleshooting and maintaining the Building Management System (BMS) and Electrical Power Monitoring System (EPMS) while developing new processes and standards that drive innovation in the controls space.

AWS data centers utilize sophisticated industrial control systems to automatically operate mechanical equipment, maintaining optimal temperature and pressure conditions throughout the facilities. These systems integrate and monitor multiple critical components, including generators, uninterruptible power sources, diesel generators, electrical switchgear, power distribution units, variable frequency drives, automatic and static transfer switches, air-cooled and water-cooled chillers, pumps, cooling towers, heat exchangers, Computer Room Air Handlers (CRAHs), and air economizers. Within this industrial control system infrastructure, the BMS serves as the primary control platform for all mechanical systems within the data center, while the EPMS functions as the primary monitoring platform for all electrical systems. This position offers the opportunity to work with cutting-edge technology in mission-critical environments while contributing to the reliability and efficiency of AWS's global infrastructure.

Amazon does not sponsor for immigration, including for H-1B, TN, and other non-immigrant visas, for this role.

Key job responsibilities
Primarily work in and support multiple data centers by deploying, servicing, and upgrading BMS and EPMS systems.

Mentor and train Facilities team members on the operation and control of BMS and EPMS systems.

Manage small to medium-sized projects and programs.

Perform point-to-point checkouts between field devices and controllers.

Perform first-line diagnostics, troubleshooting, and maintenance of programming code and hardware associated with BMS and EPMS in data centers.

Execute provisioning processes for servers, controllers, industrial PCs, and network configurations, including communication testing between third-party devices and controllers or servers.

Install, replace, configure, and calibrate sensors.

Read and interpret electrical schematics and control panel drawings with a basic understanding of closed-loop controls, field sensor scaling, and functions typically performed by industrial controllers.

Supervise low-voltage electrical contractors performing wiring and installation of field devices in compliance with AWS requirements.

Provide commissioning and systems-level testing support.

Create red-lined drawings and documentation of systems.

Follow change management processes to generate work requests and methods of procedures.

Participate in factory witness tests at vendor or panel builder facilities.

Perform root cause analysis during testing and commissioning.

Ensure personnel on site utilize proper safety methodology.

Perform service activities including monitoring and reviewing ticketing systems, conducting root cause analysis, and prioritizing tasks.

Actively manage service agreements including vendor labor scheduling, quality assurance, and financial invoice review.

Participate in material handling tasks such as lifting, carrying, or moving up to 50 lbs of equipment, and utilize OSHA-standard safety equipment including limited weight-bearing work platforms, ladders, step stools, and personal protective equipment (PPE) such as safety harnesses.

Perform other tasks as assigned by manager.

A day in the life
As a Data Center Controls Technician, your primary customers are Data Center Engineering Operations (DCEO), who rely on you to keep Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Monitoring Systems (EPMS) healthy and operational. On a given day, you are the boots on the ground solving problems that directly impact data center availability. You might diagnose a controller communication loss, calibrate instruments feeding inaccurate data to operators, or supervise vendors performing quarterly maintenance. For new builds, you perform point to point testing and support commissioning alongside construction teams. Your internal stakeholders include your Controls Engineer, Controls Manager, partner teams (Field Engineering, Critical Project Implementation, DCEO), and the vendors you oversee.

About the team
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Why AWS

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Diverse Experiences

Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Inclusive Team Culture

Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

- High school or equivalent diploma
- Associate’s degree, trade school certification, or other certified training in a related technical field with 4+ years of relevant industrial Controls or HVAC controls experience, OR 6+ years of relevant industrial or HVAC controls experience in lieu of a degree.
- Basic understanding of Industrial controls system, knowledge of meters, devices, sensors, relays and troubleshooting utilizing standard hand tools, digital metering, or calibration/diagnostic equipment in a data center, hospitals, large commercial complex, water, power, oil & gas or similar industries.
- 3+ years of experience working with low voltage controls, wiring, networking signals, electrical and mechanical systems, computers and operating systems.
- Ability to work non-standard hours and differing work rotations/shifts and overtime as required.

Preferred qualifications

title: Supply Chain Manager II, Amazon XL (AMXL) Supply Chain
descriptionHtml:
Join Amazon's Extra Large Supply Chain organization built to manage every stage of the fulfillment process- inbound, capacity, linehaul, yard, and delivery - under a single leader. This is a rare chance to see and shape a complex, worldwide supply chain network that moves unique, large-format products with special handling requirements all the way to millions of customers.

As a Supply Chain Manager on our End-to-End team, you will own problems at the intersection of modeling and analytics and hands-on stakeholder engagement. You'll build the models that drive network decisions, then take them directly to the subject-matter experts who run transportation, fulfillment, delivery, and engineering — translating analysis into operational change in real time. This role is for someone who wants both: the quantitative depth of network planning and the influence of partnering with the people who move the freight.

You'll support inventory capacity and transportation management across our Fulfillment and Sortation Network — managing trailer timeliness, linehaul scheduling, and transportation execution. Scope will flex with the needs of the network and your strengths, but you can expect ownership of the metrics and programs that keep the network running efficiently.

Because we operation end-to-end from fulfillment through delivery, cross functional work is the daily default. You'll partner across Operations, Transportation, Finance, Product, and Engineering, and you'll be close enough to the operation to solve problems that have immediate, visible impact on our network and our customers.

Key job responsibilities
- Build and own analytical models that drive transportation decisions across the Fulfillment and Sortation Network
- Translate analysis into operational change by partnering directly with transportation, fulfillment, delivery, and engineering subject-matter experts. This means you will go into facilities, see the package flow, understand the operation, and help drive the business with tactical and strategic support
- Manage trailer timeliness, linehaul scheduling, and transportation execution against network metrics and glidepaths
- Own capacity and transportation programs that keep the network running efficiently, adjusting scope as network priorities shift
- Identify operational inefficiencies and drive automation and scalable systems to resolve them
- Partner cross-functionally across Operations, Transportation, Finance, Product, and Engineering to solve problems in real time
- Communicate findings, trade-offs, and recommendations to stakeholders and leadership to drive aligned decisions. This includes analytical results in Business Reviews, documents with decision gates, and ad-hoc support to fix critical operational challenges.

A day in the life
You start the morning in your models, monitoring overnight trailer timeliness and linehaul performance, updating an AI tool to monitor a regional issue. You then present your findings and recommendation in a business review to 7 senior leaders—and walk out with a decision made and a change live that same day. The afternoon turns strategic and cross-functional: you learn the network through its experts—a transportation SME on scheduling constraints, an engineer on yard design constraints, Finance on cost trade-offs. No two days match. Your decisions directly impact customers, ensuring they receive their products on-time and satisfied.

title: Software Development Engineer, Leo Space Security
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is a constellation of Low Earth Orbit satellites that will provide low-latency, high-speed broadband network connectivity to unserved and underserved communities around the world.

We are looking for a software development engineer to join the founding cohort of the Engineering and R\&D team within Leo Space Security. The team defends the manufacturing lines, launch sites, and global ground infrastructure behind the constellation from the most sophisticated threat actors on the planet. You will build a neurosymbolic reasoning platform: large language model agents combined with a knowledge graph and real-time asset state store that ground every conclusion in verifiable fact, so every automated decision is auditable. The platform automates incident response, threat analysis, offensive security testing, and detection authoring, backed by a high-throughput streaming pipeline that takes a detection from concept to production in hours. The team is new and the surface area is wide: the features you ship become the system Leo's security teams run on from day one.

Export Control Requirement

Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen.


Key job responsibilities
You will own building software features across the platform and deliver them end to end: clarify the requirements, write the design, ship the code, instrument the system, and keep it healthy in production. The features you own are concrete and high-consequence: the live state-of-the-world record that answers where every tracked device is, who last held it, and whether it is where it should be; consolidated detection that surfaces events from every Leo site type as one signal instead of siloed alarms; automated triage so security events arrive enriched and pre-adjudicated, with containment executed in seconds under human approval; self-service workflows that cut multi-day manual processes down to seconds; and the instrumentation that produces the metrics the security organization reports against. You will code independently, make design tradeoffs with guidance from the senior engineers who own the platform architecture, review your teammates' code, and operate what you build.


A day in the life
One morning you might ship a correlation feature that joins device, custody, and access events so triage surfaces a pattern no single data source shows. That afternoon you could be debugging why a detection's latency regressed, profiling the pipeline stage that slowed it down, and adding the metric that catches it next time. The next day you might pair with an applied scientist to backtest a candidate detection against retained telemetry before it ships, then pick up an operational ticket and automate away its root cause so no one handles it again. You will obsess over the two latencies that define the platform, the time from event to detection and the time from detection to containment action, and treat every manual step you find as a candidate for deletion. The team is new, so what you build now becomes the foundation others build on.



About the team
Leo Space Security protects the people, facilities, hardware, and supply chain behind a global satellite constellation. The Engineering and R\&D team within this organization builds the platforms and tooling the security pillar teams operate on, moving security operations from manual triage to correlation-based detection, automated response, and agentic AI. The team is composed of applied scientists, software engineers, and security engineers working across physical and digital security domains.

title: Software Development Engineer, Finance Technology
descriptionHtml:
We are responsible for billions of dollars of payments each month to millions of Amazon vendors across the globe. We delight our vendors by paying them when they want and how they want, accurately and on time.

We build software applications that facilitate global financial transactions worth billions (USD) annually, rivaling the complexity and scope of dedicated payments fintech companies. Our systems decide how and when a payment happens, carry it out across the world's payment networks, and account for it — all under real regulatory, tax, and audit obligations, in every geography Amazon operates in.

You will have the opportunity to work in a high-paced environment leveraging the AI-Driven Development Lifecycle (AIDLC) within our core principles of engineering, to deliver faster and ship features incrementally.

Ownership is the center of this role, and ownership here means the whole lifecycle rather than just the code. You will take features from working backwards from the customer through design, implementation, testing, deployment, and documentation — and you stay accountable for how they behave in production long after they ship.

Own features and components of our payment systems end-to-end. The business problem and the technology direction will be understood; how to actually build it will not be, and that part is yours.
Design the solution and make the tradeoffs. You will code independently, and you will have senior and principal engineers to pull in when a tradeoff is genuinely hard or when a design needs to line up with where the architecture is heading.
Work directly with product managers and business stakeholders — finance, tax, and accounts payable operations — to understand what they need and why, so that you build the right thing. You will hear the requirement first-hand rather than through a written hand-off, and you will be expected to push back when the ask and the outcome do not line up.
Ship incrementally. Large payment changes land safely through staged rollout and measurement, not through a single release.
Reduce operational load. Our best work turns a recurring manual intervention into a code fix or a self-healing mechanism, not another runbook step.
Leave the system better explained than you found it. What you build should be maintainable and extensible by an engineer who has never seen it, which means clear documentation and design choices that hold up without you in the room.
Raise the bar around you: code review as a teaching mechanism, mentoring engineers earlier in their careers, and getting new teammates productive on how our software is built, how it operates, and how it fits into the bigger picture.

Building with agentic AI
We are not experimenting with AI on the side — it is how we work. You will use AI agents across the development lifecycle: exploring unfamiliar systems, drafting and reviewing designs, generating and testing code, triaging production issues, and automating the operational work that used to consume a week of on-call. We expect engineers to be strong directors of these agents and rigorous verifiers of their output. The judgment stays with you: you are accountable for what ships, whether you typed it or an agent did. Agentic capabilities are increasingly part of the systems themselves — automating decisions and investigations that previously required a human in the loop — and you will have room to build them.

Why this team
Payments is one of the few places in software where the business logic is genuinely hard, the scale is enormous, and a mistake has an immediate real-world consequence — a vendor who does not get paid when they expected. If you want real ownership, global scope, and the freedom to build with the newest tools available rather than waiting for permission to try them, this is a good place to build a career.

- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- 1+ years of software development engineer or related occupational experience
- 1+ years of designing and developing large-scale, multi-tiered, multi-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C#, C++, Java, or Perl experience
- 1+ years of Object Oriented Design experience

title: Sr. Customer Solutions Manager, EC2 Capacity
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform, and Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2) is its largest and most consequential service. As customers accelerate workloads spanning generative AI training and inference, large-scale analytics, and mission-critical production systems, AWS’s ability to plan, commit, and deliver compute capacity at scale is a defining competitive advantage.

We are seeking a Senior Customer Solutions Manager (CSM) to join the EC2 Capacity Customer Experience organization. In this highly visible role, you will help guide AWS’s customers through the capacity dimension of their cloud journey, planning and delivering the compute capacity solutions that power customers across our global base. You will own the end-to-end capacity and scaling plans for a portfolio of internal and external customers consuming compute (CPU and GPU) and foundational services, translating their growth trajectories into executable commitments and then driving action across AWS teams to deliver against those commitments with clarity on who owns what by when.

You will be a critical partner to your customers, leveraging your technical background and your understanding of large-scale compute and capacity dynamics to shepherd them through planning, delivery, and governance of their capacity needs. You will interface with customer and AWS leadership, driving collaboration between the core account groups (Sales, Support, Solutions Architecture, and Professional Services), product and engineering teams, supply chain, and finance. You will translate strategic initiatives in the account and capacity plan into executable actions, working backwards from customer milestones, and you will manage the cadence by leading the reporting and tracking functions along the way.

You are encouraged to think big, invent, and take ownership of customer capacity challenges. Successful candidates have a strong technical background, are familiar with cloud infrastructure and increasingly with AI/GenAI workloads, are aware of the details that matter, have excellent problem-solving abilities, and are exemplary communicators at both the executive and project-team level. You will be a peer leader able to gain stakeholder buy-in, negotiate trade-offs, and lead virtual teams. You should be passionate about delivering a great customer experience by planning and delivering capacity, driving innovation, and contributing to the day-to-day management of customers’ successful consumption of AWS.


Key job responsibilities
You will establish a deep understanding of each customer’s business vision, growth plans, and consumption patterns, and influence them to adopt the right capacity solution at the right time. The Capacity CSM-T is responsible for four focus areas:
• Accelerating adoption through capacity delivery and execution. Own and drive the capacity and scaling plans that translate customer growth forecasts into concrete, time-bound infrastructure commitments, and drive the “last mile” between an approved plan and physical capacity in the right place at the right time.
• Identifying and aligning on strategic capacity opportunities. Work with the account team to work backwards from the customer and pursue opportunities including large-scale workload migrations and modernizations, GenAI/ML scaling, platform generation migrations, regionalization, and cost-optimizing demand shaping.
• Customer enablement. Serve as the customer’s capacity coach and the voice of the customer within AWS, evangelizing their capacity needs to AWS leadership, product, engineering, and supply chain teams.
• Governance. Implement governance structures, review cadences, and escalation paths that govern both the partnership with the customer and the health of their capacity commitments.
Across these focus areas you will also:
• Drive action and accountability across partner organizations (EC2, Supply Chain, Networking, Storage, Finance, Sales) to deliver against committed capacity plans, identifying and escalating blockers with urgency.
• Organize complex demand signals into supportability scenarios that enable leaders to make informed capital allocation decisions, partnering with Finance and Supply Chain to quantify trade-offs (cost of over-provisioning versus risk of under-delivery).
• Leverage large data sets to tell the story on the customer experience, define KPIs that measure delivery fidelity and forecast accuracy, and own the metrics and the narrative.
• Build repeatable mechanisms and automation that reduce manual steps and scale the capacity engagement model across a growing queue of customers.
• Maintain working fluency across EC2 instance families (CPU: Graviton, Intel, AMD; GPU: NVIDIA, Trainium, Inferentia) and the networking and storage dependencies that influence capacity requirements.


About the team
You start your morning reviewing commitment and delivery dashboards for your portfolio of customers, flagging a delivery risk in an upcoming GPU buildout. Mid-morning you lead a capacity review with one of your largest customers, walking through next quarter’s scaling plan and pressure-testing their forecast assumptions. You then join EC2 Supply Chain and Finance partners to present supportability scenarios for a customer requesting a significant expansion, driving alignment on which to fund. After lunch you work tickets and demand signals through internal tooling, update your customer tables, and write the narrative for a weekly review that synthesizes demand across your customers into a clear state of the portfolio. You end the day with an engineering partner on a tooling gap you identified, a forecasting input that would remove a manual step, and write the one-pager to get it prioritized.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of leading large-scale, technical or engineering programs with a proven record of thought leadership, business case development, realizing customer benefits, and successful program completion experience
- 2+ years of customer-facing work, engaging with customer executives, technologists or partners to solve business problems with advanced technologies experience
- Bachelor's degree in science, technology, engineering, math, business or equivalent
- Experience leading technical and non-technical transformation project teams with a proven ability to work across broad functional teams

Preferred qualifications

- PMP certification, or SCRUM/Agile, SAFe certification
- Experience implementing cloud services including migrations and modernization projects or similar

title: Senior Program Manager, SSD R2L Delivery, Central Operations Strategy
descriptionHtml:
The Central Operations Strategy organization is seeking a Sr. Program Manager to own weather and incident response strategy for our last-mile delivery network. Weather is one of the largest drivers of unplanned variability in our operations, and this role owns the mechanisms that determine how we respond to it: how much capacity we protect, how much volume we accept, and how quickly we recover when conditions differ from what was forecast.

This role sits at the intersection of operations strategy and data. The Sr. Program Manager will build and own the reporting and analysis that show how weather affects delivery performance, translate weather forecasts into clear capacity recommendations, and measure whether those recommendations improved outcomes. They will partner closely with our central response team, meteorologists, and business stakeholders to land the right balance between volume and delivery quality for every event, and to improve the quality of the inputs driving those decisions over time.

The role requires strong program ownership and comfort making decisions with imperfect information. The ideal candidate can dig into the data to find the answer, then turn it into a clear recommendation and a durable process that operations teams can run every day.

Key job responsibilities
- Own the framework that measures how weather affects delivery quality and capacity, and the recurring reporting built on it
- Build and maintain the models and analysis that turn weather forecasts into capacity and volume recommendations grounded in historical performance
- Measure forecast accuracy and recommendation effectiveness, and drive improvements from what you find
- Partner with our central response team to improve response playbooks, escalation paths, and recovery actions for planned and unplanned events
- Partner with meteorologists to improve forecasting, feeding operational outcomes back into how forecasts are built
- Own the volume-versus-quality trade-off recommendation, sizing the cost of both over-reacting and under-reacting
- Build the tools and processes that let this program scale across the network
- Influence investment priorities through data-driven business cases, and drive alignment across operations, planning, finance, and technology partners
- Communicate strategy, risks, and trade-offs to senior leadership
Demonstrated Competencies
- Strong analytical skills and the ability to work independently with large data sets; SQL and - Python preferred
- High judgment with incomplete information
- Track record of building programs or reporting capabilities from scratch
- Willingness to go deep in an unfamiliar, technically complex domain and become the expert others rely on
- Proven ability to build consensus and drive decisions across large, diverse stakeholder groups
- Ability to simplify complexity for senior audiences
- Confidence in ambiguous, fast-moving environments

A day in the life
You start by reviewing how the network performed against recent weather events, and where results missed, working backwards to whether the fix belongs in the forecast, the recommendation, or execution. You spend part of the day in the data, refining the analysis behind our capacity recommendations and quantifying trade-offs. You partner with the central response team to prepare for upcoming events and with meteorologists to review where forecasts diverged from outcomes. The rest of your time goes to building mechanisms rather than reacting: better reporting, less manual work, and the documents that take your recommendations to senior leadership.

Central Operations Strategy owns the centralization strategy for order recovery, capacity management, and incident response across our last-mile delivery businesses. We centralize work that cannot scale at the site level, build automation to remove manual operational burden, and support the network through everything from new site launches to major disruptions. On the weather side, we measure how weather affects delivery performance, translate forecasts into capacity recommendations, and partner with meteorologists to improve forecast accuracy over time.
