title: Actuator Systems Engineer, Fauna
descriptionHtml:
Every motion our robots make starts with an actuator, and we’re looking for an Actuator Systems Engineer to help us build better ones. This role is for someone who enjoys the full loop: building a model of how a motor or transmission should behave, rigorously testing this around other industry standards, and then iterating on the hardware or firmware until the desired specification is met.

You’ll work across electrical, mechanical, and firmware design, and you’ll own actuator performance from the bench all the way to robots running in people’s homes. The things you learn and build will directly shape how safe, reliable, efficient, quiet, and strong our robots are.

Key job responsibilities
- Plan and run characterization testing on our actuators, covering things like torque constant, friction, efficiency, thermal behavior, and wear over time, and turn those results into models and specs the rest of the team can rely on

- Build and maintain electromechanical and thermal models of our actuators that help us predict robot performance, set safe operating limits, and support the controls and simulation teams

- Contribute to the electrical design of the actuator, including motor selection, motor drivers, sensing, and protection, working closely with our EE team and suppliers

- Contribute to the mechanical design of the actuator, including transmissions, bearings, housings, and thermal paths, with an eye toward torque density, efficiency, and manufacturability

- Write and tune motor control firmware, including current and position control, current and thermal limiting, calibration, and fault detection

About the team
Fauna Robotics, an Amazon company, is building capable, safe, and genuinely delightful robots for everyday life. Our goal is simple: make robots people actually want to live and interact with in everyday human spaces.
We believe that future won’t arrive until building for robotics becomes far more accessible. Today, too much effort is spent reinventing the fundamentals. We’re changing that by developing tightly integrated hardware and software systems that make it faster, safer, and more intuitive to create real-world robotic products.
Our work spans the full stack: mechanical design, control systems, dynamic modeling, and intelligent software. The focus is not just functionality, but experience. We’re building robots that feel responsive, expressive, and genuinely useful.
At Fauna, you’ll work at the frontier of this space, helping define how robots move, manipulate, and interact with people in natural environments. It’s an opportunity to solve hard problems across hardware and software with a team focused on making robotics accessible and joyful to build.
If you care about making robotics real for everyone and building systems that are as delightful as they are capable, we’re interested in hearing from you.

Basic qualifications

- Experience in developing functional specifications, design verification plans and functional test procedures
- PhD in EE, ME, Robotics, Physics, or a related field, or a Master’s degree in one of these fields and 4+ years of industry experience developing actuators, motors, or other electromechanical systems
- Experience building models of electromechanical or thermal systems and validating them against test data
- Hands-on experience testing and characterizing motors or actuators
- Experience writing embedded motor control firmware in C or C++, and analyzing data in Python
- Experience leading a technical project from early concept through validation

Preferred qualifications

- Experience designing actuators for robots
- Experience with brushless motor design, field-oriented control, or power electronics
- Experience designing gear trains such as planetary, cycloidal, or harmonic drives
- Experience with thermal modeling and with reliability or life testing
- Experience taking an actuator design from prototype into production with suppliers
- Publications or patents related to actuation, motor control, or electromechanical design

title: Senior Industrialization Engineer, Data Center Engineering
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Web Services is seeking a Senior Industrialization Engineer to lead manufacturing and industrialization activities for New Product Introductions (NPI) from prototype to high-volume production. You will own the translation of product design intent into scalable manufacturing workflows, consult on Design for Manufacturability (DFM), and partner with internal partners and external suppliers to achieve volume output based on business demands.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

As a Senior Industrialization Engineer, you work within the strategy and standards set by the team’s Principal Engineers, you develop the detailed manufacturing process, stand up production lines, and lead ramp-up activities at large-scale contract manufacturers (CMs). You are measured on getting real product out the door: lines that hit their takt time, OEE, and yield targets, and a repeatable process that scales across sites.

You will spend meaningful time on the factory floor diagnosing bottlenecks, balancing lines, and partnering directly with CM engineering teams to resolve the issues that stand between a design and dependable high-volume output.

Amazon has a global presence. Travel to our data centers (located throughout AMER region), contractor manufacturer visits, and yearly team off-sites are required. Domestic travel is ramp-driven: 30–50% during active production ramps, tapering between platform launches. International support will be part of the job and some international travel may be necessary.

Key job responsibilities
- Manufacturing Process Development: Develop and document the detailed manufacturing process, workstation definition, work content, line balancing, and takt time, translating the team’s manufacturing strategy into executable production plans.

- Capacity & Scale Planning: Build the capacity models and scaling approach for each product, deciding how the process ramps from low-volume builds to serialized production across sites, then validate the plan against real line performance.

- Production Line Build & Ramp: Stand up production lines at contract manufacturers and lead ramp-up from low-volume builds to serialized production, maintaining presence on the factory floor until OEE targets are met.

- Tooling, Fixturing & Automation: Specify and validate tooling, fixturing, and automation/robotics appropriate to the volume and product, and confirm they perform on the line.

- Process Analysis & Optimization: Use simulation, process flow analysis, and ergonomics to identify bottlenecks and drive yield improvement, cost reduction, and throughput gains.

- CM Execution & Qualification: Partner day-to-day with CM engineering teams to qualify processes against defined standards and ensure consistent, repeatable output across lines and sites.

- Design-for-Manufacturability Feedback: Work with the product design team to flag manufacturability risks early and feed line-level constraints back into design before high-volume commitment.

- Issue Resolution: Lead the resolution of production issues on the floor, partnering with Quality and Reliability to separate design defects from process/line inefficiencies and restore stability.

title: Business Analyst, RBS Emerging Stores, Retail Business Services, RBS Flex Org Variable
descriptionHtml:
Are you passionate about solving business challenges at a global scale? Amazon Retail Business Services is looking for an experienced Business Analyst to join our team and help unlock insights which take our business to the next level. The candidate will be excited about understanding and implementing new and repeatable processes to improve our employee global work authorization experiences. They will do this by partnering with key stakeholders to be curious and comfortable digging deep into the business challenges to understand and identify insights that will enable us to figure out standards to improve our ability to globally scale this program. They will be comfortable delivering/presenting these recommended solutions by retrieving and integrating artifacts in a format that is immediately useful to improve the business decision-making process. This role requires an individual with excellent analytical abilities as well as business acumen. The candidate knows and values our customers (internal and external) and will work back from the customer to create structured processes for global expansions of work authorization, and help integrate new countries/new acquisitions into the existing program. They are experts in partnering and earning trust with operations/business leaders to drive these key business decisions.

Key job responsibilities
• Design, develop, and maintain scalable dashboards, reporting systems, and automated data pipelines that support business reviews (WBR/MBR/QBR), pilot launches, and ongoing program governance.
• Own data infrastructure end-to-end—partner with tech, analytics, and operations teams to establish and maintain required tables, data lakes, and data structures that enable accurate and timely insights for APIE and related stakeholders.
• Retrieve, aggregate, and analyze data from multiple sources to produce actionable insights, KPI frameworks, and escalation deep dives that inform feature expansion, defect identification, and strategic decision-making.
• Develop and maintain SQL queries and analytical models to support APIE feature performance, ad-hoc requests, and dive-deep investigations for operational or customer/vendor escalations.
• Enable data-driven decision making by converting large datasets into digestible narratives, financial/CX estimates, and recommendations for pilots, experiments, and global expansions.
• Partner with cross-functional teams to understand requirements, build KPIs, automate processes, and drive data-aligned solutions that meet evolving business needs.
• Prepare and deliver business reviews and written narratives for senior leadership, highlighting progress, insights, risks, and decision points.
• Participate in strategic and tactical planning discussions, providing analytical input that shapes long-term product and operations strategy across global regions.

About the team
About Amazon

Amazon strives to be Earth’s most customer-centric company, where customers can find and discover anything they want to buy online. Through continuous innovation in selection, convenience, and low prices, Amazon has grown from an online bookstore into a global e-commerce and technology leader. Our teams build solutions that improve how customers shop, how sellers grow, and how our global supply chain operates.

About Retail Business Services (RBS)

RBS strengthens Amazon’s retail engine by driving standardization, improving process quality, and reducing defects across global marketplaces. RBS operates at the intersection of retail, operations, technology, and finance, ensuring Amazon’s systems and processes scale reliably while maintaining a high-quality customer and selling-partner experience.

About RBS IES

RBS International Emerging Stores (IES) is a specialized organization within RBS focused on improving Amazon’s per-unit economics across the emerging countries supply chain. The team builds mechanisms that improve cost predictability, strengthen upstream defect visibility, and enable consistent governance across high-impact cost categories, contributing directly to improved Free Cash Flow and scalable business growth.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of business analyst, data analyst or similar role experience
- 5+ years of Excel (including VBA, pivot tables, array functions, power pivots, etc.) and data visualization tools such as Tableau experience
- 3+ years of business or financial analysis experience
- Experience defining requirements and using data and metrics to draw business insights
- Experience making business recommendations and influencing stakeholders
- 2+ years of Tableau Desktop, Quicksight or other relevant data visualization software experience
- Experience in tax, finance or a related analytical field, or experience in financial modeling, P&L management or analysis
- Knowledge of writing and optimizing SQL queries in a business environment with large-scale, complex datasets

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree in business or analytical discipline

title: AIT Auditor II, Audits & Insights Team, Audit and Insights
descriptionHtml:
Amazon provides individuals or enterprises the opportunity to sell their goods on the Amazon platform. Over 2 million sellers in 14 countries (and growing) list their products for sale on Amazon and thereby contribute to the success of Amazon. Amazon is growing worldwide and Sellers are a critical part of Amazon’s ecosystem to deliver on our vision of offering the earth’s largest selection and lowest prices. These Sellers offer hundreds of millions of unique items, providing a broad and diverse inventory of products from Books, Electronics, Apparel, Consumables and beyond.

Our team, through a partnership with core business teams, contribute to key goals that help improve Seller/Buyer experience on Amazon. This team is made up of people like you. People who are: a) Entrepreneurial – we build solutions for Buyers and Sellers, regardless of size, b) Innovative – our problem space evolves every day due to scale, new categories, and new geographies. There is no playbook, so innovation and creativity are a must, c) Passionate – Everyone’s an owner at Amazon, and our team is no exception. We are passionate about our customers, both Sellers, and Buyers.


Key job responsibilities
Establish SOPs, process controls, recommend revisions and ensure alignment with business goals
· Build and scale system-level solutions that have metric impact; drive adoption of solutions across teams

- Minimum 1 year of experience managing a team directly or indirectly (coaching underperformance, mentorship, training new hires etc.)
- Experience leading initiatives and/or managing operational metrics at program or org level
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills
- Experience managing multiple stakeholders and collaborating with partner teams (Ops, product, policy etc.)
- Knowledge of Quality auditing methodology and tools
- Proficiency in Excel (Pivots, VLOOKUP etc.)
- Excellent analytical thinking, problem solving skills and proven ability of managing multiple competing priorities

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in seller facing risk functions (SEPO, SPR etc.).
- Experience managing multiple programs and driving high level process improvement initiatives
- Knowledge of Lean principles or DMAIC methodology will be an added advantage

title: AHS Compliance Spec - English & German, Account Health Support
descriptionHtml:
The Account Health Support team acts as the primary interface between Amazon and our third-party business partners (Sellers). We provide dedicated support to Sellers on the Amazon platform, predicting their needs proactively and delivering solutions that help them better serve customers.


Key job responsibilities
•You will support Selling Partners to resolve account health issues via phone and email, managing high volumes of inbound and outbound contacts with effective education, de-escalation and communication in every interaction.
•You will conduct thorough investigations to identify root causes of account health issues, including policy violations, enforcement actions, and appeals — providing clear, accurate solutions and redirecting difficult conversations with empathy and professionalism.
•You will serve as a dedicated contact for Sellers throughout their compliance journey, executing structured outreach plans including proactive contacts, follow-ups, and pre-enforcement outreach across applicable legislations.
•You will document all interactions according to standard operating procedures, managing cases through centralized mechanisms to ensure visibility, consistency, audit readiness, and high data integrity.
• You will collaborate with internal stakeholders, identify process improvements, flag policy gaps, and consistently achieve productivity and quality performance goals in a metric-driven environment


A day in the life
As an Account Health Support Specialist, you will serve as a dedicated point of contact for Amazon's Selling Partners, guiding them through their compliance journey. You will resolve account health issues, conduct investigations into policy violations, and execute proactive outreach to help Sellers maintain and regain compliant status across Amazon policies and EU regulations — including product compliance, sustainability, and general product safety (GPSR). AHS Specialists work across voice and written channels, supporting Sellers through account health issues, enforcement actions, and compliance journeys depending on role specialization.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in any field of study
- Experience in oral and written communication in English
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English and German (B2 or above)
- Experience using computer-based tools and systems to process or track work

Preferred qualifications

- Experience working in a contact center environment
- Experience working in a fast-paced, rapidly changing operations environment
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills, inspiring confidence while guiding customers through resolution steps via phone and email
- Demonstrated empathy and active listening skills
- Ability to deliver performance in a metric-driven environment with high productivity and quality standards
- Multitasking ability: handling phone, chat, and email contacts simultaneously
- Ability to troubleshoot, research, and translate technical or procedural instructions into clear guidance for customers
- Enthusiastic, self-motivated, and willing to learn new skills
- Demonstrated ability to identify and drive process improvements

title: Strategic Account Manager, OHL
descriptionHtml:
DESCRIPTION
In this role the Strategic Account Manager will manage a set of critical seller accounts which contribute to 20%+ business of the category. He/She will be responsible to develop strong relationships with top sellers in the category and drive improvements in customer facing inputs and achieve category objectives.

Role and Responsibilities:

· Managing the seller relationship by championing the seller’s needs at Amazon. Build strong communication channels at all levels of the seller’s organization, set proper expectations, provide clear status communications, and manage towards a growth plan.
· Managing and driving the growth of the seller’s business: Build and execute on a strategic account plan that delivers on key business opportunities for the seller and Amazon.
· Managing key improvement initiatives and projects: Drive new product launches and relationship extensions by partnering with the business development and onboarding teams.
· Work with sellers to improve operational aspects of their business in providing a great consumer experience.
· Analyzing the business: Conduct deep dive analysis and provide routine executive-level reporting on the seller’s current business and future opportunities. Publish recommendations and action plans based on data.



A day in the life



About the hiring group



Job responsibilities



Key job responsibilities
Own and manage a portfolio of high-value seller accounts contributing 20%+ of category business, driving revenue growth and category objectives through strategic account planning and execution.

Build and nurture trusted relationships with top sellers across all organizational levels, serving as their primary advocate within Amazon while setting clear expectations and delivering proactive status communications.

Develop and execute strategic account plans that identify and capitalize on key business opportunities for both the seller and Amazon, including new product launches and relationship extensions.

Partner cross-functionally with business development, onboarding, and category teams to drive operational improvements that enhance the end-customer experience.

Conduct deep-dive analysis on seller performance, market trends, and growth opportunities; deliver routine executive-level reporting with data-backed recommendations and actionable plans.

Identify and resolve operational bottlenecks in seller workflows, improving inputs such as selection, pricing, fulfillment speed, and catalog quality.

Monitor key performance indicators and proactively course-correct to ensure sellers meet business targets aligned with category goals.

A day in the life
You start the day reviewing seller dashboards and key metrics to prioritize actions. Mornings are spent on calls with top sellers—resolving escalations, aligning on growth plans, and discussing new product launch timelines. You collaborate with cross-functional teams including business development, catalog, and operations to unblock seller issues and drive improvements. Afternoons involve deep-dive analysis, preparing executive reports, and refining account strategies. You balance relationship management with data-driven decision-making, ensuring your sellers deliver a great customer experience while hitting category targets.

About the team
The OHL team is focused on building and scaling Amazon's marketplace by partnering with the most impactful sellers in the category. We are a team of strategic thinkers and relationship builders who thrive on data-driven decision-making and operational excellence. Our mission is to deliver an exceptional customer experience by empowering top sellers to grow their business on Amazon. We work cross-functionally with business development, category, and operations teams in a fast-paced, collaborative environment where ownership and bias for action are at the core of everything we do.

Basic qualifications

- 4+ years of sales or account management experience
- Experience managing a portfolio of high-value accounts and delivering against revenue growth targets
- Experience conducting data analysis to drive business decisions, including proficiency with Excel (pivot tables, lookups, formulas)
- Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to present to executive-level stakeholders
- Experience working cross-functionally with multiple teams (e.g., operations, category management, business development)

Preferred qualifications

- Experience working with seller/vendor ecosystems, including onboarding, catalog management, and fulfillment operations

title: シフトアシスタント, SSD Operation
descriptionHtml:
※このポジションの勤務地は東京都板橋区を予定しています。

私たちのグローバルオペレーションネットワークは、日々何百万もの荷物と笑顔をアマゾンのお客様にお届けしています。私たちは、シフトアシスタントとして私たちのチームに加わってほしいと考え、意欲的で顧客重視の人材を探しています。この役割では他業種・職種も含めこれまでの経験、スキルを活かし、改善点を模索しながら、より便利でお客様に満足いただける高い品質のサービスを提供できるビジネスをつくる事、安全・快適・楽しい職場環境の構築を行う、将来の組織のリーダーを目指していただける事を期待しています。また、お客様の注文が適切な時間に適切な場所へ確実に配送されるよう、お客様の期待に応えることにおいても重要な役割を担います。

私たちの業務の流れには3つの主要な要素があります。
商品が保管され注文に備える「ファーストマイル」、注文品をお客様のエリアまで輸送する「ミドルマイル」、そして商品をお客様の玄関先までお届けする「ラストマイル」です。各拠点で運営方法に若干の違いはありますが、一貫して変わらないものが一つあります、それは顧客を第一に考える私たちのビジョンと献身的な姿勢です。

本ポジションはアマゾンの新しいエキサイティングな配送拠点で業務を行います。可能な限り最速でお客様のご自宅に商
品をお届けすることでお客様のカスタマーエクスペリエンスを向上します。私たちと一緒に歴史をつくりましょう！


■業務内容■
具体的にはマネージャーのサポートのもと、以下の業務に責任をもち遂行いただきます。

① 安全・品質・作業効率の向上
安全安心な作業環境の維持・向上のため、日々の安全活動、品質チェックに加え、標準作業手順書の作成や多岐にわたる問題解決・改善活動を行います。

② 日々のオペレーション対応
商品を入荷、在庫として管理し、注文があった商品を出荷するという一連の流れを各工程間で連携をとりながら、業務を円滑に進める事が求められます。お客様とお約束した期日までに商品を迅速かつ正確にお届けするため、時間ごとの計画に沿ってオペレーションを実施することに責任を持ちます。

③ 新規プロジェクトの導入・セール時など、オペレーション拡大時の準備
新しいサービスやシステムの導入に備え、現場での手順変更・導入方法を検討し円滑な導入に向けて準備を行います。また、新規入職者でもAmazonの標準作業に則った手順がスムーズに身につくためのトレーニング構築やマニュアルを作成します。

④ イレギュラーへの対応
作業で発生する様々な課題の原因を追求し問題解決を行います。また、再発防止策案の検討、実施を行います。
※上記業務はマネージャーやチームのサポートのもと実施していただきます
※配送ステーション内での配送を通じて、物流の仕組みやマネジメントについて学ぶことができます
※社内公募により、マネージャーへのキャリアアップや他部署への異動機会もあります
※勤務は交代制（夜勤あり）です
※1日の流れ：以下ページをご参照ください。
先輩社員インタビュー

■福利厚生■
下記ページをご確認ください。
福利厚生 | アマゾンジャパンキャリアサイト

■教育制度■
入社後、約1週間はAmazonのリーダーとして必要な会社のカルチャーや、配送拠点の基本的な業務を一通り学ぶことができる座学の機会を提供します。各部署へ配属後は、トレーナーのもと、OJTで工程知識やツールの使用方法など基礎知識を学んでいきます。トレーニング資料も完備しており、相互に進捗を確認しながら独り立ちまでしっかりとサポートしますので、未経験者も安心してスタートができる環境です。
最先端の物流システムを学ぶことはもちろん、年齢・性別・国籍問わず様々な仲間と日々の業務を通して、次のステップとなるピープルマネージメントやビジネススキルを学ぶことができます。

■キャリアパス■
シフトアシスタントからキャリアをスタートし、チームマネージャー、統括マネージャー、そして配送拠点の拠点長となった実績も多数あります。また、Amazonでは社内公募制度があり、国内外問わず他部署や異なる職種への異動にチャレンジし、社内で多様なキャリアを築くチャンスもあります。Amazonではご自身で学び成長することを推奨し、キャリア開発できるようサポートを行っています。
キャリアアップストーリー

■会社のカルチャー■
Amazonでは全員がリーダーです。個人の裁量に任される部分が多く、社員の個々の可能性を最大限に伸ばす事を重視しています。様々なバックグラウンドを持った社員が前職で培った多様な経験やスキルを活かして職位や役割に関わらず誰もがチャレンジできる環境です。
また年次有給休暇の取得を積極的に推進しており「働く」、「プライベート」も充実できる環境です。
失敗に寛容な文化：まずは試してみることにこだわります。好奇心を持って学びます。時にはリスクを取り、計画通りいかなかったとしても、よりよい成果に繋げられることが私たちの強みだと信じています。

最後に、募集しているポジションや組織、お仕事の詳細については以下のリンクよりご確認いただけます。

・配送拠点で働くリーダーのインタビュー：インタビューをご覧ください。

・職種：オペレーション

Durch die Analyse von Daten mit Führungskräften und die Besprechung der betrieblichen Vor- und Nachteile von technischen Verbesserungen mit den Fachabteilungen trägst du zu „best in class“ Lösungen bei.

Amazon Logistik (AMZL) ist für die Auslieferung von Millionen von Produkten unserer Kunden und Kundinnen direkt an die Haustür verantwortlich. Die „Last-Mile-Logistik“ liefert unsere Pakete in Partnerschaft mit Drittanbietern und realisiert zahlreiche Initiativen zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung, um Millionen von Kunden zufrieden zu stellen.

title: Snr Process Improvement Specialist, Planning & Reporting, EU Ops Sustainability, EU Ops Sustainability
descriptionHtml:
EU Operations Sustainability drives the decarbonization of Amazon's operational footprint across Europe, focusing on reducing environmental impact from transportation, buildings, and energy consumption. The team develops and executes strategies spanning First Mile, Middle Mile, and Last Mile logistics — including energy efficiency, renewable energy, building material decarbonization and climate resiliency and adaptation, at fulfillment centers, sort centres and delivery stations. Working cross-functionally with EU Operations, WW Sustainability, engineering and procurement, the EU Ops Sustainability team translates Amazon's Climate Pledge commitments into actionable programs with measurable targets. The team navigates also the evolving European regulatory landscape to ensure compliance while identifying opportunities to accelerate decarbonization ahead of mandated timelines.

EU Ops Sustainability is looking for an analytical, detail-oriented, and self-directed Senior Process Improvement Specialist to own all planning and reporting activities that track carbon, energy, and beyond-carbon plans on behalf of the entire EU Ops Sustainability organization. This is the single-threaded planning and reporting owner for the EU Ops Sustainability team: you will build and run the mechanisms that turn complex sustainability data across First Mile, Middle Mile, and Last Mile into a reliable, auditable single source of truth that leaders use to make decisions.
This role supports our Climate Pledge goal of net zero carbon by 2040 by establishing rigorous, repeatable planning cycles and reporting mechanisms across carbon abatement, carbon intensity, energy, and beyond-carbon programs (e.g., waste, water, and circularity). To be successful, you need a passion for sustainability and data, the ability to process large and imperfect datasets to drive business decisions, and the judgment to know which numbers matter. The successful candidate must have strong analytical skills, familiarity with ETL and SQL, and the ability to apply systems thinking to complex, fast-moving problems.
You must be comfortable working independently in an ambiguous, high-pressure environment, identifying sources of uncertainty, and finding data to fill the gaps where needed. You are not only able to develop and drive high-level planning strategy, but can also roll up your sleeves, dig in, and get the job done—consolidating inputs from stakeholders across business units, resolving data-quality issues, and communicating results clearly to all levels of leadership.

Key job responsibilities
This role is inherently cross-functional - responsibilities include (but are not limited to):
• Own the EU Ops Sustainability planning calendar end to end—coordinate and deliver the annual and multi-year planning cycles (OP1/3YF, OP2, and Glidepath) for carbon, energy, and beyond-carbon plans, gathering and reconciling inputs from stakeholders across all business units.
• Build, maintain, and continuously improve the carbon, energy, and beyond-carbon reporting suite— co-developing reports, dashboards, and metrics that distill complex data into actionable insights and inform strategy across First Mile, Middle Mile, and Last Mile, working with the Sustainability Data and Analytics team within EU Ops Sustainability.
• Serve as the single source of truth for EU Ops Sustainability planning and actuals, owning the data structures, definitions, and methodology that underpin regional reporting.
• Run the sustainability month-end close for the region—ensuring data quality, timely resolution of data issues, and alignment of carbon abatement and carbon intensity reporting on a monthly basis.
• Develop and implement key performance indicators (KPIs) for the portfolio of sustainability programs, providing visibility into milestones and performance across projects.
• Establish the operating rhythm—lead programmatic reviews (MBR/QBR) and prepare variance commentary and metrics for leadership reporting, communicating status, risks, and course-correction strategies to senior leadership.

About the team
EU Ops Sustainability’s vision is to accelerate decarbonization across First Mile, Middle Mile, and Last Mile to ensure we achieve Net Zero Carbon by 2040. To drive this change, we integrate sustainability into decision-making for Amazon’s operations and supply chain. The EU strategy is aligned with the guidance provided by the WW Operations Sustainability team, and this role is central to making that strategy measurable and accountable.
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in econometrics, statistics, industrial engineering, operations research, optimization, data mining, analytics, or equivalent quantitative field
- Experience in program or project management
- Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
- Experience owning program strategy, end-to-end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
- Knowledge of Excel at an intermediate level (e.g., pivot tables & charts, multiple criteria lookups, nested logical/IF formulas, data cleansing, array formulas, etc.)
- Experience working with data analytics and using these metrics to identify problems, or experience in an operational role
- Experience managing multiple competing priorities simultaneously and driving goals to completion

Preferred qualifications

- Bachelor's degree, or Master's degree in supply chain, business, engineering, finance or related technical or quantitative field
- Experience developing and implementing of standards, policies and programs or equivalent
- Knowledge of at least one data-focused technology tool, such as Python, SQL, Alteryx, Amazon QuickSight, or similar
- Experience in analysing data and creating reports for leadership
- Experience in logistics, transportation, supply chain, import/export operations, or data entry/data administration
- Great attention to detail, strong financial acumen, and excellent written and verbal communication.

As a key member of the strategic account team, you will lead technical sales engagements, shape solution architecture, and influence revenue throughout the sales cycle for some of the largest enterprises in Financial Services, Automotive and Manufacturing, and Retail.

You will act as a trusted technical advisor, helping customers accelerate their cloud adoption — from migration and modernization to cloud-native applications and emerging technologies such as generative AI and agentic AI. You will create and lead the solution design that delivers each customer's business outcomes. Working as the link between ProServe Account Executives (PAEs) and our Delivery teams, you will make sure proposed solutions are realistic, achievable, and make the best use of ProServe and our partners. We are expanding our teams targeting Financial Services, Automotive and Manufacturing, and Retail industry segments in India, and this is a compelling time to join and help shape how these customers build on AWS.

title: Grid Analyst EMEA, Infrastructure Energy Team (IET) | Amazon Web Services
descriptionHtml:
AWS is building one of the largest energy portfolios in Europe, the Middle East, and Africa — and we need someone who can connect the dots across a complex, multi-country programme. As a Grid Analyst, you will drive programme visibility and business analytics for the energy infrastructure that powers AWS data centres across EMEA.

This is not a desk-bound reporting role. You will own the programme rhythm — aggregating data from multiple workstreams, building dashboards that surface risks early, and ensuring leadership has a clear, single view of cost, schedule, and capacity across the portfolio. You will work at the intersection of programme management and analytics, turning fragmented project data into decisions.

Day to day, you will:

- Build and maintain portfolio-level reporting that tracks grid connection milestones, utility timelines, and energisation schedules across EMEA markets
- Design automated dashboards and KPI frameworks using tools like Smartsheet and QuickSight
- Drive programme cadence
- Partner with legal, finance, and capacity delivery teams to align cost and schedule across workstreams
- Identify process gaps and implement improvements that reduce manual effort and increase reporting accuracy
- Provide analytical context on grid connection timelines and regulatory requirements to support decision-making

This role suits someone with strong programme management and business analytics skills who wants to apply them in the fast-moving energy infrastructure space. Prior power or utility experience is a plus but not required — what matters is your ability to structure ambiguity, build clarity from data, and keep complex programmes on track.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.


Key job responsibilities
- Support and collaborate with cross-functional teams (Legal, Finance Capacity Delivery) on the day-to-day programme management and reporting across the portfolio of infrastructure power delivery projects

- Enable effective decision making by managing and aggregating datasets and key performance indicators from multiple sources to provide a single source of truth on status, cost, capacity and key dates management across a portfolio of infrastructure power delivery projects

- Develop and oversee the implementation of continual process improvement initiatives related to operational efficiency, team effectiveness and new value-add activities

- Facilitate internal and external meetings by managing agendas, facilitating scheduling, owning meeting minutes, and following through on action items

- Coordinate and report on capex/programme implications

- Design and develop reporting dashboards and automated reporting solutions using tools such as Smartsheet and QuickSight

A day in the life
Your morning starts with data — scanning dashboards for overnight changes across the EMEA portfolio: a shifted energisation date in the Nordics, a permitting milestone in Ireland, updated cost forecasts in Southern Europe. You triage what matters before the weekly programme review. By mid-morning, you are the connective tissue between legal, finance, & capacity delivery — translating grid timelines into business context. Afternoons shift between building QuickSight dashboards that shape investment decisions & driving process improvements that eliminate manual reporting. Some weeks you support leadership deep-dives or stand up reporting frameworks for new country teams. No two weeks look the same.

About the team
The Infrastructure Energy Team (IET) secures and delivers the power infrastructure required to enable AWS growth across Europe, Middle East and Africa (EMEA). The team is seeking a results-orientated individual to join in the role of Grid Analyst. In this role you will support the stakeholder, administrative and contractual lifecycle of delivering power to existing and future AWS data centers throughout EMEA. This role provides an opportunity for a technically minded individual interested in building a foundation to further develop their skillset and advance their career within the energy sector. The successful candidate will be the single point of contact for AWS' grid connection applications, offers and agreements, overseeing application preparation and contractual terms management. The successful candidate will possess strong communication skills and an ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams (Energy, Legal, Finance, Supply Strategy, Real Estate and Capacity Delivery) on reporting status, issues and key risks across a portfolio of infrastructure power delivery projects. The candidate will standardize processes and develop tools necessary to provide a single source of truth on status, budget, expenditure, capacity, key dates and contractual terms management across the portfolio of infrastructure power delivery projects in EMEA. The candidate will support due diligence assessments on power connection costs, timelines and key risks for proposed data centre sites.

descriptionHtml:

Amazon MGM Studios also produces and acquires Original movies for theatrical release and exclusively for Prime Video.

The ideal candidate will bring extensive experience in content development, either as a producer or commissioner, with a comprehensive understanding of the domestic scripted TV and film landscape. title: Sr Innovation and Design Engineer, Worldwide Design and Engineering
descriptionHtml:
Are you an Innovative Engineer that wants to design the next generation of world-class fulfillment centers and logistics systems across the globe? Do you want a high level of ownership in solving complex problems? Does the idea of designing Intralogistics systems that leverage ground breaking automated Material Handling Equipment, packaging technologies and robotics appeal to you? If so, we have the job for you!

We’re looking to add a high-impact engineer to our team in Europe / United Kingdom. A successful candidate will have an established background in creating high-performance physical systems, a strong technical problem-solving ability, excellent project management skills, and an internal motivation to achieve results in a fast-paced, and often ambiguous environment. In this role, you will partner with internal and external teams to design high quality, cost effective solutions for our fulfillment and distribution systems. You will own multiple projects simultaneously, from concept realization through design approval. You will be our suppliers’ primary point of technical contact for your projects. Then, once the design is completed and approved, you will hand-off the project to our Ops Engineering team who will oversee the installation and commissioning of the project. You’ll continue working with that team to ensure that the system you’ve designed is successfully installed, commissioned and launched.

Your projects will include green-fields, brown-fields, and retrofits. Our team to designs fulfillment centers, cross-dock facilities, specialty facilities (ex. reverse logistics, hazmat) and ground and air transportation centers throughout North America and Europe. Your projects will be a variety of template-based and designed-from-scratch.

- Collaboration with internal teams and external vendors to generate high-quality, cost-effective solutions in very short periods of time.
- Simultaneously manage multiple projects and tasks while effectively influencing, negotiating, and communicating with internal and external business partners, contractors and vendors.

- Effectively communicate the vision, detailed roadmap, and specific technical solutions to make a compelling business case with senior executives.

title: SDE II, Economic Decision Science
descriptionHtml:
Economic Decision Science is Amazon’s Central Economics team in Europe. Our goal is to improve outcomes for customers by optimizing and automating business decisions. We work at the intersection of Economics, Machine Learning, Statistics, and Data Engineering, a highly engaging space where ideas directly shape how our stores operate and evolve.

We are a high-impact, autonomous, cross-functional team (Economists / Engineers / Product Managers ) focusing on long-term, ambiguous and challenging problems. Key topics include pricing, product selection, delivery speed, profitability, and customer experience. Our charter is company-wide, so we frequently collaborate with business, tech and science stakeholders across Europe and globally.

As an SDE, you’ll help us build our Factory of Economics, where economists can operate independently and in parallel, unconstrained by tech bottlenecks or engineering bandwidth. The goal: no software rewrites, predictable time to production, early integration, and fast iteration. You’ll work with tools such as DBT, Python, Apache Airflow, Spark, Iceberg; AWS services like Lambda, Bedrock, and SageMaker, containers, and whatever adds the most value. * Build and extend the Factory of Economics: automate and accelerate data pipelines, platforms, and tools, including ML and LLM capabilities, to scale innovative science products.
* Collaborate with economists to shape technical project requirements and direction.
* Be a technical leader that is not afraid to challenge the norms and innovate.

title: Technical Product Manager III, Amazon Leo Government
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is Amazon’s low Earth orbit satellite network. Our mission is to deliver fast, reliable internet connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. From individual households to schools, hospitals, businesses, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will serve people and organizations operating in locations without reliable connectivity.

This position will be working in the Product Management Team focussed on Amazon Leo products and services for US and International Government customers.

Key job responsibilities
We have an immediate opening for a Product Manager – Technical to support the Amazon Leo Government team focusing on DoD and National Security customers. This position will be based in in the Southern CA or Northern Virginia areas. This position will be part of the Product Management team defining and managing a family of products for dedicated government products and services within Amazon Leo’s broadband space network for high throughput broadband communications and other missions. This is a unique opportunity to innovate and define communications technology with few legacy constraints. The team develops and designs the Leo Government products. This team also works closely with the business and engineering teams to ensure that the products will meet customer requirements and presents a good business opportunity for Amazon.

title: Area Manager
descriptionHtml:
Operations is the beating heart of Amazon. This key part of our business makes sure we fulfil and dispatch orders efficiently so that our customers get their items on time. As an Area Manager, you’ll make sure your site is running as smoothly as it should so that we can meet customer demand. You will be leading a team that helps keep our operations safe, efficient, and of a high quality and taking on a number of projects across our network to drive productivity.

The applicable collective agreement (CCNL) for this role is Logistica, Trasporto Merci e Spedizione. The position is classified at Level 1 or above, depending on the candidate’s skills, competences and experience.

Key job responsibilities
Create, oversee, and drive a culture of safety and wellbeing
Analyse and implement changes to keep quality and productivity at a consistently high level
Oversee projects to streamline processes, optimise productivity and increase quality of service for customers within your area of responsibility
Analyse shift performance against relevant business objectives, and put in place actions to improve our operational excellence
Work collaboratively with management-level colleagues to standardise shift practices

A day in the life
You’ll work on a shift pattern at one of our sites, making sure it is as productive as it can be. Your main focus will be to own and drive a culture of safety and uphold quality and shift performance standards. You’ll also oversee process improvements within your area and drive implementation. A typical day is varied, including everything from routine team management and daily operational responsibilities to process improvement and wide-scale operational contingency tasks. You’ll also be a role model and mentor to new managers.

About the team
Customer Fulfilment, or CF, is where it all started for Amazon. CF has scaled up from a humble team of booksellers to a sophisticated global team which handles more than 1.5 million orders every day. The team is the foundation of our business and its efforts have helped us diversify across new regions and services. With the help of emerging technology, we’re always looking for ways to offer a bigger, better product range – delivered quickly and affordably.

The CF team are the first people in the chain that helps customers get products at the speed we’re known for. We’re based in Fulfilment Centres, which are at the heart of Amazon’s fast-paced Operations network. Our centres are sometimes referred to as the ‘First Mile’ because it’s where most Amazon packages start their journey. We help to manage dynamic inventory and facilitate speedy deliveries round the clock.

Lots of different people work in our Fulfilment Centres, so there are plenty of opportunities for every skillset. Some of us work with physical products, while others analyse data to help everyone across the business make smart decisions.

Basic qualifications

- Experience managing teams
- Experience communicating with a wide range of stakeholders, including colleagues and leadership
- Experience using data and metrics to drive improvements
- Speak, write, and read fluently in Italian
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English
- Bachelor's degree

Preferred qualifications

- Experience leveraging technology and implementing lean principles / Six Sigma methodologies to drive process improvements or equivalent
- Experience in a logistics/operations environment
- Experience working with the MS Office suite (Word, Excel, Outlook) in a professional environment

Are you experienced in Critical Infrastructure Commissioning and looking for a fast paced environment to work in? As a Data Center Commissioning Engineer (CxE), you will be part of highly creative, efficient team tasked with tackling fascinating and challenging problems building and supporting the operations of Amazon owned data centers. The Amazon Commissioning team (ACx) understands, evaluates, defines and manages the expectations of construction quality in accordance to engineering designs to meet the customer requirements. The CxE is responsible for supporting vendors, contractors, and other teams involved in the construction and commissioning of various systems such as:

-Medium and low voltage power systems
-Generators
-UPS
-HVAC (Air Handlers / Exhaust Fans / VFD)
-Chilled Water Systems
-Building Management systems (BMS)
-Electrical Power Monitoring Systems (EPMS)
-Testing and balancing
-Pumps and Hydronic systems

Physical Requirements
Walk job sites in uneven terrain
Work at heights and from ladders
Regularly walk, use hands and fingers, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl
Lift and/or move up to 49 pounds; and participate in group lifts for 50 pounds or more
Carry objects weighing up to 49 pounds for short distances
Work shifts longer than eight hours in duration with potential for night and weekends
Perform physical tasks throughout the day without becoming overly tired
Ability to manipulate small wires and objects easily
Work in a noisy environment
Work in environments that are colder or hotter than a normal office environment

Additional Job Requirements
· Ability and willingness to travel domestic and internationally for up to 80% of the year.
· Required to provide personal transportation for meetings and job visits away from the office; reimbursed.
· US Citizenship required

Key job responsibilities
The Commissioning Engineer (CxE) provides testing and validation oversight of AWS data center electrical and mechanical infrastructure. CxEs review design documents, lead Factory Witness Testing (FWT), and manage third-party commissioning vendors in the performance of onsite pre-functional, functional, and integrated systems testing. They take Ownership of their projects’ successes by Diving Deep to resolve technical issues and having Bias for Action to address everchanging schedule and coordination demands onsite. Additionally, CxEs communicate lessons learned and continuously collaborate on program improvements.

The CxE shall provide multi-discipline input into the scheduling, test script development, designing, and planning of projects. In addition, the CxE will be required to review component submittal packages, lead Factory Witness Testing (FWT), perform system level and integrated system testing. During commissioning the CxE will continuously audit activities to ensure compliance with environmental, quality, and safety requirements. Additionally, the individual will be responsible for comprehensive weekly reporting of status of all ongoing projects and lessons learned to continually improve the quality of our program. This position will include coverage of multiple inflight projects and tight timelines.

A day in the life
On a typical project, the CxE works across AWS engineering, capacity delivery, operations, and contractor teams to coordinate site activities, prioritize tasks, and ensure each issue has clear path to resolution. The CxE manages the project commissioning vendor whose primary scope is to identify issues, determine criticality, propose solutions, and document their findings. If project turnover is at risk, the CxE escalates to the appropriate stakeholders. Upon project completion, the CxE will communicate lessons learned to help peers on similar projects in flight and participate in initiatives that drive improvement to the commissioning program.

title: Commissioning Engineer, AWS Commissioning, AMER-West
descriptionHtml:
Are you experienced in critical infrastructure commissioning and looking for a fast-paced, high-growth environment? As a Data Center Infrastructure Engineer on the Amazon Commissioning team, you will join a creative, efficient group tackling challenging problems as we build and operate Amazon-owned data centers at an accelerating pace. Our fleet is expanding rapidly, and we need skilled engineers who can verify that every power, cooling, and control system in a new facility works correctly before it serves production traffic. You will also get hands-on experience with new data center technologies as the team scales and our designs evolve.

You will support vendors, contractors, and internal teams involved in the construction and commissioning of data center systems including medium and low voltage power distribution, generators, uninterruptible power supplies (UPS), heating ventilation and air conditioning (HVAC) equipment, chilled water systems, building management systems (BMS), electrical power monitoring systems (EPMS), and hydronic systems. You will review engineering designs, check construction quality against customer requirements, and help deliver infrastructure that directly supports the availability and performance of AWS services used by millions of active customers worldwide.

Physical Requirements:
- Walk job sites in uneven terrain
- Work at heights and from ladders
- Regularly walk, use hands and fingers, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl
- Lift and move up to 49 pounds; participate in group lifts for 50 pounds or more
- Carry objects weighing up to 49 pounds for short distances
- Work shifts longer than eight hours in duration, with potential for night and weekend shifts
- Perform physical tasks throughout the day without becoming overly tired
- Manipulate small wires and objects easily
- Work in noisy environments
- Work in environments that are colder or hotter than a normal office environment

Additional Requirements:
- Ability and willingness to travel domestically and internationally for up to 80% of the year
- Required to provide personal transportation for meetings and job visits away from the office; mileage is reimbursed


Key job responsibilities
- Review design documents and component submittal packages, then lead Factory Witness Testing (FWT) to confirm that equipment meets engineering specifications before it reaches the site.
- Manage third-party commissioning vendors through onsite pre-functional, functional, and integrated systems testing, auditing activities for compliance with environmental, quality, and safety requirements.
- Provide multi-discipline input into project scheduling, test script development, and commissioning planning while coordinating across engineering, capacity delivery, and operations teams to resolve technical issues quickly.
- Compile status reports on all active projects and share lessons learned with peers to help improve commissioning processes and program quality over time.
- Troubleshoot equipment and system-level issues during commissioning, identify root causes, and document corrective actions to make sure problems are fixed and do not come back.

A day in the life
You will start your morning reviewing the commissioning schedule and aligning priorities with construction and operations partners. Throughout the day you will move between the site and your desk, witnessing tests on electrical switchgear or mechanical systems, checking vendor work against approved test scripts, and flagging issues that need resolution before turnover milestones. When a risk surfaces, you will coordinate with the right stakeholders to keep the project on track. After site activities wrap up, you will update project trackers and share findings so teammates on parallel builds can benefit from what you learned.

About the team
The Amazon Commissioning team independently reviews and tests data center equipment designs, operational functionality, and construction practices. We make sure every facility we deliver meets strict quality and reliability standards while keeping full transparency with our partners. As our data center fleet grows at a rapid pace, the team is scaling to match and picking up new technologies along the way. This makes it a great time to join, build your technical expertise, and have a direct impact on how quickly and safely we bring new capacity online.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world's most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating, which is why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our products and services to power their businesses.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of engineering, installation, or startup/commissioning of electrical and mechanical systems experience
- Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field
- NETA or ASHRAE certification or commissioning specific education courses
- Knowledge of critical data center mechanical and electrical equipment
- Knowledge of Microsoft Office including Outlook, Word, and Excel
- Experience with the design, construction, operation, or maintenance of mission critical facilities, especially data centers

Preferred qualifications

- Knowledge of building codes and regulations for your region
- Knowledge of commercial or industrial power systems or mechanical systems
- Experience carrying design concepts through exploration, development, and into deployment or mass production
- Experience using a variety of web-based and other software tools for calculation and data processing

descriptionHtml:
Join Amazon’s mission to become Earth’s safest place to work! At Amazon, we’ve set the ambitious goal to become the benchmark of safety excellence across all industries in which we operate. As a Workplace Health & Safety Specialist (WHSS), you'll be at the forefront of transforming workplace safety culture at one of the world's most innovative companies. Your expertise and dedication will directly protect employees, ensuring they return home safely to their families every day. You'll facilitate new approaches to safety, combining technology with human-centered solutions to create an environment where safety and productivity thrive together. This isn't just about maintaining safety standards – it's about revolutionizing how we think about and implement workplace safety, making a lasting impact on our people and operations. As your building's designated safety champion, you'll have the unique opportunity to build relationships, influence positive change, and help write the next chapter in Amazon's commitment to becoming Earth's Safest Place to Work.

Core Impact Areas:
Safety Program Excellence & Implementation - Drive comprehensive safety programs through data-driven strategies. Lead daily safety audits, incident investigations, and risk assessments while implementing innovative solutions to prevent injuries. Deliver engaging safety training that resonates with associates and promotes a proactive safety culture. Champion continuous improvement initiatives that enhance workplace safety while maintaining operational efficiency.

Associate Advocacy & Cultural Leadership - Serve as a trusted safety advisor and advocate for associate wellbeing, building strong partnerships across all levels of the organization. Foster a culture where safety is everyone's priority through effective communication, coaching, and positive reinforcement. Develop strong relationships with frontline associates and leadership to drive behavioral changes and ensure safety best practices become natural habits. Transform safety data into compelling narratives that influence positive change and drive engagement in safety initiatives.

Additional Job Elements include:
- Lift up to 49 pounds and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach
- Stand/walk for up to 12 hours during shifts
- Work in an environment where the noise level varies
- Work in an environment that is subject to variable temperatures and weather (delivery stations include outside loading departments)
- Continuously climb and descend stairs (applies to sites with stairs)
- Maintain effective care delivery in emergencies and assist emergency response at the site

Must be available to work flexible shifts including days, nights and/or weekends.

For those that do not have an adult First Aid, CPR, AED certification from the American Heart Association or American Red Cross, must obtain within 3 weeks of start date.

Basic qualifications

- High school or equivalent
- A minimum of 1 year in an Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) related field OR; A Bachelor’s degree in EHS-relevant background OR; 6 months experience performing in a safety-related role within Amazon
- Knowledge of OSHA regulations specifically 29 CFR 1910
- Experience using Microsoft Word and Excel in a professional capacity
- Experience maintaining confidentiality in matter involving security and/or personnel issues in the workplace

Preferred qualifications

- Bachelor’s degree or higher, preferably in a safety related field
- Strong communication, teamwork, analysis, judgment, and customer focus skills
- Experience leading and managing a team, ability to analyze accident data, new processes, and machinery for potential safety concerns, and conduct job hazard and job safety analyses

title: 2027 Retail Vendor Manager Intern
descriptionHtml:
There’s a universe of opportunity at Amazon.

At Amazon, your career doesn’t follow a straight line. It accelerates, twists, and challenges you in ways you never expected. From the moment you join, you’re part of something big: building products or services that reach millions and shaping how people live, work, and connect every day. This is where your ideas turn into real impact.
You’ll work with world class tools, global platforms, and systems built to operate at an extraordinary scale. You’ll move fast, experiment and launch solutions that matter. With endless opportunities to explore across teams and roles, you’ll learn quickly, apply what you know and discover skills you didn’t know existed. This is an environment designed for builders who want to see the impact of their work in the world. Ready to start your adventure?

What’s in it for you?
An internship at Amazon means real responsibility from day one. You’ll build, test, and learn alongside people who want to see you succeed, while making an impact that reaches far beyond campus.

The Amazon University Talent Acquisition Team is looking for ambitious students to join us as Retail Vendor Manager Intern in 2027.

Internship length will be 12 months, full-time.


Key job responsibilities
- Work backwards from the customer, identifying inputs to grow Amazon's most strategic brands and improve their performance within a retail category.
- Support vendor managers in providing a suite of services designed to help brands succeed, collaborating with cross-functional teams including in-stock and marketing.
- Develop analytical and problem-solving skills by collecting, analysing, and interpreting data to drive category performance.
- Build an understanding of customer pain points, requirements, and potential value across retail, advertising, and merchant services.
- Identify target accounts using market data and industry intelligence to support business growth.
- Identify opportunities to improve products, services, processes, systems, and tools across the business.
- Work with different parts of the Amazon business to implement improvement projects, including category teams, product teams, and technical support teams.


A day in the life
Every day is a little different as a Retail Vendor Manager Intern. Working alongside a vendor manager, you'll learn how Amazon handles its e-commerce retail business across product categories — from books to fashion, electronics to grocery, and everything in between. You might spend your morning analysing category performance data and identifying growth opportunities for strategic brands, then spend your afternoon working with marketing or in-stock teams to implement an improvement project that enhances the customer shopping experience.
Amazon is a customer-obsessed business, so no matter which retail category you join, part of your role will involve working backwards from the customer to identify what matters most. You'll gain exposure to Amazon's advertising products and merchant services, learn how we create custom opportunities to delight clients, and partner across functions to deliver results — building your analytical, commercial, and problem-solving skills in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.
Note: You must have the right to work in the country of employment by the start date.


About the team
Intern Community:
As an Amazon Intern, you'll be part of a dynamic, supportive community that empowers your growth and development. You'll collaborate with interns from around the world, networking and participating in social events to broaden your perspectives. You can also join specialized groups focused on areas like sustainability to explore your diverse interests.

Support:
The internship program provides a robust support system, including weekly intern office hours, dedicated IT and HR support, and a program team committed to your success. This ensures you have the guidance and assistance needed to thrive.

Learning Sessions:
Exclusive learning sessions will further enhance your skills, granting you access to Amazon's industry-leading learning platforms and the expertise of industry leaders. These structured development opportunities will prepare you for the next step in your career.

Opportunities:
Upon successful completion of the internship, you may be considered for a graduate role or a second internship, allowing you to continue your journey with Amazon. Additionally, you'll enjoy a competitive monthly salary, relocation support, and access to a range of employee benefits.

Basic qualifications

- Currently enrolled in a Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree with a graduation date of Q1 2027 or a recent 2026 graduate (within the last 6 months)
- Fluent written and verbal communication in English
- Available to complete a full time 12 month internship full time.

Preferred qualifications

- Preferred qualifications are not required to apply for a position at Amazon. If you have all the basic qualifications above, we’d love to hear from you.

Amazon is an equal opportunities employer, and we value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build. We welcome applications from all members of society irrespective of age, sex, disability, sexual orientation, race, religion or belief. Amazon is strongly committed to diversity within its community and especially welcomes applications from South African citizens who are members of designated groups who may contribute to Employment Equity within the workplace and the further diversification of ideas. In this regard, the relevant laws and principles associated with Employment Equity will be considered when appointing potential candidates. title: Partner Growth Manager, Prime Video, Device & AI Partnerships
descriptionHtml:
Amazon is seeking a talented, highly motivated, and experienced individual to join Prime Video's global Device & AI Partnerships (D&AIP) team as Partner Growth Manager. This role is responsible for owning the end-to-end growth strategy for assigned third-party distribution partnerships — including partner performance and intelligence, partnership roadmap development, out-of-app (OOA) integration prioritization, and cross-functional orchestration across the Trio (Business Development, Technical Program Management, and Partner Growth Management). You will serve as the single point of accountability for ensuring partnership roadmaps are established, maintained, and aligned across stakeholders, and that growth initiatives are grounded in data and move forward with clarity and purpose.

As a Partner Growth Manager, you will drive OOA UI integration opportunities (acquisition placements, engagement surfaces, search-based ingress points, out-of-the-box experiences), synthesize inputs from across the Trio to align on sequencing and priorities, and own the lifecycle of external business reviews and partner-facing engagements. You will also manage partner marketing initiatives — including always-on programs and premium campaigns — as one dimension of a broader growth mandate. Your goals will be to maximize output metrics (starts, acquisition, engagement, and hours), build scalable processes for roadmap planning and execution, and establish trusted, strategic relationships with OEM partners globally.

This position offers an unparalleled opportunity to leverage your strategic, analytical, and cross-functional leadership skills inside one of the world's leading technology companies while experiencing the excitement of the streaming media industry. This is a highly visible role that interacts at all levels of the company and requires the ability to operate at both the strategic level (identifying bold growth opportunities, driving Trio alignment) and the tactical level (managing initiative execution, analyzing performance data, and solving problems).

Key job responsibilities

- Own partner performance and intelligence: Maintain deep expertise across all partner output metrics (starts, PPAC, hours, app opens, OOA ingress performance) and serve as the single source of truth on partner health for the Trio and broader stakeholders — enabling data-grounded prioritization across all workstreams.

- Drive partnership roadmap and OOA integration priorities: Identify, evaluate, and advance out-of-app UI integration opportunities (new placements, OOBE, Account Linking, Autoplay, co-mingled Continue Watching, search-based placements) by synthesizing BD and TPM inputs to align on sequencing, timing, and partner appetite.

- Lead external partner engagements: Own the full lifecycle of business reviews — planning, content development, facilitation, and follow-through — and maintain ongoing partner communication that is data-rich, forward-looking, and drives clear next steps.

- Develop insight-driven, partner-facing narratives that articulate the mutual value of partnering with Prime Video, grounded in performance data and product opportunity.

- Orchestrate cross-functional alignment across the Trio: Ensure prioritization decisions are made, initiatives are resourced and sequenced, and ownership is clear — reducing ambiguity and keeping roadmap execution on track.

- Coordinate with Product teams (DPTX, GTM): Serve as the primary intake point for product roadmap pitches to partners, evaluating product-market fit and timing to determine what gets prioritized within the partnership roadmap.

- Manage partner marketing programs: Design and execute always-on and campaign-based marketing initiatives that leverage partner channels to drive awareness, acquisition, and engagement in coordination with internal marketing and regional stakeholders.

- Collaborate closely with Business Development to align on shared priorities during and outside deal cycles, ensuring roadmap coherence across all active workstreams.

Basic qualifications

- Experience in business development, partnership management, or sourcing new business
- Experience managing and measuring marketing performance in various channels
- Experience working with global cross-functional teams

- Fluency in Spanish, Portuguese and English (written and verbal)
- Proficiency with site merchandising tools and campaign management platforms

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in streaming media, entertainment, or digital content distribution
- Experience working with device OEMs, telcos, or platform partnerships Familiarity with the LATAM digital media landscape
- Familiarity with the LATAM digital media landscape
- Demonstrated ability to adapt programs across markets with different maturity levels

title: Product Designer, Design Systems, Amazon Music
descriptionHtml:
The Amazon Music Design Systems team builds the foundation every Amazon Music experience is made from: the Figma libraries, design tokens, icons, and components that product designers and engineers use across iOS, Android, and web. As we continue to grow, we are looking for a talented and passionate Product Designer to help build and evolve that foundation. Our ideal candidate cares about craft and consistency, enjoys making tools that other designers depend on, and wants to see their work show up in every surface of the Amazon Music app.

Key job responsibilities
- Design, build, and maintain components in our Figma libraries, including variants, component properties, auto layout, and variables, structured so they translate cleanly into code.
- Keep the libraries healthy: publish updates, manage versioning and deprecation, and keep files organized and consistent.
- Produce component specifications and development-ready handoff, partnering with engineers through implementation and review.
- Design and expand our icon set on a consistent grid and keyline system, and produce logos, app icons, and illustrations that fit the visual language.
- Help define and document an illustration style and usage guidance.
- Write documentation and usage guidance that helps product designers and engineers use the system correctly.
- Partner with product designers to apply the system to real features, audit designs for system use, and identify gaps the system should fill.
- Review contribution requests from other designers and help decide what belongs in the system.
- Prototype with the system to test new components and patterns before they ship.
- Collaborate with other designers in designing and documenting our patterns, and maintaining our pattern library.
- Collaborate on and present work to a range of stakeholders – designers, engineers, product managers, and design leadership.

A day in the life
As a Product Designer on this team, you'll spend your time on the parts of design that everyone else builds on. One day you might draw a set of new icons and refine them until they sit naturally alongside hundreds of existing ones. Another, you might add a variant to a component, update its specification, and pair with an engineer to get it ready for development. You'll review a feature designer's file to see where the system helps them and where it gets in their way, and turn what you learn into improvements. You'll work with front-end engineers who build our libraries into code across multiple platforms, so the decisions you make in Figma reach customers. To be successful you must be detail-oriented, systems-minded, and collaborative, with strong craft in both components and iconography and an ability to communicate your ideas clearly. Being a big music fan is a plus.

About the team
Amazon Music is an immersive audio entertainment service that deepens connections between fans, artists, and creators. From personalized music playlists to exclusive podcasts, concert livestreams to artist merch, Amazon Music is innovating at some of the most exciting intersections of music and culture. We offer experiences that serve all listeners across different tiers of service.

The Design Systems team owns Amazon Music's design systems: the Figma libraries, design tokens, icons, and component libraries used to build Amazon Music across iOS, Android, and web, along with the documentation and tooling that support them. We're a small team of designers, and front-end engineers working across Seattle, San Francisco, Los Angeles, and Mexico City. Join us for the opportunity to shape how Amazon Music looks and feels on a global scale.

Basic qualifications

- 2+ years of design experience
- Experience designing and prototyping with tools such as Figma, Adobe Creative Cloud, or similar
- Experience working in a collaborative team environment to deliver high-quality design solutions
- Have an available online portfolio that includes design systems work, such as a component with its states and variants, or an icon set and how it was constructed
- Experience building components in Figma using variants, component properties, auto layout, and variables

Preferred qualifications

- Experience contributing to or maintaining a published Figma library used by other designers
- Experience with design tokens and variable modes, such as light, dark, and brand themes
- Experience designing icon sets at scale, including grids, keylines, optical sizing, and consistency across a large set
- Experience designing for iOS, Android, and web within a single system
- Knowledge of accessibility fundamentals, including color contrast, touch target sizing, and focus states
- Experience working directly with developers on implementation, including Figma Dev Mode, Code Connect, or design-to-code handoff
- Experience writing clear component documentation and usage guidance
- Curiosity about AI-assisted design and prototyping workflows
