Amazon is seeking a strategic and solution-focused Human Resources Business Partner (HRBP) to power the trajectory of our business by ensuring we have the right talent mix, leadership, and capabilities to innovate and deliver exceptional customer and Team Member experiences. As an HRBP, you will serve as a leader of people and organizational strategy — accelerating business outcomes through diagnosis, development, and execution of integrated solutions.

You will build trusted relationships with leaders and act as the client face of TMS (Team Member Services), interfacing and liaising with Recruiting, Team Member / Team Leader Development, Compensation, Benefits, HRIS, and the Legal organization. You will coach, act as a change agent, and influence critical decisions around talent and organizational design to drive business results while ensuring compliance with corporate policies, government regulations, and statutory requirements.

This role requires travel up to 25% of the time.


Key job responsibilities
Organizational Effectiveness

-Leverage deep knowledge of the business — including P&L, retail operations, and the competitive grocery/retail landscape — to tailor people-focused solutions that drive business outcomes

-Interpret key people metrics and trends, utilizing mechanisms to inspect, monitor, and proactively mitigate organizational risks

-Design, recommend, and implement effective organizational structures that align with business strategy, strengthen culture, and enable inclusive decision-making

-Partner with leaders to build customer-centric, Team Member–focused organizations that foster agility and empower frontline decision-making

-Ensure dynamic assessment of organizational capability — strengths, weaknesses, and opportunities — on a forward-looking basis

-Recommend new approaches, policies, and procedures to drive continual improvement in TMS service delivery

Leader and Leadership Team Effectiveness

-Assess both long-term and immediate leader talent needs to achieve business goals

-Develop strategies to build required leader skills and establish inclusive talent pipelines

-Coach and advise individual leaders and leadership teams on improving management abilities, addressing business challenges, and strengthening culture

-Challenge leaders when necessary to break mental models on ways of working, biases, structure, and talent decisions

-Reinforce difficult decisions that align with organizational strategies and values

Change Management

-Use listening mechanisms to identify trends, risks, and hotspots to inform change plans and maximize both customer and Team Member experience

-Drive effective change environments by leveraging multiple perspectives and inclusive communication strategies

Influence and coach leaders as they build their teams' ability to navigate organizational changes

Monitor and evaluate implemented changes to assess effectiveness and durability

Talent Planning & Workforce Strategy

Build long-term, inclusive workforce plans aligned with business objectives; proactively identify current and anticipated workforce capability gaps and develop strategies to close them

-Coach and support leaders in executing workforce plans and making resource-allocation decisions

-Anticipate industry trends and talent needs, determining gaps in current and future capabilities

-Create talent goals and cadence with the Leadership Team, building inclusive talent mechanisms into the organization's rhythm of business

Team Member Relations & Compliance

-Consult with and advise organizational leaders and Team Members on TM relations and related issues within assigned client groups

-Provide sound policy interpretations and practice decisions; ensure adherence to company policies and applicable federal, state, and local regulations (including FMLA, ADA, HIPAA, and Leaves of Absence)

-Provide assigned client teams and leaders with training, coaching, and guidance to maintain compliance

-Serve as a neutral, approachable TMS professional who recognizes and proactively resolves potential people and organizational issues — escalating as appropriate

A day in the life
This is an in-person role. You’ll be on-site in our stores four days per week, working shoulder-to-shoulder with the leaders and Team Members you support — walking the floor and being a familiar, trusted face, not working from behind a desk or screen.
This role requires balancing strategic thinking with hands-on execution. You will partner with business leaders to develop HR solutions aligned with business objectives, support organizational design initiatives, drive talent strategies, and create mechanisms to assess organizational health. You must be comfortable dealing with ambiguity while building structured approaches to drive successful and equitable outcomes.
The HRBP serves as a trusted advisor and member of the business leadership team — expected to bring perspectives on the intersections of people strategy and business performance. You will engage as a subject matter expert on TMS-related topics and model a commitment to customer service, Team Member well-being, and the values that set our organization apart.
The best HRBPs in our stores are the ones leaders and Team Members know by name — approachable in the aisle and the break room, not just in meetings. Strategy matters, but only when it’s grounded in real understanding of the people doing the work every day.

title: Data Center Infrastructure Delivery Manager
descriptionHtml:
Transform the backbone of digital infrastructure by leading a dynamic team that builds and maintains the critical networks powering global technology. In this role, you'll drive operational excellence, optimize data center deployment strategies, and create seamless connectivity solutions that support Amazon's massive technological ecosystem.
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we're the people who keep the clouds running. We support all AWS data centers and all the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we're looking for talented people who want to help.
You'll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You'll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you'll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
Effective May 15, 2017, logical access to the AWS GovCloud region will be restricted to Amazon employees who are U.S. Citizens. (GovCloud may NOT be accessed from outside of the United States)

Key job responsibilities
The ideal candidate will possess a technology background that enables them to understand the complexities of the sophisticated network architecture of Amazon data centers. To be a qualified candidate for this role you must have experience operating in large-scale data center or a background in telecom networks and display a demonstrated ability to think broadly and strategically, as this is needed to align the future of Infrastructure Delivery with the larger objectives of the business.
You will be responsible for managing a group of technicians who are installing and building server rack capacity for our customers. You must be passionate about Customer Experience, think and act globally and want to contribute to innovations in Data Center Infrastructure.
Managing and developing teams of technicians and engineers, providing both technical and leadership expertise and ensuring the highest levels of performance.

Constantly improving all our processes and procedures. We believe there is nothing we cannot improve

This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.

Essential Requirements
Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed
Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational

title: Sr Program Manager, AI & Data, Global Corporate Communications
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Global Corporate Communications (GCC) is looking for a Senior Program Manager to lead the data and AI systems that GCC's teams rely on. You'll build the shared foundation beneath GCC's work: making its data usable by AI, delivering the AI systems on top of it, and connecting the work across GCC and its partners.

Today, a lot of GCC's most valuable data is scattered. Research, media coverage, agency reporting, processes, and planning documents live in different places and formats, with different access. That makes it hard for teams to bring it together, and hard for AI to do anything with it. You'll connect those sources, structure them so AI can actually retrieve and reason over the content, and design tools on top of them. The teams who produce the data still own it. Everyone here is a builder, and your job is to support that.

No two months in this role look the same. The data keeps growing, the tools keep changing, and there's always a new challenge worth taking on. It's a great fit for someone who likes to work independently, dig into complex problems, and see their work make a difference across a team.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer (Model Customization and Optimization), AWS Forward Deployed Engineering
locations: East Palo Alto, CA, United States
descriptionHtml:
As a Forward Deployed Engineer II (FDE II) on the Custom Model and Optimization team, you embed directly with strategic customers to build, optimize, and run custom generative AI models in production alongside their engineering teams. You own complete model workstreams end-to-end from defining the evaluation bar and preparing data, through training and inference optimization, to production deployment.

FDE IIs on this team works at the intersection of models and systems. They customize state-of-the-art open-weight and foundation models for new domains, languages, and modalities; migrate and optimize training and inference workloads on AWS Trainium and operate those models as production services. They are autonomous contributors who take on projects where the business goal is clear, but the path is not. They make design trade-offs with appropriate guidance, limit short-term workarounds, coach others on producing high-quality code, and train new team members.

Key job responsibilities
Embed within customer ML and engineering teams: Understand the customer's business, data, model stack, and operational constraints. Translate ambiguous goals into a measurable evaluation bar and a technical plan for your workstream such as model selection, customization approach, and serving architecture. Requires up to 25% travel.

Customize and post-train models. Adapt open-weight and foundation models to customer domains through continued pre-training, supervised fine-tuning, preference optimization, and reinforcement learning (including RLHF, RL with verifiable rewards, and multi-turn agentic RL). Build the data pipelines, synthetic data generation, and evaluation harnesses that prove a customized model out performs the baseline on the customer's own quality, latency, and cost bar. Apply these techniques to high-value patterns such as coding agents, domain foundation models, and multi-adapter serving.

Build large-scale training and inference systems. Design and implement distributed training and RL post-training pipelines using frameworks such as PyTorch FSDP2, Megatron-LM, Miles, and verl. Build RL interaction harnesses using NeMo Gym or OpenEnv to connect agent workflows, tools, environments, and reward functions to training. Develop production inference stacks with engines such as SGLang and vLLM, and optimize throughput, latency, memory footprint, and cost per token through quantization, parallelism, speculative decoding, and batching.

Optimize models on AWS chips. Migrate and tune training and inference workloads for AWS Trainium using the AWS Neuron SDK. Profile performance, close accuracy-parity gaps against GPU baselines, and develop custom kernels where needed. Benchmark rigorously and turn results into decisions customers can act on.

Accelerate impact beyond the engagement. Codify reusable fine-tuning recipes, evaluation frameworks, benchmarking tools, and optimization patterns that accelerate future deployments. Feed field learnings back to AWS service teams, including Amazon Bedrock, Amazon SageMaker AI, and AWS Neuron. Identify opportunities to expand model customization and optimization within your customer engagement.


About the team
The Custom Model and Optimization team, part of the Forward Deployed Engineering team partners with enterprises, AI-native startups, and foundation model providers to build, customize, and optimize generative AI models at scale. Our work spans domain foundation models, post-training of open-weight models, and moving training and inference workloads onto AWS Trainium. As embedded engineers within the AWS Forward Deployed Engineering motion, we bring deep model and optimization expertise to customers' most strategic AI workloads, and we turn what we learn into tooling and patterns that scale across AWS.

title: Senior Software Development Engineer, IMDb Discovery Services
descriptionHtml:
Design and build the search, ranking, and list systems behind IMDb - the platform hundreds of millions of people use to find movies, shows, and talent. As a senior engineer, you'll own the architecture for core areas of discovery and lead the work to turn these systems into an AI-powered discovery engine built on IMDb's structured data: titles, people, credits, and the relationships between them.

- Own distributed services handling billions of requests across imdb.com, amazon.com, and partner channels
- Lead development and strategy of key system features on IMDb's Discovery platforms, driving intent-based search and AI/ML-powered ranking
- Set engineering standards, mentor engineers, and own your services end to end in production

IMDb is the world's most popular source for information on movies, TV shows, and celebrities. IMDb Discovery Services builds the search, list, and ranking platform that helps hundreds of millions of customers find, explore, and connect with the titles and talent they care about. We own real-time suggestion search across imdb.com, amazon.com, and affiliated domains; main and advanced search; charts and discovery widgets; the user list platform; and the ranking systems behind STARmeter, MOVIEmeter, and TVmeter. These services handle billions of requests and sit at the heart of the IMDb experience, powering IMDb Consumer, IMDbPro, and a growing set of partner and AI-assistant channels.

We're evolving this platform into an AI-native discovery engine: intelligent retrieval that understands intent, lists that surface as a discovery experience rather than personal storage, and self-service integration so downstream teams onboard through typed SDKs and versioned contracts. Our search stack is built on AWS OpenSearch Service, and relevance, latency, and scale are first-class engineering concerns. Every generative and agentic experience is grounded in IMDb's structured entity graph of titles, names, credits, and verified relationships — data no competitor has at this depth.

As a Senior Software Development Engineer (SDE) on this team, you'll own architecture for one or more of these areas, lead multi-engineer efforts where the customer problem is clear but the technical strategy is not, and set the engineering standard others build to. The work sits at the intersection of large-scale distributed systems, information retrieval and machine learning, and a uniquely valuable data set.


Key job responsibilities
- Lead the development and technical strategy of key system features for IMDb's search platform on AWS OpenSearch Service - index design, relevance tuning, query performance, and scaling.
- Own the architecture for a significant area of the discovery platform (search/retrieval, ranking, or the list platform), providing a system-wide view and design guidance across the team.
- Lead the design and delivery of complex, multi-engineer projects end to end - scoping, design, implementation, testing, deployment, and operations - breaking work into parallel streams and integrating it into a coherent whole.
- Build intelligent retrieval and ML-powered ranking, plus platform capabilities (API contracts, versioned SLOs, typed SDKs) for downstream and AI-agent consumers.
- Raise the operational bar: own alarms, telemetry, runbooks, and COE practices, balancing velocity against reliability on the critical path.
- Review designs and code across the team to ensure solutions are well-designed, extensible, performant, and secure; drive adoption of engineering best practices.
- Identify and resolve architecture deficiencies and systemic operational issues, including those where the platform bottlenecks other teams' innovation.
- Mentor engineers and partner with product and program management to shape the discovery roadmap.
- Contribute to AI-native platform practices - steering files, structured knowledge, and agent-readable interfaces for your codebases.

A day in the life
You might open the day reviewing a ranking-signal design and a teammate's pull request, then spend the morning on a thorny retrieval problem - tuning OpenSearch analyzers and query structure so intent resolves against the entity graph. After lunch you meet a partner team onboarding to your search SDK and refine the contract, then write code on the critical path. You close by triaging a signal from the suggestion-search pipeline and updating a runbook. The role moves between deep engineering, design leadership, and operational ownership - often in the same day.

About the team
We own four areas: (1) search and retrieval across IMDb, amazon.com, and affiliated domains; (2) the list platform, growing into a discovery surface with ranking, tagging, and social features; (3) trust - correctness, moderation, and multi-region reliability to published SLOs; and (4) a self-service platform layer that product teams integrate without manual support. Consumers include IMDb Consumer, IMDbPro, and partner and AI-assistant channels. We're building these systems into an AI-native discovery engine grounded in IMDb's structured entity graph - titles, names, credits, and verified relationships no competitor has at this depth.

Basic qualifications

- 6+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 6+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience
- 6+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team

Preferred qualifications

- 6+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
- Experience building search, discovery, ranking, recommendation, or information retrieval systems at scale
- Hands-on experience with AWS OpenSearch Service, Elasticsearch, or similar search technologies, including index design, mappings, analyzers, query optimization, relevance tuning, sharding, and cluster performance
- Experience with GraphQL, REST APIs, or similar API technologies, and building platform/self-service integration paths (typed SDKs, versioned contracts)

title: Senior Transportation Quality Manager, ROC Quality Management
descriptionHtml:
ポジション概要 Position Overview
本ポジションは、新しいビジネスや特殊輸送が生み出す、前例のないミドルマイル（拠点間輸送）の配送品質課題を担うプログラムマネージャーの役割です。新規・特殊輸送で発生する輸送貨物の遅延に対し、品質を守る手法を自ら設計・実行し、プログラムとして確立していきます。確立された品質管理の方法論を土台にしつつも、その枠に捉われず、新しい輸送形態に適したミドルマイル品質マネジメントの手法をゼロから構築します。

This is a program manager role that owns the unprecedented Middle Mile (inter-facility transportation) delivery-quality challenges created by new businesses and special transportation. You will design and execute methods to protect quality against the transportation delays arising from new and special transportation, and establish them as a program. Building on established quality-management methodologies - but not bound by them - you will create, from the ground up, Middle Mile quality-management methods suited to new transportation modes.

チーム概要 Team overview
JP ATS ROC - Quality Management (QM) は、Middle Mile（拠点間輸送）における配送品質を守る ROC（Relay Operations Center）内のチームです。我々のミッションは「お客様への約束（Promise：配送予定日）を守り抜く」こと。確立された方法論を持つ一方で、新しいビジネスや特殊輸送といった前例のない領域にも果敢に挑み、既存の枠に捉われずに品質マネジメントの手法を進化させ続けています。データとメトリクスを基盤に、オペレーション・輸送・リーダーシップをつなぐハブとして機能します。


JP ATS ROC - Quality Management (QM) is the team within the ROC (Relay Operations Center) that safeguards delivery quality across the Middle Mile (inter-facility transportation). Our mission is to keep the Promise (promised delivery date) we make to customers. While we hold established methodologies, we also boldly take on uncharted areas such as new businesses and special transportation, continuously evolving our quality-management methods beyond conventional frames. Grounded in data and metrics, we serve as the hub connecting Operations, Transportation, and Leadership.

職務内容 Job Description
担当は、新しいビジネス・特殊輸送で発生するミドルマイルの輸送遅延・品質課題です。これらの原因を分析し、既存の品質管理手法が通用するか否かを見極めたうえで、必要に応じて新しい輸送形態に適した方法論を構築・実行します。Transportation / Capacity Planning や FC / Sort Center / Delivery Station のオペレーションと連携し、現場実態に即した実行可能なプログラムへと落とし込みます。あわせて、配送予定日の精度の維持・改善や、対応プロセスの標準化・プログラム化を推進し、再現性とスケーラビリティを確保します。


You will own the Middle Mile transportation delays and quality issues arising from new businesses and special transportation. You will analyze their root causes, assess whether existing quality-management methods apply, and - where needed - build and execute methodologies suited to new transportation modes. Partnering with Transportation / Capacity Planning and FC / Sort Center / Delivery Station operations, you will translate these into executable programs grounded in on-the-ground realities. You will also drive the maintenance and improvement of delivery-date accuracy and the standardization and productization of the response process to ensure repeatability and scalability.

本ポジションの魅力 Why This Role Is Attractive
- 前例のない領域で、ミドルマイル品質の方法論を自ら設計・確立できるオーナーシップとやりがい

- 既存の手法を活用しつつ、新規・特殊輸送に最適化した新しいアプローチを構築できる大きな裁量

- リーダーシップ／経営層と直接連携し、戦略を全国規模の成果に変える影響力

- 成長領域を担うことで得られる、高い可視性とキャリア拡大の機会

- 配属直後ではないものの、将来的にはPeople Managerとしてチームを率いるキャリアパス


- The ownership and reward of designing and establishing Middle Mile quality methodologies in uncharted territory

- Significant latitude to leverage existing methods while building new approaches optimized for new and special transportation

- Direct influence with leadership, turning strategy into nationwide results

- High visibility and strong opportunities to expand your career by owning a growth area

- A career path toward leading a team as a People Manager in the future (not immediately upon joining)


At Amazon, you'll work alongside the latest AI and GenAI tools that are increasingly woven into how teams operate: from AI-powered capabilities that accelerate decision-making, to Generative AI that helps you focus on work that truly matters. You'll have opportunities and resources to develop AI fluency at your own pace, with continuous learning built into the culture.




Key job responsibilities
- 新しいビジネス・特殊輸送で発生するミドルマイルの輸送遅延・品質課題を担当し、その原因分析と改善をリードする

- 確立された品質管理の方法論を活用しつつ、その枠に捉われず、新しい輸送形態に適したミドルマイル品質マネジメントの手法を構築・実行する

- 配送予定日の精度（納期遵守）の維持・改善をリードする

- Transportation / Capacity Planning と連携し、輸送キャパシティの制約を踏まえた品質・配送予定日の設計を行う

- FC / Sort Center / Delivery Station のオペレーションと連携し、現場実態に即した実行可能なプログラムを展開する

- 対応プロセスを標準化・プログラム化し、再現性とスケーラビリティを確保する

- リーダーシップ／経営層に対し、戦略・進捗・成果をデータに基づき明確にコミュニケーションする

(English)
- Own the Middle Mile transportation delays and quality issues arising from new businesses and special transportation, and lead their root-cause analysis and improvement

- Leverage established quality-management methodologies while, unbound by their conventional frame, building and executing Middle Mile quality-management methods suited to new transportation modes

- Lead the maintenance and improvement of delivery-date accuracy (on-time delivery)

- Partner with Transportation / Capacity Planning to design quality and promised-delivery-date logic that reflects transportation capacity constraints

- Work with FC / Sort Center / Delivery Station operations to deploy executable programs grounded in on-the-ground realities

- Standardize and productize the response process to ensure repeatability and scalability

- Communicate strategy, progress, and results clearly and with data to leadership

A day in the life
1日の流れ
午前中は、各種メトリクスをもとにした分析業務が中心です。担当するミドルマイルの輸送遅延・品質課題の動向をデータから読み解き、課題の所在や改善の仮説を整理します。午後は、その分析結果をもとに関係者との協議・連携を行い、現場で実行可能な打ち手へと落とし込みます。
また、月に1回程度は実際の現場に足を運び、見学・観察を通じて得られたインサイトから品質向上の糸口を探ります。データ上では見えにくい実態を把握し、データと実オペレーションを紐づけることで、より精度の高い課題解決につなげます。

Mornings center on analysis work driven by various metrics. You read the trends of the Middle Mile transportation delays and quality issues you own from the data, and organize where the problems lie and your hypotheses for improvement. In the afternoon, based on those analyses, you hold discussions and collaborate with stakeholders - such as Transportation / Capacity Planning and FC / Sort Center / Delivery Station operations - to translate them into actions that can be executed on the ground.

In addition, roughly once a month you visit actual sites, seeking clues for quality improvement from the insights gained through observation and firsthand study. By grasping the realities that are hard to see in the data alone and connecting data with actual operations, you drive more accurate problem-solving.

フレックスタイム制 Flex time
コアタイム無し・実働8時間/日となりますが、業務時間帯はマネージャーと相談の上、業務および個人の都合に応じて勤務時間帯の調整ができ、ワークライフハーモニーを重視した働き方が可能です。 No core hours, with 8 working hours per day. Working hours can be adjusted in consultation with your manager based on business needs and personal circumstances, enabling a work style that prioritizes work-life harmony.


働き方 Work Style
原則：週5日東京へ出社 Standard: 5 days per week in the Tokyo office.


勤務地 Work Location
東京（東京都品川区） Tokyo (Shinagawa-ku, Tokyo)

Basic qualifications

- プログラムマネジメントまたはプロジェクトマネジメントの経験5年以上
- データとメトリクスを用いて改善を特定・推進した経験

Preferred qualifications

title: Senior Delivery Consultant - Customer Experience, Technology and Industries
descriptionHtml:
AWS Professional Services (ProServe) is looking for a hands-on Senior Delivery Consultant with deep contact centre domain expertise and a passion for delivering transformational customer experience outcomes. In this role, you will lead engagements or major workstreams within larger CX transformation programs for APJC customers, taking technical ownership of solution design, delivery execution, and customer outcomes.

You will bring deep practitioner experience across contact centre operations, workforce management (WFM), quality management (QM), and omnichannel customer engagement. You will combine this domain expertise with strong technical skills in Amazon Connect, conversational AI, and cloud-native architectures to design and deliver solutions that modernise how customers operate their contact centres, manage their workforce, and serve their end customers.

You will work directly with customer stakeholders including contact centre managers, operations leads, IT architects, and business owners to translate operational requirements into well-architected solutions. You will lead discovery workshops, define solution architectures, build and configure platforms, establish success metrics, and coach customer and partner teams toward self-sufficiency.

This is a customer-facing role based in Singapore. The role spans the APJC region and you will be required to travel to customer sites 50% or more of the time. You will work alongside AWS technology experts and have access to AWS's breadth of CX, AI, and Cloud services (including Amazon Connect, Amazon Lex, Amazon Bedrock, and generative AI capabilities) to deliver solutions that drive measurable business outcomes.

Key job responsibilities
- Lead end-to-end delivery of CX engagements or major workstreams within larger transformation programs, taking ownership of scope, quality, timeline, and customer outcomes

- Architect and deliver contact centre solutions incorporating Amazon Connect, conversational AI (Amazon Lex, Bedrock), workforce management, quality management, and CRM integrations

- Lead customer discovery and envisioning workshops to understand operational challenges, define transformation objectives, and shape solution roadmaps

- Design and implement intelligent automation including AI-powered agents, natural language understanding (NLU), sentiment analysis, and agent assist capabilities

- Define and track success metrics and KPIs for engagements (e.g., first-contact resolution, average handle time, customer satisfaction, agent productivity, cost-to-serve)

- Create and maintain solution design documents, technical architecture diagrams, integration specifications, implementation runbooks, and operational handover documentation

- Guide product owners and business stakeholders in breaking down complex requirements into epics and user stories, prioritising features, and defining MVP scope and release plans

- Provide strategic guidance on contact centre best practices, process optimisation, organisational change management, and adoption enablement

- Coach and mentor customer teams, partner consultants, and junior AWS consultants to build capability and self-sufficiency

- Collaborate with AWS field sales, pre-sales, and product teams, contributing customer insights and feedback to inform product roadmaps

About the team
Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job below, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn't followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don't let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world's most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating; that's why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it's in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship and Career Growth
We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there's nothing we can't achieve in the cloud.

Basic qualifications

- 7+ years of technical specialist, design and architecture experience
- 5+ years of software development with object oriented language experience
- 7+ years of external or internal customer facing, complex and large scale project management experience
- Deep domain expertise in contact centre operations including workforce management (WFM), quality management (QM), routing design, IVR/IVA, and omnichannel engagement

Preferred qualifications

- Experience working within teams delivering software products and features using agile methodologies
- Hands-on experience with Amazon Connect, including configuration, customisation, and deployment at enterprise scale
- Experience with AI/ML technologies in contact centre applications, including natural language understanding (NLU), conversational AI, chatbot development (Amazon Lex), prompt engineering, and large language model implementation (Amazon Bedrock)
- Experience with CRM and WFM platform integrations (e.g., Salesforce, ServiceNow, NICE, Verint, Calabrio)

title: シフトアシスタント
descriptionHtml:
※このポジションの勤務地は東京都葛飾区を予定しています。
入社後、数カ月間は他の事業所でトレーニング（出張ベース）をしていただく予定です。

私たちのグローバルオペレーションネットワークは、日々何百万もの荷物と笑顔をアマゾンのお客様にお届けしています。私たちは、シフトアシスタントとして私たちのチームに加わってほしいと考え、意欲的で顧客重視の人材を探しています。この役割では他業種・職種も含めこれまでの経験、スキルを活かし、改善点を模索しながら、より便利でお客様に満足いただける高い品質のサービスを提供できるビジネスをつくる事、安全・快適・楽しい職場環境の構築を行う、将来の組織のリーダーを目指していただける事を期待しています。また、お客様の注文が適切な時間に適切な場所へ確実に配送されるよう、お客様の期待に応えることにおいても重要な役割を担います。

私たちの業務の流れには3つの主要な要素があります。
商品が保管され注文に備える「ファーストマイル」、注文品をお客様のエリアまで輸送する「ミドルマイル」、そして商品をお客様の玄関先までお届けする「ラストマイル」です。各拠点で運営方法に若干の違いはありますが、一貫して変わらないものが一つあります、それは顧客を第一に考える私たちのビジョンと献身的な姿勢です。

本ポジションはアマゾンの新しいエキサイティングな配送拠点で業務を行います。可能な限り最速でお客様のご自宅に商
品をお届けすることでお客様のカスタマーエクスペリエンスを向上します。私たちと一緒に歴史をつくりましょう！


■業務内容■
具体的にはマネージャーのサポートのもと、以下の業務に責任をもち遂行いただきます。

① 安全・品質・作業効率の向上
安全安心な作業環境の維持・向上のため、日々の安全活動、品質チェックに加え、標準作業手順書の作成や多岐にわたる問題解決・改善活動を行います。

② 日々のオペレーション対応
商品を入荷、在庫として管理し、注文があった商品を出荷するという一連の流れを各工程間で連携をとりながら、業務を円滑に進める事が求められます。お客様とお約束した期日までに商品を迅速かつ正確にお届けするため、時間ごとの計画に沿ってオペレーションを実施することに責任を持ちます。

③ 新規プロジェクトの導入・セール時など、オペレーション拡大時の準備
新しいサービスやシステムの導入に備え、現場での手順変更・導入方法を検討し円滑な導入に向けて準備を行います。また、新規入職者でもAmazonの標準作業に則った手順がスムーズに身につくためのトレーニング構築やマニュアルを作成します。

④ イレギュラーへの対応
作業で発生する様々な課題の原因を追求し問題解決を行います。また、再発防止策案の検討、実施を行います。
※上記業務はマネージャーやチームのサポートのもと実施していただきます
※配送ステーション内での配送を通じて、物流の仕組みやマネジメントについて学ぶことができます
※社内公募により、マネージャーへのキャリアアップや他部署への異動機会もあります
※勤務は交代制（夜勤あり）です
※1日の流れ：以下ページをご参照ください。
先輩社員インタビュー

■福利厚生■
下記ページをご確認ください。
福利厚生 | アマゾンジャパンキャリアサイト

■教育制度■
入社後、約1週間はAmazonのリーダーとして必要な会社のカルチャーや、配送拠点の基本的な業務を一通り学ぶことができる座学の機会を提供します。各部署へ配属後は、トレーナーのもと、OJTで工程知識やツールの使用方法など基礎知識を学んでいきます。トレーニング資料も完備しており、相互に進捗を確認しながら独り立ちまでしっかりとサポートしますので、未経験者も安心してスタートができる環境です。
最先端の物流システムを学ぶことはもちろん、年齢・性別・国籍問わず様々な仲間と日々の業務を通して、次のステップとなるピープルマネージメントやビジネススキルを学ぶことができます。

■キャリアパス■
シフトアシスタントからキャリアをスタートし、チームマネージャー、統括マネージャー、そして配送拠点の拠点長となった実績も多数あります。また、Amazonでは社内公募制度があり、国内外問わず他部署や異なる職種への異動にチャレンジし、社内で多様なキャリアを築くチャンスもあります。Amazonではご自身で学び成長することを推奨し、キャリア開発できるようサポートを行っています。
キャリアアップストーリー

■会社のカルチャー■
Amazonでは全員がリーダーです。個人の裁量に任される部分が多く、社員の個々の可能性を最大限に伸ばす事を重視しています。様々なバックグラウンドを持った社員が前職で培った多様な経験やスキルを活かして職位や役割に関わらず誰もがチャレンジできる環境です。
また年次有給休暇の取得を積極的に推進しており「働く」、「プライベート」も充実できる環境です。
失敗に寛容な文化：まずは試してみることにこだわります。好奇心を持って学びます。時にはリスクを取り、計画通りいかなかったとしても、よりよい成果に繋げられることが私たちの強みだと信じています。

最後に、募集しているポジションや組織、お仕事の詳細については以下のリンクよりご確認いただけます。

・職種：オペレーション

title: AHS Specialist - English & German, Account Health Support
descriptionHtml:
The Account Health Support team acts as the primary interface between Amazon and our third-party business partners (Sellers). We provide dedicated support to Sellers on the Amazon platform, predicting their needs proactively and delivering solutions that help them better serve customers.


Key job responsibilities
•You will support Selling Partners to resolve account health issues via phone and email, managing high volumes of inbound and outbound contacts with effective education, de-escalation and communication in every interaction.
•You will conduct thorough investigations to identify root causes of account health issues, including policy violations, enforcement actions, and appeals — providing clear, accurate solutions and redirecting difficult conversations with empathy and professionalism.
•You will serve as a dedicated contact for Sellers throughout their compliance journey, executing structured outreach plans including proactive contacts, follow-ups, and pre-enforcement outreach across applicable legislations.
•You will document all interactions according to standard operating procedures, managing cases through centralized mechanisms to ensure visibility, consistency, audit readiness, and high data integrity.
• You will collaborate with internal stakeholders, identify process improvements, flag policy gaps, and consistently achieve productivity and quality performance goals in a metric-driven environment


A day in the life
As an Account Health Support Specialist, you will serve as a dedicated point of contact for Amazon's Selling Partners, guiding them through their compliance journey. You will resolve account health issues, conduct investigations into policy violations, and execute proactive outreach to help Sellers maintain and regain compliant status across Amazon policies and EU regulations — including product compliance, sustainability, and general product safety (GPSR). AHS Specialists work across voice and written channels, supporting Sellers through account health issues, enforcement actions, and compliance journeys depending on role specialization.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in any field of study
- Experience in oral and written communication in English
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English and German (B2 or above)
- Ability to follow standard operating procedures (SOPs) and detailed documentation
- Experience using computer-based tools and systems to process or track work

Preferred qualifications

- Experience working in a fast-paced, rapidly changing operations environment
- Experience working in a contact center environment
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills, inspiring confidence while guiding customers through resolution steps via phone and email
- Demonstrated empathy and active listening skills
- Ability to deliver performance in a metric-driven environment with high productivity and quality standards
- Multitasking ability: handling phone, chat, and email contacts simultaneously
- Ability to troubleshoot, research, and translate technical or procedural instructions into clear guidance for customers
- Enthusiastic, self-motivated, and willing to learn new skills
- Demonstrated ability to identify and drive process improvements

title: Software Development Engineer, Amazon Regulatory and Trade Services (ARTS Tech)
descriptionHtml:
ARTS Tech is seeking an experienced Software Development Engineer to build services that make the cross-border movement of products, software, and technology secure, lawful, and seamless. You will design and operate scalable systems that support trade classification, import and export controls, product compliance, and global expansion. This role offers the opportunity to solve complex greenfield problems, work with emerging Amazon businesses, and deliver durable solutions used across Amazon's global footprint.

Key job responsibilities
- Design, implement, test, deploy, and operate scalable distributed services for cross-border trade and regulatory compliance.
- Translate ambiguous business and regulatory requirements into simple, maintainable technical solutions.
- Own the architecture and delivery of major features, including effort estimation and rollout planning.
- Build reliable, secure, and observable systems that meet performance and availability goals.
- Collaborate with product managers, compliance specialists, UX designers, and engineers across Amazon.
- Participate in code reviews, operational support, and continuous improvement.
- Mentor engineers and contribute to hiring and team development.

A day in the life
You will work with product, compliance, and engineering partners to clarify customer needs, review designs, and build services that operate at Amazon scale. A typical day may include writing and reviewing code, resolving production issues, making architecture decisions, and planning delivery with your Scrum team. title: Risk Manager, Customer Safety Insights & Investigations
descriptionHtml:
The Customer Safety Insights & Investigations (CS2I) team within RISC is looking for a Risk Investigator to lead high-judgment, high-impact investigations into potential product safety hazards. The cases you will handle are often time-sensitive, complex, and require coordination across multiple teams, including Legal, Policy, Operations, and regional safety partners.

You will review nuanced safety incidents, analyze evidence from multiple sources, and determine whether a product poses a meaningful risk to customers. Many of the escalations you will own are high visibility and may involve sensitive customer experiences, safety hazards, or potential liability exposure. Your work directly helps prevent recurrence of safety issues and strengthens customer trust in Amazon’s stores.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving intricate problems, thrives in ambiguity, and wants to play a key role in protecting customers at scale.


Key job responsibilities
Investigation & Case Leadership
- Own the end-to-end investigation of complex, urgent, and sensitive product safety escalations.
- Combine customer reports, product details, incident data, and expert guidance to determine what happened and what the appropriate action should be.
- Navigate ambiguity with high judgment, applying consistent logic while adapting to the nuances of each case.
- Document findings clearly and maintain audit-ready case files.

Deep Analytical Problem Solving
- Conduct thorough deep dives that uncover root causes, contributing factors, or early indicators of broader concerns.
- Synthesize evidence from multiple sources to reach accurate conclusions, even when data is incomplete.
- Identify patterns in cases that may warrant additional follow-up by partner teams.

Cross-Functional Collaboration
- Work closely with Legal, Product Compliance, Operations, and policy subject-matter experts to validate findings or gather additional perspective.
- Engage with international teams to ensure alignment on cases that span regions or require localized interpretation.
- Communicate concisely and professionally to drive timely resolution of high-impact cases.

Customer-Focused Decision-Making
- Apply sound judgment to recommend mitigations that prioritize customer safety.
- Ensure decisions follow Amazon’s policies and balance customer impact with business considerations.
- Move with speed and accuracy, especially during time-sensitive escalations.

Continuous Improvement & Ownership
- Identify opportunities to streamline investigation workflows while maintaining high quality.
- Share learnings with peers to improve team consistency and strengthen overall safety mechanisms.
- Demonstrate ownership by proactively closing gaps and anticipating next steps in complex investigations.

A day in the life
You begin by triaging urgent safety escalations from multiple regions. Throughout the day, you analyze images, review claims, read customer reports, and consult with Legal or Compliance SMEs when a case presents new nuances. You may work with investigators in other geographies to align on the interpretation of evidence. You complete several high-quality investigations, document your findings, and highlight insights that may inform broader safety discussions within the team.

About the team
CS2I investigates product safety concerns, interprets complex signals, and partners across Amazon to drive actions that protect customers. Our investigators handle some of the most sensitive and high-impact safety cases across Amazon’s global stores. We value curiosity, high judgment, clear communication, and a strong commitment to customer safety.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- 4+ years of compliance program management, legal, governance, audit, risk/loss prevention, or equivalent experience
- Experience handling confidential information
- Experience in data analysis and leveraging analytics to make decisions

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of program requirements definition and data and metrics leveraging to drive improvements experience
- Professional auditing qualification, or similar risk or compliance credentials
- Experience with SQL and Excel
- Experience prioritizing and handling multiple assignments at any given time while maintaining commitment to deadlines, or experience in a fast-paced, high-tech company

descriptionHtml:

descriptionHtml:

As a Sr. Partner Integration Manager, you will own the relationship with the retailer systems and third-party integrators. Sitting at the intersection of Business Development, Engineering, and our integrator community, you are the trusted technical advisor and two-way translator — shaping the right integration paths for new partners, keeping integrators ahead of API changes, and driving our documentation toward true self-service. This role requires deep understanding of retailer systems and independent judgment about what is operationally critical for a retailer. You must be technically fluent (able to read API specs, reason about data flows, and troubleshoot integrations), excel at navigating ambiguity, and thrive in an entrepreneurial environment, with excellent interpersonal skills. This role offers an exciting opportunity to shape the technical foundation of an emerging category on Amazon. Your insights from working directly with the integrator community will directly influence our APIs, documentation, and marketplace.

Key job responsibilities
1. Partner with the BD team to assess prospective retailer and platform partners’ systems architecture and define the right integration path with Amazon, bringing solutioning expertise into partner conversations.
2. Map IMS/DMS/platform capabilities to our APIs, surface constraints and dependencies early, and apply independent judgment on what is critical for operations (inventory accuracy, transaction flows, data fidelity) to steer integration design.
3. Work closely with Engineering to understand upcoming API updates, deprecations, and new capabilities before they ship.
4. Proactively communicate API changes to the integrator community with enough lead time and clarity for them to plan and execute their own updates.
5. Act as the first line of technical support for integrators — answering questions, troubleshooting integration issues, and escalating to Engineering when needed.
6. Drive the accuracy and currency of API documentation by coordinating with the internal owners of each API surface.
7. Feed real integrator questions and friction points back into the documentation to continuously push it toward true self-service and reduce question volume at the source.
8. Build and manage durable relationships across BD, Engineering, documentation owners, and the external integrator ecosystem, operating with influence.

A day in the life
As a Sr. Partner Integration Manager, you will work cross-functionally with Business Development, Engineering, and Product Management, while building and maintaining relationships with technical stakeholders across our external integrator community. One part of your day may be spent advising BD on a prospective partner’s integration path; another translating an upcoming API change into clear guidance for integrators; another troubleshooting a live integration issue and feeding what you learn back into the documentation. You will be instrumental in defining how integrators build on Amazon, providing valuable technical insights to product and engineering teams, and creating initiatives that scale integrator self-service. This role is based in London with occasional travel to meet with systems partners and integrators.

title: Junior Logistik/Shift Manager - Vienna
descriptionHtml:
Als Nachwuchsführungskraft wirst du in unserem 11-wöchigen internen Onboarding Programm auf deine neue Aufgabe als Führungskraft vorbereitet.
Nach dieser umfangreichen Einarbeitung übernimmst du Führungsverantwortung für dein eigenes Team und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Kunden Ihre Waren pünktlich und in guter Qualität erhalten. In dieser Position bist du wichtiger Teil unseres globalen Unternehmens und arbeitest Hand in Hand mit deinen Mitarbeitenden vor Ort. Zudem arbeitest du standortübergreifend an Themen wie Arbeitssicherheit, Prozessoptimierung, Nachhaltigkeit und technischem Fortschritt.

Key job responsibilities
- Sicherstellung der Einhaltung der Arbeitssicherheitsvorschriften und des Umweltschutzes
- Ableitung von Handlungsempfehlungen und konkreten Maßnahmen zur Prozessverbesserung auf Basis von Kennzahlen wie Arbeitssicherheit, Produktivität und Qualität
- Leitung und Weiterbildung eines Teams (bis zu 100 Mitarbeitende)
- Planung und Steuerung der innerbetrieblichen Prozesse
- Teilnahme in übergeordneten Projekten zur Optimierung der Kundenzufriedenheit
- Effektives Ressourcen- und Workflowmanagement
- Zusammenarbeit mit den vor- und nachgelagerten Abteilungen vor Ort

A day in the life
Du arbeitest in einer unserer Schichten (Früh-, Spät- oder Nachtschicht). Dabei ist das Einhalten der Sicherheitsstandards an deinem gesamten Standort für dich höchste Priorität. Als Schichtleitung führst du routinemäßig Teammeetings durch und führst Feedbackgespräche mit deinen Mitarbeitenden und deinen Stakeholdern. Mit Hilfe von Datenauswertungen nimmst Du Einfluss auf die Produktivität und die Qualität deines Standortes. Als wichtiges Mitglied des Teams vor Ort arbeitest Du mit anderen Abteilungen, sowie externen Stakeholdern zusammen und sorgst dafür, dass wir die Anforderungen unserer Kundschaft, ebenso wie unsere eigenen Vorgaben jederzeit erfüllen. Durch die Analyse von Daten mit Führungskräften und die Besprechung der betrieblichen Vor- und Nachteile von technischen Verbesserungen mit den Fachabteilungen trägst du zu „best in class“ Lösungen bei.Als wichtiges Mitglied des Betriebsteams arbeitest Du mit Kolleg:innen aus anderen Teams sowie externen Partnern zusammen und sorgst dafür, dass wir die Anforderungen unserer Kund:innen ebenso wie unsere eigenen Vorgaben jederzeit erfüllen. Das beinhaltet die Analyse von Daten und Leistungskennzahlen gemeinsam mit Führungskräften in Deinem Geschäftsbereich ebenso wie die Besprechung der betrieblichen Vor- und Nachteile von technischen Verbesserungen mit dem technischen Team.

About the team
Die Logistikabteilung bei Amazon (AMZL) ist für die „Last-Mile-Logistik“ zuständig – also die Auslieferung unserer Pakete in Partnerschaft mit Drittanbietern. Wir denken kreativ und realisieren Initiativen zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung, um Millionen von physischen Produkten an unsere Kund:innen zu liefern. Unser Ziel ist es, das Liefererlebnis für unsere Kund:innen so reibungslos wie möglich zu machen und globale Lieferlösungen für unsere neuesten Angebote einzuführen, darunter Amazon Fresh, Prime Now und Amazon Restaurants.
Diese Tätigkeiten werden von zwei Mitarbeitergruppen ausgeführt. Unsere „internen“ Mitarbeitenden bereiten Millionen von Produkten auf den Versand an unsere Lieferteams vor. Unser Team ist menschenorientiert und hilfsbereit. Das ist besonders wichtig, weil viele unserer Mitarbeitenden in Nachtschichten arbeiten. Unser Fokus liegt vorwiegend auf dem operativen Betrieb. An den meisten unserer Standorte wird rund um die Uhr gearbeitet.
Unsere „Außendienst“-Mitarbeitenden arbeiten währenddessen mit Amazon Flex – einem Auftragnehmer-Netzwerk für die Lieferung. Jedes Jahr setzen wir neue Maßstäbe in puncto Kundenerlebnis und bieten neue, innovative Lieferdienste an. Wir suchen nach neuen Möglichkeiten, um branchenweite Logistikherausforderungen zu überwinden, sowie nach neuen Ideen, um unseren CO2-Fußabdruck zu reduzieren. Ein Fuhrpark innovativer Fahrzeuge (einschließlich E-Fahrzeugen) und modernste Technologie unterstützen uns dabei.

title: Senior Partner Solution Architect, Partner Solutions
descriptionHtml:
As a Senior Partner Solution Architect on Amazon Ads Partner Solutions, you help agencies, SaaS platforms, CDPs, and systems integrators design and ship integrations across the Ads API, Amazon Ads Agent, Amazon Marketing Cloud (AMC), and Amazon Marketing Stream, spanning Sponsored Ads and Display, Video, and Audio (DVA) use cases. You work across these products to build the dozens of use cases and hundreds of solutions our partners bring to market on AWS. You bring strong solution-architecture and data skills. If you are coming from a cloud or platform background without ad-tech, you will ramp on the Amazon Ads domain with support from the team.

Key job responsibilities
- Design and implement partner integrations across the Ads API, Amazon Ads Agent, AMC, and Amazon Marketing Stream, spanning Sponsored Ads and Display, Video, and Audio (DVA) use cases and the full range of solutions partners build on these products.
- Lead technical discovery and requirements gathering with partners; guide them through technical decisions to successful delivery.
- Develop reusable patterns and best practices; mentor junior solution architects; influence the product roadmap.

A day in the life
Your day involves designing and reviewing technical solutions for advertising partners, focusing on helping them implement Amazon's advertising capabilities effectively. You lead technical implementation discussions, create architecture diagrams, and provide best practices guidance. Throughout the day, you develop proof of concepts, collect partner feedback, and collaborate with product and engineering teams. You mentor junior architects while ensuring partner solutions are properly implemented and optimized for performance across advertising platforms.

About the team
The Amazon Ads Partner Solutions team enables partners to build and scale innovative advertising technology solutions. Working with customer data platforms, systems integrators, agency holding companies, independent agencies, ad servers, and retail media platforms, this global team designs and delivers technical solutions that drive partner success. The team combines deep advertising technology expertise with Amazon's latest capabilities, including AI-driven features, to help partners build scalable, secure, and performant solutions. Through technical leadership and close collaboration with product teams, they influence both partner solutions and Amazon Ads product development, driving innovation across the advertising ecosystem.

Basic qualifications

- Speak, write, and read fluently in English, and have the ability to take direction in English
- 5+ years in a technical, partner- or customer-facing solutions role (pre-sales SA, solutions/integration engineering, or equivalent)
- Hands-on RESTful API integration; proficiency in SQL and a scripting language such as Python
- Experience designing and delivering solutions on a major cloud (AWS, GCP, Azure, or equivalent)
- Ability to communicate complex technical concepts to both engineers and business stakeholders

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with advertising or marketing technology: Amazon Marketing Cloud, Amazon Ads Agent, Ads API, Amazon Marketing Stream, or close equivalents at another DSP, retail-media, or martech platform
- Familiarity with privacy-safe / clean-room data patterns (1P data, pseudonymized signals)
- Comfortable ramping quickly on a new product domain; deep ad-tech experience is welcome but not required if you bring strong solution-architecture and data skills
- Experience deploying AI/GenAI-enabled features in production; AWS service familiarity; enterprise-partner experience (agency holding companies, CDPs, SIs, ad servers)

title: AWS Marketplace Specialists Customer, AWS Marketplace Specialists Customer
descriptionHtml:
AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small- and mid-market accounts to enterprise-level customers including public sector.

Within SMGS, AWS Marketplace Specialist Customers are part of the WWSO and is responsible for driving the adoption of AWSMP with buyers. They also provide a 360-degree customer feedback loop inclusive of MP Engineering. Their role is to accelerate customer adoption of specific offerings, working through the AWS field and partners while providing direct feedback to Service engineering, strongly aligns with the Specialist role.

AWS Marketplace Specialists Customer are working with the AWS teams to increase AWS Marketplace adoption at AWS customers across Switzerland and Eastern Europe. As the owner of this business, you are working with the with the AGS AM's closely in Switzerland & Eastern Europe.

On a daily basis, you help your customers move to the next model for software procurement and deployment as they migrate to the cloud. You are engaging directly with their Procurement Managers to drive and support adoption of the AWS Marketplace.
You should be self-motivated, customer-centric, very delivery-focused with a demonstrated ability to think strategically and long-term about the needs of our customers.

AWS Marketplace (http://aws.amazon.com/marketplace) is an online store where customers can find, buy, and immediately start using software in a utility model that runs on the AWS Cloud.
Our job is to bring Amazon's e-commerce expertise to cloud software and fundamentally change how software is discovered and consumed in the cloud. We have a long list of new ideas just waiting to be designed and implemented.




Key job responsibilities
• Develop a short term and long term strategic AWS Marketplace plan.
• Work with existing AWS business development and field organizations to engage with customers, and partners to execute joint go to market programs, owning the day-to-day interactions with existing customers and greenfield accounts to identify needs met through AWS Marketplace.
• Serve as a key member of Switzerland & Eastern Europe and EMEA Marketplace Specialist team in helping to define and deliver the Marketplace strategy for Customers in a direct or indirect delivery model.
• Understand the technical requirements of customers and partners, and work closely with the internal development team to guide the direction of our product offerings
• Educate and enable the sales teams and increase visibility of AWS Marketplace products across all relevant AWS teams.
• Manage complex contract negotiations as needed and serve as a partner liaison to the legal group

A day in the life
You will define and execute the strategy across customers in Switzerland & Eastern Europe.
You will work with the AWS organization to set the AWS Marketplace strategy. In your daily job, you will enable account managers and partner managers, and engage directly with customers, independent software vendors (ISV) and software resellers to support successful software transactions through the AWS Marketplace.

title: New Product Lead - Tech, Robotics Supply Chain
descriptionHtml:
Are you inspired by invention? Is problem solving through teamwork in your DNA? Do you like the idea of seeing how your work impacts the bigger picture? Answer yes to any of these and you’ll fit right in here at Amazon Robotics. We are a smart team of doers that work passionately to apply advances in robotics and software to solve real-world challenges that will transform our customers’ experiences in ways we can’t even imagine yet.

Amazon Robotics has locations in the greater Boston and Seattle area, the epicenter of robotics innovation. Our diverse teams come from all over the world to design, test and build our dynamic fleet of robots, mechatronic systems and pack automation solutions. Having our offices, labs, test floors and factories all co-located means that we can design the hardware, write the code, test, build and watch it all come to life. This allows us to innovate quickly and on limitless ideas. Current advancements are underway in autonomous movement and mobility, artificial intelligence and machine learning, manipulation, simulation, robotic management software, predictive analytics, and much more.

The Amazon Robotics Supply Chain provides strategic sourcing for a portfolio of robotic technologies and is responsible for delivering new products by enabling the right suppliers and technologies, and getting the right materials at the right cost to the right place at the right time to support our network of global fulfillment and transportation solutions. It is a fast-paced operation that works cross-functionally with teams across Amazon and is driven by data and metrics.

We are seeking Robotics Supply Chain New Product Lead - Tech tackle to most critical, technologically advanced products at Amazon. The Lead will be responsible for a small portfolio of robotic products and accountable for supplier and supply chain strategies, product cost roadmaps, enabling rapid NPI builds, and ensuring a successful ramp to mass production. They manage their products from concept, through development, to scaled deployment. They work with senior product and engineering leaders to drive appropriate trade-offs between commercial vs. technical constraints, risks and goals. Within the robotic product they lead, they must be able to drive the multiple advanced technologies and commodities, driving a clear path to production.

Essential to the role is a level of technical subject matter expertise to work effectively with the technical teams developing these robotic products. While it varies by group, this expertise includes an understanding of the technologies and architectures of the robotic products and key commodities that make up the robotic products, including the technology’s development and integration strategy and trajectory, both within Amazon and its wider position in the business and industry. This role will contribute to technical strategies and decisions, with contributions that balance technical and business requirements, to help drive engineering teams toward scalable products that achieve Amazon’s cost targets.

The RSC New Product Lead - Tech is a trusted subject matter expert, consulted by teams above and below. They clearly communicate with direct and indirect stakeholders, advocating for commercial opportunities at the Director level and above. They contribute to strategic documents for aligning goals with cross-functional teams, own reporting on forecasting and planning the business impact of each opportunity, and regularly report on the status and impact of their contributions. Their impact is measurable via quantifiable metrics, and they have the ability to deeply influence measurable business outcomes.

We are looking for strong business owners who can Think Big, Deliver Results, and leaders who are ready to make long lasting impact to Amazon Robotics technologies. They should be comfortable working in a fast-paced environment where delivery time for new products and features is typically measured in months. The leader will have a proven background in Robotics automation, global supplier management and new product introduction on the development and scaled production of advanced technology. The successful candidate for this position will be experienced working with cross-functional leaders from product, engineering, manufacturing, and field operations. They are self-managing, have a high sense of urgency and driven to achieve product development and deployment. They will be a highly visible leader that will own the communication, coordination execution, and delivery of a multi-year program vision.

Key job responsibilities
- Support the product development process by working across cross-functional supply chain teams focused on supplier management, supply chain design, sourcing, logistics, and supply chain execution for robotics products from concept through scaled deployment.
- Serve as a key point of contact for program teams to communicate supply chain decisions and progress, share feedback on supply chain implications of program changes, and support financial planning and capital approval processes.
- Partner with Robotics leadership and cross-functional teams — including hardware engineering, operations, and program management — on commodity and supplier selection, cost-performance tradeoff analysis, cost roadmap development, and supporting rapid product development and scaled deployment.
- Support the development of Product-level Supply Chain Strategy documents, including identification of critical components and suppliers, product cost roadmaps, capacity planning, sourcing and tooling requirements, and supply chain risk assessment and mitigation plans.
- Collaborate with sourcing teams to develop negotiation strategies for categories impacting the product, working toward business objectives and building sustainable supplier relationships for Amazon Robotics priority programs aligned to the Operating Plan (OP).
- Work with Global Commodity Managers (GCMs) to support supplier relationship management, including supplier performance, capability development, capacity planning, contracting, risk mitigation, and cost and quality improvements.
- Contribute to roadmap development for achieving NPI and GA total cost targets (TCO), including make vs. buy analysis and value engineering opportunities.
- Support non-cost goals including Sustainability, Supplier Development, and Cost Savings as part of the product-specific supply chain strategy.
- 20–25% travel required.

A day in the life
Amazon offers a full range of benefits that support you and eligible family members, including domestic partners and their children. Benefits can vary by location, the number of regularly scheduled hours you work, length of employment, and job status such as seasonal or temporary employment. The benefits that generally apply to regular, full-time employees include:

1. Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage
2. Maternity and Parental Leave Options
3. Paid Time Off (PTO)
4. 401(k) Plan

If you are not sure that every qualification on the list above describes you exactly, we'd still love to hear from you! At Amazon, we value people with unique backgrounds, experiences, and skillsets. If you’re passionate about this role and want to make an impact on a global scale, please apply!

About the team
The Supply Chain Product Management team develops supply chain strategies for new FTR products from concept to general availability. As the central integration point between technical, commercial, and operational teams, we drive PDP adherence and comprehensive supplier readiness oversight. Our vision establishes scalable, cost-effective solutions leveraging AI-driven insights to exceed performance targets. Our mission encompasses end-to-end strategy development through data-driven decisions, comprehensive make-vs-buy frameworks, regional manufacturing strategies, and cross-functional integration with Engineering, Strategic Sourcing, AMQE, and Planning. We maintain accountability for product cost targets, supplier readiness metrics, and program milestones while optimizing total landed cost and operational efficiency across FTR's portfolio.

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
- Experience in Supply Chain Management
- Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules

Preferred qualifications

- Knowledge of Excel at an intermediate level (e.g., pivot tables & charts, multiple criteria lookups, nested logical/IF formulas, data cleansing, array formulas, etc.)

title: WHS Specialist
descriptionHtml:
Join Amazon’s mission to become Earth’s safest place to work! At Amazon, we’ve set the ambitious goal to become the benchmark of safety excellence across all industries in which we operate. As a Workplace Health & Safety Specialist (WHSS), you'll be at the forefront of transforming workplace safety culture at one of the world's most innovative companies. Your expertise and dedication will directly protect employees, ensuring they return home safely to their families every day. You'll facilitate new approaches to safety, combining technology with human-centered solutions to create an environment where safety and productivity thrive together. This isn't just about maintaining safety standards – it's about revolutionizing how we think about and implement workplace safety, making a lasting impact on our people and operations. As your building's designated safety champion, you'll have the unique opportunity to build relationships, influence positive change, and help write the next chapter in Amazon's commitment to becoming Earth's Safest Place to Work.

Safety Program Excellence & Implementation - Drive comprehensive safety programs through data-driven strategies. Lead daily safety audits, incident investigations, and risk assessments while implementing innovative solutions to prevent injuries. Deliver engaging safety training that resonates with associates and promotes a proactive safety culture. Foster a culture where safety is everyone's priority through effective communication, coaching, and positive reinforcement. title: Senior Solutions Architect, Media & Entertainment, Games and Sports (MEGS)
descriptionHtml:
Join the AWS Solutions Architecture team that partners with one of the world's most-watched media companies, where live sports, entertainment, and streaming reach tens of millions of people every day. In this role, you'll design resilient, low-latency AWS architectures behind streaming platforms that have to hold up when the whole country tunes in at once, and the media supply chain that gets content from creation to screen.

You'll work at the intersection of engineering and storytelling, turning complex broadcast and business challenges into elegant cloud solutions. Your work will span large-scale live and on-demand streaming; media asset management, archive modernization, and cloud-based production workflows that unlock decades of content; real-time ad decisioning, contextual targeting, and personalization across ad-supported streaming; and generative AI experiences that change how content is tagged, discovered, and monetized. From the newsroom to the big game, you'll support live moments where there are no second takes. We're looking for strategic thinkers who thrive in ambiguity, communicate with clarity to engineers, producers, and executives alike, and are energized by mentoring others.

Why join? You'll help ensure millions of viewers get the right content and the right ad, in the right moment, flawlessly. You'll collaborate on some of the most demanding streaming, media supply chain, and ad delivery architectures in the industry, and innovate in a culture that values curiosity, ownership, and diverse perspectives. Apply now to architect the future of how the world watches.

Key job responsibilities
- Lead the design of end-to-end cloud solutions for customers, working backward from their business objectives to architect systems that are extensible, secure, reliable, and cost-optimized.
- Serve as a trusted technical advisor by building relationships with customer leadership, understanding their technology challenges, and ensuring short-term decisions align with long-term business outcomes.
- Drive technical solution discussions with customer teams, diving into design choices, best practices, and use cases while proactively identifying and mitigating high-risk or overly complex approaches.
- Develop and deliver technical content such as presentations, workshops, sample code, and white papers to educate customers on cloud strategy and architectural best practices.
- Collaborate with internal teams including sales, professional services, support, and engineering to accelerate solution adoption and contribute reusable reference designs for the broader Solutions Architecture community.
- Stay at the forefront of emerging technology in streaming, media supply chain, and ad tech, including generative AI, so you can keep earning your place as your customers' trusted advisor as their industry evolves.
- Build and showcase hands-on prototypes, demos, and proofs of concept that bring new capabilities to life and shorten the path from idea to production.
- Partner with ISVs and industry partners to shape joint solutions across live streaming, media asset management, and ad delivery and personalization.
- Share your expertise through blogs, conference talks, and industry events, helping AWS stay established as the cloud of choice for media companies looking to grow revenue and modernize their operations.

A day in the life
Your day spans internal alignment, customer architecture discussions, and hands-on experimentation with AWS services to solve media challenges: live streaming at scale, ad decisioning and personalization, and modernizing the media supply chain. You might start by reviewing a proposed architecture and finding ways to simplify it, then lead a deep-dive with a customer's engineering team on the trade-offs between encoding, delivery, and ad-insertion approaches. Afternoons bring solutioning sessions where you craft architectures that hold up under the biggest live audiences, followed by building proofs of concept to de-risk high-stakes decisions, like how to unlock decades of archived content or personalize ads in real time. Between engagements, you'll partner with AWS service teams to advocate for your customer's needs and turn their feedback into roadmap priorities. You'll close your day sharing what you've learned through blogs, demos, and conversations across engineering, production, and business stakeholders.

About the team
We're the AWS Media, Entertainment, Games and Sports (MEGS) Solutions Architecture team, and our vision is simple: we meet our customers where they are, design what's next, prove what's possible, and scale what matters for every fan, every story, every screen, and every experience. #InventForFans

We come with a point of view, staying on the frontier of technology and pushing it where it matters most to our customers. We're builders who roll up our sleeves to create demos, proofs of concept, and prototypes, because a working idea beats a slide every time. We collaborate across account teams, specialists, and service teams, acting as the connective tissue that shapes what gets built next. And we scale our thinking, turning what we learn in the field into patterns and reference architectures that the whole industry can use. Every activity backs an outcome for our customers, and we're intentional about the work that matters.
