title: Audit Manager - Advertising, Risk & Internal Audit
descriptionHtml:
Are you excited by the opportunity to partner with Amazon’s business and engineering teams to identify risks, solve complex problems, and drive meaningful improvements? This role offers the chance to apply technical expertise, risk assessment, and data analytics skills while gaining exposure to a broad range of innovative businesses and technologies.

We are seeking an experienced IT Audit Manager to join our Devices, Advertising, and Media & Entertainment Internal Audit team. In this high-visibility role, you will lead operational and technical audits across diverse businesses, providing independent insights that help strengthen controls, improve processes, and support sound decision-making.

You will be responsible for planning, executing, and reporting risk-based audits, developing a deep understanding of complex business processes, technologies, and regulatory requirements. Working closely with engineers, product leaders, and business stakeholders, you will evaluate risks across operations, compliance, policy, and technology, and translate those risks into practical, business-focused recommendations.

Success in this role requires strong analytical, project management, and communication skills. You must be able to navigate ambiguity, influence stakeholders, and communicate complex issues clearly to senior leadership while driving alignment on effective risk mitigation strategies. You need to be a good coach and mentor and deliver through people, as for every audit/project, you will be managing a small team of auditors.

We value intellectual curiosity, sound judgment, creativity, and a bias for action.

Travel of up to 10–20%, including international travel, may be required.

Key job responsibilities
- Is an excellent project manager who can work independently to conduct audits from beginning to end, manage stakeholders, and often managing multiple projects at the same time.
- Results-oriented leader ability to motivate, manage, and drive consensus across diverse teams
- Has exceptional analytical skills to identify problems and work on process to address the root cause of the problems.
- Is able to prioritize effectively and drive cross-functional remediation efforts focusing on the highest risks and ensure problems stay fixed.
- Is able to dive deep to identify root cause of control gaps, inefficiencies and exceptions.
- Delivers on the highest standards by challenging assumptions and supporting with data.
- Can identify opportunities to improve, automate, standardize or simplify Internal Audit tools and processes.
- Is able to support and advocate for a culture of risk management, strong controls, and effective operations.
- Is an excellent writer who can succinctly communicate complicated technical issues.
- Can quickly become familiar with stakeholders business challenges and risks and act as a trusted advisor to them while leading change, dealing with ambiguity among cross functional teams.

A day in the life
• Lead a portfolio of audits: Plan, scope, and deliver multiple concurrent audits and advisory engagements across different business areas, balancing depth with efficiency and adapting to shifting business priorities.
• Own the audit roadmap for your sub-portfolio: Conduct continuous risk assessments across your business areas, identify the highest-impact audit topics, and influence the team's annual audit plan.
• Manage and develop auditors: Direct the work of audit teams, including Senior IT Auditors and IT Auditors. Coach team members, set the bar for quality, and grow the next generation of audit leaders.
• Understand the business behind the systems: Develop and maintain a clear view of how products and platforms operate, generate value, and scale — and where failures would have the greatest impact on customers, revenue, regulatory standing, or operations.
• Assess risk in context: Evaluate areas such as access management, data security, system reliability, software development practices, and emerging-technology controls — focusing on what truly matters to the business rather than applying controls mechanically.
• Use data to inform conclusions: Apply analytical thinking and direct (or oversee) data analysis to identify trends, validate controls, and support risk assessments at scale.
• Translate technical and business issues into business impact: Clearly articulate how risks affect customers, revenue, regulatory exposure, or operational performance — for audiences ranging from engineers to the Audit Committee.
• Influence and partner with senior stakeholders: Build standing relationships with VPs, Directors, and senior engineering leaders. Drive alignment on risks and on practical, scalable solutions, including where stakeholders push back.
• Drive meaningful outcomes: Ensure audit findings lead to real improvements, not just reports. Hold a high bar for closure and validate that risks have been mitigated.
• Raise the bar for the team: Contribute to audit methodology, team operating mechanisms, and the development of audit standards across DMAAC and broader Internal Audit.


About the team
Our teams leads Internal Audit for the new and fast growing businesses of Amazon - Devices, Advertising, Media & Entertainment, AGI/Annapurna and all the Corporate Functions. descriptionHtml:
We are the Global Procurement Organization, and we're on a mission to reshape how one of the world's largest companies powers its operations with clean energy. We're looking for a Category Manager to lead and develop our on-site solar energy portfolio across Europe, the UK, and the Middle East, partnering with cross-functional teams to deliver hundreds of megawatts of new capacity and tens of millions in cost savings.

You'll be building the playbook for solar procurement in some of the fastest-growing renewable energy markets on the planet:

Manage the full solar portfolio across diverse markets from Western Europe to the Arabian Peninsula, collaborating with regional stakeholders in markets where solar capacity is projected to grow 10x by 2035

Navigate complex regulatory landscapes—from EU clean energy mandates to Saudi Vision 2030 and the UAE's ambitious renewable targets

Structure creative deals, deciding when to deploy capital purchases vs. power purchase agreements vs. operating lease models across markets with very different economics

Contribute to meaningful sustainability impact—your work will directly eliminate thousands of metric tons of CO2 annually while reducing grid dependency across hundreds of logistics facilities, supporting Amazon's climate commitments

Help build a category from the ground up in emerging Middle East markets, working with local teams where solar is unlocking operations in locations where traditional grid connections aren't even possible

If you enjoy solving complex problems across cultures and borders, and want your work to have measurable environmental and financial impact, this is the role.

Key job responsibilities
- Develop and execute the long-term sourcing strategy for on-site solar across Europe, UK, and Middle East, covering rooftop, carport, and ground-mount technologies, in partnership with engineering and sustainability teams
- Lead portfolio-based tenders, bundling demand across multiple countries to maximise negotiation leverage and reduce procurement cycle times
- Build financial models—including net present value, total cost of ownership, and payback analysis—to support investment decisions and senior leadership recommendations
- Build and maintain strategic supplier relationships through quarterly business reviews, performance tracking, and capacity planning while maintaining competitive tension across the vendor base
- Identify and mitigate supply chain risks including equipment lead times, trade policy shifts, and regional market constraints
- Track energy production performance against forecasts and collaborate with technical teams to drive continuous improvement in system output and cost efficiency
- Lead category consolidation efforts, bringing fragmented solar activities under a unified procurement framework to unlock savings and standardise specifications

A day in the life
Your day starts with a portfolio review call across European markets, then shifts to negotiating contract terms with a supplier for a compliance-driven deployment. After lunch, you're deep in a financial model stress-testing deal structures for a new Middle East opportunity. By afternoon, you're syncing with engineering, legal, finance, sustainability, and construction partners to keep projects on track. The variety is constant—and no two days look the same as you move between strategy, negotiation, and execution across time zones.

About the team
You'll join the Power and Utilities team within Amazon's Global Procurement Organization. We manage the full energy lifecycle for Amazon's worldwide operations across five areas: utilities supply and audits, power infrastructure and grid services, on-site renewables and storage, EV charging infrastructure, and hydrogen mobility solutions. This role sits within the renewables and storage pillar, but you'll work alongside colleagues tackling everything from microgrids and demand response to hydrogen refuelling and electric vehicle charging. title: Software Development Manager, Leo AI Foundations, Amazon Leo AI Foundations
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is Amazon's initiative to launch a constellation of low Earth orbit satellites to provide low-latency, high-speed broadband connectivity to unserved and underserved communities around the world.

The Leo AI Foundations team builds the intelligence that will run Leo as an AI-native business. We combine applied science and engineering with Leo's domain expertise, own the shared AI foundation for the business, and lead work that spans teams and systems, so that progress in one part of Leo becomes a capability the whole business can use. Leo Lens is our command center for this AI network. It is pioneering agentic AI for diagnostics, reporting, troubleshooting and mitigating issues across our end-to-end network stack, and it automates workflows for mission operations, ecommerce and developer use cases. Through Lens, it is our vision that agents work as one system to keep the network secure and reliable, resolving failures before customers experience them, while Leo's teams keep authority over consequential decisions.

We are looking for a Software Development Manager to build and lead one of our engineering teams. You will own a roadmap in one of our tracks as we build the infrastructure for the AI that operates the network, from the agents themselves to the orchestration, knowledge access, evaluation and security controls that connect them. You will hire and grow a team of software engineers and applied scientists, partner with the domain teams that own satellites, gateways, customer terminals and network services, and deliver production systems where reliability, security and measurable impact are the bar.

- Set and uphold the engineering bar for the team: design and security reviews, testing, operational excellence and on-call health.

A day in the life
No two days look the same, because you are building something that has not existed before. You will set the direction for your team and remove what stands in its way. You will sit with the engineers and scientists who own Leo's satellites, gateways, customer terminals and network services, and decide with them how your team's expertise in AI can unblock them or move them faster. title: Sr Manager Package SIPI, Annapurna Labs
descriptionHtml:
About the Role
We are looking for a Senior Manager of Package Signal & Power Integrity to lead a small team of engineers delivering SI/PI solutions for next-generation 2.5D/3D chiplet-based products. This is a player-coach role: you will set the technical direction for package-level SI/PI across advanced packaging platforms (CoWoS, EMIB, 3D die stacking) while staying hands-on with modeling, simulation, and post-silicon correlation.

You will own the SI/PI strategy from early architecture through high-volume production, partnering with silicon design, physical design, system architecture, and possible with OSAT/substrate vendors to ensure robust signaling and power delivery across die-to-die, memory, and high-speed SerDes interfaces.

What You Will Do
• Lead and develop a team of SI/PI engineers, setting priorities, driving career growth, and building world-class packaging expertise.
• Define and execute SI/PI design methodology for 2.5D/3D IC packages—including silicon interposer, RDL, TSV, and bridge-based architectures.
• Drive chip-package-system co-design by performing end-to-end SI/PI analysis and optimization for HBM (HBM3/HBM3E+), PCIe Gen5/Gen6/Gen7, UCIe die-to-die interconnects and high-speed SerDes (112G+/224G PAM4).
• Own PDN design and sign-off across die, interposer, package substrate, and PCB, including AC/DC/transient droop analysis and decoupling strategy.
• Develop and validate channel models (S-parameter, IBIS-AMI) and perform BER/eye-diagram analysis for multi-lane high-speed links.
• Establish SI/PI design guidelines, sign-off criteria, and automation flows; drive continuous improvement in accuracy and productivity.
• Partner with ASIC architects, PHY/IP teams, package layout, thermal/mechanical, PCB, and system design teams to close electrical specifications.
• Collaborate with other internal partners and external partners (possible like foundry, OSAT, and substrate suppliers etc.) on technology assessment, DFM trade-offs, and new package platform enablement.
• Lead post-silicon validation and model-to-hardware correlation using VNA, TDR, oscilloscope, and spectrum analyzer measurements.

Required Qualifications
• MS or PhD in Electrical Engineering, with emphasis in electromagnetics, signal integrity, power integrity, or microelectronics.
• 12+ years of progressive SI/PI engineering experience in semiconductor packaging (IC package, interposer, or substrate design).
• 3+ years of direct people-management experience leading SI/PI or packaging engineering teams.
• Demonstrated expertise in 2.5D/3D advanced packaging technologies (CoWoS-S/L/R, EMIB, Foveros, 3D die stacking, TSV, RDL, flip-chip BGA).
• Hands-on experience with SI/PI analysis for high-speed SerDes interfaces at 56G NRZ / 112G+ PAM4 data rates.
• Strong background in HBM3/4 SI/PI design and timing budget methodology (HBM3/HBM3E/HBM4 or newer).
• Experience with PCIe Gen5/Gen6 channel design, compliance, and sign-off at the package and system level.
• Working knowledge of UCIe or comparable die-to-die interconnect standards for chiplet architectures.
• Proficiency in industry EDA/simulation tools: Ansys HFSS/SIwave/Q3D, Cadence Sigrity (PowerSI, SystemSI), Keysight ADS, HSPICE/Spectre.
• Strong scripting skills (Python, MATLAB, Tcl) for simulation automation and data analysis.
• Proven ability to drive cross-functional alignment across silicon, package, board, and system teams in a fast-paced product environment.

Preferred Qualifications

In this role, you'll be part of a team responsible for managing AWS' strategic relationships with a leading AI model provider. You'll build relationships with the partner's executives and its product, marketing, sales, and channel teams. You'll own the joint business plan and set the direction for how AWS and the partner win together. You'll drive revenue growth and customer adoption of the partner's models on AWS, and help get competitive deals over the line. This is a global role covering customers and markets across every region.

You bring a partner management background that lets you build trusted relationships at the executive level, and a sales background that makes you effective with enterprise customers and AWS field teams. You think strategically about business, product, and technical challenges, and you can turn them into clear value propositions and plans people act on. You understand generative AI, frontier models, and how enterprises adopt them. You use data and AI tools to track the business, spot trends early, and keep leaders informed.

Key job responsibilities
- Manage a strategic global model provider partnership across Amazon Bedrock and AWS Marketplace, defining and executing joint partner plans, co-sell motions, and GTM programs.
- Own the partner development plan, including consumption, exit run rate, Marketplace revenue, and pipeline targets, aligned with AWS Generative AI strategy.

A day in the life
Your day centers on one of AWS's most strategic AI partnerships. Mornings might start with a call with the partner's sales leaders to review deals in flight, then a quick huddle with solutions architects on a customer who needs help getting to production. By afternoon, you could be getting a stalled deal moving again by bringing in finance and legal, or using AI tools to turn data into a dashboard leaders actually read. Some days you'll write the briefing for an executive meeting. On others, you'll help shape how AWS works with AI companies for years to come.

About the team
We're a small, close-knit team that manages AWS partnerships. Our mission is to make AWS the best place for customers to build with AI. You'll work side by side with partner managers, solutions architects, sales teams, and finance and legal partners, and also directly with the partner's own sales and leadership teams. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship & Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

descriptionHtml:
Amazon DynamoDB powers many of the world's fastest-growing businesses, including Lyft, Airbnb, and Redfin. It also powers enterprises such as Samsung, Toyota, and Capital One. Within Amazon, it runs high-traffic properties including Alexa, Amazon.com, and every Amazon fulfillment center. DynamoDB is one of the largest distributed database systems in the world. DynamoDB customers count on consistent single-digit millisecond performance at any scale, high availability, and durable data. Testing is how DynamoDB keeps those promises with every change it ships. The Test Infrastructure team builds test frameworks that every DynamoDB engineer uses to validate features, run integration and performance tests, and qualify releases. When test infrastructure is fast and reliable, every DynamoDB team delivers features faster.

Testing is also central to how DynamoDB speeds up delivery as engineers bring AI agents into their development work. An agent can only correct its own mistakes if it can run a change against a realistic system and see the result. Ready-to-run test clusters give agents that feedback loop. The features this team builds let DynamoDB engineers use AI-assisted development for changes that need more than unit tests, and they let DynamoDB add automated testing to every code review and every release.

- Design, build, and operate the test infrastructure, frameworks, and tooling that power DynamoDB testing.
- Build test infrastructure that AI agents can use on their own, with clusters ready on demand and results, logs, and metrics an agent can act on.
- Treat DynamoDB engineers as your customers. Reduce how long they wait for test results and how often their tests fail because of infrastructure.

- Debug failures across services and fix root causes in the system.

title: Software Development Manager, AtoZ HR Services & Experiences Technology - Connections
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Connections gives Amazonians globally an effective way to give feedback on the workplace and help shape the future of the company - asking over 1.5M employees a quick question every day and using that real-time insight to strengthen Amazon's workplace culture. As a Software Development Manager on Connections Content Distribution, you'll have technical ownership of how Connections content reaches employees every day, leading a talented team that builds and operates a platform millions of people rely on.

- Own critical, high-scale systems that deliver content to ~1.5M Amazon employees and associates daily

- Lead, hire, coach, and grow a team of engineers in an environment that rewards ownership and invention

- Drive architecture, design, and long-term technical strategy for an end-to-end content platform

- Partner with Product, Research, UX, and Content Operations to expand Connections' reach and refine the experience

- Build technology that changes the face of organizational management, at the scale of Amazon

Key job responsibilities
- Lead an engineering team that builds, operates, and maintains software to meet business needs

- Manage the day-to-day activities of the team within an Agile/Scrum environment

- Hire, coach, and mentor individuals, and grow a healthy, high-performing team

- Work closely with engineers to architect and develop the best technical design and approach

- Own the operational excellence and reliability of high-scale, real-time services that employees depend on every day

- Report on the status of development, quality, operations, and system performance to leadership

- Help develop long-term development and business technology strategies

- Partner with Product to deliver the right thing for our customers

A day in the life
You'll spend your day guiding a team that owns the end-to-end journey of Connections content - from how it's scheduled and prioritized to how it's delivered across devices and channels. You'll unblock engineers on technical decisions, review designs for scale and reliability, and balance new feature work against the operational health of services that run every day. You'll partner closely with Product, Research, UX, and Content Operations to decide what to build next, while keeping a constant eye on minimizing disruption to the millions of Amazonians who interact with Connections daily.

About the team
Connections Content Distribution is the engineering team at the heart of how Connections reaches employees every day. We own the end-to-end journey of Connections content - the systems that create, schedule, and prioritize what employees see, the services that deliver it across devices and channels, and the data platform that turns billions of responses into insight. Every day we reach roughly 1.5M employees and associates worldwide - corporate staff, fulfillment center teams, and Last Mile and Middle Mile drivers alike.

We combine the culture of a startup, the innovation and creativity of an R&D lab, and technical challenges at the scale of Amazon. We encourage invention, expect a high level of ownership from engineers and managers alike, and offer builders the opportunity to build and make history.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of engineering team management experience
- 7+ years of working directly within engineering teams experience
- 3+ years of designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- 8+ years of leading the definition and development of multi tier web services experience
- Knowledge of engineering practices and patterns for the full software/hardware/networks development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, certification, and livesite operations
- Experience partnering with product or program management teams

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in communicating with users, other technical teams, and senior leadership to collect requirements, describe software product features, technical designs, and product strategy
- Experience in recruiting, hiring, mentoring/coaching and managing teams of Software Engineers to improve their skills, and make them more effective, product software engineers

title: Strategic Customer Engagements, Americas, Startups
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is seeking a Deal Lead for the Strategic Customer Engagements (SCE) team.

SCE is a specialized global deal team that engages with commercial and public sector customers on deal strategy, structuring, and negotiations through contractual closure for transformational, strategic, large, complex, and/or highly competitive opportunities such as GenAI. This is a unique opportunity to engage with AWS customers on strategic opportunities, increase the growth of AWS, and to establish AWS as their key cloud technology provider. These opportunities range across industry verticals, such as Financial Services, Telecommunications, Media & Entertainment, Energy, Healthcare Life Sciences, Automotive and Manufacturing, and Public Sector, and customer size (from start-ups to enterprise customers). These engagements may also involve Pan-Amazon and AWS go-to-market opportunities involving close partnership between the SCE team and other Amazon and AWS stakeholders.

As a Deal Lead, you will be responsible for managing the end-to-end deal cycle for strategic, large, complex, or highly competitive deals. You will focus on building trust with customers by creating actionable strategies, developing and shaping opportunities, and leading deal engagements through negotiations and closure. This highly visible role will own engagement with customer C-level executives, IT teams, and multiple lines of business to achieve business outcomes, increase the adoption of AWS services, and to enable private pricing, go-to-market, and other strategic relationships. You will work collaboratively to drive results by partnering with AWS customers, AWS field sales executives, and other internal stakeholders to empower our customers to evolve, address challenges, and create innovative solutions.

Key job responsibilities
- Lead negotiations and drive customer closure for strategic, large, complex, or highly competitive deals, including GenAI opportunities, managing the end-to-end deal cycle from strategy through contractual completion
- Develop and shape overall deal strategy, structure, and pricing approaches to meet customer business outcomes and goals, while identifying and resolving deal blockers
- Collaborate closely with Americas regional sales teams and global stakeholders — including Service Teams, Finance, and Legal — to align resources, remove obstacles, and achieve desired business outcomes
- Act as a trusted advisor to AWS Field Sales Executives on commercial strategy, partnering in the execution of the sales cycle for strategic and highly competitive opportunities
- Present deal proposals to customers and communicate the AWS value proposition, influencing alignment with internal stakeholders and experts to drive revenue growth and cloud adoption

A day in the life
Your primary focus is guiding complex, high-value deals from initial strategy through signed agreement. You might start the morning reviewing a deal proposal with a solutions architect, then join a call with a customer's procurement team to work through commercial terms. After lunch you could be collaborating with Finance and Legal to finalize pricing structures, followed by preparing a narrative for senior leadership on a competitive opportunity. Throughout, you balance independent analysis with real-time collaboration across sales, service, and business teams to keep deals moving forward.

About the team
The Strategic Customer Engagements team at AWS partners with customers across industries to structure and close some of the most impactful cloud deals in the market. We operate at the intersection of sales strategy, deal structuring, and customer relationships, working alongside field sales, service teams, and cross-functional partners to deliver outcomes that matter. Our team values creative problem-solving, clear communication, and a collaborative approach. We are focused on expanding our reach across the Americas and continuing to help customers accelerate their cloud adoption journey.

Basic qualifications

- Experience working with, presenting to, and negotiating with C-level executives, IT, lines of business, procurement, finance, legal and internal stakeholders for sizeable commercial/enterprise deals
- 7 + years demonstrated success working with customers on substantial, strategic, and complex software or cloud services/infrastructure deals (relative to industry and market size) from opportunity through closure
- 7+ years of experience working with, presenting to, and negotiating with C-level executives, IT, lines of business, procurement, finance, and legal and internal stakeholders for sizeable commercial/enterprise deals

Preferred qualifications

- Advanced degree or equivalent relevant experience
- Direct field experience with enterprise accounts
- Strong written and verbal presentation skills with the ability to articulate complex concepts to cross functional audiences

descriptionHtml:
Operations is at the heart of Amazon’s business. We are known for our speed, accuracy, and exceptional service. Our buildings deliver tens of thousands of products to hundreds of countries worldwide, every day. The Reliability & Maintenance Engineering (RME) team are the business partners that work tirelessly behind the scenes to make it happen. We drive continuous improvement, and maintain all of the robotics and material handling equipment (MHE) to ensure our customers are met with the Amazon smile. Come join us on our journey!

About the Role:
As the Automation Engineer Manager, you will lead a team in driving equipment reliability and operational excellence across our fulfillment centers. You’ll monitor and support their work in controls automation and technical support while ensuring they effectively troubleshoot complex control systems and analyze performance metrics. You’ll guide their leadership of continuous improvement projects and ensure they provide mentorship to junior engineers. You'll work with state-of-the-art technology, including conveyors, sortation systems, scanners, cameras, print and apply systems, and Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) devices and programs. Through your technical leadership and design optimization efforts, you'll directly contribute to ensuring our customers receive their orders with Amazon's signature speed and accuracy while building team capabilities and driving operational excellence.

What Do We Offer?
Amazon offers competitive compensation packages including comprehensive healthcare benefits starting on Day 1, matching 401(k) program, and up to 20 weeks of paid parental leave. But wait, there’s more: We provide lightweight fire-resistant daily wear and composite toe safety shoes for your safety!

- You will apply Subject Matter Expertise (SME) on troubleshooting and dive deeps for engineering issues, supporting automation engineers to investigate the root cause and planning actions to eliminate/mitigate the downtime of critical assets
- You will program and source code for in-house built solutions based in PLC or PC controllers and SCADA/OEE platforms
- You will understand, maintain and troubleshoot material handling control systems, including PLC/PC controllers and industrial networks such as Ethernet, ControlNet, DeviceNet, Profibus, motor control systems, servo drives, frequency drives, and electrical distribution systems
- You will provide escalation support to automation engineers, during and after business hours, troubleshooting locally and remotely, to ensure that all hardware or controls software within the building is repaired on time

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or Automation Engineering, or 7+ years of PLC programming or automation engineering experience
- 7+ years of industrial controls and automation experience
- 7+ years of process/production environment PLC-controlled automation and issue diagnosis experience
- 7+ years of robotics work cells and control systems experience

- Experience maintaining, troubleshooting, programming, and designing HMI and control network components
- Experience programming with RSLogix5000, Studio 5000, FT View, and other controls software platforms
- Experience leading Controls in manufacturing or complex industrial environments

title: Onsite Medical Representative
descriptionHtml:
Join Amazon’s mission to become Earth’s safest place to work! At Amazon, we’ve set the ambitious goal to become the benchmark of safety excellence across all industries in which we operate. The Amazon Workplace Health & Safety (WHS) team sets the strategic direction to provide resources, best practices, and safe environments to proactively manage the health and wellbeing of our workforce. To support these goals, Amazon is seeking an experienced and dynamic Onsite Medical Representative (OMR) to join our team. In this position, you will work closely with the WHS Site Manager, WHS Specialist, and occasionally the Injury Prevention Specialist (IPS). This includes attending weekly associate safety committee meetings, greeting all new hires for the site or through daily one-on-one interaction. Additionally, the OMR will participate in weekly case management review meetings as necessary.

As an OMR, you will independently assess and administer first aid as well as offer guidance to Amazon Associates (AAs) on both occupational and non-occupational injuries or illnesses. You should be passionate about learning and advocating health and wellness principles to consistently support AAs on a daily basis. You will refer care to outside medical providers as needed, and learn about OSHA regulations, risk, and analysis.

The OMR will function as a part of the larger team onsite, assisting with all first aid needs and support safety operations as needed.

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

Provide first aid support and make referrals to outside medical providers as necessary.
Minimize the AA risk of injury through awareness, education, and proactive engagement.
Maintain all records of care provided to AAs.
Coordinate and maintain the workers’ compensation and return to work programs for AAs with work-related injuries.
Provide daily activity logs and end of shift reports.
Engage with AAs and leadership on operations floor to provide coaching regarding observed at-risk work habits.
Maintain a clean working environment and ensure appropriate medical supply inventory is maintained.
Participate in training and certification to facilitate first aid, CPR and AED certifications classes.
Maintain all first aid, CPR, AED credentials.
Work flexible shifts which could include days, nights, holidays, and/or weekends.
Assist with random saliva drug testing protocols.
Maintain effective care delivery in emergencies and assist emergency response at the site.


Additional Job Elements include:

Lift up to 49 pounds and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach
Stand/walk for up to 12 hours during shifts
Work in an environment where the noise level varies
Work in an environment that is subject to variable temperatures and weather (delivery stations include outside loading departments)
Continuously climb and descend stairs (applies to sites with stairs)


For those that do not have an adult First Aid, CPR, AED certification from the American Heart Association or American Red Cross, must obtain within 3 weeks of start date.

Basic qualifications

- High school or equivalent diploma
- Current valid Basic Life Support (BLS) certification by an approved emergency cardiac care (ECC) provider; AND must have one of the following:
- Current valid Emergency Medical Technician (EMT) OR Paramedic Certification from the Department of Health OR the National Registry of Emergency Medical Technicians (NREMT); OR
- Current active Athletic Trainer Certification, by either the Board of Certification (BOC) or equivalent State Certification.

Preferred qualifications

- Certified to teach first aid, CPR, and AED training from American Heart Association or American Red Cross
- Proficient in Microsoft Office
- Experience with an industrial wellness program
- Experience managing musculoskeletal disorders, ergonomics, and coaching on body mechanics
- Demonstrated work experience with OSHA regulations and Workers Compensation

title: Embedded Controls Engineer, Power Loops
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Web Services is seeking a Controls Engineer, Power Loops to develop and validate advanced control algorithms for SST power-conversion loops, with emphasis on stability, dynamic response and high-power converter behavior.

As a Controls Engineer, Power Loops you will develop and tune current/voltage/power loops (PI, MPC, passivity-based) with state-space models and stability analysis on a defined scope. You will secure stability margins and dynamic response, decoupling and disturbance rejection across operating points and converter paralleling. You will work with FPGA/DSP and embedded engineers to deploy loops in real time and correlates model predictions to lab measurement.

About AIS

And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.


Key job responsibilities
Control development:
- Develop PI, model-predictive and passivity-based control approaches as appropriate to the converter.
- Build state-space models and perform stability analysis.
- Tune current, voltage and power loops for dynamic and steady-state performance.

Simulation & implementation:
- Use MATLAB/Simulink and Control Toolbox to design and evaluate control algorithms.
- Work with FPGA/DSP and embedded engineers to translate algorithms into real-time implementations.
- Correlate model predictions with laboratory measurements.

System behavior:
- Analyze dynamic load response relevant to variable AI compute workloads.
- Support converter paralleling, current sharing and fault-management strategies.
- Investigate instability, oscillation and transient-performance issues.

SST System Alignment:
- Design control loops to meet the system LVDC regulation targets (±1% static and ±3% dynamic, with ±0.5% switching ripple) and the specified overload/fault behavior.
- Develop control strategies for VRT/FRT, MVAC load acceptance/rejection, ESS coordination, redundancy and dynamic power sharing.

A day in the life
As a Controls Engineer, Power Loops, you'll focus on developing and refining control algorithms for solid-state transformer power-conversion systems. Your day might include building state-space models in MATLAB/Simulink to analyze system stability, collaborating with embedded and FPGA engineers to translate your algorithms into real-time implementations, and correlating your model predictions with laboratory measurements to validate performance.

You'll investigate dynamic responses under variable compute workloads, troubleshoot oscillation and transient-performance issues, and work to ensure our systems meet strict regulation targets. Beyond routine development, you'll contribute to solving system-level challenges like converter paralleling strategies and fault-management approaches that require creative problem-solving across multiple engineering disciplines.

title: Software Engineer, Worldwide Amazon Stores Finance Technology, Controllership Engineering
descriptionHtml:
Amazon's finance teams rely on financial controls to keep spending accurate and financial reports audit-ready. You will build the systems that automate those controls, catch errors and waste before money is spent, and give finance analysts fast, trusted answers through AI tools built on cloud services and large-scale data.

Key job responsibilities
- Build services that check purchase requests and orders against finance rules in near real time, then correct or flag issues before approval.
- Automate financial controls, such as reviews of fixed assets, leases, cost centers, open orders, so finance teams spend less time collecting data by hand and more time acting on exceptions.
- Build data pipelines on AWS, including Lambda, StepFunctions, Glue, EMR, DDB, and S3, that feed C-Hub/dashboards finance teams use during month-end close and audit reviews.
- Build AI agents on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore with the Strands SDK, including MCP tools, context and memory management, evaluation, harnesses, and guardrails that keep finance answers accurate.
- Big data experience with Spark, StarRocks, or similar OLAP engines.
- Build web applications and browser extensions in React and TypeScript that let finance users review exceptions, filter large datasets, and export results.
- Turn defined business requirements into technical designs, review them with senior engineers, and take them from prototype to production.
- Own your services in production. Write the tests, alarms, and automated rollbacks that let a change reach customers in hours, not days. Take part in on-call rotation.
- Work directly with finance, accounting, product, and data science partners, and explain technical tradeoffs.

A day in the life
Most of your day goes to building. You might start by looking into an alarm from an overnight data job that feeds a finance control. Then you meet an accounting partner to design how a manual review could run automatically. After lunch, you write code and tests and ship the change through an automated pipeline the same day. Some weeks, you test a new AI model against an evaluation set to see if it gives better answers. Near month-end close, you answer finance users who want to know why a control flagged a transaction.

About the team
We are a team of software engineers who build the tools that keep Amazon's spending accurate and its financial reports audit-ready. Our customers are finance analysts, accountants, and employees across Amazon who buy goods and services. We own our products end to end, from data pipelines and services to the web apps and AI agents people use every day. We ship changes through automated pipelines and measure our work by the manual effort and errors we remove. We value clear writing, careful reviews, and engineers who ask why a process exists before they automate it.

title: Sr. Research Scientist, Amazon Transportation Services (NEST) Science
descriptionHtml:
Have you ever placed an order on Amazon and wondered how it got to you so fast? Behind that speed is one of the most complex transportation networks in the world, and the scientific problems it poses are hard, ambiguous, and largely unsolved. We are looking for a senior research scientist who wants to invent the models that run it.

Come join the Network Engineering, Scheduling and Technology (NEST) Science team within Amazon Transportation Services. We are looking for a Sr. Research Scientist to lead the design and development of novel mathematical models that govern how Amazon's Middle Mile network operates. You will work on scientifically complex, poorly structured problems in network planning, scheduling, and transportation operations, inventing and extending techniques from operations research, machine learning, stochastic modeling, and simulation to solve them. This is a modeling-first role: your primary output is rigorous, original scientific work that reduces transportation cost and improves customer experience at scale.

The ideal candidate has deep expertise in at least one relevant scientific discipline and a track record of taking ambiguous business problems from formulation through to production-grade models. You are comfortable owning the scientific agenda for large problem areas, framing the right questions, inventing solutions where no textbook answer exists, and influencing scientists, engineers, and leaders across multiple teams.

Key job responsibilities
**Invent**

- Invent and design new models and algorithms for scientifically complex problems in transportation network planning, scheduling, equipment selection, and labor optimization

- Frame ambiguous, poorly defined business problems into tractable scientific formulations, distinguishing problems that require novel research from those addressable with existing techniques

- Extend the state of the art in operations research, optimization, machine learning, and stochastic/discrete-event simulation as the problem demands

- Author internal and external peer-reviewed publications where appropriate and not precluded by business considerations


**Implement**

- Lead the design, implementation, and delivery of production-grade models for complex, system-level problems, working from concept through deployment with engineering partners

- Develop code (Python, Java, C++, Julia, or similar) to build, validate, and productionize models at Amazon Code Bar quality where models ship to production

- Build models that are maintainable, extensible, accurate, and cost-effective, making principled trade-offs between scientific rigor and speed of execution

- Design and run experiments and simulations to validate assumptions, quantify benefits, and gate rollouts on solution quality


**Influence**

- Drive the scientific agenda for medium-to-large problem areas, proposing new initiatives and securing leadership buy-in

- Influence science and engineering strategy across multiple teams, building consensus and resolving contentious technical trade-offs

- Mentor and develop other scientists, raise the team's scientific bar, and participate actively in the hiring process

- Communicate complex scientific findings and recommendations clearly to technical and non-technical audiences, including senior leadership

About the team
The Network Engineering, Scheduling, and Technology (NEST) Science Team prototypes, builds, and productionizes mathematical models that reduce transportation cost and improve customer experience in Amazon's Middle Mile network. Equipped with techniques from Operations Research, Machine Learning, and Simulation, these models govern scheduling and equipment selection of hundreds of thousands of truck movements, optimize network configurations, determine transit times between nodes, and simulate network flow under uncertainty for informed decision making. Our core team consists of Applied, Data, and Research Scientists along with technical Product Managers from diverse backgrounds.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of investigating the feasibility of applying scientific principles and concepts to business problems and products experience
- PhD, or Master's degree and 5+ years of quantitative field research experience
- Experience with big data technologies such as AWS, Hadoop, Spark, Pig, Hive etc.
- Experience communicating qualitative research methods and findings to non-qualitative researchers

Preferred qualifications

- Experience converting research studies into tangible real-world changes
- Experience with discrete and continuous optimization methodologies and algorithms

title: Senior Applied Scientist, Computer Vision and Robotics, Amazon Robotics
descriptionHtml:
Come shape the future of robotic sensing hardware by building the computer vision and ML systems that define how every robot in Amazon's global fulfillment network sees, senses, and understands the world. This is applied science embedded in a hardware development team where you directly shape what gets built, manufactured, and deployed at scale.

As a Senior Applied Scientist on the Amazon Robotics Sensing and Compute hardware team, you will be the ML and perception expert working alongside the Principal Applied Scientist and Principal Hardware Development Engineer to shape the future of deployed and scaled sensing hardware. You will influence sensor selection, compute architecture, optical design, and system level trade offs, ensuring the hardware we build is purpose designed for the algorithms that run on it. You will help define what the next generation of cameras, depth sensors, and edge compute modules need to be, and then prove it with data, experimentation, and production validation.

What makes this role unique:
-Embedded in the hardware development team, directly influencing what gets designed, manufactured, and shipped
-Partner with the Principal Engineers to co define the sensing and compute hardware roadmap for every major Amazon Robotics program
-Own the ML experimentation and validation that drives hardware architecture decisions for cameras, depth sensors, and edge compute
-Solve perception problems no other company is tackling: safety rated vision, multi modal sensor fusion, and real time inference on resource constrained hardware
-Ship to hundreds of fulfillment sites worldwide across autonomous mobile robots, manipulation workcells, barcode sensing, and safety rated human collaborative systems
-Your work does not sit in a research queue. It goes into production hardware that enables the future of Amazon Robotics


Key job responsibilities
-Partner with the Principal Hardware Development Engineer and Principal Applied Scientist to co define sensing and compute hardware requirements, ensuring ML and perception needs drive sensor selection, optical design, compute architecture, and system level trade offs
-Develop and optimize computer vision and deep learning models for robotic perception including object detection, depth estimation, scene understanding, and barcode recognition, purpose built for edge deployment on resource constrained hardware
-Lead ML experimentation and validation that directly informs hardware architecture decisions for cameras, depth sensors, and edge compute modules
-Design and execute benchmarking frameworks to evaluate sensing hardware performance across diverse robotic use cases, providing data driven recommendations on what to build next
-Optimize models for production edge deployment including quantization, pruning, distillation, and inference pipeline tuning to meet strict latency, power, and accuracy requirements
-Drive research and experimentation on next generation perception capabilities in collaboration with the Principal Applied Scientist, including multi modal sensor fusion, safety rated vision, and real time inference for autonomous and human collaborative robotics
-Collaborate cross functionally with hardware engineers, software developers, and robotics program teams to transition models from prototype through production validation and fleet deployment
-Contribute to the sensing and compute hardware roadmap alongside the Principal Applied Scientist, identifying where ML trends and emerging capabilities require new hardware architecture or sensor modalities
-Mentor engineers and scientists on ML best practices for embedded systems and production robotics
-Publish and present research to advance the state of the art in robotic perception

A day in the life
In this role you will work at the intersection of machine learning and physical robotics hardware. You will collaborate with hardware engineers to evaluate how your models perform on real sensors and edge compute, run experiments that directly influence what gets built next, and validate perception systems alongside robotics program teams. You will push the boundaries of computer vision for robotic applications while seeing your work deploy on real robots in real fulfillment centers. This is applied science with immediate, measurable impact at a scale no other robotics company can offer.

Amazon offers a full range of benefits that support you and eligible family members, including domestic partners. Benefits can vary by location, the number of regularly scheduled hours you work, length of employment, and job status such as seasonal or temporary employment. 3. Paid Time Off (PTO)
4. 401(k) Plan

About the team
The Amazon Robotics Sensing and Compute team powers a customer centric ecosystem built for speed, quality, and innovation. We stay ahead of sensing and compute technology, standardize reusable and cost effective modules, and pair them with deep engineering expertise and a robust supply chain. Every customer gets the right solution, whether off the shelf, rapidly customized, or purpose built, easy to integrate and ready to scale. We are a small, fast moving team of builders who own the full stack from optics through edge compute and take pride in shipping production hardware that enables every major robotics program in Amazon's global fulfillment network. If you want your work to matter on day one, this is the team.

Basic qualifications

- PhD, or Master's degree and 6+ years of applied research experience
- Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language
- Experience building complex software systems, especially involving deep learning, machine learning and computer vision, that have been successfully delivered to customers
- Experience with one or more deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or equivalent
- Experience with 2D and 3D vision tasks including object detection, segmentation, depth estimation, or point cloud processing
- Experience optimizing ML models for deployment on resource constrained hardware including quantization, pruning, or distillation techniques
- Experience in written and verbal communication with the ability to present complex technical information in a clear and concise manner to executives and non-technical leaders

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with robotic perception systems in industrial, warehouse, or manufacturing environments
- -Experience with sensor fusion across multiple modalities (RGB, depth, lidar, time of flight)

title: Lab Engineer II, Global Materials Science
descriptionHtml:
Join Amazon's Global Materials Science (GMS) organization as a Lab Engineer and be part of pioneering sustainable e-commerce packaging. In this hands-on role, you'll conduct materials testing and characterization that directly supports the development of breakthrough packaging materials. You'll work in state-of-the-art laboratories, operating advanced testing equipment, executing experiments, and generating critical data that enables our team to make informed decisions about materials that touch millions of customer experiences daily.

Key job responsibilities
Materials Testing & Characterization:
- Conduct hands-on materials testing using equipment including tensile testers, burst testers, tear testers, rheometers, and other materials characterization tools.
- Execute test protocols following TAPPI, ASTM, ISO, and ISTA standards as well as internal developed methods.
- Perform testing on packaging materials including paper substrates, adhesives, coatings, and alternative fiber materials.
- Operate and maintain laboratory equipment, ensuring proper calibration and functionality
- Prepare test and store specimens according to specifications and standard operating procedures
- Identify, recommend, and help implement improved lab processes for the team. Learning to create mechanisms.

Data Collection & Analysis:
- Collect, organize, and document experimental data with high accuracy and attention to detail.
- Analyze test results and identify trends or anomalies in materials performance.
- Generate clear and concise test reports summarizing findings and observations.
- Support data-driven decision making by providing reliable, high-quality test results

Laboratory Operations:
- Follow standard operating procedures (SOPs) and work instructions for all testing activities
- Maintain a safe, clean, and organized laboratory environment.
- Participate in laboratory safety programs and equipment maintenance schedules.
- Assist in identifying opportunities to improve testing efficiency and data quality.
- Support inventory management of laboratory supplies and test materials

Cross-Functional Support:
- Collaborate with Advanced Materials Engineers and scientists on experimental design and execution.
- Communicate test results, status updates, and any issues or blockers to team members.
- Support supplier qualification activities by conducting materials testing on vendor samples.
- Assist with sample preparation and testing for field trials and deployment validation.
- Participate in team meetings and contribute to project planning discussions.

Documentation & Continuous Improvement:
- Contribute to the development and refinement of test procedures and SOPs
- Document experimental procedures, observations, and results clearly and thoroughly.
- Identify and recommend improvements to testing methods and laboratory processes.
- Learn and apply materials science principles to understand the significance of test results.
- Seek feedback and continuously develop technical skills and domain knowledge.

Work Environment:
- Primarily laboratory-based work with hands-on equipment operation.
- Standard lab safety protocols and PPE requirements.
- Occasional lifting of materials and equipment (up to 50 lbs), standing, walking, kneeling throughout the day.
- Collaborative team environment with regular interaction with scientists and engineers.

A day in the life
Your day starts in the lab preparing test specimens—cutting paper samples to precise dimensions and conditioning them in the environmental chamber. You're supporting a critical adhesive development project, and today's testing will determine if the new formulation meets performance requirements.

Mid-morning, you're running tensile and burst tests on paper samples, carefully following the test protocol and recording data in real-time. The results look interesting—you notice the tear strength is higher than previous samples and flag this for the materials engineer leading the project.

After lunch, you're operating the rheometer to characterize viscosity profiles of new hot melt adhesive samples from three different suppliers. You meticulously document the temperature ramps and flow behavior, knowing this data will directly inform sourcing decisions.

Your afternoon includes calibrating equipment, organizing test data into clear summary reports, and preparing samples for tomorrow's environmental conditioning tests. You also participate in a team meeting where you present your week's testing results—your data shows one supplier's material consistently outperforms the others.
This is hands-on work that matters. The tests you conduct today generate the data that enables breakthrough materials innovations, supports major procurement decisions, and ultimately improves packaging for millions of customers while advancing Amazon's sustainability goals.

About the team
The Global Materials Science (GMS) organization is Amazon's Center of Excellence for packaging materials development and supply chain transformation. Our team represents a fundamental shift in how Amazon approaches packaging innovation—owning the invention, development, and optimization of materials that power our fulfillment network.

Our Mission: We build deep expertise in packaging materials through rigorous research and testing, develop innovative packaging solutions that unlock automation potential and sustainability improvements, and establish robust supply chains that deliver superior solutions at lower cost.

Our Vision: To be the global leader in e-commerce packaging materials science and innovation, enabling the best customer packaging experience at the lowest cost to serve.

What Makes Us Unique: We're not just specifying materials—we're fundamentally understanding them through the materials science triangle framework (processing, structure, properties). Our integrated capabilities span from molecular-level materials characterization, to full packaging system testing, to automation compatibility testing. This end-to-end ownership enables us to innovate faster, unlock step-change improvements previously thought impossible.

Our Impact: We're driving Amazon's transition from plastic to paper packaging, developing breakthrough materials and establishing supply chains that reduce costs while advancing our 2040 net-zero commitment. Our work directly influences automation success, customer experience, and sustainability metrics.

Our Culture: We operate with high technical rigor while moving at startup speed. We embrace calculated risk-taking in R&D, fail fast, and iterate based on data. We believe in radical collaboration—our success requires seamless partnership across engineering, procurement, operations, and sustainability teams. We value both technical excellence and the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

Our Team: We bring together materials scientists, chemists, engineers, lab technicians, and program managers who are passionate about solving hard problems. We partner with world-class academic institutions, leading materials suppliers, and internal Amazon teams to push the boundaries of what's possible in packaging materials.

title: Sr Software Development Manager, Managed Agents, AWS
descriptionHtml:
Running AI agents in the cloud is an exciting, quickly-evolving area, and successfully deploying them at scale can be difficult. An agent runs for minutes or hours, calls tools, writes and runs code, and keeps state across many turns. It has to do all of that inside a customer's security boundary, with the same trust, reliability, isolation, and auditability that customers expect from any other AWS service. Our team builds the managed services that makes this possible. Customers define their agent definitions, and we run them as a fully managed AWS service: provisioning, sandboxed execution, session state, identity, observability, and scaling.

The service covers the whole agent lifecycle. It creates and configures agents, runs long-lived sessions with durable state, executes tools and code in isolated environments, connects to customer data and systems with appropriate identity, and gives customers the logs, metrics, and controls they need to run agents in production. We work closely with leading model providers to bring their agent experiences to AWS customers. That means our engineers solve problems at the boundary between AWS customers, frontier labs, and AWS cloud infrastructure.

As Sr. SDM for Managed Agents, you will lead a team of senior engineers building one of the newest and fastest-growing areas of AWS. You will own the technical strategy and roadmap for the service, partner with model providers and AWS service teams, and be responsible for all aspects of its end-to-end engineering, operations, and growth. This is an early-stage service. You will set the engineering bar, hire and grow the team, and make architectural decisions that influence how enterprises run AI agents for years to come.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of engineering team management experience
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science (or related field) or equivalent work experience
- 10+ years' experience in the development of mission-critical system software, with experience working on distributed systems, machine learning infrastructure, or large-scale data platforms

Preferred qualifications

- Experience building or operating services that run untrusted or customer-supplied code, such as serverless compute, container platforms, or sandboxed execution environments
- Experience developing and deploying cloud-based AI/ML technology, particularly LLM inference, agent frameworks, or tool-use and orchestration systems
- Deep knowledge of identity and access control in multi-tenant systems, including credential delegation and least-privilege design
- Experience leading technical partnerships with external companies, especially co-developing a product with a partner
- 5+ years' experience partnering with product, sales, and customer success teams to launch and grow a new service
- Advanced degree: Masters or PhD in Computer Science or Engineering, or an MBA or similar business qualification

title: Sr Tech Infra Program Manager, DCPD
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Amazon Web Service (AWS) is a comprehensive, evolving, and growing business unit within Amazon.com. Since early 2006, AWS has provided a highly reliable, scalable, low-cost cloud infrastructure platform that empowers hundreds of thousands of businesses in 190 countries to innovate and invent.

Do you have the business background, complex cross functional program management experience, financial expertise, legal/regulatory comprehension and technical understanding? Can you communicate effectively, find clarity in ambiguity, and simplicity in complexity ? Have you managed complex infrastructure projects ?

If yes, then come and explore this exciting role. This role in Amazon Data Services India Private Limited (ADSIPL) Hyderabad, Telengana builds infrastructure that hosts AWS cloud services. It delivers AWS cloud infrastructure in a challenging, high growth, fast paced and customer focused work environment. In this role, you will lead cross functional teams to deliver usable data center capacity. You will partner with senior stakeholders to develop, document, manage and deliver infrastructure designs, implementation schedules and budgets. You will earn trust of your partners in your ability to solve complex issues and steer teams in right direction to deliver results, on-time and at-cost.

You must be an exceptionally strong communicator (both written and verbal), and possess relevant experience in managing technical and strategic programs. If you bring past experience in data center deployment programs, great. If not, then having a background in program and project management, architecture/design, mechanical/electrical engineering, software/hardware engineering managing a team with strong urge to learn will be essential.

Come Join us, have fun, and create history!!

Key job responsibilities
Senior Infrastructure TPM owns delivery of new DC across one or more availability zones in Hyderabad, Telangana India. The Sr TIPM manages delivery of ~5 projects at any time. They bridge internal customers, business functions, (Planning, Finance, Procurement, Legal, Policy, Operations), and functional delivery teams (Construction, Commissioning, Controls, Fiber and Network) to enable on-time and right sized delivery of new DC capacity. The Sr TIPM is able to guide and develop partner teams to accomplish the regions goal.

The scope begins with early expansion planning, which includes a feasibility analysis to approve expansion plans and associated build timelines. They evaluate multiple factors prior to approving a new plan of record, including owned/leased/collocated DC supply, utility delivery (power, water, and fiber), and long lead equipment (LLE) availability. It requires region-wide knowledge and monitoring of in-flight projects, major risks, and remediation efforts to ensure DC delivery is not only on track to meet supply commitments but also to meet customer demand, which is constantly changing.

A successful TPM Manager must be capable of managing a combination of metrics, tools, and mechanisms to remain aware of ongoing risks or issues that require their action, decision, mitigations, or effort to identify alternative solutions communicating up, down, and across the organization to align direction, gain support and drive remediation efforts


About the team
Diverse Experiences
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Inclusive Team Culture
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our department, Data Center Planning and Delivery (DCPD), sponsors leadership programs that support the growth and development of builders across the organization. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events build stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation draws on the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship and Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

- 4+ years of project management experience

descriptionHtml:
Are you interested in solving the most critical operations problem behind cutting-edge robotics development? Interested in fast dynamic environment? Amazon's Frontier AI & Robotics (FAR) team is building advanced robotic systems through frontier foundation models, and high-quality data collection is a core input to that research.

Key job responsibilities
Own the technical execution and continuous improvement of early-stage data collection for advanced robotics. Partner with researchers to translate research objectives into reliable collection workflows, improve data quality, and shorten policy training iteration cycles. Work independently within agreed priorities, providing hands-on technical guidance to data collectors and coordinating execution across research, engineering, and operations.

In this role, you will
- Own end to end collection iterations for assigned research tasks, from requirements and station readiness through pilot data collection, quality review, and delivery of training-ready data. Coordinate dependencies and resolve blockers to meet agreed quality and turnaround goals.

- Bachelor's degree or above in Operations Research, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, Engineering, Computer Science or related field, or experience working in Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics (STEM)
- Demonstrated ability to deliver independently within defined objectives, coordinate multiple partner teams, and resolve operational blockers with limited guidance
- Experience diagnosing hardware, software, or process issues, using evidence to identify root causes and implement corrective actions
- Strong problem-solving and systems-thinking skills, including the ability to assess risks and make sound technical decisions with incomplete information
- Working understanding of how collection quality, task coverage, and consistency affect model training and evaluation, with the ability to translate research requirements into executable procedures and quality checks
- Demonstrated ability to train and mentor others and communicate complex information clearly to technical and nontechnical audiences, including remote teams and colleagues who use English as a second language

Preferred qualifications

- 2+ years of experience in technical operations, engineering, technical project management, or a related role involving hands-on ownership of complex systems or workflows
- Experience developing SOPs, technical documentation, performance metrics, and process improvements, and ensuring their adoption
- Experience with robotics, teleoperation, egocentric video, or multimodal sensor data

- Familiarity with sensor calibration, timestamp synchronization, pose tracking, and data integrity checks
- Experience using vibe coding agents to build and maintain lightweight operational tools
- Experience taking an experimental workflow from initial pilot through repeatable execution across multiple stations or teams

title: Global Process Manager, AWS GFO, AWS Global Field OPerations (GFO)
descriptionHtml:
Do you love fixing how work gets done, not just writing it down? Help AWS make operational processes simpler, safer and faster for field teams supporting infrastructure in places most people never see.

As a Global Process Manager, you'll own a set of global processes from start to finish and lead improvement projects that measurably change how teams around the world work. This isn't a documentation role. You'll find where work slows down, fix it with the people doing it, and use AI tools to keep processes current, so your time goes into improvement.

In this role you will:
- Lead improvement projects from workflow mapping to measurable results
- Own and continuously improve global operational processes
- Help new programs design their ways of working from scratch
- Partner with field technicians, program managers, operations leaders, and safety and security teams
- Use AI tools to cut manual effort and keep processes up to date

Key job responsibilities
- Lead process improvement projects from start to finish: map the current workflow, find the waste, run workshops with the people doing the work, and follow actions through to measurable results.
- Own a portfolio of global operational processes and keep them accurate, simple and easy to follow.
- Review and act on incoming change requests from field technicians, program teams and partners, and spot the patterns that point to a bigger problem.
- Design processes from scratch for new programs and customers, working with their teams to get them ready to launch.
- Use AI tools to draft, update and maintain process documentation, cutting manual effort so your time goes into improvement.
- Set improvement targets for your processes, track them with data, and report progress to operations leaders.
- Work with safety, security and quality partners so processes meet safety and compliance standards.
- Step in quickly when a field issue needs a procedure changed, and make sure the fix sticks.
- Share what works across teams, including supporting teams that don't have their own process expertise.

A day in the life
Your main focus is making global operational processes work better. Most weeks you're running an improvement project: mapping a workflow with the team, running a workshop to find waste, then following up on the actions until they're done and the results show up in the data.

You also own a set of processes from start to finish. You'll handle change requests from technicians and program teams around the world, talk with the people who use your processes, and update them yourself with AI tools, so your time goes on improving things rather than paperwork.

Some days you'll help a new program build its processes from scratch, or step in when something in the field needs a fast fix.

About the team
We support AWS infrastructure outside the traditional data center: at customer sites, partner locations and new programs around the world. Our mission is to give these customers the best end-to-end support, safely and reliably, wherever the work happens.

You'll join a small global process team that gives field technicians, coordinators and partner vendors clear, simple ways of working. You'll work with operations leaders, program managers, safety and security partners, and the people doing the work on site.

The problems you'll solve are real and visible: steps that slow technicians down, handoffs that break between teams, and new programs that need processes built from scratch. We're growing quickly, so there's more work than people, and plenty of room to shape how we operate.

- Experience building processes, project management, and schedules
- Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization
