title: Applied Scientist, AWS Agentic AI
descriptionHtml:
The best coding assistants have to do two hard things together: understand code as the structured, interconnected system it really is, and keep learning from every interaction so they get better over time. Most AI tools today do neither well. They flatten code into tokens and lose the structure that makes software navigable, and they start each session from scratch, forgetting what they learned yesterday about a developer's codebase, patterns, and way of working. Amazon Web Services (AWS) is assembling an elite team of scientists and engineers to change both at once, and we are hiring an Applied Scientist who will work across code understanding and continual learning as a single, connected problem. You will help create generative AI technologies, including Kiro IDE and CLI, that are transforming how software gets built.

In this role you will turn the many signals around code, from static analysis and symbol graphs to build systems and language servers, into a unified representation our models can reason over, and you will make that system learn over time, so it accumulates knowledge without forgetting what it already knew, retrieves the right memory at the right moment, and personalizes the experience for each developer and team. These are not two separate jobs. A system that understands code deeply is also the one best positioned to remember and personalize how it helps, and you will own that intersection end to end. Your work will reach millions of developers rather than sit in a paper.

Key job responsibilities
- Build representations of code that fuse static analysis, symbol and call graphs, type information, and build system context, and that models can use at repository scale

- Make those systems learn over time through memory-augmented architectures, retrieval mechanisms, and personalization that consolidate and recall knowledge across sessions

- Invent and implement state-of-the-art machine learning solutions that operate at unprecedented Amazon scale

- Deploy products that directly impact the daily workflows of millions of developers worldwide

- Publish and present your work at premier ML, NLP, and software engineering conferences (NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, ACL, EMNLP, ICSE, FSE)

- Accelerate innovation by working directly with customers to rapidly transition research breakthroughs into production systems

About the team
Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Hybrid Work
We value innovation and recognize this sometimes requires uninterrupted time to focus on a build. We also value in-person collaboration and time spent face-to-face. Our team affords employees options to work in the office every day or in a flexible, hybrid work model near one of our U.S. Amazon offices.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of building models for business application experience
- PhD, or Master's degree and 4+ years of CS, CE, ML or related field experience
- Experience in patents or publications at top-tier peer-reviewed conferences or journals
- Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language
- Experience in any of the following areas: algorithms and data structures, parsing, numerical optimization, data mining, parallel and distributed computing, high-performance computing

Preferred qualifications

- Experience using Unix/Linux
- Experience in professional software development

title: Customer Solutions Manager , AWSI
descriptionHtml:
We are seeking a Customer Solutions Manager (CSM) to join our global Strategic Industries team. In this new, highly visible role, you will be responsible for helping guide AWS customers along their multi-year journey to the cloud, ensuring that all AWS teams are working together effectively and efficiently to deliver outcomes for the customer.

Our team is committed to helping industry enterprise customers enable their digital transformation journeys. Our primary goal is to meet customers where they are in their cloud journey and work backwards from their industry specific needs to transform their business and their entire industry. Our team speaks the language of our industry customers, which means that we focus on business outcomes and industry use cases on behalf of our customers, whether that is how we build products and solutions, how we sell, how we deliver, or how we partner.
If you are excited about the prospect of using your cloud architecture experience to assist our most valuable customers, tackling challenging problems, have a hand in shaping the future of cloud adoption, enhancing and growing your own skills, and having fun, then we would love to hear from you.

You will be a critical partner to our customers, leveraging your experience with large scale cloud transformations and helping shepherd them through their stages of AWS adoption. Guiding the customer through the operational, educational, and governance aspects of a successful AWS cloud journey.

You will interface with customer and AWS leadership, driving collaboration between the other core account groups (Sales, Support, Solutions Architecture, and Professional Services), product/engineering teams, and customer teams, planning and supporting major workload migrations. You will translate strategic initiatives in the account plan into executable actions, working backwards from our customers key milestones. You will manage cadence by leading the reporting and tracking functions along the way. The execution of education plans, roadmap to business outcome alignments, Executive Briefing Sessions, and go-live events and transitions are a few items owned by the CSM that are critical to the success of our customer’s cloud journey.

You are encouraged to think big, invent and take ownership on customer challenges. You will not only bring the best of AWS/Amazon to our customers, you will proactively help solve the customer’s challenges through new ideas, tools and mechanisms.

Successful candidates will have a strong technical background, be aware of details that matter, have excellent problem-solving abilities, and be exemplary communicators both at the executive and project team level. You will be a peer leader, have the ability to gain stakeholder buy-in, negotiate and lead virtual teams. Your enterprise cloud experience and operational excellence will influence the team’s decisions, provide insight, and help drive secure and robust solutions.
You will evangelize AWS services and influence customers for adopting them. You should be passionate about delivering a great customer experience by deploying AWS solutions and driving innovation, and also be obsessed with contributing to the day-to-day management of customers’ successful migration to AWS.
Key job responsibilities

You will establish a deep understanding of your customer’s business vision, culture and processes, and evangelize AWS services and influence customers to adopt the right solution at the right time.

Customer Solution Managers (CSM) are responsible for four focus areas:
1/Accelerating AWS Adoption through Delivery and Execution
2/Identify & Align on Strategic Opportunities: CSMs work with the Customer Account team to work backwards from the customer to identify and pursue strategic cloud opportunities. These strategic cloud opportunities can include but are not limited to large-scale migrations, GenAI, data and analytics, digital innovation, high performance computing, product innovation, and business agility.
3/Customer Enablement, you will serve as the customer’s cloud journey coach and be the voice of the customer within AWS, evangelizing customer needs to AWS leadership, product, and engineering teams.
4/Implement governance structures to effectively govern both our partnership with the customer, and the customer’s adoption of AWS.

These interconnected focus areas will enable CSMs to effectively drive cloud adoption, pursue strategic growth opportunities, and empower customer success - all of which are critical to achieving the Automotive & Manufacturing IBU’s objectives. By aligning CSM activities, goals, and opportunities under these focus areas, the Automotive & Manufacturing CSM team can ensure a disciplined, customer-centric approach that maximizes business impact and revenue realization for AWS.

title: Principal, Senior, Distinguished Engineer, AWS Foundational Data & Storage Services, AWS Foundational Data & Storage Services
descriptionHtml:
We are hiring Principal, Senior, and Distinguished Engineers to join AWS Foundational Data & Storage Services.


AWS Foundational Data & Storage Services is redefining how the world stores, serves, and reasons over data in the age of AI. Our vision is to make every byte of enterprise data instantly durable, infinitely scalable, and intelligent by default — so that organizations of any size can turn their data into insight and action. We pair decades of hard-won operational experience with relentless curiosity to build the foundational services the rest of the cloud is built on: object storage (Amazon S3), block storage (Amazon EBS), archival storage (Amazon S3 Glacier), analytics and database engines (Amazon Redshift, EMR, SageMaker), and the ultra-high-performance caching layers that make generative AI and analytics fast and trustworthy at enterprise scale. We're hiring Principal and Senior Principal Engineers across the org to own technical direction for some of our hardest problems: building a new cache product purpose-built for GenAI and analytics — delivering ultra-low-latency, ultra-high-throughput access to S3 data at exponential scale; setting architecture for S3 storage at the exabyte tier; and driving the engineering direction of SageMaker, Redshift, EMR, and AWS Database Services. These are deep, high-ownership systems roles — some remote-eligible, others anchored to hubs like Seattle, Irvine, and Berlin — for engineers who have led org-wide technical strategy and want to see it run in production. If you want to build systems that operate at planet scale — where durability, availability, latency, and failure-mode ownership are first-class concerns measured in eleven nines — this is the team.

What You'll Do

This is a rare chance to own and ship the foundational services the rest of the cloud is built on — not features on top of a platform, but the storage, data, and caching layers that everything else depends on, operating at a scale no one else in the industry touches. You'll architect systems that store and serve exabytes of the world's most critical data, where a single design decision ripples across hundreds of millions of customers and millions of applications.

The problems here are unlike anywhere else. How do you deliver eleven nines of durability while adding net-new capabilities to a service that already stores hundreds of trillions of objects? How do you build a new cache product that serves S3 data at ultra-low latency and ultra-high throughput for GenAI and analytics workloads growing exponentially? How do you evolve block, object, and archival storage — and the analytics and database engines on top of them — without ever compromising the durability, availability, and latency guarantees customers have bet their businesses on? These are deep systems challenges solved in production, at a scale where the usual playbooks break down. You help write the new ones.

The systems you build here don't sit in a backlog — they're load-bearing for the internet: S3, EBS, and Glacier storing the data behind modern AI and analytics; Redshift, EMR, and SageMaker turning that data into insight; and the next generation of high-performance caching making all of it fast. You'll have direct influence over technical choices, minimal layers between you and decisions, and the opportunity to define what foundational data infrastructure looks like in the AI era.

Key job responsibilities
Deliver strategic technical projects and design new storage, data, and caching systems at massive scale

Lead architecture and engineering strategy for foundational services across S3, EBS, Glacier, and the analytics and database layer (Redshift, EMR, SageMaker, AWS Database Services)

Mentor and guide engineers while solving the hardest durability, availability, and latency problems hands-on

Work cross-functionally with Principal Engineers and teams across AWS Foundational Data & Storage Services

Scout and recruit top technical talent, actively growing the engineering community

Drive a strong engineering excellence and operational culture across all services and teams

Shape technical direction for systems where correctness, durability, and failure-mode ownership are first-class, measured in eleven nines

Balance deep systems expertise with strong analytical skills to make informed architectural decisions at scale

Basic qualifications

-10+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
-Knowledge of object-oriented design, data structures, and algorithms

Preferred qualifications

-Experience designing and building large-scale systems in a multi-tiered, distributed environment (Service Oriented Architecture)

descriptionHtml:
There’s a universe of opportunity at Amazon.

This is where your ideas turn into real impact. You’ll work with world class tools, global platforms, and systems built to operate at an extraordinary scale. With endless opportunities to explore across teams and roles, you’ll learn quickly, apply what you know and discover skills you didn’t know existed. This is an environment designed for builders who want to see the impact of their work in the world. Ready to start your adventure?

What’s in it for you?
An internship at Amazon means real responsibility from day one. You’ll build, test, and learn alongside people who want to see you succeed, while making an impact that reaches far beyond campus.

This is a summer only internship, taking place between May/June and August/September 2027. Amazon internships across all seasons are full-time positions. Interns should expect to work in office, Monday through Friday, up to 40 hours per week, typically between 8am and 5pm. Specific team norms around working hours will be communicated by your manager. Students should not have conflicts such as classes or other employment during the Amazon workday.

Applicants should have a minimum of one quarter, semester, or trimester remaining in their studies after their internship concludes. By applying to this position, your application will be considered for all UX Designer Intern roles at the locations we hire for across the United States.

title: Sr. System Dev Engineer, EC2 Core Platforms Engineering
descriptionHtml:
Build the systems that bring Amazon's newest servers to life. As a Systems Development Engineer on EC2 Core Platforms Engineering, you'll lead the technical direction for how we launch new compute platforms, keep the core fleet healthy at massive scale, and automate the way we build, working at the seam between hardware and software.

We own the quality, performance, and reliability of the platforms that host EC2 instances, from lab bring-up through general availability. You'll lead the bring-up and validation of new EC2 server platforms, driving the technical plan across Nitro firmware, operating systems, and provisioning. You'll also set the approach for diagnosing and reducing failures across the core fleet, working to eliminate whole classes of failure rather than individual instances. A big part of the role is defining the architecture for the automation, including AI-driven tooling, that makes platform launches faster, safer, and more repeatable, and driving its adoption across the team and our partners.

You'll partner with hardware engineering, Annapurna, and the Nitro component teams, working on some of the largest compute fleets in the world, where a single improvement in reliability or build automation compounds across millions of hosts. You'll influence the technical strategy and roadmaps of these teams, build consensus where priorities compete, and bring clarity to problems where the right solution isn't yet defined.

Key job responsibilities
- Lead the bring-up and validation of new server platforms that host cloud compute instances, owning the technical plan from early lab testing through production launch, and bringing in hardware, firmware, and Nitro experts where the work needs them.
- Own the approach to reducing hardware and software failures across a large-scale server fleet. Use data to find root causes, and drive permanent fixes and mechanisms that eliminate entire classes of failure and improve reliability.
- Design and lead the software and automation that streamline how new platforms are introduced, setting the standard for provisioning, deployment, and validation so platforms reach production faster and with a high quality bar.
- Take on ambiguous, difficult problems that span firmware, operating systems, networking, and infrastructure. Define the technical strategy and break the work into pieces that you and others can deliver in parallel.
- Improve the safety, agility, and automation of the build and launch process across the team and partner teams. Review designs, operational readiness reviews, post-incident analyses, and code, and raise the bar for operational excellence.
- Mentor and coach engineers, take part in hiring, and help the team succeed without depending on your presence.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of programming with at least one modern language such as C++, C#, Java, Python, Golang, PowerShell, Ruby experience
- 4+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- Knowledge of systems engineering fundamentals (networking, storage, operating systems)
- Experience programming with at least one modern language such as C++, C#, Java, Python, Golang, PowerShell, Ruby

As a Preconstruction Manager within Global Engineering Services (GES) North America (NA) Design & Construction (D&C), you are Amazon's owner's representative during the preconstruction phase — responsible for independently managing difficult, cross-functional industrial building projects from site selection through design completion, permitting, and contract execution across your assigned region. Preconstruction services refers to the planning of a construction project before actual construction begins.

You will partner with internal and external stakeholders to ensure scope, budget, and schedule definition are established, including timely receipt of building and site permits. You are responsible as the project manager to lead planning, design, and preconstruction projects — including new built-to-suit industrial buildings, tenant improvements, extensions of existing facilities, and renovation projects — supporting Amazon's logistics network infrastructure.

You work independently within your assigned region, using your knowledge of construction and project management concepts to decide which actions to take to complete projects, and seeking guidance as needed on strategic components. You are tactical with some strategic components, utilizing well-defined processes and best practices to facilitate delivery of high-quality results. You make trade-offs between time, quality, and resources to keep projects on track.

Key competencies of this position include ensuring that contracted resources deliver work product in support of project durations, permitting, key performance indicators (KPIs), and quality documentation; managing project teams (developers, design engineers, professional consultants); influencing internal teams (Design Engineering, Amazon Robotics); contract management governance; conceptual estimating and budget oversight; and managing multiple large industrial projects in various locations simultaneously. Translating technical documents and information into clear, concise narratives with detailed risk analysis for leaders and customers is essential.

This opportunity combines construction engineering, planning, project management, real estate development, design validation, site visits, understanding of local building and fire code issues, utilities, sustainability, multi-disciplinary design management, and contract management. The Preconstruction Manager is responsible for the planning and design of scope, budget, and schedule prior to handing off to the Construction Manager — focusing on taking ownership to resolve upstream issues and supporting the construction team throughout the process.

This role requires 60% regional travel on a yearly basis. When not traveling, you must have availability to work from a corporate office. Candidates should either live near or be willing to relocate within a reasonable commuting distance of one of the corporate office locations listed. Relocation assistance may be provided.


Key job responsibilities
Safety & Compliance
- Supervise the implementation and management of Amazon's safety programs and standards across all internal and external project teams during the planning and preconstruction phases of a project
- Interface and coordinate with Authorities Having Jurisdiction (AHJ) to ensure regulatory compliance, smooth permitting execution, and timely approvals
- Review noise, traffic, and environmental studies; understand zoning, planning, fire code, and building code requirements for assigned projects

Preconstruction & Project Management
- Independently manage difficult, cross-functional industrial preconstruction projects from site selection through design completion, permitting, and contract execution
- Lead site selection and validation, scope development, and design management — coordinating with design teams to develop site plans and composite floor plans in compliance with Amazon's design standards and operational requirements
- Manage multiple concurrent large industrial projects across various locations simultaneously
- Keep scope under control and accelerate progress by driving crisp, timely decisions, identifying and clearing blockers, and escalating appropriately
- Identify and resolve upstream issues proactively to support a clean handoff to the Construction Manager; remain a key support resource for the construction team throughout the project lifecycle
- Assess project performance through Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) for safety, quality, cost, schedule, and sustainability
- Minimize disruptions and proactively mitigate risks; plan ahead to prevent problems before they happen

Budget, Schedule & Contract Management
- Develop and manage project budgets and costs; own comprehensive schedule management and cashflow forecasting across assigned preconstruction projects
- Perform conceptual estimating and pricing reviews for scope inclusions and exclusions; negotiate the cost of work with developers, general contractors, and design consultants
- Contribute to the selection of external vendor partners and manage vendor procurement; oversee professional service providers to ensure their skills and competencies meet project requirements
- Review and analyze design and construction contracts, related exhibits, and lease agreements; provide detailed analysis of technical matters and site-specific deal structures and terms
- Partner with the Transaction team and developers to optimize schedule and strategy for entitlements and long-lead procurement
- Identify and solve factors that may impede a successful permitted project handover to Amazon stakeholders; make trade-offs between time, quality, and resources

Stakeholder & Vendor Management
- Work with internal and external teams — including Real Estate, Design Engineering, Entitlements, Construction, Finance, Launch/Startup, architects, engineers, permitting agencies, developers, and landlords — to secure resources, scope infrastructure builds, set priorities and milestones, and drive delivery to meet deadlines
- Drive results through communicating, weighing risks, making decisions, leading, and influencing; competently represent project and technical information to diverse audiences
- Maintain good working relationships with stakeholders and vendors; lead constructive dialogue to resolve and prevent project issues
- Act as the primary escalation point for project team members; own and track issues to ensure they are addressed, documented, and resolved

Communication & Reporting
- Prepare and present project status and risk reports; provide clear, concise summaries for projects under your ownership to leadership and management teams
- Translate technical documents and information into end-to-end narratives with detailed risk analysis for leaders and customers
- Run preconstruction meetings effectively — putting the right people in the room, checking progress, and driving high-level alignment and consensus
- Communicate budgets, schedules, project status, and priorities clearly to internal teams and external partners; trusted to present decisions to leaders up to 2-3 tiers above level
- Utilize Amazon's information systems to record and update schedule, budget, and other key project developments
- Represent Amazon's interests in weekly Architect, Owner, and Contractor (AOC) meetings; provide input on root causes and corrective actions

Process Improvement & Innovation
- Optimize preconstruction processes and implement improvements in procedures and playbooks to improve project efficiency and delivery
- Look for opportunities to improve operational excellence and influence the team to determine where to iterate and make improvements
- Seek sustainable, environmentally responsible solutions throughout the preconstruction process in alignment with Amazon's building practices
- Adapt to constant change and innovation; find adaptable solutions for an evolving business

A day in the life
Each day, you represent GES NA Design & Construction as Amazon's owner during the preconstruction phase — navigating uncertainty, proactively unblocking project barriers, and influencing the best project decisions. You are tactical with some strategic components, working independently and interacting with leadership to resolve issues. Your day may include:
- Coordinating with architects, engineers, and design consultants on design document development, scope changes, and project status
- Reviewing site plans, composite floor plans, and design documents for compliance with Amazon's standards and operational requirements
- Negotiating contract terms with developers, contractors, and consultants while driving adherence to schedules and budgets
- Coordinating with AHJ on permitting status, zoning, fire code, and building code requirements
- Preparing and presenting project status and risk reports for leadership
- Partnering with Real Estate and Transaction teams on entitlement strategy and long-lead procurement
- Providing estimating support, interpreting drawings, contributing to budgets, and reviewing lease exhibits
- Updating Amazon's project management systems with current budget, schedule, and status information
- Supporting the Construction Manager on active construction projects with preconstruction expertise

About the team
At Amazon, the GES North America Design & Construction team is a diverse group of engineers, construction managers, and preconstruction professionals who deliver the physical infrastructure behind Amazon's logistics network. We are employee owners who take pride in delivering high-quality, innovative facilities — on time and on budget — for our internal customers and the communities we serve. We are committed to being Earth's best employer and to building a more sustainable future through every project we deliver.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Architecture, Construction Management, Engineering, or a related field
- 5+ years of experience as an Architect, Engineer, Construction Manager, Development Manager, Owner's Project Management Representative, or in a related commercial development or construction discipline
- 5+ years of project management experience from design phase through implementation and operation, including negotiating construction, procurement, and labor contracts
- Experience within packaging, processing, or logistical facilities with complex equipment, or comparable experience
- Position includes travel up to 60% (Nationwide). Travel involves air travel to regional airports and driving to site locations. A valid driver's license is required due to project assignments in areas with limited public transportation and rideshare options.

Preferred qualifications

- Advanced degree or certification in Architecture, Engineering, Construction Management, or Business Administration
- Experience operating across at least two disciplines within the construction industry (e.g., General Contracting, Owner's Representation, Commercial Development, Engineering & Design, or Owner's Project Management)
- Demonstrated capability in planning, design review, implementation, and project management/control of new structures and enhancement of existing facilities
- Experience managing multi-disciplinary design incorporating industrial automation, robotics, or similar
- Strong influencing and negotiating skills
- Demonstrated success communicating project requirements to diverse audiences (e.g., senior management, peers, fire marshals, utility providers, public officials, vendors)

title: Sr. Software Dev Engineer, AWS EKS
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Web Services is looking for a Sr. Software Development Engineer to join our growing Amazon Elastic Container Services for Kubernetes (EKS) team. Amazon EKS is our managed Kubernetes service that makes it easy for customers to use Kubernetes without needing to become experts in provisioning and operating Kubernetes. EKS manages time-consuming administrative tasks like setting up, operating, scaling and updating Kubernetes, freeing customers up to focus on their applications.

The EKS Networking team builds the networking stack that connects customer workloads running on EKS clusters. We own the VPC CNI, which runs in the majority of EKS clusters worldwide, and an eBPF-based network policy enforcement path that replaced third-party dependencies with a native implementation. We are now building a service mesh, an Istio or Istio-like capability (traffic management, mTLS, policy, and observability) that avoids the per-pod sidecar tax by leaning on the kernel and the networking stack we already own. You will be joining a fast paced team working on greenfield projects, building the data path for that mesh.

You will own how traffic is intercepted, encrypted, and forwarded between services, deciding where Layer 4 and mTLS live (a per-node proxy and the kernel) versus where Layer 7 processing happens, and owning the performance budget that justifies a sidecarless design. You will be solving challenging technical problems, often ones not solved before, alongside peers with remarkable technical expertise. The solutions you build will be high impact and rolled out to our large customer base across the world. If you are excited to work in a dynamic environment, we would love to hear from you!

Mentorship & Career Growth Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we're building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. Our senior members enjoy one-on-one mentoring and thorough, but kind, code reviews. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects based on what will help each team member develop into a better-rounded engineer and enable them to take on more complex tasks in the future.

Key job responsibilities
Key job responsibilities
- Design the mesh data path: traffic interception, encryption, and forwarding between services without a per-pod sidecar.
- Decide where Layer 4 and mTLS enforcement live (per-node proxy and the kernel) versus where Layer 7 processing happens, and own the handoff between them.
- Own the data path performance budget (latency, CPU, memory) against a per-pod sidecar baseline, with measured results.
- Partner with the control plane, kernel/eBPF, and protocols engineers whose subsystems run inside the path you design.
- Raise the bar through design reviews and code reviews, and mentor engineers building on the data path.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 5+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience
- 5+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team

Preferred qualifications

- 5+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

title: Principal Accounting Manager, Amazon Stores
descriptionHtml:
Amazon's Stores business is the heart of how we serve hundreds of millions of customers worldwide — spanning our fulfillment network, transportation and logistics, physical stores, and the capital infrastructure that powers them. Supporting the continued expansion of this business requires individuals with deep accounting experience AND the entrepreneurial aptitude to accelerate decision making and management of the business and its accounting. Also needed is the intellectual capacity to produce innovative ideas/analysis and the willingness to take end-to-end ownership in implementing those decisions.

As the Stores Infrastructure Technical Accounting subject matter expert, you will own the end-to-end accounting for new financing initiatives that support Amazon's worldwide operations and infrastructure expansion. This includes real estate and equipment leasing, fleet and material-handling-equipment (MHE) financing and/or leasing arrangements, build-to-suit and sale-leaseback structures, and other emerging capital programs across the Stores network. You will be surrounded by people that are exceptionally talented, bright, and driven, and believe that world class support is critical to customer and business success. To support this quickly growing business, you must be highly analytical and possess a strong passion for analytics and accountability, setting high standards, and making decisions that are right a lot.

As the Principal Accounting Manager, you will serve as the single-threaded owner of accounting policy, controls, and reporting for the Stores leasing and financing activities — upholding an exceptionally high controllership bar across every transaction, control, and disclosure. Your ability to make a difference and take ownership begins on Day One. You will partner cross-functionally with Finance, Business, Treasury, Tax, Legal, FP&A, and Tech teams to stand up new accounting frameworks, design and strengthen the control environment, drive system implementations, and ensure compliance with relevant accounting standards.

Key job responsibilities
This position will be responsible for:
• Own the end-to-end accounting lifecycle for Stores CapEx, infrastructure, and leasing financing transactions.
• Assess the accounting for new business events, transactions, and structures across the relevant technical literature including ASC 842 (Leases), ASC 815 (Derivatives and Hedging), and ASC 360 (Assets Held for Sale) and determine the appropriate treatment.
• Lead the implementation of accounting structures for new and evolving lease structures across the Stores network (real estate, fleet, and equipment).
• Drive the design and execution of accounting processes in Amazon systems to support lease and financing origination, modification, and termination workflows.
• Develop and maintain lease and financing accounting models, including present value calculations, classification assessments, and ongoing measurement under ASC 842.
• Partner with Treasury, Tax, Legal, FP&A, Finance, Business, and Tech teams to evaluate new financing structures and provide accounting guidance on proposed transactions.
• Set and enforce a high controllership bar: design, implement, and maintain SOX-compliant internal controls over leasing and financing processes, including journal entries, reconciliations, and disclosures, with full audit-readiness.
• Prepare and review technical accounting memos for complex lease/financing arrangements, including sale-leaseback, variable lease payments, embedded lease assessments, embedded derivatives, and held-for-sale conclusions.
• Own monthly close activities for the leasing and financing portfolio, including journal entries, flux analysis, balance sheet reconciliations, and financial statement disclosures.
• Lead cross-functional projects to stand up new leasing and financing programs, coordinating requirements across accounting, systems, operations, and business teams.
• Identify and drive process improvement and automation opportunities to scale leasing and financing operations and enhance the control environment.

Basic qualifications

- 12+ years of finance, accounting, or related analytical field experience
- Bachelor's degree in business, finance, accounting, tax, economics, or a related analytical field

Preferred qualifications

- MBA, or CPA
- Experience in a leadership position managing finance, accounting and operational processes

ソフトウェア、ハードウェア、ネットワークエンジニア、サプライチェーンスペシャリスト、セキュリティエキスパート、オペレーションマネージャー、その他の重要な役割を担う多様なチームに参加していただきます。AWS 全体の人々と協力して、お客様に最低コストで無限の容量を提供しながら、安全性とセキュリティの最高基準を提供できるよう支援していただきます。そして、大胆なアイデアを歓迎し、それを完成まで自分のものとして進める力を与える包括的な文化を体験していただけます。

Key job responsibilities

Amazon Web Services (AWS) は、世界で最も包括的で広く採用されているクラウドプラットフォームです。私たちはクラウドコンピューティングのパイオニアであり、イノベーションを止めることはありません。だからこそ、最も成功しているスタートアップから Global 500 企業まで、幅広いお客様が当社の堅牢な製品・サービスを信頼し、ビジネスを推進しています。

AWS では、学び、好奇心を持つことが私たちの本質です。従業員主導のアフィニティグループは、私たちが自分たちの違いを誇りに思える包括的な文化を育んでいます。Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) や AmazeCon (ジェンダーダイバーシティ) カンファレンスを含む継続的なイベントや学習体験は、私たちが独自性を受け入れることを決して止めないよう刺激を与えてくれます。

title: Network Development Manager, Leo
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is Amazon's low Earth orbit satellite network. Our mission is to deliver fast, reliable broadband connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. From households to small businesses, schools, hospitals, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will serve communities and organizations operating in places without dependable internet access.  

The Network Development Manager (NDM) leads the Terrestrial Networking (TNT) team responsible for designing, building, and operating the ground-infrastructure and Amazon Web Services (AWS) backbone network that connects ground sites — Gateway (GGW) and Telemetry, Tracking & Command (TT&C) sites — to AWS. This leader owns the strategy, delivery, and operational health of terrestrial network connectivity: site network architecture, Direct Connect / backbone integration, device fleet (routing, switching, encryption), and the automation that scales it across regions. They manage a team of network development and systems-development engineers, partner across ground, control-plane, and security organizations, and are accountable for the availability, security, and capacity of the terrestrial network that carries customer and command traffic.


Export Control Requirement
Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.


Key job responsibilities

Lead the Terrestrial Networking (TNT) team that designs, builds, and operates the ground-infrastructure network connecting Ground Gateway (GGW) and Telemetry, Tracking & Command (TT&C) sites, including connectivity into Amazon Web Services (AWS).

1. Hire, develop, and retain Network Development and Systems Development Engineers; set goals, give feedback, and own team planning and roadmap execution across Operating Plan (OP1/OP2) cycles, including sustainable on-call health.
2. Drive ground-site network design and buildout (routing, switching, redundancy, and encryption such as Media Access Control Security and Internet Protocol Security).
3. Own AWS Direct Connect (DX) and backbone integration — Direct Connect Gateways, Virtual Interfaces, Internet Protocol Address Management, and Autonomous System Number / Border Gateway Protocol routing — plus region expansion and new-site turn-up through automation.
4. Review and approve network designs, change plans, and capacity decisions.
5. Own availability, performance, and security of the terrestrial network; define Service Level Objectives, lead high-severity incident response, and drive Correction of Error follow-ups.
6. Partner with ground infrastructure, control-plane, security, and AWS networking teams; represent TNT in design and Operational Readiness Reviews and leadership reporting.
7. Manage vendor, hardware, and capacity planning with supply and site-deployment teams.

title: BIE II, Tax
descriptionHtml:
Amazon is a fast-paced, dynamic, high-tech company based in Seattle. Global Tax Data (GTD) organization provides data management services and supports program and product initiatives that improve tax data integrity across Amazon's global indirect tax compliance operations. GTD ensures timely, accurate data is available for tax compliance reporting and audit readiness, and our teams manage the tax data infrastructure, pipelines, reconciliation tools, and operational reporting that compliance teams rely on worldwide.

As a Business Intelligence Engineer (BIE) II in GTD, you'll build gold-standard analytics datasets and data mart/warehouses while driving the data analysis, reconciliation operations, root-cause investigations, and process improvements that directly support Amazon's monthly tax compliance cycles. You'll partner cross-functionally with your customers in tax compliance and accounting, and with stakeholders across finance technology, to make sure the data behind every filing is complete, accurate, and delivered on time. You'll also work closely with Data Engineering, Software Engineering, and Solutions Architects.

This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys digging into large datasets — spotting patterns, explaining the story behind the variances, and driving issues to resolution independently.

You'll thrive here if you bring strong analytical skills, the ability (or a genuine eagerness to build it) to work with large-scale data, and the business judgment to translate tax and accounting context into the right system configurations.

Key job responsibilities
• Build and own the Gold standard data mart/warehouse for business reporting and analysys
• Perform hands-on reconciliation and detailed analysis of large financial datasets each month, investigating and resolving discrepancies across source systems, tax reporting warehouses, and the general ledger.
• Troubleshoot data quality issues, identify root causes, and drive corrective actions with upstream and downstream teams.
• Partner with compliance and customer teams to understand reporting requirements and translate business objectives into clear data specifications and technical development requirements.
• Develop and maintain operational reports, dashboards, and metrics that give visibility into reconciliation health and data readiness.
• Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, controllership, and data quality — automating manual processes, reducing cycle time, and coaching customer teams on how to use the reporting and functionality you build.
• Own and manage SIM tickets and intake workflows, ensuring timely response and resolution for internal and external stakeholders.
• Support audit data requests by extracting, validating, and delivering data packages to auditors and tax authorities.
• Document standard operating procedures, runbooks, and process flows for recurring operational activities.
• Build strong relationships with key technology providers and technical teams across Amazon, and clearly explain financial and technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
• Contribute to Monthly and Quarterly Business Reviews (MBRs/QBRs) and operational readiness activities.

About the team
We are a fast-growing team supporting the Corporate Tax function. We seek candidates who are eager and able to learn new content quickly, who are willing to venture into unfamiliar territory, and who bring ironclad judgment and integrity when handling confidential information.




A day in the life
Work closely with Tech partners, non-tech customer and team to deliver the required solution.

Basic qualifications

- Experience in analyzing and interpreting data with Redshift, Oracle, NoSQL etc.
- Experience with data visualization using Tableau, Quicksight, or similar tools
- Experience with data modeling, warehousing and building ETL pipelines
- Experience using SQL to pull data from a database or data warehouse and scripting experience (Python) to process data for modeling
- Experience with SQL
- Experience in the data/BI space
- Experience in tax, finance or a related analytical field
- Experience in Excel (including VBA, pivot tables, array functions, power pivots, etc.) and data visualization tools such as Tableau

descriptionHtml:
Application deadline: Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis

The Amazon Web Services Professional Services (ProServe) team is seeking a skilled Senior SAP Technical Consultant to join our team at Amazon Web Services (AWS). You will own the technical architecture and engineering strategy for SAP engagements across ABAP development, BTP extensibility, BASIS operations, and integration delivered within customer environments. You will lead multidisciplinary delivery teams of ABAP developers, BTP engineers, and BASIS professionals on complex SAP S/4HANA RISE migrations and modernization programs, establishing the technical standards, governance, and delivery mechanisms that produce secure, scalable, and maintainable SAP outcomes for AWS customers.

This role requires someone who moves fluidly between enterprise architecture decisions and hands-on technical problem-solving. You will evaluate solution alternatives, define development and extensibility patterns, resolve complex technical risks mid-delivery, and ensure ABAP, BTP, and BASIS workstreams operate as one integrated engineering organization across AWS teams, customer teams, and SI partners.
The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using the AWS Cloud. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing initiatives. Our team provides assistance through a collection of offerings which help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption. We also deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries.

Key job responsibilities
Own the SAP technical architecture across ABAP, BTP, BASIS, integrations, extensibility, and platform operations on active customer engagements

Lead and develop multidisciplinary delivery teams across BASIS, ABAP, and BTP disciplines, establishing clear ownership, priorities, standards, and delivery expectations on every program

Define technical patterns and guardrails for SAP configuration, custom development, workflows, forms, reports, interfaces, conversions, enhancements, and extensions and enforce them across customer and partner teams

Establish and defend clean-core principles on every engagement, determining when requirements are addressed through standard SAP functionality, in-app extensibility, side-by-side BTP extensions, or custom ABAP and holding that line under commercial pressure

Own BTP architecture decisions including account and subaccount design, environments, connectivity, identity, security, application services, integration services, development standards, and lifecycle management

Lead BASIS architecture and operational design across system landscapes, environments, transports, upgrades, patching, performance, capacity, availability, disaster recovery, monitoring, and production support

Establish software development standards covering solution design, coding, peer reviews, automated testing, documentation, source control, CI/CD, transport management, and release governance and embed them into customer delivery teams that will own them post-engagement

Partner with functional architects, customer product teams, and SI partners to convert business requirements into scalable technical designs and accurate delivery estimates

Review and approve technical designs across workstreams, ensuring solutions meet requirements for performance, scalability, security, controls, resilience, supportability, and cost

Develop technical roadmaps, architecture documents, SOW inputs, decision materials, and executive updates that communicate priorities, risks, trade-offs, and required investments to both customer and AWS leadership

Evaluate emerging SAP and generative AI capabilities including Kiro, ABAP Accelerator, and agentic testing frameworks and identify opportunities to improve engineering productivity, user experience, automation, monitoring, and support on active engagements

What Makes This Role Different

You are not maintaining a system. You are building the technical foundation customers rely on after AWS leaves. Every architecture decision, every standard you set, and every pattern you enforce becomes the customer's operational reality. The bar is high, the engagements are complex, and the impact is permanent.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field
- 10+ years of SAP migration, implementation, or consulting experience in software or technology industries
- Experience as a technical lead or mentor on SAP S/4HANA RISE migrations
- Deep expertise in one or more of: ABAP development, SAP BTP, SAP BASIS, SAP integration, or SAP technical architecture

Preferred qualifications

- 10+ years of infrastructure architecture, database architecture, and networking experience in customer-facing delivery contexts
- Deep knowledge of SAP systems including Business Suite, S/4HANA, BW, HANA, and Business Objects and their architecture and infrastructure requirements
- Hands-on experience with SAP clean-core design, including build using non-SAP technologies across Generative AI, agentic AI, and data and analytics
- Experience with ABAP Cloud, Core Data Services, RESTful Application Programming Model, Fiori, SAPUI5, APIs, workflows, forms, and enhancement frameworks
- Experience with SAP BTP services including Integration Suite, Extension Suite, Cloud Foundry, Kyma, SAP Build, Event Mesh, API Management, or related capabilities
- Experience with SAP BASIS and HANA administration across system landscapes, transports, upgrades, performance tuning, high availability, disaster recovery, monitoring, and operational support

title: Senior Site EHS Manager
descriptionHtml:
At Amazon, we prioritize health, safety, and well-being above all else. There is nothing more important. To support this priority, Amazon is seeking an experienced and innovative Senior Site Workplace Health and Safety (WHS) Manager to join our team. In this position, you will be responsible for partnering with the site level operations team for your designated site in order to execute company WHS policies and ensure compliance to all applicable local and regional regulations. By leveraging lean principles and Kaizen events, you will lead continuous improvement initiatives to reduce conditional and ergonomic risk in Amazon’s processes to ensure a safe and healthful working environment for our associates.

In this role, you must demonstrate the ability to build trust and confidence with the cross functional operations teams, and influence change through providing comprehensive risk assessments and safety data analysis. To do so, you must be an effective communicator and send clear, concise and consistent messages, both verbally and in writing. You will also be required to instruct and train operations leadership and site WHS professionals in company EHS policies while assisting the regional teams in incorporating our safety standards at their sites. Your experience working in safety programs and your relevant safety, environmental and ergonomic knowledge in an operations environment will be crucial. You will be responsible for developing a team of safety managers and safety professionals at your designated site. Your teams’ success will depend on your ability to create and execute leadership development plans for your larger team. You must demonstrate your ability to clearly communicate organizational direction through your team. As a senior leader in the WHS organization, you will also be responsible for judging and assessing safety talent to select appropriate bench strength for current and future business needs.

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:
- Act as SME of local/regional regulations and company WHS policy.
- Provide guidance and oversight to ensure compliance to all applicable Amazon Safety Policies.
- Measure site performance against published requirements in safety policies. For all deficiencies, identify a plan for the site to implement and fix all identified deficiencies.
- Ensure safety record keeping and data integrity and provides Operations with accurate reporting and metrics to support business safety initiatives.
- Deliver on-time and quality projects to Operations.
- Deep Dive safety metrics and review incident weekly and monthly incident trends to discover trends to justify the allocation of appropriate resources to areas where the safety risk is highest.
- Deep Dive trends and propose action plans to Sr. Leadership on site.
- Audit record keeping practices and Global Safety Database entries to ensure compliance to global safety standards and local regulations.
- Audit the workplace organization and Associate behaviors to ensure that training, auditing and scoring methods are accurate and consistent.
- Manage and mentor the Safety Managers and Safety Associates in your assigned site.
- Engage the Injury Prevention Specialists (IPS) and Site Leadership to drive long-term strategic actions to achieve incident reduction.
- Perform targeted Kaizen events in partnership with the Operations teams based on the risks identified in each task (force, repetition, and awkward postures).
- Ensure site leadership and associates are trained and knowledgeable of their responsibilities under each policy.
- Audit the quality, delivery (including qualifications of the trainer), and effectiveness of all required safety training.
- Review for effectiveness the deployed safety tools and revise to ensure continual improvement.
- Partner with corporate and other regional field safety personnel to leverage global safety and environmental best practices into NA network standards.

title: Software Engineering Manager, AWS EKS
descriptionHtml:
Amazon's Elastic Kubernetes Service (EKS) is looking for a Software Engineering Manager for one of our infrastructure team that manages EKS compute products including EKS Auto and EKS worker node AMI. We have an ambitious road-map that seeks to redefine how our customers build their applications and run them at scale on AWS and Kubernetes.

Amazon EKS allows our customers to use Kubernetes at scale without the undifferentiated heavy lifting required to manage Kubernetes. Our mission is to accelerate the adoption of AWS by providing the best possible experience for customers using Kubernetes. We are growing fast and we are expanding our team to help build additional features for our customers. This is a great time to join a growing team and help influence what we can do for customers who are adopting Kubernetes as a cornerstone in their AWS strategy.

As a leader of the EKS compute and runtime team you will be responsible for building and owning core services responsible for EKS products including EKS Auto and EKS Hybrid. The teams charter is to manage Kubernetes worker nodes and related software components that help monitor and repair nodes. It is a critical team that helps manage AI/ML workload infrastructure.

Your team will build solutions to ensure the safety and stability of software the team operates, integrate with other AWS services with an eye towards simple and streamlined interfaces. You will own staffing and managing the engineering team, product development, setting the team culture, best practices, and organizational planning. The successful candidate will be able to deal with ambiguity and will need to think big.

In addition to our core compute and runtime charter, this team is at the forefront of running AI/ML and inference workloads on Kubernetes. We ship EKS-optimized AMIs with dual NVIDIA driver support so the newest GPU instance families are ready out of the box without separate per-driver AMIs or slower boot times; we're building a hardware-isolated pod runtime that gives each pod strong isolation on shared nodes to unlock secure multi-tenant and emerging agentic AI use cases; we're accelerating fast model loading to cut cold-start and scale-up latency for large models on GPUs; and we continuously advance GPU and node health monitoring in the EKS Node Monitoring Agent, classifying GPU and fabric faults and detecting failing hardware, so large inference fleets stay healthy and nodes aren't needlessly replaced. It's an exciting opportunity to shape how AWS customers run the next generation of AI/ML workloads at massive scale.

The ideal candidate will be passionate about the potential of cloud computing, and about building simple and elegant software solutions and customer-centric products. This leader has thrived and succeeded in delivering high quality technology products/services in a hyper-growth environment where priorities shift quickly. The candidate is a leader who can prioritize well, communicate clearly and compellingly and who understands how to drive a high level of focus and excellence with a strong team. AWS in general, and this business in particular, operates at very large scale and on critical workloads, so a passion and discipline around operational excellence is key. A high level of ownership and accountability is a must.

title: Support Engineer, Identity and Access Management
descriptionHtml:
Amazon's Security Compliance Investigations team protects our most sensitive and regulated data by monitoring and investigating access at scale. We are seeking an experienced Support Engineer to lead complex investigations, set quality standards, and help the team grow.

In this role, you will lead high-stakes investigations that require advanced SQL analysis and pattern recognition across large datasets to determine compliance with data access policies. You will connect patterns others miss, engage stakeholders and their leadership to drive remediation, and establish best practices that keep internal customers compliant. You will own the quality bar for investigation documentation and access-request reviews, refine how the team investigates, and mentor engineers to elevate the capability of the entire team. This is a hands-on, investigation-heavy role for engineers who combine technical depth with sound judgment.

Key job responsibilities
- Lead complex investigations by reviewing SQL and access records to determine what data was accessed, interpreting dashboards and logs to identify patterns across large datasets, and reaching clear compliance determinations with limited guidance
- Own the quality of investigation documentation, clearly articulating impact, steps taken, and case state, and serve as the lead reviewer for content in your area of technical expertise
- Engage stakeholders and their leadership to understand access behavior, drive remediation, and establish best practices that help internal customers stay compliant with data-sharing and data-handling policies
- Evaluate access requests to protected data against policy, assess internal use cases for compliance, and identify recurring issues to improve investigation methods and standard operating procedures
- Act as a subject matter expert and technical point of contact for escalations, mentor other engineers on the team to raise their capability, and use data to identify and drive development of new support mechanisms and tools


A day in the life
You will lead the team's most complex investigations: reviewing SQL and access records to determine what data was accessed, connecting patterns across dashboards and large datasets, and reaching clear compliance determinations. You will engage stakeholders and their leadership to remediate access behavior and set best practices for staying compliant. You will own the review of access requests to protected data, evaluating internal use cases against data-sharing and data-handling policy. Where an investigation calls for it, you will write queries to validate findings across datasets. You will also improve how the team investigates by refining methods and standard operating procedures, and mentor less experienced engineers.

This role includes occasional on-call responsibilities.


About the team
Diverse Experiences

Amazon Security values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn't followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don't let it stop you from applying.

Why Amazon Security?

At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon's products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores.

Inclusive Team Culture

In Amazon Security, it's in our nature to learn and be curious. Ongoing DEI events and learning experiences inspire us to continue learning and to embrace our uniqueness. Addressing the toughest security challenges requires that we seek out and celebrate a diversity of ideas, perspectives, and voices.

Training & Career Growth

We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, training, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there's nothing we can't achieve.

The Security Compliance Investigations team protects Amazon's most sensitive and regulated data by monitoring and investigating access to protected data. As an experienced engineer on the team, you will lead complex investigations into how data was accessed and whether that access complies with policy, set the standard for how the team reaches compliance determinations, and help other engineers grow.

Our team is building robust investigation capabilities that scale with Amazon's growth. We value careful analysis, sound judgment, and collaboration. You will work alongside talented engineers who are passionate about security and compliance, and you will have opportunities to shape how we protect data and support the business.

- Experience with advanced use of SQL for data mining and business intelligence, or experience troubleshooting problems and offering solutions to streamline complex challenges
- Knowledge of writing and optimizing SQL queries in a business environment with large-scale, complex datasets
- Experience troubleshooting problems and offering solutions to streamline complex challenges, or experience working with stakeholders
- Experience with data analytics platforms (Power BI, Python, SQL, Tableau), or experience working with Excel, reporting tools, and large-scale data mining tools, such as Power BI, Python, SQL, or Tableau
- Experience performing data analysis and troubleshooting data integrity issues
- Experience with any combination of the following: application security frameworks, identity and access controls, incident response, mobile security, cloud computing and security, AI security, threat intelligence, and penetration testing

title: Robotics Systems Engineer I, Robotics Delivery and Packaging Innovation (RDPI) - Tech Deployment
descriptionHtml:
Are you enthusiastic about the latest advancements in industrial automation and robotics? Would you like to play a vital role in Amazon's investment in advanced technologies? If you have a passion for making an impact on the future today, consider joining Robotics Delivery & Packaging Innovations (RDPI) Technology Deployment team within Amazon Robotics (AR) org.

In RDPI, we have the unique role and privilege of deploying leading edge industrial robotics and customer fulfillment technologies across North America Stores operations. We raise the bar on the speed, quality and cost of deploying industrial technologies at scale across North America, functioning as the field team who plan, execute and launch the technologies that our internal design and product strategy partners in RDPI develop.

Project durations vary from a few days to several months, with travel across North America. This is a travel-based role and you will be expected to travel to meet the requirements of your projects across North America, upwards of 75% or more.

As a Systems Engineer in RDPI, you will be overseeing large scale project planning, installation, and launch of industrial automation technologies across Amazons growing Stores network. This field engineering position demands strong technical skills for deploying robotic equipment, including mechanical and electrical systems, network configurations, and software coordination. The ideal candidate has experience with complex electro-mechanical and network systems, demonstrating leadership in installation, maintenance, upgrades, and troubleshooting of technologies being deployed across North America. You will work with cross-functional partners across our engineering, product strategy, software, supply chain, third-party installers, contracted deployment engineers, construction teams, and internal operations customer teams, functioning as the lead on-site project manager to provide technical oversight on installation Amazon-designed automation equipment. This Systems Engineer position is an individual contributor role, influencing and leading stakeholders from planning through go-live of each project. Candidates should have a proven track record of successfully leading multiple concurrent projects across one or more automation solutions.

**Relocation to Amazon Corporate offices in Seattle, Boston, Nashville or Austin will be required for the role.

Key job responsibilities
As a Systems Engineer I, you will work with a team of 1-5 engineers and collaborate with an on-site project manager to provide technical oversight on the installation of both third party and Amazon designed robotics equipment that may be in various phases of the product life cycle. These deployments require extensive collaboration with various stakeholders, including third-party installers, contracted engineers, construction, hardware, software, IT, and other partner teams. Strong communication skills are essential for interacting with both internal and external partners and customers. As an Amazonian, you must demonstrate independent initiative to identify and solve problems in real time during deployments. A strong technical understanding, love for field work, and a keen interest in diving deep into the understanding of Amazon’s robotics systems are key attributes for this role.

- You will support and guide installation of robotics, packaging and sortation technologies at Amazon fulfillment centers
- You will develop detailed knowledge of the operation of robotic systems and guide installation, commissioning, and troubleshooting of these systems both on site and remotely
- You will manage technical ambiguity around integration of work cells in fulfillment centers
- You will collaborate with hardware engineering, technical program managers, product managers, and internal customers including site maintenance and operations teams
- You will travel to project sites and collaborate both virtually and in person to ensure all business stakeholders are aligned on program status
- You will manage day to day project scheduling and budget management
- You will work on continuous improvement activities to improve the projects in your space
- You will generate and implement continuous improvement ideas around work-scopes
- You will lead teams of other engineers on projects
- You will travel to both live warehouses and new construction sites, the scopes may vary significantly in length and include heavy travel
- You will manage the tactical deployment of large scale industrial automation technologies, ranging in technical complexity and product maturity from early alpha/beta to mature Generally Available.
- You will own the tactical execution (onsite coordination of installation and acceptance testing) to achieve the target “go-live” date for each project assigned; delivering independently.
- You will collaborate with hardware engineering, technical program managers, product managers, and internal customers including site maintenance and operations teams to convert technical requirements into refined deployment execution documents (schedules, Standard Operating Procedures, dependencies, etc.)
- You will improve operational metrics and team processes through automation and optimization
- You will independently resolve difficult technical problems during deployment, considering operational burden and making appropriate trade-offs between time, quality, and resources
- You will create and improve standard work documents and operational guidebooks, and work towards automating or improving team processes.
- You will influence internal and partner teams towards meeting team level goals.
- You will develop subject matter expertise in one or more deployment domains
- You will mentor junior engineers and participate in technical assessment
- You will drive operational excellence initiatives with measurable results
- This is a travel-based role and you will be expected to travel to meet the requirements of your projects across North America, upwards of 75% or more.
- Lift and move totes up to 49 pounds each
- Regular bending, lifting, stretching and reaching both below the waist and above the head
- Walking in the FC and around area with great frequency; facilities are over a quarter mile in length
- Must be able to stand/walk for up to 10-12 hours
- Should be able to work in environments with variable noise levels, lighting conditions and temperature variation
- Able to access all areas of building (ascending and descending ladders, stairs, gangways safely and without limitation)



A day in the life
In this role you will be focused on execution of end-to-end deployment and manage technical ambiguity around integration of workcells in fulfillment centers. On a daily basis you will collaborate with hardware engineering, technical program managers, product managers, and internal customers including site maintenance and operations teams, to ensure the product you are deploying, is both ready for deployment and capable of achieving the business requirements. You will travel to your project sites, collaborate both virtually and in person, to ensure all business stakeholders are aligned on program status. You will manage the day-to-day project execution, and work on continuous improvement activities to improve the projects in your space. You will spend time with mentors and your manager to develop your professional skills and collaborate amongst your team to move the needle on the services you are accountable for.

Answer yes to any of these and you’ll fit right in here at Robotics Delivery & Packaging Innovation (RDPI) within Amazon Robotics (AR). The team is geographically located across four North America hub locations. The work we deliver directly impact high priority goals set each year to our most senior leadership at Amazon.

- Understanding of data collection, reporting processes, and ability to make data-driven decisions
- Ability to read technical drawings and/or reading CAD models to resolve on-site clash issues using 3D clash detection reports
- Ability to troubleshoot robotics systems to resolve escalations including quality hand-off, live order testing, site acceptance testing, operational readiness testing, monitoring robotics system performance, etc.
