title: Hardware Test and Integration Manager, OISL
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is Amazon's low Earth orbit satellite network. Our mission is to deliver fast, reliable broadband connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. From households to small businesses, schools, hospitals, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will serve communities and organizations operating in places without dependable internet access.

We are seeking a Hardware Test & Integration Manager to lead a major share of the Prototyping and Integration (PI) Team. You will manage three engineering functions — Testing (development, qualification, and reliability test), Mechanical DVT, and Electromechanical Integration (harnessing, PCB fabrication, and related electro-mechanical build) — and the mixed team of engineers and technician staff who deliver them. You are accountable for the people, the mechanisms, and the hardware outcomes across all three.

This is a people-leadership role where the problem, opportunity, and strategy are often not yet defined. You set the metrics and long-term direction these functions run by, design the team structure and mechanisms that keep complex prototype hardware moving at quality and speed, and negotiate priorities across the organization when three disciplines compete for the same bench and the same week. You hire and grow bar-raising talent, build a team that delivers without you, and represent these functions to program leadership and partner engineering organizations.

Export Control Requirement:
Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Key job responsibilities
- Manage the Testing, Mechanical DVT, and Electromechanical Integration functions of the PI-Team.
- Define the metrics, goals, and long-term strategy for development, qualification, and reliability test of OISL prototype hardware, and establish the mechanisms that make test results auditable, data-driven, and repeatable.
- Direct the team's electromechanical integration work — GSE and prototype design, harnessing, and PCB fabrication — setting the workmanship and quality standards the team executes to.
- Own configuration control for the team's hardware — ensure designs, drawings, BOMs, and test documentation are created, reviewed, and released through formal PLM structure and change control (Siemens Teamcenter or equivalent).
- Establish workflows, SLAs, and cross-pillar prioritization, and negotiate resourcing across teams when programs and disciplines compete for the same capacity.
- Build and scale process-improvement and operational-excellence mechanisms across all three functions.
- Partner with design, manufacturing, and program engineering upstream to influence hardware design and schedule decisions before they are finalized.
- Serve as the escalation point for cross-functional blockers, resourcing conflicts, and schedule delays.

A day in the life
You move across multiple labs in a day — a reliability test review in the morning, a design verification test plan midday, a harnessing or PCB integration issue in the afternoon. You spend real time with your engineers and staff: unblocking them, coaching ownership, and holding 1:1s that tie their work to where they want to grow.

When program demands create a resourcing conflict, you make the prioritization call and own the outcome. You carry status to leadership yourself, pulled from the work rather than reported up to you. The ideal candidate is a hands-on technical leader who manages through mechanisms, earns trust across engineering disciplines, and builds a team that runs well without them.

About the team
The Prototyping & Integration (PI) Team accelerates hardware development through rapid prototyping, manufacturing, and integration of novel Line Replaceable Units (LRUs) and systems for the Optical Intersatellite Link organization. Our service areas span Hardware Fabrication, Electrical Integration, Systems Hardware Development, DVT and Qualification Testing, and Quality Assurance. Our learnings are directly applied to scale aerospace manufacturing processes and enable risk reduction through comprehensive Design Verification Testing and qualification testing. We seek candidates who thrive in dynamic, fast-paced environments where ownership, operational excellence, and engineering-first approaches are valued.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Electrical, Mechanical, Power Engineering, or a related field
- 10+ years of engineering team management experience
- Experience directly managing engineers and/or technicians, including hiring, setting deliverable expectations, and managing performance.
- Experience establishing engineering processes, standards, or operational-excellence mechanisms that a team executes to, driven to measurable results.
- Experience driving hardware through development and qualification phases (DVT/PVT or equivalent) in a prototype or low-volume development environment.
- Experience creating and releasing hardware designs and documentation — drawings, BOMs, and procedures — within a formal PLM structure and change-control process.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience managing multiple projects and priorities across teams in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment
- Experience building processes, project management, and schedules
- Experience in written and verbal communication with the ability to present complex technical information in a clear and concise manner to executives and non-technical leaders
- Experience in aerospace, defense, satellite, or other high-reliability hardware development.
- Deep working knowledge of at least one pillar — test strategy and reliability methods, design of experiment, or harnessing/PCBA and electromechanical integration — strong enough to set the standard and mentor senior individual contributors in it.
- Experience building out lab infrastructure, including executing facilities improvement projects and/or commissioning capital equipment.

descriptionHtml:

title: Operations Engineer, Ops Integration, AMZL Operations Integration Engineering
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Logistics (AMZL) is looking for an Operations Engineer II to join the Ops Integration Engineering (OIE) team. OIE is responsible for bridging the gap between engineering innovation and field operations by ensuring new automation technologies, equipment, and systems are successfully planned, piloted, launched, and adopted across the AMZL network. This role supports the full lifecycle of automation programs — from early-stage pilot planning through network-wide expansion — and requires a hands-on leader who thrives in fast-paced, ambiguous environments where cross-functional coordination and field presence are critical to success.

The ideal candidate is comfortable operating independently in the field, building relationships with site leadership and partner teams, and translating complex technical programs into clear operational standards. You will travel extensively (~80%) to Amazon sites across North America to support installations, testing, launches, and post-launch performance monitoring.

Key job responsibilities
As an Operations Engineer II on the OIE team, you will own the operational integration of new automation equipment and systems across Amazon’s last-mile logistics network. Your work spans two core functions:

Pilot Planning

Partner with Innovation & Design, Process Engineering, and Safety teams to develop the operational framework for new automation pilots. This includes building training curricula, defining success criteria and key performance indicators, supporting Site Acceptance Testing (SAT) and Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT), providing inputs to site selection, and creating the operational standards that will govern how associates interact with new technology.

Operational Readiness & Expansion

Lead the on-the-ground operational readiness for automation programs expanding across the network. Develop and deliver pre-launch training for site operations teams, provide on-site support during launch windows, track post-launch performance metrics against defined success criteria, and coordinate the handoff to ACES and site ownership once performance stabilizes. title: Enterprise Customer Success Manager, ASCS, Amazon Freight
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Freight, a key pillar within Amazon Supply Chain Services (ASCS), is looking for a Customer Success Manager to join our Enterprise Account Management team. This is a customer facing relationship management role within our commercial organization. You will serve as the primary operational partner for Amazon Freight's largest enterprise shippers, owning the customer relationship, identifying systemic issues that impact their experience, and coordinating cross functional teams to drive resolution.

Key job responsibilities
• Own the enterprise customer operational relationship across all freight modes (TL, IMDL, LTL), serving as the single threaded point of contact for your accounts' operational points of contact
• Identify systemic operational defects impacting your accounts using performance dashboards and customer feedback. Quantify the problem in dollars, loads, and retention risk
• Coordinate cross functional teams to resolution: gather customer insights, understand requirements, bring the right internal teams together, align on the path forward, and ensure we deliver. You don't solve problems alone but you own making sure they get solved
• Own the customer facing performance narrative. Lead Quarterly Business Reviews, produce recovery plans during performance degradation, and proactively communicate progress on open issues with timelines and measurable targets
• Own escalation communication to customer executives when something goes wrong: what's happening, what we're doing about it, and how we're tracking toward resolution
• Own internal reporting, including MBRs, account bridges, and leading inspection mechanisms for your accounts. Report out on performance metrics, cost inputs, and customer KPIs
• Influence customer operations to drive optimal inputs that lower our costs. Define what good looks like, measure it, and partner with customers to change how they operate
• Activate structured recovery programs before the customer escalates


A day in the life
Your day starts with account health dashboards, spotting a detention-charge trend at one customer's facilities and digging into its cause. By midmorning you're briefing a customer's regional transportation director on performance, then rallying ops and pricing partners on a structural issue hitting multiple facilities. After lunch you build your MBR narrative, quantifying your team's impact and open items. Later you lead a working session with operations and product on a fix to prevent recurring defects, then close by updating a customer VP on a two-week escalation, showing progress against committed targets.


About the team
The Enterprise Customer Success team is newly formed within Amazon Freight's commercial organization. This team serves as the single threaded relationship owner for our largest customers' operational points of contact. We exist to ensure that every enterprise shipper on our platform experiences the service level we committed to, and when they don't, we coordinate the teams that fix it.

title: Content Specialist, IDC CX Content Strategy, AWS Marketing
descriptionHtml:
Content Specialists support the development and execution of content strategies that align messaging, audience needs, and campaign objectives. Working under the guidance of senior content strategists, they help maintain narrative consistency across the customer journey by producing and coordinating defined content deliverables, applying established content types and placements by funnel stage, and contributing to Content Lifecycle Map development.
The Content Specialist helps execute content strategies that guide customers through a cohesive AWS narrative across touchpoints of their journey. Using our standardized messaging hierarchy and the direction set by senior strategists, this role helps keep messaging, audience needs, and business objectives aligned while maintaining consistency in brand voice and customer experience. The Content Specialist does not own the content strategy or the messaging within the content; they apply the strategic direction provided to them to help content creators deliver consistent, personalized content experiences that educate, engage, and empower customers.


Key job responsibilities
With a focus on audience engagement and consistent storytelling, the Content Specialist’s key responsibilities include assisting with audience and content audits, maintaining content calendars, helping coordinate content creation (though not producing it), and gathering content performance metrics to support continuous improvement. The role involves collaborating with Content Studio, Digital Strategy, Campaign teams, and subject matter experts to help deliver high-quality content across various platforms and formats, ensuring the strategic direction and messaging provided is executed consistently in each content piece—whether blogs, infographics, or videos, etc. The Content Specialist works with the Channels team, Digital Strategists, and Content Studio to apply recommended content formats based on persona, customer journey stage, and content placement.

Key Responsibilities
- Support the execution of content strategies aligned with AWS goals and target audiences
- Assist with audience and content audits to inform strategy
- Help maintain content calendars and information architecture
- Coordinate content creation across various formats (blogs, infographics, videos, etc.) under guidance
- Apply SEO best practices and support multi-platform distribution
- Compile performance metrics and surface observations for review
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams (design, peer marketing teams, subject matter experts, etc.) to support alignment across execution touchpoints
- Help ensure brand and messaging consistency across all content
- Apply recommended content formats based on persona to support engagement, lead generation, and brand loyalty


A day in the life
Your Day-to-Day
- Help maintain the content calendar from ideation to publication
- Coordinate with content creators and designers to produce various content formats
- Help identify trends, content gaps, and audience preferences
- Work with data and analytics teams to gather and track KPIs
- Work with peer teams to support SEO optimization and user-friendly formats
- Stay informed on industry trends and algorithm changes affecting content marketing
- Help maintain relationships with internal and external subject matter experts


About the team
The Integrated Demand Center (IDC) Content Strategy team shapes how AWS tells its story across the customer journey. We're the connective tissue between messaging, audience insight, and campaign execution — making sure the right content reaches the right customer, in the right format, at the right moment. Our work spans the full content lifecycle, from strategy and planning through creation and performance, in close partnership with Content Studio, Digital Strategy, Campaign teams, and subject matter experts across AWS Marketing.

We're a collaborative, curious group that cares as much about craft as about outcomes. We dive deep on our audiences, challenge each other's thinking, and keep a cohesive AWS narrative at the center of everything we build. For someone early in their content career, this is a place to learn from experienced strategists, develop your craft on high-visibility work, and see the direct impact of great content on how customers discover, evaluate, and adopt AWS.

descriptionHtml:

Its mission is to deliver fast, reliable internet to customers and communities around the world, and we’ve designed the system with the capacity, flexibility, and performance to serve a wide range of customers, from individual households to schools, hospitals, businesses, government agencies, and other organizations operating in locations without reliable connectivity.

We are seeking a Lab Engineer to run day-to-day lab operations and support production and hardware testing. You'll build and maintain test fixtures, manage lab resources and equipment, and make sure measurements are accurate and traceable. You'll work hands-on with hardware, electrical harnesses, and precision measurement tools, and you'll work closely with design, test, and production teams.

As a Lab Engineer, you will support test, readiness, and operation of SSL test systems infrastructure. You will work closely with cross-functional engineering teams to translate test needs into safe, reliable, and repeatable test setups.
You will improve current test setups, integrate instrumentation and equipment, perform equipment checkout and commissioning activities, execute complex testing, troubleshoot hardware and test system issues.
This is a highly hands-on engineering role that combines mechanical engineering, test system development, production operations, troubleshooting, and testing.


Key job responsibilities
• Set up, operate, and maintain lab equipment for production station and test hardware.
• Partner with Engineers and cross-functional stakeholders to understand test requirements and determine equipment, instrumentation and fixture needs.
• Monitor complex tests, evaluate system behavior, identify abnormal conditions, and safely respond to test anomalies.
• Design, build, and modify custom test fixtures and tooling.
• Operate, maintain, and troubleshoot 3D printers.
• Perform basic machining operations to fabricate and modify fixtures and hardware.
• Read and interpret engineering drawings, schematics, electrical drawings, and GD&T to build, assemble, and verify hardware.
• Develop, build, troubleshoot, repair, and rework electrical harnesses, working from schematics and electrical drawings.
• Manage lab resources, equipment, and supplies, including inventory, ordering, and scheduling.
• Develop and execute preventative maintenance plans for mechanical equipment.
• Organize and maintain the lab or shop space, and track equipment calibration to keep it current and compliant.
• Document test setups, procedures, and results.
• Enforce lab safety and housekeeping standards.
• Provide technical guidance to technicians and other personnel on equipment operation, test setup, troubleshooting, and safe test execution.

Basic qualifications

- 1 year + of experience in hardware development, industrial equipment maintenance, space/aerospace maintenance, or another hands-on engineering environment.
- Knowledge of and experience with measurement and inspection devices (torque wrenches, calipers, micrometers, multimeters, oscilloscopes, DAQ systems).
- Experience developing, troubleshooting, and repairing mechanical equipment
- Associate's or Bachelor's degree in engineering or a related technical field, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
- Experience troubleshooting and operating Thermal and Vacuum chambers

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with calibration management systems.
- Experience with CAD tools for fixture design.
- Experience creating engineering drawings for machining.
- Experience presenting data and findings to multiple levels of leadership
- Experience using data to drive changes in processes

Amazon's Internal Risk team sits at the intersection of advanced investigation, emerging technology, and global business impact, and we're looking for an investigator ready to operate at that level. This is a role for someone who has built real expertise in fraud, cyber, or financial crime, and is ready to apply it where the complexity is greatest.

The ideal candidate brings a strong foundation in risk management, digital fraud, compliance, or cyber investigations, with demonstrated experience conducting technical investigations across domains such as cybersecurity, cryptocurrency, fraud auditing, or security engineering. In this role, you will lead complex, end to end investigations using SQL, AI native tooling, and agentic automation to identify patterns, scale findings, and contribute to systematic solutions for risk challenges that span Amazon's global operations. We are looking for someone who is analytically rigorous and skilled at translating investigative findings into clear, credible intelligence for senior stakeholders.

In this role, you will also collaborate with Legal and regional HR partners to develop interview strategy for suspected bad actors, conduct those interviews, and produce disciplinary recommendations that result in meaningful accountability outcomes. • Use SQL to complete risk analyses using complex data sets.

We design and implement the policies, tools, and investigative capabilities that protect customers, selling partners, and Amazon itself from bad actors operating at scale.

Our team is built on deep subject matter expertise across fraud, cybersecurity, data security, insider risk, and compliance, paired with a strong bias toward data-driven investigation and technical problem solving. title: Senior Delivery Consultant, Professional Services - SAP
descriptionHtml:
Application deadline: Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis

The Amazon Web Services Professional Services team is seeking a skilled Delivery Consultant specializing in VMware to AWS migrations. In this role you will work closely with customers to design, execute, and manage large-scale VMware estate migrations to AWS, delivering measurable business outcomes across every phase of the programme lifecycle. You will be a key player in driving customer success, providing technical expertise, migration best practices, and hands-on delivery leadership from initial assessment through production cutover.



With deep expertise in VMware environments and AWS migration services, you will lead enterprise data centre exit programmes spanning multiple countries and regulatory jurisdictions. You will assess VMware workloads through discovery tooling and application owner interviews, define migration strategies and target architectures, assign R-strategies across the portfolio, and design wave plans that respect dependency groupings, capacity constraints, and regulatory frozen zones. As a trusted advisor you will guide customers through risk mitigation, architecture decisions, and the organizational change that large-scale VMware exits require.



The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes on AWS. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network to execute enterprise cloud computing initiatives through a collection of offerings that help customers achieve specific outcomes related to cloud adoption and migration at scale.


What Makes This Role Different

VMware estates are not just infrastructure. They are the operational core of enterprise businesses built over decades. You will not be running a lift and shift. You will be designing the path from a legacy platform to a modern, cloud-native foundation, and making that transition invisible to the business. The complexity is real, the stakes are high, and the outcomes are permanent.

Key job responsibilities
Design and implement complex, scalable, and secure AWS target architectures for VMware workload migrations, covering compute, network, storage, and virtualization layers

Lead end-to-end VMware estate assessments using discovery tooling and application owner interviews, producing portfolio disposition recommendations with R-strategy assignments across rehost, replatform, refactor, retire, retain, and relocate

Define migration strategy and target architecture for VMware workloads, translating technical choices into business outcomes for executive audiences

Design and own wave plans including dependency grouping, capacity balancing, cutover sequencing, and multi-geography coordination under regulatory constraints

Apply AI-powered and agentic migration tools including AWS Transform, ModelizeIT, Kiro, and equivalent tooling to accelerate discovery, assessment, and migration execution at scale

Lead large delivery teams and matrix organizations, driving alignment across business and technology stakeholders throughout the program lifecycle

Partner with AWS Migration Services including Application Migration Service (MGN), Database Migration Service (DMS), and Migration Hub to execute migrations with precision and repeatability

Provide technical guidance and troubleshooting support throughout delivery, ensuring adherence to AWS Well-Architected principles and optimizing wave sequencing to minimize risk and business disruption

Act as a trusted advisor to customers on VMware licensing optimization, infrastructure modernization, and emerging AWS capabilities relevant to their environment

Share knowledge within the organization through mentoring, training, and creating reusable migration artifacts, runbooks, and cutover playbooks that partners can execute at scale

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
- 10+ years of cloud architecture, solution implementation, or consulting experience with a focus on large-scale cloud migration and modernization programs
- Experience leading the delivery of large-scale, mission-critical enterprise IT and migration programmes including data center exits in a customer-facing role
- Deep hands-on experience with VMware environments including vSphere, vCenter, NSX, vSAN, and ESXi administration and migration
- Experience as the technical lead of large-scale migrations, defining migration strategy and target architecture, selecting the right approach for each workload, and translating technical choices into business outcomes for executive audiences
- Experience using AI-powered and agentic migration and modernization tools such as AWS Transform, ModelizeIT, Kiro, or equivalent to accelerate discovery, assessment, and migration execution at scale
- Hands-on experience with technology infrastructure including network, compute, storage, and virtualization
- Experience with wave planning including dependency grouping, capacity balancing, and multi-geography coordination under regulatory constraints
- Experience leading large teams and matrix organizations and driving alignment across business and technology stakeholders
- Experience with the software development lifecycle and agile and iterative delivery methods

Preferred qualifications

- Work experience in financial services including banking, capital markets, payments, or insurance, with regulated workloads and compliance and security standards
- Deep knowledge of AWS services including EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda, IAM, and VPC, and AWS migration services including Application Migration Service, Database Migration Service, and Migration Hub
- AWS Professional level certifications including Solutions Architect Professional or DevOps Engineer Professional
- VMware certification including VCP, VCAP, or equivalent
- Experience with two or more migration domains beyond VMware such as SAP, Windows and SQL Server, database migrations including Oracle licensing and PostgreSQL, or mainframe
- Experience with infrastructure as code, automation, and scripting including Terraform, CloudFormation, Python, and PowerShell
- Experience with public, hybrid, and multi-cloud platforms including VMware Cloud on AWS
- Comfortable navigating ambiguity in complex multi-vendor environments with incomplete documentation and conflicting data sources while prioritizing needs and delivering measurable results

title: Risk Manager, NA Air & Energy, EAP
descriptionHtml:
Amazon's Global Environmental Assurance and Protection team works to make Amazon the global benchmark for environmental excellence across our operations. As the NA Air/Energy Program Manager, you own the lifecycle of Amazon's most complex air and energy compliance programs across North America and turn an ambiguous, fast-moving regulatory landscape into program frameworks the field can execute. That scope covers air quality and emissions compliance, air permitting and greenhouse gas reporting, energy management and efficiency, and emerging air and energy regulatory obligations across North America. You take partially defined business problems and regulatory requirements and build them into structured programs with clear objectives, milestones, and success criteria, owning each program through its pilot and scaled rollout.

As an individual contributor, you own the strategic definition and lifecycle management of these air and energy programs. You break ambiguous challenges into program plans that account for real field constraints, define what "done" looks like, and design the systems, processes, and tools, with measurement built in, that the field organization adopts and sustains on its own. You partner with legal, regulatory affairs, operations, technology, and procurement to keep programs aligned with the operating model, and you contribute to internal operations planning while owning goals within the NA air and energy program portfolio.

You identify and influence cross-functional investments that solve long-term air and energy compliance requirements, negotiating resources, priorities, and timelines across organizations. You build business cases with quantified risk and return, present them to director and vice-president audiences, and represent EAP in cross-functional planning forums so that air and energy compliance requirements are built into business decisions. You own the program governance, business reviews, escalation paths, and metric dashboards that surface risk and drive accountability in real time, and you stand in for the senior manager independently in business reviews and cross-functional forums with full ownership.

This role requires independent judgment, a high tolerance for ambiguity, and the ability to find a path forward where solutions are not predefined, driving cross-functional alignment without pushing decisions upward. You communicate technical compliance requirements clearly to executive, operational, and legal audiences, and you use data and business intelligence to look around corners, spotting and mitigating risk before it surfaces. If you are motivated by solving complex regulatory problems at scale and building the compliance infrastructure to match, this role is for you.

Key job responsibilities
- Translate the compliance vision into functional programs. Integrate them into annual and multi-year planning and shape the budgets that fund them, weighing near-term compliance needs against long-term infrastructure investment.
- Work independently in an ambiguous, high-stakes regulatory environment, finding paths forward where no solution is predefined and driving alignment without pushing decisions upward.
- Own compliance programs end to end, taking problem definitions through pilot to full rollout, and build the resulting standards into daily operations so field teams sustain them on their own.
- Build the metrics and review system that holds the program accountable, covering KPIs, business reviews, escalation paths, and dashboards that give leaders real-time visibility into performance, milestones, and regulatory standing.
- Report program status, risks, and escalations clearly to director and vice-president audiences across operations, legal, finance, and technology, and stand in for the senior manager in business reviews and cross-functional forums.
- Oversee third-party contractors, consultants, and inspection vendors, holding them to program milestones and quality standards through structured audits.
- Travel up to 25 to 50% of the time.

Basic qualifications

- 6+ years of compliance, audit or risk management experience
- 5+ years of program or project Management experience
- Experience owning program strategy, end-to-end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
- Bachelor's degree in Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) or related field

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in regulatory compliance management with government agencies
- Master's degree in environmental engineering, chemical engineering, atmospheric or air quality science, energy systems, or a related field
- Experience developing and implementing air and energy compliance programs, for example Title V and minor source air permitting, greenhouse gas reporting, emissions inventories, refrigerant management, and energy or utility compliance, in accordance with applicable laws
- Professional credential where applicable, for example a Professional Engineer (PE), a Qualified Environmental Professional (QEP), a Certified Energy Manager (CEM), or an equivalent professional environmental certification
- Experience with ISO 14001 and ISO 50001 management system design, implementation, or certification

title: Software Development Engineer, Ads AI Core Infra (ACI)
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Advertising is one of Amazon's fastest growing and most profitable businesses, responsible for defining and delivering AI-powered solutions that transform how advertisers make strategic decisions. We deliver billions of ad impressions and process massive volumes of advertiser data every single day. You'll work with us to pioneer breakthrough approaches in how AI agents access and reason over real-time advertiser data at scale.

The Campaign Management team is responsible for capturing inputs for advertisers to control their advertising efforts. You can think of our team as the brain and nervous system of all the advertisements you see on amazon.com. We build large scale, high velocity distributed systems to service 100’s of millions of API requests per day, steam data at PB scale, process business logic on tight latency budgets, all while streaming and the data at high fidelity to 20+ other services to perform other critical advertising functions. We stand up world class CI/CD pipelines to deploy our service automating infrastructure provisioning, high volume load testing and first-rate monitoring so our engineers can keep their heads down inventing for our advertisers. Our problem space covers concurrent workflows across distributed systems (linearizability, eventual consistency), big data problems (propagation delay, ordering and hygiene) and performance (search optimization). Our team uses the latest AWS products and services to solve our problems including but not limited to: ECS, Fargate, EC2, EMR, Lambda, Kafka, Elastic Search, Dynamo DB, SQS, SNS, Cloud watch, CDK, Cloud Formation and many more.

We are using generative AI and agentic systems to help advertising agents provide instant, strategic advice to millions of advertisers. You will need to invent new techniques for global ads experience, agent orchestration, and context optimization to ensure we're delivering accurate, trustworthy insights with minimal latency and token consumption. You'll create feedback loops to ensure our solutions are constantly evaluating themselves and improving.

Key job responsibilities
- Design and implement scalable architectures for APIs serving millions of advertisers at thousands of transactions per second
- Build Model Context Protocol (MCP) server infrastructure—an emerging standard for AI agent-data interaction—that delivers advertiser context with sub-second latency and minimal token consumption
- Establish system design patterns and best practices for global ads experience at scale

title: Applied Scientist, PXT Central Science
descriptionHtml:
The People eXperience Technology (PXT) Central Science (PXTCS)'s mission is to make PXT the most scientific, technologically proficient, and inclusive HR organization in the world. PXTCS does this by accelerating scientific rigor in business-led initiatives, working backwards from employee experience, and delivering science-driven products that improve the well-being of and value of work for Amazonian worldwide.

We are seeking an Applied Scientist to build production machine learning systems that turn Amazon's employee listening signals into insight at scale. You will design, develop, and deploy ML solutions that transform large volumes of employee feedback — survey responses, free-text comments, and other listening channels — into signals that drive strategic decision-making across the organization. In this role, you will work on challenging problems spanning natural language processing, large language models, predictive modeling, and generative AI applications applied to employee experience. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to translate ambiguous business challenges into rigorous technical solutions.

- Apply and adapt state-of-the-art NLP and machine learning techniques to extract structured, reliable signals from employee listening data (surveys, free-text feedback, and related channels), using reasonable assumptions, data, and customer requirements.

- Write secure, stable, testable, maintainable, well-reviewed code (at the SDE I bar) to deliver solutions into production that benefit customers and the business.
- Design features and signals responsibly, applying privacy-preserving practices appropriate to sensitive employee data.
- Collaborate with cross-functional partners to understand business context and impact, and help mentor interns.
- Communicate complex technical concepts to diverse audiences, from technical peers to senior leadership.

About the team
The People eXperience and Technology Central Science Team (PXTCS) uses economics, applied science, statistics, and machine learning to proactively identify mechanisms and process improvements which simultaneously improve Amazon and the lives, wellbeing, and the value of work to Amazonians. We are an interdisciplinary team that combines the talents of science and engineering to develop and deliver solutions that measurably achieve this goal.

title: Business Intelligence Engineer, FCGT
descriptionHtml:
The International Seller Services Analytics team for WW Reimbursements is looking for a Senior Business Intelligence Engineer to lead advanced analytics for our Product and Business teams. You'll bring together large, multi-dimensional datasets across reimbursement claims, inventory discrepancies, and seller settlements to build data models and insights that drive high-impact decisions. As part of the International Seller Services Analytics team, you'll partner with business, finance, and engineering stakeholders to turn complex data into actions that protect seller trust and Amazon's financial accuracy. If you're customer obsessed, hands-on with SQL and Python, and energized by solving ambiguous problems at scale, this role is for you.

Key job responsibilities
The International Seller Services Analytics team for Amazon's Worldwide (WW) Reimbursements organization is seeking a talented, self-driven and experienced Senior Business Intelligence Engineer to lead the advanced analytics wing for the WW Reimbursements Product and Business team. This pivotal role gives you the opportunity to work with an exceptionally innovative team, slice and dice multi-dimensional, high-depth data across reimbursement claims, inventory discrepancies, and seller settlements, and build complex data models that drive data-driven insights for high-impact decisions spanning Seller and Customer experience, financial accuracy, and loss-prevention Product/Program initiatives.

Are you customer obsessed, flexible, smart and analytical, strategic yet execution focused, and passionate about e-commerce and operational excellence? Are you an experienced, entrepreneurial leader with a strong work ethic? If yes, this opportunity will appeal to you.

To be successful in this role, you will have the ability to roll up your sleeves, innovate, and quickly become a subject matter expert on the reimbursement lifecycle, assessing performance across claim types, fulfillment channels, and marketplaces. You will be a self-starter who is willing to work hands-on, is comfortable with ambiguity and large data sets. You will be part of the International Seller Services Analytics team working with Stakeholders, Finance partners, Data Engineers, Business Intelligence Engineers and Business Analysts to achieve our goals. You will also have strong communication skills, be able to work closely with stakeholders, and translate data-driven findings into actionable insights that protect both seller trust and Amazon's financial integrity.

You will have demonstrated proficiency in SQL across a variety of databases, BI tools, and R or Python to analyze large data sets.

Key job responsibilities

Passionate about working with huge data sets and someone who loves to bring datasets together to answer business questions.
You should have deep expertise in the creation and management of datasets, with exposure to implementing and operating stable, scalable data flow solutions from production systems into end-user-facing applications/reports. These solutions will be fault tolerant, self-healing and adaptive.
Detail-oriented with an aptitude for solving unstructured problems, especially where reimbursement discrepancies, root-cause attribution, and financial reconciliation demand precision. You should work in a self-directed environment, own tasks and drive them to completion.
Excellent business and communication skills to work with business and finance owners to develop and define key business questions, and to build data sets that answer those questions across the WW Reimbursements space.

- Experience with data modeling, warehousing and building ETL pipelines
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, or a related field

title: Sr. Workplace Health & Safety (WHS) Manager, WHS Field , Workplace Health & Safety (WHS)
descriptionHtml:
アマゾンでは、“地球上で最もお客様を大切にする企業になること”というミッションを掲げ、日々改善と改革が行われています。
今回アマゾンの物流拠点/ Fulfillment Center（以下FC）にて、もっとも重視されている「安全」に対する中核部門をLeadするSite Sr. WHS Managerを募集します。オペレーション各部門と効率的に連携し、大規模FCの安全活動をLeadし安全文化を創造することで、お客様一人一人に確実に商品をお届けすることに貢献する役割を担います。

本ポジションが所属するWorkplace Health and Safety (WHS) Teamは、アマゾンの物流拠点であるFCで働くあらゆる立場の方が安全で安心した業務を行う為の環境を提供し、ルールを整備し、関係部署と連携することによって、FCの安全をLeadする部署です。現場に即した安全を提供するために、慣例に捉われず、リスクを捉えつつ剛柔な判断を行い、本来の安全を追求していきます。

Sr. WHS Managerは担当するFCの自然災害、火災、FC内でのオペレーションに関わるリスク検出をし、それらに対しての予防措置、是正措置の導入、安全に関わる事故の防止と削減を計画し、関連部署と実行していきます。また、標準化した内容をFCで実行しつつ、より効果的で効率的な方法を検討しNetwork全体へも展開します。
リスクの低減、安全教育のシステム構築や、データ解析による事故低減といった幅広い役割と責任を担いつつ活躍できるポジションです。

具体的には、担当サイトのWHS年間目標と計画作成・実施支援、リスクアセスメント、内部監査の実施、防火・防災対策の計画立案と導入を行います。また、1-3名程度の直属の部下の採用、勤怠管理、業務指導、キャリア開発、メンタル面のケア、エンゲージメントの向上に取り組んでいただきます。現場を何よりも大切にしているアマゾンであるため、Safetyのスキルをベースに自らが高い現場力を発揮することで、机上ではない安全のLeadも求められます。

更に社内のあらゆる部門と関わるだけでなく、社外のパートナーと協働で体制を構築して続けることが重要な業務となるため、Safetyのスキルだけでなく、ビジネスマナーに優れ、高いコミュニケーションでパートナーシップを築ける能力をお持ちの方からのご応募をお待ちしております。

50%：サイトにおけるWHS目標及び活動内容の計画立案と実行 (教育・訓練、監査、リスクアセスメントなど)
30%：メンバーの育成 (目標設定および実行支援、専門知識、一般知識の醸成、評価)
10%：安全にかかわる事故が発生した場合の情報収集、原因調査並びに是正対策立案・実施、是正措置の有効性の確認、NW内へのシェアと類似対策防止対策の導入。
10%：Amazon Global Policy、並びに、日本のサイトで実施する(または実施されている)安全に関わる手順書の作成、導入、維持　及び　他サイトの安全活動のサポート (監査、安全対策導入のサポート、会議出席など)
*安全活動を通じて倉庫内での入出荷、在庫管理、物流の仕組みやマネージメントを学べます。
*キャリアアップのチャンスもあります。

本ポジションが所属するWHS(Workplace Health and Safety)Teamは、アマゾンの物流拠点であるFCで働くあらゆる立場の方が安全で安心した業務を行う為の環境を提供し、ルールを整備し、関係部署と連携することによって、FCの安全をLeadする部署です。現場に即した安全を提供するために、慣例に捉われず、リスクを捉えつつ剛柔な判断を行い、本来の安全を追求していきます。

Sr. WHS Managerは担当するFCの自然災害、火災、FC内でのオペレーションに関わるリスク検出をし、それらに対しての予防措置、是正措置の導入、安全に関わる事故の防止と削減を計画し、関連部署と実行していきます。また、標準化した内容をFCで実行しつつ、より効果的で効率的な方法を検討しNetwork全体へも展開します。リスクの低減、教育システムの構築や、データ解析による事故低減といった幅広い役割と責任を担いつつ活躍できるポジションです。

具体的には、担当サイトのWHS年間目標と計画作成・実施支援、リスクアセスメント、内部監査の実施、防火・防災対策の計画立案と導入を行います。
また、1-3名程度の直属の部下の採用、勤怠管理、業務指導、キャリア開発、メンタル面のケア、エンゲージメントの向上に取り組んでいただきます。現場を何よりも大切にしているアマゾンであるため、Safetyのスキルをベースに自らが高い現場力を発揮することで、机上ではない安全のLeadも求められます。

更に社内のあらゆる部門と関わるだけでなく、社外のパートナーと協働で体制を構築して続けることが重要な業務となるため、Safetyのスキルだけでなく、ビジネスマナーに優れ、高いコミュニケーションでパートナーシップを築ける能力をお持ちの方からのご応募をお待ちしております。

50%：サイトにおけるEHS目標及び活動内容の計画立案と実行
(教育・訓練、監査、リスクアセスメントなど)
30%：メンバーの育成
目標設定および実行支援、専門知識、一般知識の真醸成、評価
10%：安全にかかわる事故が発生した場合の情報収集、原因調査並びに是正対策立案・実施、是正措置の有効性の確認、NW内へのシェアと類似対策防止対策の導入。
10%：Amazon Global Policy、並びに、日本のサイトで実施する(または実施されている)安全に関わる手順書の作成、導入、維持　及び　他サイトの安全活動のサポート
(監査、安全対策導入のサポート、会議出席など)

title: Software Development Engineer II , Amazon Pay
descriptionHtml:
Want to be part of a dynamic start-up environment within Amazon and be at the forefront of enabling "Amazon Pay" outside of Amazon?
Our team is looking for passionate, experienced software developer who can deliver high quality platform solutions to support our customers (buyers and merchants) enabling "Amazon Pay" to scale as the universal wallet for all of Amazon buyers.

As an engineer in Amazon Pay, you will be part of a dynamic team working on complex problems innovating on behalf of our customers. As an SDE II, you will play a key role in building a world-class, frictionless payments solution and merchant experience that helps us scale while retaining customer and merchant trust.

This is an excellent opportunity to join Amazon's world-class technology teams, working alongside some of the industry's top engineers. You will have access to mentoring programs, regular tech talks with principal engineers, and opportunities to develop your skills and advance your career within one of the most innovative and progressive technology companies.

If you're passionate about building transformative payment solutions that enable merchants and delight customers, we encourage you to apply.

AmazonPay, one of the fastest growing businesses of Amazon, enables e-commerce websites to accept, and customers to utilise the payment information stored in their Amazon.com accounts to pay for goods and services at sites off-Amazon. We develop software at every level of the stack from front-end user interfaces to backend server software and everything in between.

title: Supply Chain Management, SSD
descriptionHtml:
We are looking for a proactive, detail-oriented, and execution-focused L3 Associate to own and drive end-to-end launch management and supply chain readiness across key workstreams, including forecasting, licensing, CAPS deployment, and operational planning. The role will be responsible for coordinating launch activities from initial planning through execution and post-launch stabilization, ensuring alignment across business, supply chain, planning, licensing, and operations teams.

The associate will play a critical role in ensuring launch readiness by driving demand forecasting inputs, tracking supply and inventory requirements, coordinating licensing activities and approvals, and managing CAPS deployment in line with defined timelines and business requirements. This includes maintaining accurate launch plans, monitoring critical milestones and dependencies, identifying potential supply or execution risks, and proactively driving resolutions to avoid launch delays or operational disruptions.

The role requires strong ownership of multiple parallel workstreams, effective stakeholder management, and the ability to translate business requirements into actionable execution plans. The associate will be expected to establish robust tracking mechanisms, provide timely visibility into launch progress and risks, and ensure that all launch-related activities are completed within agreed timelines. Additionally, the role will focus on improving process adherence, strengthening cross-functional coordination, and identifying opportunities to enhance forecasting accuracy, deployment efficiency, and overall supply chain readiness.

The ideal candidate should be comfortable working in a dynamic, fast-paced environment, managing competing priorities, and driving closure through structured planning, data-driven decision-making, and proactive follow-through. The ultimate objective is to ensure seamless launch execution, accurate forecasting, timely licensing readiness, successful CAPS deployment, and uninterrupted supply chain operations.

Key job responsibilities
Launch Management: Own end-to-end launch planning, readiness tracking, execution, and post-launch stabilization.
CAPS Deployment: Drive CAPS deployment across applicable supply chain operations, ensuring adherence to deployment plans, timelines, and defined processes.
Cross-functional Coordination: Partner with supply chain, operations, planning, technology, and other relevant teams to align on launch requirements and deployment readiness.
Milestone Tracking: Maintain launch trackers, deployment schedules, action logs, and status reports to ensure timely execution.
Risk and Issue Management: Identify potential risks, deployment blockers, and dependencies; drive timely resolution and escalate critical issues as required.
Operational Readiness: Validate process readiness, resource availability, system/process dependencies, and stakeholder alignment before launch.
Performance Monitoring: Track key operational metrics, deployment progress, and launch performance to identify gaps and drive corrective actions.
Process Improvement: Identify opportunities to standardize launch processes, improve deployment efficiency, and strengthen execution mechanisms.
Documentation and Reporting: Maintain deployment documentation, SOPs, launch checklists, and regular progress updates for stakeholders.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English
- Experience with Microsoft Office products and applications
- Experience with Excel
- 2+ years of customer-facing environment, warehousing, logistics or manufacturing experience

Preferred qualifications

- Relevant experience in supply chain operations, project coordination, launch management, deployment, or process implementation.
- Strong program coordination, planning, and execution skills.
- Ability to manage multiple workstreams, timelines, and dependencies simultaneously.
- Strong analytical, problem-solving, and stakeholder management capabilities.
- Proficiency in Excel and reporting tools; experience with dashboards or project tracking tools is preferred.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
- Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and drive closure on deliverables with minimal supervision.

title: Operations Manager
descriptionHtml:
Der operative Geschäftsbereich ist das Herz von Amazon. Dieser wesentliche Teil unseres Unternehmens sorgt dafür, dass wir Bestellungen effizient erfüllen und versenden, damit unsere Kund:innen ihre Artikel rechtzeitig erhalten. Getragen wird er von Operations Manager:innen, die das Team zusammenführen, um an allen unseren Standorten hervorragende Sicherheit, Qualität und Produktivität zu fördern. Du koordinierst an Deinem Standort andere Manager:innen und erstellst den Betriebsplan, der Deinen Teams bei der Erfüllung ihrer Ziele hilft. Diese Rolle ist voll darauf ausgerichtet, die Operational Excellence zu unterstützen, um das Amazon von Morgen zu schaffen.

Key job responsibilities
-Leitung und Entwicklung eines Teams von Area Manager:innen
-Schichtleitung von Betriebsteams, Handhabung von Problemen und Förderung der Standortleistung
-Analyse der Schichten laut Unternehmensvorgaben und Umsetzung von Maßnahmen zur Verbesserung unserer Operational Excellence
-Enge Zusammenarbeit mit anderen Support-Teams, einschließlich derer für die Bereiche HR, Finanzen, Arbeitsschutz und Sicherheit
-Gestaltung und Umsetzung von Initiativen an allen Standorten zur Verbesserung der Betriebsleistung

A day in the life
Du übernimmst die Schichtleitung an einem unserer Betriebsstandorte. Außerdem fungierst Du als Hauptschnittstelle zwischen mehreren verschiedenen Teams, u. a. den Finanz-, Sicherheits- und Betriebsintegrationsteams. Das bedeutet, dass Du die täglichen Betriebsabläufe an Deinem Standort unmittelbar beobachtest und gleichzeitig auch zu neuen Innovationsmöglichkeiten beiträgst.
Ein typischer Arbeitstag umfasst Treffen mit verschiedenen Geschäftsbereichen, eingehende Untersuchungen der Leistungs- und Risikokennzahlen für Standorte sowie Prognosen zur Vorbereitung auf unterschiedliche Nachfragevolumen. Weiterhin bietest Du Deinem Team täglich Mentoring und Coaching. Als Führungskraft unterstützt Du Deine Teammitglieder dabei, ihr Managementpotenzial voll zu entfalten.

About the team
Amazon Logistik (AMZL) ist für die Auslieferung von Millionen von Produkten unserer Kunden und Kundinnen direkt an die Haustür verantwortlich. Die „Last-Mile-Logistik“ liefert unsere Pakete in Partnerschaft mit Drittanbietern und realisiert zahlreiche Initiativen zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung, um Millionen von Kunden zufrieden zu stellen.
Unser Ziel ist es, das Liefererlebnis für unsere Kund:innen so reibungslos wie möglich zu machen und globale Lieferlösungen für unsere neuesten Angebote einzuführen, darunter Amazon Fresh, Prime Now und Amazon Restaurants.
Unsere Arbeit lässt sich in zwei Sparten unterteilen. „Under the Roof“ betrifft alles was innerhalb unserer Logistikstandorte passiert und „On the Road“ alles was in den Liefergebieten auf der Straße stattfindet. Unsere Mitarbeitenden bereiten die Pakete in entsprechenden Schichten (Nacht, Früh, Spät) auf den täglichen Versand an unsere Lieferteams vor und kümmern sich um Retouren, die nicht ausgeliefert werden konnten.
Jedes Jahr setzen wir neue Maßstäbe in puncto Kundenerlebnis und bieten neue, innovative Lieferdienste an. Wir suchen nach neuen Möglichkeiten, um branchenweite Logistikherausforderungen zu überwinden, sowie nach neuen Ideen, um unseren CO2-Fußabdruck zu reduzieren. Ein Fuhrpark innovativer Fahrzeuge (einschließlich E-Fahrzeugen) und modernste Technologie unterstützen uns dabei.

Basic qualifications

- Studienabschluss oder gleichwertige Qualifikation
- Erfahrung in der Führung von Teams sowie im Management verschiedener Stakeholder
- Englisch und Deutsch jeweils auf C1-Niveau (CEFR — Gemeinsamer Europäischer Referenzrahmen) in Wort und Schrift
- Erfahrung in der Nutzung quantitativer und qualitativer Daten zur Begründung geschäftlicher Entscheidungen
- Erfahrung in Produktions- und Lieferkettenbereichen

Preferred qualifications

- Erfahrung mit Lean, SixSigma und Kaizen-Methoden
- Erfahrung in einer ähnlichen Logistikumgebung
- Erfahrung in der Arbeit mit der MS Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook) im beruflichen Umfeld

title: Técnico/a de Seguridad y Salud
descriptionHtml:
En Amazon, la seguridad y el bienestar de nuestro personal es una prioridad absoluta. Nuestros Técnicos de Seguridad desempeñan un papel esencial para hacerlo posible. Este puesto es una oportunidad para comenzar tu carrera en seguridad laboral y desarrollarte en una empresa internacional. Colaborarás estrechamente con nuestros expertos para supervisar tu centro, lo que te permitirá ver cada día el impacto positivo de tu trabajo en el bienestar de las personas.

Key job responsibilities
- Realizar auditorías y evaluaciones de riesgos.
- Supervisar el centro para garantizar que los procesos cumplan con los procedimientos de seguridad de Amazon.
- Crear y actualizar informes sobre las métricas de seguridad para que otros empleados los revisen.
- Colaborar con el personal de Operaciones y de toda la empresa en tareas relacionadas con la seguridad y ofrecer orientación sobre los procesos.
- Apoyar en la implementación de nuevas medidas de seguridad.

A day in the life
Trabajarás en uno de nuestros centros. Esto significa que podrás seguir de cerca lo que sucede y los compañeros podrán consultarte fácilmente durante sus turnos. Este puesto consiste en identificar posibles problemas antes de que ocurran. Dedicarás mucho tiempo a revisar el centro y a conocer cómo el personal utiliza los equipos. Al comprender cómo funciona cada tarea y cada máquina, podrás pensar en la mejor forma de mantener los procesos seguros. También serás una de las personas encargadas de poner en práctica los cambios de seguridad, lo que implica trabajar estrechamente con muchas personas. Además de tus tareas diarias y semanales, ofrecerás apoyo al equipo de Operaciones en trabajos puntuales relacionados con la seguridad. La seguridad es fundamental en Amazon, y nos ayudarás a recopilar los datos esenciales que nos permiten controlar nuestros procesos y adelantarnos a cualquier incidencia. También compartirás esos datos con el personal de toda la empresa y colaborarás con otros equipos para asegurar que la seguridad sea siempre lo primero.

About the team
El equipo de Workplace Health and Safety (WHS) desempeña un papel fundamental para garantizar el bienestar mental y físico de nuestro personal en el trabajo. Nuestro equipo trabaja con responsables, asociados y administraciones locales en todos nuestros centros, asegurando el cumplimiento de las políticas de Amazon y las normativas legales, y garantizando la seguridad de nuestros entornos de trabajo. El equipo ofrece una variedad de oportunidades, desde Técnicos de Seguridad hasta Responsables de Programas. Independientemente de tu puesto, contribuirás al desarrollo y la implementación de la estrategia de seguridad en toda la red.

Basic qualifications

- Formación como técnico/a intermedio en prevención de riesgos laborales (Incluye las especializaciones en Seguridad en el Trabajo, Higiene Industrial y Ergonomía, y Psicosociología aplicada), de acuerdo con los reglamentos españoles en materia de salud y seguridad.
- Experiencia relevante en el cumplimiento de la legislación local en materia de salud y seguridad.
- Dominio del español y nivel básico de inglés (A2), escrito y hablado.

Preferred qualifications

- Las cualificaciones preferidas no son necesarias para solicitar un puesto en Amazon. Si cumples con todas las cualificaciones básicas anteriores, nos encantará saber de ti.
- Experiencia con metodologías Lean, 5S o Kaizen.
- Experiencia en la planificación o gestión de iniciativas medioambientales.
- Capacidad para trabajar de forma independiente y en equipo.

At your site, you’ll lead other managers and create the operational plan that helps your teams meet their targets. This role is all about driving operational excellence to create the Amazon of tomorrow.

Location: Eggolsheim
Shift: Yes (late shift or night shift)

What we offer:


- A permanent contract directly with Amazon
- An attractive compensation package including Restricted Stock Units (through Amazon.com, Inc.)
- Relocation package if your home is at least 80 km from the site
- Free life and disability insurance and support with company pension plans
- Employee discounts on amazon.de as well as Amazon Extras (e.g., discounts on travel, restaurants, entertainment, electronics, home, etc.)

You’ll lead shifts at one of our operational sites. You’ll also be the key link between a number of teams, including finance, safety and operations integration teams. That means you’ll be close to the day-to-day operations at your site but also contribute to new ways to innovate at your site.

Using air, sea and road transport, as well as sortation centres equipped with the latest technology, you’ll help Amazon’s transport run at maximum efficiency. Our team captures data and uses it to drive decisions. They are key to making Amazon more innovative and efficient.
We put safety first as our people are our priority. And we use the expertise of our people to get packages to their destination – quickly, conveniently and sustainably.

title: Operations Manager/ Kierownik Operacyjny
descriptionHtml:
Operations is the beating heart of Amazon. This key part of our business makes sure we fulfil and dispatch orders efficiently so that our customers get their items on time. It’s driven by Operations Managers who bring the team together to push excellence in safety, quality and productivity across our sites. At your site, you’ll lead other managers and create the operational plan that helps your teams meet their targets. This role is all about driving operational excellence to create the Amazon of tomorrow.


Key job responsibilities
- Manage and develop a team of Area Managers
- Lead operational teams on a shift, deal with issues, and positively impact site performance
- Analyse shift performance against relevant business objectives, and put in place actions to improve our operational excellence
- Work closely with other support teams, including HR, Finance, Health and Safety, and Security
- Design and deliver initiatives across the sites to improve operational performance

A day in the life
You’ll lead shifts at one of our operational sites. You’ll also be the key link between a number of teams, including finance, safety and operations integration teams. That means you’ll be close to the day-to-day operations at your site but also contribute to new ways to innovate at your site.

A typical day will involve meetings with different areas of the business, deep diving into performance and risk metrics for sites, and looking ahead to prepare for different levels of demand. Every day will also involve mentoring and coaching your team. You’ll be a source of leadership and support your team to be the best managers they can be.

IMPORTANT: Operations Managers and their teams work on-site, and are assigned to shifts that include one weekend day, and a day/night rotation every 4 weeks.

About the team
Customer Fulfilment, or CF, is where it all started for Amazon. CF has scaled up from a humble team of booksellers to a sophisticated global team which handles more than 1.5 million orders every day. The team is the foundation of our business and its efforts have helped us diversify across new regions and services. With the help of emerging technology, we’re always looking for ways to offer a bigger, better product range – delivered quickly and affordably.

The CF team are the first people in the chain that helps customers get products at the speed we’re known for. We’re based in Fulfilment Centres, which are at the heart of Amazon’s fast-paced Operations network. Our centres are sometimes referred to as the ‘First Mile’ because it’s where most Amazon packages start their journey. We help to manage dynamic inventory and facilitate speedy deliveries round the clock.

Lots of different people work in our Fulfilment Centres, so there are plenty of opportunities for every skillset. Some of us work with physical products, while others analyse data to help everyone across the business make smart decisions.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree, or MBA in supply chain, business, engineering, finance or related technical or quantitative field

descriptionHtml:

Amazon Leo is building a constellation of Low Earth Orbit satellites designed to deliver low-latency, high-speed broadband access to underserved and unserved communities around the world. Amazon Leo is seeking a motivated Associate Corporate Counsel to support regulatory and policy advocacy efforts that help establish the legal and regulatory frameworks enabling this global connectivity mission.

As Associate Corporate Counsel, you will research, analyze, and help draft advocacy positions on emerging regulations and policy proposals affecting Amazon Leo's spectrum rights, satellite operations, and broadband service offerings worldwide. You will prepare consultation responses, regulatory comments, policy position papers, and legal analyses on topics including spectrum allocation and sharing, satellite licensing and landing rights, telecommunications legislation, earth station regulations, and broadband/ISP regulatory frameworks. You will work closely with regulatory affairs, public policy, and business teams to develop and advance Amazon Leo's policy positions before national regulators, multilateral bodies such as the ITU, and other standard-setting organizations across multiple jurisdictions.

title: Security Engineer II, AWS Cloud Security Response
descriptionHtml:
The AWS Cloud Security Response team operates on the ‘AWS’ side of the Shared Responsibility Model, protecting our customers by ensuring the security of AWS Cloud services. Our engineers independently investigate and resolve security issues across 200+ AWS products, working hands-on with service code, security data, and cloud infrastructure at massive scale.

This role goes beyond coordination. You will apply security judgment to drive outcomes, close security gaps through code, and build automation that scales how we respond to security issues. You will think strategically, identifying patterns that point to systemic risks and driving proactive solutions before issues recur.

We are looking for security professionals who bring deep technical curiosity and the judgment to operate autonomously in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment. You will leverage the latest technology and tools to augment your capabilities, and you will partner closely with engineering teams to achieve security outcomes.

Successful candidates should:

- Exercise independent security judgment to assess risk, form informed opinions on severity, and drive engineering teams toward the right outcomes.

- Take a hands-on investigative approach to security issues, building deep technical understanding of risk and customer impact.

- Be technically proficient across security domains including network and operating system security, cryptography, software security, and incident response.

- Communicate complex security issues clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences at all levels.

- Challenge flawed analysis and escalate to senior leadership to ensure the best outcome for customers, even against consensus.

- Work effectively in AI-augmented workflows, using generative AI tools to accelerate security work.

- Mentor and coach junior engineers on security practices and professional growth.

- Drive security outcomes across organizational boundaries, partnering effectively with service teams and peer security teams.

An ideal candidate should be able to conduct most of the following:

- Close security gaps through code, working alongside service teams to develop and validate remediations.

- Navigate complex IAM and access control issues with confidence and technical depth.

- Build automation that improves how the team operates at scale.

- Think proactively, identifying systemic security themes and driving solutions that prevent classes of issues.

- Engage with cloud services at the architectural level, understanding how they work in order to assess and address risk.

Key job responsibilities
- Identify recurring security patterns across AWS services and drive proactive solutions that address root causes and prevent classes of issues.

- Build automation to scale incident response procedures, improving efficiency and reducing manual effort across the team’s global operations.

- Own and drive security issues from identification through resolution, bringing informed risk assessments and security judgment to every engagement with service teams.

- Independently reproduce and validate reported security issues to develop a deep understanding of the vulnerability, its exploitability, and its potential customer impact.

- Investigate and analyze security data across multiple sources to scope the impact of security issues and inform remediation priorities.

- Develop and validate remediations through hands-on code engagement, partnering with service teams to close security issues through code.

- Communicate the state of security issues to technical and non-technical audiences at all levels of seniority, up to and including the AWS Chief Information Security Officer. Escalate when the pace of resolution does not match the impact to customers.

A day in the life
As part of our follow-the-sun rotation, you will receive a handoff from global peers and take ownership of security issues presently in-flight. The issues could relate to any of our 200+ AWS products, so you will often need to learn on-the-fly.

Your first task may be to reproduce a newly reported vulnerability, working through service code and infrastructure to confirm the issue and assess the real-world risk. From there, you will analyze security data to understand whether customers have been impacted and determine the scope. You will engage service team engineers with a clear explanation of the issue, your reproduction details, and your recommended path forward.

As the day progresses, new issues will be assigned to you based on workload. You will triage them, determine their level of impact, and work toward resolution at the appropriate pace. For some issues, you will develop code-level remediations or build automation to address the problem at scale. Throughout the day, you will balance driving individual issues with identifying patterns across your caseload that point to systemic security gaps.

At the end of the day, you will document your work to allow the incoming shift to continue driving issues to resolution.

About the team
Cloud Response is a team within AWS Security Operations. This team is broadly responsible for the ‘AWS’ side of the Shared Responsibility Model, providing oversight of security issues from identification through resolution. Cloud Response operates follow-the-sun with teams based in four geographical locations.

We are evolving toward a model where our engineers are hands-on technical investigators who drive security outcomes through code, automation, and deep understanding of AWS services. We work with AWS service teams to ensure security issues are resolved with the right level of urgency while keeping stakeholders informed throughout the issue lifecycle.

Amazon Security values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon’s products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores.

Addressing the toughest security challenges requires that we seek out and celebrate a diversity of ideas, perspectives, and voices.

title: Clearance Processing Administrator, US ADC Security
descriptionHtml:
Amazon's Security team is looking for a Clearance Processing Administrator to build and sustain the cleared workforce for a U.S. Government program standing up a classified AI Factory. We are obsessed with getting the right people cleared, badged, and mission-effective as fast as the rules allow, because clearance throughput is the single biggest driver of whether this program starts on time. In this role you own personnel clearance processing end to end: submitting and tracking crossover packets and SCI access requests, verifying eligibility, citizenship, and investigation currency, and coordinating adjudications and access determinations with our sponsoring security office. You will work in the trenches with personnel security, program security officers, and hiring managers to turn a 120-plus person staffing plan into people who can actually walk into the SCIF and work. If you thrive on high-volume, high-stakes personnel security, this role is for you.

This position requires that the candidate selected be a US Citizen and must currently possess and maintain an active TS/SCI security clearance with polygraph.

Key job responsibilities
• Submit and track clearance crossover packets and SCI access requests (e.g., via the Government clearance-submission system).
• Verify eligibility, citizenship, SSBI/CIP currency, and need-to-know prior to access.
• Coordinate with the sponsoring security office on adjudications and access determinations.
• Maintain the personnel-security database and access records, and remove access when no longer required.

A day in the life
Each day starts with the clearance queue. You triage incoming crossover packets and SCI access requests, verify eligibility, citizenship, and investigation currency, and push the cleanest cases forward first to keep throughput high. You coordinate with the sponsoring security office on adjudications and pending access determinations, chase down the one missing document holding up a start date, and update the personnel-security database so records stay audit-ready. Between submissions you partner with program security officers and hiring managers to sequence the staffing plan, flagging risks before they stall a start. By day's end, more people can walk into the SCIF.

Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon’s products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores.

In Amazon Security, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Ongoing DEI events and learning experiences inspire us to continue learning and to embrace our uniqueness. Addressing the toughest security challenges requires that we seek out and celebrate a diversity of ideas, perspectives, and voices.

Training & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, training, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

descriptionHtml:
What if you could build intelligent systems that shape how millions of packages move through Amazon's transportation network every day?

North American Sort Centers (NASC) are a critical part of Amazon's Middle Mile transportation network, connecting fulfillment centers with the last-mile delivery network. NASC Tech is building the next generation of AI-powered planning and execution platforms that drive labor, capacity, and network connectivity decisions across hundreds of Sort Centers. We are looking for an experienced Software Development Engineer to help shape the technical direction of platforms that connect long-term strategic planning, mid-term optimization, and short-term operational execution into a unified ecosystem. Our vision is to move beyond disconnected planning tools and manual decision-making toward intelligent, event-driven systems where changes in network demand, capacity, or labor requirements can automatically trigger downstream model execution, planning adjustments, and operational actions. This is an opportunity to work at the intersection of distributed systems, Applied Science, and Agentic AI. You will design scalable model orchestration platforms, integrate ML models into production workflows, and build agentic systems that leverage LLMs, MCP, and tool-based integrations to connect data, and operational systems. As an SDE II in this team, you will own complex technical problems end-to-end, influence architecture and engineering decisions, and partner closely with Product, Applied Science, Data Engineering, and Operations teams across Amazon. If you enjoy building new systems, solving challenging engineering problems at scale, and turning emerging AI capabilities into practical solutions with measurable business impact, this role offers an opportunity to help define the future of Middle Mile planning technology.

Key job responsibilities
The position focuses on building scalable planning and execution platforms across multiple planning horizons within Sort cneters. You will partner closely with Product, Science, Site Operations, and cross-organizational teams including AFT and Sort Tech to develop intelligent systems that connects planning systems and operational execution. This includes building agentic systems, model orchestration frameworks, and AI-powered automation to streamline complex workflows and enable data-driven decision-making.

In addition, you will:

- Design and build scalable distributed systems and full-stack applications that solve complex operational challenges at Amazon scale.
- Architect and develop intelligent automation solutions that integrate AI capabilities, science models, and enterprise systems.

As an engineer on our team, your day could involve designing an event-driven workflow that automatically re-evaluates labor and capacity plans when network demand changes, building agents that connects planning data with ML models to generate actionable recommendations, or scaling distributed orchestration platforms that executes hundreds of optimization and simulation workflows across the Sort Center network. You will work closely with Scientists to host new models, collaborate with Product and Operations teams to understand real-world planning challenges, and partner with engineers across Amazon to integrate systems that have traditionally operated independently. Some days will focus on architecture and technical design, while others will involve hands-on development, experimentation with emerging AI technologies, reviewing code, or improving the reliability and performance of production systems. title: Program Manager, Supplier Development, Global Procurement Sustainability
descriptionHtml:
