In this role, you'll design and scale programs that accelerate the positive impact driven through Amazon's supply chain building supplier sustainability capability and readiness, unlocking capital access, creating innovation engines, and opening contract pathways giving suppliers of all sizes the tools they need to succeed at scale.
• You'll build scalable mechanisms, think digital workshops, e-learnings, training programs, resource hubs, and playbooks that connect suppliers to real improvement pathways
• You'll target and engage with suppliers directly through accelerator programs, office hours, focused workshops, and matchmaking programs connecting them to real opportunities and accelerated growth
• You'll partner across sustainability, procurement, finance, legal, and other teams to solve complex supplier readiness challenges
• You'll measure what matters: readiness outcomes, participation rates, sourcing introductions, capital access, and contract wins

This is a high-visibility role where a single, well-designed decision can change the experience of tens of thousands of suppliers across 20+ countries and directly advance Amazon's sustainability commitments.

Key job responsibilities
• Own the development, deployment, and maintenance of all content in the Supplier for Good (S4G) Academy – Amazon’s primary digital training and engagement platform for suppliers
• Design, launch, and scale the Supplier for Good (S4G) Resource Hub, providing suppliers – both existing and prospective – with on-demand access to the tools they need to succeed
• Build mechanisms that create clear growth pathways for small businesses and certified Suppliers for Good (S4G) to scale across the organization
• Identify, assess, and develop suppliers to meet current and future business needs across indirect procurement categories
• Partner with operations, finance, treasury, accounts payable, and legal teams to support supplier financing programs, payment term escalations, and onboarding processes
• Design and deliver workshops, accelerators, webinars, office hours, and educational engagements for suppliers at various stages of the supplier and readiness lifecycles
• Create playbooks, SOPs, intake mechanisms, development plans, and FAQs that standardize best practices across Amazon business units
• Define and report on supplier development metrics including readiness outcomes, payment term utilization, participation rates, capital access, and contract outcomes
• Serve as a primary escalation point for supplier readiness issues across the procurement ecosystem

A day in the life
Your morning might start by reviewing supplier intake requests and triaging development priorities. By mid-morning, you're partnering with finance colleagues on a payment terms escalation. After lunch, you're facilitating a supplier readiness workshop, coaching 100 small businesses through certification, operational, and sustainability requirements and connecting them to a category sourcing lead. Later, you're analyzing program metrics to identify where suppliers are getting stuck and building solutions to remove those barriers. No two days look alike, but the through-line is always the same: creating a positive impact by helping suppliers succeed responsibly.

About the team
We sit at the intersection of procurement and sustainability, focused on one mission: partnering with suppliers to make life better every day. We make it easier for suppliers of every size small, medium, and large; local and global to understand what Amazon expects, to build the capabilities to meet it, and to be recognized when they do. We are collaborative, data-driven, and builder-minded: we partner across procurement, sustainability, finance, learning, and technology to turn independent activities into a scalable, accountable system. If you want work that combines strategic thinking, technology, and tangible impact on real businesses and communities, this is the team.

- Experience in supply chain
- Experience in requirement gathering and ability to write clear and detailed requirement document
- Experience owning program strategy, managing end-to-end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
- Experience using data and metrics to measure impact and determine improvements

- Experience building and cultivating relationships with internal and external stakeholders
- Experience producing executive-level written materials and presenting to executive audiences

title: Senior Data Scientist, Amazon Leo
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is seeking a Senior Data Scientist to transform complex satellite, network, and customer terminal telemetry into actionable insights that drive system performance, reliability, and engineering decisions.

In this role, you will work with large-scale datasets generated across satellite payloads, ground infrastructure, customer terminals, and end-to-end laboratory and on-orbit testing environments. You will develop analytical models, statistical methods, and automated data processing solutions to identify performance trends, detect anomalies, isolate issues, and support system validation and operational readiness.

You will partner closely with systems, hardware, software, RF, and test engineering teams to establish meaningful performance metrics, correlate telemetry across multiple system components, and translate complex technical data into clear recommendations. Your work will directly influence engineering priorities, test strategies, system improvements, and launch readiness decisions.

The ideal candidate combines strong statistical and data science expertise with practical experience analyzing complex engineering systems, processing high-volume time-series data, and developing scalable analytical solutions. Experience in satellite communications, wireless networks, or telecommunications is highly desirable.

Export Control Requirement: Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Key job responsibilities
- Develop and maintain scalable data processing and analytical solutions for satellite payload, ground network, customer terminal, and laboratory test telemetry.
- Analyze large volumes of structured and unstructured data to identify system performance trends, anomalies, degradation, and potential failure conditions.
- Correlate telemetry across satellite payloads, RF systems, networking infrastructure, customer terminals, and application-level measurements to identify relationships and isolate root causes.
- Design statistical models, machine learning techniques, and predictive analytics to detect anomalies, characterize system behavior, and identify emerging reliability or performance issues.
- Establish performance baselines, key performance indicators (KPIs), and statistical methodologies to evaluate system functionality, reliability, and performance across laboratory and on-orbit environments.
- Analyze automated test results, test campaign data, and regression trends to identify software and hardware performance changes, recurring failures, and gaps in test coverage.
- Develop dashboards, automated reports, and visualization tools that enable engineering teams and leadership to understand system health, performance, and readiness.
- Apply statistical analysis and experimental design to compare software releases, hardware configurations, and system changes, quantifying their impact on end-to-end performance.
- Translate complex telemetry and analytical findings into actionable engineering recommendations that influence test priorities, troubleshooting, product improvements, and operational decisions.
- Collaborate across multiple engineering organizations to define data requirements, improve telemetry quality, and develop consistent analytical methodologies.
- Lead the development of reusable analytical frameworks and scalable solutions that improve engineering efficiency, reduce manual investigation, and accelerate decision-making.
- Mentor engineers and data scientists in statistical methods, telemetry analysis, data interpretation, and data-driven problem-solving.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of data querying languages (e.g. SQL), scripting languages (e.g. Python) or statistical/mathematical software (e.g. R, SAS, Matlab, etc.) experience
- 4+ years of data scientist experience
- Experience with statistical models e.g. multinomial logistic regression
- Experience building large-scale, high-throughput, 24x7 data systems
- Experience in functional or operational data analysis, based on large volumes of data
- Experience in identifying incomplete or inaccurate data, identifying the root cause and creating/implementing an escalation plan, or experience in creating process improvements with automation and analysis
- Experience in understanding performance metrics and developing them to measure progress against key performance indicators
- Experience programmatically testing products, measuring test coverage, developing the best automation, driving testability and diagnostic
- Experience developing tools, reports, process maps, scorecards, and data visualizations that improve upon those currently employed for understanding the business and making decisions
- Experience using data, reporting, or tools to measure performance and make adjustments accordingly
- Experience solving complex problems quantitatively and develop actionable data-driven business recommendations

Preferred qualifications

- Experience managing data pipelines
- Experience as a leader and mentor on a data science team
- Master's degree or equivalent in computer science, engineering, mathematics or equivalent, or experience in data science, machine learning or data mining
- Experience in embedded wireless systems, or experience in machine learning, data mining, information retrieval, statistics or natural language processing
- Experience troubleshooting and debugging technical systems, or experience operating highly available, distributed systems of data extraction, ingestion, and processing of large data sets
- Experience with AWS data warehouse and reporting technologies like Redshift, Athena, S3, etc.
- Experience in several of the following areas: machine learning, statistics, deep learning, natural language processing, or information retrieval
- Experience with data analytics platforms (Power BI, Python, SQL, Tableau), or experience in creating process improvements with automation and analysis
- Experience with one or more analytics visualization tools (e.g., Excel, Tableau, QuickSight, MicroStrategy, PowerBI)

title: Sr. Trade Manager, EMEA, Global Trade and Product Compliance
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Security is looking for an experienced Senior Trade Manager to support our Europe and Africa business on a broad range of global import, export and product compliance matters. You may interact with Amazon subsidiaries, product development, Data Center Engineering, Product Compliance Engineering, Amazon Services, Operations, Procurement, Supply Chain, Legal, Tax, Regulatory Authorities and other internal businesses and external stakeholders to drive trade and product compliance.


Amazon is at the forefront of providing a broad set of global cloud-based services including compute, storage, databases, networking, analytics, deep Machine learning, robotics, and enterprise applications, to help organizations move faster, lower IT costs, and scale. This is a dynamic business within Amazon, and one of the world’s fastest growing and evolving companies, with a team of exceptionally talented, bright and driven people. The role sits within the Amazon Global Trade and Product Compliance (GTPC) team and is responsible for ensuring the infrastructure and other equipment necessary to support the Amazon services are imported/exported in a compliant manner across the multiple countries where Amazon operates and expects to expand.


PRINCIPAL DUTIES:
- Develop, document, and maintain operational processes and procedures to support trade compliance and overall cross-border activity
- Build and own core trade compliance processes and analytical rhythms to align with subsidiary and key programs’ objectives.
- Monitor EMEA regional import/export regulatory or procedural changes that could impact planning for import or related requirements, and clearly communicate those guidelines to stakeholders during the export/import planning process.
- Establish and manage positive business relations with key stakeholders and business teams.
- Manage tasks and communication in relation to all regional regulations for Amazon trade and product compliance activities, including requirements gathering, executing import/export transactions, updating status reports, and coordinating team deliverables.
- Assist with technology, hardware, and software trade classification and related activities, including: Harmonized Tariff Schedule (HTS), import license reviews and applications to meet local partner government agency requirements
- Interface with internal and external functional partners to identify and rectify any information/process gaps.
- Build communications and training plans to achieve awareness in all internal and external partners so that they are aligned to trade and product compliance processes.
- Generate and contribute to performance requirements, timelines, and metrics for all related activities.
- Proactively identify and drive process improvement initiatives.
- The qualified candidate must have 10 or more years of trade compliance experience advising on Trade compliance topics or similar regulatory issues, covering Europe and Africa and ideally multiple additional countries in region. The successful candidate must be enthusiastic, and enjoys working hard, being challenged, and demonstrate sound judgment even in ambiguous situations.

title: Electrical Design & Verification Engineer (DVE), Leo Optical ISL Development
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is Amazon's low Earth orbit satellite network. Our mission is to deliver fast, reliable broadband connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. From households to small businesses, schools, hospitals, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will serve communities and organizations operating in places without dependable internet access.

The Design Verification Engineer will be a member of the Avionics team, focusing on the design verification of the various electrical functions of high-performance communication systems.
You will ensure proper data collection, reviews, and demonstrate the system requirement verification.

In this role, you will be responsible for developing Test SW (Python scripts) to test proprietary hardware. These scripts will interact with standard lab test equipment, execute automated functional checkout tests, analyze pass/fail criteria, and generate comprehensive test reports.

You will be part of a multidisciplinary avionics design team and work closely with PCBA design engineers, harness engineers, FPGA and embedded SW developers as well as system and integration engineers.

This is a fast-paced, intellectually challenging opportunity to work with thought leaders in multiple technology areas. You’ll have relentlessly high standards for yourself and everyone you work with, and you’ll be constantly looking for ways to improve.


Key job responsibilities
We are looking for an engineer who combines superb technical and analytical capabilities with a demonstrated ability to get the right things done quickly and effectively.

Automated Functional Testing: Develop test sequences that can perform automated functional checkout tests on proprietary hardware to ensure reliability and performance.

Data Analysis: Implement algorithms to analyze test data, compare results against predefined pass/fail criteria, and provide insights into the hardware's performance.

Report Generation: Generate detailed test reports that summarize test results, including pass/fail status, and provide valuable information for the broader team.

In this role, you will conduct test readiness reviews and align with various stakeholders on data review activities

Expect to work with a team of top-notch engineers and influence overall test strategy by helping define system test requirements

You should be comfortable with a high degree of autonomy and relish the idea of solving problems that haven't been solved at scale before.
You are expected to maintain requirements traceability during testing and solve integration and test problems in real time.
If this sounds like the role for you, come make history with us!

You will tackle challenging, novel situations every day and have the opportunity to work with multiple technical teams at Amazon in different locations. In this role, you will be a member of the Hardware Test, Verification, and Validation Team with responsibilities for developing hardware tests and test automation for validation of various avionics systems. This is a cross-functional role requiring constant interaction with multiple HW/SW design teams and end-users.

- Experience with prototyping and implementation
- Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field
- Solid understanding of EE and test fundamentals
- 3+ years of experience in board level design verification for aerospace, automotive, or consumer electronics products; OR 3+ years of experience building test fixtures and complex test systems including integrating test software3+ years of experience in board level design verification for aerospace, automotive, or consumer electronics products; OR 3+ years of experience building test fixtures and complex test systems including integrating test software

- Ability to coordinate between engineering, test lab, and technicians and schedule testing resources

title: Sr. Associate - Quality Analyst, Global Solutions & Risk Compliance (GSRC)
descriptionHtml:
The Global Solutions and Risk Compliance (GSRC) organization is a component of Amazon's operations, dedicated to ensuring the compliance of its products and services worldwide. GSRC's core mission is to keep customers, partners, and associates safe while protecting the company from legal and regulatory risks. With a diverse global team spanning across India, China, Poland, Romania, Netherlands, Jordan, Philippines and Costa Rica, GSRC partners with its stakeholders to classify products and ensure regulatory and legal compliance for product listings. GSRC raises the bar on quality by implementing operational changes matching the everchanging regulatory space. The team designs global, consistent, and scalable solutions and prioritize a blend between technology-driven and human decision-making processes. GSRC believes that innovation thrives on diversity, fostering an inclusive and equitable culture that empowers employees with opportunities for learning and development.

Key job responsibilities
Your job responsibilities as a Sr. Compliance Associate-Quality Analyst may include:
• Performs quality audits on a daily basis using Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) and achieves self-utilization, productivity and quality as per defined targets.
• Must be able to comprehend SOPs with minimal support and identify opportunities.
• Identifies anomalies through audits (SOP defects, Process gaps etc.).
• Uses knowledge and identifies defect/s & preliminary root causes, explains the rationale
• Proposes solutions on quality/productivity and work on milestones with managers
• Expertise in research – finding specific information (eg: products, regulations etc) in a timely manner.
• Prepares key insight trends and share reports on regular basis.
• Provide feedbacks to the associates and close loop on audit observations.
• Respond to stakeholders with guidance and flags any updates to Lead/Manager

About the team
Amazon is an E-commerce and Cloud Computing company with headquarters in Seattle, Washington. Since 1995, Amazon has focused on being “the world’s most customer centric company.” Our customers are worldwide, and include not just consumers, but also our sellers and vendors (selling partners). World-class retail brands and individual sellers increase their sales and reach new customers by leveraging the power of the Amazon e-commerce platform. To meet our selling partners’ needs, our smart, diverse, customer-obsessed employees are constantly innovating and building on new ideas.
The Operational Risk Compliance (ORC) organization exists to keep our customers and partners safe, protect associates, and ensure legal and regulatory compliance. We coordinate the aspects of product transactions that are regulated (distribution, shipping, sale, and import/export). Global Solutions and Risk Compliance (GSRC) is the operational arm of the ORC organization. This involves analyzing product import documentation and flagging hazardous risks. We are also responsible for keeping Amazon customers safe and informed by coordinating actions around worldwide program teams to classify products and ensure Amazon’s product listings follow regulatory and legal compliance guidelines. These actions include removing products from the site and from our warehouses, and contacting customers with pertinent sustainability information. The ORC team partners with GSRC supports regulatory compliance requirements for Amazon’s worldwide programs such as Dangerous Goods, Chemical Safety Compliance, Global Trade Services, Transport Risk Compliance, Sustainability, Extended Producer Responsibility and Food Safety. GSRC has offices across India, China, Poland, Romania, Jordan, Philippines and Costa Rica and supports compliance related needs for worldwide Amazon marketplaces.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree
- 1+ years of logistics, transportation, supply chain, import/export operations, or data entry/data administration experience
- Knowledge of Excel at a basic level (e.g., UX navigation, math & logical functions, lookup functions, etc.)
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English
- Work 40 hours/week, and overtime as required
- Experience performing accurate data entry and analysis

Preferred qualifications

- High school or equivalent diploma
- Bachelor's degree in logistics, transporation, supply chain, or business
- Licensed customs broker
- Experience in international logistics, cross-border transportation and supply chain, or U.S. Customs rules and regulations
- Experience in customs

title: Cost Program Manager, APJC Data Center Capacity Delivery, APJC Construction Program (PMO)
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables affecting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

The APJC Data Center Capacity Delivery (DCCD) Construction PMO is looking for a Cost Program Manager to own and mature cost management as a discipline across the full data center project lifecycle. This role covers both Pre-Construction and Construction and drives cost initiatives at the DCCD organisational level.

You won’t control cost on a single project. You will build and govern the system that our cost teams work within: the processes, standards, data, tools, reporting and training behind cost planning and cost control across Asia Pacific. You will support Pre-Construction Cost Planners, Cost Control Cost Engineers and Construction Managers, and work closely with Global Cost Control, Global Tooling, Procurement and Finance. The ideal candidate knows construction cost well, has a strong bias toward automation and standardisation, and can lead change across multiple teams and regions.

Key job responsibilities
Cost Management Manual: Lead the revamp of the Cost Management Manual and maintain in the long term. Make processes more regionally focused while keeping the alignment with global processes to support upstream reporting.

Global BID template: Revamp and standardise the global BID template so cost control teams work from an agreed baseline, with flexibility for regional breakdowns.

Cost reporting: Restructure and automate Quarterly Business Review and Monthly Business Review cost reporting, aligned globally reporting to VP level.

Cost planning, estimating and control tool: Develop an end-to-end tool in phases, starting with a repository of BAFO and Final Cost data integrated with the Procurement Platform. This gives Cost Planners historical averages to build estimates at DD and early design and set the Budget.

DCCD and Data Center Planning and Delivery (DCPD) cost initiatives: Support DCCD and DCPD cost initiatives and lead cost-related discussions at DCCD level.

Legacy tool deprecation: Lead the retirement of legacy tools to reduce tool fragmentation and maintenance effort.

Integrated financial management tool: Partner with Global Tooling and Cost Control to deliver an integrated financial management tool, including integration with the internal financial system.

Change order categories: Revamp change order categorisation. Consolidate the root-cause-of-change taxonomy and standardise categories across tools, so change orders are classified in the same way region-wide and support year-on-year trend analysis.

Cost training and development: Develop and deliver cost training, including setting up the Amazon Learn Cost Training cohort.

Governance: Run cost governance and audit across the region, and give ad-hoc process and tooling support to cost teams.

Metrics: Define, track and report program KPIs, including adoption of standards, data quality, reporting automation and tool rollout milestones.

A day in the life
You might start the day with Cost Planners reviewing how historical BAFO data feeds into a new estimate, then join a Global Tooling working session on the integrated financial management tool. In the afternoon you could be finalising the half-yearly VP cost pack, agreeing change order root-cause categories with Cost Control Engineers, or running a training session for a new cohort. You will use data to tell the business what it shows, earn trust across teams, and push for simpler, automated ways of working.

About the team
The APJC Construction PMO supports data center delivery across Asia Pacific with program governance, schedule and cost management, digital delivery and training. The team stays lean and focuses on automation, standardisation and capability building, so our Construction, Pre-Construction and Cost Control teams can deliver faster and at lower cost. You will work with a global network of Construction Managers, Pre-Construction Managers, Cost Planners, Cost Control Engineers and Program Managers.

Basic qualifications

- 7+ years of quantity surveying, cost planning, cost management and cost control experience on large, complex projects, including estimating, budgeting and cost control
- Experience using various cost estimating and planning tools, including using BIM models for quantity take-off, conducting market research and building cost planning models that enable early-stage cost forecasts to inform leadership decisions on land selection, design type and build technology
- Experience building cost repositories, rate libraries, benchmarking tools or estimating models

Preferred qualifications

- Experience working in data centers or critical infrastructure
- Experience in identifying, leading, and executing opportunities to improve, automate, standardize or simplify finance or business tools and processes, or experience designing and implementing controls or experience performing audits over financial reporting environment
- Experience developing and implementing training programs
- Master’s degree in construction management, project management, quantity surveying, cost modelling, engineering, finance or equivalent
- RICS Quantity Surveyor Member or AIQS Credit QS, or equivalent in experience and qualification.
- Experience standardising processes and documentation, such as manuals, templates and change order categorization, supporting Finance on return on investment (ROI) analysis

title: Senior Structural Engineer, TIPM, Global Realty Building Design & Engineering
descriptionHtml:
Amazon is seeking an experienced Structural Engineer to join our team as Senior Technical Infrastructure Program Manager (TIPM), playing a pivotal role in leading design, facility, and engineering activities within Amazon's Fulfillment Network across Europe, Middle East, and Africa (EMEA). This role will be located in Luxembourg or Madrid with occasional travel. Reporting directly to the Head of Global Building Design & Engineering in Luxembourg, the successful candidate will be responsible for developing and cross-functionally managing structural engineering programs aimed at optimizing and enhancing the safety and efficiency of both existing and new facilities. Collaboration with various stakeholders will be essential to drive the development and management of fire protection design specifications. The ideal candidate will possess extensive project and program management experience, practical knowledge of structural engineering, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, technical environment while partnering with multiple stakeholders to implement cost-saving processes and programs.

You will be our Subject Matter Expert for Timber, Metal and Concrete structures supporting the structural solutions for the prototype templates, working with other Global teams such as Sustainability and Execution teams such as Preconstruction and Construction.

Key job responsibilities
The Sr TIPM (Technical Infrastructure Program Manager) will be the single threaded leader on structural design initiatives across the EMEA/EU/LATAM region while tracking key metrics and performance, function as consulting SME to stakeholders, be able to build a business case and market building improvements, and work across the industry to understand trends and develop scalable technologies.

A day in the life
Your morning begins with a cross-functional stand-up alongside architects, mechanical engineers, and construction managers, aligning on a new fulfillment center design. You dive into structural modeling — optimizing steel frames, analyzing seismic and equipment loads, and future-proofing for robotics. Midday brings peer design reviews where you challenge assumptions and drive cost-efficient solutions. Afternoons involve coordinating with fabricators, resolving site queries with bias for action, and developing standardized design templates that accelerate delivery across the network. You mentor junior engineers, collaborate globally, and own your designs from concept through construction. Here, you don't just design structures — you build the infrastructure powering customer delivery at unprecedented scale.

About the team
Global Realty Building Design & Engineering (GBDE) is the centralized, Architectural and Engineering subject matter expert for Global Customer Fulfillment, Amazon Transportation Services, and Global Delivery Services , including Global Specialty Fulfillment and Amazon Logistics. The primary functions of GBD are to create and maintain facility design templates, criteria, and guidelines on behalf of our customers, and centralize global design references for output of frugality and the highest standards. The team creates value for the Operations Network by aggregating business and cross-functional requirements to drive cost control, operational functionality efficiency, consistency, and safety to facilitate rapid decision making.

Basic qualifications

- Master's degree in Structural Engineering
- Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
- Experience working with large, complex data sets

Preferred qualifications

- 5+ years of experience in structural design of industrial, warehouse, or large-scale commercial buildings,Proficiency in structural analysis software (ETABS, STAAD Pro, SAP2000, RISA, or Tekla Structures),Familiarity with seismic design, dynamic equipment loads, and vibration analysis,Working knowledge of international building codes (IBC, IS, Eurocode, AS)

title: Sr Environment Compliance Mgr, EAP
descriptionHtml:
SEU team is seeking a Senior Environmental Compliance Manager who will be responsible for managing environmental compliance at Amazon Facilities within Italy. They will also provide technical support for existing operations and future expansion across Italy and SEU. The Senior Environmental Compliance Manager will report to the SEU Environmental Leader through the EU Environmental Assurance and Protection team.
The Senior Environmental Compliance Manager will partner with operations leadership teams to execute company environmental procedures and ensure compliance with all applicable specific country, state/province, region and local regulations. Utilizing risk assessments and compliance evaluations, this individual will lead site specific continuous improvement initiatives to minimize environmental aspects and impacts and communicate and implement best practices.
This role entails up to 50% travel to multiple sites across Italy, and EU.

The applicable collective agreement for this role is Logistics, Delivery and Shipping Sector. The position is classified at level Quadro or above, depending on the candidate's skills, competences and experience.


Key job responsibilities
Compliance management:
- Manage and execute multi-site responsibilities to comply with air emissions, storm-water, waste, wastewater, energy, and other environmental laws, regulations, and permits, including required country, state/province, and local reporting.
- Establish and maintain cross-organizational alignment on a unified environmental compliance vision, spanning all in-scope business units and integrating objectives into OP1, OP2, and quarterly planning cycles.
- Communicate compliance strategy, program status, and escalation risks clearly and concisely to Director- and VP-level audiences across Operations, Legal, Finance, and Technology.
- Define, implement, and govern key performance indicator (KPI) and compliance metric frameworks that provide real-time visibility into program performance, milestone achievement, and regulatory posture across all business units in the assigned country.

Risk assessment and mitigation:
- Serve as the environmental subject-matter expert for the assigned area; stay current on related industry trends (e.g., changing regulations, innovations in risk mitigation, testing mechanisms) and know how to apply them across teams.
- Measure and analyze sites’ performance against published requirements in environmental policies. For all deficiencies, identify and implement a remediation plan.
- Navigate ambiguity in environmental risk programs and projects where the risk, the business problem, and the solution may not be clearly defined.
- Drive goal- and regulation-based control outcomes and risk reduction, informing and helping to establish mechanisms to bring risk within tolerance levels. Manage overall schedules, overcome obstacles, and keep scope under control.

Stakeholder / Program management:
- Develop and maintain relationships with business partners to support their success in environmental compliance, performance and sustainability initiatives.
- Cooperate in contact with the authorities and in the implementation of notification, permission and approval procedures under environmental law (water / wastewater, pollution control, air, waste, energy).
- Lead the talent management lifecycle, including hiring, onboarding, and structured development planning that builds organizational depth and capability.


A day in the life

Every day will be different. You will be visiting Amazon's Italy locations, engaging with the local teams and ensure the sites and the business as a whole are set up to deliver effective environmental compliance. You could be working with our Legal Team to engage a Regulator, collaborating with Maintenance or Safety partners, or helping sites deliver environmental training.
A flexible approach to work is essential in this role, as priorities can shift in a dynamic environment. As a team, we need to be able to respond accordingly.


About the team
Amazon's Worldwide Environmental Assurance and Protection (EAP) team is responsible for ensuring that Amazon's global operation is the benchmark for environmental excellence across all similar industries. EAP transforms environmental regulatory compliance into a zero-defect process through scalable, sustainable, and technology-enabled solutions that protect the business, our communities, and the environment.

Basic qualifications

- Speak, write, and read fluently in Italian and English at C1 level or above
- Bachelor’s degree in the Environmental Sciences, Environmental Engineering, or related field of study, or equivalent level of qualification in line with the European Qualifications Framework (EQF).
- In depth knowledge of EU environmental regulations, including country-level (IT) and local environmental regulations.
- Experience managing environmental compliance, audit, or risk management programs spanning multiple operational sites or BUs across different regulatory jurisdictions within the EU.

title: Sr. Compliance Associate-Quality Analyst, Global Solutions Risk and Compliance (GSRC)
descriptionHtml:
The Global Solutions Risk and Compliance (GSRC) team ensures that Amazon transactions satisfy legal and safety requirements in accordance to the guidelines across global marketplaces. We proactively identify risks involved for Amazon while doing business in various countries and enable smooth flow of products across international borders. A Sr. Compliance Associate- Quality Analyst is responsible for protecting Amazon customers from products that are illegal, hazardous, unsafe, or otherwise prohibited /regulated by Law and Amazon policies.

Key job responsibilities
Your job responsibilities as a Sr. Compliance Associate-Quality Analyst may include:
• Performs quality audits on a daily basis using Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) and achieves self-utilization, productivity and quality as per defined targets.
• Must be able to comprehend SOPs with minimal support and identify opportunities.
• Identifies anomalies through audits (SOP defects, Process gaps etc.).
• Uses knowledge and identifies defect/s & preliminary root causes, explains the rationale
• Proposes solutions on quality/productivity and work on milestones with managers
• Expertise in research – finding specific information (eg: products, regulations etc) in a timely manner.
• Prepares key insight trends and share reports on regular basis.
• Provide feedbacks to the associates and close loop on audit observations.
• Respond to stakeholders with guidance and flags any updates to Lead/Manager

Skills:
• Proficiency in verbal & written communication in English
• Good working knowledge of MS Office, MS Outlook; MS Excel. Proficiency is an advantage.
• Strong attention to details.
• Ability to analyze and identify patterns in large data sets.
• Decision making aptitudes based on given guidelines and in ambiguous contexts.
• Must be comfortable working with large data sets.
• Very good knowledge and experience in internet navigation and research – finding specific information about products in a timely manner.

About the team
Amazon is an E-commerce and Cloud Computing company with headquarters in Seattle, Washington. Since 1995, Amazon has focused on being “the world’s most customer centric company.” Our customers are worldwide, and include not just consumers, but also our sellers and vendors (selling partners). World-class retail brands and individual sellers increase their sales and reach new customers by leveraging the power of the Amazon e-commerce platform. To meet our selling partners’ needs, our smart, diverse, customer-obsessed employees are constantly innovating and building on new ideas.
The Operational Risk Compliance (ORC) organization exists to keep our customers and partners safe, protect associates, and ensure legal and regulatory compliance. We coordinate the aspects of product transactions that are regulated (distribution, shipping, sale, and import/export). Global Solutions and Risk Compliance (GSRC) is the operational arm of the ORC organization. This involves analyzing product import documentation and flagging hazardous risks. We are also responsible for keeping Amazon customers safe and informed by coordinating actions around worldwide program teams to classify products and ensure Amazon’s product listings follow regulatory and legal compliance guidelines. These actions include removing products from the site and from our warehouses, and contacting customers with pertinent sustainability information. The ORC team partners with GSRC supports regulatory compliance requirements for Amazon’s worldwide programs such as Dangerous Goods, Global Trade Services, Transport Risk Compliance, Sustainability, Extended Producer Responsibility and Food Safety. GSRC has offices across India, China, Poland, Romania, Jordan, Philippines and Costa Rica and supports compliance related needs for worldwide Amazon marketplaces.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English
- Experience with Microsoft Office products and applications
- 1+ years of data-driven business operations processes experience
- Business Process Outsourcing, Operations processes; Database management is an added advantage

Preferred qualifications

- Knowledge of consumer product compliance processes and regulations
- Experience in regulatory compliance management with government agencies
- Experience as a quality auditor in retail chain management / FMCG company / Corporate role
- Experience in designing and implementing custom reporting systems using automation tools
- Experience with data analysis in a variety of quantitative fields and experience building data and decision support systems
- Knowledge of database query technologies (SQL)

Key job responsibilities
Job Description
As a SLAM Intern, you will join our team to advance the localization and mapping capabilities of our last-mile delivery robot. Your work will directly shape how our robot perceives and navigates complex urban environments from benchmarking existing approaches to prototyping novel algorithms and validating them on hardware. This role offers hands-on experience in spatial perception, algorithm development, and real-world deployment within a dynamic and collaborative environment. We are committed to finding and nurturing exceptional talent; our internships are a key pathway to recruiting outstanding graduates who can make a significant impact in our team.

descriptionHtml:

You will work with Brazilian and global vendors to drive all aspects of terms improvements, which includes analysis and projections, as well as direct negotiations with decision makers in local vendors. Additionally, you will increase product category sales, by auditing vendors performances, driving store marketing promotions, negotiating partners to improve selection, and reacting to industry-related economic trends.

You will have excellent verbal and written communication, the ability to analyze and communicate complex terms and margin structure and work well across other teams including Finance and Inventory Management. Candidates who are organized, flexible, creative, analytical, and able to drive negotiations through completion will be highly appreciated. Strong ownership values, a real passion for innovation, and hustle are also key to succeed in this position.

If you are passionate about e-commerce and career growth, this opportunity with Amazon.com.br is for you!

Key job responsibilities
Retail Managers focus on and act at the intersection of customers, vendors, and functional teams:

* CUSTOMERS: They rely on specialized teams for customer and category information and insights, and works with and influences other teams to get the category-specific customer needs addressed. The Retail Manager is responsible to hold category-specific knowledge about customers and their needs, emerging product trends and the market segment evolution, and new business opportunities.

*VENDORS: RM are the ultimate owners of the vendor relationship, with a direct focus on the top vendors that drive the vast majority of sales. They are directly responsible for auditing and escalating performance, improving overall terms and cost structures of the relationship by means of negotiation, and for developing long term partnerships with new and existing vendors to drive topline and selection fueling category growth.

*CENTRAL AND FUNCTIONAL TEAMS: As a business owner, the RM represents customer and business needs in interaction with central teams, projects and initiatives.The Retail Manager drives central teams for the evolution of customer-facing and internal systems to improve the customer experience from the category perspective. At the same time, they implements centrally driven initiatives within the category to drive CX or cost improvements, even more important prioritize based on impact and potential tradeoffs, and if need be pushing back on selected initiatives.

A day in the life
Retail Managers are owners of the Retail business. Either for subcategories or subgroup of vendors they own the respective business end-to-end including the entire P&L, from topline down to free cash flow. They manage inputs by driving selection, securing great prices and increasing convenience/speed to accelerate Amazon’s flywheel. While they focus their activities on our most strategically relevant vendors and holdouts, they audit and escalate the performance of lower tiered vendors.

title: Sr. Manager - Technical Product Management , Alexa for Shopping (Rufus) Agentic AI
descriptionHtml:
We are seeking a Senior Product Leader to build agentic shopping experiences on Amazon. Alexa for Shopping (AFS), formerly Rufus, is Amazon's Shopping AI, a high-visibility generative AI investment within the Stores business built on large language models (LLMs). Our vision is for AFS to be an always-on personal shopping agent that learns what matters to each customer, anticipates their needs, and acts on their behalf. Beyond responding to requests, AFS will proactively recognize opportunities to help, suggest timely next steps, and follow through on goals that unfold over days, weeks, or months.

If you are passionate about reinventing e-commerce, helping customers offload tedious shopping tasks to smart, autonomous AI, and building a team that does the same, this is a rare opportunity to define the future of agentic commerce at Amazon.

In this role, you will own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for AFS's agentic portfolio. The portfolio spans customer-initiated automations such as price and deal alerts and replenishment, proactive experiences where AFS recognizes opportunities to help, long-running goals that AFS follows through over weeks or months, and the platform capabilities that let teams across Amazon Stores build agentic experiences. You will lead a team of PM-Ts, each owning a set of features. You will set the portfolio's goals, decide where to invest, and hold the team to a high bar on customer outcomes. Success means customers save time, money, and effort, trust AFS to act within their instructions, and engage more, with progress measured in customer value per action.

To get there, you will shape the priorities of AFS Engineering and Science teams, pairing a clear product vision with rigorous technical execution. You will partner with multiple Applied Science and Engineering organizations to push new frontiers and build experiences that state-of-the-art models only now make possible. You will make data-driven portfolio decisions: which bets to scale, which to iterate, and which to retire, grounded in experiment results and customer signals. You will also hire, coach, and develop product leaders who invent novel LLM-driven interactions that balance technical feasibility with customer delight.

Key job responsibilities
Build
- Build and prototype hands-on. Use AI-native tools to turn ideas into working agentic prototypes in days, test them with customers and leaders, and to set engineering and science priorities.
- Dogfood the portfolio and competitive landscape and make it a team habit.
- Set the bar for agent quality, trust, and safety with Science and Responsible AI partners.
- Partner with platform teams to define the shared agentic primitives (triggers, mission state, actions, scheduling) that let builders across Amazon Stores launch experiences independently.

Think Big
- Own the multi-year vision, strategy, and roadmap for the agentic portfolio, and write the narratives (OP1, PRFAQs, strategy docs) that align senior leadership on where agentic commerce goes next.
- Define portfolio goals and metrics that tie agentic features to incremental customer and business value. Decide which bets to scale, iterate, or retire based on experiment results and customer signals.
- Invent new interaction models for agentic shopping, and set the direction for capabilities that state-of-the-art models only now make possible.

Lead
- Hire, coach, and develop a team of PM-Ts who are builders and strategic thinkers. Set clear ownership boundaries, raise the bar on product judgment, technical depth, and writing, and expect every PM to prototype and dogfood.
- Set priorities across Engineering, Science, UX, and partner teams, including Notifications, Personalization, Pricing, Search, and Ads, and resolve trade-offs across team boundaries.
- Run the review mechanisms (WBRs, goal reviews, launch readiness) that drive delivery, experimentation, and international expansion of the portfolio.

- Bachelor's degree
- Experience in technical product management, program management or engineering
- Experience managing teams
- Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
- Experience with end to end product delivery
- Experience leading engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
- Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product

title: Corporate Counsel, Amazon Leo (Satellites / Communications)
descriptionHtml:
Help shape the future of global connectivity.

Amazon Leo is building a constellation of low Earth orbit satellites designed to deliver low-latency, high-speed broadband access to underserved and unserved communities around the world. Amazon Leo is seeking an experienced Corporate Counsel to support strategic commercial customer agreements, technology transactions, and commercial engagements that help power this global connectivity mission.

As Corporate Counsel, you will negotiate and structure complex commercial transactions that support Amazon Leo’s growing portfolio of enterprise customers, channel partners, and mobility-related engagements. You will work closely with business, product, and operations teams on high-impact agreements that shape Amazon Leo’s commercial strategy.

This is an opportunity to work at the intersection of satellite technology, telecommunications, emerging technology, and sophisticated commercial transactions within one of Amazon’s most ambitious innovation initiatives.

Export Control Requirement:
Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Some domestic and international travel will be required.

Key job responsibilities
- Draft and lead negotiations for strategic enterprise agreements, commercial transactions, technology partnerships, and channel partner agreements supporting Amazon Leo’s global connectivity business, with a focus on mobility engagements
- Advise business teams on legal, commercial, operational, and strategic considerations associated with large-scale customer and partnership engagements
- Develop practical and scalable legal frameworks that enable rapid business growth while appropriately managing organizational risk
- Partner cross-functionally with product, business development, operations, and compliance to support evolving commercial models and international expansion initiatives
- Help build efficient legal processes that support fast-moving technology and infrastructure businesses


A day in the life
Your day will combine strategic commercial counseling, sophisticated transaction negotiation, and cross-functional collaboration. You will work directly with business leaders and partner teams to structure enterprise agreements, support complex customer and channel partner negotiations, and advise on emerging commercial and operational issues tied to satellite connectivity and global infrastructure expansion.

About the team
Amazon Leo’s legal team is a collaborative group of commercial and technology attorneys supporting the development and expansion of next-generation satellite connectivity solutions. The team works closely with business leaders, engineers, product teams, and global partners to navigate complex legal and commercial challenges while enabling innovation at global scale.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of post bar admission legal experience
- Juris Doctor and membership in one state bar or equivalent
- Experience in transactional and technology licensing or equivalent

Preferred qualifications

- Experience of a mix of corporate law firm and in-house work
- Experience supporting enterprise customers, strategic commercial partnerships, or channel partner transactions
- Experience advising on technology transactions, telecommunications agreements, infrastructure projects, or emerging technology matters
- Experience in technology, telecommunications, infrastructure, satellite, cloud, or related industries
- Ability to provide practical, business-oriented legal advice in fast-paced and evolving environments
- Experience working cross-functionally with business, operational, product, and leadership stakeholders
- Experience supporting global or international commercial transactions

title: Area Manager, EU AMZL Central Operations.
descriptionHtml:
When you join Amazon as an Area/Shift Manager, you’ll gain experience leading a large and diverse team to make sure your area of the business keeps pace with demand. In this hands-on role, you’ll learn about the complexity of operations at a global business and what it takes to make everything run seamlessly. While you implement your team’s approach to drive productivity, you’ll also work closely with your colleagues to address challenges, which means no two days will be the same.



Key job responsibilities
- Promote a culture of safety and wellbeing
- Analyse and implement corrective actions to make sure quality and productivity are at consistently high levels, and business objectives are met across all shifts
- Support and lead a team and handle administrative work alongside building and supporting a strong team culture
- Analyse performance and suggest process improvements to optimise work and improve customer service
- Collaborate with other managers to standardise shift processes

A day in the life
You’ll work shifts and be based at one of our operational sites. Your main focus will be to maintain safety standards within your team and across your site. You’ll also monitor and maintain process efficiency. Your days will always include prioritising routine team management and daily operational tasks, alongside other tasks like individual escalations, process improvement work and wide-scale operational contingency planning.

Being a key part of the operations team involves working with colleagues in other teams and external partners to make sure we stay on track to meet our customer demands and targets. This will involve analysing data and performance metrics with leaders in your business area, as well as discussing the operational pros and cons of technical improvements with engineers.

(Sun to Wed AM shift)

- completed university degree before the start date OR graduated within the last 24 months
- Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays

- Experience in English-language communication skills, both written and verbal
- University degree (Bachelor's or Master's degree), completed before start date or 2+ years of Amazon Tenure
- Relevant experience in performing data analysis

Preferred qualifications

title: Creative Director, XCM Design Dept.
descriptionHtml:
The XCM Design Department is looking for an experienced, hands-on Creative Director whose passion for design is matched by flawless execution and smart strategic thinking. The ideal candidate is a design thinker and maker — equally comfortable concepting brand systems and rolling up their sleeves to execute alongside the team — who develops bar-raising creative for visual brand identities, onsite experiences, and campaigns spanning Amazon’s portfolio. They are a problem solver with a strong bias for action and a genuine dedication to craft, equally skilled working across digital, social, broadcast, print, and OOH channels. They thrive collaborating with designers, writers, motion designers, photographers, and marketing professionals to deliver brand experiences seen by millions of customers worldwide.

Key job responsibilities
- Lead hands-on creative development from concept through delivery across brand systems, campaigns, and digital/physical channel executions — actively contributing to the work, not just directing it.
- Develop and maintain brand identity and system guidelines that scale across multiple global touchpoints.
- Direct and mentor a team of designers, writers, and creative contractors while remaining an active contributor to the work.
- Build and maintain cross-functional relationships with product, consumer research, and marketing teams to translate strategy and consumer insights into compelling creative.
- Design and produce mockups, prototypes, and production assets across digital, social, broadcast, print, and OOH channels.
- Own brand personality and creative vision across XCM’s portfolio of Amazon brands and initiatives, evangelizing brand purpose globally.
- Partner with motion designers, photographers, and directors to execute high-production brand experiences.

A day in the life
As Creative Director, you will partner with Designers, CDs, and the Group CD to bring exceptional ideas to life through brand design.

On any given day you might be:
- Concepting and designing alongside the team — not just reviewing work, but actively creating mockups, exploratory directions, and production-ready assets.
- Interpreting a creative brief and rapidly developing design directions that respond to both business goals and customer needs.
- Directing a small team of designers in close collaboration with program managers, production, motion, and media teams.
- Presenting creative concepts to senior executives and cross-functional stakeholders with clarity, confidence, and narrative.
- Developing or refining brand system guidelines that scale across global touch points.
- Advocating for the brand, the design organization, and your team across Amazon's broader partner ecosystem.
- Managing multiple projects simultaneously, maintaining high creative standards against tight deadlines.

Basic qualifications

- 8+ years of driving compelling creative strategy and execution at an agency or in-house creative team experience
- Have an online portfolio demonstrating strong visual design skills and advertising experience across a range of media and platforms, along with work that reflects your design process
- Bachelor’s degree in design, Fine Arts, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

Preferred qualifications

- Deep understanding of typography, layout, grid, and design principles across digital and print.
- Experience designing transformative interactive experiences: front-end UI, narrative storytelling, systems thinking, prototyping, and production-ready assets.
- Proficiency in Figma, InDesign, Photoshop, and Illustrator.
- Strong art direction skills and background — experience concepting, directing, and executing photo and video shoots, and developing brand image systems from initial vision through final production assets.
- Experience creating brand guidelines and developing O&O digital campaigns at global scale.
- Understanding of motion design principles and how they integrate into brand systems.
- Experience working with world-class brand-focused design agencies or consultancies.
- Unwavering dedication to craft from first idea to final execution.
- Familiarity with the evolving AI landscape as it applies to design — including awareness of generative image and video tools, AI-assisted workflows, and emerging best practices — with a thoughtful point of view on how these tools can raise the creative bar without compromising craft or brand integrity.

title: Tecnico de manutenção , Amazon Reliability Maintenance Engineering - IntlRME
locations: Cabo De Santo Agostinho, PE, Brazil
descriptionHtml:
Esta é uma posição de tempo integral, permanente, presencial baseada em REC3-(Cabo de Santo Agost,BR) e não oferece benefícios de realocação. Os candidatos devem estar localizados e legalmente autorizados a trabalhar no Brasil para serem elegíveis para consideração.
A equipe de Engenharia de Manutenção e Confiabilidade (Reliability Maintenance Engineering - RME) na Amazon é fundamental para nossas operações - são eles que mantêm maquinários vitais funcionando o tempo todo. Como Técnico de RME, você fará a manutenção de uma ampla gama de equipamentos e espaços de trabalho, ao mesmo tempo em que mantém as melhores práticas de Saúde e Segurança. Você ajudará a manter seus colegas seguros e prevenir o tempo de inatividade das máquinas. Nossos Técnicos de RME aumentam a disponibilidade e qualidade de nossos equipamentos e também trabalham para melhorar o ambiente operacional.

Key job responsibilities
- Tarefas de manutenção proativa e preventiva em uma ampla gama de equipamentos do site.
- Realizar reparos reativos e diagnóstico de falhas em um centro de distribuição em operação.
- Utilizar as ferramentas mais recentes para maximizar a eficácia dos equipamentos.
- Manter todas as políticas e práticas de saúde e segurança.
- Apoiar o desenvolvimento e a progressão de aprendizes no local.
- Trabalhar em projetos de melhoria contínua e implementar as melhores práticas em diversos sites do Brasil.


A day in the life
Nossos Técnicos de RME estão baseados no site, para que possam responder rapidamente a quaisquer problemas com maquinários. Você realizará uma série de manutenções preventivas planejadas nos equipamentos de nossos sites para garantir que estejam funcionando com segurança. Como Técnico de RME, você também responderá prontamente a avarias, investigando, encontrando e implementando soluções o mais rápido possível. Você também fará sugestões para melhorias de longo prazo.

Trabalhando ao lado de colegas mais experientes, você realizará tarefas de manutenção diárias e fará a ligação com contratados se precisar de expertise externa. Você poderá trabalhar em uma variedade de turnos (dia ou noite) para garantir que nossos sites sejam apoiados 24 horas por dia - permitindo que a Amazon entregue na velocidade pela qual somos conhecidos.

About the team
Nossa equipe de Engenharia de Manutenção e Confiabilidade ou RME mantém nossos equipamentos funcionando em seu melhor desempenho. Somos uma equipe com mentalidade técnica, composta por excelentes jogadores de equipe e guiada por líderes experientes. Trabalhamos juntos para manter, solucionar problemas e reparar equipamentos em nossa rede global de centros de distribuição. Algumas de nossas pessoas são líderes, que supervisionam a equipe enquanto trabalham com tecnologia empolgante - algumas das quais existem apenas na Amazon.

Desde a instalação de sistemas automatizados de embalagem até a supervisão da manutenção geral de um site e o reparo de equipamentos-chave de distribuição, nossa equipe lida com a maioria dos aspectos técnicos da Amazon. Isso inclui manter os edifícios em conformidade legal, garantindo que todos estejam seguros e que nossos sites estejam operando com eficiência máxima. Há muitas oportunidades de progressão, tanto dentro da equipe de RME quanto mais amplamente na Amazon.

Trabalhamos para reduzir o tempo de inatividade nos sites cruciais de operações da Amazon, para que os clientes recebam seus pedidos no prazo. Se identificamos uma maneira melhor de fazer algo, temos as habilidades e a oportunidade de desenvolver e introduzir processos completamente novos ou tecnologias de ponta.

Basic qualifications

- Experiência em sistemas de manutenção preventiva programada
- Experiência em tarefas de manutenção mecânica e/ou elétrica
- Experiência em busca de falhas de sistemas de correias transportadoras (MHE, do inglês: Material Handling Equipment) e Automação
- Pensamento estratégico para buscar soluções de problemas
- Trabalhar em horário/turno/área de trabalho flexível, incluindo fins de semana, noites e/ou feriados
- Ensino médio completo ou diploma equivalente
- Experiência com produtos e aplicativos do Microsoft Office

Preferred qualifications

- Experiência com padrões de segurança de equipamentos de movimentação de materiais (MHE) de acordo com o fabricante original do equipamento (OEM) e normas de segurança
- Fluencia em inglês.
- Experiência com sistemas e controles de transportadores automatizados
- Experiência na realização de procedimentos de manutenção preditiva e preventiva

title: Delivery Station Customer Service Assoc - FT(40 Hours) - DSM4 - W Sacramento, CA
descriptionHtml:
Role: Full-Time Delivery Station Customer Service Associate
Job Type: Permanent
Location: 3620 Ramos Drive, West Sacramento, CA
Pay Rate: $20.20/hour
Schedule: Sunday-Thursday 11:00AM-8:00PM

At Amazon, our mission is to be Earth’s most customer-centric company. To achieve this goal, we strive to exceed expectations by innovating and providing best-in-class customer support as we expand our logistics products and services including improving how we fulfill and deliver customer orders. We’re making history and the good news is that we’ve only just begun. At Amazon you get to Work with smart, passionate people who are building new products and services every day on behalf of our customers.
As a Delivery Station Liaison, you will help improve the customer experience by providing in station real-time, hands-on support to ensure our customers receive their packages on time, as promised. The role will also help connect customers with experts who can provide them the most accurate and up-to-date information about their packages. The work is beyond fulfilling and delivering customer orders; it’s making sure we put smiles on customer’s faces.
As a Delivery Station Customer Service Associate, you will be responsible for:

  • Managing difficult customer situations while using empathy through phone and email; Responding promptly and prioritizing customer needs; Soliciting customer feedback to improve customer experience.
  • Analyzing data; Using stories and experience to complement data; Willing to seek out and develop work flows and procedures. Looking for ways to improve and promote quality; Demonstrating accuracy and thoroughness while meeting established deadlines.
  • Using Problem Solving skills to identify and resolve customer facing issues in a timely manner. Gathering and analyzing information skillfully to develop alternative solutions.
  • Effectively communicating; Listening and getting clarification; Focusing on solving customer needs, maintaining confidentiality and following policies and procedures.
  • Balancing team and individual responsibilities; Exhibiting objectivity and openness to others' views; Giving and receiving feedback; Contributing to building a positive team environment; Commitments to goals and objectives; Supporting team’s efforts to succeed.
  • Treating people with respect; Inspiring the trust of others; Supporting organizational values and goals with integrity.
  • Supporting affirmative action and respects diversity.
  • Carrying, lifting, pushing and pulling up to 49 pounds.
  • Standing, kneeling, crouching, and/or stretching during shifts up to 12 hours long.
  • Working in a warehouse production environment where noise level and temperatures vary (personal protective equipment provided)

Basic qualifications

Basic Qualifications

  • High School or equivalent diploma
  • Previous experience in Customer Service
  • Ability to effectively prioritize work time to ensure efficiency
  • Experience with Windows Operating Systems and Microsoft Outlook
  • Familiarity with multiple web browsers, data base searching and instant messenger tools
Preferred Qualifications
  • Bachelor Degree or equivalent work- related experience
  • Proficiency in verbal and written communication skills
  • Experience in understanding performance metrics and developing them to measure progress against key performance indicators

title: Atendimento ao Cliente -Temporário- Estado de Ceará-Brasil
descriptionHtml:
Estado de Ceará!
       Trabalhe em casa com o Atendimento ao Cliente da Amazon!

Cargo: Associado de Atendimento ao Cliente em Português.
Tipo de posição: Temporária em tempo integral.
Salário: R$ 1280
Localização: Trabalho em casa no Estado De Ceará

 A Amazon tem a missão de ser a melhor empresa de atendimento ao cliente do mundo, portanto, nossos representantes de atendimento ao cliente são essenciais para atingir esse objetivo. Para o nosso Centro de Atendimento no estado de Ceará, buscamos pessoas para o cargo de Representante de Atendimento ao Cliente na modalidade Trabalho Virtual que se identifiquem com os mais altos padrões de qualidade da Amazon, e tenham interesse em fazer carreira em uma empresa pioneira , dispostos a inventar e simplificar com base em nossos clientes.
O que você fará como Associado de Atendimento ao Cliente?
Como Associado de Atendimento ao Cliente da Amazon, você tem um propósito muito claro: evitar problemas, resolver dúvidas e encantar nossos clientes. Você será o primeiro ponto de contato para nossos clientes no mercado brasileiro, respondendo às suas solicitações por telefone, chat e/ou e-mail. Isso inclui tudo, desde perguntas sobre pedidos e produtos até problemas de pagamento e orientação do site.

Quais são os horários?

Esta função exige horários de trabalho que variam para coincidir com o momento em que os clientes mais precisam de nós. Você trabalhará em diferentes turnos e sua semana de trabalho é de no mínimo 36 horas. Para atender a demanda de nossos clientes, agendamos de acordo com uma variedade de padrões de turnos dentro do nosso horário de funcionamento das 06:00 às 24:00 de Segunda feira à Domingo. Você pode ser obrigado a trabalhar em feriados nacionais e será compensado de acordo com a lei. Você aprenderá mais sobre sua programação exata mais perto de sua data de início. 

Quais benefícios você receberá?
Uma das melhores coisas de se juntar à equipe de atendimento ao cliente da Amazon é que você não precisa de nenhuma experiência anterior de atendimento ao cliente. Você receberá treinamento e um pacote completo de equipamentos será fornecido quando você ingresar. Além disso, oferecemos uma série de benefícios, incluindo:
  • Seguro de vida e morte acidental  (Icatu)
  • Programa de Previdencia Complementar
  • Programa de Assistência ao Funcionário (EAP)
  • Vale Refeição - $836,00
  • Ajuda de custo Internet - $120,00
  • Treinamento remunerado
Se parece que esta posição é para você, clique no link abaixo para iniciar o processo de inscrição!
Você precisará de 1 a 2 horas para concluir a inscrição em sua totalidade, incluindo as avaliações que medirão sua adequação ao cargo. Recomendamos o uso de um laptop ou computador desktop para obter a melhor experiência. Você terá a opção de salvar sua inscrição entre cada etapa do processo de inscrição e retornar a ela, se necessário, mas recomendamos que você conclua o processo de uma vez só, sempre que possível. 

Se for selecionado, você será fornecido com um Lenovo Case o CPU, teclado, mouse, fone de ouvido e dois tokens de segurança. Certifique-se de que o endereço fornecido é um endereço exato e completo de onde você reside, de forma que possa receber o equipamento e garanta que não haja atrasos em seu recebimento. Adicione o número do apartamento(se houver). É de responsabilidade dos atendentes garantir uma conectividade à internet sem interrupções, e ter um ambiente ``semelhante a um escritório`` dentro de sua residência, para que possam oferecer o melhor desempenho em termos de produtividade e qualidade.   

A Amazon segue rigorosamente a Legislação Geral de Proteção dos Dados e informação pessoal que você fornece em sua candidatura, e a gerenciará e cumprirá às exigências legais correspondentes. De forma particular, não iremos compartilhar suas informações pessoais com terceiros sem seu consentimento prévio, a não ser por determinação legal. A Amazon conservará sua informação numa base de dados eletrônica armazenada pela Amazon.com nos Estados Unidos ou, outros escritórios da Amazon desde que, autorizado previamente por você. Para maiores informações sobre o armazenamento e processamento da sua informação pessoal na Amazon, por favor, acesse o seguinte endereço: http://www.amazon.jobs/ . 

Se você passar em todos os testes, entraremos em contato com os próximos passos!

Basic qualifications

Requisitos Obrigatórios:

  • Ter mais de: 18 anos
  • Residir no Estado de Ceará.
  •  Fortes habilidades de comunicação em Português
  •  Experiência em trabalhar com um computador
  • Diploma do ensino médio completo.
  • Identidade nacional ou cartão de residência com situação migratória legal no País.
  • Você precisará de um espaço de trabalho tranquilo e livre de distrações (espaço de mesa dedicado com cadeira).
  • A disponibilidade para trabalhar em vários turnos de segunda à domingo no horário de funcionamento de 06h e 24h
  • Você precisará de um espaço de trabalho tranquilo e livre de distrações (escritório dedicado com mesa e cadeira)
  • Do ponto de vista técnico, uma velocidade mínima de conexão de banda larga (download de 10 MGB / upload de 2 MBG ou superior) usando uma conexão de internet hard-wire ethernet (sem WIFI).
Que pontos fortes você trará? 
  • Orientação para o detalhe e elevada capacidade de organização.
  • Amigável e focado no cliente em todas as situações.
  • Capacidade de aprender rapidamente e abraçar a mudança.
  • Adaptabilidade a um ambiente multitarefa acelerado, enérgico.

title: 日语客服代表BB-2025Q2
descriptionHtml:
职位：日语客服代表
地点：大连


亚马逊的使命是成为地球上最以客户为中心的公司，而我们备受称赞的客户服务团队正是实现这一目标的关键。为我们的客户做到最好是我们的能量来源，我们会不同的方式处理问题，您不会被要求照本宣科或死记硬背。相反，我们将为您提供所有解决客户问题所需的培训。在这里，您有机会在每一次与客户的对话中展示出您的个性，提供出色的客服支持。

作为一名客户服务代表，您将做什么？
作为一名亚马逊客户服务代表，您将需要通过电话、在线聊天和/或电子邮件的形式向客户提供从订单和产品问题到付款事宜和网站指导等一切相关支持以及解决方案。同时，作为客户的第一联系人，您需要及时回复客户投诉问题和客户意见，在系统中准确记录客户的问题及对应情况，并与客户进行有效沟通。

您的工作时间是什么？
为了更好的提供客户服务支持，配合客户的时间，我们的工作时间并不固定。我们根据各种不同的轮班模式来安排工作时间，通常而言，每周出勤5天，休息2天。每天出勤9小时，包含8小时工作时间以及1小时休息时间。在线聊天/邮件业务每天覆盖的班次最早6:00 上班，最晚为23:30 下班。大连电话业务每天覆盖的班次最早6:00 上班，最晚为23:30 下班。您有可能需要在法定节假日工作，并将获得相应的报酬。

Basic qualifications
